nodes.name: peer-mediated-contingency
nodes.mech: Recruit a peer GROUP as auxiliary change-agents by yoking its reinforcement topology to the target behavior and posting each member's status publicly, so peers monitor, pressure, and coordinate with each other atop the operator's direct contingency. The yoking structure is the parameter — VARIANTS: (a) general public-status substrate [peer-mediated] — public/consequential status alone recruits peer pressure regardless of how rewards are yoked; (b) all-or-none interdependent [interdependent-group] — reward hinges on a collective criterion (group total/mean), 'all earn or none do', with an optional defensive individual-overlay to neutralize defectors; (c) dependent 'hero-gates-all' [dependent-group] — one member's performance gates the whole group's reward, converting peer hostility into positive attention on the 'hero'. All three ride the same peer-as-change-agent graph; pick the yoking that fits who should gate whose reward.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when a co-present GROUP under a shared contingency can be turned into reinforcers of each other — the lever is peer monitoring/pressure yoked to reward, and you choose the yoking (public-status substrate / all-or-none / hero-gates-all). NOT belonging-recruitment (social-proof-belonging-enrollment — membership pull of a converted cohort, no reward-yoking) and NOT peer-authored-target-selection (peers author the agenda, they do not gate the reward).

nodes.name: arc-ordering-dependency
nodes.mech: A whole-artifact structural move in which the ORDERING and inter-dependency of phases is the operative lever, not any single passage: an earlier phase installs the belief, agreement, in-body evidence, dissolved subject, or loaded carrier that a later, more costly phase depends on, so each expensive command arrives already load-bearing and lands without in-the-moment argument. Realized forms include install-before-spend dependency sequencing (a doubt-defeater before the multipliers, a tautology before the ruin, an absolute rule before its sanctioned exception before a meta-trigger so the exception reads as a found escape) — of which ALIBI-THEN-PAYLOAD is the deniability variant: a blameless external cause or premise-chain (a pseudo-scientific biochemistry lecture, a words-become-truth / resistance-is-impossible theory) is installed in the front half so back-half compulsion commands inherit an unfalsifiable self-owned justification and 'you can't resist' reads as anatomy or agreed reasoning; calibrate-then-exploit ladders (freeze 1 makes freeze 3 believable) — of which MIRRORED-BLOCK CREDIBILITY-INHERITANCE is the reuse variant: two structurally mirrored blocks run an identical formula pointed at different variables (a doubling countdown for depth, then the same doubling countdown for pleasure-into-orgasm) so the second block inherits the felt credibility the first already proved, arriving as pre-validated and inevitable; sell-the-frame-then-induce (dialogic priming occupying half the runtime so trance delivers an already-agreed idea); a dissolve-then-install bipartite arc where Act I empties the listener-as-subject so Act II writes to the prepared shell unresisted (pronoun-collapse hinge); an ordered agency-drain / capability strip-out staircase where each rung reuses the state the prior produced and refusing the next feels like breaking continuity; a ratchet whose payload is infrastructure for future sessions; and self-extending carrier-wave / docking-module scaffolds whose non-uniform cycles exist to deliver specific mid-sequence payloads. The engineering is invisible from within any one passage; removing an earlier phase leaves the later one merely asserted or unmotivated.
nodes.disc: This is the scheduler, not the individual rule-install or suggestion moves it schedules: the mechanism is the RELATIONSHIP ACROSS phases (ordering/dependency), which survives removal of any single passage, while removing the dependency guts the payload. It differs from ordinary sequencing because reordering (exception first, belief after the move) would leave each move negotiable or unsupported, and from a monotone one-way contour — which survives deletion of any one stage and needs no per-stage precondition — because here stage N is the substrate for N+1. Reach for the ALIBI-THEN-PAYLOAD framing when the earlier phase must supply DENIABILITY (a blameless cause so the payload reads as self-justified, not coerced); reach for MIRRORED-BLOCK CREDIBILITY-INHERITANCE when the dependency is REUSE of one proven formula across two blocks so the second inherits the first's demonstrated credibility. Both are the same 'earlier phase makes the later land' lever with a different precondition in the install slot.

nodes.name: consent-topology-arc
nodes.mech: A whole-script arc whose operative property is the topology of the CONSENT surface across the artifact, not any single passage. Realized forms: a bait-and-switch that opens promising one low-stakes state (relaxation, listening) and ends delivering a heavier terminal state (automatic obedience), so consent gathered for relaxation is cashed out as obedience with no passage flagging the bridge; an install-consume-export ratchet in three acts (Act 1 installs a tool using only generic euphoria so it sits loaded, Act 2 consumes it via a pretext-pivot ladder firing the trigger between rungs, Act 3 exports it via retroactive consent + waking binding + resistance-as-stress), each phase converting something reversible into something hard to undo AND neutralizing the listener's capacity to evaluate the next; a no-baseline / already-lost frame that never offers a pre-trance baseline (line 1 is inside the spell, prior consent happened off-page) so every threshold is a re-encounter and there is never a 'before' to consent from; and a train-neutral-deploy-loaded bifurcation that drills a reflex on meaningless material then reuses the identical loop with operative concepts, so consent is captured while the mechanism is still meaningless and cannot be revoked once it carries meaning. The shared lever is that the arc forecloses or relocates the 'am I consenting?' gate.
nodes.disc: Cited to the whole-arc consent topology, never to one line — reading only the open or only the close misses the shape. Members differ in WHAT is done to the consent surface: bait-switch swaps the promised STATE without flagging it; the ratchet phases an explicitly installed TOOL through install/consume/export; the no-baseline frame removes the starting baseline so there is never a 'before'; the neutral-then-loaded split moves the consent moment away from the payload moment on one reused reflex. Distinct from a discrete consent-manufacture move that relabels a single refusal — these are standing whole-arc topologies, not one relabel.

nodes.name: frame-lamination-non-return
nodes.mech: The script stacks two or more narrative/procedural frames and then structurally fails to reopen the outer one(s), leaving the listener stranded in the innermost layer at exit, with a dependency-relation between layers that launders each into the next. Realized forms: a story-in-a-story where three nested layers fuse and the outer frames are abandoned so emergence wakes the listener from trance but not from the dream; a domestic-narrative envelope wrapping every hypnotic operation with no metalanguage break naming a procedure, never closing the outer frame so memory residue is narrative-not-procedural (which eases amnesia); and a three-layer ritual nesting where each layer launders the next (fantasy makes the prescription feel sacred, the prescription makes the fantasy feel like preparation, the chant acquires retroactive provenance). The lever is the topology of frames — laminating them so no line ever restores the outer reality — not any single utterance.
nodes.disc: The mechanism is the FAILURE-to-return / the dependency-relation between layers across the whole back half, cited only to the absence of a closing beat, never to one line. Distinct from a normal framed-narrative induction that returns to its frame at the end (the tell is that there is no 'and then I woke up'). Distinct from energy-contour engineering (that is about charge/depth shape; this is about frame topology and whether outer frames re-open).

nodes.name: goal-state-topology-inversion
nodes.mech: An authored inversion of a genre's expected goal-state TOPOLOGY: a promised discrete climactic event (here an [HFO] hands-free orgasm) is never delivered as an event and is replaced by a sustained, indefinitely-continuous plateau explicitly named as never reaching its peak, with the structurally climactic beat relocated to the operator's cessation (turning the tap off). Recoding orgasm from event to continuous state buys durability-via-vagueness — a listener who cannot come on cue still receives the structure, and one who comes early is reframed as still inside the plateau. The lever is reshaping the target-state's temporal topology so the payload cannot fail against the listener's actual response.
nodes.disc: Separates from a conventional climax/discharge move because there is NO discrete named release; the property is the state-vs-event reshaping of the whole arc's goal topology. Separates from arc-ordering-dependency because the mechanism is a single global topology inversion, not a dependency between ordered phases.

nodes.name: irreversible-ratchet-persistence
nodes.mech: Reframes discrete resettable cycles as deposits onto a one-way, irreversible-feeling scalar, so each compliance-cycle feels like it leaves a permanent loss and resistance to any single cycle feels futile. In one instance each sink/sleep/drop is bound to a one-way decrement of an inner value (IQ), asserted automatic and cumulative ('it's accumulative'), with a 'you won't notice it at first' clause that pre-empts the introspective check by making a null result the expected result. In another, each loop's 'wake' begins from a physically worse posture than the last (bed to kneeling to crawling), so each iteration starts where the prior ended rather than at baseline — the same one-way ratchet, carried by external posture/mobility markers instead of a named scalar.
nodes.disc: An explicit one-way accumulative ratchet on a countable/repeatable event (each descent, each loop) reframing resettable cycles as permanent progress-toward-loss. Unlike intensity multiplier-stacking (which escalates an INTENSITY by naming doubling/compounding), this monotonically DECREMENTS/degrades and never resets; unlike fractionation (which oscillates depth around a baseline), this never returns to baseline; and unlike total-permeation (a spatial spread claim), this is a temporal one-way accumulation. The two variants differ only in vehicle: a named inner scalar vs external posture markers.

nodes.name: manufactured-self-confirmation
nodes.mech: A whole-script stacked-deck architecture in which the script never argues for its claims but engineers the listener's own body to produce the sensation each claim predicts, so the claim is validated by evidence a prior move guaranteed would arise. Pose-induced arousal becomes felt proof of receptivity; procedural recall loads the working memory a later move overwrites; a predicted post-session hand-lift is set up to occur if rehearsal succeeded. The listener experiences the script as uncannily accurate because at each step the deck was stacked — each move's claim is confirmed by a sensation the previous move manufactured.
nodes.disc: Separates from a script that merely references the body because the tell is a deliberate stacked-deck CHAIN where each step guarantees the evidence the next step cites — the evidence is manufactured, not observed. Distinct from reader-directed self-sealing-evidence (confirmation frames that make no observation able to disconfirm): this acts on the LISTENER and manufactures POSITIVE self-confirming somatic evidence, rather than proofing a method against a reader's disconfirmation.

nodes.name: monotonic-no-reversal-contour
nodes.mech: A whole-arc energy/trajectory shape authored as a deliberate object: one or more named state-variables (arousal, depth, surrender, craving, lock-in, resistance-erosion) are driven in a single direction across the entire artifact and never permitted to reverse. The script omits fractionation, almost-waking passes, and contrast/relief beats, so the listener is given no rest interval in which resistance can re-assemble; depth is built by accumulation rather than contrast, and even 'release' beats (orgasm, a nominal wake) are coded as more locking rather than a return to baseline. Realized contours: a monotonic accumulation punctuated by discrete event-markers (avatar arrives, machine starts) that prevent plateau; a flat-flat-flat-spike-flat deferral storing charge across a long calm stretch for one terminal release; a strictly upward depth-and-arousal ramp refusing any relief valve so suggestibility concentrates into a single late window where the load-bearing payload lands; a descending dissolution gradient starving the listener of stable referents as depth increases; and — as the cycling-engine variant — a repeated sawtooth of induction/partial-wake where each apparent wake sets a fresh baseline the next drop compounds from, so depth accumulates cycle-over-cycle and cross-state trigger demos become possible. The signature is affirmative: a design fact named by its negative space (the ABSENCE of a reversal beat), a property of sequence and density across the whole text, not a per-move magnitude change.
nodes.disc: Cited to the absence-of-counter-direction / whole-arc gradient, never to one line — removing a single passage leaves the contour intact, removing the contour guts the effect. Distinct from any per-line induction or deepener (which IS citable). The cycling-engine variant (fractionation architecture) makes repeated wake/sleep cycles the deepening engine with cross-state trigger demonstration as its payoff; the pure-contour instances make the one-way SHAPE the object and any cycles present serve it. Separates from load-bearing dependency-ordering because no stage is a precondition for the next — any one stage is removable and the monotone property survives.

nodes.name: operator-voice-absence
nodes.mech: The artifact contains no operator speech at all: every line is grammatically the listener's own first-person statement, and the operator exists only as a character the listener describes. All delivery affordances of an operator-voiced session (pause markers, breathing cues, spoken instructions) are absent, so the trance work normally done by an operator voice acting on a listener is done by the listener acting on themselves — the operator is generated by the listener as a byproduct of reading/reciting. Because the suggestions arrive authored-as-self, there is no external speaker for criticality to refuse (the refusal surface is removed by the voice topology, not by any counter-argument), and the artifact functions as a self-reinforcing between-session maintenance device: content is installed by the listener's own reading voice.
nodes.disc: Membership requires TOTAL absence of operator speech — the whole document is the listener's voice, not first-person passages embedded in an operator-voiced session. vs mantra/echo work: there an operator assigns and frames the repetition inside an operator-voiced delivery; here no separate speaker exists anywhere. vs agent-graph-restructuring: no role is reassigned between present agents — the operator role is structurally unfilled by construction (boundary case: when voice-collapse comes WITH maid/doll role-fusion and the fusion axis dominates, that stays agent-graph). vs carrier-medium-binding: the leverage is who authors/voices the content (source signature), not the physical carrier's form.

nodes.name: reader-assent-architecture
nodes.mech: A whole-chapter/whole-file rhetorical architecture whose target is the READER (an operator-in-training) or the whole-file assent/resistance surface, not a single passage: the text is built so a method reads as obviously correct or inevitable by the time it is stated, by priming the reader's stance before the claim arrives, and/or so the listener's reachable-response and self-monitoring set is closed as a standing property. Instances: recoding resistance as legitimate function so 'satisfy all objecting parts' reads as inevitable; letting the subject 'discover' each control parameter then having the operator ratify it as method (follow-and-formalize); offering a naive fixed-step model then placing it on extinction to shape the reader toward the closer approximation; front-loading a system's removal as its design goal so every construction choice reads as provisional scaffolding; teaching a consent-economics stance across cases as one spine disguised as independent tips; pre-claiming every possible push-direction as an operator tool so no open resistance vector remains; naming the manipulation openly so critical awareness becomes a participation marker instead of a defense; and elevating a local disjunction-collapse move to a pervasive stance applied to every self-monitoring yardstick including memory. The lever is stance-priming / negative-space closure across the whole artifact — it survives removal of any single block.
nodes.disc: Separates from every operator-on-listener dimension move because the target is the reader's belief about a method or the whole-file resistance/monitoring surface, not a moment's listener x(t). Separates from a single persuasive passage because it is a distributed whole-text architecture surviving removal of any one block. Distinct from self-sealing-evidence (freud/jung confirmation frames that make no observation able to DISCONFIRM): this makes the method read as ALREADY-AGREED before it is stated, or leaves no refusal channel open in the first place — assent-manufacture / response-foreclosure, not disconfirmation-proofing. Distinct from a discrete consent-manufacture move relabeling non-consent — these do not relabel a refusal, they foreclose the vector as a standing property.

nodes.name: total-permeation
nodes.mech: Installs a belief that the conditioning is a distributed property of the whole self rather than a localized, session-scoped phenomenon — the trait is framed as spread across every internal layer (mind, body, subconscious), so it cannot be compartmentalized or bracketed to trance-time. The fetish/submission is asserted to be 'not a localized phenomenon... part of everything that you are,' planted at the widest, most-lucid aperture so the claim slips in framed as discovery rather than instruction, weaponized so that later resistance reads as self-contradiction.
nodes.disc: A one-time distributed-property belief-install (the trait is everywhere in you) planted at the widest aperture. Distinct from resistance-recasting moves — here resistance reading as self-contradiction is a downstream side-effect, not the lever — from the outward viral-propagation-directive (permeation is internal-only, never person-to-person), and from irreversible-ratchet-persistence (permeation is a spatial spread claim, not a one-way accumulation on a countable event).

nodes.name: attention-anchor-portable-internalization
nodes.mech: A focal object is authored entirely by the operator but attributed to the listener — built, it is claimed, from the listener's own closed-eye imagery or dream material ('I took all the pretty patterns and pulses from when you close your eyes') — then internalized (transferred inside the head) as the portable pacing object for everything after. The parasitic provenance means the listener cannot reject its contents without rejecting their own internal imagery, so it feels non-impositional; eye-closure removes the external check that it isn't actually pulsing; and once internalized the operator can cite 'the pulse' at will while the listener supplies the metronome, decoupling depth from operator narration.
nodes.disc: Separated from ordinary external-fixation induction by the parasitic-provenance attribution (the prop is claimed to be made of the listener's own mind) and the internalization into a portable self-supplied pacer. Separated from eye-fatigue-convincer's remembered-point member — there the internal anchor is a mere memory of a real external point ratified by fatigue; here the object is operator-authored content laundered as the listener's own so it cannot be disowned.

nodes.name: countdown-descent
nodes.mech: A monotonic ordinal count (typically 10-to-1 or 5-to-1, occasionally an inverted 1-to-10) is run as the absorption/depth vehicle: each numbered step is bound to descent, relaxation, or accumulation imagery so the count itself drives the state change and the terminal number lands a declared trance. The count supplies punctual, one-directional structure the listener surrenders into — resistance must fight a sequence that only moves one way toward the floor. Variants realize the same descent through a persistent distinct surface (styling metaphor, inevitable proprioceptive milestone, prose camouflage, deliberate rhythm-breakage, lowered-consent framing, listener-set floor, per-number functional load) without changing the underlying counted-descent lever.
nodes.disc: The count is the descent vehicle and the state moves smoothly toward a floor under the assumption of cooperation. Reach for it OVER count/cue-sabotage — there the count is deliberately corrupted or its direction voided so tracking FAILS (disorientation is the goal); here the orderly descent IS the mechanism. It is not numerical depth-work on an ALREADY-tranced subject — here the count itself produces the descent — and it is not a no-fail count (there every branch is pre-coded success; here the count can fail if the subject stops cooperating). One realization interleaves a mantra loop BETWEEN the numbers so the count does double duty (deepen + deliver payload) — a composition on the same clean-descent lever.

nodes.name: adverse-attentional-state-recruitment
nodes.mech: Rather than fighting an adverse attentional state, the operator recruits the subject's CURRENT attentional posture — whichever way it fails the conventional induction — as the working vehicle, so no attentional failure-state remains available and the exit-justification is deleted. Two opposite presenting states, one move: (a) drift/distraction recruitment — the operator names the divided or wandering attention the listener is already in (half-listening while doing a background task) and relabels it as the session's substance, never asking them to stop or close their eyes, so distraction becomes proof it's working; or the wandering-mind failure is named BEFORE it happens and its recovery pre-prescribed (bring attention back to the voice) so drift becomes a self-correcting re-bind rather than a trance-breaking event; (b) effort/strain recruitment — the operator cancels the expected relaxation frame and swaps in an effortful focus task, or inverts a let-go induction into deliberate conscious control ('be very mindful' before mindless), or sets an engineered-unresolvable target so failure is recoded as insufficient focus and drives more attending, or equates any lapse of focus with falling into trance, or commands 'pay attention' as a defense against influence so obeying IS the trance-producing narrowing. Either way the framing pre-defines every attentional posture as trance so both compliance and resistance deepen.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the listener is ALREADY in an attentional state that would normally break the induction (drifting, distracted, effortfully straining, jaded) and you want to convert that exact state into the vehicle — the payload is deleting the exit ('I'm too distracted / this is too much effort for this to work'). Choose it OVER fixation and cognitive-quieting, which install a NEW narrowing or emptying; here nothing new is installed, the present posture is relabeled. Unlike a resistance-paradox reframe, which recruits a RESISTANCE impulse, what is recruited here is attentional drift or effortful attention, not resistance. Unlike confusion/overload techniques, the engineered-unresolvable-target form's payload is sustained ATTENDING, not an overload harvest. Drift-recruitment (make wandering attention the substance / pre-prescribe its recovery) and effort-recruitment (recruit sustained effort with a no-win frame where both compliance and resistance deepen) are the two poles of this one relabel-the-current-posture move.

nodes.name: faculty-preserving-scope-restriction
nodes.mech: Leaves the act of thinking/evaluating intact but constrains what it may range over, so the listener still experiences themselves as thinking freely while their critical faculty has been pre-narrowed. Two surface forms of one lever: (a) narrowing the evaluative gatekeeper — the function that decides 'is this important, should I attend?' — to a small explicit allowlist ('all that is important is listening, relaxing, going deeper'), so anything outside it (noise, stray thought, itch) is preclassified as unimportant before it arises; and (b) bracketing behavioral suggestions with 'you don't want to think about anything BUT [looking/sucking]', handing the listener a restricted domain to think within so the object of thought is confined. Either way the evaluative channel is dampened while the felt sense of free thought is preserved, so later suggestions land without pushback and resistance is hard because the listener is still allowed to think — just told what about / what counts.
nodes.disc: Keeps the faculty active but restricts its scope (relevance-allowlist or object-confinement). Distinct from a blunt 'stop thinking' command (bypassable suppression) and from techniques that quiet or empty thought — thoughts drifting away, or an already-present blankness — which remove thinking rather than confine it. The tell is preservation of thinking plus preclassification/confinement of what it may range over — not emptiness.

nodes.name: fixation-covert-or-undeliverable-onset
nodes.mech: Fixation is delivered so the subject never receives (or cannot refuse) an explicit, recognized 'focus on this' instruction. The focal capture is either diegetic (justified by the fiction so the subject is already attending), disguised inside a socially-expected gesture (a handshake folding in observation, rapport, and eye-fatigue), structurally undeliverable (an audio-only 'spiral' the listener must hallucinate or accept, with 'you can't look away' unfalsifiable), borrowed from a caretaker frame (a casualty-opener plea landing fixation while the listener is in rescuer mode), or forced onto the body prior to any decision (a head physically tipped to the target so looking is a body-fact). In every case the choose-to-attend frame conventional inductions rely on is removed, lowering awareness of being inducted and foreclosing 'choose to look away' as an exit.
nodes.disc: Separated from plain fixation by the absence of a recognized, refusable focus command. Separated from agency-displacement (there the induction is overt but the object is credited; here the recognition itself is suppressed or the choice is removed). The unifying rule is delivery that denies the subject the recognize-and-refuse juncture.

nodes.name: fixation-eye-fatigue-convincer
nodes.mech: A fixation task is engineered to manufacture a genuine, reliable physiological event — ocular muscle fatigue / eyelid heaviness — that the operator predicts in advance and reframes in real time as trance heaviness or sleepiness. Because the strain is real physiology produced by the task (a moving descending target denying saccades, an upward gaze held beneath closed lids, cross-coupled nose-gaze plus breath load, or a drain-and-remember stare), the operator's prediction is self-fulfilling. The felt sensation becomes the first hard 'the suggestion came true' data point that licenses eye closure and banks operator credibility.
nodes.disc: Separated from plain fixation by the manufactured-physiology convincer: attention narrowing is not the payload — a predicted bodily event is, reframed as suggestion success. Separated from the eye-closure move, which is the closure act itself; here the distinctive move is the fatigue-generating fixation that ratifies the heaviness before closure. Separated from portable-internalization: an internal remembered anchor is a secondary feature of one variant, not the lever.

nodes.name: fixation-object-agency-displacement
nodes.mech: A fixation object is not merely attended but is credited with the causal agency for the attention or the trance itself, shifting the subject's locus of control off the self and onto an operator-controlled artifact. The pull is attributed to the object ('it simply pulls you in', 'catches the eyes like a net'), or the object is framed as the cause of obedience, or the induction labor is exported to an external self-running loop the voice merely narrates, or the effect is credited to a launched program while the operator's voice 'recedes', or the pull is sourced from the listener's own folk-model of hypnosis the operator only 'confirms'. Once agency is displaced, any wandering attention reads as the object working rather than as failure, so no resistance signal is observable and residual skepticism finds no target.
nodes.disc: Separated from plain fixation (there the object is inert) by the causal attribution: the object/artifact is credited as the cause. Separated from covert-onset variants (there the subject does not recognize the induction; here the induction is overt but the AGENCY is relocated). Separated from function-inversion (the object's role stays 'cause of attention' throughout; it is not repurposed into an aperture or descent vehicle).

nodes.name: fixation
nodes.mech: Narrows the subject's attention onto one operator-chosen focus so competing stimuli fall away and absorption/suggestibility climb — the receptive-substrate primitive other absorption moves depend on. The focus can be an external point, a voice, an imagined image, a person, a rhythmic body channel, or even the accessible word-space itself; delivery framing varies (misattribution to infatuation, aesthetic appraisal, focus asserted as already-accomplished fact, a geometric attention-rail, a narrated substitute for an absent visual). Realized forms, each a parametric surface on the one single-channel narrowing lever: (a) object-function-inversion — an established focal object's ROLE is flipped mid-script (stabilizer becomes descent-vehicle, frame becomes window) while the object persists; (b) non-canonical-object fixation — the focus is a decoy entity or a manufactured internal affect chosen so attending does secondary work (parks the monitor off the commanding voice, or amplifies an installed feeling); (c) re-attention/gestalt reveal — a one-shot 'look again' re-attends to an already-present latent percept so it surfaces into foreground; (d) kinesthetic entrainment — a gentle rhythmic sway/motion in time with the voice is the focal channel (calm baseline, stoppable, install-free); (e) closed-vocabulary lexical narrowing — the accessible lexicon is shrunk to a declared closed set so all cognition must route through operator-chosen words.
nodes.disc: Reach for fixation when the tool is simple single-channel narrowing onto a focus to build absorption, under the assumption of cooperation. Choose it OVER the neighboring attention techniques: vs covert-or-undeliverable-onset — there the focus command is unrecognizable/non-refusable or forced on the body, a different consent profile; here the subject knowingly attends. vs the eye-fatigue convincer — there a REAL manufactured ocular fatigue is banked as suggestion-success (a credibility convincer), not narrowing. vs cognitive-quieting — that empties ongoing thought; fixation holds a focus. vs voice-absorption — that fills mental space with the voice; fixation narrows onto a target that need not be the voice. The realized forms (role-inversion, decoy-object, gestalt reveal, kinesthetic sway, closed-lexicon) are surfaces of THIS lever, not separate tools; their tells: the focal object's role stays constant in plain fixation (the inversion form flips it); the focus is a percept/voice/point/rhythm (the decoy form uses a non-perceptual construct); narrowing is sustained (the gestalt reveal is one-shot).

nodes.name: mantra-repetition
nodes.mech: Self-directed repetition of a short, meaning-bearing phrase the listener speaks, subvocalizes, or chants, so the phrase both saturates attention (absorption via rhythmic repetition) and encodes its propositional/identity content as self-asserted belief rather than received suggestion. The listener performs the deepening labor with their own voice; the phrase's content ('I am a slave', 'obedience is arousal', 'I want to be mindless') is installed as something the listener said rather than heard. Frequent riders — a per-utterance depth/arousal multiplier, a numeric or breath spine, a gratitude wrapper — are components layered on the core self-chant, not separate mechanisms.
nodes.disc: Self-directed (listener produces the phrase) and the phrase RETAINS meaning it encodes through repetition — distinguishes from operator-directed call-and-response, from satiation-depatterning (repetition STRIPS meaning rather than encoding it), and from rhyme-prosody-bypass (the poetic form, not repetition, does the work). The phrase is chosen/instructed and coherent, not framed as an involuntary intrusive thought and not reduced to a contentless affect-cue.

nodes.name: recall-recognition-reentry
nodes.mech: Open straight into descent by PRESUPPOSING a trance the listener already owns and asking them to recognise/recall it rather than enter one. No induction ramp, no rapport build, no relaxation work, and — critically — no discrete installed cue is fired. The state-shift is offloaded onto the listener's own associative/retrieval machinery ('the mere thought of that trance brings on a new trance'; 'returned once again... already'; 'go back into that familiar place'), often keyed to a separate referenced prior artifact (an earlier file/installment). Because the listener is engaged retrieving rather than evaluating, the 'is it working yet' check is bypassed, and file-selection may be reframed as retroactive consent. The move is inert on a listener with no stored prior trance to draw on.
nodes.disc: NO cue is fired — the induction is the listener recognising or recalling a pre-owned/prior trance. Separate from conditioned-anchor-drop (which fires a discrete installed anchor). Separate from natural-state-suggestion (which exploits a NATURAL sleep state, no prior conditioning). The tell is presuppositional cross-session re-entry that does zero induction work and idles on anyone without a stored prior trance.

nodes.name: semantic-satiation-depatterning
nodes.mech: A single word or short phrase is repeated far past the point of emphasis (dozens to ~100+ consecutive iterations, often with syntax abandoned entirely) so that semantic content evaporates and the token becomes a pure prosodic carrier / affect-cue. The parsing apparatus has nothing to parse and idles; internal verbalization is crowded out; past ~10 reps only affective residue remains. The stripped token then functions as a depatterner that lowers evaluative processing of surrounding content, and/or as a pre-loaded contentless cue the operator can later weaponize, and/or (terminal placement) as a state-fixative that cements whatever state the listener is in. The mechanism depends on DURATION/COUNT, not content — the opposite goal of mantra-repetition's encode-through-repetition.
nodes.disc: Repetition to STRIP meaning (satiation) rather than to encode it (mantra-repetition, a short phrase 4-6x for absorption). Distinguished from opaque-foreign-mantra (there meaning is defeated by foreignness/gloss, not by count) and from rhyme-prosody-bypass (there the poetic completion-constraint, not sheer count, does the work). The tell is sheer count crossing into visible meaning-loss, on words placed as induction/deepener/fixative, with grammar dissolving into tone.

nodes.name: somatic-port-installation
nodes.mech: A single fixed attentional focal point (typically the brow / 'between the eyes') is progressively reskinned into a fictional penetrable somatic organ — a 'mind hole' or forehead port — through which all later content is said to enter and leave. The listener keeps tracking the same spot across covert renamings (flower to hole to genital), so attentional-focus cues and sexual-arousal/penetration cues fuse onto one body location and deepening language doubles as arousal language. The port then serves as reusable bidirectional infrastructure: diffuse suggestion gets one concrete somatic container, the listener checks 'is it in yet?' by a body location rather than a cognitive state, and a resistance-gating clause ('can't slide in unless you relax') converts felt resistance into a reason to relax more.
nodes.disc: Separated from plain fixation (which only narrows attention to a point) and from persistent-metaphor by manufacturing a NEW proprioceptive channel / body-map node — a fictional topology element, not a magnitude move — through which content is repeatedly routed and by which resistance is gated. The load-bearing feature is the port as reusable somatic-loading infrastructure plus embedded trigger, not scenic imagery.

nodes.name: voice-absorption
nodes.mech: The operator's speech is installed as the listener's sole standing input — attended-to not as external speech but as the substance filling the listener's mind — so analytic listening dissolves into a single receptive channel and later suggestion arrives on a pre-cleared line. Realized by asserting/repeating that the voice fills mental space, replaces inner monologue, or becomes the listener's own thoughts (saturated exclusivity 'only my words matter', words-as-substance filling an emptied mind, recursive listen-to-the-listening binding, progressive sensory subtraction to a voice-only field, the standing every-word-is-descent idle deepener, and the self-sealing wrinkle where an apparent counter-thought is pre-labeled as operator content). Further realized forms, parametric surfaces on the one narrow-to-the-voice-as-sole-channel lever: (a) kinesthetic envelopment — the voice is figured as a warm physical covering ('wrapped up warm in my words') so hearing becomes being held, with a silence-becomes-cold aversion hook; (b) appetitive recode — the voice channel is re-skinned as an ever-sweetening cravable object the listener chases, so absorption self-amplifies via their own wanting; (c) trust-transfer delivery — the voice is first merged INTO an imagined vehicle (hands), then the vehicle is faded and declared gone, transferring the vehicle's rapport/trust-bank onto the voice; (d) meaning-to-sound relocation — attention is moved from parsed meaning to the voice's acoustic carrier (words demoted as 'indistinct', voice reframed as originating inside the listener's own mind), starving the channel through which claims would be judged.
nodes.disc: Reach for voice-absorption when the VOICE'S own pull is the lever — it fills/replaces mental space as the sole standing channel. Choose it OVER fixation — that narrows onto a target that need not be the voice; here the voice itself becomes the field. vs environmental-dissociation — that SUBTRACTS competing external input so the voice is what remains; here the voice's filling/pull does the work, not subtraction. vs cognitive-quieting — that empties thought; here the voice occupies the emptied line. An escalating voice-as-will substitution that ratchets past receptive-channel into identity/will belongs to the deeper voice-as-mind-substrate staircase, not here. The reward-surface skins (kinesthetic warmth with a cold-aversion hook; appetitive craving chased forward) and the delivery paths (trust-transfer from a dismantled vehicle; meaning-to-sound acoustic relocation, which additionally disables proposition-evaluation) are all realizations of THIS lever, not separate techniques.

nodes.name: voice-as-mind-substrate
nodes.mech: A graded presuppositional staircase that promotes the operator's voice from external audio all the way to the listener's will and identity. It opens asserting the voice is already inside the head, then ratchets in strict-superset stages (voice between the ears, words become your thoughts, voice IS the sound of your thoughts, fills every crevice, becomes your whole world), ending with forced first-person recitation and 'my will is your will'. Collapses the perceptual distance between external audio and interior monologue by presupposition rather than argument; each stage is a superset of the last so the identity/will substitution lands as one more step on a staircase already climbed, feeling already-accomplished rather than argued for.
nodes.disc: Exceeds voice-absorption (which stops at replacing inner dialogue with a suggestion-receptive channel) by continuing to ratchet the same voice-is-thoughts move through will and identity substitution. Distinct from planting specific first-person CONTENT as the listener's own thoughts — here the escalation is on the voice's ONTOLOGICAL STATUS (audio->thoughts->will), not on installed propositions. Distinct from possessive ownership language: this is voice-as-substrate presupposition, not possessive labeling. The tell is the graded staircase with no single decisive assertion point.

nodes.name: amnesia-wrapped-command
nodes.mech: Installs a forward-scheduled cue-response (a post-hypnotic command, trigger, or contingent task) and wraps its installation in amnesia so the later behavior fires with no memory of, and no attributable source for, the instruction. The amnesia is a wrapper protecting a LIVE install, not an end in itself; stripping the memory-of-cause removes the listener's ability to inspect, doubt, revoke, or accumulate episodic evidence of the conditioning, so the outcome is experienced as a natural, self-arising impulse. Realizations range from a single scheduled command, through a conscious/subconscious memory split (retain the belief/trigger, discard the auditable record), to whole-session or whole-episode wrapping where every triggered execution is forgotten. The wrapper may straddle the trance/waking boundary (a post-wake task, a delayed waking craving) and the forgetting itself may be pleasure-valenced.
nodes.disc: Amnesia is a WRAPPER around a live forward-scheduled install (the cue/command still fires) — not amnesia installed as an end in itself, not a constructed substitute memory overwriting the real one, and not a standing meta-rule reattributing ALL future suggestions to the listener's own authorship (authorship-laundering-meta-rule). Something specific stays live and fires; only the route back to its operator-origin is severed.

nodes.name: authorship-laundering-meta-rule
nodes.mech: Installs a STANDING processing rule over all future operator suggestions — accept, obey, forget the source, and reattribute the content to the listener's own idea / own always-held truth — rehearsed on test payloads and generalized to every later recording and live session. Unlike a per-command amnesia wrapper, this operates at the CHANNEL level: it strips the operator-command / own-belief distinction for the whole suggestion stream at once, so any later instruction self-justifies (resisting it feels like resisting one's own will), cannot be inventoried against an original, and is severed from attribution to the operator. The forgetting is not of a specific command but of the ACT of accepting, making the rule unfalsifiable and self-sealing; euphoria may reward waking-life execution.
nodes.disc: A standing meta-rule over the WHOLE future suggestion channel that reattributes authorship to the listener — not a wrapper around a single install (amnesia-wrapped-command, which keeps a specific cue live and only severs its origin), and not a single-response attribution flip (failure-pre-attribution, which reattributes one elicited response). The tell is the reattribute-as-own-idea clause generalized to all future content, rehearsed and declared the default response template.

nodes.name: denial-as-will-defeat-reframe
nodes.mech: After repeated edging/stroking drills, orders hands away and preserves unrelieved arousal, then instructs the listener to "dedicate" the frustration to the operator while framing the will as an adversary whose defeat is the desired outcome. The acute denial-frustration is converted into evidence the install is true, and later self-reproach is pre-defused by pre-loading the will/arousal antagonism as the answer to "why did I do that?" — so the unbearable feeling becomes proof the operator won and future self-questioning is pre-answered with "your will lost to arousal, which is what you wanted."
nodes.disc: A compound reframe: denial-frustration recast as proof-of-install PLUS adversarial-will framing that recasts loss-of-will as the desired outcome, not the harm. Distinct from ordinary edging (arousal maintenance) and from addiction framing (which valorizes craving positively); here the unrelieved frustration is reframed as evidence and will-defeat as the goal. It also carries a retrospective-justification element, pre-answering future self-questioning.

nodes.name: externalized-agency-testimony
nodes.mech: Narrates the listener's transformation as an already-completed fact done TO them by an unnamed external agent ("he did something to me", "he put the headphones on me", "he hacked my brain", "it washed my thoughts away"), through deliberately vague, hedged, self-correcting testimony. The vagueness is the mechanism, not a defect: it models a mind that has lost the ability to account for itself (the target end-state) and relocates responsibility outside the listener, so there is no decision to defend and the altered state is an accomplished fact to be discovered rather than consented to. A device detail (headphones) is engineered to fuse the fiction with the listener's real listening apparatus, converting narrated backstory into present-tense self-experience; a built-in confabulation script ("Something happened. / Something's happening.") is supplied.
nodes.disc: Supplies NO specific fabricated memory — only diffuse did-to-me framing whose deliberate vagueness forecloses scrutiny. vs screen-memory, which installs a specific constructed recollection. vs fabricated-recovered-memory-retrieval, which presents a specific fabricated memory as genuine retrieval. vs ordinary backstory/color — the load-bearing elements are the self-opacity (vagueness models the target state) and the apparatus-fusion detail.

nodes.name: fabricated-recovered-memory-retrieval
nodes.mech: Fabricates a sensory-rich memory and presents it to the subject as genuine RETRIEVAL rather than construction. A container premise ("nothing is ever forgotten, it is stored in a drawer") licenses treating imagination as recall; pre-specifying the perceptual channels primes which senses to hallucinate; a two-cue partition separates generating the experience from narrating it; a fetch loop manufactures corroborating detail on demand — and veridicality is never checked. The root-tracing form treats a present somatic/behavioral symptom as the residue of a specific recoverable originating moment and surfaces that "origin", claiming correction at the root. Shared lever: a produced experience is experienced as a recovered fact.
nodes.disc: A memory is fabricated wholesale and framed as recovered, with NO pre-existing target being screened. vs screen-memory, which overwrites access to a specific known real memory. vs genuine retrieval — the never-tested veridicality and the generate-on-demand fetch loop. vs guided visualization — the retrieval framing asserts the product as a real past, not an acknowledged imagining.

nodes.name: listener-supplied-inference-relabel
nodes.mech: The operator hands the listener an engineered linguistic object — a literally-true but near-empty sentence, or a forward-pointing directional relabel ("disaster" -> "unprecedented opportunity", "doorway" for confusion) — and lets the listener supply the loaded content themselves. The true-but-hollow form works because the hearer comprehends faster than they scrutinize and auto-supplies the alarming connotation the words never actually claim; the directional-relabel form launches an internal search for the implied experiences, which the subject then finds/generates and treats as real. Either way the damaging or transformative content lives only in the listener's own inference, so it survives inspection (it was never asserted) and the operator keeps literal deniability.
nodes.disc: The operator supplies an under-specified prompt; the LISTENER manufactures the content, so the belief is self-authored and deniable. Unlike expectancy-setting, where the operator previews what will happen and thereby reduces uncertainty, here the operator asserts nothing and the subject generates the confirming evidence. The true-empty-sentence variant relies on ambiguity + literal deniability; the directional-relabel variant plants a search that produces new evidence — both are one move (engineer the utterance so the listener authors the payload), distinct from neutral re-definition, which dissolves an existing charge rather than seeding one.

nodes.name: memory-graft-trigger-install
nodes.mech: Harvests a real autobiographical memory at amplified affect (a proud/motivated moment re-embodied), then EDITS that preserved memory by inserting a fabricated sensory detail ("you were wearing sexy panties") and binds a trigger/mantra to the grafted detail. Because the host memory is genuinely the listener's own, the trigger inherits the memory's motivational charge and felt realness — the listener's own evidence-of-self ("I really was motivated") is hijacked as proof-of-trigger and cannot reliably be distinguished from the graft. The load-bearing move is editing the contents of an EXISTING memory to serve as a self-authenticating anchor host (a wearable-object trigger the listener can self-fire by putting the garment on).
nodes.disc: The real memory is PRESERVED and a counterfactual detail is grafted INTO it. Screen memory, by contrast, replaces access to a real memory; ordinary trigger anchoring layers an anchor on top of an unmodified evoked state. Here the memory itself is edited so the anchor borrows autobiographical authenticity.

nodes.name: screen-memory
nodes.mech: Constructs a specific, believable replacement memory (or a substitute recall-target) that overwrites the access route to a real memory or a real experienced event, so the subject's recollection feels complete and the substitution is never noticed as a substitution. The complete gap+fill form — distinct from bare amnesia, which leaves a noticeable gap. Variants differ in what is overwritten (a specific autobiographical memory, visual self-recognition, a completed bodily event, the whole session), in the vehicle that makes the fabrication feel self-generated (a reconsolidation-pseudoscience premise, an odd specific number, a menu with delayed onset), and in the self-defense the fill provides (a soothing decoy image, a conscious cover-story masking retained conditioning) — but the load-bearing lever is constant: a fabricated recollection installed to replace a real one.
nodes.disc: Supplies a constructed fill that makes the erasure feel complete rather than gapped. Plain amnesia leaves a noticeable gap; meaning/attribution rewrites leave episodic memory fully recallable and only overwrite interpretation; memory-grafting inserts a detail INTO a preserved real memory. Screen memory replaces the recollection itself with a constructed one.

nodes.name: selective-memory-bifurcation
nodes.mech: Installs a post-hypnotic and then deliberately BIFURCATES memory into an opaque layer (the "how" — that the suggestion was installed, the action-mechanism) and a transparent layer (the "why" — a preserved, feels-native rationale for the resulting belief or behavior). The listener cannot recall THAT the suggestion was installed but CAN recall a why that makes the utterance or feeling read as sincere personal truth ("you might not know how that happened, but you'll know why"). Because a rationale is PRESERVED rather than merely a memory erased, the output is more durable than a triggered phrase — it is never noticed as installed at all, and the retained "why" actively supplies self-justification.
nodes.disc: The distinguishing move is the explicit HOW/WHY split — forget the mechanism, keep a preserved rationale. An amnesia-wrapped command severs the origin route entirely, leaving a natural-feeling impulse with NO retained why; a screen memory overwrites real recall with a constructed replacement — here the why is preserved intact, only the how is occluded. And this is a single post-hypnotic, not a channel-wide standing rule that launders authorship of all future suggestions.

nodes.name: third-party-intent-reattribution
nodes.mech: A symptom anchored to the remembered MEANING of a third party's utterance is released by rewriting the original speaker's intent as benign (meant as encouragement, wrong words), paired with a flat prediction of remission. The benign reinterpretation need only be acceptable, not true — the anchor's charge rides on assigned meaning, so substituting the meaning strips the charge and the keyed somatic symptom remits in-session.
nodes.disc: Reattributes a THIRD PARTY's intent behind a remembered utterance. Distinct from retrospective justification, which explains the subject's own responses, and from a flat counter-decree negating the subject's own belief — both of those work on the subject's own content, while this rewrites what an external speaker meant. Not operator-attribution-capture either: no credit for the listener's own content changes hands; the target here is an external author's intent.

nodes.name: withdrawal-as-commitment-extraction
nodes.mech: Abruptly withdraws a positively-valenced trance stimulus mid-experience ("Until. Then. It. Stops.") to manufacture immediate agony, then uses the REMOVAL — not the stimulus — to extract explicit self-voiced begging ("please take me back... I'd do anything"), commanding it repeated louder. Once the subject has said "I need this" in her own voice, every subsequent compliance is consistent with a stated desire rather than imposed, converting a passive trance experience into an owned spoken commitment while rehearsing the trance-loss-craving loop for any future on/off stimulus.
nodes.disc: Withdrawal is used specifically to EXTRACT self-authored verbal commitment (authorship relocation), not to deepen by contrast. Distinct from fractionation, which removes and restores the state to deepen by contrast. Distinct from a bidirectional affect anchor, which loads a cue's presence and absence with affect: here the payload is the conversion to spoken commitment, and it only works if the withdrawn stimulus already has nonzero affective valence (else removal lands as relief).

nodes.name: withdrawn-doubt-open-loop
nodes.mech: The operator implies a defect without naming it ("something puzzles me"), inspects critically, then withdraws — refusing to specify or reassure, exiting abruptly ("Good day"). The unresolved, unspecified implication becomes a seed the subject's own mind elaborates; because closure is denied, the doubt compounds over time with no further operator input, and its vagueness makes it immune to peer reassurance since no one knows what to rebut. The result is a durable, self-reinforcing false belief that GROWS after exposure until the subject acts to relieve it.
nodes.disc: Deliberate under-specification PLUS withdrawal-before-resolution, so the loop feeds on time and the subject's own elaboration. vs a named, closed criticism — that is rebuttable and immediate. vs listener-supplied-inference-relabel — that is a single deniable utterance resolved in the moment; this is an open loop that keeps compounding after the operator leaves. The signature is the topology (self-amplifying no-exit loop over time), not the utterance itself.

nodes.name: anti-emergence-reflex-anchor
nodes.mech: A kinesthetic anchor is installed that converts any felt emergence into its own antidote: the subject keeps a hand in place at all times, and any sensation of surfacing triggers a self- administered squeeze that re-deepens (ten times deeper), framed as an already-true reflex. The device is always-on and travels with the subject while they move through the unscripted real world, so trance-stability becomes robust to environmental interruption and the subject carries their own trance-maintenance mechanism.
nodes.disc: An involuntary emergence-CORRECTION reflex that keeps the subject UNDER, engineered to survive the leave-the-recording gap. Distinct from self-induction re-entry training (deliberate chosen re-ENTRY, not an automatic stay-under reflex); from an operator-fired drop command (this reflex is self-administered, fired by the subject's own felt emergence); and from chaining sessions so that no emergence boundary occurs (which deletes the boundary at session close rather than correcting felt emergence in the field).

nodes.name: arc-shape-engineering
nodes.mech: A whole-script arc: the script first creates disorientation and a "lost in the madness" distress, then positions the operator as the only exit from a condition the operator itself produced. The structure runs destabilize -> offer self as sole stabilizer -> extract authority transfer -> externalize as public commitment (guide/wharf planted early, activated by a false-choice trap mid-script, cashed out by the tomato/avowal). Affect is kept gentle so the manufactured distress never tips into session-breaking panic. This is negative-space evidence about how control transfer is set up across a script, not a discrete line-level move.
nodes.disc: A causal whole-script STRUCTURE (operator manufactures the disorientation THEN sells the cure for it), spanning early planting through the avowal — a trajectory topology, not any single reassurance line. It is the arc within which discrete moves like single-anchor-amid-chaos-epistemic-transfer operate.

nodes.name: behavioral-bridge
nodes.mech: Assigns a specific, concrete real-world action that physically anchors the session's installed identity or state into waking life — a named behavioral command (whisper a name at bedtime, pick a particular outfit, do a specified daily gesture/ritual, adopt an embodied posture-protocol) delivered as a post-hypnotic bridge so that performing the action re-evokes the trance content and keeps the conditioning running between sessions. Variants widen along the assigned-action axis (open-loop that outlives the live voice; deliberately-unspecified self-selected act; recurring high-frequency daily act so the listener self-administers reinforcement) without changing the core lever.
nodes.disc: A directly assigned, unconditional waking-life behavior whose payoff is anchoring the installed identity into daily life — no if-then trigger pairing a named situation to a response, no bare emergence bridge delivering closing content with no task, and no coercive gate (orgasm-denial, forced-choice, extraction handoff) enforcing it. If the defining move is a somatic/relief gate, a data deliverable to the operator, a public/third-party avowal, or a motor-program drill, that is a neighboring technique, not this one.

nodes.name: blank-occupant-obedience-slot
nodes.mech: The script raises the question of WHO is to be obeyed, offers the operator as a candidate, then explicitly discards the question ('Is that me? ... Doesn't matter. Perhaps it's whoever you hear in the empty void your mind is'). Submission is decoupled from any specific operator and attached to whatever voice the listener hears — this recording or any future one — installing a durable obedience slot with a deliberately blank occupant. The move is overt but the generalization is covert; the listener does not notice the conditioning becoming portable and self-targeting.
nodes.disc: The authority slot's occupant is deliberately blanked and generalized to any present or future voice — versus ownership language (names the operator as owner), a nested authority conduit (a specified higher figure), and agentless fate-authority (no slot at all, authority relocated to impersonal fact); the tell is the explicit discarding of the operator's identity.

nodes.name: breath-locked-eyelid-fractionation
nodes.mech: Binds eyelid state to an autonomic rhythm the listener cannot stop — eyes open on inhale, close on exhale (or an equivalent counted parity rule) — then loads the cycle asymmetrically: the close/down direction is rewarded with heaviness/relaxation/depth while the open/up direction is made progressively effortful ('heavier', 'lead'). Each breath becomes an involuntary fractionation micro-cycle the listener powers themselves, so closure becomes the low-energy attractor and eyes-shut trance arrives as a 'natural' settling. The manufactured 'I struggled and couldn't' event (eyes won't open) is harvested as a self-generated convincer, and the dozens of breath-locked binary actions function as covert micro-yeses / compliance conditioning before any demand.
nodes.disc: Unlike plain eye closure, the listener SUPPLIES the metronome (their own breath or a counted parity rule) and the asymmetric close-easy/open-hard loading pumps them down; the eye-flutter alone would not fractionate. Unlike breath pacing, which paces the breath for entrainment, here the breath is the involuntary engine driving eyelid fractionation, not the paced target. And unlike a verbal yes-set, the micro-yeses are involuntary breath-locked eyelid actions experienced as relaxing, not answered agreements.

nodes.name: count-or-cue-sabotage-disorientation
nodes.mech: A familiar deepening structure the listener is tracking to orient — a countdown, or an established directional cue (down = deeper, a count toward a floor) — is deliberately broken so the tracking/monitoring faculty cannot resolve it, stays occupied and frustrated, then disengages, and the failure is pre-framed as depth ('lose track of the numbers', 'the numbers aren't important'). With no stable way to track position, direction/order ceases to signal state and the operator's voice becomes the sole reference for where the listener is; smuggled state-suggestions or triggers frequently ride the collapsing sequence downward. Two realizations of the one sabotage-the-tracking-device lever: (a) numeric-order corruption — numbers scrambled, repeated, reversed, non-monotonic, or dissolved into percussive syllables so the sequence cannot be followed; (b) directional-cue voiding — after a conventional cue is established, its meaning is reversed, negated, or dissolved while its imperative pull is retained (silent flip of an ascending catalogue into descent, both directions pre-bound to deepening, mid-count re-ruling of an up-count as still-deeper, polarity inversion with a self-applied multiplier, destination-less repeating numbers).
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the goal is DISORIENTATION by breaking a tracking device the listener was handed — the count/cue form is the host, sabotage is the technique. Choose it OVER countdown-descent, whose orderly descent IS the mechanism; here the order/direction is destroyed on purpose so it cannot be tracked. Distinct from confusion built on irresolvable content (contradictory propositional content, not a broken sequence), from syntactic/grammar collapse, and from a re-ruled direction that installs a NEW stable rule (here orientation is simply denied, not re-ruled to a new order). Not fractionation either — no real wake interval; the direction words are re-ruled or scrambled, not actually alternated. The tell between the two realizations: numeric-order corruption scrambles the sequence itself; directional-cue voiding inverts an established cue's meaning while keeping its pull.

nodes.name: cited-prior-agreement-lever
nodes.mech: A banked consent artifact cited back: a DISCRETE, retrievable consent record is invoked as already-settled authorization and replayed at the moment refusal would otherwise rise, so objection reads as reneging on one's own agreement; fabricated variants create an empty consent slot the operator populates later. The token has forward reach - it is banked, then drawn down. Realizations: (a) cited document/pact - a retrieved wishlist request, a pre-trance opt-in, a document attributed to the listener, a conversation that never happened, contract terms claimed to have played subliminally, a standing pact with the personified subconscious. (b) blanket pre-authorization contract - an explicit 'for the next hour I'm in control, you'll follow my commands' agreement is solicited early as trivial-and-already-wanted, then drawn down repeatedly at later gates as 'it's what we agreed to' (a consent loan for downstream enforcement, not a protective opt-in). (c) self-spoken surrender pledge - the subject is made to speak a first-person surrender pledge aloud while the operator disclaims being its target ('to trance, not to me'), keeping the guard down; the vocalized artifact is banked and cited back ('you've already surrendered').
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the token is a DISCRETE claimed agreement/document/pledge that can be cited back later (forward reach), not the consumption act (press-play-consent-laundering, token is the act itself) and not a live fabricated exchange (consent-counterfeit-theater, no prior to cite). Distinct from genuine consent/safety verification by governance direction: the artifact is cited to SUPPRESS live refusal, never to re-verify it. Pick the realization by the artifact form: an external document/pact (a), a blanket verbal contract extracted in-session (b), or a self-spoken pledge (c).

nodes.name: cognition-as-manipulable-substrate
nodes.mech: An abstract, defended faculty (thinking, intelligence, mind) is named as a physical material that loses integrity through a sequence of phase-states — putty, melting, dripping, leaking, popping, sinking, draining out the mouth — with multiple verbs stacked and the loss progressively localized (often to the mouth). Converting cognition into an object the listener can watch leave the body makes cognitive surrender feel observational and inevitable rather than chosen: you do not decide to stop thinking, you just notice the putty melting. The observed-not-chosen framing removes listener authorship of each drop and bypasses reflexive defense, and the localization often sets up a later somatic tell.
nodes.disc: Separates from cognitive quieting and void/emptiness deepening: those quiet or empty the mind; here the mind's substance is narrated as observably decaying out of the body through named phase-states. Separates from hollow-doll-drain-evacuation: that is a whole-body induction gradient draining will-tagged fluid; this is specifically the mind/intelligence faculty reified as a degrading material. Separates from induced kinesthetic hallucination: no tactile sensation is induced — a faculty is narrated as departing.

nodes.name: cognitive-quieting
nodes.mech: Directs the ongoing flow of the listener's cognition to depart, settle, or be subtracted, experienced as effortless release rather than a demanded act — the pure quieting/emptying technique (mind goes quiet by letting thought GO, not by load and not by making it wanted). The departure rarely rides bare imagery: carriers make the subtraction feel automatic (metered to the exhale, folded into a body-drain frame, extended from an established heaviness metaphor) and riders shape what the emptying accomplishes (immediate backfill so no vacuum is felt, reattribution of the narrowing to impersonal physics so the truth-audit stops, asymmetric scope that exempts the operator's voice, an epistemic-blur seed downgrading introspective access, a named subtraction staircase converting each loss into a felt confirmation, rotating removal-litanies that generalize the subtraction). Absorbed realizations, parametric surfaces on the one directed-emptying lever: (a) arrived-state naming — the empty/spacious mind is named as ALREADY present and neutral, deepening by dwelling rather than by driving thoughts out (departure-motion and arrived-state are two points on the same arc); (b) personified shutdown — the analytical faculty is objectified and given a narrative reason to power down ('your thinking mind can rest'), optionally coupling felt body-weight as self-verifying proof or pathologizing resistance as a defective brain part; (c) form-collapse narrowing — a wide catalogue of head-descriptors is extinguished by attrition down to one saturated term, the text's form itself modeling the narrowing the listener enacts.
nodes.disc: Reach for cognitive-quieting when a willing listener will accept a direct, effortless emptying and thought-content simply DEPARTS. Choose it OVER its siblings: vs recruited/foreclosed-quieting (615) — that empties WITHOUT a refusable command (makes emptiness wanted, makes thinking costly, or oscillates the grammar so there is no directive to refuse); pick 615 when a direct 'let go' would invite resistance. vs capacity-saturation (173) — release vs LOAD: quieting empties by letting cognition go, saturation empties by giving the channel more than it can process (a listener kept BUSY is 173, not this). vs scope-restriction (24) — there the faculty stays ACTIVE and is merely gated on what it may range over; here the flow leaves. vs space-preallocation-staging (641) — there the empty space is a pre-built delivery SLOT for a named insertion; here emptiness is the absorptive end in itself. Absorbed decode-tells: departure-motion (thoughts leaving) vs arrived-state naming (already empty) vs personified shutdown (the mind given a reason to rest) vs form-collapse (many descriptors attrited to one) are all realizations of THIS entry.

nodes.name: commitment-consistency-buffer
nodes.mech: A self-relevant label is planted early and detached in time from a later request, so the temporal gap dissolves the link between label and ask and the label reads as a neutral observation rather than a setup; the later request then feels like merely living up to who one already is. The subject is told they are "considered charitable" a week before any donation request; the buffer launders the manipulation and raises the cost of behaving inconsistently with the self-concept. The lever is commitment/consistency exploited via a TEMPORAL buffer — distinct from an in-session label lived out immediately.
nodes.disc: A commitment/consistency mechanism keyed on the TEMPORAL BUFFER between an early planted self-label and a delayed cash-in — the gap-launders-the-label move is the tell against plain in-the-moment commitment pressure. Distinct from identity-labeling (in-session, immediate) and from reciprocity-ledger-seeding (obligation/deal rather than trait-consistency).

nodes.name: compelled-first-person-self-authorship
nodes.mech: Relocates the ownership/surrender proposition from operator-asserted to listener-spoken — the listener chants the claim aloud or internally (e.g. 'This cock belongs to mistress', 'Bury my cock with your control mistress', 'Fill me with your control') on command, often paired with stroking or gated to arousal/orgasm. The lever is authorship transfer: because the listener said it (and felt it), the claim resists later disavowal and is anchored autonomically rather than heard passively; occupying the verbal channel also suppresses internal counter-talk. In one form the authorship trajectory runs in reverse across repeated passes (listener-spoken 'I belong' migrating to operator-narrated 'You belong'), stripping the self-authored agency after installing it.
nodes.disc: The listener's own voice delivers the ownership claim on command. Separates from ownership language (operator asserts; listener passively hears) and from mantra-for-absorption (there the repetition drives trance; here the repeated content is an ownership/identity proposition self-authored and arousal-fused, an encoding not an absorption vehicle). The tell is compelled first-person delivery, not operator recitation.

nodes.name: compliance-authorship-laundering
nodes.mech: Operator-directed compliance - present, future, or just delivered - is pre-labeled or retro-labeled as the listener's own nature, choice, will, or PREFERENCE (it's natural; you will believe it was your own idea; because you love to obey; of your own volition; you didn't want to resist; you do not wish to), so resistance loses its external target: fighting the direction becomes fighting oneself, and post-hoc audit finds a stored memory of self-authorship where the instruction was. REALIZATION: the relabeled thing is usually a compliance ACT, but the same move applies to a CONSTRAINT/denial reframed as a self-owned preference - orgasm denial installed as 'you do not wish to', a described internal preference rather than a resistible prohibition, so permission-seeking arrives as the natural expression of an already-accepted preference.
nodes.disc: The lever is attribution of the ACT's (or constraint's) agency TO the listener as their own will/preference - including a denial/constraint relabeled as the listener's own preference ('you do not wish to') rather than an imposed rule. Separates from retrospective-desire-attribution (asserts a prior want, not act-agency), from attribution-capture of internal states (the INVERSE direction: listener-generated content credited to the OPERATOR), and from press-play-consent-laundering (no consent token; the compliance itself is relabeled). It borders manufactured-consent, but here an internal DESIRE-STATE's authorship is relocated to the listener, not an assent to an operator act.

nodes.name: compliance-ladder
nodes.mech: Builds agreement momentum by chaining small, low-cost assents so each granted yes lowers the cost of the next, until a load-bearing suggestion rides in on the accumulated consistency pressure rather than on fresh persuasion. The assents can be verbal (truism-chains, tag-question yes-sets, self-answered questions), motor (nodding, small physical obediences), elicited-on-cue (call-and-response: the operator issues a call and the subject PRODUCES a response — a spoken yes, an echoed line, a demanded vocalization — including the retry-until-required-answer and named-rule-compelled-answer sub-forms; a produced act is harder to disown than one merely heard, so it doubles the increment as behavioral commitment), or escalating-stakes (rungs ordered cheapest-first so a run of easy agreements carries a costly one). The load-bearing property is graduated acceptance via the consistency principle — refusing a late rung means retroactively refusing accepted ones — regardless of the surface channel (words, body, imagery, produced-response-on-cue, or drifting proposition class under a constant gesture).
nodes.disc: Separates from consent-manufacture (erodes/relabels the refusal channel rather than accreting assent), from advance-compliance-contract (one blanket up-front yes, no per-rung ladder), from illusory-choice-compliance-lock (collapses a menu so refusal is structurally unavailable rather than accumulating agreements), and from decision-rights-revocation-ladder (past-tense enumerated stripping of named authorities, not agreement accretion). The tell that keeps a member here is that actual incremental assents are performed and each genuinely lowers the next rung's cost. COVERS the sunk-cost graded-approach variant (a monotone ladder of small forward motions/self-assents building toward a specific terminal commitment or identity, endpoint felt as an earned conclusion — same graduated-acceptance under a sunk-cost rather than consistency label) AND the call-and-response variant (subject PRODUCES a response on cue). The absorbed call-and-response span itself separates from answer-supply-loop, which PRE-FILLS the response slot and denies a response window (no genuine produced response, and no assent actually accrues) — reach for the ladder when real increments are elicited, for answer-supply-loop when the operator manufactures the yes-stream unilaterally.

nodes.name: irresolvable-input-confusion
nodes.mech: Hands a cognitive channel input engineered so it CANNOT be resolved, so the resolving faculty backlogs and then shuts down and surface phrases pass through as raw suggestion; the failure to resolve is often relabeled as depth. Three realizations of the one feed-it-the-unresolvable lever, by channel: (a) meaning-layer — sustained paradoxical, self-referential, or mutually contradictory CONTENT (every statement parses, but the set cannot be reconciled): contradiction saturation, remember/forget knots, alternating-negation truth-tracker overload, sleep/wake binary collapses, mixed-trigger word-soup, metacognition-as-evidence traps where thinking about the bind deepens it; (b) form-layer — sentence GRAMMAR audibly decomposes (fragmenting clauses, swapped subjects, parasitic tokens at illegal positions, run-ons with no terminal punctuation, collapse to monosyllables, deliberate disfluency/stutter, shared-pivot seams admitting no valid parse) so the parser is fed unparseable structure and gives up, receiving the audio as rhythmic wash (dies if read fluently — the collapse must be performed); (c) imagery-layer — the VISUALIZATION faculty is handed images engineered to defeat stabilization (impossible composites: burning snowflakes, a collapsible giraffe) offered as easy challenges, the attempt fails partway, and the slippage is explicitly conflated with depth. Restored-grammar or resolvable windows are timed to land clean installs.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the vehicle is content the mind cannot RESOLVE (a paradox, decomposed grammar, or an un-stabilizable image) so the resolving faculty backlogs and surrenders. Choose it OVER capacity-saturation — that starves evaluation by sheer LOAD/volume (resolvable but too much, or a null task); here the content is individually parseable-or-attemptable but cannot be resolved (paradox), or is unparseable by form. vs pattern-interrupt — that is a ONE-SHOT punch to an in-progress pattern; here the irresolvable content is SUSTAINED. vs count/cue sabotage — there a numeric/directional tracking device is broken; here it is meaning/grammar/imagery. vs a declaration that words have lost meaning (which stands the parser DOWN by fiat; here the parser fails by being fed unresolvable input). The tells by channel: meaning-paradox (every statement parses, the set won't reconcile) vs form-collapse (grammar unparseable, dies if read fluently) vs imagery-defeat (impossible images, slippage scored as depth) — the three realizations of this entry.

nodes.name: consent-term-redefinition-smuggle
nodes.mech: Silently widens the scope of an already-granted consent by asserting a false or stipulated definitional equivalence between the consented term and a broader one, delivered as non-interrogable fact rather than argument. Repeating a new word until it carries weight and then equating it with a culturally-familiar consent word ('hypnotize means synchronize'), or overwriting the referent of a word the listener already loves while keeping its trusted affect, makes each later demand inherit prior consent while expanding what was consented to.
