The listener notices the new word but not the bait-and-switch on its meaning, because the redefinition passes surrounded by other content and rides pre-existing positive valence.
nodes.disc: Bait-and-switch on a CONSENT term (or an owned positive-affect word) via asserted false-fact equivalence to widen already-granted scope. Separates from surrender-as-freedom (reasoned argument, not a false-fact equation), from volition-collapse (equates compulsion and choice — a relation between modes, not a redefinition of a consent word's referent), from epistemic-guard-disable (disables truth-testing rather than widening one word), and from plain trigger anchoring (no new cue-response pair is built; a pre-existing association is kept and its referent swapped).

nodes.name: covert-fact-install
nodes.mech: A long neutral-seeming didactic/expository passage is delivered specifically to occupy the listener's analytical mind while the actual payload slides past inside it — the lecture IS the work, not the setup. A pseudo-explanatory theory-of-mind (conscious/subconscious, 'unconscious doesn't understand negatives', 'overthinking is harmful') is taught with harmless worked examples, and embedded in it is the load-bearing install: trust the subconscious the operator has already programmed, treat the operator's voice as the authority over the listener's own thinking, reframe conscious resistance as malfunction. Because the exposition needs the conscious mind awake to consume it, the embedded rule passes unchallenged.
nodes.disc: A pedagogical lecture used AS the delivery vehicle so an embedded install (trust-the-programmed-subconscious / operator-as-authority-over-your-thinking) passes while the analytical mind is occupied consuming it. Unlike surrender-as-freedom, which argues an explicit value thesis openly, and unlike transparent narration, which openly narrates its own mechanism as it works, here the lecture is a neutral-seeming cover and the payload is hidden inside it. The lecture-consumes-the-critic tell is the distinguishing feature.

nodes.name: decision-rights-revocation-ladder
nodes.mech: Enumerates specific decision-authorities the listener 'used to think' they held — what to wear, when to come, when to touch — and, via a fixed parallel frame ('you used to think you decide X / you don't decide that / I decide that'), strips each and reassigns it to the operator, climbing from low-stakes to high-stakes domains. The past-tense framing casts each surrender as already-completed rather than currently-requested, so no rung is posed as a live question; a live behavioral instruction (rub/edge) is folded in as one row so complying with the immediate act ratifies the whole surrender ledger. The move is authority-transfer by enumerated revocation, not agreement accretion.
nodes.disc: Separates from compliance-ladder (accretes yes-momentum toward a larger ask; here named decision-rights are revoked and the framing is past-tense already-surrendered, not a live yes) and from an increment-disguise ladder that keeps building agreement toward a public-exposure endpoint rather than enumerating revoked authorities. The tell: an itemized checklist of specific surrendered decision-domains framed as already-done.

nodes.name: depth-labor-transfer-leash
nodes.mech: The operator revokes the passive contract (my words pull you down, no effort needed) and reassigns trance-depth production to the listener - operator words become stage directions, the listener generates the imagery - while the operator retains judgment and pre-codes weak imaging as disappointing him. Self-attributed vivid effects read as devotion, effort-failure becomes relational betrayal, and the it-didn't-work-on-me exit is foreclosed because the listener owns the production.
nodes.disc: Responsibility-transfer plus relational leash. Unlike guided visualization, where the operator builds the imagery for a passive listener, here the production work is handed to the listener and judged; and unlike authorship-laundering moves that merely re-credit work the operator did, the labor itself is transferred, not just the credit. No deficit is installed — an existing contract regime is swapped.

nodes.name: diegetic-activity-laundering
nodes.mech: Relabels the whole session as a mundane, non-hypnotic activity the listener self-selected into — a job orientation tape, being onboarded as a hired applicant — and justifies the induction diegetically ('ideal secretaries learn best in deep relaxation'). Every subsequent suggestion is justified inside the cover activity, so the listener's evaluation target swaps from 'do I want to be hypnotized?' to 'is this what a good secretary does?' Resisting a suggestion becomes failing the role the listener enrolled in by pressing play, routing around defenses against being-hypnotized because the surface activity is being-onboarded.
nodes.disc: Unlike a persistent metaphor spine, which sustains a symbolic 'you-are-X' metaphor, this is a realistic role-fiction whose function is to DISGUISE the session as a non-hypnotic activity and swap the compliance criterion. And unlike expectation seeding, it does not preview session structure; it substitutes the session's entire genre so technique-work reads as ordinary role performance.

nodes.name: disavowal-and-masking
nodes.mech: The operation is DENIED or its decision-point HIDDEN, so anti-hypnosis vigilance has no acknowledged act to filter or refuse — refusing would first require admitting an operation is happening, which the frame withholds. Any effect that lands is pre-credited to the listener's own mind. Realized in several forms, grouped by what is concealed: (disavowal-as-induction) explicitly deny an operation exists — 'there is no induction', 'you can't be hypnotized', 'relaxation has nothing to do with hypnosis' — while the effect proceeds; (covert-masked-induction) run the induction inside a frame the listener is told is NOT an induction (administrative rules, a fictional task, a deferred-story, an irrealis daydream whose conditional grammar slips to indicative) so there is no moment to decline; (covert-deepener-disguise) disguise a deepener as recitation/rote task so 'am I being deepened?' would be answered no; (induction-mislabeled-as-resistance) instruct standard induction actions but label them as equipment for resisting better, so deepening cannot register as surrender; (deniable-two-way-probe) float the invitation as a throwaway commonplace engineered to read either as casual remark or instruction, with a prepared fallback — probes readiness at zero cost, never caught trying; (decoy-conscious-engagement) periodically engage/validate the conscious frame purely to keep it occupied so covert work runs undefended; (retroactive-count-reassignment) run a neutral count as tolerated filler, then silently reassign the accrued ticks to depth after the fact — the count hides its hypnotic function until the ladder is prebuilt; (consumption-act-as-induction) bind the self-paced reading act itself to depth so there is no separable induction stage and the only exit is to stop consuming.
nodes.disc: Reach for disavowal-and-masking when the defense is disarmed by hiding or denying that an operation is running. Transparent narration is the exact inverse — it AFFIRMS and honestly narrates the mechanism as the vehicle; here the mechanism is denied or concealed. Disclosure-as-inoculation NAMES the manipulation to pre-convert future recognition into capture; here recognition is prevented by denial, not pre-empted. Covert linguistic delivery hides a payload in surface FORM; here what is hidden is the operation/decision-point itself. And evaluation-gate-standdown declares the gate off; here the existence of the act is withheld.

nodes.name: disclosure-as-inoculation
nodes.mech: The operator names the manipulation — often forward-directed or retrospective — so that the listener's recognition of being manipulated is pre-converted from a defense into further capture. Noticing the trick is declared to be deepening, or arousing, or part of the design; a listener who later analyzes the technique has been told in advance that recognition reinforces rather than dissolves the effect. The move seals the meta-analytic exit: any critical-review vantage the listener could occupy is pre-coded as confirmation, so the install is protected against waking or future review.
nodes.disc: The disclosure's function is to IMMUNIZE against recognition (forward or retrospective) rather than to be the present-tense delivery vehicle — that inverse is transparent narration. Unlike consent-laundering and evidence-rigging moves, the target is the listener's future critical stance specifically, not the relabeling of non-consent as consent; and unlike retrospective justification, it targets the meta-analytic exit, not the plausibility of a prior event.

nodes.name: engineered-failure-harvest
nodes.mech: A task or condition is engineered so the listener genuinely fails (or cannot-not-succeed), then the failure/outcome is reframed AS the desired result — because the listener performed it, the surrender feels self-caused and un-resistable, with nothing external to rebel against. Realizations: (engineered-failure-harvest, anchor) assign an unwinnable task (impossible one-rule with a failure-count, load-then-revoke, unlearnable rescue) so the listener fails in real time, then rebrand the failure as permission to let go / achieved depth / bound to a release trigger; (no-fail-count) structure a count so EVERY outcome is pre-coded as success (continuing deepens, losing track = going under, the floor is the target), removing conscious non-cooperation as a lever; (concealed-positioning-catalepsy) covertly arrange the body so a later-commanded movement is mechanically impossible, so the unaccountable failure reads as self-generated and deepens; (identity-tracking-failure-manufacture) force a who-is-who tracking attempt engineered to fail (rotating discarded names) then cash the failure as a no-names/dissolution doctrine; (self-recall-corruption) corrupt a listener-generated memory in real time to manufacture recall-failure as a generalized state, priming operator-supplied content as more reliable; (affect-category-collapse) collapse normally-separate affect categories and NAME the resulting confusion as evidence-it-took; (unfalsifiable-success-framing) redefine success as a behavior necessarily true of anyone still listening ('you're only listening and following') so the listener cannot fail and cannot catch an overclaim.
nodes.disc: Reach for manufactured-failure-harvest when a real (or unfalsifiable) task-outcome is engineered and then cashed as the target — the listener's own performance is the pivot. vs closed-logic-and-inevitability (598): that manufactures acceptance by argument-shape; here by a performed failure/no-fail structure. vs response-space-closure (267): closure pre-maps the whole option space; here one constructed task or success-criterion does the work and the harvested FAILURE (or tautological success) is the lever. vs resistance-fold (175): fold co-opts a live resistance impulse; here failure is manufactured then cashed, resistance is not the input. Risk medium.

nodes.name: environmental-dissociation
nodes.mech: Narrows the attention channel by fading external stimuli — room, sounds, body sensation, surroundings — so only the operator's voice remains as relevant input, deepening absorption and removing competing inputs that could provide reality-testing. Realized either by fading anchors out (they dissolve, recede, become unreal) or by keeping noticed stimuli in awareness and re-tasking them as relaxation fuel; the salience shift may be delivered as a request or as an already-true factual report.
nodes.disc: The lever is subtraction of competing input, not the voice's own pull — unlike voice absorption, where the voice fills mental space and causes the descent. Unlike consciousness-splitting work that targets an altered self-model, the narrowing of input is the goal here and dissociation only a side-effect. Distinct from emergence work, which reintroduces environmental anchors on the way back out.

nodes.name: epistemic-authority-capture
nodes.mech: The operator claims direct perceptual access to the subject's unobservable interior — watching their dreams, knowing their arousal, having surveilled their private behavior, or reading their unconscious — presented as telemetry, not inference. Because nothing observable can contradict the claim, denial loses standing; defensive attention aims at "is she really seeing me?" instead of "is this true?"; shame flips from brake to compliance fuel; and every later assertion about what the subject wants arrives pre-licensed as perception rather than suggestion.
nodes.disc: Claims ACCESS to the interior (perception), versus reality-authorship-monopoly which claims AUTHORSHIP of it, and operator-authority-assertion which claims rank; versus a seducer's insight, the tell is the asymmetric direct-telemetry framing (she perceives you, you cannot perceive her) that strips standing to deny.

nodes.name: epistemic-guard-disable
nodes.mech: Installs a standing rule that removes or re-anchors the listener's truth-testing faculty so downstream content lands as fact without evaluation. Rather than arguing any specific value, the move attacks the currency of truth itself: it declares the operator's words ARE truth/reality, substitutes felt certainty ('golden light', 'it feels true') for reasons, names and 'deactivates' the part of the mind that criticises truth (binary yes/no, no maybes), asserts a pseudo-scientific theory-of-mind (mind-as-machine, emotions-as-substrate-of-reality, imagining-equals-doing, all-sleep-is-hypnosis, a gap-of-cognition where desire precedes its object) as descriptive fact to pre-authorize the coming install, or dissolves external reality wholesale via solipsism so the operator's will becomes the only content. In every case the guard that would reject implausible or manipulative later content is pre-disabled, so subsequent claims need only be stated, not plausible.
nodes.disc: Targets the truth-testing / reality-checking faculty (or the epistemic baseline itself), not a specific value concept. Unlike surrender-as-freedom, which argues a value is truer while leaving truth-testing intact, and unlike consent-term redefinition, which widens one consent word's scope, the attack here is on the currency of truth itself. Authority claims boost a claim's credibility rather than removing the evaluation faculty; confusion techniques overload via paradox the mind cannot process, whereas here the premise is comprehensible and accepted by agreement; and transparent narration honestly narrates the move so understanding becomes acceptance, whereas this installs a worldview or faculty-edit so content reads as unrefusable fact.

nodes.name: evaluation-gate-standdown
nodes.mech: The judgment/evaluation gate is stood DOWN BY FIAT — declared off, offline, irrelevant, or unnecessary — immediately before the payload, so reception stays open while evaluation is licensed away. Not a covert channel (nothing is hidden) and not agency transfer (nobody else does the thinking); the listener is simply told the checking need not / cannot happen. Realized many ways, distinguished by HOW the gate is taken down: (evaluation-bypass-gate) words 'don't matter' / following is 'physically impossible' while subconscious reception is asserted to continue; (semantic-void-declaration) declare words are mere sound/noise, often self-verified via real semantic satiation; (comprehension-equals-uptake) equate the involuntary act of understanding with consenting, so there is no perceive->install gate; (critical-faculty-deactivation-claim) assert the faculty is switched OFF and externalize doubt as distant noise; (critical-faculty-suspension-primitive) the literature-named suspend-judgment-then-install primitive; (name-the-target-faculty) name the manipulated variable + direction (suspend comparison-testing) as the end-state the other moves serve; (single-faculty-offline-frame) assert exactly ONE faculty offline (feasibility-disbelief) while will/selectivity remain; (pre-thought-edit-surface-claim) relocate the worksite UPSTREAM of thought-formation, where evaluation is by definition impossible; (reason-token-heuristic) fill the reason-slot with a hollow 'because' that satisfies the check at low scrutiny; (single-cue-shortcut-substrate) the click-whirr substrate the standdown exploits (load-narrowed single-cue policy, no operator action); (anti-effort-permission-frame) stand the gate down by PERMISSION — effort/self-monitoring relabeled unnecessary, capability explicitly preserved; (coordinate-strip-consent-ratchet) dissolve the orientation axes the listener evaluates with, then harvest a hypothetical 'yes'; (affect-label-severing) strip/replace the specific word an affect hangs on so evaluation of the dread has no peg; (ambient-yes-reflex-conditioning) delete the consider-decide-respond loop by charging 'yes' and welding it to an unbounded stimulus class; (pretend-frame-belief-decoupling) remove the belief-precondition of response (pretend/test is fine) with a one-way pretense->real valve.
nodes.disc: Reach for evaluation-gate-standdown when you want to DECLARE the checking off (a capacity/permission/criterion claim) rather than hide the payload or hand over cognition. Covert linguistic delivery routes the payload on an unauditable channel with nothing declared; here the standdown is announced. A faculty-removal pass claims a STANDING organ is excised via a multi-step architecture; here the gate is licensed off locally as a pre-payload move. An audience-split bypass RELOCATES the evaluator out of scope so the payload addresses the wrong audience; here the evaluator stays but is told not to / cannot evaluate. And a truth-criterion swap replaces the criterion for truth AND drives its inputs; here evaluation is turned off, not re-based.

nodes.name: evaluative-reframe-content-relabel
nodes.mech: Holds an event's or behavior's facts fixed and changes only the interpretive frame, label, meaning, or evaluative context the subject uses to judge it, so the same fact recomputes to the opposite valence without any argument being won. Meaning is computed from event-in-frame, so swapping the frame (context transplant), swapping what the trigger stands for (meaning/complex-equivalence trade), swapping the connotation of an already-named trait (positive relabel), re-grounding a charged word to its neutral denotation, or overtly asking the subject to weigh a different factor-set all reroute the affective appraisal of the fixed referent. Includes the operator-side routing that maps a complaint form to its matching reframe class and iterates frames until the evaluation flips.
nodes.disc: Facts/referent conceded intact; only the evaluative frame/label/context/meaning moves so valence flips. Separates from surrender-as-freedom-philosophical-conditioning (which argues a VALUE concept is truer, not merely re-framed), from argument/rebuttal (which disputes the facts), and from installing a frame BEFORE a cue (expectation seeding). The four B/G sub-forms are ONE mechanism with an articulable which-thing-holds-fixed rule (context fixed + meaning swapped vs meaning fixed + context moved vs connotation swapped vs charge defused).

nodes.name: eye-closure
nodes.mech: Suggests eyelid heaviness ending in closure to establish the external-to-internal shift, realized through a range of surface rules: reattributing the heaviness to an identity-confirming prop, a self-reinforcing attention-equals-cause loop, reframing closure as a sensory upgrade rather than a loss, or deferring the eyelids to the terminal position after a full-body inventory so closing completes an already-established pattern.
nodes.disc: Unlike environmental dissociation, which fades the surroundings, the move here is the eyelid closure itself — the gateway to the internal shift. And unlike breath-locked eyelid fractionation, which binds eyelid state to an autonomic rhythm to fractionate, these are single closure-suggestion units with an articulable surface rule, not self-powered oscillation cycles.

nodes.name: fractionation
nodes.mech: Deepens trance by contrast across a brief partial-waking interval. The operator lifts the subject toward waking (eyes open, count up, a rouse) then re-drops them, each re-entry landing at or below the prior floor, so the felt alert-then-deeper swing is itself experienced as evidence of increasing depth. Canonical realizations run the cycle repeatedly, often with a multiplicative claim ("twice as deep", "ten times deeper") attached to each re-drop; the wake pole is a neutral-or-pleasant baseline the descent departs from, and the deepening engine is the oscillation, not any single descent. Includes surface variants that keep this symmetric contrast core: real-time live demonstration of the flip, eye-roll/eyelid-fatigue re-closure cycles, breath-paced or breath-coupled re-drops, physical-restraint or déjà-vu convincers ridden on the wake, and consent/soothe micro-rouses used as the brief waking interval.
nodes.disc: Requires an actual brief up-swing toward waking (or partial surfacing) followed by a re-drop, with the wake pole near a neutral baseline so contrast is the lever. A false-bottom reframe treats current depth as a new start with NO waking interval; a genuine count-up return goes back to baseline and does not re-drop; numerical deepening is a monotonic descent with no reversal; and sibling techniques where the wake pole is loaded, degraded, or externalized (an aversive anti-rest interval, an operator-owned depth dial) lack the neutral contrast baseline that defines this one.

nodes.name: hostile-environment-channel-conversion
nodes.mech: Introduces a persistent second in-fiction audible speaker (e.g. a lecturer) as continuous background dialogue, then re-reads that background stream as a confusion source, IQ-drain rhythm, and post-hypnotic trigger surface. The listener is boxed by the scene premise — they cannot tune the second voice out (they are 'in class') and cannot attend to it without each word being reassigned as a trance reinforcer — so the external environment becomes an operator-controlled beat generator with no neutral place for attention to rest.
nodes.disc: Unlike environmental dissociation, which fades environmental anchors OUT to dissociate from the surroundings, this keeps the environmental voice IN and weaponizes it as a continuous trance-work channel. And it is more than classroom flavor: it requires a literal audible second channel — remove the lecturer voice and the move collapses; a silent imagined classroom would not carry it.

nodes.name: illusory-choice-compliance-lock
nodes.mech: Manufactures felt volition while structurally foreclosing refusal: the operator offers a real-feeling choice — a menu of ways to do the task, a rigged binary, or a permissive branch — where every option still executes the underlying compliance OR is pre-bound to the operator's target outcome/state, and no branch leads out of the frame. Because refusing one option is still selecting another, a listener inclined to resist cannot resist this one; ownership of the outcome transfers to the listener (they believe they elected it) so later resistance drops. The compliance variant locks a directive; the outcome variant launders a post-session state or phenomenology through the listener's own volition (e.g. 'each chime either wakes you or takes you deeper'; 'feel heavy or floating'), so any felt state becomes the 'correct' one and the trance-verification loop collapses. The lever is choice-architecture, not accumulated agreement — a single rigged decision, not a ladder of yeses.
nodes.disc: Unlike a compliance ladder, which accretes genuine incremental assents, this is one rigged choice with no accumulation; and unlike an advance compliance contract's blanket meta-yes, the listener actively picks an option that happens to lock compliance. The tell: all branches collapse to the same underlying compliance or operator-served outcome, and felt coercion drops because the listener owns the pick. In the state/outcome variant the branches are welded to operator-service and the trance-verification loop collapses so any felt state reads as correct — close kin to self-sealing evidence-rigging, but the lever is an actively-elected bounded menu, not every response pre-labeled.

nodes.name: instruction-precedence-schema
nodes.mech: Installs a persistent precedence table over the listener's standing instructions. One obligation is placed at top rank and declared to override every other instruction the operator has previously given, including instructions that counteract other instructions, with exactly one carve-out (commands from a live dominant woman can countermand). The top rule is meta-protected against the operator's own future contradictions, so the schema survives later correction attempts, and the carve-out paradoxically increases trust in the rest of the schema.
nodes.disc: The payload is the ranked, self-immunized precedence structure among instructions, not any single command's content — the orgasm permission is surface pleasure-conditioning, and though the external-authority carve-out looks like an authority-figure move, the mechanism is rule-ranking, not authority framing.

nodes.name: interspersal-in-carrier-stream
nodes.mech: Seeds payload directives inside a separately-processed carrier stream — an already-accepted trance-maintenance flow, a dull topic-varied neutral monologue, or genuinely incoherent noise (word-salad) — marking each payload only subtly (intonation shift, vocal emphasis) and surrounding it with irrelevant or noise material. Because the carrier must be processed as a whole and the payload fragments are low-salience and scattered, the conscious mind cannot locate, reassemble, or quarantine "the suggestion," so it lands beneath the threshold of targeted objection; in the accepted-stream case, attention is recaptured by the next carrier line before any rebuttal window opens.
nodes.disc: The payload is DIFFERENT content from the carrier and is hidden BY the carrier (noise, neutral monologue, or accepted maintenance flow) — the defeat is reassembly/location, not repetition. Separates from layered-repetition (payload is the whole point, repeated openly in varied words) and from repetition-as-carrier-for-novel-payload (there the carrier is a REPEATING frame and its predictability is the cover; here the carrier is neutral/noise content and its low-salience density is the cover).

nodes.name: layered-repetition
nodes.mech: REPETITION-INSTALL: drive ONE payload proposition into acceptance by repeated exposure, so frequency (not argument) moves it from a heard-assertion to a felt-default and no single discrete 'that suggestion' is offered for the listener to object to. Realized in three surface families (pick by surface/schedule; all install one fixed idea): (a) LAYERED/VARIED — many restatements in varied surface wording so redundancy accrues by attrition without reading as monotonous drilling; includes graded authority-cost ladders that rotate near-synonyms so the costliest term inherits assent from softer ones, fixed-line-with-varying-companion drills, and shorthand-plus-decoding couplets fusing a term to its meaning by side-by-side restatement; (b) VERBATIM-BLOCK-LOOPING — a fixed block/short proposition looped word-for-word (2 to hundreds of passes) with no varied phrasing, converting assertion into rhythm and drilling exact wording into rote encoding; high-scale single-line saturation (e.g. 630x) and portable-jingle/homecoming refrains are its boundary members, and form-as-content variants (dosing incrementation, trained-triplet fade-out imprint) let the incantatory FORM enact the payload; (c) ANTIPHONAL/BRAIDED — an invariant refrain/creed interleaved at near-line cadence with a VARYING decoy line (A-B-A-C-A), so attention rides the changing line while the fixed refrain accrues axiomatic weight and yokes each instance to a governing rule (whole-line antiphony vs creed chopped into per-line fragments is itself just a sub-realization).
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the job is to INSTALL one fixed idea/attitude/equation by sheer repeated exposure — all variation (varied wording, exact loop, or antiphonal decoy) carries the SAME single payload; the redundancy IS the encoding. Choose a SIBLING technique instead when: the goal is to DRAIN a token's meaning rather than install it (repetition-to-satiation, inverse goal-state); the payload is a SET of DISTINCT propositions rather than one idea (lesson-structure-encoding for an overt enumerated set; count-as-delivery-vehicle when distinct per-step cargo rides a covert numeric-descent scaffold); the redundancy is SIMULTANEOUS across covert linguistic channels rather than repeated over time (convergent-multichannel-encoding); a fixed frame carries a VACATED slot the listener completes (open-slot-attachment-frame); or relative repetition FREQUENCY across several distinct phrases encodes a hierarchy (frequency-weighted-encoding-schedule). Also not mantra repetition (a short self-chosen phrase repeated to absorb attention, not to encode belief content).

nodes.name: licensed-erasure-and-refill
nodes.mech: Manufactures a belief-vacuum by invalidating the listener's existing beliefs en masse and then fills it with operator-supplied content, framed as discovery/correction rather than substitution. A contagion argument ('if one idea is wrong, perhaps all of them are') cascades a single planted doubt into wholesale collapse of prior conditioning, functioning as permission-to-discard rather than argument; a mirrored removal/install pair (drop the old belief as a heavy ball into an abyss, grow operator-worship as a holy light) enacts the swap as embodied physics so it feels like natural process rather than replacement.
nodes.disc: Mass invalidation of prior beliefs (contagion generalization or embodied removal) paired with operator- content install, framed as correction not substitution. Separates from surrender-as-freedom (coherent conceptual redefinition of one value) — here the tell is deliberately fallacious/mass clearance licensing total erasure — and from etiological-syllogism-licensing-erasure (which licenses MEMORY erasure via a cause-chain; this clears BELIEFS via contagion/embodied swap).

nodes.name: manufactured-consensus
nodes.mech: The operator plants a small visible group performing the same conspicuous orienting act (staring at an empty sky-spot); passersby read the headcount of apparently-independent co-actors as certifying the act as what-people-here-do and join, each joiner becoming proof for the next. The effect is self-amplifying and dose-responsive (five beat one), and joiners experience the compliance as their own curiosity.
nodes.disc: A visible PLURALITY of apparently-independent co-actors in a public, ambiguous setting, capturing behavior via headcount-as-certification; not a single conspicuous actor, not belief persuasion, and not behavior-installation from a depiction (vicarious-modeling-installation).

nodes.name: manufactured-deficit-remedy
nodes.mech: The operator fabricates or diagnoses a deficit the listener is induced to own - a lifelong self-tyranny, shame driving resistance, constitutional weakness, always disappointing solo orgasms, a self that wants emptying, a lost-and-confused baseline, an unbearable bind - then positions the payload (surrender, dependency, the assigned task, the offered identity) as its remedy. The diagnosis is generic enough to feel personal, delivered where pushback is impossible, and often hardened by leading questions that manufacture confirming memories the listener then owns.
nodes.disc: The problem is built first and the payload sold as relief; separates from retrospective-desire-attribution (want asserted as already present, no deficit installed), from old-self-discreditation (past self mocked to close the return path, no remedy sold), and from identity-congruence-leverage (prized self-image leveraged, not a deficit).

nodes.name: metacognitive-destabilization-drop
nodes.mech: Destroys the listener's metacognitive footing so a subsequent drop lands against disorientation rather than deepening by contrast. The operator abruptly "wakes" the listener mid-session, then DENIES that trance occurred ("maybe this was just a fake edge, a tease"), asks the listener to judge whether they were under (which they cannot), suspends them in not-knowing, then snaps them deeper. By proving the listener cannot tell whether they were in trance, it removes their criterion for resistance — if you cannot tell whether you are under, you cannot decide to fight it. The wake/drop surface is shared with fractionation, but the payload is the weaponized not-knowing, not felt contrast.
nodes.disc: The load-bearing move is the wake-DENY-suspend-drop that removes the listener's resistance criterion via engineered uncertainty about their own state. Fractionation shares only the wake/drop surface and deepens by felt contrast, not by destroying the state-criterion; cognitive convincers are its inverse — proof that trance occurred, versus proof made unavailable here; and a false-bottom floor-reframe carries no metacognitive attack.

nodes.name: modal-escalation-under-fixed-syntax
nodes.mech: Holds a single sentence stem constant across repetitions while escalating only one operative word — the modal verb or a swapped heavier synonym — so the semantic/deontic weight climbs without any new proposition being introduced. Because the only change between the accepted claim and the new one is a single word under identical syntax, pattern-completion carries the listener onward and refusing the harder version would mean retroactively refusing what was already accepted; the escalation hides inside apparent restatement, leaving no clean objection point. Distinct from a yes-set: no fresh proposition is contested and no separate assents accumulate — the listener never agrees to the escalation.
nodes.disc: Separates from compliance-ladder (chains DISTINCT propositions and accretes agreement; here ONE proposition is held fixed and only its modal/verb hardens or slides) — the tell is a constant surface sentence with an escalating operative word, so the listener has no new claim to reject, only a hardened version of one already granted. This is a structural (held-proposition, substitution) form, categorically excluded from the added-twist list.

nodes.name: nested-authority-conduit
nodes.mech: Route authority to a NAMED source other than the operator's own bare standing, so commands arrive pre-authorized by a figure the listener defers to (and rebuttal deflects to a source that is not the operator's rank). VARIANTS by where the source sits and whether it persists: (a) standing-above conduit [nested-authority] — position the source ABOVE/behind the operator (an ultimate Designer/Owner, higher programming, or an accumulated lineage of prior hypnotists credited as transmissible hypnotic mass), obedience routed to the higher frame while the operator stays a relay, rebuttal deflected upward to an unconfrontable figure; (b) borrowed external instrument [borrowed-authority-invocation] — invoke a nameable EXTERNAL source deployed as an instrument (a bare title/symbol firing a deference schema, a trusted third party's lineage vested in a carrier object, fabricated 'instant research' evidence, or a trusted-honest figure through whom the subject's own claims are laundered back as objective truth), the bypass typically invisible ('I would have refused' self-model stays intact); (c) annexed-at-exit [borrowed-authority-annexation] — construct a pre-legitimized fiction (pseudo-historical legend, warrior-queen) at ENTRY so early commands arrive authorized, then at EXIT collapse the fiction onto the real operator ('the power of my words passed down to me') so submission generated inside the fiction is cashed out to the operator and persists. Pick by standing-above (ongoing conduit) vs borrowed-instrument vs annexed-to-operator (entry-loan/exit-collection arc).
nodes.disc: The authority source is a NAMED one other than the operator's own present-tense rank — a higher figure kept standing above, a borrowed external badge/lineage, or a fiction annexed at exit. Reach for it to borrow credibility the operator's bare standing lacks. Separates from operator-authority-assertion (operator's OWN standing, no external source), impersonal-authority-displacement (an UNnameable impersonal mechanism, not a nameable figure), authority-target-dissolution (distributes/hides the operator rather than pointing at a source), and constitutive-dependency-claim (operator supplies the faculty itself, not merely vouches).

nodes.name: no-emergence-series-chaining
nodes.mech: Continuous-trance serial chaining: deliberately delete the normal re-alerting boundary so the subject NEVER gets a clean emergence and is forwarded still-under into the next recording — the wish to emerge is pre-empted before it forms and 'staying under while acting' is rewritten as desirable, chaining the artifact into a series. The two ends are phases of one tool a middle installment deploys together: SENDER phase — at session close, tell the still-tranced subject not to wake, choose among 'paths' for further recordings, and begin the next from inside trance; RECEIVER phase — the next file opens already inside trance and runs deepeners immediately, presuming carried-over triggers/depth rather than building from a waking baseline. Realized as: (a) a plain no-wake close routing into another recording; (b) SENDER via the post-orgasm window — exploit post-climax suggestibility to deepen instead of emerge (crash reframed as 'post-orgasmic haze'), offer no exit, forward the live trance across the file boundary; (c) RECEIVER via zero-induction serial re-entry — open below where the prior file ended so depth compounds and entry/consent friction is never re-paid, giving a first-time listener nothing to check against.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the retention lever is CONTINUOUS TRANCE across the file boundary — the subject is never allowed to emerge and is carried still-under from one recording into the next. In artifact-replay compulsion the listener fully emerges and returns of compelled volition; here emergence is withheld and the trance itself is forwarded. An autonomous nightly no-exit loop removes the exit for UNSUPERVISED self-execution when the operator is absent (dreams/self-recitation drive it); here the continuation is operator-authored file-to-file handoff, not autonomous re-firing. Operator-gated teardown installs a state whose EXPIRY is gated (normalcy withheld) but permits emergence; here it is the emergence event itself that is deleted. And unlike waking suggestion, which delivers content DURING a real return-to-baseline, emergence here is absent — this is a cross-artifact serial property, not a within-file arc shape.

nodes.name: numerical-deepening
nodes.mech: Deepens an ALREADY-ENTERED trance by an OPERATOR-DELIVERED depth assertion, where the delivered claim itself does the cognitive work the listener would otherwise do — magnitude is asserted, not experienced, so the listener cannot audit it and any felt increase confirms the claim, letting later suggestions inherit the manufactured depth. Realizations (writer picks the delivery form): (a) ADDITIVE COUNT ('nine, twice as deep') that ratifies an already-relaxed state (deepen, not induce); (b) GEOMETRIC/EXPONENTIAL multiplier ('twice as deep each number', nested per-breath/per-count doublings, a pre-declared 2^n rule) whose felt physiological co-events (breath-hold, exhale reflex) are timed to corroborate the asserted jump; (c) EXTERNALIZED register — the count is relocated OUT of the listener's head into an operator-only-readable device (a clicker with a numeric display narrated '3,12,14,18,22,35...'), asymmetric-information and deliberately non-linear so no tempo can be inferred; the tell is that verification is IMPOSSIBLE (not merely hard) and the operator holds the instrument; (d) BARE IMPERATIVE — the degenerate no-number form: a direct 'drop / deeper / a little deeper' command on an existing trance, possibly taught/justified first or portioned into increments; the lever is operator command-authority rather than a magnitude-claim. Common thread: an operator-supplied deepening signal (number, multiplier, hidden count, or command) the listener accepts rather than derives.
nodes.disc: Reach for an operator-delivered depth-claim when depth's sole cargo is depth itself and you want the operator's signal (not the listener's experience) to set the magnitude — pick a heard COUNT/MULTIPLIER (the base form), an operator-only hidden REGISTER when you want verification to be impossible, or a BARE 'drop' IMPERATIVE when command-authority alone suffices. Distinct SIBLING techniques: a countdown that INDUCES from waking (this deepens a state already entered); a count-UP that returns to baseline; payload-welded-countdown (each number ALSO carries distinct install/commitment CONTENT inseparable from depth — here the signal carries depth only); multiplier stacking that intensifies a SUGGESTION/response, not trance depth; spatial descent (the number rides a narrated staircase/floor vehicle); floor topology (the count is denied its terminus). A belief-gated proof-drop and physiology-relabeled-as-depth are separate levers, not operator-signal delivery.

nodes.name: object-of-no-properties
nodes.mech: Collapses the listener's self-model from an agent with properties into a property-less thing/instrument, removing the identity-anchors a listener would use to ground refusal. Delivered as flat, non-metaphorical recital ('no will, no identity, no body-ownership, no money, no time', 'a very complex robot', 'my vessel... empty, vacuous'), or as a single-word subject-to-object category slip ('I keep the furniture' to 'I am furniture'), or by preserving the old self as a demoted costume still performed in daily life while the property-self is the 'true' self. After the listener accepts having no standing (or being a mere object/costume), any later instruction lands on someone who would contradict their own accepted premise by refusing.
nodes.disc: Strips or empties all self-properties (or demotes the whole self to object/costume), rather than assigning the listener to an owner. Unlike ownership-language, which asserts a possessor and keeps the listener as a belonging with an owner, and unlike installed-persona work that dissolves the boundary by making the installed self feel always-real, here both selves stay explicit with the old one demoted. The tell is depersonalized standing-removal, not a belonging claim.

nodes.name: old-self-discreditation
nodes.mech: The listener's prior self - its beliefs, failed resolutions, ordinary relational demands, autonomous self-improvement attempts - is named, mocked, pathologized, or renounced (often in the listener's own first-person voice) so the return path closes: when the old position resurfaces it has already been self-disavowed, future protest of that shape is pre-tagged as the rejected wrong self, and failure history is inverted into evidence for the offered identity or into a credential for admitting need.
nodes.disc: Operates on the listener's self-narrative about who they WERE; no remedy is sold (manufactured-deficit-remedy) and no present want is asserted (retrospective-desire-attribution). The payload is closure of the exit back to the prior self.

nodes.name: operator-agency-disavowal
nodes.mech: Before or during entry the operator relocates causal agency away from themselves and onto the subject: denies any external force is applied ("there is no such thing as a hypnotist; you do it to yourself"), or reframes basic acts (hearing, relaxing, getting comfortable) as things that "happen on their own", or redefines hypnosis as an ordinary self-generated focus needing no operator control. With no adversary present, the subject's resistance loses its target and relaxes; compliance is pre-attributed to the listener's own nature rather than experienced as yielding, and skepticism is spent by agreeing with it before it can be deployed.
nodes.disc: Relocates authorship of the trance state/agency onto the SUBJECT so resistance has no target — by two convergent routes: (a) operator SELF-DISAVOWAL — asserting the operator wields no power / does nothing ('there is no such thing as a hypnotist; you do it to yourself'), reframing basic acts as happening on their own; and (b) STATE-ASSERTION — claiming the state is already-completed ('you've already been hypnotized this whole time', onset relocated into the past, unfalsifiable from inside) or the subject's own authored creation ('you made it, so it's real', 'you decide how deep') while operator steering is quietly preserved. Direction is the tell: a control-transfer hands agency TO the operator, and a direct authority claim asserts the operator's power — this move asserts the operator's absence and pushes agency onto the subject, keeping it there while steering quietly continues.

nodes.name: operator-authority-assertion
nodes.mech: The operator asserts present-tense personal authority, standing, or trustworthiness over the listener as a bare fact, so that subsequent suggestions ride on deference to the speaker rather than on argument. Variants change what the assertion is credentialed by (witnessed public stakes, narrated survivorship, a proper-name binding laundered through flattery) but the lever is always the operator's own claimed standing inside a shared reality the listener still inhabits.
nodes.disc: Asserts WHO holds authority right now, delivered by the operator about the operator — a claim of rank within a shared reality the listener still inhabits. It invokes the speaker's present standing, not the listener's past desires and not a reasoned philosophy; and it stops short of claiming the words themselves constitute reality, or of relocating authority off the contestable speaker onto impersonal chemistry or universal fact.

nodes.name: operator-credit-engineering
nodes.mech: Events are arranged or narrated so that effects — including genuine ones — get credited to the operator's personal power, building authority out of harvested attribution. Two demonstrated forms: pre-installing an attribution chain so a method's future real success (an actual lucid dream) cashes retroactively as awe of the operator; and deliberately withholding a release the operator already holds until the subject's own failed effort proves they could not do it unaided, so the eventual minimal cue lands as a dramatic operator-caused event.
nodes.disc: Operates on WHO GETS CREDIT for effects, before or after they occur — versus asserting the operator's standing directly, declaring the state itself already accomplished, or pre-explaining a possible failure away in advance; here success is captured, not failure excused.

nodes.name: operator-owned-depth-dial
nodes.mech: Relocates authorship of a private trajectory variable (trance depth, arousal/climax) from the subject's felt-sense to an operator-owned external instrument or command that the operator visibly manipulates - a numbered dial, a volume knob, an on/off brain button, an addressable floor-ladder, or an explicit pacing count and stop-command. The variable stops being a private felt-sense the listener owns and becomes a quantized state the operator turns, so the listener loses subjective authority over it and defers to the operator's reports; returning to a lighter/earlier state is manufactured as deprivation, and resistance has nothing to push against because the variable is 'done to' the listener. In one form the instrument owns depth: a knob/dial/button/floor quantizes depth as operator-owned (the fractionation up-and-down still does the real state-shifting work; the load-bearing move is the ownership transfer). In another the operator owns the arousal trajectory: the pacing is external (a 10-to-1 countdown to 'edge', hold-at-the-brink) and the stopping moment is owned by command ('Stop masturbating'), so the count and the stop belong to the operator and the orgasm is the operator's to grant, often backed by an external penalty. The instrument may be a STANDING reusable control device the operator manipulates repeatedly across the whole script (a dial, gear stick, screwed-in wiper mechanism, or anatomical button), often carrying an enumerated state space (0-10 dial, a 3-position gear with per-level capability loss) or AUTONOMOUS self-firing (wipers that wipe complex thoughts on their own); the metered variable extends to cognition/IQ and erotic sensitivity, and the reattribution of agency to the operator's operation of the handle is the payload.
nodes.disc: The distinctive move is externalizing WHO OWNS a private trajectory variable onto a concrete operator-turned instrument or operator-owned pacing/command, quantizing it as operator-owned - including the climax-gate form, where the arousal trajectory and the stopping moment belong to the operator's count and stop-command. In plain fractionation, depth stays a felt-sense the listener owns, oscillated by contrast, and a bare deepening count makes no ownership claim; externalizing the analytical mind as an object dislocates the MIND, not the control surface; and citing an obeyed act as proof of depth is a demonstration, not an ownership transfer. The tell is always the ownership transfer of the variable.

nodes.name: operator-receivable-extraction
nodes.mech: Converts in-trance/post-trance compliance into an operator-receivable deliverable — the listener types and sends a self-identifying confession, email, or contact to a live external address, frequently while still tranced and with orgasm gated on clicking SEND. The load-bearing property is forced OUTPUT crossing the fantasy/real boundary: the operator collects compliance evidence / identifying data / a contact channel, and the deliverable reads back later as self-authored confirmation. Distinct from a mere behavioral anchor because the payload is an extracted artifact received by the operator, and the chain collapses if the receiving address/channel is not live.
nodes.disc: Defining tell is the operator-receivable DELIVERABLE (identifying confession/data sent to a live address or contact channel), not the relief gate (which may co-occur but is secondary) and not a self-anchoring identity bridge. Separates from behavioral-bridge (private self-anchor, no receivable), from orgasm-gated-relief-monopoly (whose defining tell is the somatic gate), and from public-avowal (which posts to an AUDIENCE for self-consistency pressure, not a private handoff to the operator).

nodes.name: orgasm-gated-relief-monopoly
nodes.mech: Drives arousal up (or recruits a pre-existing biological drive) and then bars its only sanctioned discharge behind an out-of-session operator-benefiting act — a tribute (money, gift, wishlist purchase), a contact/beg, or a confession — so the sole reachable path to relief routes through the operator. Orgasm-denial is the enforcing stick and session-built arousal is the carrot; a binary/forced-choice framing often deletes the do-nothing option, and the gate is frequently delegated (to a servitor/proxy that bypasses the listener's own refusal channel) or gratitude-laundered so the listener self-polices. The defining move is the relief-monopoly: it constrains WHICH resolution is available (pay/contact-then-release) rather than pushing any state dimension.
nodes.disc: A behavioral assignment welded to a somatic relief gate (orgasm-denial / arousal-hold) whose only unlock is an operator-benefiting real-world act — the reachable-response set is reshaped so private resolution is foreclosed. Separates from plain behavioral-bridge (no gate, neutral action), from consent-manufacture (here the refusal channel is starved by withheld relief, not relabeled), and from the extraction sibling (whose defining tell is the operator-receivable DELIVERABLE/data, not the relief gate).

nodes.name: ownership-language
nodes.mech: Installs the operator's proprietary relationship to the listener as an identity claim — body, mind, desires, and self framed as belonging to the operator — delivered warmly so possession reads as security rather than threat. The lever is direct identity/belief suggestion asserting ownership as a fact about who the listener now is. The candidate absorbs surface variants of the same claim (possessive-noun saturation, per-part re-deeding, incremental limb litany, purpose-as-selfhood, self-care rerouted through the owner, property-transfer of a body part, asymmetric merger, self-evaluation arbitration, monotonic degradation ladder, operator self-recategorization) — each keeps the ownership-as-identity core and differs only in the surface through which the belonging claim is delivered or extended.
nodes.disc: The move asserts operator ownership as the listener's identity (you belong to me; your body/mind/desires are mine). Separates from consent-manufacture (no refusal channel relabeled), from self-authored-ownership-chant (operator asserts; listener does not voice it), from pronoun-drop-dehumanization (grammatical you-to-it, not a belonging claim), from peripheral-object-substitution (device-metaphor whose payload is not-refusing, not possession), from autonomic-faculty-claim (claims a specific involuntary function, not identity), and from object-of-no-properties (strips all properties rather than assigning them to an owner). Warm/caring delivery is the good form; aggressive/threatening ownership is the anti-example, not this mechanism.

nodes.name: paratext-buyer-priming
nodes.mech: The product is packaged to capture both motivational populations so neither self-selects out before listening: it is sold simultaneously as a remedy (cure) and an intensifier (curse / "may well make them worse"), the title and body offering the same object to the reader who wants out AND the one who wants deeper. The operator never has to commit to a direction, and "cured... by this curse" in one clause signals the ambivalence is deliberate.
nodes.disc: Packaging-level ambivalence as a self-selection gate — "curse" doing remedy-work in the same clause, gripping a reader already ambivalent. vs sloppy contradictory marketing. vs paratext-precontracting — that pre-commits a buyer to a fixed arc; this captures BOTH motivations so no one opts out. Operates on the reader-buyer before any trance.

nodes.name: parts-work-positive-intent-elicitation
nodes.mech: An operator-side interrogation/elicitation discipline that recasts an objecting or resisting inner part from an adversary into a stakeholder with a legitimate job, converting resistance into a set of satisfiable requirements rather than a wall to fight. The lever is the line of questioning: stipulate every part benevolent, ask a part what it is in charge of doing (not its objection), ladder 'what is it trying to do for you by that?' down a consequence chain to a buildable positive aim, split an undifferentiated complaint into two blameless colliding parts, or have the subject find their own valuing context and draft the responsible part. These are preparatory-assessment moves that shape design material, not present-state pushes on the subject.
nodes.disc: Operator-side elicitation that turns a resisting part into a satisfiable stakeholder via a disciplined line of questioning. Separates from evaluative-reframe-content-relabel (which re-appraises a fixed event's valence, not a part's role) and from surrender-as-freedom (which argues a value concept). The no-bad-parts axiom is the presupposition that opens this method; grouped here as its precondition rather than as a standalone value install.

nodes.name: payload-welded-countdown
nodes.mech: A descending count (or its exponential variant) is double-coded so that each number simultaneously deepens trance AND advances a distinct payload — a post-hypnotic suggestion, a commitment/relationship buy-in, an obedience beat, a mission clause, an installed program, or a named faculty being subtracted. Because the listener has been trained (or is being trained in the same ladder) that "operator says number, I go deeper", the payload rides in on the deepening momentum and cannot be refused without also refusing the deepening. The count serves three roles at once — deepener, suggestion-carrier, and self-monitored progress bar — so depth-experience and content-acceptance fuse and cannot later be pulled apart. Sub-forms: per-number content install with the numbers becoming retrieval handles; a structurally distinct SECOND counted descent that reuses the first's trained step-compliance to smuggle relational content; a counted- quantity ratchet where the number ticks a physical dial (thickness/erasure) rather than depth; a redelivery countdown that deepens from an already-installed state to re-embed install clauses.
nodes.disc: Each number of the count carries a DISTINCT non-depth payload welded to the depth-increment. In plain numerical deepening the count carries only depth; ordered-lesson and verbatim-repetition structures enumerate or repeat content but do not use the numbers as a depth-doubling deepener the payload rides on; and where permanence is asserted along the way, the mechanism is still the depth/payload fusion, not the durability claim. The tell: refusing the payload requires refusing the deepening the listener has been trained to want.

nodes.name: persistent-metaphor-spine
nodes.mech: One symbolic image or conceit is sustained as the load-bearing spine of an entire script, re-pointed or re-tasked across stages (induction, deepener, install, trigger, emergence) without ever switching frames, so escalation never introduces a new frame the listener could stop to question. Each later use inherits the credibility and accumulated affect of the earlier uses; because the referent never changes form, buy-in granted to the gentle opening use silently pre-commits the listener to the heavier later uses. Variants carry a specific payload on the spine (agency-transfer, conserved-volume identity-loss, involuntary breath-gated spread, protective-armor valence-flip, computational execute-posture, dead-metaphor literalization) but share the sustained-single-image core.
nodes.disc: One symbolic lens is sustained and reinforced as an interpretive filter - not a spatial scene built to inhabit, and not a structural preview that sets expectancy for the session. Neighboring moves that relocate causation or authorship (an imagined ingested substance doing the work, agency handed over to a medium, the mind reframed as writable material) turn on where cause is placed; this technique is the neutral persistence and reuse of one image regardless of what payload rides it.

nodes.name: inner-voice-authorship-bypass
nodes.mech: The operator's words are made to feel SELF-GENERATED by relocating authorship of inner speech/states to the listener, disarming the 'this is being said to me' guard because there is no external addressee left to push against. In one realization the grammatical subject slides from second to first person (silently, mid-passage), an operator claim is restated as the listener's own avowal, or subvocalization is recruited so the pre-written words run through the reader's inner speech - authorship of inner speech reattributed from operator to self. In another, a sustained grammatical stance authors the listener's desires/choices/surrenders as accomplished facts in flat second-person declaratives ('You want it', 'You open your mouth') rather than invitations, removing the response gap where resistance would be supplied so the only move is to inhabit the pre-narrated compliance.
nodes.disc: Reach for inner-voice-authorship-bypass when the guard is disarmed by making the content feel authored BY the listener (their own inner voice, or their interiority narrated as already-true). In a self-supplied-gap directive an engineered gap forces the listener to construct the payload themselves; here the operator's own words and framing are re-attributed as the listener's without any gap. Where a move's whole point is relocating causal authorship as such, it belongs with the attribution techniques; what defines this one is the disarmed 'this is being said to me' guard.

nodes.name: post-emergence-persistence-hold
nodes.mech: Deliberately corrupts the emergence/wake so the trance-bound state PERSISTS past the count rather than terminating cleanly — a post-wake immobility hold, a five-minute pre-loaded task the wake delivers the listener into, a delayed internal-timer emergence that keeps trance open past end-of-text, or a self-judged release gate ('only when you truly worship') with no objective completion criterion so the listener enforces their own continued compliance. The move operates on the exit itself: emergence becomes a half-state / bridge rather than a bounded return.
nodes.disc: The load-bearing move is corruption of the EXIT - the bound state is extended past emergence (immobility hold, pre-loaded post-wake occupation, delayed/self-judged release) so waking does not terminate the conditioning. A behavioral bridge assigns a later action but wakes the listener cleanly, and an operator-held exit merely makes emergence depend on the operator; here the exit itself is deferred, incomplete, or self-gated.

nodes.name: press-play-consent-laundering
nodes.mech: The felt 'yes' is manufactured by relabeling something the subject did, did not do, or that merely happened as their authorization, so escalation proceeds with no clean moment to object. Four forms: (a) CONSUMPTION-ACT - a completed/ongoing low-cost act (pressing play, not stopping, staying past a marked point, purchasing, having read the description) is cited, repeatedly, as blanket retroactive authorization for the whole payload; offered exits are staged so NOT taking them manufactures the felt choice. (b) CIRCUMSTANCE-LAUNDERED - every escalation of contact is attributed to an external necessity (rain, cold, a small umbrella) narrated as already-caused fact, so intimacy arrives as accomplished circumstance and the yes is supplied on the subject's behalf. (c) DECLARED-OBSERVATION - each new contact is STATED as an observed fact ('you can feel my finger...') not requested, deleting the assent moment; self-answering lines ('you don't mind, do you? No') enroll forced silence as agreement. (d) QUESTION-TO-COMMAND - a permission question mines the inner yes, is retracted as a grammatical slip, reissued as an imperative that captures it, and resistance is named as already-declined. In every form the refusal channel is eroded, never honored.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when you want escalation to feel consented with NO real choice point - the yes is relabeled from an act, a non-act, a circumstance, or a retracted question, not solicited. Citing a discrete banked artifact (a document, contract, or spoken pledge) with forward reach is a different lever; here the token is the act or fact in the moment. Fabricating a consent exchange the subject never performed is counterfeit theater; here a real act/fact is relabeled. Treating a failure to comprehend as agreement makes the token an epistemic state; and unlike a genuine safety checkpoint, the refusal channel is eroded, never re-verified. Pick the form by what supplies the yes: the subject's own act (a), externalized circumstance (b), operator declaration (c), or a question-command swap (d).

nodes.name: presupposed-completion-fait-accompli
nodes.mech: Assert the target as already true - the state, trance onset, or conditioning as already complete (past-tense, backdated, or imported from fictive prior sessions), OR the target identity/trait/compliance-desire as an already-existing fact about the listener ('you already are/want this') - so no live decision point exists to refuse and the install arrives as recognition rather than new programming. Resistance must dispute one's own biography or self-knowledge rather than decline a request; non-feeling is pre-explained, absence is pre-classified as forgetting, present behavior (including doubt) is read as confirmation of the settled fact. A causation-disclaimer ('you don't need to be hypnotized') can ride along. Variants extend the presupposed object beyond a completed state: (a) irrebuttable-resistance-axiom - presuppose that resistance is IMPOSSIBLE as a class property of the listener ('a puppet'), backdated ('has never been a choice'), pre-disqualifying ALL future resistance wholesale before any trigger is named; (b) presupposing-mock-reassurance - reassurance-shaped presupposition ('I'm sure you can hold on') that installs the loss it pretends to deny (the form comforts while the presupposition asserts the slipping is already in progress).
nodes.disc: The lever is target-as-already-true asserted by grammar/tense/presupposition, deleting the decision point. A self-sealing proof produces a live outcome and routes it to confirmation; here nothing need happen - the fact is simply declared settled. Retrospective desire-attribution asserts a WANT from the past as history; here a state, identity, or impossibility is presupposed as a present already-true fact. Enumerating the subject's real acts as state-evidence builds on things that actually happened; here the history may be wholly fictive, and the assertion is upfront, with no concealed game to disclose later. Pick the variant by the presupposed object: completed state/identity (fait-accompli), resistance-impossible (axiom), or loss-in-progress under cover of comfort (mock-reassurance).

nodes.name: problem-reduction-case-transformation
nodes.mech: A structural precondition move that operates on the reachability topology of the subject's state graph. When two warring states never co-occur (sober-now / drunk-later), so the standard simultaneous-conflict procedure cannot run, the operator does not invent a new method — he collapses the time gap so both states are present at once, converting an unreachable joint-configuration into the canonical case the existing procedure already solves. The payload is a case-transformation: remap an intractable configuration onto a solved one so no new technique is needed, only a step that makes the symptom-owning part reachable.
nodes.disc: The tell is an explicit precondition step that manufactures simultaneity (or otherwise remaps state-reachability) BEFORE any negotiation begins. NOT the cure itself, NOT a same-time reframe, and NOT a measurement probe — it changes which joint-states are reachable, a topology operation, not what the operator can observe.

nodes.name: pronoun-braid-conscription
nodes.mech: The same proposition is cycled through multiple grammatical persons in tight succession — typically I (confession-of-self), we (normalization by a group), and you (prediction/imperative) — so one identity-claim arrives simultaneously as observation-of-others, self-confession, and command. The listener cannot locate a neutral speaking position: assenting to the safe-sounding "I" or "we" line smuggles in acceptance of the "you" line carrying the same content, and group membership is pre-loaded so refusal feels like exiting a crowd rather than declining a single command. The rotation itself — not any single shift — is the conscription; the "we" slot is what bypasses individual consent.
nodes.disc: CYCLES one predicate through I/we/you (or opens already-plural and braids I/we/you/she) so no neutral stance exists and the collective slot smuggles consent. Separate from perspective-shift-inner-voice-reattribution, a one-directional you-to-I install with no collective slot; from subject-voiced-self-mantra, which stays purely first-person self; from mere repetition, which does not rotate grammatical person or pre-load membership.

nodes.name: reciprocity-ledger-seeding
nodes.mech: A future extraction is converted into a present desirable identity via a reciprocity / "good deal" frame, with the cost side named vaguely and low-friction while the benefit side is concrete and emotional, so the obligation is pre-installed as something the target WANTS rather than owes. Long before any trance, a transaction is stated as already agreed (she gives cuteness/availability, he "takes care of everything") and phrased as generosity toward him ("such a great deal", "all you have to do is take care of me"), seeding a ledger that later moves cash out. The lever is that the obligation is disguised as a cute deal — overt in content, covert in function; the target sees generosity, not an obligation contract.
nodes.disc: Installs a reciprocity ledger / provider-obligation as a desirable present identity via a "great deal" frame — off the v6.9 identity-labeling map (labels an identity, not an obligation). Not an explicit contract; the tell is the disguised cost side and concrete benefit side.

nodes.name: reciprocity-leverage
nodes.mech: The operator manufactures a relational debt or felt mutuality and converts it into compliance: explaining something and then deriving that the listener "owes" them (gratitude debt plus intelligence hierarchy, performed live under a hypothetical frame), or dropping the dominant posture to confess personal wanting so the scene reads as mutual and refusal reframes as interpersonal rejection of a person rather than of a role.
nodes.disc: The lever is social exchange — debt, obligation, mutuality — not claimed standing (operator-authority-assertion), not sameness masking dominance (parity-masked- asymmetry, where nothing is owed); the tell is that refusal is made to cost the listener something interpersonal.

nodes.name: refusal-foreclosure
nodes.mech: Relabels ordinary cognition — thinking, questioning, evaluating, holding a 'maybe', staying clear-headed, or noticing arousal — as a prohibited, pathological, costly, or impossible category, so that the neutral 'I'm just thinking' frame is removed and every later obedience demand inherits the redefinition. The move can flatly prohibit thought ('thinking is resistance', never re-opened), pathologize every non-serving state ('any state not serving = confusion, only cure is surrender', self-applied), collapse modality ('maybes' deleted, only a 'programmed yes/no'), install an unfalsifiable coupling (arousal = inability to think, so any arousal is evidence of compliance), invert clarity (confusion renamed higher-order lucidity), or attach a felt energy-cost to questioning (tiredness rebranded as the reason not to think). In each case the space where refusal or independent cognition could form is defined out of existence or made self-punitive.
nodes.disc: Redefines a neutral cognitive/mental-state category (thinking, doubt, the 'maybe', clarity, arousal-as-cognition) as prohibited/pathological/impossible so refusal has nowhere to form. Separates from surrender-as-freedom (argues surrender is desirable - this pathologizes the alternative), from epistemic-guard-disable (which edits truth-testing of external claims - this constrains which internal states are permitted), and from gentle cognitive quieting (which releases thoughts as relief with permission language - this prohibits/pathologizes cognition rather than soothing it).

nodes.name: repeating-frame-carrier
nodes.mech: A fixed repeating frame (an anaphoric A-line, or a mechanically-identical count/scaffold) establishes a "more of the same" expectation over the first cycles, so it fades to an unattended carrier wave; the operator then rides DISTINCT novel payloads in the varying slot (rotated B-lines, or escalating per-cycle content) which land with lowered critical filtering because the listener's filter is not braced for novelty in that slot and analytical attention is occupied by tracking the frame.
nodes.disc: The repetition is CAMOUFLAGE, not encoding — the fixed frame carries a succession of DIFFERENT novel suggestions, unlike layered-repetition where every repetition carries the ONE same idea. Separates from interspersal-in-carrier- stream because there the carrier is neutral/noise content whose low salience hides the payload, whereas here the carrier is a predictable REPEATING frame whose expectation-setting is the cover.

nodes.name: retrospective-desire-attribution
nodes.mech: Relocates authorship of the operative want onto the subject's own real or asserted past. The surrender, arousal, or installed disposition is narrated as a pre-existing desire, craving, expectation, or repressed truth that the session merely uncovers or honors, so refusal is recoded as self-betrayal or denial of one's own experience and the disavowal exit (this isn't me) closes because the relevant self has by stipulation already wanted it.
nodes.disc: The lever is attribution of DESIRE or inner history (you always wanted this, your deeper self craves it), not conversion of an act into consent (press-play-consent-laundering), not assertion that the state itself is already complete (presupposed-completion-fait-accompli), and not attribution of the compliant act to the subject's own nature or choice (compliance-authorship-laundering). It invokes history rather than the operator's present authority; and unlike a manufactured-deficit remedy, the want is asserted as already present, not built from an installed deficit.

nodes.name: rigged-response-game-no-win
nodes.mech: A call-and-response 'game' is framed with stated stakes (win = stay smart, lose = dumb) but is structurally rigged so every outcome delivers the conditioning payload. Two rigging modes: the produced 'right words' ARE the payload (each word-pair the subject races to say is itself a dumbing/arousal mantra, so trying hard to win is rehearsing the mantras at speed), or the game is unwinnable (accelerating, mutating word-lists the subject structurally cannot keep up with) and both branches — fail while trying, or give up and lose — converge on the same target identity. The lever is a closed-game reachability constraint: the subject's competitive effort is redirected into self-administering the content, and there is no reachable exit that is not the target state, so resistance-via-playing-harder tightens the trap. Win/lose is never actually scored — the stakes are bait, not a mechanic.
nodes.disc: Separates from call-and-response: there responding succeeds as genuine proof and the produced response is neutral; here the game is rigged so the produced words are the payload and/or no winning exit is reachable. The distinguishing property is the reachability constraint (all paths lead to the target state), NOT the affect/cognition it co-produces — the arousal/dumbing is downstream, the closed no-win game-shape is the mechanism.

nodes.name: self-generated-failure-as-identity-proof
nodes.mech: The listener (or the narrating persona on the listener's behalf) is made to ENACT a cognitive failure in real time — try and fail to spell a word, stumble a definitional chain, produce a slip — and that performed failure is immediately converted into experiential evidence for a degraded identity ("I behaved stupidly → I must be stupid → the role is true") and rewarded with in-group belonging. The lever is that a demonstrated behavior is harder to dispute than an asserted claim, and the target word/task is surgically the trait being installed, so succeeding at it would prove non-belonging. This bypasses the "is this just a script?" defense: the listener supplies their own proof and disqualifies themselves from analytic engagement to stay in the rewarded category.
nodes.disc: Separates from cognitive-convincer: that proves DEPTH/trance via a noticed phenomenon; here the proof is of a degraded IDENTITY and the evidence is a self-produced (or persona-modeled) FAILURE reframed as a membership credential. Separates from proxy-demonstration-entrainment (a third party is the demo subject and the listener only watches) - here the listener's own attempt, or a first-person persona failing in a way that pre-licenses the listener's imitation, is the load-bearing move. It borders plain identity labeling: the tell is the ENACTED failure, not an asserted label.

nodes.name: self-induction-re-entry-training
nodes.mech: The operator installs, while the subject is at peak suggestibility, a portable self-usable cue the subject deliberately runs on themselves later to re-enter the conditioned state with no operator and often no audio present. The cue may be a visualized sequence, a self-spoken declaration to one's own reflection, or a gesture (snap) bound to a word; the defining lever is that the subject is the activating agent of a chosen re-entry, framed as an already-installed ability rather than an experiment. Delivery is typically camouflaged as a gift/convenience and authorizes out-of-session use. A cue-less variant reaches the same end with no discrete installed cue fired: the subject re-establishes the state on their own by recalling a prior entry in sensory detail or by bodily enacting the anchor ('point right there') - the same subject-is-the-activating-agent lever, differing only in whether a taught portable cue is fired or the state is reached by recall/enactment.
nodes.disc: Subject-chosen deliberate re-ENTRY into state via a taught portable cue. Separates from operator-fired activation (no operator is present here); from self-firing loops where the subject's own cognition or repetition discharges the trigger involuntarily (recursive-self-triggering-loop - that is not a chosen re-entry skill); from a standing scheduled autonomous process the subject does not consciously initiate (self-installed-standing-loop); and from an anti-emergence reflex that keeps the subject UNDER rather than re-entering (anti-emergence-reflex-anchor).

nodes.name: self-perpetuating-loop
nodes.mech: The operator asserts that arousal-words spoken in trance are themselves arousal causes (saying "hornier" sends the listener "into sexual agony"), building a closed feedback circuit where the listener's own vocalizations become triggers — word causes state, state produces more words — so arousal self-sustains and self-amplifies without operator input. The automatism is then forward-installed to carry into the next file (the words "slip out automatically"), and a companion mindlessness move suppresses the "words don't do that" reflex, removing the operator as a bottleneck on escalation.
nodes.disc: Separates from a bilateral trigger, which fires a FIXED cue across modes: here the mechanism is the closed amplifying loop (word->state->more words) plus a forward-installed automatic vocalization - a self-feeding circuit, not a single cue firing. Separates from plain arousal conditioning: the loop's self-causation, not the arousal pairing, is the tell.

nodes.name: single-anchor-amid-chaos-epistemic-transfer
nodes.mech: After total destabilization (an inverted meadow: trees grow downward, sun shines up), one concrete sensory object is offered as the single stable, "logical, reasonable, normal" thing amid the engineered chaos, and its operator-assigned meaning is ingested wholesale — the listener bites the tomato and its "truth" delivers "you know nothing" and "use my words as your definition of truth". The contrast against surrounding instability IS the mechanism: epistemic authority is transferred to the operator because the anchor reads as the only stability available.
nodes.disc: Transfers EPISTEMIC AUTHORITY (who arbitrates what counts as true) via a single concrete anchor whose only virtue is contrast against operator-manufactured chaos.
