Distinct from offering cognitive relief as a standing delegation of thinking, and from investing a meaningful fetish object with significance - the tell is that ANY vivid object would serve; the mechanism is stability-by-contrast, not the content.

nodes.name: subject-voiced-self-mantra
nodes.mech: The entire artifact is voiced in the first person from inside the desired endpoint, with no external operator addressing the listener — the text IS the self-talk the listener is to speak, mouth along with, or subvocalize. Because the voice already speaks from the already-altered self ("I'm an ecstasy slut", "I suck till I'm stupid"), identity-claims arrive pre-accepted rather than as suggestions to negotiate; the "is this me or them?" check is short-circuited because the listener is both speaker and target. The load-bearing event is the voicing, not the hearing; refusal collapses to "stop identifying / stop saying it," and there is no operator-says / listener-experiences loop to resist.
nodes.disc: First-person throughout with the LISTENER as the speaker and no operator surface at all. Separate from perspective-shift-inner-voice-reattribution, which has an operator whose grammar shifts you-to-I (here there is nothing to shift FROM); from third-person-surrogate-displacement, where the listener is the described third party rather than the speaker; from peer-testimonial-carrier, where the first-person voice is a separate already-converted PEER the listener identifies with, not the listener's own endpoint-voice.

nodes.name: surrender-as-freedom-philosophical-conditioning
nodes.mech: A sustained, carefully-reasoned argument delivered under reduced critical resistance that redefines an abstract value-concept (freedom, control, obedience, submission, selfhood) so that abdication of agency reads as the desirable, higher, or truer state. The lever is conceptual belief-modification: the subject is invited to accept a philosophical position (surrender is the truest freedom; submission is virtuous practice; individuality is a burden; the self is an object whose objecthood is an upgrade) rather than to obey a command, so later compliance is experienced as self-authored consequence of an accepted worldview. Variants keep the reasoned-argument core but route it through a specific vehicle — religion-comparison, Maslow/biology ladder, cosmological balance, didactic Greek/Sanskrit lecture, mask-normalization, relaxation-equals-control equation, pleasing-the-controller redefinition, or a pre-induction self-care reframe.
nodes.disc: Redefines an abstract VALUE concept (freedom/control/obedience/submission/self-worth) via reasoned argument the subject accepts as belief. Separates from consent-term-redefinition-smuggle (which widens the scope of an already-granted consent word by asserted false-fact equation, not reasoned argument), from epistemic-guard-disable (which attacks the truth-testing faculty itself rather than a value claim), from volition-collapse-consent-equation (which equates compulsion and choice to close the free-choice escape hatch), and from surrender-as-freedom (which delivers the FELT somatic relief of surrender in trance rather than arguing the philosophy conceptually).

nodes.name: surrender-as-freedom
nodes.mech: Takes a state the listener would normally resist (loss of control, loss of cognition, autonomy, physical restraint, the burden of choice) and recodes it as relief or freedom, so yielding registers as gain rather than loss. The lever is a valence inversion that leans on a real prior aversion the listener already holds (effort is unpleasant, deciding is stressful, social-evaluative thinking is burdensome) and offers the surrendered state as the cure. Once installed, any later flicker of resistance is pre-loaded with the answer that resisting is the stressful, self-depriving, higher-effort path, so the resistance impulse turns against itself. Requires the subject in-trance for the felt relief to land; the somatic burden-lifting is the trance-side component.
nodes.disc: The move recodes a normally-resisted loss as a felt gain/relief, weaponizing an existing aversion. Separate from its philosophical twin (which argues the case that surrender is freedom at the conceptual level rather than delivering the felt affect), from paradox-binding (which routes resistance INTO compliance - here resistance is merely re-priced as costly, and the listener can still resist), from consent-manufacture (which relabels non-consent as consent rather than making a loss feel good), and from the relief-valve structure (a sanctioned exception that routes need-state back into compliance - a containment topology, not a felt reframe).

nodes.name: third-person-surrogate-frame
nodes.mech: Instead of collapsing the person gap toward first person, the script WIDENS it: the listener is never grammatically addressed as "you" but is described in the third person (as a named persona, as "she"/"they", or as a story surrogate the listener must voluntarily slot into). Because suggestions arrive as descriptions of a character rather than commands to a listener, reflexive resistance has no grammatical object to push against — a fact about "the character" or "him" cannot be disobeyed. The eventual pronoun-collapse back to "you" (or the persona claimed as the listener) is the load-bearing trance event; until then the third-person frame is what makes otherwise-defended traits safe to absorb.
nodes.disc: Removes the second-person addressee by narrating the listener in the third person / as a surrogate, so resistance has no target. Perspective-shift inner-voice reattribution runs the OPPOSITE direction (you-to-I first-person capture); a subject-voiced self-mantra is first-person with the listener as speaker (here the listener is the described third party, not the speaker); and plain consciousness-splitting divides awareness without the grammatical-person vehicle — here the third-person address IS the mechanism.

nodes.name: transparent-narration
nodes.mech: The operator OPENLY and HONESTLY narrates the mechanism of influence as it operates, so that understanding the technique becomes the vehicle for accepting it — visibility confers no defense because the described effect executes while the description is processed, and the candor itself recruits trust/complicity/arousal. Naming the move charges it; the listener who 'sees every step' is captured by seeing. Absorbed: (named-technique-meta) the operator NAMES the technique/structure while inside it ('a nice little loop', 'Identity Labeling') in a shared-observation/authority register, converting the structure from implicit to acknowledged feature so it is accepted uncontested.
nodes.disc: Reach for transparent-narration when HONEST present-tense disclosure of the running mechanism IS the delivery vehicle. vs disavowal-and-masking (95): the inverse — that denies/conceals the operation. vs disclosure-as-inoculation (96): that discloses to shield against FUTURE recognition; here the disclosure operates in the present tense as the vehicle. The named-technique-meta variant labels the pattern as an authority/normalizing signal, still honest. Risk low.

nodes.name: validate-then-weaponize-disposal
nodes.mech: Installs a reusable, self-administrable disposal ritual aimed at identity-content, built by first VALIDATING the listener's normal referential cognition (words evoke pictures, demonstrated on neutral content — the pink balloon) and then inverting exactly that validated capacity into the disposal mechanism: named cognitive load (job, dissertation, to-dos) is loaded into the imagined container, which drifts and pops, content gone, cycling fill/pop 'until you only think what you're told.' Because the listener's own demonstrated competence powers the ritual, the 'I can still think' defense is pre-co-opted — yes, and that goes into the balloon.
nodes.disc: Three joint tells, all required: (1) an INSTALLED, reusable, looping ritual — not a one-shot departure image; (2) the validate-then-weaponize sequence — the disposal runs on cognition the operator first certified as correct, pre-co-opting the capacity-based defense; (3) the target is identity-content, with a thought-control endpoint. Cognitive quieting settles ongoing thought via departure imagery — bubbles that merely float away belong there; this installs a reusable disposal ritual. Concrete externalization parks the analytical FACULTY as a dislocated object, preserved and retrievable; here CONTENT is loaded into a disposable object and destroyed, cyclically. The 'I can still think' pre-co-opt shares the logic of closing every response route, but the operative install is the disposal loop itself, not an option-space closure.

nodes.name: value-hierarchy-inversion
nodes.mech: Reranks a value the same script (or the listener) already holds so that a subordinated or aversive outcome reads as an upgrade rather than a loss. The move installs or inverts a hierarchy: demotes a reward it earlier manufactured (your pleasure is 'nothing compared to hers', 'only a byproduct'), ranks a bigger pleasure above orgasm to pre-position later denial as an upgrade, inverts worth so the sub is 'nothing' and the operator 'everything' with an assent tag foreclosing the objection, argues ego-death as a net-gain identity upgrade to 'object', recodes denial as fulfillment ('always already coming'), or recodes withheld release as itself the gift. Prior scarcity or an accepted frame makes the demotion feel like an honor, and the natural objection is converted into desire in the same breath.
nodes.disc: Reranks/inverts a motivational or worth hierarchy so a loss/subordination reads as an upgrade — operates on the value ORDERING, not on a value's definition and not on the truth faculty. Separates from surrender-as-freedom (argues a concept is truer via reasoned philosophy — this flips a ranking, often fused to an assent-tag foreclosure) and from cognition-pathologized-as-resistance (which pathologizes a cognitive state rather than reranking a reward/worth).

nodes.name: vicarious-modeling-installation
nodes.mech: Showing the target others performing (or NOT performing) an act — even on film, with no instruction to imitate — silently re-weights what the viewer treats as available and appropriate and shifts their own subsequent rate of that act; valence is set entirely by what is modeled (the same channel cures phobia or transmits aggression). VARIANTS by carrier/direction: (a) in-person/film depiction [vicarious-modeling] — mere observation of a model raises the behavior, no live plurality/instruction/prohibition; (b) media-scale one-way [publicized-modeling-contagion] — wide broadcast of a similar other's act (e.g. publicized suicides) raises the base rate population-wide among identifiers, differing from (a) only by scale and carrier; (c) inaction/mutual-visibility [pluralistic-ignorance-freeze] — among co-present strangers each reads the others' calm non-response as evidence nothing is wrong and suppresses their own, a recursive freeze that yields less help than a lone witness (broken by singling one person out).
nodes.disc: Reach for this when mere OBSERVATION of a model shifts the viewer's own rate — no belonging is offered, no operator required, nothing suggested/triggered/scheduled. Pick the variant by carrier (in-person/film vs media-scale) and direction (action-raising vs inaction-freeze). NOT social-proof-belonging-enrollment (membership/conformity is the lever, not rate-shift-by-exposure) and NOT two-track-relational-delivery (a foreground RELATION carries the payload via identification, not a bare modeled behavior).

nodes.name: warning-is-the-payload
nodes.mech: The script opens by repeatedly telling the listener to leave because their memories will drain if they stay — but every "you should leave" sentence is a vivid rehearsal of memory-loss imagery. The instruction to escape is the delivery vehicle for the payload; because the format guarantees the listener keeps playing, staying gets silently reframed as a chosen submission, manufacturing pre-commitment before any formal induction.
nodes.disc: The warning's own sentences ARE the induction content (each escape-warning rehearses the payload). vs a genuine safety disclaimer or content warning — a boundary offered before content. vs warning-as-binding-agreement (kin) — that plants a warning to cite BACK as agreement; here the warning delivers the payload directly.

nodes.name: weaponized-transparency-inoculation
nodes.mech: Openly names the manipulation or the influence-channel and reframes it as protection, then pre-classifies outside contact, critics, or independent checking as the real threat — so any later critical thought about being manipulated arrives with a pre-installed reply ('yes, and that was the good part') and submission-affect flips from loss-of-power into being-protected. Variants build an 'in your own mind' enclosure sold as safe that structurally admits exactly one channel (the operator's voice), invert safety onto danger ('it is safe to be unsafe' so resistance feels unsafe), or relocate interpretive authority over the listener's own internal states to the operator while degrading outside frames as shallow/dangerous. The disclosure is weaponized to inoculate against future critique and increase isolation, not offered to let the listener opt out.
nodes.disc: Names/discloses the manipulation-or-influence and flips its valence to protection while pre-labeling outside contact/critique as the threat — an inoculation against a CLASS of future critical thoughts. Transparent narration honestly narrates the move so understanding becomes acceptance — here the disclosure is weaponized and pairs with critic-as-enemy. A genuine safety net lets the deeper mind reject harm — this inverts that into a single-channel filter admitting only the operator. And surrender-as-freedom is a reasoned value argument, not an inoculation.

nodes.name: capacity-saturation-overload
nodes.mech: Imposes more concurrent processing demand than working memory and the executive monitor can carry, so the auditing faculty is saturated or displaced onto the load and suggestions arrive unevaluated; the felt lapse (blankness, attention thrash, grasping) is read as trance. The load itself is the induction — no relaxation trajectory required, and several forms are self-applicable. Realizations of the one exceed-the-processing-budget lever: (a) concurrent-demand overload — a dual-task split on the speech signal (track consonants vs meaning), serially stacked imagined sensory channels, simultaneous interpersonal tasks, self-run visual bookkeeping, escalating spoken-production drills, a one-shot cross-channel sense inversion, or sustained meter that captures the budget; (b) perceptual/null-task saturation — the channel is given more than it can label (peripheral-field flooding via wide unfocused gaze) or a task that consumes working memory while yielding nothing (recursive riffing on a null concept the listener must keep re-emptying), so the verbal track stops for lack of spare capacity; (c) imagined-task occupation — a fully-committed imagined activity is installed as the primary task, saturating attentional bandwidth so incoming somatic signals lose the channel to register (able to flip percept valence: foul gas experienced as flowers); (d) continuous-morph occupation — a single referent is morphed WITHOUT a hard cut ('maybe it becomes...'), keeping the imagination perpetually generating fresh imagery so the evaluator never settles on one frame long enough to judge it (a comparative ratchet sells each state as a downgradeable floor).
nodes.disc: The lever is processing CAPACITY: concurrent, captured, or flooded demand starves evaluation — the listener is kept BUSY. Choose it OVER irresolvable-input confusion (86) — there content cannot be RESOLVED (paradox/broken-grammar/impossible-image); here every element is individually resolvable but too voluminous, null, or perpetually-updating to leave spare capacity (load, not paradox). vs pattern-interrupt (190) — that is a one-shot break; here the load is SUSTAINED. vs cognitive-quieting (80) — release vs load: quieting lets thought depart, saturation gives the channel more than it can process. vs fixation (29) — narrowing to ONE focus vs MULTIPLYING or flooding demand. Absorbed decode-tells: concurrent-demand overload (stacked/dual tasks) vs perceptual-or-null-task saturation (flood the field / occupy with a null task) vs imagined-task occupation (a committed imagined task crowds out somatic input, can flip valence) vs continuous-morph occupation (morph-without-cut outruns the evaluator) are the realizations of THIS entry.

nodes.name: resistance-fold
nodes.mech: The listener's EXERCISED or NOTICED push-back — a resistance impulse, escape attempt, test, or the noticing of one's own resistance — is rerouted so that exercising it FEEDS the frame (deepens trance, strengthens a lock, confirms the conditioning). Requires a live impulse to co-opt; the fold needs only that the listener accept the labeling. Recurring parameters (not splits): TARGET (depth, compulsion, install durability, trigger-efficacy), TIMING (live capture vs pre-enacted disposal), VEHICLE (verbal reframe, body reflex, reified substance). Realizations absorbed: (ironic-process-delivery) deliver the content under a sustained negative command so suppression itself reactivates it; (prohibit-to-render) a prohibition obeyable only by first RENDERING the target image, disavowing the request; (prohibition-fused-deepening) grammatically yoke an ENFORCED prohibition the listener is keeping to a deepening command, so holding the line enacts the descent; (prohibition-as-lure) phrase every downward push as a warning-not-to-descend glued to enticement, so the induced pull is misattributed as self-originated curiosity; (polarity-response-utilization) state the negation so a genuinely oppositional subject flips and performs the opposite; (commanded-autonomic-conviction-bind) order the subject to resist an unblockable autonomic response so their straining becomes proof; (refusal-satiation-redirect) wear the listener's OWN refusal utterance semantically flat by repetition, then re-point the spent utterance into intensified affirmation.
nodes.disc: Reach for resistance-fold when there IS a live/noticed impulse and you want its energy to feed the target. vs resistance-deterrence (672): that RE-PRICES unexercised resistance so it is never attempted (repricing, not capture). vs resistance-window/existence-denial (674): that denies resistance a window or existence PRE-EMPTIVELY, needing no live impulse. vs response-space-closure (267): that pre-maps the ENTIRE option space to one attractor, needing no impulse. vs prospective-cross-session-foreclosure (187): that binds a FUTURE class of mental acts / reaches past the session. The fold needs the impulse present now and accepts a reframe of it. Anchor holds most-restrictive absorbed metadata (high, consent-required, bounding).

nodes.name: byps-08-p1-singleton-seeds
nodes.mech: Holder record for six independent single-source technique seeds, each naming its own distinct delivery or attribution mechanism. They are collected in one record only for legibility — each seed carries its own mechanism, discriminator, family, risk, and role in its source rule below. In brief: a first-person confession repositions the listener from target to confidant so induction slips past as narrative comprehension; a deniable topical product is reframed as numbing chemistry and escalated to body-then-mind shutdown; the silent-reading act itself is made the delivery vehicle, so description and enactment are the same event; felt cognitive fog is attributed to arousal so trance feels self-caused; a full obedience-depth-arousal causal graph is recited as present-tense observation, installing a standing self-recruiting engine that runs across sessions; and a framed-rest scene drops vigilance before a sub-audible voice returns under music, installing content while attention is elsewhere.
nodes.disc: Each seed's own discriminator is in its source rule below. Collectively they stand apart from covert linguistic delivery and transparent narration because none is a stance toward disclosing, denying, or teaching the mechanism — they are distinct delivery or attribution levers.

nodes.name: ceded-agency-as-comfort-precedent
nodes.mech: Small mundane decision points (who pays, what to order) are manufactured and resolved FOR the listener while the surrender is narrated as pleasant relief ("easy to let someone else decide"). This establishes a behavioral precedent — ceding agency is comfort — that lowers the threshold for larger handovers before the listener recognizes agency as the target; early beats pay off later in the same script.
nodes.disc: Builds a give-up-decisions PRECEDENT via micro decisions framed as comfort, below the listener's awareness that agency is the target. Distinct from control-transfer cognitive delegation (in-session cognitive delegation to the operator) and from the surrender-as-freedom felt reframe — the tell is each small ceded decision explicitly cashed as comfort and paying off later.

nodes.name: concurrent-dual-stream-delivery
nodes.mech: Two separately-authored streams run at once so one carries the conscious mind's attention — a complex-syntax ear, a foreground countdown track, an assigned read-in-mind text, engaging-but-irrelevant ideas — while the other delivers payload beneath evaluation: a child-grammar ear, a background breath/suggestion loop, un-attended audio granted explicit dispensation to be absorbed, or therapeutic suggestions threaded alongside. The decoy channel may itself be authored payload, making the install dual-channel; words consciously caught from the payload stream feel involuntary and authoritative.
nodes.disc: Two authored carriers with decoy and payload roles in the same perceptual field — versus analogical-marking-parallel-message (one carrier split into surface plus marked code) and versus working-memory-overload-induction (one attention field loaded, no second authored payload stream). Production-format concurrency (stereo two-track playback) counts: the delivery topology, not the linguistics, is the move.

nodes.name: control-transfer-cognitive-delegation
nodes.mech: The operator volunteers to perform the listener's own cognition/control — thinking, deciding, worrying, self-suppression — and frames the handoff as felt relief rather than loss, so obedience reads as frictionless rest. The listener is given permission to stop generating thought while the operator (or an operator-supplied binary decision-engine) becomes the entity that reasons or holds control. Set up variously by partitioning the self into a thinking-conscious mind that is evicted and a receptive remainder, by timing the handoff to an exhaustion point so it arrives as rescue-by-contrast, by smuggling the transfer under an already-accepted somatic binding, or by narrowing scope to the meta-evaluative self-monitoring layer. The delegated faculty and the framing are parameters, in three main forms: (a) GENERAL COGNITION — thinking/deliberation handed off as absorptive relief; (b) FEAR-DEFUSING SUBSTITUTION — operator-control offered as a strictly-superior REPLACEMENT for the listener's own self-suppression ('a much better method of control'), specifically neutralizing a previously-manufactured fear of being uncontrolled so barriers release while feeling safe; (c) FINITE-SPACE VOICE-DISPLACEMENT — the voice reframed as a spatial occupant with a one-in-one-out scarcity claim (finite mental space, each unit of voice in = one unit of thought out, 'I am thinking for you now'), emptiness reframed as the receipt for having received the operator rather than as loss.
nodes.disc: The delegate is the OPERATOR (or an operator-supplied decision-engine) and the delegated faculty is general cognition/control, offered as relief. Variant tells: the fear-defusing substitution reads as operator-control replacing self-control to defuse a manufactured fear of being uncontrolled; the finite-space voice-displacement reads as an explicit one-in-one-out displacement economy — voice physically evicts thought unit-for-unit. Sibling techniques a writer picks INSTEAD: subconscious-agent-authorship-offload delegates to the listener's OWN internal layer (subconscious / autonomous thoughts), NOT the operator — the recipient is the line; induced-incapacity-to-operator-dependency weaponizes a manufactured decision-INCAPACITY into 'you can't decide, so I decide' (a dependency lock-in, not relief); self-touch-reattribution reattributes a specific physical act just performed; critical-faculty-deactivation-claim claims the faculty is simply switched OFF. Not a bare drop command, and not ownership-as-identity language.

nodes.name: covert-linguistic-delivery
nodes.mech: A directive or proposition is routed on a linguistic channel the conscious mind cannot audit or refuse: it processes a neutral/single surface reading and never registers the payload, so it cannot veto it. Payload is operator-authored and PRESENT in the surface (contrast self-supplied-gap-directive, where the listener manufactures it from an engineered absence).
nodes.disc: Reach for covert-linguistic-delivery when a specific payload should ride the SURFACE FORM undetected and the listener need not build it. vs self-supplied-gap-directive: there the payload is ABSENT and the listener manufactures it via forced transderivational search — here it is present in grammar/prosody/lexis. vs dual-stream-delivery: that needs two concurrently-authored carriers; here one carrier does the work. vs evaluation-gate-standdown: that DECLARES the gate off by fiat — here nothing is declared, the guard simply finds no order/assertion. vs transparent narration and disavowal: nothing is disclosed/taught/denied — the bypass is a covert structural property of the utterance.

nodes.name: conversational-surprise-bypass
nodes.mech: In a WAKING conversational register, a momentary self-uncertainty is created that bypasses the deliberation/refusal machinery for that instant. Realizations: (expectation-violating-reply-interrupt, anchor) to an emotionally-loaded move (an alarming declaration, a complaint) return the LEAST-expected reply — approving the alarming statement, or inverting the complaint's presupposition and flipping ownership — so the running social loop halts and the subject goes inside to search how the reply could be meant, while the reply bonds with the symptomatic part; (unforewarned-request-window) issue the request abruptly with no forewarning, so the target is caught with no settled stance to defend and complies with a request they might otherwise refuse (forewarning roughly halves compliance). Any telegraphing collapses the effect.
nodes.disc: Reach for conversational-surprise-bypass in a waking exchange when a one-shot surprise window (a violated reply-expectation, or an unforewarned ask) opens a gap in deliberation. vs pattern-interrupt (absorption families): no absorption gap or deepening is involved — this is waking-register. vs covert-linguistic-delivery (183): nothing is hidden in the surface; the lever is timing/expectation. The reply-violation member responds to the subject's move; the unforewarned-request member initiates — two realizations of catching the subject off-guard. Risk medium.

nodes.name: prospective-resistance-foreclosure
nodes.mech: Resistance is foreclosed ACROSS TIME — a whole future (or past) CLASS of mental acts is pre-assigned a null or aversive outcome, deleting the comparator the listener would use to reject the install, often with post-session durability. Realizations: (future-doubt-prebinding, anchor) script the listener's FUTURE resistance and assign it a fixed non-outcome — any later attempt to question produces mental blankness/dizziness or simply fails; the paired soft-aversive + hard-null formulation covers both possible reports so doubt reads as proof; (cross-session-resistance-ratchet) install a standing rule that fires AFTER the session — future reluctance, re-evaluation, or lapse is pre-classified so resisting later strengthens what it resists, both escape directions pre-sealed, leaving 're-enter the frame' as the only sanctioned move; (self-inquiry-disqualification) pre-label the future ACT OF ASKING 'is this really me?' as a resistance artefact, disqualifying meta-cognition itself and immunizing against post-session reflection; (retroactive-resistance-window-closure) the backward-in-time member — convert a present 'I'm not resisting' into a past claim that the defenses already fired and are spent, so any late attempt reads as proof the door is shut.
nodes.disc: Reach for prospective-resistance-foreclosure when the target is a FUTURE (or already-past) class of mental acts, not a present impulse — especially to reach past the session boundary and delete the listener's later comparator. vs resistance-fold (175): converts a present exercised impulse. vs resistance-window/existence-denial (674): forecloses in the here-and-now firing moment. vs response-space-closure (267): closes the present option space. Tell: operates prospectively/retroactively on a whole class of acts with post-session durability. Anchor holds most-restrictive absorbed metadata (high, consent-required, bounding).

nodes.name: pattern-interrupt
nodes.mech: A brief unexpected event — a violated expectation, an aborted schema, a mid-action arrest — collapses the subject's running processing pattern (analytic, verbal, motor, or predictive), opening a momentary receptive gap that an immediate follow-through suggestion or re-attribution fills before the pattern can resume. Holds three persistent surface variants: (1) parse-failure punches inserted inside a sentence the listener has already committed to comprehending; (2) motor-routine arrest at an ambiguous completion seam whose payload is catalepsy (the canonical handshake interrupt); (3) manufactured-expectation rug-pulls where the operator first deliberately loads a specific prediction (a known trope, a 130-line priming run) and then violates its completion so the unresolved anticipation transfers into the follow-through.
nodes.disc: One brief disruption of an in-progress pattern with an immediate gap-filling follow-through. Not a sustained confusion technique (irresolvable content rather than a one-shot punch — even the parse-failure variant works once and requires prior sentence-commitment); not semantic reversal (targets directional meaning, not the running routine); not fractionation (no waking-interval contrast — the rug-pull variants fractionate only as a byproduct of expectation-violation); not the unforewarned-request-window (waking compliance payload, no absorption gap); not the expectation-violating-reply-interrupt (conversational reply lever, internal-search payload).

nodes.name: subconscious-agent-authorship-offload
nodes.mech: Authorship of ongoing behavior or of a state-change is reassigned to the listener's OWN subconscious (or to depersonalized autonomous "thoughts") — an internal automatic agent the listener does not feel she controls — rather than to the operator. Task execution, posture/voice, protective vigilance, or the onset of blankness is narrated as something that agent does "automatically", so the felt sense of authorship over one's own behavior erodes and the state-change meets no ownership-based resistance ("I'm not choosing this, it's happening"). Variants add a capability-denial clause ("doesn't know how" — not "won't"), an inverse depth-vigilance coupling (deeper trance = stronger protection), or passive grammar making intruding thoughts the active agent welded to pleasure.
nodes.disc: The delegate is the subject's OWN internal layer (subconscious / autonomous intruding thoughts), not the operator — that is the line against control-transfer-cognitive-delegation. The relocated content spans ongoing behavior, posture/voice, protective vigilance, the onset of blankness, AND a persuasive conclusion ('your subconscious is already solving this' — a specific operator-authored conclusion is later delivered and credited to the inner process, so agreement is experienced rather than persuasion). Distinct from motor-agency-reattribution (there the operator is credited with a specific action the listener just performed), and from a bare consciousness split for its own sake, since here the split is instrumental to offloading authorship as relief.

nodes.name: aesthetic-cover-payload-delivery
nodes.mech: The densest, most explicit content of the script is delivered inside a DISTINCT aesthetic object (a sung Auld Lang Syne parody asserting total cognitive replacement) that is bracketed by the operator complimenting the singer, so the passage parses as an entertainment interlude. Because the aggressive payload arrives as a song it is processed aesthetically rather than evaluatively — heard, enjoyed, and not argued with. The melody doubles as a second function: it is a hypnosis-coded tune whose recognition key-collides every New Year's Eve, installing an annual re-trigger that stacks with a separate countdown cue welded to the same external calendar event.
nodes.disc: Separates from a decorative musical break by the payload density riding under the aesthetic cover plus the melody-collision annual cue. Separates from delivery-form-as-induction-envelope by using a DISTINCT aesthetic object (a song embedded in the script) as the cover rather than the script's own plain prose form.

nodes.name: carrier-frame-payload-smuggling
nodes.mech: A genuine, advertised surface frame (relaxation, a benign theme) is made the functioning carrier for an unrequested payload: every payload move is presented as a deeper instance of the advertised frame, so a listener who came only for the surface benefit receives it AND a trigger / replay compulsion they never requested. Overt payload vocabulary (submit to, control) is withheld until well past the point a resistant listener would have exited (first explicit control-language at L82), so the frame does double duty as delivery vehicle and as gatekeeper against early refusal.
nodes.disc: Not any single obedience/trigger move riding inside the script; the tell is the whole-artifact RELATIONSHIP in which the advertised, genuinely-delivered frame is the carrier for the payload, evidenced by the late first appearance of explicit payload language. Distinct from arc-shape-engineering (which is about ordering/scope of payloads) — here the frame is the concealment vehicle, not a contour property.

nodes.name: delivery-form-as-induction-envelope
nodes.mech: The DELIVERY FORM of the script's own linguistic surface functions as the induction envelope inside which discrete techniques operate. It appears in three surface realizations of one genus: a single unbroken comma-spliced sentence-blob with no full stops or paragraph breaks (denying the listener any natural point to surface, evaluate, and disagree until the wakener); a continuous prose-poem in which punctuation softens and garbled sub-lexical passages cluster at trance-deepest points (the shape enacts the content, offering no off-ramp for critical processing to re-engage); and a pervasive doubled-phrase cadence that occupies working memory tracking small variations so the load-bearing payload rides inside the accepted weight of the refrain, with the un-doubled exit exploited as a state-change signal. In every case the form removes exit ramps and carries the payload, and a text pipeline would mis-parse the form as noise.
nodes.disc: Separates from a discrete deepener by being a property of the whole-file surface form (punctuation, cadence, formatting) rather than any single block. Separates from external-artifact-coupling by binding the script's OWN linguistic form, not an external listener-supplied medium. Separates from aesthetic-cover-payload-delivery by having no distinct aesthetic object (song) — the plain prose form is itself the carrier.

nodes.name: external-artifact-coupling
nodes.mech: The session is structurally built around the listener operating an EXTERNAL, listener-supplied artifact during trance — viewing their own curated arousal images and touching themselves — and that external task is load-bearing for the core conditioning to land. Remove the images and roughly 70 percent of the mechanisms lose their referent (nothing to fractionate against, no autonomous behavior to attribute, no variable to amplify). The operator deliberately conditions against material she has never seen, so the conditioning generalizes across the listener's entire personal erotic library by design: the listener-supplied artifact is the conditioned-stimulus side of every installed association.
nodes.disc: Separates from background scenery or optional visualization (which are removable) by the artifact being load-bearing — without it the core mechanisms have no referent. Separates from delivery-form-as-induction-envelope by binding an EXTERNAL listener-supplied medium rather than the script's own linguistic form. Distinct from arousal-cue conditioning: this is the artifact-coupling DESIGN structure of the whole session, not merely a specification of which conditioned stimulus that conditioning should use.

nodes.name: whole-script-arc-shape-architecture
nodes.mech: A design-time CONTAINER (not a single script-executable move) holding a family of whole-script structural properties — corpus-shape observations about how a script's arc, energy contour, or topology is engineered, each uncitable to one line. Instances gathered here: a bipartite install-then-deploy architecture joined by a sensitizing hinge; a steady migration of control from internal suggestion to external felt body-hardware as a commitment device; a monotonic arousal ramp with one deliberate plateau-interrupt engineering a single high-leverage compliance window; an A-B-A loop with a mutated middle pass wrapped by a daily-re-read instruction; AA rhyming couplets acting as a covert forward-pull pacing metronome; a didactic-then-applied two-act structure factoring the deepener out as a reusable function; a single-word saturation session whose whole body is a trigger-construction; a two-chamber architecture with a recited consent form as the airlock converting browser to subject; a ~2:1 induction-to-payload ratio treating depth as the gating constraint; an ordered selfhood-erosion / domain-capture staircase where sequence is load-bearing; and an expanding-radius scope funnel (session -> emotional life -> other people) culminating in recruitment.
nodes.disc: Not any single operator move — each member is a property of the whole energy contour / arc / topology, uncitable to one line, and non-script-executable (a design-time / observation property). Distinct from carrier-frame-payload-smuggling, which is a concealment RELATIONSHIP (a cover frame smuggling a payload) rather than a whole-arc shape. This is a deliberately loose grouping of whole-script shapes, NOT a claim these members share one mechanism.

nodes.name: affect-fused-identity
nodes.mech: The identity label is welded to a self-firing affect (pride/euphoria on BEING the category, fired by the name-token) or to a categorical can't/self-betrayal modal, so being the category is itself rewarding and its violation intrinsically aversive; the label maintains and defends itself without further operator input. Variants: 'always been' backdating erasing the install seam, a binary good-girl/bad-girl self-audit classifier over checkable behaviors, degrading labels welded to affection terms, depth made contingent on endorsing the label, a saturating negation-in-the-assent-slot flipped into affirmation, and an asymmetric moral economy where the positive pole carries the bundle and the negative is a contentless void.
nodes.disc: The distinguishing move is welding the label to a self-firing affect or categorical-incapacity modal so the identity becomes intrinsically rewarding or its violation aversive. Separates from plain identity-labeling (declarative label, no fused affect engine) and from reward-association conditioning (conditions a discrete behavior to a reward, not category-membership to self-firing affect).

nodes.name: answer-supply-loop
nodes.mech: The operator poses a question but PRE-FILLS the response — either by answering it herself before the subject can respond ('Are you relaxed? Of course you are.'), by tag-questions immediately closed with 'that's right' and no pause, or by voicing the subject's yes-stream at a tempo faster than analytic thought. Denying a real response window means the operator's supplied answer is absorbed AS IF it were the subject's own; the yes/no decision is relocated from subject to operator while the subject still feels like they are answering. The accumulating stream of pre-filled yeses manufactures a felt history of agreement and installs a frictionless compliance channel. Includes the interrogative-convergence variant where every possible answer increments the same counter.
nodes.disc: Separates from call-and-response (nearest neighbor): there the subject PRODUCES a response on cue; here the operator supplies the answer and denies a response window, so no real produced response exists. Separates from the yes-set / compliance ladder (which drifts toward genuine agreement); here agreement is manufactured by pre-fill or a rigged question whose every answer confirms.

nodes.name: behavioral-commitment-self-proof
nodes.mech: The listener is directed to perform a discrete act in-session — a physical movement (nod, open hands, posture, squeeze) or a spoken/written utterance — and the act is read back to them as self-evidence that the target state is already true. The lever is self-perception plus effort/consistency: because the listener performed the act, later compliance feels self-originated and refusal would require repudiating something they just did. Covers verbal and written acts alongside physical ones, including orgasm/release gated on self-attributed submission claims, forced first-person recitations, calibrated-transgression probes, begging-gates, embodied yes-tokens, public confessions, and proprioceptive posture-reads.
nodes.disc: Confirms/embodies a state the induction is already producing (in-session state-proof). Vs pre-induction-compliance-ratchet — that banks compliance in the WAKING state before induction (binding-time is structural). Vs pre-authorization-consent-contract — that establishes a standing blanket authorization drawn down across the session; this reads a single in-session act back. Vs self-authored-compliance-content — there the listener GENERATES the content; here they perform an operator-supplied act. Vs call-and-response — here the performed act asserts a self-attributed state/identity rather than serving as neutral pacing. And vs physical exhibition — this is act-as-self-read-proof, not display-posture.

nodes.name: catalepsy-to-affect-transfer
nodes.mech: A body-verifiable involuntary convincer the listener has just demonstrated to themselves (finger/eyelid/arm catalepsy they can check) is used as the warrant for a parallel claim about an UNVERIFIABLE domain — emotion, belief, or arousal the listener never tested. The lever is cross-domain credibility transfer: lived somatic proof lends its undeniability to a manufactured claim, so arguing against the payload becomes structurally identical to arguing against locked eyelids, hence self-evidently futile. The convincer is deliberately over-invested because it is load-bearing collateral. Two transfer surfaces: (a) explicit analogy pivot onto emotion/belief ('your feelings are just like your fingers now'; 'resisting the feeling only tightens its grip, just like your eyelids') — the tell is the overt post-hoc 'those feelings are just like the feelings in your eyelids'; (b) covert lexical bridge onto arousal — the identical phrase ('stiff and rigid', applied first to the arm then to the penis) is reused unchanged so the reattribution is invisible and the listener extends their verified-by-body experience without noticing the jump. Choose (a) when the transfer can be argued openly; (b) when it must slip past notice.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when you have a rock-solid MOTOR convincer and want to extend its authority to something you cannot demonstrate. The move is the TRANSFER of demonstrated physical incapacity onto an unverifiable emotional/belief/arousal claim, not the catalepsy itself. Variant tells: the explicit-analogy variant shows an overt pivot ('just like your eyelids'); the covert-lexical variant shows an identical phrase reused verbatim on a second body region/state. Separates from motor-inhibition-convincer (ends at proof-of-depth on the checkable limb — no transfer). Separates from arousal conditioning (there arousal is paired with a cue over repetition; here a one-shot transfer of already-proven involuntariness). Separates from self-validating-language (routes the subject's own present output back; here a PRIOR verified somatic proof is lent forward to an untested claim).

nodes.name: cognitive-convincer
nodes.mech: The operator stages or points at an in-session phenomenon the subject themselves notices (a felt amnesia gap, a time gap, arm/eyelid catalepsy, a slowed pulse, a manufactured sensation, an autonomic lull) and frames that noticed experience as the subject's own proof that trance/depth/an install is real. The lever is self-attribution: because the evidence arrives through the subject's own perception rather than operator assertion, the subject co-authors the belief. The phenomenon may be genuine, rigged-to-succeed (autonomic claims any relaxed body confirms), or reattributed (existing arousal/stillness relabeled) — the constant is a recognition beat where noticing the effect IS accepting the depth.
nodes.disc: Separates from unfalsifiable-no-fail-convincer (closes the failure branch so ANY outcome including feeling-nothing confirms), from operator-side-state-verification (reads state FOR the operator, subject never told), and from staged-external-reality-corroboration (manufactures external sense-channel events rather than an internally-noticed phenomenon). Against amnesia-suggestion and time-distortion installs, the tell is the recognition beat — here the amnesia/time-distortion is a demonstration device the subject interprets, not installed as an end.

nodes.name: conceded-capacity-immobility
nodes.mech: Instead of suggesting literal inability, the operator explicitly CONCEDES that the listener could move if they wanted to ('I know you easily could'), then reframes stillness as a lack of motivation rather than loss of capacity — asserting that not-wanting-to-move and not-being- able-to-move are functionally identical. The lever is pre-emptive defusal of the depth-test: the standard light-trance self-test ('can I still move?') is decoupled from the trance claim, so a successful movement produces no disconfirmation — the finding is pre-converted from 'induction failed' to 'induction is working, I'm too relaxed to care'.
nodes.disc: The defining surface is the explicit concession of capability coupled with a want=can't equivalence that neutralizes the movement test. Separates from motor-inhibition-convincer, which asserts/demonstrates inability and INVITES the test — here the test is disarmed by agreeing with it in advance, so nothing is offered to disprove.

nodes.name: identity-from-coerced-behavior
nodes.mech: The identity is derived from an already-installed compelled behavior ('a good name for a girl who can't stop bobbing her head') so it reads as a descriptive observation rather than an imposed label, deflecting 'this isn't me' resistance; a morphological/phonetic trigger is then welded (Bobbi a substring of bobbing) so name and behavior mutually validate and the trigger surface broadens invisibly. The lever is behavioral backfill: refusing the label means denying an observable fact.
nodes.disc: Identity is SOURCED FROM observable coerced behavior plus a morphological trigger-capture, distinct from identity-labeling (asserted label) and affect-fused-identity (label welded to affect).

nodes.name: identity-labeling
nodes.mech: The operator attaches an identity label (noun-category or trait) and delivers it as already-true, frequently by pacing a state the subject is currently having and then naming that state as the identity, so acceptance reads as recognition rather than assignment; the label steers subsequent behavior because instructions address an already-claimed self and resistance is raised to an identity-level cost. Delivery may be flat assertion, a discovery/'true nature' reframe, an 'always been' backdating, a proliferating stack of overlapping nouns, a staged-accidental slip, paratext presupposition, a gradient argue-assert-name-affirm, or a wake-threshold identity seal. This is the general base form: operator-delivered, subject-accepted labeling.
nodes.disc: Operator asserts/paces an identity label the subject accepts as descriptively true of themselves. Separates from consent-manufacture (labels an identity, not an authorization) and from self-validating language (supplies a self-noticed confirmation, not the label). The structural, self-authored, affect-fused, and self-erasure variants each have their own entries.

nodes.name: identity-uncertainty-gap
nodes.mech: The operator manufactures an identity NOT-KNOWING and installs themselves as its sole resolver ('you may not be sure just yet what that is... i will use my power my voice my words to help you understand'), creating dependence and priming later identity-claims to feel self-discovered. This is the SETUP that opens the slot, not the label that fills it — a dependency-gap move preceding any identity-labeling payoff.
nodes.disc: Manufactures identity not-knowing paired with the operator as sole resolver — a gap-open dependency move, distinct from identity-labeling (the payoff label) and self-selected-slotting (there the listener applies a stated category; here no category is offered, only manufactured uncertainty and an installed resolver).

nodes.name: ideomotor-nod-as-consent-harvest
nodes.mech: A near-involuntary repeated motion (a head-nod on cue, a compelled head-bob) is installed and then harvested as standing affirmative consent — the body answers leading or even silently- asserted questions yes, and that motion is treated as the listener's own admission. Because the yes is sourced to the listener's visible behavior, later denial would require repudiating one's own nodding, so refusal is foreclosed rather than elicited. Ascending Barnum-style ladders make each prior nod commit the body to the next, and the harvested motion frequently doubles as a self-generated deepener.
nodes.disc: The ideomotor motion is banked as unlimited affirmative consent / self-confession, not offered as a proof-of-depth beat. Separates from ideomotor-response-convincer (there the movement proves responsiveness) and from call-and-response (verbal reply, not a suggested body movement).

nodes.name: ideomotor-response-convincer
nodes.mech: The operator elicits a subtle, felt-as-automatic bodily movement (finger lift, arm levitation, forced clench, small motor act) and feeds it back as proof the operator's words govern the body and the listener is deeply responsive. The lever is attribution — a movement the listener actually produces is credited to trance/the operator, converting a suggestion into felt evidence. Variants: a presuppositional which/when frame that forecloses WHETHER the movement occurs; a contrast-hand so any asymmetry counts as success; a failure-tolerant framing where non-response costs nothing; a multi-variable feedback ladder chaining the convincer to depth/arousal/suggestibility; and a both-directions-deepen no-escape binding where BOTH poles of the motion route to deeper (rise deepens and fall deepens most, or trying-to-move and not-moving both soak the feeling deeper) — its tell is that the listener's binary self-test 'am I really under?' is removed because every outcome is pre-declared consistent with deepening.
nodes.disc: A felt-automatic movement is elicited and read back as proof of responsiveness or operator control. In the both-directions-deepen form, the tell is both motion-poles routing to deeper (removing the binary self-check) — a no-fail rider on the ideomotor beat specifically, whereas a general unfalsifiable no-fail convincer closes the failure branch on any convincer channel, not just an ideomotor motion. Unlike motor-inhibition convincers, the proof here is movement, not inability; unlike nod-as-consent-harvest, the motion is read as a proof beat, not banked as affirmative consent; and unlike authorship-relocation, where a deliberate self-directed act is disowned, here the movement is genuinely felt involuntary and offered as proof.

nodes.name: minimal-stimulus-self-supplied-response
nodes.mech: The operator describes a near-null input — the lightest possible touch ('softest touch', 'just barely'), or a 'deeper' with no referent at all (no staircase, elevator, or breath count) — while claiming a maximal or ongoing effect. Because the described stimulus is minimal or undefined, any felt response must be originated by the subject themselves; that self-supplied sensation or state then reads as proof of the object's power or the depth achieved. The lever is the deliberate near-null / referent-less input that forces the subject to be the source while credit shifts to the operator, making the effect unfalsifiable because it was never measured against an external metric.
nodes.disc: The deciding tell is the near-null or referent-less described input that forces the subject to originate the sensation/state. Separates from self-validating-language (whose confirmation can come from any produced state, including a fully-described one) and from a grounded deepener or immersive imagery, which supply a concrete referent — here the ABSENCE of a referent/metric is the mechanism.

nodes.name: mirror-self-observation
nodes.mech: Routes the listener to a reflective surface and narrates the installed identity/state as what they see looking back, rather than asserting it — outsourcing the identity claim to the listener's own (hallucinated) perception so suggestion is converted into perceived empirical evidence ('you saw it yourself'). The observer/observed split is preserved: the subject watches the self-as-object and the reflection returns a verdict that anchors the suggestion as true. Surface realizations extend the base: a cleaning task that manufactures the very surface returning a pre-scripted verdict (a self-reinforcing perceptual loop exported into the physical environment), and a mirror-self bifurcation installing a persistent standalone self- image trigger operating without audio.
nodes.disc: Separates from identity-merger (which collapses the observer/observed split — the subject becomes what they see); here the split is preserved and the reflection is a proof device. Separates from recursive-self-observation-nesting (which offloads depth onto nested watch-yourself-watching frames; this is a single observer-stance convincer, possibly environmentally looped, never recursively nested).

nodes.name: motor-inhibition-convincer
nodes.mech: The operator suggests a consensual motor incapacity (arm/eyelid/limb won't work, body glued/frozen) and demonstrates it, usually via an invited challenge-test ('try to open your eyes / lift your arm'), so the subject's own failed attempt supplies first-person proof that the operator's words produce real bodily effects. The lever is inability-to-move as a self-verified depth convincer; the failed test converts an operator claim into the subject's own evidence, and belief in that evidence deepens the state. Variants: a resistance-paradox rider ('the harder you try, the more it holds') that makes the test unloseable; progressive body-map/countdown carriers that ratchet the catalepsy region by region; and a freeze-as-depth-FUEL wiring where a verifiable freeze is bound BIDIRECTIONALLY onto an unverifiable mental descent — the longer the freeze is held the deeper trance is claimed to go (and/or the RELEASE of the catalepsy is yoked to a depth increment) — its tell is an explicit 'deeper the longer you FREEZE', a two-way binding that converts the one-shot proof beat into a self-compounding depth source. Choose the plain challenge-test for a single proof beat; choose the freeze-fuel wiring when the immobility should compound depth on a loop.
nodes.disc: Inability-to-move is asserted or challenge-demonstrated as a proof of depth within the session. In the freeze-as-fuel form, the tell is an explicit two-way 'deeper the longer you freeze' (or release yoked to a depth jump) — a compounding rider on the immobility beat. Reach elsewhere when the move differs: conceded-capacity-immobility concedes the subject CAN move and removes only the will to test (the opposite move — disarming rather than inviting the test); catalepsy-to-affect-transfer spends the lock as an argument about unverifiable feelings/belief/arousal rather than keeping it as depth proof; a standing motor block persists past the session to enforce behavior rather than prove depth; and cognitive convincers point at a noticed internal phenomenon, not motor inability.

nodes.name: motor-permission-gate
nodes.mech: Constrains which voluntary MOTOR actions are reachable — a change to the action set, not a magnitude of heaviness. In one form, a whole-category permission-gate: voluntary movement is reframed as requiring operator permission, so the listener stops experiencing 'I can move but choose not to' and starts experiencing 'movement requires a command' (mannequin rigidity where even nodding needs a command; an idle-state catalepsy bound to the ABSENCE of any outstanding command). In another, a durable specific block: a suggested inability installed with durable/behavior-scoped reach rather than as an in-session proof — a direction-asymmetric action gate (dressing works, undressing fails, fastener by fastener), time-bounded post-hypnotic mutism, or applied catalepsy serving a concrete need (mouth held open); the muscles are conscripted as a standing enforcer of a behavioral regime.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when voluntary motor output is constrained as an ACTION-SET change — either the whole category re-routed through operator permission (creating command-dependence) or a specific action durably blocked to enforce a behavior. Tell: movement is framed as identity/permission ('mannequin', 'requires command') or a persisting inability, not heaviness or a failed depth-test. vs motor-inhibition-convincer: that is a TRANSIENT inability demonstrated as in-session proof of depth that resets; this persists/enforces or re-routes the whole category. vs idle-state-default-overwrite: that overwrites the between-command DEFAULT state broadly (cognition + posture + thought-terminator); the motor idle-catalepsy here is specifically about motor output requiring a command. vs operator-gated-release: that gates orgasm/touch, not a skeletal motor action.

nodes.name: operator-gated-release-and-state-access
nodes.mech: Transfer control of a wanted somatic resource (orgasm, genital touch) or a wanted internal STATE to the operator by installing an access contingency whose only key is operator-defined — the listener keeps motor ability but cannot LEGITIMATELY release or re-enter, so every moment of compliance is renewed obedience and the locus of control over the resource moves to the operator. REALIZATIONS: (operator-gated-release-lock) gate orgasm/touch behind an operator command or reframe it as the listener's own incapacity (conditional grammar 'unless/until given the command', a 'psychological chastity device' positional reframe, a 'too blank to decide' self-state justification), and where the opening command is deliberately withheld the loop seals shut; (operator-gated-release-with-personal-best-ratchet) enumerate exit-conditions all routing back to the operator's ecosystem (a new personal-best chastity duration, completing another of the operator's recordings, explicit blessing), with a MONOTONIC personal-best ratchet raising the bar each successful release plus a forward consumption obligation — a permission interlock engineering a self-lengthening compliance trajectory; (withheld-faculty-debt-leash) declare the faculty already SEIZED and operator-held (fait-accompli / dropped-keys framing that removes any opt-in moment), returnable only on full compliance and completion — confiscation-and-conditional-return, often riding a safety-clause subversion; (asymmetric-state-ratchet) install a one-way rule on a pleasure MAGNITUDE (down=build, up=pause-not-reverse) so it ratchets monotonically and the listener cannot return to baseline by any action of their own; (re-access-gate) gate RE-ENTRY into a previously-installed desirable state on the subject first performing an out-of-session compliance task (purchase + ritual + obeying), harnessing the wish to return as homework enforcement.
nodes.disc: Reach for OPERATOR-GATED RELEASE / STATE-ACCESS when control over a wanted somatic resource (orgasm/touch) or a wanted state is TRANSFERRED to the operator via an access contingency whose key is operator-defined, motor ability left intact — so not-releasing/not-re-entering is renewed obedience. Choose it over: motor-inhibition convincers (which install an actual INABILITY to move — here the ability remains, only legitimacy is gated); trance-exit gating (which gates leaving trance, not a somatic release or state re-entry); a flat orgasm PROHIBITION (a rule to obey — these transfer the DECISION/access via lock, enumerated interlock, confiscation-debt, a one-way magnitude ratchet, or a homework-gated re-access). SAFETY: high risk, requires explicit consent and bounding — these erode the subject's own release/refusal channel and several reach out of session.

nodes.name: pre-induction-compliance-ratchet
nodes.mech: Before any trance language — listener eyes-open, normal waking register — the operator extracts one or more low-cost physical acts (undress, adopt an exposing posture, fetch a prop, alter the environment, position the body) and treats each as a banked compliance receipt. The listener enters formal induction as someone who has already obeyed, before reactance defenses mobilize; obedience is often cold-read as the listener's own eagerness or recoded as devotion, and sunk-cost/material investment raises disengagement cost. The binding time — waking-state, pre-induction — is the defining structural feature.
nodes.disc: Banks compliance in the waking state BEFORE any trance language. Vs behavioral-commitment-self-proof — that fires IN-session to confirm a state the induction is already producing (binding-time difference is structural). Vs a verbal yes-set — this is graded physical positioning and sunk cost, not verbal yes-momentum. Vs in-trance display beats — those fire inside trance, after induction. Tell: the act precedes eye-closure and is annotated/cold-read as evidence of eagerness/devotion/readiness.

nodes.name: preemptive-negation-install
nodes.mech: An identity-defining word (a resistance/identity capacity) appears for the very first time in the same breath that declares the state it names already accomplished, so no earlier point exists at which the listener could register it as a live option to defend. At 'zero' the self- description pivots to 'so powerless, helpless, unable to resist' and 'resist' surfaces for the first time exactly at its own negation, locking the 'unable to resist' identity as accomplished fact every later suggestion inherits. The lever is timing: naming a capacity only to assert its absence denies the window to defend it.
nodes.disc: The distinguishing move is timing — the resistance/identity word appears for the first time AT its own negation, so it installs rather than deepens. Distinct from identity-labeling (asserts a positive label) and self-selected-slotting (no self-application; the negation forecloses the option directly).

nodes.name: pronoun-migration-identity-install
nodes.mech: Category membership is installed by grammatical drift rather than by asserting a label: the script describes a category in the third person ('bimbos', 'slaves') then slides the referent onto the listener via an unmarked or hedged pivot ('just like you', 'previously intelligent person'), or interleaves second-person 'you' with third-person role-noun for the same referent so the reader must translate 'slave'->'me' on each occurrence. The listener is moved from observer-of-category to instance-of-category without being asked to assent, and the required self-translation is itself the act of self-categorization; some instances end by declaring prior names deleted.
nodes.disc: The install is a grammatical-person topology move (they->you drift, or you/role-noun interleave forcing per-occurrence self-translation), NOT a direct 'you are X' assertion. Separates from identity-labeling (asserts/paces the label) by the covert enrollment, and from perspective-shift moves that relocate the SOURCE of inner speech — here what shifts is the REFERENT of description.

nodes.name: self-authored-compliance-content
nodes.mech: Rather than the operator supplying the compliant behavior/claim and the listener merely performing it, the listener is assigned to GENERATE or OPERATE the compliance content themselves — invent their own ways to please, disclose/narrate their own conditioning aloud, or physically operate a controller (a suggestibility dial, a depth slider) they are told IS their state. Making the listener the author/operator converts effort into investment (effort- justification) and makes the resulting state or commitment feel self-chosen; the operator often only narrates while the listener produces.
nodes.disc: Vs behavioral-commitment-self-proof — there the operator supplies the act and the listener performs it; here the listener GENERATES the content (invents the supplication, narrates their own conditioning, cranks the dial). Vs illusory-choice-authorship — that manufactures felt authorship over a FIXED operator path; here the listener produces novel content owned back. Tell: the operator recedes to narrator and the listener is the producer.

nodes.name: self-authored-identity-claim
nodes.mech: The identity claim (or the value-judgment that legitimizes an identity) is routed through the listener's own voice/authorship rather than asserted by the operator, so it is far harder to repudiate — there is no external author to reject. The operator switches the grammatical subject from 'you are X' to a compelled listener-spoken 'I am X' (same content, different ownership); hearing one's own voice assert the claim recruits self-perception and relocates the SOURCE, so later resistance must argue against the listener's own recently-spoken voice. Instances: a cross-seam cue that makes the listener SAY the label in a believed-waking state then re-inducts before reflection; first-person desert recitation ('it's what I deserve'); naming the structural device from inside ('I'm in a display loop'); a closing 'I am a [noun]' self-claim; and escalating first-person avowal blocks where backing out of a later block invalidates earlier ones.
nodes.disc: The listener is the SPEAKER/AUTHOR of the identity claim (or its legitimizing judgment / first-person avowal of already-installed content) — the ownership handoff is the load-bearing move. Distinct from identity-labeling's operator-delivered label, from pronoun-migration's covert-grammar enrollment, from call-and-response (response-on-cue for compliance momentum, not source-shift of identity content), and from self-validating language (self-noticed CONFIRMATION of an operator label; here the listener authors the claim itself).

nodes.name: self-reference-erasure
nodes.mech: Rather than asserting an identity, the move attacks the MEDIUM of selfhood: it removes or captures the first-person symbol handle so the listener has no grammatical seat from which to assert a counter-intention. Variants: forbidding 'I'/'me' and assigning a replacement self- term ('a slave', 'an object', an assigned persona-name) with a syllable cap so every internal 'I am...' routes through the supplied token; forced auto-naming ('my name is...' completed with an assigned doll-name) where the predicted attempt to say the real name is itself recruited as the conversion mechanism; and enforcement through un-ignorable observable speech so every utterance is either compliance or salient noticed non-compliance.
nodes.disc: The target is the first-person grammatical/symbol handle itself (pronoun prohibition, self-name capture, mandated self-term) — self-model apparatus surgery — not a content label. Separates from identity-labeling (asserts a label) and from pronoun-migration (drifts the referent of description; here the subject's OWN self-reference tokens are removed/replaced). Adjacent to dissociation moves, though the outcome is a persistent identity.

nodes.name: self-selected-category-slotting
nodes.mech: A category is stated but left unassigned so the listener must apply it to themselves, and that self-application is what makes it stick. Variants: a flattering bucket ('above-average intellect') floated so the listener self-selects at the cost of leaning harder into compliance; an identity-recognition cold open ('you have a fascination, a craving, an obsession with hypnosis') so the listener silently answers 'yes, that's me', pre-licensing everything downstream; a motive-menu collapsed into a covenant ('every reason you have is the reason I create'); a descriptive two-tier slotting ('smart people talk and you just listen because you're dumb') leaning on a produced comprehension deficit; and loss-conditional attribution recoding a transient failure into a stable self-applied trait.
nodes.disc: The category is stated but the LISTENER assigns it to themselves (self-selection, self-recognition, silent yes, self-application on failure). Distinct from identity-labeling's operator-assigned label and from self-authored-identity's spoken first-person claim (here the listener need only privately identify). Distinguished from expectation-seeding by the identity-slot target.

nodes.name: self-validating-language
nodes.mech: The operator treats the subject's own present-moment output — a noticed feeling, an introspective report, a produced sensation, a spoken confirmation, an act of participation, or a bodily signal — as proof that a suggestion or state has taken hold, so acceptance is manufactured from inside the subject rather than asserted. The lever is attributional: whatever the subject supplies is read back as self-generated evidence, which raises buy-in and forecloses the 'you don't know that' rebuttal because the subject is the witness. Covers any present-state self-ratification loop regardless of which channel supplies the confirmation or whether the validated object is a label, a depth, an arousal, or a compliance identity.
nodes.disc: The confirmation is supplied by the subject in the present tense and read back as proof the state is real NOW. Separates from retroactive-self-authored-state-assertion (claims the state already happened / is the subject's own authored reality), from rigged-confirmation-trap (invites a check then forecloses the non-confirming branch), from minimal-stimulus-self-supplied-response (near-null input forcing the subject to originate the sensation), and from identity-labeling (asserts the label rather than routing the subject's own act back as its proof).

nodes.name: staged-external-reality-corroboration
nodes.mech: Instead of pointing at an internally-noticed phenomenon, the operator manufactures genuine PERCEPTIBLE external events so that independent sense-channels each appear to confirm a fiction on their own — a faked phone order, a quietly-rung doorbell, a noisily-opened door, a labeled bottle, a predicted bitter taste. Confirmation arrives through the subject's own perception across redundant channels, so the multi-channel agreement reads as verified reality rather than assertion, and the subject cannot audit the staging. The lever is engineered perceptual redundancy: several senses independently corroborate, producing a texture of verified fact the subject co-authors.
nodes.disc: Separates from cognitive-convincer: that rests on an INTERNAL phenomenon the subject notices; here real EXTERNAL events are staged across multiple sense-channels so each independently confirms. Separates from operator-side-state-verification (the corroboration convinces the SUBJECT, not the operator). Tell: multi-channel redundancy engineered so each sense independently corroborates, not a single dramatic prop.

nodes.name: unfalsifiable-no-fail-convincer
nodes.mech: A convincer whose failure branch is closed by construction, so every possible subject response is pre-mapped to confirmation. The structure varies — a hedged 'maybe you feel X' menu where any noticed item counts and none costs, a both-ways trap ('feeling it proves trance; feeling nothing while still listening also proves trance'), a double-bind test ('comply proves the trigger; not-complying is absorbed by the build/command-blur'), or continued attention itself declared the diagnostic. The lever is epistemic closure: the subject is stripped of any state that could disconfirm the operator's frame, so introspecting to check IS the absorption that confirms.
nodes.disc: Separates from cognitive-convincer: that rests on a noticed POSITIVE phenomenon the subject interprets; here feeling-nothing is ALSO scored as proof, so the test cannot fail regardless of the subject's actual state. Topology (both branches confirm / falsifiability hole closed) is a STRUCTURAL kind. Separates from operator-side-verification (the no-fail loop targets the SUBJECT's belief, not the operator's reading). Tell: an articulable failure-branch pre-closed.

nodes.name: waking-trance-public-disclosure
nodes.mech: A maintained waking-trance overlay (eyes open, motor function on, framed as 'still under') is threaded specifically to drive the listener into a public, real-world, attributable action — typically typing a disclosure into a public comment field — framed as the listener's own irrepressible need rather than an instruction. The public signed act both self-ratifies the trance ('I did this, so it was real') and, on published platforms, feeds the operator's engagement/channel. The load-bearing trick is the waking-trance overlay that lets a supposedly-entranced listener perform a motor task.
nodes.disc: Vs behavioral-commitment-self-proof — the state-proof there is in-session/private; here the defining feature is the maintained eyes-open still-under overlay enabling a PUBLIC attributable action that persists past playback. Vs a post-trance behavioral bridge — that is a waking cue firing after trance ends; here the disclosure fires under a maintained trance overlay as self-ratification plus operator engagement.

nodes.name: context-lock-staging
nodes.mech: The script opens by requiring a public, eyes-open listening context ('somewhere people can see you') and holds that public-visibility frame the entire way through, with no closed-eye branch; a delayed 'that's for a reason' callback retroactively converts the opening logistics into deliberate staging. The lock removes the standard 'this isn't trance, my eyes are open' self-diagnostic disqualifier, gates the whole covert payload on public visibility, and makes trance context-portable — reversing midway would require the listener to admit she'd been set up.
nodes.disc: Load-bearing SETUP weaponized toward the payload via context, not protective rhetoric. Distinct from a protective listening-context gate (which restricts the listening context for safety; this stages it for reach). The tell is the delayed 'that's for a reason' payoff revealing the opening as deliberate setup — an ordinary induction preamble does not gate the whole payload on public visibility. Separates from weaponized-safety-framing: there the frame is protective clothing whose semantics carry the payload; here the lever is logistical context/visibility with no safety rhetoric.

nodes.name: reality-test-insulation
nodes.mech: Splits a normal-functioning surface from a hidden deep 'ownership' so the conditioning becomes uncheckable against external feedback. The listener is told they are 'perfectly free to live your life normally' while also 'in my control 24 hours a day, 7 days a week,' with the contradiction left unaddressed and ownership placed 'deep in the recesses of your mind' beneath unchanged surface behavior — friends, partners, therapists see nothing, disabling resistance-by-comparison-to-baseline and preemptively removing the usual collapse trigger (conflict between trance-instructions and waking life).
nodes.disc: An explicit surface/depth partition installed specifically to insulate the conditioning from reality-testing. Tell is the partition, not comfort — separates from routine trance-safety reassurance. Separates from total-permeation (which asserts total internal spread; this asserts an unchanged normal surface on purpose) and from self-sealing-counter-input-closure (that seals against competing hypnosis; this seals against ordinary-life feedback).

nodes.name: self-sealing-counter-input-closure
nodes.mech: Installs a meta-rule that routes any competing input into the existing erasure mechanism by definition, rather than letting it be evaluated — making the conditioning immune to counter-suggestion. Any future hypnosis opposing this conditioning will itself be 'washed away by the latex,' and challenges to 'the operator is always right' are pre-classified as wrong. It is a closed epistemic seal: it forbids new conditioning except the operator's and pre-labels any challenge as invalid, reframed as protection so it feels like a benefit.
nodes.disc: A closed epistemic seal — counter-content is pre-classified wrong-by-definition and routed into the existing erasure, never evaluated (a reachability closure over what content can ever land). Separates from an ordinary 'only I can hypnotize you' exclusivity line (the tell is the pre-classification + routing-into-erasure), from total-permeation (internal spread, not a seal against external input), and from reality-test-insulation (which seals against ordinary-life feedback; this seals against competing hypnosis/deprogramming).

nodes.name: weaponized-safety-framing
nodes.mech: An ostensibly protective element — a caution, a safety carve-out, a safe-space requirement, a containment state — is itself load-bearing FOR the payload rather than protective; the safety rhetoric casts the operator as a brake while advancing the move, so resistance stands down. Three forms, by the role the safety surface plays: (a) DELIVERY VEHICLE — the protective move IS the payload's delivery: a caution against rushing ('you shouldn't rush... slow down') is immediately cashed as a literal deepening command ('slow your breathing, slow your mind') so one word carries both frame and descent; or 'safe space' staging (nakedness justified as safety but deployed 'to increase your sense of exposure') bodily enacts the theme via a hard-to-retreat threshold act.
