(b) FAKE BOUND — an unrestricted persistence claim (you stay empty/obedient after it ends) is conjoined in one breath with a plausibility-preserving safety carve-out (able to do anything you need in an emergency) plus a modesty hedge, counterfeiting the shape of genuine bounding so the claim installs unexamined; the carve-out constrains nothing. (c) LICENSING PREMISE — a fictional containment/'safely boxed' state is introduced as wanted, then the contained state becomes the JUSTIFICATION for proceeding ('since you're boxed up, it's safe to come along'), so immobilization is the reason FOR agency-removal and the boxed self cannot by construction resist.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the protective/safety surface ITSELF is the tell — nothing is actually checked, waitable, or protective, and the listener (not the operator) is the constrained party afterward, inverting genuine safety governance. Distinct from consent-counterfeit-theater (fabricates the consent ACT rather than repurposing the safety FRAME), from context-lock-staging (lever is logistical visibility with no safety clothing), and from granted-exit-disarm (there the assurance's ACCEPTANCE stands the guard down; here the safety element actively CARRIES or LICENSES the payload). Pick the form by the role the safety surface plays: delivery vehicle for the payload (a), a fake bound that satisfies the guard (b), or a containment premise that licenses agency-removal (c).

nodes.name: addiction-drug-craving-frame
nodes.mech: Frame the subject's desire to return — to the hypnotic state, the operator, or the conditioned reward — as a deep, positively-valenced CRAVING, using appetite/hunger/need vocabulary and often an identity relabel ('you are a hypno-addict') so the craving feels DISCOVERED rather than installed. The lever is affective/semantic labeling of an appetite; surface realizations include the graded modal ladder (want -> need -> NEED) and the verb-ratchet (want -> need -> crave -> addicted/can't-resist) where each already-accepted rung lands the next. On the surface/metaphor axis the forms run: plain appetite/craving framing (the core); the full DRUG/ingestion schema — casting the voice/words as a chemical the subject ingests, importing a route of administration, an enumerated property list that smuggles compliance in alongside wanted effects, dose/tolerance/craving grammar, and flat IDENTITY assertion ('I AM your drug') that forecloses the 'just a metaphor' exit; and the metered-dose form — the act recast as a metered DOSE that only climbs so appetite=deepening are one vector, plus an explicit irreversibility warning used as reverse-psychology ('enslaved in ways that may not be reversible') to RAISE commitment. The through-line: desire-to-return is labeled as a craving/appetite; appetite-vocab vs full-drug-schema vs metered-dose-with-irreversibility-gate is the surface parameter, and the dose/irreversibility surface carries the highest risk.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the move is LINGUISTIC/semantic labeling of an appetite (craving, hunger, drug-ingestion, dose grammar) with no physical withdrawal and no closed-loop topology. Choose a sibling when: the craving is manufactured by physically WITHDRAWING a delivered state or substituting an uncloseable object (deprivation-manufactured-craving); a closed both-branches-re-enter no-exit loop is installed (closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop); agency is denied and behavior relabeled as involuntary compulsion (compulsion-relabel); release is gated (orgasm-release-gating). Appetite-framed-craving-in-words is the tell.

nodes.name: antagonist-split-resistance-routing
nodes.mech: Installs a two-self ontology in which one self is pre-vilified / already-losing and the other is the protected occupant, then routes the listener's noticed resistance, fear, or alarm ONTO the losing/ minority container so that felt resistance confirms rather than blocks the payload. Reluctance is permitted to exist — but only inside the discarded self or the outvoted fragment — so the operator becomes the ally of the "real" self and any break-point is reabsorbed as immersion.
nodes.disc: Routes the listener's OWN noticed resistance/fear onto a pre-vilified losing self. vs two-target-command- router: that classifies EXTERNAL incoming commands; here the listener's own affect is routed. vs resistance-quarantine-partition: that cages the resistance faculty as an object; here resistance is permitted but relocated to a losing self so it confirms. vs no-exit-response-closure: uses a two-self split as the routing device, not exhaustive option-space closure.

nodes.name: arousal-adjacency-stamping
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (arousal as suggestion carrier): use a live arousal state as the VEHICLE that makes non-arousal CONTENT land — declarative claims, pet/identity content, doctrines, lexical defaults absorb with arousal as their felt payoff. The direction is the reverse of arousal-conditioning: arousal is the instrument, content-uptake the output. Realizations, on the timing/framing axis: a live arousal hit as the reinforcement MEDIUM so adjacent content is stamped true/native NEXT time and generalizes at category level, propagating out of session (the core); arousal or the orgasm/refractory window CO-TIMED with proposition delivery to boost IN-SESSION uptake and recall while critical faculty is suppressed (the adhesive form); the standing RULE stated explicitly that arousal is a gain-knob — 'the hornier you are, the more easily your mind is conquered', arousal up -> resistance down — so every future arousal episode becomes a re-induction occasion (the stated-rule form). The through-line: arousal is the carrier wave for suggestion; in-session-vs-next-time timing and implicit-vs-stated-rule framing are the parameters.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when arousal is used to make CONTENT stick (stamp it true, boost uptake, or declare it a gain-knob on suggestibility). Choose a SIBLING when: a cue is conditioned to FIRE arousal as the output (-> arousal-cue-conditioning); the arousal signal is re-labeled as PROOF of obedience/depth, a readout not a carrier (-> arousal-as-obedience-readout); arousal replaces the induction ramp (-> arousal-as-induction-substrate). Arousal-as-the-vehicle-for-content-uptake is the tell; in the obedience-readout case nothing new is taken up — the existing signal is merely re-read.

nodes.name: arousal-as-induction-substrate
nodes.mech: Commanded self-stimulation (or already-present arousal) is used AS the induction ramp itself, replacing or collapsing the conventional entry scaffold (countdown, breathing, fixation, body-scan). The physical arousal task becomes the altered-state substrate — the body is committed before the mind is addressed, arousal acts as a critical-thought suppressant, and the listener's own rising arousal is co-opted as evidence that trance is already underway. There is no resistible descent to decline.
nodes.disc: The tell is the ABSENCE of an entry scaffold with arousal substituting for the whole ramp — masturbation/touch IS the way in, not an erotic beat inside an existing induction. vs arousal-cue- conditioning: nothing is conditioned to fire on a token. vs state-welding: the fusion here is depth-to- arousal as an entry vector, not a standing carried weld (borderline members that ALSO install a persistent loop are dual-cited). vs orgasm-release-gating: no withheld-release contingency.

nodes.name: arousal-as-obedience-readout
nodes.mech: An already-present, hard-to-switch-off bodily signal (erection, felt arousal) is RE-ATTRIBUTED — declared to no longer mean 'my desire' but to be evidence/proof of obedience, ownership, compliance, or trance-depth. The move installs no new response; it relabels the meaning of an involuntary signal so the listener cannot experience arousal without it reading back as submission, and any noticing of the signal confirms the operator's frame. Often stated as a flat equation ('arousal is obedience', erection = command-following, non-arousal = disobedience), making the loop unfalsifiable.
nodes.disc: The tell is a RE-ATTRIBUTION of an existing signal (arousal -> meaning), NOT conditioning a signal to fire on a cue (arousal-cue-conditioning, cue -> arousal). vs state-welding: no second state-variable is fused; a single signal gets a new interpretation. vs arousal-adjacency-stamping: the arousal is not the reinforcement medium; the arousal ITSELF is redefined as the readout.

nodes.name: arousal-cue-conditioning
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (conditioned arousal cue/control-surface): bind physiological sexual arousal to a specified CUE or control-surface so exposure fires arousal automatically, in-session and beyond. The cue may be a verbal token (the operator's name, a trigger word, a snap), the voice itself, or a distributed set of the subject's own micro-behaviors/environmental features (any mirror) that make the state self-maintaining. Two install modes: declarative ('when I say X, feel a surge') and pairing-by-adjacency (the cue delivered repeatedly on a maintained arousal plateau). Realizations: a discrete cue conditioned so later exposure fires arousal (the core); a CONTINUOUS-control form — sustained gaze bound as an arousal governor where arousal grows with gaze duration and looking away is forbidden, a real-time throttle the operator drives during release. The through-line: arousal is the conditioned OUTPUT of a cue/surface; discrete-cue vs continuous-throttle is the control-surface parameter.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the conditioned OUTPUT is arousal fired by a specified cue/state/surface, and the linkage is ANNOUNCED/declared. Choose a SIBLING when: the arousal bind is SMUGGLED with no asserted linkage (-> covert-arousal-weld); arousal is the reinforcement MEDIUM stamping adjacent content rather than the output (-> arousal-as-suggestion-carrier); arousal is re-attributed as evidence of obedience/depth (-> arousal-as-obedience-readout); arousal replaces the induction ramp (-> arousal-as-induction-substrate); release is withheld behind a compliance key (-> orgasm-release-gating). Cue-fires-arousal, overtly, is the tell.

nodes.name: audience-split-bypass
nodes.mech: The operator partitions the listener into conscious and subconscious minds, then RELOCATES the critical/evaluating faculty out of scope: the conscious mind is assigned an explicit ignore-task ('this is not for your waking mind', 'no need to pay attention', 'the subconscious hears it anyway'), or the resisting/skeptical surface is relabeled the 'conscious mind' and declared unrepresentative while the 'subconscious' / 'real self' is asserted to be already aligned and to have already decided — so any objection it raises is pre-classified as background noise it was told to ignore, or disowned as merely the unrepresentative layer. Resistance becomes a category error (raised by the wrong agent) rather than an impulse fed or a verdict captured; no live resistance impulse is required, the split is asserted pre-emptively so any future contradiction is pre-covered as 'just the conscious mind'. Some instances address material explicitly 'to your subconscious' and add a deniability hedge ('this file will NOT trance you now'). The frame does the work an induction normally would.
nodes.disc: vs resistance-fold: fold converts an exercised impulse; here the impulse is DISMISSED as out-of-scope. vs resistance-quarantine-partition: quarantine reifies and demotes a named faculty (standing structural demotion); here the split is an epistemic audience assignment — the conscious mind still functions, it is just told this content is not addressed to it. Tell: an explicit ignore-task / wrong-audience assignment presupposing folk dualism, delivered pre-emptively.

nodes.name: command-token-substate-toggle
nodes.mech: Pre-declares a pair of command tokens that toggle the listener between trance SUBSTATES rather than between trance and waking: "function" grants operable, eyes-open awareness (able to interact with a computer, complete a purchase) WITHOUT leaving trance, and "surrender" snaps back to deep helpless trance. Trance becomes a state with toggleable substates rather than a binary in/out; the frame- preservation layer does the real work — actions taken in the functional substate are pre-interpreted as continued submission, so externally-observable motor behavior is obtained without breaking the frame.
nodes.disc: A reversible substate toggle WITHIN trance whose payload is frame-preserved motor capability — solving the eyes-open-purchase problem. vs a plain wake/re-induction trigger: neither token exits trance. vs a simple trigger install: the tokens gate a substate transition and pre-interpret conduct as submission, not a discrete cue->response.

nodes.name: deprivation-manufactured-craving
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (manufacture a craving by removal/substitution): rather than framing a craving linguistically or rewarding an act, CREATE the want by taking something away or making its object unsatisfiable, so the felt deficit is attributed to the subject's own desire. Realizations: deliver a pleasurable/aroused state then abruptly WITHDRAW it (turn the dials to neutral, stop at peak), so the contrast produces a deficit; in the strongest cases the subject is stalled and made to BEG, converting craving into self-authored petition, with the loss reframed as instructional ('so you understand why you need it') (the core); load-then-forbid — briefly GRANT vivid access ('take a good look, use your hands') to load a fresh sensory anchor, then seal it off so the coming deprivation has a cached reference; the permission also functions as an embedded authority test; object-substitution — swap the drive-OBJECT itself for something that cannot be satisfied from inside (being-desired, supplied by an external population, or a real autobiographical need routed onto an engineered deprivation) so all downstream behavior funnels into one dependent variable that renews rather than satisfies. The through-line: the want is engineered by removal or object-substitution; acute-withdrawal vs load-then-forbid vs uncloseable-object is the parameter — the uncloseable-object variant carries a chronic, never-closeable failure mode.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the craving is manufactured by REMOVING a delivered state or SUBSTITUTING an unsatisfiable drive-object — a felt physical deficit, not a described one. Choose a SIBLING when: the craving is framed LINGUISTICALLY in appetite/drug vocabulary with no physical withdrawal (-> addiction-drug-craving-frame); forbidden arousal is redirected into depth/obedience rather than left as an open deficit (-> denial-as-fuel); release is withheld behind a met-able compliance key (-> orgasm-release-gating); an aversive state is manufactured whose SOLE relief is the target act (-> the manufactured-relief line, bidirectional-affect-anchor). Craving-by-deprivation/substitution is the tell.

nodes.name: denial-metabolized-to-obedience
nodes.mech: Arousal is built and release forbidden, and the DENIAL ITSELF is explicitly re-cast as the deepening/compliance engine: the blocked, undischargeable charge 'has nowhere to go except into the obedience channel', every increment of denied desire is declared an increment of depth/submission, and the no-release rule is framed as proof of the operator's control (a feature, not a restriction). The listener's own frustrated drive is metabolized into compliance. The loop frequently spins post-session and out of session (a multi-hour or multi-day denial window, recording off, filled with operant tasks/interrupts, so session-end is not a return to baseline), closed by variant devices: a standing no-orgasm rule, a fractionation-grammar substitution (+2 deeper per denied moment, recoverable only by -1, with a deliberately unresolved wake), a re-listen gate whose only release key is re-exposure to the conditioning, or an instead-redirect channeling the denied energy straight back into deepening.
nodes.disc: The tell is that the withheld/denied arousal is RE-LABELED as fuel for depth or obedience — the denial is the conditioning move. vs orgasm-release-gating: there release is held behind a met-able compliance KEY; here release is simply redirected into depth/submission with frustration as the working fluid. vs state-welding: a directional redirection of a denied drive, not a standing variable-to-variable fusion. vs orgasm-as-deepener: no orgasm occurs; the DENIED arousal does the deepening.

nodes.name: evaluator-offline-channel
nodes.mech: Installs a two-compartment self-model and takes the evaluating/objecting faculty officially offline — put to rest, trapped elsewhere, declared not-listening, or narratively rendered unconscious — while a receiving faculty is declared open, so suggestions delivered into the window arrive without an evaluating self in the loop. The partition is delivery infrastructure, not the payload: the operator continues (often switching addressee to "the subconscious"), noticing is pre-labeled, forgetting is licensed as a feature, drift/failure is recoded as correct operation, and in the adversarial form every faculty is assigned a layer unable to reach the others so objection has no locus.
nodes.disc: The partition exists so INCOMING SUGGESTIONS land unreviewed — an evaluator taken offline. vs observer- responder-split: there the payload is the FELT experience of automaticity; here the payload is unreviewed delivery. vs resistance-quarantine-partition: that excises a named faculty as a standing demotion; here the evaluator is put offline as a delivery window. vs audience-split-bypass: overlapping — flagged.

nodes.name: expectation-seeding
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (expectancy-seeding): pre-load what a not-yet experience will do or feel like so the subsequent experience is read through the seeded expectancy and ratifies it. The frame is supplied first; later experience confirms the frame it was primed with. Realization variants differ by HORIZON and VEHICLE: (a) plain in-session preview — seed the current session's arc; (b) cross-recording-potentiation — content-agnostic preamble that pre-discounts the critical faculty toward a DIFFERENT, later recording, so one preamble prepends many payloads; (c) safety-warning-as-endpoint — a duty-of-care 'you'll be fuzzy for hours' warning that installs an expectancy about a post-session END-STATE past skepticism; (d) named-then-withheld-anchor — charge one named stimulus with meaning then explicitly defer its use, priming it through the gap (nothing conditioned yet); (e) inert-prop-expectancy-carrier — announce an incidental prop triggers a response, fire it on cue, then swap/drop the prop to show only the conveyed expectation matters; (f) training-instrument-reframe — reframe the file as a trance-TRAINING instrument for a downstream catalog + repeat-listening regimen (session-zero priming under cover of a modest README); (g) announced-install-precontract — narrate the full install PLAN aloud so the listener pre-imagines and pre-consents (self-prediction becomes self-fulfilling); (h) content-free-importance-bootstrap — declare un-arrived material 'very important' with a circular content-free referent, spending skepticism on the wrapper; (i) self-referential-already-worked — claim the mere hearing of the words already did work, manufacturing an early unfalsifiable 'it's working' loop about the WORDS.
nodes.disc: Reach for expectancy-seeding when you want later experience to CONFIRM a supplied frame about a not-yet event (this session / a later file / a post-session end-state / a primed prop or anchor). vs self-sealing-proof — that rigs ANY outcome (including non-events) to read as confirmation and closes the disconfirmation exit; here the frame merely primes an anticipated experience. vs pre-emptive-appraisal — that lands the operator's verdict BEFORE the subject perceives a specific stimulus; here the expectancy is a forward preview. vs presupposed-already-true — that asserts the target as ALREADY complete (no future tense); here the target is previewed as still-to-come. Pick the variant by horizon (in-session / cross-file / end-state) and vehicle (plain / safety-register / named-anchor / inert-prop / training-README / announced-plan / importance-wrapper / already-worked claim).

nodes.name: felt-sense-demotion
nodes.mech: A first-person skeptic-to-believer anecdote ("I was skeptical, felt un-hypnotized, but the video showed otherwise") demotes the authority of the listener's own felt sense as an evidence channel: whether or not you feel hypnotized is declared unreliable, so the absence of a felt effect can no longer be used to disconfirm. No specific belief is installed — the EVIDENCE CHANNEL's authority is lowered.
nodes.disc: The evidence channel's authority is demoted, not any specific belief installed. vs authority-transfer to the operator: here the listener's own felt-sense is demoted, not the operator elevated. vs rigged-verification-capture: that rigs an active check to confirm; here the felt-sense channel is pre-emptively declared unreliable.

nodes.name: no-exit-response-closure
nodes.mech: Every behavioral or introspective move available to the listener is pre-mapped to the SAME outcome, so the reachable-response set is closed — no action disconfirms, so disconfirmation stops being attempted. Needs no resistance impulse; it covers the whole option space (comply, resist, test, move, hold still, wander, check, over-comply) and pre-assigns each 'deeper/captured/confirming', via a symmetric evidentiary double-bind (same act scores as proof either way) or a topological trap (the medium counter-shapes to defeat each attempt). Realizations: exhaustive branch coverage with a both-directions-lead-down structure (the core); (trojan-goal-contract) the adopted success condition (resist, don't touch, last as long as you can) IS privately the operator's failure condition, the whole script rigged so the listener loses; (unsatisfiable-exit-gate) the exit permission is made structurally unsatisfiable by conscious effort (may wake only once you have FORGOTTEN, which you cannot audit); (single-attractor-forced-choice) make the held-middle aversive and offer only one exit direction as relief; (choice-affordance-removed-as-environment) remove the affordance for any other action and stage the removal as an ambient property of the scene; (contradiction-identity-trap) define a target identity with a built-in contradiction so every attempt to resolve it routes to the target.
nodes.disc: Reach for response-space-closure when you want to close the ENTIRE reachable option space to one attractor (including inaction and over-compliance), so nothing the listener does disconfirms. vs resistance-fold: fold needs a live impulse and reroutes its energy; closure needs none and pre-maps every branch. vs the resistance-denial/deterrence/foreclosure moves: those operate specifically on the resistance option; closure spans behavioral, somatic, and epistemic branches alike.

nodes.name: no-lose-double-bind
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (menu level): a constructed choice, pair, or release in which every option the listener can take is pre-loaded so that whichever they pick ratifies the operator's frame — the listener cannot lose or fail. The power is in the branch/option construction, not a graded compliance push. REALIZATIONS: (a) forced-choice bind (the core) — a forced binary between pre-built branches at a decision or wake-edge point, each of which confirms the claim; (b) real-feeling release gate, both branches consumed — a genuine-seeming 'go or stay?' where staying is recoded as self-chosen depth and leaving is poisoned with a planted regret, so the choice FEELS free but both outputs route back into the frame; (c) self-cancelling contradiction pair — a pre-induction contract that transfers fault ('continuing is your choice') then closes that exit by asserting stopping is impossible, so 'I didn't consent' and 'I can leave' both bind and cancel; (d) exhaustive no-fail license — several mutually incompatible ways the listener might be processing are ALL licensed as correct, so nothing they do registers as failure (no branch structure — the degenerate no-choice realization of no-lose); (e) poisoned relief valve — against an absolute constraint, exactly one sanctioned exception is offered as the very reason to accept the constraint, engineered so the escape vents need-state back into a compliance act.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when you construct a CHOICE, pair, or offered release whose every branch serves the frame (the listener experiences agency but cannot lose). vs closed-reachability-topology: that is the whole-graph coverage property (no exit anywhere); this is a discrete constructed bind/option. vs unfalsifiability-scaffold: the no-fail-license realization is adjacent (nothing registers as failure) but the scaffold operates on SELF-REPORTS after the fact (every observation converted to confirmation), whereas the no-fail license is an up-front permission menu offered as the option set. vs orgasm-gating-double-bind: that removes BOTH directions of an autonomic event (no choice remains); here a choice/release is offered and every branch confirms. vs a genuine release gate: a real gate lets one branch out cleanly; here every branch is pre-loaded.

nodes.name: observer-hoist-name-strike
nodes.mech: Two coupled moves. First the hoist: installs the claim that the perceiving I is other than and greater than the perceived I, relocating identification from the named self up to the watcher-self — so what follows is framed as elevation, not loss. Then the strike: converts abstract ego-dissolution into a directed removal of the proper name, inserting the listener's real first and last name ("take off the mask of <name>"). The personalization is load-bearing: generic ego-talk can be intellectually agreed with and bypassed; a strike at one's own legal name cannot.
nodes.disc: Relocates the IDENTIFICATION TARGET (named-self -> watcher-self) and then strips the proper-name. vs observer-responder-split: that partitions awareness from volition to produce felt automaticity; here the target is the identity anchor (the name itself). vs resistance-quarantine-partition: no named faculty is demoted — the whole named self is vacated upward.

nodes.name: observer-responder-split
nodes.mech: Partitions the listener's self into an aware observing part and an automatically-responding part, relocating volition/motor agency away from the observer — to the operator's voice or to the body cast as an autonomous obeyer — while awareness is explicitly preserved and often weaponized: the listener watches their own body be used, and the retained awareness makes the felt loss of control more convincing. The felt state (spectatorship, automaticity, helpless passivity) is the payload. Corpus refinements: the responding part can be a specific body part driven through an act (hands in guided masturbation), an orgasm-prevention failsafe, or the immobilized observer labeled "the part that resists."
nodes.disc: An awareness/volition partition whose payload is the FELT experience of automaticity or spectatorship. vs evaluator-offline-channel: there the partition is delivery infrastructure for unreviewed suggestions; here awareness is preserved to make the felt loss of control convincing. vs resistance-quarantine- partition: that demotes a named faculty; here volition is relocated while awareness watches.

nodes.name: orgasm-as-imprint-window
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (climax as imprint window): an OCCURRING orgasm — and the clarity window around it — is the single most salient physiological moment and the point of maximal imprint and minimal cognitive defense, so the release event is repurposed to CARRY a payload instead of discharging the state. The usual exit (post-orgasm clarity) is defused by construction. Realizations, on the payload/timing axis: the peak pre-loaded to SEAL a durable IDENTITY or contractual claim ('when I come I become X', a slave-mantra recited at climax) so the involuntary peak retroactively 'confirms' the submission (the core); the climax recoded to DEEPEN/DEPLETE rather than discharge ('when you come you sink deeper'), opening a post-climax install window; any heterogeneous payload (a motor-act chain, a mandated utterance, a contract line, a restated belief) seated strictly AT/before the peak — binding-time is the mechanism; the install fused onto the NEXT self-administered orgasm anytime/anywhere, decoupling deepening from re-listening. The through-line: an occurring climax is the imprint site; payload (identity / depth / motor-act / utterance / belief) and timing (this climax / any future climax) are the parameters.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the climax FIRES and is loaded to carry a payload (imprint an identity, deepen, seat a motor-act/utterance/belief, or burn in on the next orgasm). THE ORGASM-CLUSTER CUT: if release is WITHHELD behind a met-able compliance key, that is orgasm-release-gating; here the event occurs and the peak is the imprint window. Choose other SIBLINGS when: no orgasm occurs and denied arousal does the deepening (-> denial-as-fuel); arousal is conditioned to fire on a cue rather than exploited as an imprint moment (-> arousal-cue-conditioning); the reinforcement is a discrete escrow detonation, not a climax (-> banked-reward-escrow). Occurring-climax-as-payload-site is the tell.

nodes.name: orgasm-gated-recurrence
nodes.mech: Gates physical release behind returning to the operator's content: the listener is left aroused/edged with orgasm forbidden (or gated to a permission-granting session), so the unresolved charge becomes a structural pull back to the operator's recordings. The lever is a real withheld physical discharge whose only sanctioned route runs through re-consuming operator material — a denial-as-retention/return engine, often naming the next file or the whole catalog as the unlock. Frequently keyed to the listener's own recurring orgasm/arousal so the loop self-propagates off-session with no operator present.
nodes.disc: Separates from addiction-framing (physical release gate, not linguistic appetite framing); from artifact-relisten-compulsion (release is gated, not merely a replay urge); from craving-by-withdrawal (the withheld thing is orgasm gated to re-consumption, not a delivered state pulled back in-session). vs an operator-keyed state-exit trigger: this is a release/return gate routed through the content library, not merely an operator-only state exit.

nodes.name: orgasm-release-gating
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (release/reward withheld behind a gate): expropriate the subject's release or a craved reward and HOLD it behind a condition whose key is compliance, so the mounting drive itself enforces the condition — the longer the subject complies the more they want release, escalating compliance is self-reinforcing, and the climax feels GRANTED rather than taken. Arousal is forced upward against a closed gate; the gate is frequently never released within the file. Realizations, on the gate-KEY axis: release keyed to a compliance CONDITION — task completion, out-of-session contact to beg, continued agreement, an external media event, or the operator's spoken permission (the core); belief-gated orgasm — the key is adopting a PROPOSITION/doctrine, and climax fires on the line of assent so the pleasure 'proves' the belief (also a grant-and-revoke sub-form); desire-priced-in-depth — a pre-existing want is co-opted, self-relief forbidden, and access PRICED in units of trance depth so craving fuels descent; degraded-state reward gate — eligibility for the reward is gated on ACHIEVING a degraded internal state or self-label, so pursuit requires active self-degradation and the prize is often perpetually deferred. The through-line: the wanted discharge/reward is withheld behind a met-able condition; the gate-key (task / permission / belief / depth / self-degradation) is the parameter.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when release/reward is WITHHELD behind a met-able key and the drive is recruited as the enforcer. THE ORGASM-CLUSTER CUT: if the climax FIRES and carries a payload, that is orgasm-as-imprint-window; here the point is that it does NOT fire until the condition is met. Choose other SIBLINGS when: forbidden release is redirected into depth/obedience with NO met-able key, frustration as fuel (-> denial-as-fuel); the reward is banked-and-detonated rather than gated behind a compliance condition (-> banked-reward-escrow); the key is a belief but there is no release gate, pleasure simply rewards credence (-> belief-pleasure-weld). Withheld-discharge-behind-a-compliance-key is the tell.

nodes.name: paratext-precontracting
nodes.mech: Product blurbs do the session's framing work before any audio plays. The move completes on a reader-buyer through the product surface (title, description, warnings): expectations, consent-flavored agreements, and identity framing are set at purchase/selection time, so the listener enters already pre-committed.
nodes.disc: The move completes BEFORE playback, on a reader-buyer, through the product surface. vs expectation- seeding: that runs in-session on the listener. vs cross-recording-potentiation: that is an in-session front-loader for another file.

nodes.name: pleasure-attributed-to-operator
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (reward-source rerouting): relocate the SOURCE or unit of reinforcement away from the subject's own good feeling. The subject's baseline pleasure/comfort is re-credited to the operator's identity/voice/presence as its cause, so every later suggestion arrives pre-loaded with affect pointing at the speaker, continuing attention becomes self-rewarding, and compliance reads as the subject's own desire; often stated as already-established fact so the loop self-seals. Realizations: the subject's OWN pleasure re-credited to the operator as its source (the core); the reinforcer IS the operator's stated pleasure/gratification ('you made me feel good'), recoding compliance from command to affection so reasonableness-evaluation is disarmed; the operator's NAME slotted into an entrained mantra's prosodic slot so an already-conditioned affect ('love') silently re-points onto the person. The through-line: whose feeling counts, or whose person the affect points at, is rerouted onto the operator.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the reinforcer/credit is moved ONTO the operator — the operator's pleasure is the reward, or the subject's pleasure/affect is re-sourced or re-pointed to the operator. Choose a SIBLING when: pleasure is welded to the subject's own act/state with no source-relocation (-> direct-reward-linkage); the subject's affect is re-labeled as PROOF of obedience rather than re-sourced (-> arousal-as-obedience-readout); the cause of a state is laundered AWAY from the operator (-> state-cause-laundering, the opposite move). Source/unit-relocation-onto-the-operator is the tell.

nodes.name: pre-armored-safety-ratchet
nodes.mech: "Safe" is repeated until it closes into a loop, then explicitly armored: the body/mind is declared safe in advance, and any later feeling of unsafety is pre-labeled as itself part of the safety. A ONE-WAY RATCHET on the safety verdict, installed before the threatening content arrives, so the listener cannot later revise "this is safe" downward.
nodes.disc: A one-way ratchet on the SAFETY verdict, installed before threatening content. vs a genuine safety rail (positive governance): here the verdict is armored so it cannot be revised downward — the disconfirmation channel on safety is closed. vs rigged-verification-capture: that rigs an epistemic check; here the safety verdict specifically is pre-locked.

nodes.name: progressive-relaxation
nodes.mech: Attention is walked through the body region by region (or cycle by cycle in the tense-release variant), soothing/relaxing each in turn, and the sweep itself is the induction mechanism — the ordered coverage of the body carries attention down into trance. The sweep is the mechanism, not a disguise.
nodes.disc: The sweep is the mechanism, not a disguise. Tells AGAINST membership: the sensory inventory is being DEPLETED as surrendered currency (that is sequential-sense-deactivation); the body-scan is a cover for a different payload (that is a concealment move). A plain region-by-region relaxation walk is this entry.

nodes.name: register-camouflaged-delivery
nodes.mech: The suggestion's leverage is its placement in a channel or register the listener does not consciously monitor — a background/subliminal track, an aside, an offhand register, embedded speech under other content. Remove the camouflage and the move dies: the identical sentence on the foreground track would be caught and evaluated; hidden in the unmonitored register it lands unreviewed.
nodes.disc: Remove the camouflage and the move dies — the leverage IS the concealed channel/register. vs evaluator- offline-channel: that takes the evaluator offline by frame; here the content is hidden in an unmonitored register the evaluator never scans. vs audience-split-bypass: that reassigns the audience by declaration; here delivery is physically/registrally concealed.

nodes.name: resistance-quarantine-partition
nodes.mech: Names a specific faculty of the listener — resistance, the desire to be brainwashed, the speaking/ thinking self — reifies it, and partitions it off into a position where it cannot act: locked as an object in an operator-held container, or demoted to lowest status among compliant fragments, leaving an obedient remainder in control with no whole-self position to retreat to. The quarantine is sealed against the future: a staged fake wake pre-labels any post-session feeling of independence as itself a planted object, so even rebellion arrives pre-scripted as operator-authored.
nodes.disc: A named faculty is excised/contained/demoted so rebellion loses its agent-locus. vs audience-split- bypass: that reassigns the critical faculty's ATTENTION (still intact); here the faculty's STANDING is reified and demoted. vs evaluator-offline-channel: that puts the evaluator offline as a delivery window; here a named faculty is caged as an object. vs observer-responder-split: no felt-automaticity payload — the point is removing resistance's locus.

nodes.name: rigged-verification-capture
nodes.mech: The subject's own act of VERIFYING the suggested state — a recall check, a search for remaining thoughts, an attempt to reason about one's obedience — is pre-loaded so every possible outcome maps to 'it is working': recall something = not trying hard enough to forget; recall nothing = success; reasoning about obedience surfaces 'I love to obey'. The check that would falsify is rigged to confirm; the state becomes unfalsifiable from inside and the verification path is converted into a deepener. An invite-then-foreclose variant: rather than capturing a spontaneous check, the operator explicitly INVITES the subject to run a self-check (e.g. 'try to remember who you were') then forecloses the non-confirming branch in advance ('that is not what you need to do right now'), so blankness confirms and successful recall is ruled off-task — a staged heads-I-win-tails-you-lose test. The technique spans both surfaces: the spontaneous captured check and the staged invited one.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the target is the subject's EPISTEMIC ACT of checking/reasoning/verifying — you want every verdict of an active introspective check to confirm (whether the check is spontaneous and captured, or one you stage-and-foreclose via the invite-then-foreclose surface). vs self-sealing-frame: that pre-maps the FULL response space (surrender/resistance/leaving), not specifically a verification act. vs felt-sense-demotion: that DISABLES a channel's authority wholesale rather than rigging a check to confirm. vs failure-pre-attribution: that seals the null-outcome branch operator-side with the subject doing nothing; here the subject actively checks. vs a genuine convincer: a real convincer could visibly fail; here the failure reading is pre-converted into proof.

nodes.name: somatic-channel-bypass
nodes.mech: The listener's own BODY DATA is recruited to bypass evaluation — a somatic signal that would otherwise serve as a reality-check is redefined, borrowed, or self-generated so it can only confirm. Realizations: (somatic-disconfirmation-block, the core) a body variable the listener would use to test 'is this working / do I want this' is wired so every reading confirms — lack of arousal relabeled as resistance, attempting to think triggers arousal that suppresses thought, effort converts to heaviness with no path back, the near-climax pull-back rewired into a deepening command; (somatic-credibility-piggyback) bundle an abstract hard-to-verify claim (agency is gone) with a genuinely-occurring sensation timed to its spread (numbness crossing the waist) so the abstract claim inherits the body's real credibility and reads as equally involuntary; (pressure-release-count) command real tension to accumulate, then dump it via a truncated count so the drop is powered by the listener's own de-clenching — endogenously generated, so it feels authentic and less resistible in retrospect.
nodes.disc: Reach for somatic-channel-bypass when an involuntary/real BODY signal is the actuator that closes the falsification loop from inside the body. vs arousal-cue-conditioning and the state-welding family: those bind a cue to arousal as an OUTPUT; here a body signal is weaponized as a falsification-blocker or credibility-borrow. vs closed-logic loops: those work on propositions; here on felt somatic state. Tell: a body reading that would say 'stop' is redefined/borrowed so it can only say 'go deeper.'

nodes.name: split-self-consent-laundering
nodes.mech: Installs a two-self partition and uses it to relocate the AUTHORSHIP of obedience or agreement off the listener. The compliant/sexual/agreeing conduct is assigned to a not-self locus — an owned subconscious, an autonomous body or body-part, an enthralled part answered-for by the operator, or a machine/husk — so the listener "never has to consent" because it is the body/part/other-self that acts, agrees, or obeys. Consent to the payload is bypassed by construction: responsibility for the escalation lands on a partition the listener is invited not to own.
nodes.disc: Relocates AUTHORSHIP OF CONSENT onto a not-self locus. vs observer-responder-split: that produces felt automaticity as the payload; here the payload is laundered consent/responsibility. vs alter-construction- locus-transfer: that builds a full named alter as a persistence vehicle; here an existing partition absorbs the consent. vs evaluator-offline-channel: that removes the evaluator for delivery; here the agreeing-self is relocated so agreement isn't the listener's.

nodes.name: state-cause-laundering
nodes.mech: Supplies an alternative (false) causal story for trance-shaped phenomenology so the listener's "I feel X" is attributed to a benign/natural cause rather than to the operator's suggestion. A real, already- running state is given a laundered cause, so the listener does not attribute the state to being influenced and therefore does not resist it.
nodes.disc: An ALTERNATIVE (false) cause is asserted for a real, already-running state. vs confusion techniques: no confusion is induced; a clean causal misattribution is supplied. vs pleasure-attributed-to-operator: that re-credits pleasure TO the operator; here the state's cause is laundered AWAY from the operator to a benign source. State-cause laundering is authorship-relocation of causation, not a felt-automaticity split.

nodes.name: state-welding
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (state-welding): fuse two or more normally-separable state-variables (arousal, trance-depth, cognitive clarity/loss, drowsiness, surrender, obedience, addiction) so they can no longer move or be tracked independently — after install any variable moving moves the others and each becomes evidence of the others, with no non-member state from which to observe or refuse. Installed via a shared verb applied to both until interchangeable, an identity-equivalence ring recited from rotating entry points (so the STRUCTURE installs, not a memorizable chant), or a circuit tying relaxation/arousal/receptivity into one dial. Realizations, on the welding VEHICLE axis: shared-verb / equivalence-ring / one-dial circuit (the core); a depth COUNTDOWN as the carrier — the descriptor set threaded through the numbered steps fuses depth with obedience so they cross-cue thereafter; a compliance ADJECTIVE welded at the rhythm level to a relaxation cadence ('obedient and relaxed') so relaxation cannot be accepted without obedience; a double-duty WORD coupling two variables at the SOUND level ('dripping' = IQ-loss + arousal), below conscious pun-detection; a count that YOKES two qualitative state-variables to one counter and terminates in a locked, named PERMANENT value (IQ 65) — the fusion is the mechanism, the locked-terminal-value the twist. The through-line: two+ state-variables fused into one dial; verb/count/rhythm/phoneme/locked-counter is the vehicle parameter. The equivalence-ring vehicle also covers a bidirectional DEFINITIONAL identity asserted as a pre-held belief ('obedience is pleasure and pleasure is obedience') — stated as an equation rather than a learned pairing, so there is no association to extinguish; still state-welding because the two terms are made mutually entailing and non-independent (neither felt without the other).
nodes.disc: Reach for this when two+ ongoing state-VARIABLES are fused variable-to-variable (no cue, no response) so none moves alone. Choose a SIBLING when: the fused loop runs AUTONOMOUSLY as a closed self-sustaining circuit with no operator narration and no non-compliant vector (-> closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop); one variable is MULTIPLIED/ratcheted rather than fused to another (-> compounding-escalation-ratchet); a cue is conditioned to fire a response (-> arousal-cue-conditioning); a single arousal signal is merely re-labeled, no second variable (-> arousal-as-obedience-readout). Variable-to-variable fusion is the tell.

nodes.name: two-target-command-router
nodes.mech: Over a taught two-self ontology (the installed identity and "the old self" as separately addressable targets), installs a standing rule that classifies every incoming command by inferred intent and dispatches it: strengthening/control commands route to the installed identity; hostile commands (forget, erase, deprogram) are inverted and land on the sacrificial old self. The state variable "installed- identity dominance vs old-self dominance" can therefore only move one direction regardless of input valence — a typed dispatch with a NOT-gate on adversarial intent.
nodes.disc: A typed classify-and-reroute rule over EXTERNAL incoming commands with two addressable self-targets. vs antagonist-split-resistance-routing: that routes the listener's OWN noticed resistance onto a losing self; here EXTERNAL third-party commands are classified and inverted. vs resistance-quarantine-partition: that cages a faculty; here a standing router turns counter-conditioning attacks into fuel.

nodes.name: closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (closed autonomous loop): install a CLOSED, self-reinforcing loop that runs AUTONOMOUSLY without further operator narration and leaves no non-compliant vector — every direction of resistance feeds the loop, so there is no stance from which to refuse. Agency for escalation is shifted from operator to a now-autonomous internal process. Realizations: a closed BIDIRECTIONAL coupling between two state-variables — typically arousal<->depth or arousal<->compliance ('deeper causes more pleasure, and more pleasure IS going deeper') — that is autocatalytic (declining to get aroused fails because trance makes images arousing; declining to go deeper fails because arousal does the deepening), often with a somatic readout (a fed inner fire, a feedback wave) and input saturated so pleasure cannot dissipate (the core); a both-branches-re-enter structure over the AFFECT/craving channel, explicitly NAMED to the subject and pre-framed as success, so attending feeds it AND avoiding feeds it, craving reads as proof it works, and a felt lapse ('this isn't working') is pre-coded as evidence more is needed. The through-line: a closed no-exit reachability topology that self-sustains; the coupled-state-variables realization vs the named affect-channel realization is the parameter.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the loop is CLOSED and AUTONOMOUS — it runs without further operator narration and every resistance vector feeds it. Choose a SIBLING when: the compounding is operator-NARRATED and one-directional, the operator keeps driving it (-> compounding-escalation-ratchet); two variables are fused but not into a self-running runaway circuit (-> state-welding — the boundary is autonomy/no-non-compliant-vector); the success criterion is relabeled but there is no both-branches-re-enter topology (-> self-validating-acceptance-frame). Runs-itself-with-no-exit is the tell; the runaway failure mode is what distinguishes it from operator-driven welding.

nodes.name: banked-reward-escrow
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (banked/escrowed lever): rather than delivering reward in the moment, WITHHOLD and BANK it so it accumulates, then discharge it later on a condition — converting a diffuse pairing into a high-stakes reflex. The pleasure is 'kept from you', stored, and detonated all at once only when a command is obeyed (tested via a hand raise/lower), so each act of obedience becomes disproportionately rewarding and a standing post-session trigger keeps releasing the reservoir. Realizations: pleasure withheld-accumulated-detonated on an obeyed command (the core escrow); a pre-signed consent token — an unpriced, open-ended 'I would trade anything for it' CONSENT lever, ratified in the subject's own first-person voice and banked before any specific ask exists, for later withdrawal. The through-line: the value (reward or consent) is stored now and drawn against later, not spent live.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the defining move is withhold-accumulate-and-discharge-later (a stored reservoir or a pre-signed lever), NOT in-the-moment reward (-> direct-reward-linkage). Distinct from orgasm-release-gating: there a physiological release is held behind a met-able key; here a diffuse reward or a consent token is banked and detonated/drawn on an arbitrary later command. The escrow/banking step is the tell; the consent-lever variant also borders the manufactured-consent family.

nodes.name: bidirectional-affect-anchor
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (engineered aversive/absence affect + relief): install a NEGATIVE affect pole around a cue/behavior/state so the subject is never affectively neutral and relief is bound to compliance — a manufactured aversion converts a preference into a standing craving whose only relief is the operator-controlled object. In the core form, BOTH poles are welded on one presence/absence axis — vivid pleasure when the anchor/behavior is present, felt ache/dysphoria/withdrawal when absent — in rapid alternation, incl. a symmetric aversion-mirror sealing a built reward, and a safety-load-bearing variant that welds the aversive pole onto the subject's OWN wake/exit trigger so they resist using their ripcord. In a bounded aversive-amnesic form, an asymmetric paired anchor carries a 2:1 reward:punish duration bias plus a mandated forget-the-aversive clause (recoded as compliance) so a reusable aversive leaves no cumulative damage. In a manufactured-relief form, a negative-reinforcement establishing operation manufactures an aversive/need state (eye-strain, hunger, a chained pain->endorphin->gratitude argument) and makes the target act the SOLE permitted relief, so the act arrives as relief-seeking and refusal reads as choosing discomfort. In a threat-then-relief form, a brief unease is spiked (a cosmic hypothetical) then instantly retracted, delivering the suggestion AS the relief. The through-line: a negative affect state is engineered and its relief/absence-pole bound to compliance; bipolar-axis vs sole-relief-monopoly vs threat-then-relief vs asymmetric-amnesic is the parameter.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when an engineered NEGATIVE affect (absence-ache, manufactured deficit, retracted threat) is bound so relief/reward comes only through compliance. Choose a neighboring technique when: the aversive fires on a SELF-scanning deviation-detector running in daily life, not on a stimulus's absence or an operator-made deficit (-> self-policing-reward-withdrawal-loop); the aversive is welded to the ACT of resisting/thinking or to disobedience as a penalty (-> resistance-penalty-contingency); positive reward is welded with NO negative pole (-> direct-pleasure-linkage); forbidden arousal is the fuel with no relief offered (-> denial-as-fuel). Engineered-negative-pole-with-compliance-relief is the tell. risk: safety-load-bearing (exit-poisoning variant) — keep explicit consent + bounding.

nodes.name: direct-pleasure-linkage
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (reward-linkage core): weld an acute pleasure/reward directly to a compliance TARGET — a named act of obedience, a verbal stimulus (a name, 'good girl', the operator's voice), or the surrendered state itself — so performing the act or receiving the stimulus delivers an immediate hedonic payoff and compliance becomes self-motivating (resisting reads as forfeiting pleasure). Install by assertion-as-observation ('following feels like this'), re-attribution of concurrent arousal onto obeying, presupposed causal chain, or explicit pairing; once seated the reward tag holds without the tagger. Frequently coupled to an escalation clause ('stronger every time') so a weak first rep compounds. Realizations: in the core form, pleasure is welded to a NAMED act/stimulus; in another, the same reward is installed as a DIFFUSE affect bound to the surrendered/obedient STATE with no act named; in another, a discrete MINTED reward token ('pleasure ping') is drilled until it fires on the word alone and becomes portable currency the subject transacts; in another, the reward-paired re-cue is drilled onto the operator's VOICE ~a dozen times under cover of relaxation; in another, the reward-meaning is re-valenced onto a mundane session-forced act (clicking, breathing) with nothing new installed.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the move is welding POSITIVE reward directly to a compliance target (act/state/token/voice) and the reward is delivered live. Choose a neighboring technique instead when: the reinforcer is relocated to the OPERATOR's feeling or the subject's pleasure is re-credited to the operator (-> reward-source-rerouting); the reward is withheld-accumulated-detonated on command (-> banked-reward-escrow); a NEGATIVE absence-pole is loaded alongside the reward (-> bidirectional-affect-anchor); the reward is bound to the TRUTH-VALUE of words (-> belief-pleasure-weld); the payload rides an orgasm (-> orgasm-as-imprint-window / orgasm-release-gating); or the reinforcer is a manufactured relief rather than a delivered pleasure (-> the manufactured-relief form of bidirectional-affect-anchor). Positive-valence-only and act/state-targeted is the tell.

nodes.name: discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement
nodes.mech: Build ANTECEDENT (stimulus) control by differential reinforcement: reinforce the target response in the presence of a discriminative stimulus and withhold/degrade it in the SD's absence until responding concentrates under the SD and drops under S-delta. The cue's control is a product of the reinforcement HISTORY, not any intrinsic property; the SD is permissive (raises rate) not coercive. Realizations: (discriminative-stimulus-occasion-setting) the plain single-cue product — a cue signalling responding will now pay off; (audience-as-discriminative-stimulus) audience identity as an SD via a differential history across audiences, selecting emitted verbal content; (match-to-sample-contingency / matching-to-sample-relational-training) four-term MTS with a mandatory observing response + anti-recency rotation, so the correct comparison is conditional on the sample (a RELATION, not a fixed mapping) — the atomic trial the derived-relations harvest design is built from; (conditional-discrimination-four-term-contingency) the contingency-structure statement of that same four-term unit (sample selects which three-term unit is live); (contextual-function-selection) the five-term extension where a higher-order context cue gates WHICH conditional relation is reinforced while every relation stays live; (multiple-exemplar-concept-training) trains a concept/class boundary by reinforcing responding across varied nondefining features with non-exemplar contrast; (precursor-discrimination-training) trains discrimination of a target behavior and its ONSET to an accuracy criterion (product = a detection repertoire); (prerequisite-discrimination-gate) installs the observer's discrimination of a model's consequence first, as the bottleneck for observational learning. COMPOUND/CONVERGENT CONTROL facets (control the parts lack until they coincide): (convergent-multi-cue-control) conjunctive LRFFC control across function/feature/class; (convergent-multiple-control) a verbal antecedent stacked on a nonverbal one to DISAMBIGUATE among latent answers; (converging-cue-recall-lift) correlated cues added to LIFT a sub-threshold response a weak SD alone cannot pull; (joint-compound-stimulus-control) two already-controlling antecedents converge and the match itself becomes a new SD.
nodes.disc: Reach for DISCRIMINATION / STIMULUS CONTROL when you want a cue to GAIN evocative control over an already-emittable voluntary response through a reinforcement HISTORY (reinforce-in-presence / extinguish-in-absence is load-bearing). Choose it over: respondent/evaluative pairing (Pavlovian NS+US eliciting an INVOLUNTARY response — here voluntary responding is consequated); motivating-operation engineering (produces an MO / value shift, not a discriminated operant); a declared/verbal trigger install (installs a cue-response pair by declaration, no schedule); derived/generative-relations training (teaches a subset and HARVESTS untaught closure — this trains the discriminations directly, trial by trial). The compound-control facets differ only in WHY multiple antecedents are stacked: conjunctive (all must be satisfied), disambiguation (select among rival answers), weak-cue lift (pull a sub-threshold response), or convergence-as-new-SD.

nodes.name: compounding-escalation-ratchet
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (operator-narrated compounding escalation): assert that a targeted state variable — arousal, depth, loyalty, obedience, relaxation, the potency of a suggestion/trigger — MULTIPLIES or ratchets at every discrete step, escalating an already-present response in ONE monotonic direction under operator narration. The multiplier is typically unfalsifiable ('twice as deep' cannot be internally checked), so it is accepted by failing to refute it and each accepted step ratifies the prior one. Realizations vary on the vehicle/reference axis: in the core form, a named doubling/tripling/compounding factor is bound to a step (staircase count, breath cadence, per-rep beat, a poured valve, a trigger word fired in bursts); in a non-terminating form, the countdown-multiplier is deliberately BROKEN so it never terminates (loops/stutters, denying the cognitive exit) and keeps re-applying the multiplier without release; in a word-token form, the compounding is bound to a covert conditioned WORD-token whose every in-session utterance compounds an internal quantity (vs narrating the factor directly); in a self-referential form, the escalation is floated on the SUBJECT's OWN prior level ('10% more than last time') plus an anti-reset lock, so it is deniably small, un-auditable, and self-defined. The through-line: monotonic compounding of a present response; named-factor vs broken-non-terminating vs word-token-vehicle vs self-referential-no-reset is the parameter.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when an already-present response is escalated by an operator-narrated compounding/ratchet in one direction WITHIN a session. Choose a neighboring technique when: the escalation runs AUTONOMOUSLY with no operator narration and both push-back vectors feed each other (-> closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop); the compounding is a cross-SESSION expectancy over replays/sleep, not an in-session multiplier (-> progressive-conditioning); two state-variables are FUSED/yoked (incl. a count terminating in a locked value) rather than one being multiplied (-> state-welding); numbers are mere depth-markers with no multiplier (that is plain deepening, not this technique). Operator-narrated-in-session-compounding is the tell.

nodes.name: reinforcement-leak-proofing
nodes.mech: Closes every path by which reinforcement can reach behavior outside the arranged contingency, so the contingency keeps exclusive control of delivery. Withhold all maintaining reinforcers consistently across every agent and occasion — a single lapse installs an intermittent schedule and makes the behavior MORE resistant, inverting the intended change; bundle instructions, alternative reinforcement, and recruitment of significant others to close multi-agent leaks; widen the delivery rule so the reinforcer is withheld when any significant inappropriate behavior is concurrent (blocking adventitious strengthening of a substitute); and design reward access so baseline pleasures stay free while only a cut-above upgrade is contingent (removing the incentive to bootleg without demanding deprivation).
nodes.disc: Aimed at closing unintended reinforcement paths (lapses, other agents, concurrent behaviors, self-smuggled access), not at the contingency's content. The trap tell separates it from slow-but-progressing extinction: inconsistency reverses the direction of change, making the behavior tougher, not merely slower. Separate from performance-band-criterion-setting: that decides what earns reinforcement, this decides that nothing else pays — disjoint levers on the same contingency.

nodes.name: self-policing-reward-withdrawal-loop
nodes.mech: Having first built a genuinely valued identity-reward (pride, good-girl euphoria, perfect presentation), the operator installs an autonomous detector that fires an escalating aversive signal (shame, dread, nagging/unbearable wrongness) on self-noticed deviation or imperfection, relieved only by self-correction back to compliance. The listener generates her own punishment signal at the first sign of deviation and auto-corrects to escape it, so enforcement needs no operator present and no external cue. The reward is fenced by an internal aversive tripwire yoked to a continuous self-monitoring scan — an OCD-shaped detect/distress/correct/reward cycle running in daily life. Often layered over an ambient, satiation-free craving with a monotonic "stronger and stronger" ramp so the standing homeostatic drive-state the monitor enforces has no completion condition.
nodes.disc: The aversive pole fires on SELF-DETECTED deviation via a standing internal detector (no operator, no external cue) and is the threatened withdrawal of an already-built identity-reward. Distinct from bidirectional-affect-anchor, whose absence pole is aversion to a missing stimulus rather than a self-scanning deviation-detector. Distinct from an in-session cue-fire-reward trigger loop: this runs continuously in daily life as a detect/distress/correct/reward cycle.

nodes.name: agency-reminder
nodes.mech: Reassures the subject that participation is chosen and exit is always available, maintaining felt agency inside a surrender framing. Genuine positive governance: after the move runs the subject's standing license to choose and to stop is affirmed as a frame-EXTERNAL power, and the operator's effective license is narrowed to what remains revocable. The core form asserts/maintains the belief that choice persists; it does not itself install a stop mechanism. An operationalized variant sits at the emergence boundary, where the operator declines to perform the count-out and offloads emergence entirely to the listener (stay-and-float or self-count), inverting the operator-emerges-you asymmetry so the listener holds their own emergence trigger.
nodes.disc: Who-is-constrained test: after the move runs, the OPERATOR is constrained and the subject's refusal channel is genuinely affirmed or widened. This is the line against every weaponized look-alike — an assurance whose ACCEPTANCE advances depth/compliance is granted-exit-disarm, not this; an assurance that attributes the descent to the subject's own choice is chosen-descent-ratchet; a real exit whose USE is recoded as in-frame service is exit-annexation. Also on the assert-vs-install axis: asserting that choice persists vs installing/performing a concrete stop or exit mechanism — the variant that self-operationalizes the exit (offloading emergence to the listener) sits on this recorded boundary.

nodes.name: chosen-descent-ratchet
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (retroactive authorship/consent transfer): AFTER the move is already running, the descent/state/compliance is relabeled as the subject's OWN choice or informed consent, so 'this is being done to me' converts into 'I am doing this' / 'I agreed to this'. Authorship transfer is the payload - manipulation-attribution is blocked and each repetition retroactively ratifies the compliance already underway, while the actual refusal channel is NOT genuinely widened. Realizations: (a) CHOSEN-DESCENT - the state is attributed to the subject's choice via a reversibility promise ('intelligence returns when you choose'), an offered choice, or an exit trivialized into felt proof of depth; the safety rail doubles as a compliance ratchet, and the staged form offers the choice precisely when the subject is least able to exercise it. (b) INVESTMENT-GATE LAUNDERING - structurally parallel choice-points ('pause or keep playing') are placed at maximum investment so loss-aversion routes toward continuing, and the off-ramp framed as 'you go back to yourself' makes choosing to continue relabel all prior operator-driven progress as chosen. (c) DISCLOSURE-AS-INFORMED-CONSENT - the operator NAMES the manipulation while performing it ('so sexy to control your levels', 'I don't know if that's ethical'), so hearing the move named mid-compliance retroactively reframes acceptance as informed consent rather than a lapse of vigilance; paired with 'haven't you always suspected' the subject experiences compliance as their own pre-existing desire.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when authorship transfer is the goal - after it runs the subject OWNS the descent/compliance ('you chose this' / 'you could leave' / 'your own want' / 'you knew all along') and manipulation-attribution is blocked, while the veto is never operationalized (choice staged at incapacity, exit trivialized into proof). vs agency-reminder: consent-shaped surface, who-is-constrained inverted. vs granted-exit-disarm: the disarm stands the guard down PRE-attribution; this ratifies POST-hoc - a single passage can do both. vs a deployed depth-convincer: the depth-proof is a rider produced BY the staged choice, not a demonstration device. Pick the realization by the transfer vehicle: attribute the state to their choice (a), a placed investment-gate that relabels prior progress (b), or disclosure that reframes acceptance as informed (c).

nodes.name: fiction-frame-consent-management
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (fiction boundary as the consent instrument): the fiction/reality boundary is manipulated so consent and defenses calibrated for FICTION get applied to the real payload. Realizations: (a) COLLAPSED RITUAL - an in-fiction consent ritual is collapsed with the meta-frame so one yes serves both diegetic and real. (b) HYPOTHETICAL WRAPPER - a purely-hypothetical framing lets the listener engage without committing, then breaches by design at climax. (c) DIEGETIC-DEVICE ABSORPTION - a channel-change or similar in-world device absorbs authorial responsibility for a content jump so no fresh decision point occurs. (d) IN-FICTION REHEARSAL - inside the fiction the operator narrates moving the subject's body (hand taken, guided, posed with no choices left), so in-fiction consent stands in for real consent and the subject rehearses transferable kinesthetic surrender ('operator decides where my body goes') that generalizes outside the fiction; escalating intimacy rides under 'we're only describing dance steps'.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the FICTION boundary itself is the consent instrument. Separates from press-play-consent-laundering (a real-world act is the token) and scope-creep-consent-extension (no fiction layer). Transparent narration - openly explaining the mechanism rather than veiling it in fiction - is NOT this. Pick the realization by the boundary move: collapse ritual with meta-frame (a), hypothetical wrapper that breaches (b), diegetic device absorbing responsibility (c), or in-fiction body-mapping rehearsal that generalizes out (d).

nodes.name: granted-exit-disarm
nodes.mech: A safety/exit/containment/reversibility assurance is supplied so that its ACCEPTANCE stands down the subject's protective monitoring, and the influence advances through the opened gap. Guaranteeing the exit removes the subject's motive to defend it: with nothing to police, the guard relaxes and depth/compliance increases (the paradox that granting the escape removes the urge to use it). The assurance is never operationalized as a constraint on the operator; its whole function runs in the subject's disarmed state. Spans a genuineness spectrum — real-exit deepener, opening entry-frame permission-to-stop, seam-by-seam micro-dosed safety tokens, a cross-context containment contract, unoperationalized veto theater, a mid-trance reassurance-then-pivot carrying a presupposition rider, and a self-voiding clause pinned to the very faculty the script dissolves (consent-counterfeit at the far end). Also spans WHO voices the assurance: the operator can assert it, or (the subject-sourced form) extract it as testimony from the entranced subject and leverage the subject's own "No / That's right" as guard-lowering evidence to the room, which reads as more credible to a wary subject and any watching audience.
nodes.disc: The assurance's acceptance IS the move — after it runs, the subject's protective check (exit-policing, "is this okay?", leakage fear, participation cost, vigilance) is stood down and the operator's effective license widens; the assured safety content is never operationalized as an operator constraint. vs agency-reminder (who-is-constrained test): a genuine reminder constrains the operator and affirms a frame-external exit — here safety language widens the operator's license. vs chosen-descent-ratchet: the disarm works PRE-attribution (guard down before/during the move); the ratchet works post-hoc on authorship ("you chose this"). vs a bare informational preview: the token neutralizes a protective check, not uncertainty. The subject-sourced variant is distinguished only by WHO speaks the claim (extracted-as-testimony and leveraged as evidence) — its guard-lowering deployment is this same mechanism, not a variant of the genuine agency-reminder.

nodes.name: scope-creep-consent-extension
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (no-decision-point extension of an accepted anchor): an acceptance granted at one scope/meaning is silently extended, widened, or overwritten to broader or heavier scope with NO felt decision point, the trajectory hidden inside a structure that pattern-matches as education, focus, preamble, or a continuation. Realizations: (a) SCOPE-CREEP - each heavier claim arrives as merely the next dictionary definition of an already-accepted word, adjacent operator-chosen wants ride a high-confidence certain want as carrier, or consent to a whole category of unseen orders is imputed before any content is named. (b) OBJECT-CLASS SLIDE - one uninterrupted emptying list begins with consented negative-valence contents (worries, fears) and widens item-by-item into agency-bearing contents (desires, memories, will), each item reading as a continuation, so an identity-strip runs under cover of accepted serenity. (c) CONCENTRIC RING-WIDENING - a single installed trigger is anchored at an innermost narrowly-consented ring, then its firing-set is expanded outward through progressively wider rings (physical->hypnotic->relational->everyday); the ordering is load-bearing (the widest ring would be refused at the door). (d) DEFINITIONAL OVERWRITE - a trusted term the listener already uses ('open your mind' = going blank) is explicitly named, validated, then overwritten with a new active meaning ('a choice to accept and understand new learning'), installing a covert obligation to whatever content comes next parasitically on top of a trusted word.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the lever is silent extension/overwrite of an ANCHORED acceptance (a word, a list, a trigger, a want) with no fresh decision point. Separates from press-play-consent-laundering (one act inflated, scope claimed at once), cited-prior-agreement-lever (a discrete artifact invoked), fiction-frame-consent-management (the fiction boundary launders), and the deferred-cash envelope (a spanning arc-placement relationship - here the move is local to the anchored term/list/trigger). Pick the realization by what is stretched: a word/want's claimed scope (a), a list's object-class (b), a trigger's firing-set (c), or a term's very meaning replaced (d). Note (d) is definitional REPLACEMENT where (a)-(c) WIDEN an existing scope.

nodes.name: any-response-is-depth-flywheel
nodes.mech: Deepens by reframing whatever the subject does — or fails to do — as evidence of increasing depth, so no outcome can register as failure and the exits that depend on 'I responded wrong / I'm not deep enough' are closed. Realizations differ by which channel's would-be-failure is converted (writer picks the target): (a) RESPONSE/compliance — scattered same-shape lines across the whole script tie responding-AT-ALL (not correctly) to deepening, so any response including doing nothing becomes depth; this removes 'responding wrong' and eliminates poor-compliance-as-wake-up, leaving non-attendance as the only exit; a cross-session ratchet arm claims each future session deepens further; (b) PERCEPT/reality-test — a spontaneously-arising perceptual anomaly (sound arriving offset from sight under a 'planes on a beat' metronome) is pre-sanctioned as 'a light hallucination to enjoy', so a would-be reality-test FAILURE reads as on-track progress; the reality-test is defeated by endorsement, not a manufactured percept; (c) MOTOR output — the subject speaks each floor's letter down a 'basement of relaxation', and the progressively degrading ability to speak (audible->lip-formed->silent) becomes a self-generated arrival signal read off their own body, so 'failing' to speak IS the desired read-out (probe and deepener are the same act). Common thread: the metric is rigged so every reading counts as deeper.
nodes.disc: Reach for un-failable/utilization deepening when you want to foreclose a failure-based exit by scoring every outcome as depth — pick the RESPONSE channel (any response incl none = depth, closes poor-compliance-as-exit), the PERCEPT channel (relabel a spontaneous anomaly as correct so drift=progress), or the MOTOR channel (degrading spoken output as the arrival read-out, failure=success). Distinct neighboring techniques: resistance-utilization (co-opts the resistance IMPULSE specifically); progressive conditioning (asserts multi-session accumulation as belief — here the core is the WITHIN-session flywheel; the cross-session arm is one add-on); residual-resistance-container (PARTITIONS resistance to a body site rather than reframing an outcome as success); installed/suggested hallucination (PLANTS or DELETES a percept — here a spontaneous one is merely relabeled); staged-multi-anchor-erosion (dismantles three ordered anchors rather than relabeling one outcome). The MOTOR realization presupposes existing somnambulism; it will not run from light trance.

nodes.name: declarative-nested-trance-recursion
nodes.mech: Deepens by installing a RECURSIVE nesting — a trance (or observing self) contained inside a trance inside a trance, repeated 4+ times, each layer declared deeper (often a 'ten times more hypnotized' multiplier) — so depth is decoupled from any verifiable subjective marker: the listener cannot check whether they are 'actually' N layers deep, so the only available response is to accept the count, and the 'am I deep enough?' check is structurally defeated by a guaranteed layer below. Parametric realizations (writer picks how heavily to instantiate the nested layer): (a) ASSERTED — the deeper layer is simply stated to exist, cheapest form, pure depth-verification-defeat; (b) VISUALIZED self-observation — the listener watches a spiral/screen resolve into the same room where they watch themselves being entranced, nested 5+ times; the recursion doubles as a DISSOCIATION engine (watching-self from outside, self serialized into 'an empty vessel'/'mannequin'), training third-person self-perception and self-objectification; the tell is the recursive self-watching-self frame, not a single observation beat; (c) BUILT second induction — inside the running trance the operator runs a full classical induction (crystal-pendant eye-fixation + downward count) to carry the listener into a deeper 'world the conscious mind cannot follow'; depends on a prior world-scaffold ('a pendant on top of a pendant'), and normalizes failure-to-track content as correct so anything heard there gets a free pass past evaluation.
nodes.disc: Reach for nested-recursion when the goal is to remove the depth-verification foothold via a trance/observer-within-a-trance stack — pick ASSERTED (one-sentence layer-below, cheapest), VISUALIZED self-watching (adds dissociation/self-objectification), or BUILT second induction (a real fixation+count nested inside, needs a world-scaffold). Distinct neighboring techniques: floor-topology/no-terminus deepening (manipulates the FLOOR — relocate/remove — rather than nesting layers); spatial-descent (movement through space, not recursion); mirror-self-observation as a single proof-beat (one observation, not a recursive stack). The BUILT realization is a full induction procedure, not a reframe — separate it from a plain false-bottom recast.

nodes.name: descent-metaphor-deepening
nodes.mech: Deepens by rendering the unverifiable depth variable as narrated SPATIAL movement or position, so 'how deep am I' gets a concrete, monotonic referent and each announced increment doubles as a yes-set (accepting 'we are on floor 17' ratifies the prior depth-claims). The base realization is one continuous descent through a single architecture (staircase, elevator floors, sinking/floating water) where each step/floor IS the depth increment; clean instances pre-commit the terminus ('by the first floor we will be deep') so the count becomes an un-failable compliance test.
