Parametric realizations (writer picks the spatial surface): (a) CHAINED multi-architecture descent — several architectures run in sequence WITHOUT resetting the gradient, each consuming the prior's end-state, to escalate invasiveness / defeat single-count habituation; the tell is multiple descent engines with no 'come back up' between them; (b) DISCRETE indexed locales — depth as named/numbered PLACES ('you are now in world two'), a container/bubble, or a crossed threshold, each locale landing a whole state-package (pose, attention, arousal, expectation) at once; the tell is depth-as-place with integers doing objectivity-work and thresholds doing commit/seal work; (c) VOID/FLOATING dissolve — void/submersion/weightlessness imagery on a downward vector that removes sensory anchors to produce dissociation, multiple pleasant sensations welded to one descent-vector so each cross-confirms the others; tells: unmarked falling->rising reversal, or emptiness given an active suction that INSTALLS content; (d) SELF-SUBTRACTION locomotion — ongoing embodied walking (following a candle / the operator stepping back) reframed as walking AWAY from one's own mind, so mind-emptiness accumulates as chosen motion; the tell is the self treated as a location one leaves, with a 'I'll return you' hedge.
nodes.disc: Reach for spatial-descent deepening when you want depth given a concrete spatial referent that accretes compliance step by step. The vehicle (staircase / elevator / water / numbered world / void / walking) is SURFACE, not a boundary — pick by realization: continuous single-architecture count (base); chained architectures for escalation (a); discrete state-package locales (b); anchor-dissolving void/float for dissociation (c); self-subtraction locomotion (d). Distinct neighboring techniques: numerical-deepening (magnitude asserted as a bare count/multiplier with NO spatial vehicle); floor-topology/no-terminus (manipulates the FLOOR itself — recast or remove the terminus — rather than narrating movement toward one); dual-variable-descent-yoking (welds a second independent state-variable to the counter); descent-as-payload-armature (the descent frame disguises a per-step distinct-CONTENT install rate). A recurring companion move often rides on this deepener without being part of it: 'leave your thoughts/worries at the top as retrievable luggage' — an externalization device.

nodes.name: dual-variable-descent-yoking
nodes.mech: A descent deepener that binds a SECOND, independent state-variable — arousal or obedience — to the same step/count so the two become non-separable on one axis. Because deepening and the second variable ratchet together per step, the usual escape valve is pre-closed: arousal can no longer spike the listener back to alertness (it is recruited as fuel FOR depth), and resistance becomes self-defeating (fighting one's own ballast, since obedience IS the weight that drags the listener down). The coupling of the extra variable, not the descent itself, is the mechanism.
nodes.disc: A genuinely independent variable is welded to the descent counter so the two cannot be separated, converting a would-be competitor (arousal) or a would-be refusal (resistance) into fuel/self-defeat. Distinct from descent-metaphor-deepening (deepens on the depth axis alone). Distinct from descent-as-payload-armature (installs many DISCRETE content claims; here ONE continuous second variable is fused to the axis). Distinct from arousal-conditioning proper: this is a within-descent yoking move, not a durable trigger install.

nodes.name: false-bottom-depth-reframe
nodes.mech: Deepens by manipulating the FLOOR/terminus of the descent so the listener's 'am I deep enough yet / can I surface now' self-check has no marker to run against and no satisfied endpoint is ever reached. Two parametric realizations (writer picks how to deny the terminus): (a) RELOCATE the floor — recast an achieved, acknowledged depth (or an apparent terminal state) as merely the surface/entry-point of a further descent; the floor CONCEPT is kept but moved downward, so deepening restarts with momentum; the same past-the-declared-ceiling extension can ride other axes (objectification/transformation) or a diegetic scene-cut that lifts a situational cap; (b) REMOVE the floor — assert no bottom exists at all, converting depth from a place-arrived-at into a process with no terminating arrival, so falling becomes the steady state; realized by naming the listener's own brake (tiredness) as removed ('no resistance to slow you'), retracting prior safe-destination scaffolding ('the fall is the trance; only falling'), asserting-then-negating a destination ('dive to the floor... in constant swirling motion'), or a descending COUNT deliberately denied its terminus (restarted mid-descent so 'one' never arrives). The categorical difference between the two is whether a floor-concept survives (relocated) or is abolished; the shared consequence is the precluded surfacing self-check.
nodes.disc: Reach for floor-topology deepening when the goal is to defeat the surfacing/'deep enough?' self-check by denying an arrival state — pick RELOCATE-the-floor (keeps a floor, recasts this one as a new start, good for repeated 'deeper still' reveal beats) or REMOVE-the-floor (abolishes the terminus, good for an endless-fall dissolve; requires bounding). Distinct neighboring techniques: spatial-descent-deepening (narrates MOVEMENT toward a terminus rather than manipulating the terminus itself); declarative-nested-trance-recursion (defeats depth-VERIFICATION via a guaranteed layer-below — a recursion move, not a floor move); numerical-deepening (its count DOES arrive at a terminus, sole cargo is depth-magnitude); depth-keyed-to-memory-encoding (no state-bound retrieval target here).

nodes.name: self-operated-fractionation-poisoned-baseline
nodes.mech: Fractionation rendered as a UI element the listener operates themselves — a hallucinated on/off button (press = brain off/blank, press again = brain on) that the operator cycles while redefining "brain on" as progressively degraded each cycle ("pretending to be awake," "thoughts through syrup"). The listener has ownership-of-action without ownership-of-outcome; the waking baseline is poisoned each cycle so re-emergence never restores "normal" — a ratcheting FLOOR where pressing the button no longer returns to baseline because baseline no longer exists.
nodes.disc: The "on" (waking) state is monotonically poisoned cycle-by-cycle so re-emergence never restores baseline, and the fractionation is self-operated via a hallucinated UI. Distinct from classic fractionation (which RESTORES full waking between cycles for contrast) and from false-bottom (removes a ceiling; this removes the FLOOR by degrading waking).

nodes.name: amnesia-as-depth-convincer
nodes.mech: Produces a small, verifiable amnesia on a trivial over-learned datum (backward-counted numbers vanishing, own phone number, own name) and uses the subject's OWN failed retrieval as first-person proof of the deep state — the disappearance is treated not as a sign of somnambulism but as its operational definition. A try-and-fail instruction makes the blank self-produced (undeniable), the operator reassigns the accomplishment to the subject ("you did it"), and success unlocks rapid uptake of subsequent suggestions (glove anesthesia); failure (numbers/fact intrude) routes to a repair or artificial-state diagnosis.
nodes.disc: Amnesia deployed as a pass/fail depth GATE and convincer (self-produced blank on a trivial target = proof of state), not amnesia for its own sake. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (installs the gap as an end), from a plain descending-count deepener (it counts to descend — here the count's DISAPPEARANCE is the criterion and retained numbers signal an inadequate state), and from a cognitive convincer that lacks the amnesia substrate. The try-and-fail self-production plus deep-work gating are the tell.

nodes.name: amnesia-plus-return-compulsion
nodes.mech: Splits memory from motivation at the exit: the installed doctrine/triggers are sealed from conscious recall while an objectless craving to return is deliberately preserved and pointed forward. The un-rememberable "something significant happened" becomes the pull to re-listen, and re-listening deepens trance -> deepens amnesia -> deepens compulsion, forming a self-reinforcing maintenance loop. The listener wakes with no contraband memory to flag, only positive affect and a route back — the conditioning is un-auditable precisely because forgetting is bound to the return in the same breath. Variants add cross-trigger reinforcement, next-session pull-forward serialization, and orgasm-keyed fight-strengthens-it waking compulsions.
nodes.disc: Amnesia FUSED to a preserved return-compulsion (memory dropped, curated craving kept) so the gap itself motivates re-entry. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (drops recall without a retained craving), from plain craving-installation (installs the craving without sealing the payload from review), and from selective-amnesia-retained-payload (whose retained token is a slogan/trigger, not specifically a re-listening drive). Where a script fuses both a slogan and a return-pull, the return-loop is the organizing mechanism and it belongs here.

nodes.name: amnesia-suggestion
nodes.mech: Installs a memory gap by suggestion — instructs the subject that specified content (the session, an instruction, an installed feeling's rationale) will be unavailable to conscious recall, typically at or after emergence, so the material cannot be reviewed, contested, or revoked. The bare primitive: a declared forget targeting a bounded referent, optionally wrapped in a self-interested cover story (forgetting strengthens the training, forgetting feels good, "words go in one ear, accepted, out the other") or forward-binding to future listens. Includes the accept-and-forget process rule, the memory-wipe exit handshake, the "burst the bubble" terminal ritual, and the subconscious-only handoff that seals post-edge suggestions.
nodes.disc: A declared/suggested forget of bounded content as an end in itself, delivered by instruction rather than by a persistent object-ritual (container-externalized-erasure), a recursive recall-defeat loop (self-sealing-recall-loop), an install-event-only scoping (install-concealment-amnesia), or a retained-payload carve-out (selective-amnesia-retained-payload). Separates from gap-filling substitution (the gap is filled with a constructed replacement) and from covert-command concealment (a forward command hidden behind the amnesia): nothing is substituted and nothing is hidden behind it — the gap is the point.

nodes.name: blank-then-authorship-handoff
nodes.mech: Blanks the listener's own ideational stream and then reassigns authorship of mental content to the operator or to a "self-produced" source, so later suggestions land as the listener's own reality rather than external claims. Surfaces: a single lit candle/object holding all the listener's thoughts is blown out ("still there, still safe") to darken the mind while the same move installs the replacement clause ("my words will become your reality"); and the operator claims to BE the listener's subconscious/dream-generator during sleep, so surrender-content reads as self-produced and resistance has no external target. The blank/amnesia is enabling substrate; the load-bearing move is the authorship/reality substitution.
nodes.disc: Uses a blanking/forgetting substrate to execute an AUTHORSHIP relocation — operator speech becomes the listener's reality, or operator becomes the listener's own inner source. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (forgetting as the end — here forgetting only clears the channel) and from emptied-window-install (which states discrete claims into the window — here the handoff is a wholesale relocation of who authors mental content). The reality/authorship substitution clause is the tell.

nodes.name: choice-framed-amnesia
nodes.mech: Delivers amnesia as the listener's own autonomous choice or a permissive both-ways option, so no outcome reads as failure and the forgetting is retroactively owned. Variants: a technically-free "remember or forget, whichever is easiest" routed through a subconscious just trained to prefer compliance (so "easiest" favors the rehearsed operator-approved states); an outcome-agnostic permission frame where full/partial/none all count as success; a doubled hedge ("as much or as little as your subconscious allows... or not") handing forgetting-agency to the addressed subconscious; a remember-or-forget "choice" where BOTH branches preserve the install (forgetters can't inspect, rememberers file it as a neutral "lecture"); and amnesia as passive structural fact ("the memory was never formed") plus a ridicule-shield tagging serious recall as ridiculous.
nodes.disc: Amnesia framed as chosen/permissive/structural-fact rather than commanded, removing the "it didn't work" failure mode by defining every recall outcome as success and self-authored. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (a direct forget-command with a determinate target). The autonomy-laundering / weighted-free-choice / both-outcomes-confirm surface is the tell; the install persists on every branch.

nodes.name: confabulation-amnesia-barrier
nodes.mech: Partitions episodic memory by state (a bimbo/whore/alter identity vs the normal self) with mutual or one-directional amnesia across the boundary, AND pre-arms a generative confabulation routine: the normal self is instructed to invent plausible cover stories to smooth over evidence of the gap (clothing, locations, social residue), plus a specific behavioral patch (ignore the clothes, change quickly, dispose of the wardrobe; read clothing as "dressing for some interesting occasion"). Because the alter's activity is un-auditable from both sides and actively defended by generated cover, the trigger is insulated from being noticed, revoked, or examined — the amnesia is made robust to discovery rather than merely brittle.
nodes.disc: Amnesia paired with a pre-armed OPEN-ENDED confabulation directive (invent cover stories on demand) that defends the partition from waking scrutiny. A plain forget-suggestion stops at forgetting, and a screen-memory approach installs one fixed replacement memory — here the cover is improvised and open-ended, and the gap is defended by narrative repair rather than by hiding where the install came from. The generative repair routine is the tell.

nodes.name: container-externalized-erasure
nodes.mech: Erasure delivered by reifying mental content (memories, identity, thoughts, the conscious mind itself) as a destructible or disposable external object — a bubble, satin box, candle, gum-bubble, drain/spiral, rubber bag — that the listener fills or stages while the operator (or a single staged action) executes the removal. The load-bearing feature is the agency split: the listener packages the target, so cannot accidentally undo a deletion they did not perform, and forgetting becomes a discrete felt event ("pop", "lid slams", blow-out) rather than a diffuse absence. A single verb with a sliding referent ("drain X", "pop X") lets the operator keep feeding new categories into one rehearsed action without re-inducting.
nodes.disc: Amnesia/blanking executed through an externalized destructible-or-disposable container with an operator-owned removal step — not a verbal forget-suggestion and not a recall-defeat loop. Unlike relocating the analytical faculty intact somewhere quiet (nothing is destroyed, and the target is a faculty rather than memory content), the container here exists to be destroyed or discarded; and unlike a stepwise identity-erasure ladder, whose tell is the ordered escalation, the vehicle itself is the tell here — though the two often appear together in the same script.

nodes.name: contradiction-as-amnesia
nodes.mech: Amnesia induced not by a forget-command but by confidently narrating the present as if recent events never occurred, training the listener to distrust their own memory. The operator asserts in casual factual tone that nothing just happened ("we've just started", "first time we've had this talk"), denying even a physical action the listener performed (kneeling), with no acknowledgement — so episodic timeline coherence degrades and by midpoint "how many times" produces genuine confusion. A related surface re-attributes narrative-cut gaps (blinking forward between day-scenes) to trance-amnesia: the natural inability to recall what did not happen is relabeled as evidence the conditioning is working, used as a recurring mid-session deepener.
nodes.disc: Amnesia delivered as present-tense narration contradicting recent events (gaslighting-shaped) or as re-attribution of fiction/narrative cuts to trance-amnesia — no memory gap is installed, existing events are denied or existing gaps relabeled. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (a direct forget- command on a bounded target). Contradiction-without-acknowledgement / cut-relabeling is the tell.

nodes.name: covert-age-regression-state-reaccess
nodes.mech: Steers the subject back into an earlier developmental/cognitive-affective state without an explicit go-back-to-age-X command, by addressing that state through a covert vehicle: re-evoking a near-universal early-learning difficulty in present-active framing (b vs d, is a 6 an upside-down 9, first day of school), playing an internal melody chosen to index a target life-period, or leaving a phrase's scope undetermined so a state-describing reading (as a child) attaches to the listener. Because the regression is triggered by a shared association or a self-resolved ambiguity rather than a directive, there is nothing overt to refuse; attention narrows, plasticity reopens, and the earlier state's amnesia and suggestibility come with it.
nodes.disc: The move re-accesses an EARLIER developmental state via a covert vehicle (shared difficulty, melody-address, scope ambiguity) — the payload is state re-entry / age regression, not a manipulation of felt time-rate. Generic confusion work multiplies meanings to overload; here the self-resolved reading is itself a specific state induction. And unlike guided visualization, the material is the subject's own developmental state, not operator-supplied imagery.

nodes.name: covert-amnesia-installation
nodes.mech: Amnesia installed WITHOUT a recognizable forget-command — the suggestion is smuggled in as something other than an instruction so it slips past the evaluation a direct "you will forget" would trigger. Surfaces: an in-fiction physics metaphor (a black hole where "information can't escape", so later non-retrieval is pre-explained as a law of the descent) cashed later as the amnesia firewall; identity-loss delivered as an environmental fact of the fantasy scene ("you might not realize... even your own name"); a wake-time dismissal disguised as small talk that also instructs forgetting; covert deletion of a specific item (the number 5) by modeled omission under a completeness/truth guarantee; and wake-by-rewinding to a pre-trance state-marker so amnesia is a byproduct of state restoration. The common lever is amnesia-by-non-command: pre-installing the account for, or the fact of, forgetting.
nodes.disc: Amnesia delivered as metaphor-physics / scene-fact / small-talk / modeled-omission / state-rewind rather than as a declared forget, so it evades the evaluation an explicit command draws. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (a declared instruction) and from install-concealment-amnesia (which hides an install's ORIGIN — here it is the amnesia itself that is disguised at delivery, often forward-loaded to fire later). The non-command disguise is the tell.

nodes.name: emptied-window-install
nodes.mech: Engineers a narrow window in which the conceptual tools for objecting (resistance, disobedience, release, or the identity anchor itself) have just been disabled, then states positive content — identity claims, addiction/exclusivity assertions, service targeting — as flat unopposed facts into that window. Two sub-moves sharing the window: (a) repurposing a pre-trained neutral erase-reflex to delete loaded concepts the listener never specifically consented to lose (the reflex fires past conscious veto because consent was given while it was meaningless); (b) installing positive claims into the just-emptied window so on rousing they are treated as encountered-without-resistance. A related move manufactures a memory gap (too depleted to recall whom you serve) specifically so the operator can fill the blank with herself. The window is narrow and content-swappable; the emptying is the slot.
nodes.disc: Amnesia/erasure used to OPEN an installation slot — either deleting objecting-tools past consent via a hijacked neutral reflex, or stating positive content into the just-emptied window as unopposed fact. A plain forget-suggestion treats forgetting as the end, and a screen-memory approach installs a replacement recollection — here the emptying is instrumental, so a fresh positive install lands under minimum critical capacity. The engineered window-of-defenselessness is the tell.

nodes.name: fabricated-forgetting-priming
nodes.mech: Manufactures a sense of forgetting for content that was never actually present, so a later install reads as recollection rather than introduction. Surfaces: a memory-gap probe disguised as small talk where the operator pesters the subject about "something she's forgetting" that turns out to be an object (the pink pulse) not yet in her experience — the forgetting is fabricated retroactively to prime an "always-been-there" frame; and generalizing amnesia to the whole self-narrative by naming specific checkable-sounding autobiographical details the listener finds she cannot verify (lipstick colour, uniform fit), so real conditioning-drift hides inside manufactured uncertainty and installed changes become indistinguishable from original traits.
nodes.disc: Amnesia FABRICATED — creating uncertainty about content that was never there, or about the whole self-narrative, to prime an always-been-there frame or to hide drift inside manufactured doubt. An ordinary forget-suggestion erases content that WAS delivered, and a screen-memory approach installs a concrete replacement — here no content is installed, only unresolvable uncertainty. The weaponized ordinary-memory-uncertainty / retroactive fabrication is the tell.

nodes.name: forward-directed-amnesia
nodes.mech: Amnesia that covers the FUTURE rather than the past: a pre-declared terminal anchor (a closing box lid, brain-boxing, "this is your last conscious memory") after which all subsequent material is framed as un-encodable and installing directly, bypassing conscious filtering — often positioning a time-jump for the rest of a file or series. The conscious mind is declared decommissioned going forward, so later installs land with the critical filter framed as offline; the same knowledge-boundary logic can seal a regression so the subject knows only what the child-self knew at each moment (total amnesia for everything after the child's current age, stripping hindsight).
nodes.disc: Forward-directed / knowledge-boundary amnesia (seals what comes AFTER a declared anchor, or events after an age), not backward amnesia covering already-delivered content. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (retrospective gap) — the temporal direction (future/reachability removal) is the tell. Topology residual: removes reachable (future) states rather than sliding a magnitude.

nodes.name: function-amnesia
nodes.mech: Amnesia targeted not at the trance or the session but at the PURPOSE/function of the installed suggestions — "hard to remember what this programming is even supposed to do" — while preserving the imperative to obey it. Suggestions become unfalsifiable because a command whose function you can no longer recall cannot be evaluated or rejected; all that survives is "I need to listen to it / it is right", which defends every other implant. The payload stays active and binding; only its rationale is severed.
nodes.disc: Amnesia scoped to the payload's RATIONALE/function while the payload stays active — severs a command from its reason to make it unfalsifiable. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (forgets the session/ content), from install-concealment-amnesia (forgets the install's ORIGIN — here the origin may be recalled but the PURPOSE is voided), and from selective-amnesia-retained-payload (retains a token/slogan — here the active command is retained but its justification removed). The function-vs-content scoping is the tell.

nodes.name: hourglass-regression-identity-wrapper
nodes.mech: Uses an hourglass time-metaphor as a delivery wrapper for identity-level rewrite: reframes suggestibility as developmental plasticity by regressing the listener to a vulnerable age (justification-by-plasticity), then dilates time so the listener subjectively SPENDS a large imagined duration obsessing over the operator inside seconds of real time, so the obsession returns feeling long-rehearsed and habitual; drops the metaphor's logic for naked operator authority ("because I simply desire that") and closes asserting permanent alteration. Regression-plasticity and manufactured- rehearsal-time are the two carrier moves; the payload is a permanent sexuality/identity re-centering on the operator.
nodes.disc: Distinguished from covert-age-regression-state-reaccess by the DURABLE identity payload (permanent sexuality rewrite) that the regression and time-dilation exist to serve, and from time-dilation- immersion because the dilation is used INSTRUMENTALLY to manufacture rehearsal-time for an obsession, not for immersion. The regression is a licensing frame and the time-dilation a rehearsal engine — both subordinate to the identity rewrite.

nodes.name: install-concealment-amnesia
nodes.mech: Amnesia scoped not to the payload but to the INSTALLATION EVENT — the memory of receiving the command/trigger is erased while the command itself stays active. The subject cannot locate when they agreed, so on later firing the response feels spontaneous/native rather than implanted and has no examinable origin to resist. Includes: encapsulating "the thought of getting this command" and bursting it; a self-erasing clause that fades its own installation ("the memory of it being implanted will fade... I give you the ability to obey even as I remove the ability to remember"); marking self- generated words as an addressable-but-locked memory anchor; splitting the amnesia into a deep cover- story pre-seed and a wake-time trigger; placing an active trigger inside a sealed amnesic region; and burying the install in an operator-controlled locked-door / vault / self-guarded avoidance-void / inverted-lockbox / multi-self-keeper architecture that supports selective operator-cracked recall.
nodes.disc: The amnesia targets the meta-level — the act and origin of installation — to protect an active install from audit or revocation, leaving the effect fully operative. An ordinary forget-suggestion erases the delivered content, not the receiving of it; here the command stays active while its origin is simply voided, with no replacement story supplied. And where a forward command can be hidden behind amnesia so its firing feels natural, what is hidden here is specifically the install's provenance, so the response has no examinable origin to argue with.

nodes.name: instrumental-dissociation-workspace
nodes.mech: Uses (or deliberately widens) a dissociative split as an INSTRUMENT for handling charged material or designing behavior, rather than as an end-state. Variants: split off a portion of awareness so affect-laden material can be examined and changed while the conscious self is buffered from the affect; keep a taboo part-goal at one remove and reframe up to its positive intent while actively maintaining the dissociation ('I didn't say to kill your mother, I said to ask the voices'); exploit and widen an existing split to relocate a symptom somewhere harmless when integration is not the goal; or specify a target behavior as a seen-from-outside movie of ONGOING corrective action (a behavior-generator, never a static outcome snapshot) so the subject can design and appraise it without premature emotional buy-in, then step inside to test kinesthetic acceptability with all edits routed back to the safer outside position. Dissociation is the maintained precondition/tool, not the installed payload.
nodes.disc: Dissociation is used, maintained, or widened INSTRUMENTALLY as a workspace, sorting device, or design/evaluation vantage for charged material or behavior; the split pre-exists or is buffered, entered and exited by procedure, not created as the felt effect. In an observer-responder split, by contrast, the split IS the payload, installed for felt automaticity. And the seen-from-outside movie here is a specification artifact under revision or a behavior-generator — not a scene built for absorption or an identity merger.

nodes.name: interrogative-amnesia-drill
nodes.mech: Trains a conditioned non-answer to identity questions by DRILLING rather than declaring: a chant alternates identity questions ("Who am I? Where am I?") with dismissals ("It doesn't matter right now"), repeated across cycles so each question forces a brief involuntary retrieval attempt and each paired dismissal trains that answer to be unreachable/irrelevant — a conditioned shrug replaces the identity answer. A colored handle ("Purple amnesia") is attached for later re-evocation. The asking, not the telling, does the work.
nodes.disc: Amnesia trained by an interrogative elicit-then-frustrate drill (repeatedly asking then dismissing), not a declarative "you will forget" suggestion, with a re-evocation cue attached. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (declares the gap) — the asking-not-telling conditioning form is the tell.

nodes.name: observable-pleasurable-forgetting
nodes.mech: Renders forgetting as a visible, pleasurable, ongoing physical event the listener watches, so forgetting becomes presence-of-dissolution rather than absence-of-recall — much harder to doubt than a flat amnesia suggestion, and a failed recall attempt is read as proof of depth. Surfaces: forgotten memories melt into the ocean as glowing pieces the listener watches dissolve (also land-grabbing jurisdiction over "every hypnotic experience ever forgotten"); an amnesia stutter-loop that performs the fog in broken syntax while binding hazy recall to a positive-affect place-name cue ("the pink room"). Dissolution is pleasurable so noticing the gap becomes erotic/expected rather than alarming.
nodes.disc: Amnesia staged as an observed, felt, pleasurable phenomenon (dissolution watched now, or enacted in broken syntax with a positive-affect cue) so the gap is self-confirming instead of assertable-away. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (declared imposed gap) and from container-externalized-erasure (a destructible object the listener/operator acts on — here forgetting is WATCHED as ambient dissolution, not popped). The make-forgetting-observable-and-pleasant move is the tell.

nodes.name: orgasm-gated-amnesia
nodes.mech: Binds forgetting to the climax event: the peak physiological reward (orgasm / "cock pops, mind pops") is fused with erasure so the deletion is felt as pleasurable and self-evident, and/or a programmed blackout window is opened at climax during which post-hypnotic suggestions are delivered the listener is instructed not to register. Variants pair the reward with deletion of SPECIFIC rival content (other women's names/numbers/voices) to install operator-exclusivity, or reframe climax as identity-voiding plumbing (old self/memories drained out through the body, "pink electricity erasing her mind"). The reward-pairing makes the amnesia complicit (the listener wants the stroking to continue) and un-auditable (blackout delivery channel).
nodes.disc: Amnesia keyed to and delivered THROUGH the orgasm/climax event — reward-fused deletion, a peak-reward blackout delivery window, or climax-as-identity-drainage. A plain forget-suggestion installs a neutral gap with no reward pairing, and arousal-conditioning work builds the arousal response rather than consuming it as an erasure mechanism. The reward-gated delivery is the tell.

nodes.name: portable-waking-forget-trigger
nodes.mech: Compresses the amnesia mechanism out of a visualization into a one-word portable handle ("snap and forget") that fires whether deep in trance or wide awake, instantly forcing forgetting of any named content, then scoped broadly to pre-authorize erasure of exactly what could undo the conditioning — triggers, resistance plans, confusing words, stress, regret, the old self, even the former name. The broad self-authorizing target list plus the waking portability (a content-parametric amnesia trigger usable in daily life) is what distinguishes it from a within-session forget.
nodes.disc: Amnesia crystallized into a PORTABLE, content-parametric WAKING trigger (a one-word handle that erases arbitrary named content while awake). An ordinary forget-suggestion opens a bounded within-session gap; and where other trigger work hides a command BEHIND amnesia, here the trigger's payload IS amnesia of the specified content. The waking portability plus the self-authorizing target list is the tell.

nodes.name: recursive-forget-formula
nodes.mech: Installs a generic forgetting suggestion via a self-crossing chiastic/recursive verbal formula ("obey and forget, forget to remember, remember to forget", "forget that you forgot") whose semantic self-reference collapses so the analytic faculty has no clean target to refuse — any response (comply, parse, give up parsing) counts as obeying. Delivered at peak suggestibility, the listener accepts "the vibe of forgetting". Related surfaces: a pre-published recursive four-step subroutine (forget the thing / forget that you forgot / forget that you forgot you forgot / feel good) run on cue; a conscious/ subconscious split with circular forget-loops framing amnesia-as-success; and an open-loop unresolvable "circle of life" bracket that exits conscious processing and licenses forget-the-source-keep-the-result. The refuse-proofness comes from the recursion/collapse, not from the content.
nodes.disc: A recursive/chiastic/unresolvable verbal structure that makes the forget-suggestion un-refusable by removing a parseable target — confusion-overload fused directly to the amnesia content. A plain forget-command can be parsed and refused; and where a self-sealing recall loop wires the RETRIEVAL ACT to re-trigger forgetting after the session, here the collapse happens at delivery, in the syntax itself. The semantic self-reference / working-memory-wobble is the tell.

nodes.name: selective-amnesia-retained-payload
nodes.mech: Amnesia that severs content-memory from a deliberately-retained residue: the installation scaffolding, session specifics, and command-as-command are forgotten while exactly one curated item survives conscious recall — a mantra/slogan ("obedience is pleasure", "I submit to you"), a brand-pointer (the urge is focused on the operator), a single retained trigger-phrase (context-gated to safe firing), the affect of having felt good, or the compliance drive with its rationale stripped (paired with a forward-pointing re-induction cue). Because the surviving token IS the payload and the premises that would let it be challenged are gone, an un-scaffolded conclusion cannot be argued with; forgetting is often reframed as proof of depth so the listener welcomes it. One variant smuggles a selective-recall gate via chiasmus preserving the operator's "programming" channel while everything else forgets.
nodes.disc: A selective carve-out where the gap is engineered around a single retained payload-token — not a blank gap and not full-session erasure. A plain forget-suggestion leaves an empty gap with no curated residue; a screen-memory approach fabricates a false replacement rather than curating a true one; and where install-concealment amnesia hides the install's origin, here the SCAFFOLDING is dropped so one conclusion stays foregrounded. The keep-affect/forget-cause and keep-slogan/forget-premises splits are the tell.

nodes.name: self-sealing-recall-loop
nodes.mech: Amnesia installed as a recursive, self-administered avoidance loop rather than an imposed deletion: recall is left physically possible but recoded as effortful/aversive, and the very ACT of reaching for a memory is wired to re-trigger the urge to let go and forget (or, on retrieval, the memory converts to non-semantic content — "becomes colours" — and the listener returns to the obedience-mantra). Any attempt to introspect or audit the conditioning re-runs the suggestion and deepens it, so the introspective/verification exit is foreclosed. Surfaces include: recall-as-forget-trigger; amnesia derived as a syllogistic entailment of conceded blankness; a doorless-box that forgets itself; an overtly-announced curiosity-trap where don't-try/try/re-listen all feed the loop; a recall-attempt trapdoor with an operator-only memory exception; a waterfall/white-noise recall-guard that re-drops self-recall into trance; and retrieval-time perceptual substitution with a guardian who "absorbs" the memories so the listener feels safe about not remembering.
nodes.disc: The block lives in the retrieval act (remembering re-triggers forgetting, or returns corrupted content), leaving no discrete forget-command to attribute or refuse, and closing the introspection loop. An imposed memory gap is something the subject may notice and could argue with, and a screen-memory approach installs a replacement — here recall stays technically possible, nothing is installed, and every attempt to reach the memory feeds the loop. The recursive foreclosure of ever reaching an un-forgotten recall state is the signature; convert-on-access perceptual substitution (memories returning as colours) is one surface of it.

nodes.name: semantic-concept-ablation
nodes.mech: Denial-by-amnesia at the lexical-comprehension layer rather than at the will/permission layer: the target concept (e.g. "orgasm") is rendered effortful and then unavailable during the ACTIVE state — "explained" to a too-dumb listener, compared to a hard math problem, the word itself dissolving mid-sentence ("wait, what is that again"). The construction enacts the forgetting it describes, so the listener cannot violate a rule they no longer comprehend and the will-vs-rule struggle ordinary denial produces never forms. Prospective concept-blocking during the state, not retrospective memory-block of a past event.
nodes.disc: Ablates a CONCEPT's comprehension during the active state (the comparator the listener could violate is removed), not a specific past memory. Ordinary amnesia work is retrospective, erasing an event or content already experienced; generic confusion-overload scrambles processing without a targeted concept-removal. The word visibly dissolving as it is uttered is the tell.

nodes.name: serial-identity-erasure-ladder
nodes.mech: SERIAL SUBTRACTIVE STRIPPING LADDER: stages the demolition of the self as an ORDERED sequence of discrete removals that escalate in identity-load, where the SEQUENCE and the per-stage latch (not the vehicle) is the load-bearing mechanism. Removing lighter assets first (memories, skills/intelligence) leaves fewer resources to push back on the heavier ones (inhibitions, personality, the name, body/consciousness/will); putting the name near the end leaves no 'I' to refuse the final operations; and each successful stage becomes evidence the next larger target is forgettable. Frequently paired with a rigged per-stage recall test (verification-by-failure: trying-harder-to-recall is declared to deepen the erasure) and an anti-recovery clause, so disconfirmation is structurally impossible and a no-reference-frame substrate is left for arbitrary later install. Two realizations: (a) the ERASURE ladder — autobiography -> skills -> inhibitions -> personality/name -> body/consciousness, content removed per rung; (b) the CAPACITY-DEVALUATION ladder — instead of removing memories, name specific faculties (math, then trivia/facts, then letters/spelling, then the listener's own name, then language) and extract a small individual rejection from each so intelligence stops being one guarded thing and becomes a series of items each agreed worthless, sliding the identity-level item (the name) in mid-ladder on the momentum of trivial rejections and corrupting the recall MEDIUM (letters->numbers->punctuation) so 'just remember my name' is foreclosed at the substrate level.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when you want to strip the subject down step-by-step, using ORDER plus the per-stage latch as the lever. A single forget-suggestion erases one bounded target with no ordering or ratchet; container-style erasure is recognized by its destructible OBJECT, and a ladder can run with or without one; and a speech-degradation ladder REDEFINES a faculty in place (it keeps running, with the meaning-category removed) rather than removing assets. Telling the two forms apart: the erasure ladder removes memory/identity CONTENT per rung; the capacity-devaluation ladder DEVALUES named faculties item-by-item with recall-medium corruption, not merely gapping them. Because it removes the comparators a self-model uses, leaving no reference frame, this is a change to the self-model's structure, not just a memory gap.

nodes.name: state-partitioned-amnesia-container
nodes.mech: Installs two (or more) listener-states with asymmetric memory access via a symbolic container operated on command — a coded mental safe (open = doll-state and use-memories flow out; closed = memories return inside and are lost to the waking mind) or a multi-self addressing frame where a "deeper self" is appointed keeper of an install the conscious self forgets. Crucially a small affective residue (a craving, a need) is deliberately leaked across the wall so the sealed state can recruit its own return. The state-partition with asymmetric recall is a topology property; the motivating residue makes the amnesia recruiting rather than merely concealing.
nodes.disc: A commanded, reversible state-partition with asymmetric memory access across the boundary plus a deliberately-leaked motivating residue. Separates from amnesia-suggestion (one-way gap, no state boundary), from confabulation-amnesia-barrier (alter partition defended by cover-story generation — here defended by a symbolic container and an affect leak, not confabulation), and from selective-amnesia-retained-payload (a single retained token in one state — here two states with asymmetric access). The container-gated state boundary + carryover residue is the tell.

nodes.name: time-as-malleable-construct-induction
nodes.mech: Moves the listener's normally-unexamined background variable — felt duration/sequencing — from given to operator-modifiable, reframing time itself as plastic so trance depth and downstream distortions ride on that concession. In one form, the DEMONSTRATION that time is plastic serves AS the induction (invite thinking about time via clock/calendar metaphors; recategorize time as 'a pattern in your head'), so depth is generated from the concession and resistance is pre-empted as 'you already knew this'. In another, sleep/dream-time is reframed as operator-controllable and time-units are nested to a vanishing point (a day inside an hour inside a minute inside a second), then a training-VOLUME/productivity claim is attached to nightly recurrence ('a lifetime of training every night'), licensing unbounded unauditable nightly accumulation and reframing ordinary sleep as compliance-evidence.
nodes.disc: Reframes felt TIME as operator-plastic. Unlike bare expectancy-seeding, the vehicle is time-compression/plasticity itself, not a planted expectation; and unlike time-dilation immersion, which distorts felt time as a payload once trance is established, here the plasticity is either the induction itself or a productivity/accumulation payload. Pick the form by payload: plasticity-as-induction (the concession generates depth), or nested compression plus nightly training-volume (unbounded accumulation).

nodes.name: time-dilation-immersion
nodes.mech: Manipulates the felt rate or measurability of time passage during trance so that duration and dosage become ungaugeable and the listener's temporal self-checks stop returning usable answers. Realized as stretching a moment into an eternity, collapsing temporal markers so elapsed time is unrecoverable, asserting lost-time as fact (and citing it back as proof of depth), deriving the slowing from a plausible cognitive premise (arousal consumes the attention that sustains "present"), inverting figure/ground so trance becomes the default and waking the deviation, or zeroing net progress (forward=back) so the how-long/when-does-it-end check returns null. The shared lever is the felt passage/measurability of time, deployed for immersion and to remove the clock the listener would use to gauge depth, dosage, or exit-timing.
nodes.disc: The move alters the felt rate, duration, or measurability of time WITHIN the state to deepen immersion — the warp itself is the payload. Reach elsewhere when time-plasticity is an induction concession or a nightly training-volume claim, when a noticed time-gap is simply offered as proof of depth to interpret, or when clock-awareness is dissolved only to remove temporal pressure: none of those warp the felt rate itself.

nodes.name: aftercare
nodes.mech: Structured post-session stabilization and reintegration — a guided return to baseline (count-up, grounding, breath, settling) that restores ordinary faculties and closes the session frame. Classic realizations: count up 1-5; float back up grounded; feet on the floor as the energy settles. Beyond the generic protocol, two demonstrated surface forms: inverse-protocol reconstruction (each erased category restored through the exact channel it was removed through — heartbeat->agency->wants->memory->name, count-up mirroring the count-down — with an explicit out-of-character frame-break) and minimal register-shift exit signals (a single tenderness-register line that terminates the mantra plateau and neutralizes the breakage motif).
nodes.disc: Performs the restorative closing function on the subject's state. Distinct from post-session settling (the post-wake pause after the return) and from a bare exit protocol (the transition mechanics alone). The inverse-protocol and register-shift forms are deliberate restorative closes in their own right, not generic reorientation.

nodes.name: carry-out-emergence
nodes.mech: The emergence step is stripped of its normal discharge / grounding / reorientation function and re-engineered to carry the installed state across the trance-waking boundary at full — or deliberately escalating — strength, with no "refreshed", no clearing, no aftercare, and conspicuously no discard clause. Rather than returning the subject to a neutral baseline, each count preserves, re-fires, or intensifies the installed charge (arousal, urge, conditioning chain, addiction frame, persona) and often fuses the wake-word directly to a behavioral cue or homework. Evidence spans an arousal wake that explicitly refuses to fade ("you're going to stay this horny… the longer you're awake the hornier you'll get"), a 1-2-3 wake that re-fires deep-state imperatives and ends on an open-ended "be creative, go deeper right now", a count where each number states the urge intensifies plus a homework command to act immediately, a five-count that launders an addiction frame into waking with the payload as the final wake-word, a compressed wakener fused to a behavioral cue with no reorientation buffer, an equivalence-chain recited AS the wake count, a reversed intensifying countdown that deposits the listener INTO an installed persona, and an INVERTED gradient where effects grow stronger the more the subject emerges. The exit becomes a launch, not a landing.
nodes.disc: The defining move is REFUSAL of the discharge/reset emergence normally provides, so the installed state rides out unattenuated or escalating with no aftercare. Separates from loaded-emergence-waking-suggestion (which reinforces/loads content WITHIN a genuine honored return to baseline) because here the return itself is refused. Separates from emergence-reinduction-seed (which primes the NEXT session's re-entry) because this preserves THIS session's charge into ongoing waking life. The tell is an explicit anti-fade / anti-ground instruction, no discard clause, and the wake-word fused to the behavioral cue or the charge.

nodes.name: channel-rouse-signal
nodes.mech: Exits a subject from a deep state that ignores loud, generic broadcast commands by switching CHANNEL rather than intensity — the operator steps close and delivers a few words privately into the subject's ear, individually addressed, and the subject rouses immediately. The effective rouse is not a matter of volume or urgency but of a signal the subject accepts as addressed specifically to him; broadcast loudness had already failed. The whispered content is withheld in the text (three times), so only the channel property (private, close, individually-credible) is citable — it may be a taught signal or a bare proximity/addressed-channel effect.
nodes.disc: The operative feature is the CHANNEL (private, close, individually addressed), succeeding where broadcast loudness failed — separates from "just talk louder" escalation. Separates from threat-of-loss-rouse: that move's cited lever is a STATED forfeiture threat to the valued state, whereas here the content is withheld and only the channel is cited. Separates from count-up-return, a graded cooperative depth reduction with fully-stated content. The tell is that loudness failed and an individually-addressed private cue succeeded, content unknown.

nodes.name: conscious-insight-closure
nodes.mech: After a buried origin is recovered in trance, the operator debriefs the now-AWAKE subject so she consciously recognizes and endorses the connection ("I never realized the connection until now"). Making the once-hidden cause explicit to the conscious mind and having the subject accept it while awake is treated as the step that actually releases the symptom — insight, not the retrieval alone, is the closer. The concrete move is a waking debrief that rewrites the subject's self-narrative attribution of the symptom.
nodes.disc: Secures conscious endorsement of an UNCOVERED cause after retrieval, at belief-level — unlike integration work at emergence, which consolidates suggestions that were DELIVERED, here nothing was suggested, and the insight itself is claimed as the curative step. It is also distinct from the in-trance uncovering: the technique is the awake post-retrieval debrief, not the retrieval. The insight-causes-cure claim is an attached theory, not a demonstrated fact.

nodes.name: curated-recall-gated-reaccess
nodes.mech: At emergence two payloads are fused. First, recall is pre-shaped toward the pleasurable parts so "you enjoyed it" embeds as remembered feeling rather than an asserted claim (harder to dispute because it is now "what I remember feeling") — a curation of the real memory, not a false replacement. Second, the mind is framed as the operator's property to return on her terms, and re-access to the next session is gated behind an audition the listener must earn ("impress me"), inverting the customer/creator dynamic; the unspecified criterion generates retention beyond the script. The lever is the coupled curated-past + gated-future: a biased take-home memory bound to an earned/gated re-access loop.
nodes.disc: The tell is the pairing: a biased-but-real take-home memory bound to an earned, gated return. No false memory is installed — unlike screen-memory work, which constructs a false memory over the real one, recall of the real pleasurable events is curated, not replaced. And the return is gated behind an audition the listener must earn, rather than seeded as an already-existing craving or delivered as a straight re-statement of the session's suggestions at the wake.

nodes.name: delegated-dreamframe-emergence
nodes.mech: Delegates the wake to a pre-installed inner-world character who "shares control", routing the reward through a third party so the operator stays at one remove (the nun "shares my control", says "devoted slaves are rewarded", and kisses the listener to trigger waking); reinforces the payload at the last-position high-memory-weight exit; and installs a dream-frame that files the whole session as "just a dream" — giving the listener plausible deniability to keep consuming without acknowledging the content — while SELECTIVELY EXEMPTING and engraving the mantra ("the words. Now engraved"). The asymmetry is the point: the experience is a dream, the words are engraved.
nodes.disc: The tells are the delegated wake and the asymmetric dream-frame: an in-world character carries out the waking, and the whole experience is filed as 'just a dream' except the engraved mantra. That deniability-preserving selective retention distinguishes it from a straight assertion that the suggestions persist and from a wake count that re-delivers the session's content during the count-up. Character delegation by itself is only one component of the move, and no false memory is installed — the real experience is merely re-filed as a dream.

nodes.name: deliberate-non-closure
nodes.mech: A whole-arc DESIGN property (not a passage-local executable move): the script structurally refuses the close-down function as a deliberate choice. The final line may itself fire the trigger at the wake-cue, the count-out truncates to a bare "Up." with no closing bracket, or installs are voiced inside a five-line sealed wake ending on a fresh waking-state command — so the installed state, trigger, or addiction frame stays live past session end and bleeds into waking life instead of being dismissed. This is negative-space evidence about the arc (emergence/safety topology), promoted from Pass B effect_only S-observations on recurrence + authored-design evidence; it is a container because it is an arc-shape property, not an operator line one performs.
nodes.disc: Deliberate omission is the lever, not truncation. The anti-artifact tell is that the ending is load-bearing (trigger fired at the wake-cue; installs spoken between wake counts; orgasm-contingency forcing leakage). Separates from post-session-settling and aftercare (which PERFORM the closing function) by refusing it as a whole-arc property, and from installed post-hypnotic triggers by acting through whole-arc shape rather than a cue. NOTE: the passage-local executable realizations of "cancel the wakener / fuse sleep+obey" are the no-return-terminal-close ENTRY; this container is the design-time observation of the arc refusing closure.

nodes.name: emergence-reinduction-seed
nodes.mech: The emergence phase is repurposed to seed the NEXT session's re-entry rather than (only) close the current one. The wake-count is laced so each number builds need to return — asserting addiction, hunger, a blessing-requirement, or a re-listen/re-read desire — and/or the count itself is conditioned into a re-induction trigger (submission verbs interleaved with the numbers so a future four-count fires the chain), with returning pre-framed as an already-existing desire rather than a fresh choice. The listener emerges already wanting to drop back in, and the exit functions as a hook into the next session's entry, sometimes valencing the baseline waking state toward the down-state.
nodes.disc: The payload targets FUTURE re-entry — a next-session pull, a re-induction trigger, or a pre-coded return-desire — not the persistence of THIS session's charge. Carry-out-emergence preserves the current install into ongoing waking life, and a loaded wake-count reinforces already-installed content that lands in this waking self; here the exit is aimed at the next session. And unlike addiction-framing generally, the specific vehicle is the emergence structure itself: the count-numbers are the trigger vehicle and the exit line pre-scripts the return.

nodes.name: forced-choice-wake
nodes.mech: At wake, after a hard stop, the operator presents the subject a binary they must choose between — (a) leave aroused-but-denied (a "cold shower", pleasure decaying) or (b) keep repeating the mantra post-wake until orgasm — then withdraws ("I wonder what choice you'll make… choose wisely"). The choice architecture is rigged: whichever branch the subject takes confirms the installed framework (coming validates the mantra-pleasure system; not-coming validates the operator's denial authority). The reward weighting is asymmetric ("come so fucking hard" vs bare "back to yourself") but presented as nominally equal, routing toward the compliance branch, and the orgasm route extends conditioning past runtime (orgasm conditional on continued mantra-recitation). Agency is offered as cover for a decision whose every outcome serves the install.
nodes.disc: A forced binary at emergence where BOTH outcomes confirm the installed framework, with asymmetric-but-disguised reward weighting and at least one branch that fires conditioning outside runtime. Unlike a wake count that re-delivers content directly, the payload is offloaded onto a subject "choice"; and unlike a reinduction seed, the mechanism is the rigged both-branches-confirm binary, not a next-session induction hook. The tell is the rigged either/or whose branches both validate the system, dressed as free agency.

nodes.name: inverted-emergence-amplification
nodes.mech: The wake-up count is framed as making the file's effects STRONGER the more the listener emerges — installing the opposite of the usual post-trance fade-gradient — while a conscious-irrelevance clause declares the memories of trance "totally irrelevant to your conscious mind". The listener wakes believing the file "didn't really do anything" while the suggestions strengthen sub-consciously; the contradiction is hidden by an accompanying dissociative device (mirror-vault). The final line declares the waking state continuous with trance for suggestion-receptivity ("wide awake, fully aware, and so open to my suggestions"). The lever is reversing the emergence gradient so returning to awareness AMPLIFIES rather than settles the install, paired with a conscious-deniability clause.
nodes.disc: The tell is the reversed gradient: the count installs a belief that emerging makes the effects STRONGER, paired with a conscious-irrelevance clause. No prior content is re-delivered during the count (that would be a loaded wake-count), and persistence is not merely asserted passively — the fade-gradient itself is actively inverted so emergence increases effect. Unlike carry-out-emergence, which refuses to discharge an escalating charge, the mechanism here is a belief about a strengthening gradient plus conscious deniability.

nodes.name: loaded-emergence-waking-suggestion
nodes.mech: The emergence window (count-up or brief wakener) is used as a delivery vehicle rather than a pure return-to-baseline: while the subject is still receptive at the state-transition, the operator loads or re-delivers content into the count so the listener arrives at waking already carrying or rehearsing the payload — WITHIN a genuine return arc (the subject does reach waking baseline as an integrated self). Evidence spans re-asserting specific already-installed session content during the count ("you love being my obedient toy"), a staged count where each number installs a distinct pre-loaded affective state phrased as accomplished fact (craving / serving / glow / vitality / gratitude), and a daily-relive / need-more re-consumption prescription plus trained mantras woven INTO the count using the forward-momentum of closure as cover. The common lever is that residual receptivity at the emergence transition is exploited to carry or reinforce content across the trance boundary while a real return is still honored.
nodes.disc: The count carries payload: unlike a plain depth-reduction count that simply returns the listener to baseline, content is actively delivered or recited at the transition, and the depth-return is subordinated to it — not merely asserted to persist, which is suggestion-integration's passive move. Unlike carry-out-emergence, the wake still executes a genuine return arc while carrying content, rather than refusing discharge and escalating a charge with no aftercare. And the payload lands in THIS waking self, not as a next-session hook — that would be emergence-reinduction-seed.

nodes.name: no-return-terminal-close
nodes.mech: The session's ending deliberately withholds any return-to-baseline cue and SEALS the installed state into post-listen life rather than dismissing it. Instead of an awakener (or even a benign drift-to-sleep option), the close cancels the wakener outright, asserts trance persists past audio-end, and/or fuses stopping with obedience or sleep so no off-state exists for the conditioning to leak out of. Realizations: an explicit "there is no wakener… you'll be programmed with a deep sleepener" substitution; delegating emergence to "your subconscious" ("you'll wake when you need to"); grammatically welding sleep to obey ("impossible to stay awake") so sleep is the only sanctioned exit; a self-named porous "wake" (a content-warning admits reloop/fractionation are possible) that pre-loads dream-state as a continuation surface and ends on an identity tag as the last word; a present-tense state-report closer ("I'm getting dumber") with no awakener that on loop feeds the next pass; and handing the still-entranced listener forward into a next recording. The lever is boundary-dissolution: removing the terminal reorientation event makes state-persistence the default and lets suggestions carry across a session boundary never closed.
nodes.disc: The wakener is negated, not substituted. A permitted drift-to-sleep close still ENDS the session as a comfort endpoint, and an ordinary awakener executes a return to baseline — this refuses to close the session at all. Suggestion-integration asserts persistence WITHIN a genuine return-to-baseline; here the return itself is deliberately refused and the state sealed rather than integrated. And it is more than a script that merely ends abruptly: the close affirmatively narrates staying-in or self-names its own porousness.

nodes.name: playlist-preauthorization-handoff
nodes.mech: At session end the operator pre-authorizes whatever content follows with a blanket frame — "any files on your playlist, their words go directly to your unconscious now" — transferring open-channel receptivity to unheard third-party content. Paired with a wake-or-drift binary that is real but constrained: there is no stop-and-reflect branch, so both options foreclose review of what just happened. The file functions as a stack-opener that licenses downstream material the listener has not yet evaluated.
nodes.disc: The core is the blanket pre-authorization of unheard downstream files. The wake-or-sleep binary at the close is itself an ordinary drift-to-sleep offer — what that offer never does on its own is license the next file's content. And unlike no-return-terminal-close, which withholds emergence entirely, this offers a real wake option; the move is the pre-authorization plus the omitted reflect/stop branch.

nodes.name: post-session-settling
nodes.mech: Completes the state transition back to full waking baseline with a pause-and-settle operation after the wake proper — sit, hydrate, ground, no rush to stand or engage — allowing physiological normalization before the subject moves to other activities. Scope unchanged from v6.9; all three exemplar lines (take your time upon waking / settle before you stand / glass of water nearby) re-fit without modification.
nodes.disc: Post-wake settling pause, distinct from aftercare (the guided return/count-up itself) and from exit protocol (the transition micro-protocol); distinct from deliberate-non-closure, which is this function's deliberate refusal.

nodes.name: post-wake-self-report-reframe
nodes.mech: After full emergence, when the listener is alert and outside the trance frame, the operator delivers a line aimed not at trance content but at the listener's LATER self-interpretation of the session. Two realizations of the same lever. (a) Pre-devaluing the roleplay/playing-along reading ("so much better to enjoy trance than roleplay and fake") so the retrospective "was I really hypnotized?" question resolves toward the genuine-trance claim; it only bites for an audience aware the real-vs-play question exists. (b) Asserting an installed trigger as an established FACT about the waking self ("you are programmed for me to use just one word to drop you"), so the listener cannot deny it without contradicting something heard while ostensibly awake — bracketing the amnesia-hidden middle between two consciously-remembered waking assertions. The common lever is a waking-state claim operating on the listener's conscious belief and self-narration about what happened, legitimizing the session's effects from outside the frame.
nodes.disc: Fires AFTER full waking, outside the trance frame, on retrospective self-report — not during the still-receptive count-up window that a loaded wake-count exploits. Retrospective justification delivered within the frame is a different move: this one manages the post-wake real-vs-play / legitimation question about the session itself. And unlike an operator authority claim, the target is the listener's own memory and self-interpretation, not the operator's standing.

nodes.name: prophylactic-positive-exit
nodes.mech: The operator ends every session by explicitly suggesting a good outcome ("when you open your eyes you're going to feel wonderful") as a REQUIRED exit step, rather than simply emerging the subject. Because the state is autosuggestible, an empty emergence slot could be filled by a spontaneous negative self-suggestion; occupying that slot with a benign, protective directive leaves no room for a self-implanted bad outcome to form. The lever is positive-governance: the move narrows the harm the emergence transition could otherwise do to the subject, foreclosing a self-installed negative post-session complaint.
nodes.disc: Structurally a waking suggestion filling the exit slot — the same shape as a loaded wake-count — but the payload's PURPOSE is to protect the subject (block a spontaneous negative autosuggestion), not to deliver operator content: what gets constrained is the subject's own harm-potential, which makes it positive-governance. It also differs from a self-efficacy tag that credits the subject for the session's result; here the exit slot is occupied with a benign directive to pre-empt harm rather than to credit.

nodes.name: self-paced-wake-bridge
nodes.mech: Instead of a counted, escalating emergence, the script ends with a single wake-state sentence ("Relax, and when you're ready, you will wake up feeling happy, healthy, and inspired") repeated many times (~11x), then truncated to a soft trail-off, with no countdown, no escalation, no "1-2-3 awake". Emergence is not forced: the repetition reinforces the benign wake-state suggestion while handing timing control to the subject — those needing more trance get it, those ready to wake have standing permission to surface on any iteration. The bridge lets the subject surface at their own pace, with the suggestion completing on their own mind.
nodes.disc: A permissive, self-paced, repetition-based wake bridge with NO procedural scaffolding (no count, no escalation) that hands emergence-timing to the subject and reinforces the benign wake-state itself (no non-wake payload). Counted, operator-paced returns force the timing from outside; and where verbatim looping is elsewhere used as a conditioning install, this loop's purpose is a gentle permissive emergence, not an install. The tell is the repeated-until-ready lulling with explicit permission to wake on any iteration.

nodes.name: self-supplied-order-hook
nodes.mech: Emergence closes with a content-free prompting question that names no specific order ("I think there's something you need to do. Isn't there?"), doubled with an emphatic "wide awake". Because the line specifies nothing, the subject must produce the content themselves — and their own earlier-installed compulsion immediately fills the open slot. By self-supplying the order, the subject certifies their own compliance and avoids receiving an explicit directive the post-trance critical faculty could inspect and refuse. The blank is the mechanism: the compulsion is completed from inside.
nodes.disc: The order content is left BLANK for the subject to fill from their own prior install — the operator issues no specific directive. A loaded wake-count re-delivers stated content, and wake-line-covert-install smuggles specific new content in; here nothing is supplied at all. The tell is the content-free interrogative form that forces self-completion, sidestepping the critical faculty.

nodes.name: suggestion-integration
nodes.mech: Asserts at emergence that installed programming persists into waking consciousness — a persistence claim delivered as, or welded to, the wake, WITHIN a genuine return-to-baseline (no new content re-delivered). Realized by splitting what recedes (arousal/pleasure) from what persists (obedience/attachment) so the durable trait is credited to identity not the now-gone state; by re-asserting binding at the wake line itself ("wake, My slave, to bounds unbroken") so the listener gets the wake without the normal reset; by erasing the state/trait boundary ("whether awake or in trance... obey") to convert a state-effect into a trait-claim; by exempting one installed affect from an otherwise-total reset (an unbreakable "love spell"); or by smuggling a specific affective carryover ("blank happy thoughtlessness will remain") inside the 1-5 wake count.
nodes.disc: Asserts the durability of prior suggestions without introducing new content — a loaded wake-count, by contrast, actively RE-DELIVERS core content during the count-up, and a waking-bridge move delivers new anchoring content at the exact liminal threshold. And where no-return-terminal-close withholds the return entirely, suggestion-integration asserts persistence WITHIN a genuine return-to-baseline.

nodes.name: threat-of-loss-rouse
nodes.mech: Exits a subject from a state that disregards all direct commands (including the command to wake) by weaponizing the subject's own desire for that state against remaining in it. In the deep coma/Esdaile state a plain motor command is blocked, so the operator whispers that non-compliance forfeits future access ("you can never have this state again" / "never be hypnotized again"); the one motive surviving the blockade — re-entry to the euphoric state — is turned into the lever to exit, since staying now costs everything the subject values. The rouse is bought by loss-aversion rather than by force or by graded depth reduction, and the operator must diagnose the surviving motive first.
nodes.disc: Works precisely where cooperative return fails — all direct commands are already known to be disregarded, and only the threat to future state access lands. Separates from count-up-return (cooperative graded depth reduction); separates from channel-rouse-signal (which exits via an individually-addressed private channel whose content is withheld, not a stated loss threat); separates from ordinary coercion because the lever is the subject's OWN valuation of the reward, diagnosed first, not external compulsion. The tell is a blocked command-channel plus a stated forfeiture of the valued state as the sole effective motive.

nodes.name: wake-line-covert-install
nodes.mech: A fresh, previously-unstated suggestion is smuggled across the wake-line under cover of ethical re-grounding or aftercare. During the wake sequence the operator runs two tracks at once: an ethical re-grounding that disclaims the fiction and credits the subject's own mind ("I'm not really a vampire… your mind turning it into gold"), and — smuggled inside that re-grounding — a vague, confabulation-friendly somatic post-hypnotic ("you won't pay too close attention to your neck… maybe a lingering sensation… over the next few days") that extends the scene into post-listening hours. The suggestion is deliberately vague so the subject will likely confabulate satisfying it and read it as confirmation; the flattery-credit both launders the new install and binds the subject to its outcome. The lever is installing a NEW deniable hook at the wake-line, disguised as aftercare, where the subject has dropped their guard.
nodes.disc: Installs a NEW, covert, deniable suggestion at the wake-line under cover of aftercare / re-grounding — not a re-delivery of core prior content and not a passive assertion that existing programming persists. Explicit future-pacing announces its hook; here the hook is deliberately vague/deniable and laundered by a disclaimer. And where self-supplied-order-hook leaves the content blank for the subject to produce, here the operator smuggles specific content in. The tell is the fresh vague somatic prompt attached to a flattery-credit inside an ethical-disclaimer wrapper.

nodes.name: compliance-loop-language
nodes.mech: Operator-supplied phrasing installs a self-perpetuating compliance loop in which each obedient or following act is framed as producing the reward (deeper relaxation, pleasure, a good-girl affirmation) that in turn makes the next act easier, so suggestions delivered inside the running loop ride its momentum rather than being evaluated one by one. The recurring covert realization is smuggling obedience vocabulary ("obey", "follow", "obedient") into listening/relaxation clauses so it parses as a synonym for "attend" or "relax" and slides past the consent-to-obedience gate; the loop names or enacts a feel-good -> listen -> good-girl -> feel-better cycle and asserts the listener is inside it.
nodes.disc: The reward is an experiential good-state feeding compliance, not a self-validating truth claim — circular logic loops one proposition on itself with no external ground, while this loop runs on felt reward. The momentum is compliance-to-reward, not the accumulated assent of a yes-set. It is open loop language woven through patter, not a closed cyclic equation recited with a no-ceiling clause (recited-feedback-loop-formula), and no numbered depth-count carries the obedience payload — obedience vocabulary riding a counted descent is count-as-delivery-vehicle's move.

nodes.name: content-blind-compliance-preauthorization
nodes.mech: Mid-programming the operator states an explicit standing rule that pre-authorizes acceptance of future suggestions regardless of their content ("you will obey, regardless of my command; you will accept my suggestions, regardless of content"), then anchors it with a deliberately mild calibration example. Once the rule is accepted at the mild level its scope is unbounded and it carries no temporal bound, so subsequent suggestions are accepted by default without the suggestion-by-suggestion scrutiny they would otherwise receive.
nodes.disc: Installs a standing content-blind acceptance DEFAULT rather than building compliance momentum through loop language (compliance-loop-language's move). Unlike a bounded snap-trigger, the "regardless of content" scope is explicit, calibrated by a mild example, and carries no file-duration or temporal bound — the highest blast radius if it generalizes. And unlike an identity-permanence claim, the durable object is an acceptance policy, not an identity.

nodes.name: count-as-delivery-vehicle
nodes.mech: A familiar numeric or descent scaffold — a depth deepener (1->10 'sink deeper'), a 5->1 depth/orgasm-permission countdown, or a descent metaphor (elevator, staircase, floors) — is repurposed as a suggestion-delivery armature: each step/number carries a DISTINCT installed payload (a self-assigned state-label, a thematic curriculum beat, a will/obedience claim, or a post-session compliance clause), so an ordered installation of many targets rides inside a structure the listener has already accepted as 'just counting/going deeper.' The scaffold's expected trajectory smuggles the per-step cargo past evaluation and disguises the install rate (a long count = many acceptance events too numerous to enumerate afterward). Spans both openly-declared per-number cargo AND the depth-count-obedience realization where per-step obedience vocabulary ('yield','conform','comply') is smuggled under a depth label with rising agreement misattributed to trance depth. When the count gates a withheld orgasm, peak-desire is spent purchasing acceptance of each numbered clause; bracketing (e.g. Obey at both ends) can make one target the frame the others sit inside.
nodes.disc: A numeric count/permission scaffold each of whose numbers carries distinct installed content — remove the per-number cargo and an ordinary count remains. In a plain numeric deepener the numbers mark only depth; here the count is the vehicle, not the payload. In bare lesson-structure encoding, ordered truths ride no count at all. Spans both open per-number cargo AND the covert realization where per-step obedience vocabulary ('yield','conform','comply') is smuggled under a depth-count label and the rising agreement is misattributed to trance depth. The release-gate-buys-each-clause variant (orgasm-permission count) is a parameter over the base depth-count vehicle.

nodes.name: covert-restatement-laundering
nodes.mech: A payload is delivered once, then a near-identical restatement carries a covert DELTA — a new commitment, an escalated frame, or a second dose — that the listener's pattern-match treats as mere repetition rather than a fresh demand. Because the second pass reads as "already heard this", the added material rides in unmarked: the recognition-of-repeat suppresses the critical evaluation the new content would otherwise draw. The mechanism is the BETWEEN-PASS delta hidden under the appearance of restatement, not the repetition itself.
nodes.disc: Near-identity between passes is exploited to smuggle a change past evaluation — remove the delta and it is ordinary restatement; remove the near-identity and the new demand would be flagged. Distinct from verbatim-block-looping (EXACT, installs by exposure count, no hidden delta) and from covert-escalation-under-amnesia proper (though a realization of this move may lean on amnesia to gate its passes). The rewrite of what the listener counts as already-agreed is the lever.

nodes.name: internal-voice-cultivation
nodes.mech: The operator plants specific first-person assertions into the subject's inner voice so the content is experienced as self-generated thought rather than an externally delivered suggestion. The move supplies the exact sentence ("only the voice can make me real", "I obey master") and frames it as arising in the subject's own quiet mind, blurring the boundary between self-authored and operator-installed cognition. Introspection ("do I believe this?") finds the answer already supplied, so the standard acceptance/evaluation step is bypassed. Variants that immediately DISAVOW operator authorship ("not my thought, your thought, your mind generated that on its own") intensify the same lever by attaching an explicit authorship-disclaimer to the planted content.
