nodes.disc: The operator plants specific first-person CONTENT experienced as self-generated, and the operator remains the (acknowledged or disclaimed) author. If the listener actively voices and repeats the lines, that is self-recited-first-person-mantra — here the content is planted to feel spontaneously arisen, with no recitation drill. If no operator voice is present anywhere, it is an operatorless first-person script; here an operator is present installing the content. Absorption in the operator's voice generally carries no specific first-person content, and delegating thinking away entirely is a different lever. Authorship-relocation moves manipulate the source-attribution of an already-installed belief; this plants the self-generated-feeling content in the first place.

nodes.name: lesson-structure-encoding
nodes.mech: Encodes multiple distinct target beliefs or commands as an ordered, enumerated lesson/doctrine sequence — numbered truths, catechism triads, numbered "laws", or a saturating declarative block — so the payload is a coherent indexable content set rather than one looped suggestion. The ordering/enumeration is the lever: each item is a self-standing proposition the listener attends and often vocalizes, producing a structured set the operator can later cite, quiz, and reuse. Two amplifiers recur: compelled first/second-person recitation ("repeat after me") that shifts belief-authorship to the listener, and volume/redundancy saturation (dozens of phrasings of one claim defeat point-by-point evaluation) optionally compressed into a self-chanted carrier mantra that re-inflates the full set on recall.
nodes.disc: Distinct enumerated propositions delivered as an ordered lesson set. Unlike layered repetition of ONE suggestion, this encodes several DISTINCT numbered lessons; when a mantra appears it is a compression key over the already-delivered enumerated set, not rhythmic saturation of a single phrase. Unlike internal-voice cultivation, the payload is an ordered external lesson set — the listener-voiced recitation is an amplifier here, not the mechanism. And unlike delivery that rides a counting scaffold, no numeric descent is required: the ordered truths can ride no count at all.

nodes.name: linguistic-deletion-selfsupply
nodes.mech: A family of Ericksonian linguistic moves that delete or nominalize obligatory content so the listener must supply the missing referent from their own current experience to make the utterance cohere. Realized by dropping a required grammatical argument (who/what), freezing an experiential process into a referent-less noun the hearer must re-run, or asserting an unobservable inner state with no evidence trail. Because self-generated content is not audited the way an external claim is, the listener pre-accepts the supplied meaning as their own and the operator gains coverage over — and paces — inner states he cannot see.
nodes.disc: Separates from ordinary vagueness/abstraction for style: the tell is a deleted OBLIGATORY role or a nominalized process the hearer is forced to reconstruct, landing on a subject already motivated to extract meaning. Separates from minimal-constraint-permissive-suggestion (the sibling), which leaves the RESPONSE open by omitting prohibitions or using a channel-neutral verb rather than deleting content the listener must fill. Separates from any assertion move that supplies content outright — here the listener authors the specifics.

nodes.name: minimal-constraint-permissive-suggestion
nodes.mech: Specifies only the wanted positive response and leaves everything else unconstrained — no prohibition to resist, no prescribed modality — so the subject's own resources fill the unspecified gap and self-organize the desired outcome. With no ban to push against, defiance is pre-empted; the under-specification recruits the subject's competence rather than dictating it.
nodes.disc: The content of the wanted response is stated here — what is deliberately left open are the response's boundaries (what else may happen, which modality). That separates it from deletion-based phrasing, which deletes obligatory CONTENT the listener must reconstruct. Two realizations: the broad strategy of stating only the positive anchor and omitting all prohibitions, and the lexical instance of a permissive channel-neutral verb ("sense color" not "see color") leaving the modality open. Leaving the response modality open is not voice absorption.

nodes.name: multivariable-state-yoke-forced-avowal
nodes.mech: The operator drills an explicit if-then chain that yokes three independent state-variables into a single dial ("the more you focus on chastity, the more sleepy and obedient; the more sleepy and obedient, the more aroused"), so attention, compliance and arousal can no longer be moved independently — resisting compliance requires giving up arousal, and pursuing arousal deepens compliance. The move is completed by extracting a forced first-person identity claim ("I am [the assigned persona-name], sleepy, obedient treasure"), making the listener the speaker of the binding, not just its hearer.
nodes.disc: Separates from mere syntactic co-listing of states by the explicit if-then chain yoking THREE variables plus a forced first-person avowal; from compliance-loop language because it mathematically welds independent variables into one dial and forces the listener to voice the binding, rather than building compliance momentum in operator language; and from identity-labeling because the identity claim here is the seal on the three-variable yoke, not a standalone label install.

nodes.name: pedagogical-reframe-conditioning
nodes.mech: Every conditioning escalation is dressed as mundane classroom discipline — spelling the target word ten times on the board, "spanking for your own good", "rewrite your research paper", "stay after class". The disciplinary act's LITERAL content IS the conditioning being installed: the listener rehearses the target word and commits to a re-entry loop as if it were schoolwork, so the trance content is practiced and normalized under cover of familiar teacher authority and "punishment" is read as care. A "do more research / rewrite the paper" loop is folded in as a self-renewing re-entry hook for repeat listens. The pedagogical framing is the lever — it lowers evaluation of the content by relocating it into an ordinary authority relation.
nodes.disc: A framing move that reads conditioning-as-discipline so the disciplinary act's content is the installed target. Separates from literal discipline roleplay (where the discipline is the point, not a cover) and from lesson-structure encoding (there the ordered enumerated truths are the payload — here the payload is the reframe, not an enumeration). Not a behavioral-commitment install: the self-renewing loop is one folded-in clause, and the pedagogical-authority cover doing the normalizing work is the mechanism.

nodes.name: recited-feedback-loop-formula
nodes.mech: The operator states a closed cyclic causal chain (listening -> feeling -> needing -> obeying -> listening) first loosely, then compresses it into a tight verbal formula recited almost as an equation, feeding the loop's output back in as its input. Because each turn is asserted to raise both pleasure and the need to obey with no stated ceiling ("there's no limit"), a single moment of compliance is converted into a runaway self-reinforcing escalator that drives arousal and compulsion monotonically upward and that the listener cannot easily step out of. The loop presupposes the affect it claims to amplify, so it bootstraps off any good feeling already present.
nodes.disc: Separates from compliance-loop language because the load-bearing move is a specific closed-cycle TOPOLOGY recited as a formula with an explicit no-ceiling clause, not open loop language woven through patter; from circular self-validating logic because the cycle binds escalating affect and need (a runaway dial), not a truth claim; from addiction-framing because the engine is a recited feedback equation, not a craving-to-return frame; and from inhabiting a new visualized self because the self-consuming variant reframes identity as fuel consumed by obeying, not a new self to step into.

nodes.name: repetition-to-satiation
nodes.mech: A word or short clause is repeated to the point that its SEMANTIC content bleaches out (semantic satiation), so it stops parsing as language and becomes bare sound. The goal is not to encode the proposition but to DRAIN a token's function — either to strip an aversive charge (clinical defusion), to degrade a live trigger below evaluation so it can't be argued with, or to hold the listener in a derealized fixed state where critical/analytic processing drops. The lever is meaning-erosion by over-repetition, the inverse of encoding.
nodes.disc: Repetition run to DESTROY or suspend a token's semantic function, not to install its content — "a phrase you can't fully parse can't be argued with". Same surface operation as verbatim looping but inverted in purpose. Distinct from confusion techniques, where incoherence rather than satiation defeats parsing — though one variant here (a self-contradicting clause repeated at the decision point) sits close to that line.

nodes.name: self-recited-first-person-mantra
nodes.mech: The operator hands the listener fixed first-person declarative lines ('I am so easily hypnotized', 'I obey master', 'obedience is arousal', 'Hypnosis is MY obsession') and instructs the listener to actively voice or subvocally think them, so operator-asserted content is re-encoded in the listener's own first-person voice. Because the listener performs the claim, authorship is self-attributed and resisting would mean contradicting oneself mid-sentence; the operator often echoes or rewards the utterance to manufacture the felt experience of agreeing with oneself. Delivery surfaces vary (repeat-after-me hand-off, reward-gated recitation, paced-descent inner mantra echoed by the operator, escalating burn-in, interleaved you/me lines never explicitly told to repeat) but the lever is constant: recitation converts received suggestion into self-attested belief. REALIZATION: the payload is often a bare mantra, but the same enacted-self-voicing installs an IDENTITY predicate [<-593 self-voiced-identity-adoption: an asserted equation moved into first-person self-voicing (is-YOUR -> is-MY), doubled and drilled ('Again.'), so a transient state hardens into a self-owned identity via self-perception through enactment - the listener KNOWS they are repeating operator content; the adoption works through the act of self-attribution].
nodes.disc: The listener is the ACTIVE producer of operator-supplied content - voicing it aloud, sub-vocalizing it, or writing/inscribing it, on a loop - with an operator present who hands or mandates the payload; the self-production re-encodes the content in the listener's own voice and bypasses the defenses external commands trigger. DECODE absorbed: 593 = an enacted overt identity handoff (is-your -> is-my) drilled until the trait registers as descriptive. Separates from internal-voice-cultivation (396 - content PLANTED to feel spontaneously arisen, listener does NOT actively produce it), from operator-voice-absence (12 - no operator present anywhere), and from verbatim-block-looping (operator-delivered repetition). The load-bearing act is the LISTENER's own vocalization/inscription (remove the listener producing it and the move loses its anchor); the payload's grammatical person is incidental. A permanence payload a chant may carry is adjudicated in permanence-declaration, not here.

nodes.name: totalizing-attribution-law-frame
nodes.mech: Numbered imperative "laws" are seated as fixed etched symbols (obey all commands; your purpose is to serve/please; you always want more programming), and law two is expanded with a totalizing attribution clause: any behavior — "even in abstract ways" — is retro-scored as serving the operator, so no reachable behavior falls outside the frame's scope. Law three closes the loop by making consumption of further files a programmed desire, and recruitment (sharing the programming with others) is folded in as virtue, making the frame self-extending and outward-recruiting.
nodes.disc: Separates from plain numbered-command lists and from ordered lesson-set delivery by the self-extending "everything counts" attribution clause: the load-bearing feature is not the ordered set of laws but the open-ended retro-scoring rule that leaves no behavior outside scope. And where total-permeation framing always stays internal to the subject, the "share my programming with others" clause recruits outward, past the subject entirely.

nodes.name: behavior-chaining
nodes.mech: ASSEMBLE a multi-step behavior sequence by reinforcement, exploiting that each link's stimulus is both conditioned reinforcer for the prior response and SD for the next. Forward chaining reinforces step 1 to criterion, then withholds until 1+2, then 1+2+3 (total-task is the every-step-every-session variant); backward chaining pre-completes all but the last step, reinforces only the final step, then rolls backward, so every trial ends contacting the terminal natural reinforcer; a probe-and-skip/leap-ahead variant skips already-owned links while reinforcement still demands the whole sequence in order. Assembly DIRECTION (forward vs backward) is a structural/binding-time difference. FACETS absorbed: (chain-junction-fusion) deliberately engineers a junction so one cluster's terminal response becomes the SD for the next cluster's first response, fusing unit boundaries into one fluent sequence; (facilitative-chain-reinforcement) the intra-chain maintenance contingency where each completed step is reinforced by making the NEXT step available, so long self-guided chains hold together without external reward per link; (maintenance-probe-silent-extinction) periodically probes the ENTIRE chain to detect silent decay of mastered early links (which forward chaining stops actively reinforcing) before it collapses the chain, converting an open-loop 'mastered=stays mastered' assumption into a closed loop.
nodes.disc: Reach for BEHAVIOR-CHAINING to build or maintain a multi-step SEQUENCE (vs shaping, which refines a single response). Forward tell: a reinforced prefix grows front-to-back; backward tell: links added in reverse, terminal reinforcer contacted every trial; probe-and-skip tell: skipped steps still must be performed for reinforcement. The junction-fusion, facilitative-maintenance, and whole-chain-probe facets are build/maintenance parameters of one chaining program. Its OPPOSITE-direction moves — surgically severing one link, or collapsing a chain by removing the terminal payoff so decline cascades backward — are behavior-REDUCTION and live under reinforcement-extinction (chain-structured suppression), not here.

nodes.name: conditioned-reinforcer-manufacture
nodes.mech: Transfer reinforcing VALUE to a neutral or natural stimulus by repeated tight-contiguity pairing with an already-effective reinforcer, so the paired stimulus can then maintain or select behavior on its own AS A CONSEQUENCE. FORMS: an automatic self-reinforcer (a word emitted just before an existing reinforcer, so the subject's own production becomes self-reinforced); a precision event-marker bridging the response-to-reward delay (an invariant conditioned clicker fired at the instant of a correct approximation, enthusiasm expressed by enlarging the treat, never the marker — marker-invariance preserves its information value); a natural social reinforcer strengthened to carry behavior after artificial tokens are withdrawn (praise yoked to token delivery). GENERALIZED facet (generalized-conditioned-reinforcer): back a token with a WIDE, varied menu of currently-effective backups so it retains value across shifting satiation/deprivation states and across individuals with different preferences (motivation-independence), and protect that value by monopolizing the physical means of token production (a special pen/hole-punch/card available only to the operator) so no unearned token dilutes the supply.
nodes.disc: Reach for CONDITIONED-REINFORCER MANUFACTURE when you need a stimulus to acquire reinforcing FUNCTION and fire as a CONSEQUENCE that selects or maintains behavior (a marker, a token, a self-reinforcing word). Choose it over: respondent/evaluative pairing (which elicits an involuntary reflex or transfers a biasing VALENCE onto a choice target — here reinforcing function is delivered as a consequence, not affect elicited); an antecedent cue evoking a state (a covert anchor — this is consequence-side). The generalized facet's tell is BREADTH of the backup array as the source of motivation-independence plus supply-channel control as the value-integrity move; marker-invariance (scale the treat, never the marker) preserves information value.

nodes.name: differential-reinforcement
nodes.mech: Change a behavior's rate by reinforcing SOMETHING OTHER than the target behavior in its problem form — its own absence/low-rate, an incompatible or alternative response, or a richer concurrent option — rather than removing all reinforcement (extinction) or delivering it free (NCR). One parametric technique across schedules (DRO/DRL/DRI/DRA + concurrent-choice); the schedule chosen sets which 'other' behavior earns reinforcement. Realizations: (DRO) reinforce the target's ABSENCE — momentary DRO samples only at an interval's end (trades suppression strength for monitoring cost), VI-DRO uses an unpredictable window, finite-license/coupon forms convert an unspent budget to bonus; a leak-guard form conditions delivery on absence of the WHOLE undesirable set and/or shortens the interval so a co-occurring substitute is not adventitiously reinforced; (DRL) reinforce the behavior's own occurrence only when its count stays at/under a criterion (spaced-responding DRL gives per-response reset feedback; interval DRL is a weaker two-stage form), keeping a desirable-in-small-doses behavior alive, optionally with a depleting token board; (DRI — differential reinforcement of incompatible behavior) reinforce a topographically INCOMPATIBLE competitor (silence vs noise, slack vs taut leash) that cannot co-occur; (DRA/FCT — functional reinforcer rerouting) a distinct deployment: a functional assessment identifies the maintaining reinforcer, then an alternative behavior is engineered to produce the SAME reinforcer more efficiently (teach a sign/card/'break' request; DNRA delivers escape for the alternative while the problem behavior gets escape extinction; an effort-undercut form makes the alternative cost less response effort); (graded concurrent choice) stage several concurrently-signaled options with graded payoffs (problem behavior pays worst but still works, task pays best) and raise the demand for the best over time; (rate-differential allocation) two concurrent schedules where the alternative pays richer/faster/more reliably so allocation shifts per the matching law, out-competing rather than blocking the problem behavior.
nodes.disc: Reach for DIFFERENTIAL REINFORCEMENT when you want to reduce (or replace) a behavior by paying SOMETHING ELSE — its absence/low-rate (DRO/DRL), an incompatible competitor (DRI), a same-reinforcer alternative (DRA/FCT), or a richer concurrent option — while keeping some reinforcement flowing. Choose it over: extinction (removes the reinforcer entirely, no alternative paid); NCR (delivers the reinforcer free on a time schedule with no behavioral contingency). Internal deployment fork: DRO/DRL reinforce the TARGET's own absence/low-rate; DRI/DRA reinforce a SEPARATE response class (DRA additionally requires a functional assessment and preserves the identified reinforcer, rerouting it — the one facet with a meaningfully distinct precondition); concurrent-choice/matching arms retain a degraded payoff for the problem behavior and win by relative payoff, not withholding.

nodes.name: precommitment-rule-governed-stakes
nodes.mech: Bind the FUTURE self in advance, during a low-temptation window, by restructuring the contingency so the later self cannot easily defect — pre-committing an irreversible act or a pre-set stake whose anticipated outcome (a rule-governed analog) controls present behavior across the delay a literal operant contingency could not bridge. FORMS: (future-self-precommitment) perform an IRREVERSIBLE or costly-to-reverse act while a tempting smaller-sooner reward is still temporally distant and discounted below the larger-later outcome (locking the cigarette case, early-month payroll savings, Odysseus at the mast), removing or penalizing the future impulsive choice before temptation peaks; soft pattern-over-days commitments are the same mechanism at a longer horizon; (self-imposed-penalty-commitment) pre-arrange a fixed penalty ( to a friend) on any day the target behavior fails a criterion, with a TRUSTWORTHY THIRD PARTY holding the stakes so it is non-self-waivable; (rule-governed-delayed-stakes) pre-commit a sizable, somewhat-delayed aversive tied to a behavioral limit (forfeit money to a despised cause for exceeding a cap; avoid a fine by exercising by midnight), a despised recipient sharpening the stake.
nodes.disc: Reach for PRECOMMITMENT / RULE-GOVERNED STAKES when you want to control a LATER behavior by binding the future self NOW — an irreversible act or a pre-set non-waivable stake set before temptation peaks, working across a delay. Choose it over: self-instruction/self-cueing (which supplies an antecedent that EVOKES the next response — precommitment FORECLOSES or penalizes the choice, foreclosure vs evocation being the structural line); self-administered contingency (which relocates the ongoing measurement-consequence ADMINISTRATOR role into the subject — precommitment arranges ONE future contingency, not an ongoing loop); an in-the-moment refusal / willpower act (precommitment is a separate act done in advance on the contingency structure). Facets differ by irreversible-act vs external-stakeholder-penalty vs delayed-aversive-stake.

nodes.name: motivating-operation-engineering
nodes.mech: Bring a response under MOTIVATIONAL rather than prompt control by shifting the momentary VALUE of a consequence BEFORE the response is evoked, then evoking the response that obtains it. Value moves UP by an establishing operation or DOWN by an abolishing operation (satiation); nothing is delivered — only the momentary value is engineered, raising or lowering the rate of every behavior that reinforcer maintains. The primary fork is CAPTURE (exploit a value change the environment already supplied) vs CONTRIVE (produce one on demand). Realizations: (captured motivating operation) watch for collateral behavior signalling an object's value spontaneously rose and insert a teaching trial at that potent moment; (transitive mand gate-block) present item A that makes item B instrumentally valuable, then block access to B and teach the unblock response — a transitive conditioned MO via a standing means-end relation plus operator-controlled access; (chain-interruption evocation) interrupt a running chain at the point a needed element is missing so the incompletion spikes motivation for the repair mand (the interrupt-the-chain transitive-CMO route); (MO-override of stimulus control) push an MO high enough that an in-repertoire behavior generalizes beyond its trained SD, broadening the range of evoking stimuli with no new training; (conditioned motivation by pairing) pair a neutral cue with a motivating state / reinforcer / aversive until the cue alone reproduces the value-altering effect — a SURROGATE CMO manufacturing wanting (appetitive) or avoidance (aversive), the operator selecting valence by the correlation history. Satiation/aversion overshoot is the failure mode.
nodes.disc: Reach for MOTIVATING-OPERATION ENGINEERING when you want to change how MUCH a consequence is worth right now (raising or lowering the rate of all behavior it maintains) WITHOUT delivering anything — an antecedent value move, decided via the capture-vs-contrive fork. Choose it over: direct reward conditioning (which DELIVERS a reinforcer contingent on an act — this pre-sets its worth); chain-collapse's satiation route (the abolishing-operation twin used to DEVALUE-and-suppress — MO engineering here establishes value to EVOKE); respondent/evaluative pairing (which elicits an involuntary reflex/affect — the surrogate-CMO pairing facet here produces a value-altering MO, i.e. manufactured wanting/avoidance, not a triggered response). The mand facets of verbal-operant teaching TEACH the ask; this engineers the value the ask rides on.

nodes.name: noncontingent-reinforcement
nodes.mech: Deliver the maintaining reinforcer on a fixed-time schedule INDEPENDENT of the behavior, so the reinforcer the problem behavior used to produce is now free on the clock and the behavior loses the motivation to produce it. In the escape variant, breaks from a demand are handed out pre-emptively on a fixed-time schedule before the subject acts out, decoupling escape from misbehavior so the task is experienced as interruptible-by-default (compliance rises, disruptive escape falls). ABSORBED GUARD (ncr-competition-discrepancy): for NCR to actually suppress, the free source must OUT-COMPETE the earned one — increase amount/quality and densify the schedule so it exceeds baseline rate, and typically pair with extinction; if free and earned reinforcement merely MATCH, the subject keeps working for the earned one and NCR does nothing (the named failure mode).
nodes.disc: Versus extinction (removes the reinforcer) and DRO (reinforces omission); the tell is the maintaining reinforcer is still DELIVERED but on a time schedule with no behavioral contingency. The escape variant's tell is that the free reinforcer is scheduled task-removal, not an appetitive item.

nodes.name: reinforcement-extinction
nodes.mech: Reduce a behavior by breaking the response-reinforcer contingency: once the maintaining reinforcer is identified, arrange the environment so the behavior no longer produces it, so with no payoff the rate declines toward its pre-reinforcement baseline. Nothing aversive is delivered — the lever is removal (not punishment), and partial reinforcement undermines it. The move spans every reinforcer channel and carries its own integrity rules: withhold a positive reinforcer with no alternative; enumerate and withhold ALL maintaining sources at once (one live source only thins the schedule and can leave the behavior intact); block escape so a negatively-reinforced response no longer terminates the aversive (escape extinction); restate the contingency flatly and disengage to deny an attention/conflict payoff; break the contingency at the sensory channel when the reinforcer is the behavior's own self-produced sensation (sensory masking). Route targeting through a functional assessment ('just ignore it' is the named anti-pattern) so the identified reinforcer is the one cut. Anticipate the extinction burst and hold the line consistently through it (relenting reinforces an intensified response); optional accelerants engineer extra evoking occasions to raise non-reinforced trial density, titrate a caregiver's tolerated ignoring duration upward so the procedure is actually sustained, and guard NCR delivery timing so a scheduled free reinforcer never coincides with a just-emitted problem behavior. PROCEDURAL FIDELITY: hold the contingency steady through the predictable side-effect cascade (burst, response variation, spontaneous recovery, resurgence, emotional/aggressive outbursts) treating these as expected, and critically do NOT let an emergent burst topography contact reinforcement — caving to an escalation trains a new, worse behavior to do the old job (topography substitution is itself the consistency failure). CHAIN-STRUCTURED SUPPRESSION (breaking a chain via its reinforcer structure): (chain-link severing) pay the LATE response of a two-response chain unconditionally so the intermediate stimulus stops predicting reinforcement and loses SD/conditioned-reinforcer value — only the EARLY link decays, surgical vs broad suppression; (chain collapse) strip the value of the chain's TERMINAL payoff so decline cascades BACKWARD through every upstream link — an extinction route (withhold the terminal consequence, the most immediate breaker) or a satiation route (an abolishing operation devalues it — the same abolishing-operation move as motivating-operation engineering).
nodes.disc: Reach for EXTINCTION to reduce a behavior by REMOVING its maintaining reinforcer so the rate declines to baseline (no aversive delivered). Choose it over: punishment (delivers an aversive); noncontingent reinforcement (still delivers the reinforcer, free on a schedule); differential-reinforcement rerouting/DRA (preserves the reinforcer and redirects it to a sanctioned channel); differential reinforcement of absence/low-rate (reinforces omission, not full removal); graded-support-withdrawal / transfer-of-control (there withdrawal is engineered so the GAIN persists; extinction removes support so the response dies); motivating-operation engineering (the chain-collapse SATIATION route here is its twin — extinction WITHHOLDS the payoff, satiation DEVALUES it). The chain-structured facets split by whether one link is surgically severed (unconditional late-response payment) or the terminal payoff is removed so the whole chain cascades backward. Variants also split by reinforcer channel (positive / escape / attention / automatic-sensory) and by integrity/acceleration rule (complete-enumeration, burst-integrity, trial-density, graduated-ignoring, NCR timing-guard).

nodes.name: self-management-self-administered-contingency
nodes.mech: Relocate the measurement-and-consequence machinery of a contingency INTO the subject, on the premise that the self is the one agent guaranteed present everywhere — extending contingency management into private events and settings no external agent can follow. Spans from bare self-observation (which changes behavior by reactivity alone) to a full self-run consequence loop. REALIZATIONS: (self-administered-contingency) the subject self-selects task and reward, self-monitors completion, and self-delivers the reward — a self-contract collapsing all four roles (integrity resting on honest self-monitoring), an accuracy-matching contingency (reinforcement for MATCHING an independent observer's record — reinforcing correct self-observation), or a self-scoring loop against an answer key with a self-delivered consequence; (two-response-self-management-split) the genus framing — emit a SEPARATE controlling response that manipulates a variable of the target function at a PRIOR time-point when the competing reinforcer is weak, converting an intractable in-the-moment impulse into a tractable earlier engineering problem; (self-monitoring-reactivity) bare observe-and-record with NO added consequence, where the act of measurement alone shifts the rate (and yields an ABC baseline); (self-recording) install a recording act contemporaneous with the target (tally, chart on the mirror) so the mark itself becomes an immediate discriminative/consequating event, with an accuracy-matched-to-observer training variant that thins the external check until the subject records accurately unsupervised.
nodes.disc: Reach for SELF-MANAGEMENT / SELF-ADMINISTERED CONTINGENCY when the CONTINGENCY-ADMINISTRATOR role (measure, and consequate or just observe) relocates into the subject, running as an ongoing loop the subject drives. Choose it over: precommitment / rule-governed stakes (which arranges ONE future contingency / binds the future self by a stake — this transfers the ongoing administrator role); self-instruction/self-cueing (which relocates the ANTECEDENT/cue, not the measurement-consequence loop); operator-outsourced conditioning loop (where the operator OWNS the framing and reattributes the subject's self-generated reward to themselves — here the subject genuinely self-administers, autonomy intact). Facets span reactivity-only (observe/record, no consequence) through full self-contract; the accuracy-matching variant trains correct self-observation rather than the behavior itself.

nodes.name: shaping-successive-approximation
nodes.mech: Build a not-yet-existing response by differential reinforcement that walks a moving reinforced window toward a terminal behavior: capture and reinforce the slightest movement toward target, then withhold from it and pay only a closer approximation while priors extinguish, so the modal response inches forward in the smallest viable steps (gradualness is load-bearing; on deterioration drop back to the last successful approximation — the dip-and-recover signature confirms it working). The criterion can move along any dimension (threshold, tolerance-window, or a rate parameter moved one axis at a time). Realizations and parameters: FRONT-HALF (setup) — (bootstrap entry point) selects the STARTING behavior, an already-occurring in-repertoire fragment seized rather than induced, solving 'can't reinforce what never happens'; (baseline-anchored initial criterion) computes the numeric STARTING schedule parameter from the subject's measured baseline (first interval/criterion at or just below baseline mean) so existing behavior contacts reinforcement immediately instead of the contingency collapsing from too-sparse reinforcement. BACK-HALF (progression) — (performance-band criterion setting) makes the advancing criterion a FUNCTION of the subject's own recent performance band (an explicit percentile formula k=(m+1)(1-w) recomputed over the last m responses, or error-rate-keyed relax/raise one dimension at a time, or graded constant/proportional/performance-yoked thinning), placed inside the achievable range and advanced in performance-gated steps so reinforcement stays earnable (a static winnable-ceiling DRL sub-form sets the bar once inside the band so one slip does not extinguish effort). SESSION MANAGEMENT — (reinforcement-density pacing) keep the learner working the whole session at a high reinforcement rate (idle only while consuming the reinforcer, closing with a free-reinforcer goodbye) so the behavior stream stays dense enough for the differential-reinforcement engine to operate on. Companion design contrast: shaping holds the antecedent constant and differentiates the RESPONSE, whereas stimulus fading holds the response constant and shifts the antecedent.
nodes.disc: Reach for SHAPING when the target response does not yet exist and must be built by moving a reinforced window across successive approximations of ONE response — including its setup (which behavior/number to start on), its progression (how the criterion advances, keyed to recent performance), and its session-density management. Choose it over: behavior-chaining (assembles a multi-step SEQUENCE, not one response); prompt-fading/transfer-of-control (an external support carries the response then is faded — shaping uses no added support); stimulus-side fading (grades the antecedent's form while holding the response). Its criterion-placement rules decide WHAT EARNS reinforcement — a different job from reinforcement-leak-proofing, which decides that nothing ELSE pays.

nodes.name: unconditional-antecedent-consequence-logging
nodes.mech: The operator records each targeted antecedent and consequence whenever it occurs, UNCONDITIONALLY — regardless of whether the target behavior accompanied it — alongside the behavior, using interval or frequency sampling on a coded form. Because the antecedents/consequences are logged unconditionally, the protocol supplies the base rates needed to later compute genuine contingency rather than mere co-occurrence, and surfaces events in close temporal proximity to the behavior. It is a measurement-recording protocol, not a present-state manipulation.
nodes.disc: The tell is unconditional logging (events recorded whenever they occur, behavior or not), which is what enables base-rate computation. Distinct from co-occurrence-only ABC recording (logs A/C only when the behavior fires, so it cannot compute contingency) and from functional-analysis-arrangement (which manipulates variables experimentally rather than passively recording).

nodes.name: authority-diffusion-plurality
nodes.mech: Restructure the operator's AUTHORITY SURFACE so there is no single hypnotist to push back against — the rebuttal target is removed rather than defended. VARIANTS by how the surface is dissolved: (a) diffusion/plurality [authority-diffusion] — personify operator functions into simultaneous figures each escalating (resisting one leaves the others working), linguistically pluralize self-reference ('my voice'->'the voices'->'our voices') so rebuttal migrates to 'them' and the listener's own inner voice is enrolled, or offload onto a listener-populated imagined group of trusted friends who carry the speech so the operator disappears as source; (b) descend-to-peer [operator-as-fellow-conscript] — the operator repositions into the listener's OWN relational slot (a peer or a prior output of the process: 'Master made me a brainwashed brainwasher', a fellow-victim harm-reduction voice, a chorus of already-processed peers relaying for an absent apex) and derives leverage from RENOUNCED authority; (c) mask-as-parity [parity-masked-asymmetry] — exercise a real dominance asymmetry while presenting it as parity/alliance/shared-victimhood/onside-confidant so resistance loses its visible target; the gap operates precisely because it is not presented as one. All share the goal-state: no single authority surface to defy.
nodes.disc: Reach for this to make the operator un-resistable by REMOVING the target — go plural/diffuse, descend to peer, or disguise the asymmetry as parity — so resistance has no addressee; the tell is that no membership is offered and no single figure stands to be confronted. NOT social-proof-belonging-enrollment (a happy cohort pulls via belonging), NOT interposed-proxy-agent (a single persistent agent ACTS and issues commands rather than dissolving the surface), and NOT named-source-authority (a single specified higher/borrowed figure — here the operator function is distributed or hidden, not relayed upward).

nodes.name: borrowed-reflex-recruitment
nodes.mech: Borrowed external legitimacy: rather than build credibility/momentum from scratch, recruit an external source the subject already trusts or that is already working, so its legitimacy transfers to the target. The realizations differ by the SOURCE borrowed: (a) borrowed-reflex recruitment — map the session onto an existing fluent REFLEX (nightly sleep as the induction carrier, asserted automatic-because-sleep-is; or the arousal/hypnosis-fetish reflex as motivational fuel), so momentum is inherited not achieved; (b) borrowed-precedent legitimacy — import a likely-real autobiographical MEMORY where surrender was sanctioned and pleasant (surgical anesthesia) and glue the fictional frame to it with a 'this feels so similar' bridge, so the frame inherits the real precedent's legitimacy; (c) borrowed conviction — tie the effect to a state the subject GENUINELY experienced before ('the exact nerve pattern of your previous anesthesia') so belief is cheap; this form also couples a covert graded verification test (towel clips) run before the irreversible step — a separable safety/measurement move; (d) cultural-ritual hijack — borrow a shared time-anchored RITUAL (New Year's resolutions), ruling out adjacent rituals to pin the listener onto the target script, doing the warm-up an induction would; (e) credibility by adjacency — position target suggestions AMONG induction/maintenance suggestions that are visibly already working, transferring their demonstrated efficacy onto the adjacent unproven ones.
nodes.disc: Reach for borrowed legitimacy when something the subject already trusts, experiences, or does can lend the target its credibility or momentum. Expectancy-seeding predicts a coming experience; here an existing source is recruited as engine or sanction. Entailment-laundering builds an accepted MODEL and then cashes the payload as entailed; here a pre-existing reflex, memory, ritual, or already-working neighbor suggestion is borrowed, not constructed. Pick the variant by the source: a fluent reflex (engine), a real memory (sanction), a verified prior state (cheap belief, plus a covert verification test), a cultural ritual (warm-up), or adjacent working suggestions (efficacy transfer).

nodes.name: collective-social-proof-enrollment
nodes.mech: Stage the target end-state as the social norm of an ALREADY-CONVERTED, happier peer collective, so resistance is recast as isolation from a happy crowd rather than defiance of an operator and JOINING becomes the lever. The peer collective can be asserted, grammatical, or observed. VARIANTS: asserted-'we' cohort reporting they're happier (listener framed as last holdout); phantom-chorus asserted as an audible present background pre-seeding the exact mantra phrases (later extraction feels remembered) and carrying the harshest claims deniably; grammatical division of labor (we=identity/belief, you=instructions, I=peer) conscripting the listener into a collective; a long 'join us / our hive mind' peer run under low defense; observed-peer-model tableaux showing the end-state already-lived (chorus, overheard party-girl gossip inverting recruitment into membership-application via scarcity, on-screen montage of happy others); future-tense class-destination [social-proof-identity-destination] showing prior converts and 'you soon will be one of them'; and explicit membership INVITATION into the revealed converted network [conversion-as-belonging] ('my friends talked to Daddy, now they're stupid... join us'). All share the peer-belonging lever; pick the register by how the cohort is presented (asserted/grammatical/observed/future/invited).
nodes.disc: The load-bearing element is a peer COLLECTIVE whose membership/consensus does the work — social proof and belonging pull, not an operator demand, an authority figure, or a reward contingency. Reach for it to make surrender read as joining. NOT authority-frame moves (no authority above; the referent is a peer cohort), NOT observational-modeling-contagion (rate-shift by exposure, no membership offered), and NOT authority-target-dissolution (there the operator descends to peer to dissolve the target; here a happy cohort pulls the listener in).

nodes.name: competence-harvest-installation
nodes.mech: Instead of arguing or teaching a disputed concept, the operator elicits a domain where the subject is expert and automatic (gear-shifting, tire-listening, engine gauges), actively surfaces the subject's own out-of-awareness access to it in real time, then renames that lived experience AS the concept. Acceptance of the familiar, undeniable domain carries acceptance of the concept because it now arrives as the subject's own knowledge rather than the operator's claim; the subject holds the new frame as lived knowledge with no didactic teaching, and the borrowed domain can be extended into a signal channel.
nodes.disc: The operator must actually ELICIT and use a real accessed experience, then rename it — a mere analogy that gets only agreeable chat FAILS (the football control case), and even a metaphor that gets access but is not used falls short. The tell is harvesting a real accessed experience, not delivering an analogy. Separates from concede-the-defended-topic (domain conceded to disarm guarding, nothing installed) — same expert-domain face, different lever.

nodes.name: concede-the-defended-topic
nodes.mech: The operator opens on a genuine shared-identity hook (a real common experience), then explicitly concedes and disclaims the topic the subject is defensively expert in ("it won't be about flowers... you know more than I do... that isn't what you want"), while naming the subject's actual unmet want. Flattering the expertise and surrendering the defended topic removes it from contention so the subject stops guarding it; naming the true want redirects the motivational search inward toward relief, and rapport forms as the suspicion of angling dissolves.
nodes.disc: The tell is the PAIRING of a real shared-identity hook with an explicit surrender of the topic the subject is defensively expert in — not small-talk rapport, not needs-matching alone. Separates from a needs-matched entry offer (matches an offer to a need without conceding a defended domain) and from generic concede-then-reframe (here the concession disarms guarding, it does not set up a reversal). vs competence-harvest-installation — same expert-domain face, but there the domain is harvested to install a concept; here it is conceded to disarm.

nodes.name: manufactured-insufficiency-treadmill
nodes.mech: Grants a small acknowledged success then immediately revokes its sufficiency ("that's it... but you still get distracted don't you... so let's take you deeper"), so each compliance becomes the pretext for going further; the operator owns the standard for "focused enough" / "deep enough", so the listener can never reach a stable "done". Success is spent as evidence of inadequacy, generating continuous downward pressure justified by the listener's own asserted shortcoming — compliance earns more depth, not satisfaction.
nodes.disc: The grant-then-revoke ADEQUACY cycle where success is used as evidence of failure. Distinct from false-bottom deepening, which resets the DEPTH metric rather than the adequacy metric the operator owns, and from endurance compliance (sustained holding, not a moving adequacy goalpost). Not standard progressive deepening. The startle-back disarm ratchet also makes over-compliance the only success path, but the lever there is a sleep-onset startle reflex; here it is an operator-owned adequacy standard.

nodes.name: own-acts-surrender-ledger
nodes.mech: The operator enumerates or annotates the listener's genuine recent acts — purchasing, browsing, fetching a garment, adopting a posture, obeying setup instructions, sustained engagement, even a single compelled motion — and re-labels each as an instance of the target state (surrender, obedience, vulnerability, love, devotion), openly and contemporaneously. Because the cited proofs are the listener's own real behavior they are hard to repudiate; the perceived baseline shifts from zero to already-surrendered, future resistance now feels like self-contradiction (sunk-cost/complicity), and skeptical mode becomes harder to enter. Registers span retrocausal compliance/surrender ledgers, posture-as-consent ratchets, waking-compliance relabeled as automatic-obedience, a compliance act laundered into "natural" baseline desire, a symptoms-to-diagnosis interpretive frame, a single compelled motion re-narrated as a chain of consensual obedience acts, and a lure-reveal that rebinds self-generated pursuit to the operator.
nodes.disc: Requires REAL acts openly annotated as EVIDENCE OF A STATE as they accrue. Separates from presupposed-completion-fait-accompli (history there may be wholly fictive), from press-play-consent-laundering (acts read as consent tokens, not state evidence), and from withheld-frame-reveal (no concealed game; the annotation is contemporaneous). Not a yes-set — this commits the listener to a causal story about just-performed behavior, not to verbal agreements.

nodes.name: preempt-objection-frame
nodes.mech: Objection pre-emption: before the subject can author their own (often resistant) reading of a coming change, hand them a ready interpretation that defuses a SPECIFIC anticipated objection, so the objection it targets never forms. Realization variants: (a) benign-reading preempt — supply the defusing frame directly (position the technique as an additive 'plus' not a replacement; relabel an imposed contingency as a jointly-owned exchange; add an admitted-ignorance disclaimer); (b) trait partition — when the objection is an identity contradiction, partition the disputed attribute so the subject KEEPS the sub-part they value (strategic intelligence) and only drops the part framed as a chore (math/spelling/decisions), pre-disarming the identity objection; (c) mind-before-body binding — pre-empt the specific 'I don't feel rope on my wrists' objection by announcing an ORDERING INVERSION (capture the mind first, derive body-immobilization as its consequence) so physical restraint is read as the visible surface of an accepted mental state.
nodes.disc: Reach for objection pre-emption when you can NAME the specific resistant reading the subject would form and want to supply a defusing frame first. Expectancy-seeding predicts what will happen; this pre-empts a specific objection. Conceding a defended topic disarms by SURRENDERING that domain, not by supplying a reading. Filter-shaping shapes EVERY suggestion to pass an intact veto (a global channel), not a single anticipated objection. Pick the variant by the objection's shape: a general resistant reading (benign frame), an identity contradiction (trait partition), or a somatic-realism doubt in bondage framing (ordering inversion).

nodes.name: startle-back-disarm-ratchet
nodes.mech: Names the familiar jerking-back-awake experience near sleep, then asserts that here the pull-back gets monotonically harder each attempt while letting-go gets easier. This disarms the specific micro- resistance that keeps insomniacs awake (the startle-back): by framing each pull-back as strictly costlier than the last, any attempt to stay awake is reinterpreted as evidence sleep is winning — arousal/ vigilance pushed down with a one-way valve, and over-compliance becomes the success path.
nodes.disc: Targets the specific sleep-onset startle-back reflex and installs an ASYMMETRIC ratchet (pull-back always costlier than the last). Distinct from false-bottom deepening (a depth-ceiling reframe, not a directional asymmetry on a named reflex) and from fractionation (deliberate re-waking; this makes re-waking strictly harder). Only lands if the body is already near sleep onset. The manufactured-insufficiency treadmill also makes over-compliance the only success path, but the lever there is an operator-owned adequacy standard; here it is the sleep-onset startle reflex.

nodes.name: subtractive-fear-label-management
nodes.mech: A SUBTRACTIVE framing move that manages the affective valence of the state's label so the subject's defensive/skeptical schema is never pre-activated — the operator removes stakes or dread rather than building anticipation. Registers: recasting hypnosis from a "condition" (which the subject must have changed, and resists) to an everyday self-occurring "mood" that already shifts many times a day ("how many moods have you had since you got up this morning?"), so being "put into" something loses its alarm; systematically omitting the culturally loaded word altogether, describing only the desired effect ("teach you to relax") so the state arrives unflagged with no cue to attach dread to; and swapping the loaded term for a prestige euphemism ("the Esdaile state") chosen so the esoteric replacement supplies authority-flavored expectancy while stripping the loaded term's dread.
nodes.disc: Subtractive — removes stakes/dread by arguing the change is ordinary, or by withholding/swapping the culturally loaded name, so the defensive schema is denied its trigger. Predictive frame-setting tells the subject what will happen, adding a frame; this removes a label so no frame (including dread) attaches. Credentials-based authority framing makes a credentials claim; here the prestige substitute is only a word swap. And unlike mere euphemism or bedside phrasing, the omission/reframe is systematic and framing-controlled from first contact, aimed at denying a specific fear-word its target. Recast-as-everyday-mood, omit-the-word, and swap-for-prestige are variants of one subtractive label/fear-management move.

nodes.name: withheld-frame-reveal
nodes.mech: A concealed frame, cashed: run the session under a stated benign frame or vehicle the subject accepts, then CASH that accepted cover for an uncovered payload without re-consent — either by disclosing late that it was secretly something else, or by reusing/unmasking the vehicle to license a payload it never openly covered, so the payload reads as continuous with what was already agreed to. Two variants: (a) withheld-frame reveal — DISCLOSE, after compliance/depth/irreversibility has accumulated, that the interaction was a trap/conditioning/capture; the LATE reveal retroactively reclassifies sunk participation as consent and is TIMED where renegotiation is foreclosed (post-restraint/climax/ingestion, max depth, or post-wake); (b) preloaded frame licenses the payload — pre-load a benign-seeming frame/vehicle (a faked anti-hypnosis architecture, an empty legitimizing meta-rule, a neutral entrained oscillator already consented to) and later REUSE or unmask it to justify the payload, so prior acceptance is the lever that makes the later payload non-refusable.
nodes.disc: Requires an accepted benign cover CASHED for an uncovered payload — the acceptance-then-cash asymmetry is the lever. Decoy-frame entry uses a false frame to get IN unresisted, with no payload cash-out. Presupposing the change as already true asserts it upfront, concealing nothing. The own-acts surrender ledger annotates real acts openly as they accrue — no hidden game. Pick the variant by the cash-out mechanism: a LATE disclosure that reclassifies sunk cost (the reveal), or REUSE/unmasking of a pre-accepted vehicle to license the payload.

nodes.name: addressable-construct-building
nodes.mech: The payload is built as a durable, ADDRESSABLE imaginal object — given a location, a route, or a discrete handle-image — engineered for re-navigation and rehearsal AFTER the building moment rather than for present-tense absorption. Addressability is the load-bearing property: in one form, a door bearing the listener's own name is reached through a hallway of installable rooms; in another, three iconic frozen future-self images, sensory-anchored, are 'built before being used' as addressable anchors for a later ritual. Self-authorship of the object generates investment; extensible architecture (many doors / an image chain) implies further installable slots.
nodes.disc: The constructed object is engineered for LATER re-access (addressable, routable, rehearsable) — vs guided-visualization, where the scene is inhabited now and addressability is absent. Unlike faculty-externalization moves that dislocate the analytical mind itself and park it outside as an object, here a new payload is built and given a location. The construct is explicitly built and known-made, with no claim that it was discovered already-present within. And the move ends at construction — no declared extension of the effect into future situations; putting the anchor to USE later is a separate move.

nodes.name: causal-attribution-to-external-agent
nodes.mech: Relocates CAUSATION for an induced state-change onto an external NON-CONSUMED cause the operator names, so the listener's volition has nothing to push against and there is no self-effort to succeed or fail at; because the agent is external and objective-seeming, the effect stabilizes against introspection.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when you want a NON-CONSUMED external cause to own the state-change so volition has no target. Neighboring techniques a writer picks INSTEAD: fictional-substance-agent — an imagined INGESTED/inhaled substance with pseudo-pharmacology, where the consumption act performs delivery (consumed vs non-consumed is the split); fixation-object-agency-displacement — an object credited with the ATTENTIONAL PULL rather than the state-change; state-cause-laundering — supplies a BENIGN/natural false cause to deflect attribution off the operator ('you're just relaxed', nothing is being done to you), the opposite felt-result from 'this external thing is doing it to you'; concrete-externalization-parked-faculty — a place a result is STORED, not a cause that DID the work. The tell for THIS: an external non-consumed agent is ASSERTED AS THE CAUSE ('the agent will do the rest', 'the latex did it', 'you cannot fight a wavelength').

nodes.name: concrete-externalization-parked-faculty
nodes.mech: Reifies an internal faculty (the analytical mind, memory, resistance, bodily agency, or the self- model) as a concrete external object and relocates it out of the body so it can be set aside, watched, contained, or handed off. The parked object remains intact and retrievable in principle; the move quiets or dissociates by giving cognition a spatial 'away' model rather than by destroying, throttling, or attributing causation elsewhere. Variants differ by what is externalized (mind vs memory vs resistance vs body), by portability (carry-case, return promise), by who handles the extraction (listener vs operator-as-physical-agent), and by whether an observer/viewed split is staged, but all share the intact-parked-object surface.
nodes.disc: The externalized object is SET ASIDE INTACT (retrieval implied or explicitly promised), not destroyed (externalize-then-destroy-faculty), not converted into a standing operator-manipulable control device (externalized-operator-control-handle), and not a causation-displacement onto an inert agent (causal-attribution-to-external-agent). Distinct from attention moves that merely direct thoughts to drift away and depart without reifying the faculty as a dislocated object, and from observer/responder splitting, which divides awareness INSIDE the subject rather than relocating the whole faculty outside.

nodes.name: consummation-as-trance-threshold
nodes.mech: Deepens by recruiting the subject's own built-up WANTING as the descent engine, so the drop reads as self-caused and inevitable rather than operator-imposed, foreclosing the 'I was made to' attribution because the subject supplies the motive force. Two realizations (writer picks completion-moment vs ongoing-pursuit): (a) CONSUMMATION threshold — desire is built across the induction until it discharges in one imagined consummatory act (wrapping lips around a finger and sucking, eating a treat), and the COMPLETION of that craved act is DEFINED as the transition/drop; a variant re-narrates the consummation the instant it lands as a trap that already closed (a consume/consumed agency-inversion pun), flipping authorship from 'I chose' to 'I was taken' at the moment of most active visualized choice; (b) SELF-PURSUIT — instead of a completion moment, the listener is made to actively CHASE the descent (a lure flashing ahead, a striptease unclasped one button per depth-increment), so each step deeper is volitional and the forward-wanting IS the deepening; sets up later re-attribution of the self-generated pursuit (laundered into devotion to the operator). The tell for both: a forward-pulling appetite/anticipation object built INSIDE the fiction, not an installed conditioned cue.
nodes.disc: Reach for built-desire deepening when you want the subject's freshly-built appetite (not a number, command, or count) to be the switch — pick the COMPLETION-moment of a craved act or ongoing SELF-PURSUIT of a lure. Distinct neighboring techniques: surrender-release-ritual (symbolic yielding/RELEASE of an objectified faculty powers the threshold, not desire-consummation); an installed conditioned drop-cue (relies on a PRIOR conditioned cue — here the craving is built fresh inside the fiction); arousal-as-deepening-medium and physiological-state-relabeling (arousal is the continuous DEPTH SUBSTRATE, not a discrete consummation/pursuit event); dual-variable-yoking (a coupled second gauge, not the listener's forward wanting). The tell separating this from a plain counted/commanded deepener: completion of, or pursuit of, an appetitive act is the transition.

nodes.name: covert-arousal-weld
nodes.mech: Arousal is bound to a target WITHOUT any asserted conditioning statement — the linkage is smuggled by structural means: a shared verb and matching motor program (a chore verb slid onto a sexual act because the scrubbing pulse matches oral motion, floor -> shoes -> cock), a single overloaded word whose referent silently slides ('cock': own body -> edge-trigger -> a master's cock), a semantic pun collapsing two referents into one repeated phrase ('come to me' = approach AND climax), or a broad-then-narrow assent funnel that carries a specific unconsented pairing in on the back of a general 'yes' (rainbow-of-pleasure assent -> spiral->lust). The listener experiences continuous escalation of one thing, never a discrete linkage they could refuse.
nodes.disc: The tell is the SILENCE of the weld — arousal is bound by motor-isomorphism, referent-slide, pun, or assent-smuggle, never announced. Unlike arousal-cue-conditioning, which DECLARES the conditioned cue->arousal response, no linkage is ever stated here. Unlike transitive-charge-chaining, where emotional charge is inherited across a chain of small inferences, the vehicle here is a shared word / motor-program / assent seam, not an inference chain. And unlike discovery-framing, this is a covert bind, not a retrospective justification.

nodes.name: covert-referent-migration
nodes.mech: The word that names the listener stays fixed while what it points to is quietly moved, or a pronoun slides across a boundary that is never marked — 'her/[the named character]' migrates to 'you' mid-fantasy, 'you' is held constant while its referent zooms from couch-viewer into an in-screen body, 'I obey' is rewritten as 'we obey' as the listener speaks, an operator-built idol is silently re-pronouned from Her to My so the operator inherits it. Because there is no announced switch, the listener's first- person locus migrates without a checkpoint at which resistance could fire; noticing the swap is itself a precondition of resisting it.
nodes.disc: Separates from identity-merger-occupation: that payload is inhabiting a figure; here the payload is the covert pointer-swap itself, which can re-aim a story at the listener, a listener into a screen, an individual into a collective, or a listener's desire onto the operator. Separates from surrogate- identification-delivery: that keeps the referent a distinct other the listener follows; this moves the referent onto/through the listener under a stable surface form. Tell: a grammatical seat (pronoun/referent) is migrated with no marked boundary.

nodes.name: externalize-then-destroy-faculty
nodes.mech: A two-step operation: first reify an internal faculty (memory, rationality, the rival/old self, identity) as an external container or object, then DESTROY that object as a discrete narrated act — pop the bubble, burn the fuel, crumble the machine, sense-deprive-and-imprison the doll. The destruction adds an irreversibility marker the single-step 'let it fade' version lacks, and offloads the impossible act of deliberate forgetting onto two individually-plausible moves (accept relocation, then accept destruction). Frequently a trance-drop or snap is welded to the moment of destruction. Some members extend to destroy-and-replace (the same hardware rebuilt with an inverted function) or destroy-as-fuel-consumption.
nodes.disc: Requires an explicit DESTRUCTION step performed on the externalized object (pop/burst/burn/crumble/dissolve) narrated as irreversible — this is what separates it from concrete-externalization-parked-faculty (object set aside intact, retrieval implied) and from a plain amnesia suggestion (recall suppressed with no severed object). Watching an externalized resistance lose a rigged struggle is a different technique — here the object is destroyed by operator fiat, not by a struggle-trap.

nodes.name: externalized-agent-body-scan
nodes.mech: Runs a progressive somatic body-scan in which the RELAXER is not the listener but an externalized non-self agent — warm jacuzzi jets, the operator's narrated hands placed down the body, a cumulative warmth-vector massage — so the listener is recast as recipient-of-action rather than actor. The scan grafts arousal onto relaxation (a parked stimulator, co-listed arousal/obedience, a genital-skip anticipation gradient) so a sexual signal stays live through an otherwise sedative pass, and the self-generated proprioceptive change reads as externally caused, installing operator-presence-in- the-room without consent friction.
nodes.disc: The tell is an EXTERNALIZED agent doing the relaxing on a passive body during a progressive scan (agency handoff), often with an arousal graft. Distinct from ordinary progressive relaxation (the listener relaxes themselves, no externalized agent or arousal graft), from kinesthetic-hallucination (a discrete installed sensation, not a whole-body agency-handoff scan), and from fictional-substance-agent (a substance/drug owns causation vs a narrated hands/jets agent doing the scan).

nodes.name: fictional-substance-agent
nodes.mech: Causation for a state-change (arousal, sedation, resistance-loss, suggestibility, willingness, identity-change) is offloaded onto an imagined external substance or agent — an injected serum, inhaled gas/smoke/mist, a lotion/oil, a drink, a pleasant toxin, a drug in the air — narrated with pseudo-pharmacology (soaks through skin, enters bloodstream, reaches the brain). Because the listener is asked to imagine a substance rather than to feel a thing, the 'I'm not actually feeling that' objection is bypassed and any felt change reads as the substance working ON a passive recipient; the consumption/inhalation act itself performs the delivery. Poles run from the subject as self-administering agent ('the listener becomes the syringe') to passive recipient of a prop that acts on them. Breath-coupling ('every inhale = more') makes dosing automatic and refusal-proof; a stated resistance-removal / manufactured-willingness function makes it a consent-displacement hinge.
nodes.disc: A FICTIONAL external carrier substance/agent credited with causal power over the body/state (pharmacology owns the causation), the imagined scene merely the surface. vs kinesthetic-hallucination: routes the sensation through a substance whose pharmacology owns the causation, not a free-standing felt sensation. vs arousal-cue-conditioning: there arousal is the conditioned OUTCOME of a cue, with no fictional carrier. vs the resistance-paradox reframe, which folds the resistance impulse back on itself: here resistance-removal is laundered through an in-fiction substance whose stated function IS resistance-elimination. vs transitive-charge-chaining: a drug may be one link's content there; here the substance is a causal relabeling of delivery, not merely a shared prop.

nodes.name: graded-somatic-identity-loading
nodes.mech: Delivers an identity-shift (feminization, a new body) as felt residue rather than as an asserted belief: the listener is walked through a staged chain of small sensory compliances (weight in the chest, burgeoning breasts, height, hip-sway, scent), each small enough to comply with alone, so a hallucinated body-change precipitates and belief in the new identity accrues as the by-product — nothing is ever asserted to be believed. A sensation-first / cause-second ordering makes the new body feel discovered as physical fact rather than staged as a costume, and an externalizing image (a drawn picture) lets the listener see the new body as already real.
nodes.disc: The tell is a graded chain of somatic compliances that DELIVERS AN IDENTITY payload as residue (belief never asked for), often with sensation-first/cause-second ordering. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (installs sensations with no identity payload precipitating as residue), from identity-merger-occupation (asserts/merges an identity directly), and from progressive-body-substitution (replaces the body with a MATERIAL part-by-part; here the body-experience is graded feminine sensation, not a material swap).

nodes.name: guided-visualization
nodes.mech: The operator builds a detailed constructed scene and narrows the subject's attention into it; inhabiting the imagined environment pulls attention resources off the physical surround (absorption primary, environmental dissociation secondary). This is the corpus's base scene-building delivery vehicle, routinely parameterized rather than replaced.
nodes.disc: Operator-guided construction of a scene for PRESENT inhabitation/absorption; multi-channel ENRICHMENT of that one scene is this technique's sensory-layering variant (adds channels for scene richness). Reach for THIS instead of siblings by these tells AGAINST it: content disguised as the subject's own self-generated material (-> internal-content-cultivation); built as a durable ADDRESSABLE structure for later re-navigation rather than present inhabitation (-> addressable-construct-building); NO verbal channel, only a mimed expectation-cued frame (-> pantomime-populated-hallucination); a new channel brought online by a SHARED-FEATURE carry-over rail that conserves state, not additive enrichment (-> cross-modal-channel-bridge); a SINGLE sensation swept spatially through the body as a payload-carrier (-> somatic-carrier-sweep); the subject's OWN autobiographical material re-instated (-> recall-state-reinstatement); imagery whose transitivity/never-settling dynamics do the work (-> transitive-charge-chaining / continuous-morph-chain); imagery embedding a reality-testing trainer or premise (-> impossibility-acclimation / imagined-is-real-premise).

nodes.name: identity-merger-occupation
nodes.mech: The subject's self-model is made to inhabit a visualized figure — either by direct assertive predication ('you are my doll') or by a gaze-pivot-to-occupancy move (drift into the figure's body, look out through its eyes) — so the figure's predicates, sensations, and function become first- person self-descriptions. The observer/observed split is collapsed: the subject does not watch or learn from the figure, they become it, and refusing the role would require dis-embodying. Variants seat the merge in proprioceptive/somatic imagery and assert ontological collapse ('it's not just a picture, it's real'), or run the merge through an operator-POV echo apparatus with a controlled de-merge.
nodes.disc: Separates from the mirror-as-proof-device move (observer split PRESERVED) by collapsing the split into occupation. Separates from surrogate-identification-delivery, which routes suggestion through a proxy the listener merely follows without becoming, and from covert-referent-migration, whose payload is the unannounced pointer-swap rather than the occupation itself. Separates from self-authored-identity-target where the listener AUTHORS the figure; here the figure is operator-supplied. Tell: the self-model ends up located inside the figure and inheriting its predicates.

nodes.name: imagined-completion-diagnostic
nodes.mech: A guided imagined-completion ritual (gather the important people from a special vantage, state the decision, finish unsaid business, look into a future-without-them) that DOUBLES AS DIAGNOSIS: if the subject is congruently ready it organizes real final tasks; if not, it harvests the positive outcomes behind the decision and the still-meaningful attachments as change leverage. The subject- side imagery effects (mild absorption, a dissociated vantage) are real but faint and low-confidence; the load-bearing purpose is the operator-side diagnostic/harvest.
nodes.disc: The diagnostic payload is the tell (not a guided-imagery relaxation script — the operator reads congruence and mines unfinished business). vs guided-visualization: the imagery is instrumentation for operator-side information capture, not an absorption anchor. Off-axis for the subject-state dims — hence the residual flag.

nodes.name: kinesthetic-hallucination
nodes.mech: Guides the subject to feel a specific imagined tactile/kinesthetic sensation (texture, pressure, temperature, weight, restraint, attachment point) that is not arising from any actual physical stimulus, so the experienced body diverges from the physical body. The install may be a discrete felt object, a progressive body-scan overlaid with imagined touch, a felt immobility/restraint, or a self-generated somatic anchor the subject sustains — the common lever is that the subject produces the percept from suggestion alone and treats it as real. Surface twists (self-generated so it survives operator absence, a compounding-arousal rider, redundant catalepsy imagery, sensation- first then cause-second ordering, an auditory hum overlaid on a heaviness sweep, an operator-dictated device schedule, retroactive non-noticing insertion) are variants, not separate mechanisms.
nodes.disc: Installs a felt sensation absent from actual stimuli — unlike sensation-reinterpretation moves, which re-label a sensation already present. Distinct from words-as-touch-transposition (there the operator's VOICE/words are equated with the sensation's source) and from self-touch-reattribution (there a REAL self-generated touch is re-credited to the operator with the physical situation unchanged) — here the sensation itself is manufactured, not merely re-sourced or re-authored.

nodes.name: pantomime-populated-hallucination
nodes.mech: With NO verbal suggestion at all, the operator acts out a perceptual event (mimes a door opening, rises in courtesy, gestures to a chair) using cues tuned to the deeply-entranced subject's expectations. The subject populates the empty behavioral scaffold from his own most-available content, rationalizes the percept from contextual cues, and — because he supplied the figure himself — treats it as real and DEFENDS it. No recognizable suggestion exists to resist.
nodes.disc: Zero verbal channel: the frame is mimed and expectation-cued, never described (vs guided- visualization, which verbally guides construction). vs internal-content-cultivation: there operator-authored content is disguised as self-generated; here the content genuinely IS the subject's own — the operator supplies only the empty frame, and perceptual completion (not invited imagining) does the filling. vs guided-visualization's delegation-variant: delegated content there is a conscious imaginative choice; here the subject does not know a frame was offered.

nodes.name: progressive-body-substitution
nodes.mech: Rewrites the body-schema one region at a time in a directed (usually toe-to-head or head-to-toe) sweep, replacing each named part with a new material or referent — shiny plastic, latex, liquid plastic, devotion-as-substance — until the whole body has been recategorized and only then applying the cognitive/identity change at the head. Because each region is a small object-claim complied with alone, ~20 accepted body-claims accumulate before selfhood is visibly negotiated, so refusing the final identity move would require retroactively rejecting all the prior acceptances (a commitment ratchet). The doll/latex-body replaces the meat-body as the referent for 'my body'.
nodes.disc: The tell is an ORDERED part-by-part substitution installing a new body-schema/substrate (a commitment ratchet), not a single free-standing sensation and not a one-move identity merger. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (installs discrete sensations, no ordered substrate rewrite), from identity-merger-occupation (merges the self into a visualized identity as ONE move), and from a plain progressive relaxation body-scan (no material substitution / commitment ratchet).

nodes.name: regime-change-threshold-gate
nodes.mech: A discrete, one-way threshold (a red velvet curtain positioned as a point-of-no-return) is staged as a voluntary crossing that converts continuous deepening into a REGIME change — after crossing, the operator's words and the subject's are framed as identical ('your words' and 'her words' are the same). The subject does the stepping so lost control is self-attributed, the operator answers the readiness check on the subject's behalf, and the feared cost of crossing ('all your control will be gone') is named directly and then inverted ('but all your wants will be yours') so pre-validating the fear stops it from breaking trance. The distinguishing object is the discrete one-way GATE topology — a bounded regime boundary — not a graded deepener and not a symbolic release act.
nodes.disc: A discrete one-way point-of-no-return gate whose crossing installs a REGIME where operator words are experienced as own thoughts, with operator-supplied readiness answer and paradoxical fear-naming. Separates from surrender-release-ritual (a symbolic release act, not a topology object — the threshold structure itself is the difference); from the resistance-paradox reframe (the fear-inversion here rides a spatial one-way gate, not a resistance-into-deepening fold); and from a plain deepener (a discrete regime-change boundary, not graded depth). In the source material the 'no going back' is later structurally violated by re-crossing — a tell that the gate is a framing device.

nodes.name: reified-depletion-inventory
nodes.mech: Converts an unobservable continuous internal state (intelligence, cognitive sharpness, thought- capacity) into a concrete, countable, depletable inventory — black bubbles that 'pop, pop, pop', IQ points that tick down and never climb back, brain draining/melting out the ears 'more and more', an IQ counter the listener picks and watches. The reification gives the listener a sensory referent they can hear/see happening and a self-generatable micro-animation to run during trance (each pop = one unit), offloading trance-maintenance onto the listener's imagination; the open-ended supply lets the loss be claimed indefinitely without contradiction, and a pause-not-reset clause preserves the accumulated depletion across fractionation cycles.
nodes.disc: The tell is quantization of a continuous cognitive drain into countable/completable self-generated units (often onomatopoeic or listener-owned). Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (a felt tactile sensation, not a counted cognitive-loss inventory), from numeric depth-claim deepeners (numerical/exponential claims deepening an EXISTING trance — here a faculty is reified as a self-owned counter, not a depth claim), and from progressive-body-substitution (rewrites the body, not a cognitive scalar).

nodes.name: resistance-externalized-as-object-watched-losing
nodes.mech: Externalizes the listener's own resistance/agency/self-control as a discrete object and then narrates that object LOSING on a scripted trajectory the listener merely witnesses — a self-control weight held over an abyss that gets heavier the more they resist, individuality reified as a thing watched softening and stopping against the latex, a resistance-fragment progressively deactivated across escalating passes. The externalization converts resisting into spectatorship of an inevitable defeat: trying to resist supplies the very struggling object the narration needs, and doing nothing also concedes, so no response escapes. The distinguishing structural feature is a reachability/no-exit topology — every branch routes to surrender — layered onto the externalization surface.
nodes.disc: Beyond parking a faculty (concrete-externalization-parked-faculty), the externalized object is narrated LOSING under a no-exit topology where both resisting and not resisting confirm the defeat.
