Distinct from externalize-then-destroy-faculty (object destroyed by operator fiat, not by a struggle-trap) and from the resistance-paradox reframe (which converts resistance into deepening, not into spectatorship of an externalized object's scripted loss). The no-winning-move topology — every response routes to surrender — is the load-bearing structural feature.

nodes.name: self-discontinuity-clear-and-replace
nodes.mech: CLEAR-AND-REPLACE the self: the prior self-model is structurally ended (shattered, emptied, liquefied, name-slot popped, or regression-stripped to a seam) so later resistance has no owner, and the vacated identity slot is then occupied by an assigned replacement. A built-in non-recall alibi ('the person who experienced that ended when it melted') removes the subject of any later objection.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when you want to END the prior self and seat a replacement in the vacancy — a discontinuity/erasure topology, NOT relabeling new content as native (intrinsic-self-reframe, which leaves the prior self intact) and NOT inhabiting a figure while the self persists (identity-merger-occupation). Distinct from neighboring techniques in the same family: mind-as-substrate-reframe only establishes the emptiable-matter ONTOLOGY that licenses a replacement — it is the precondition move, run before this; old-self-discreditation closes the return path by discrediting the prior self but sells no replacement; identity-origin-erasure removes the timeline/baseline rather than the self-content. Variant tells: shatter/decant = broken-shards or liquefied-into-vessel topology; excision-overwrite = self hollowed to 'no one/only a purpose' plus an assigned object whose content is swappable but whose obey-need is fixed; myth-substitution = cleared slot filled with a borrowed cultural persona so extreme claims land as fairy-tale.

nodes.name: self-touch-reattribution
nodes.mech: The listener performs a real, self-generated touch (or a real motor act), and the operator re- credits its authorship to themselves — 'I am touching all those places', 'my control touching you', fingers as 'the bridge between my voice and your body', the hands 'possessed' or 'taken control of'. The physical situation is unchanged; what changes is the felt agency: self-produced sensation is experienced as externally administered, so the listener's own labor becomes evidence of the operator's grip and the agency boundary over their own body dissolves. Frequently paired with a self-touch ban ('let me do the work') that routes all somatic load to the operator as the sole pleasure source.
nodes.disc: A REAL self-generated touch or deliberate motor act (self-stimulation, hand/head movement, posing) is re-authored to an external agent — the operator ('I am touching you', 'your hands are my hands', 'my control touching you'), a stranger, or a worn uniform — with the physical situation unchanged, so felt agency transfers at the sensory level and the listener's own labor becomes evidence of the operator's grip. Often paired with a self-touch ban ('let me do the work') routing all somatic load to the operator as sole pleasure source, with counted permission-grants making permission (not desire) the operative variable, and locked by a bondage/catalepsy hallucination that empties the seat an objection would come from; a low-stakes-rehearsal variant trains the disownment on trivial movements before a high-stakes payoff. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (no real touch; a sensation is manufactured), from words-as-touch-transposition (the voice IS the touch, no real self-touch), from ideomotor-response-convincer (the movement is genuinely felt involuntary and offered as proof; here a voluntary act is relabeled), from motor-inhibition-convincer (installs an INABILITY to move), and from ownership language (an identity claim, not sensory-authorship relocation).

nodes.name: surrender-release-ritual
nodes.mech: A symbolic enacted act marks and installs a compliance threshold — an abstract faculty (will, resistance, responsibility, wakeful cognition) is first objectified into a manipulable thing (a lock, a bubble, an object in the hands, a colored glow, an exhaled substance) and then released, dropped, popped, dimmed, or offloaded by an act the subject performs or authors. The enacted release IS the suggestion; authorship of the letting-go stays with the subject, so surrender reads as a chosen, completed, and felt event rather than something done to them. Common twists ride the same lever — re- arming the release onto an involuntary cue for auto-maintenance, animating the threshold as a mechanical event, gating it on a count, offloading the changed-belief authorship onto a device while the subject speaks the admission aloud, or recasting the released substance as the subject's own weakness.
nodes.disc: The move objectifies an abstract faculty and installs the transition through a symbolic enacted RELEASE whose authorship stays with the subject. Consent-manufacture counterfeits a self-attributed YES to erode the refusal channel — here the release itself is the ritual, not a manufactured permission artifact. In consummation-as-trance-threshold, desire-completion rather than surrender-symbolism powers the drop. A discrete one-way regime-change gate is a piece of trance topology, not a release act. Techniques that relocate the analytical faculty move it somewhere quiet to mute it; here the subject discards or releases the faculty at a threshold. And in a plain deepener count the numbers deepen by themselves; here a count only animates a watched mechanical release or gates an externalize-and-discard.

nodes.name: surrogate-delivery
nodes.mech: Induction moves and suggestions are routed through a PROXY the listener identifies with — a fictional character, dream-narrator, captive's first-person 'I', a partner in a 'failed' anecdote — so the content is grammatically ABOUT someone else and no second-person command is ever aimed at the listener. Defensive reactance has nothing to fire against; trance phenomena are absorbed by identification, and compliance is pre-laundered by watching/voicing it happen to a stand-in. Realizations: (surrogate-identification-delivery, anchor) suggestions arrive as reported speech / autobiography / narrator self-report, incl. a demonstrated-defeat variant where the listener's avatar resists and fails in seconds; (vicarious-resistance-exhaustion) a narrating avatar performs the entire fight-then-yield arc repeatedly ON THE LISTENER'S BEHALF so their own 'I could resist' impulse is pre-spent before it forms; (decoy-opposition-descent) two openly-opposed personified voices (protective vs coercive) both deliver descent — the protective one's soothing content is itself induction, so the binary is a decoy and every side feeds the drop.
nodes.disc: Reach for surrogate-delivery when the payload should arrive via a proxy the listener identifies with, with no 'you' command. vs covert-linguistic-delivery (183): that hides a directive in the surface aimed (deniably) at the listener; here it is grammatically about a distinct other. vs identity-merger/occupation (self-model families): the listener FOLLOWS the proxy without becoming a named self — the deniable delivery channel is the payload, not self-model occupation. vs resistance-fold (175): the proxy DEMONSTRATES defeat rather than reframing the listener's own live resistance. Anchor holds most-restrictive absorbed metadata (high, consent-required).

nodes.name: surrogate-object-property-projection
nodes.mech: A desired state or a refuse-worthy property is predicated of a NEUTRAL external object (a tomato plant, a granite statue) rather than of the subject's own body, removing any first-person claim the subject could falsify. The subject experiences the attributed state by identification/projection while resistance has no target to push against; properties the listener would reject if said directly ('you have no will') pass through the metaphor membrane because they are attributed to the object the listener now occupies. A referent-disqualification variant deletes referential indices and pre-rules-out the literal subject ('this won't be about flowers'), forcing the motivated subject to supply himself as the missing index so the asserted states are generated as his own. A trigger- seeding variant welds a cue word onto the object's already-true-feeling imagery, pre-charging it.
nodes.disc: Separates from identity-merger-occupation: the state stays on a THIRD object the subject need not become — the unfalsifiability comes from the attributional displacement, not from occupation. Separates from guided-visualization and from mere evocative metaphor: the load-bearing trick is that no first-person claim is ever made, so there is nothing to refuse. Tell: the desired state/property is grammatically the object's, not the subject's.

nodes.name: transitive-charge-chaining
nodes.mech: A graceful slide of tiny inferential steps (love her voice -> shape of her lips -> what they taste like -> a drugged 'devious lipstick') in which each image INHERITS the previous image's emotional charge, so the terminal payload image lands without ever being argued for. Content imported by a link (named substances, spells) brings its own frame along — here resistance-cancellation ('you can't resist') arrives as drug-imagery connotation instead of as an assertable, refusable claim.
nodes.disc: Transitive charge-inheritance across a chain of small inferences is the mechanism. Unlike guided-visualization, no scene is inhabited; the chain's motion does the work. Continuous-morph-chain is also chained imagery on the surface, but there the chain keeps the image moving so evaluation never settles; here the chain TRANSFERS charge onto a payload. No cue->arousal conditioning pair is installed — arousal-subjugation coupling is the chain's OUTCOME, not a trigger install. And unlike imagined-substance-delivery or fictional-substance-agent, the drug here is one link's content, not a causal relabeling of the delivery.

nodes.name: vicarious-depth-inheritance
nodes.mech: The listener is instructed to imagine the OPERATOR hypnotized 'over and over' under untrackable quantitative pressure (pocket watches, spirals, four voices, stacked inductions) with a compliance- forcing 'try, yes try, try right now to keep track of all the ways' — an impossible task producing tracking-failure into surrender while working memory saturates with hypnosis imagery. Then the protagonist is swapped mid-image from operator to listener ('the light bulb clicks on and your brain turns off'): the listener inherits whatever depth-mass they granted the imagined operator. Descent is inherited rather than freshly produced, and resistance is hard because the listener generated the imagery themselves.
nodes.disc: Depth arrives by INHERITANCE through a named mid-image protagonist swap. Identification machinery is used, but the payload is state-depth transfer, not adoption of a visualized identity. The overload/tracking-failure element is a set-up precursor, not the core move. And unlike guided-visualization, the imagined scene is fuel for the swap, not an absorption anchor.

nodes.name: words-as-touch-transposition
nodes.mech: Collapses the auditory channel into the tactile so that hearing the operator's voice IS being touched — the words/voice are asserted to BE a physical sensation on the listener's body (tracing skin, caressing, vibrating between the legs, penetrating), not merely to describe or cause one. Once made, the substitution binds a somatic component to every subsequent utterance: the listener can no longer hear without feeling, the normal evaluate-speech stance is removed, and later commands ride an already-open somatic carrier. Often the felt intensity is made contingent on trance depth, turning 'go deeper' into a chaseable sensory reward.
nodes.disc: The distinguishing tell is auditory->haptic synesthesia — the operator's VOICE itself is the sensation's source and every spoken line becomes a stimulus event on the body. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (a manufactured sensation with no voice-equation), from self-touch- reattribution (a REAL self-generated touch re-credited to the operator, no cross-modal claim), and from fictional-substance-agent (a fictional object/drug owns causation, not the voice).

nodes.name: autonomic-act-rekeying
nodes.mech: The operator discards the ordinary name for an autonomic act (exhale/inhale) and installs a higher-register replacement (expire/inspire), loading the new word with its other dictionary senses — expire as 'a little sacrificial death', inspire as 'breath of life / I am penetrating you through the air' — sealed with a tiny consent-ratification beat ('isn't that beautiful?'). Every subsequent breath is now taggable by the operator with the imported connotations, so the listener's baseline involuntary metabolism is converted into a low-grade continuous compliance signal that runs without any further operator action.
nodes.disc: Separates from breath pacing, which paces breath for relaxation and does no renaming — this does zero pacing and instead re-keys the act's meaning to import non-trivial connotations. Separates from directional-cue-reversal (redefines a directional cue to disrupt orientation) — here the redefinition weaponizes an autonomic function into a persistent compliance channel, not a tracking device. Tell: semantic re-keying of an involuntary act carrying death/penetration connotations into the body. Separates from term-redefinition-smuggle (a one-time obligation install; this binds the new meaning to an ongoing bodily carrier).

nodes.name: climax-purge-lock
nodes.mech: Convert the triggered climactic sexual moment into the structural locking step of the conditioning: the listener experiences self-deletion as pleasure and is told this discharge is what makes the conditioning permanent. Successive triggered orgasms are staged to purge progressively heavier substrate — pleasure, then old thoughts and memories, then the whole prior self — with the orgasm asserted as the vehicle that expels prior self-content through the body. The reward and the erasure are the same event; the discharge does the locking.
nodes.disc: The tell is that the orgasm IS the identity-purge-and-lock operator, not a pleasure payoff rewarding a named act. Separates from direct pleasure linkage (there pleasure rewards an act; here the discharge does the deletion), and from escalating-release-fire (there the staging primes a release; here the release is asserted to expel self-content and seal permanence).

nodes.name: counterfeit-cue-forgery
nodes.mech: Automatic recognition/compliance routines key on an isolated, forgeable cue rather than the true object's provenance or state of affairs. The operator manufactures a fake token of that normally-reliable cue (false mating flash, rove-beetle contact cues, canned laughter, salted tip jar, inflated club line, staged unrehearsed-interview ad) so the target's routine runs to completion toward a referent that does not exist. Nothing new is installed; an already-reliable releaser or heuristic is counterfeited, and the discrimination/verification step is bypassed entirely. Detection of the forgery collapses the move instantly.
nodes.disc: Forges a token of a PRE-EXISTING reliable cue so an existing shortcut misfires — unlike a conditioned-trigger install, which creates a NEW cue by pairing; unlike rigged-verification-capture, which corrupts a check the subject actively runs, whereas here the check is skipped because the counterfeit substitutes for it; and unlike honest cue-use, identical in form, differing only in the referent's truth-value.

nodes.name: enacted-embodied-proof
nodes.mech: COMMANDS the listener to perform a physical action so that their own body manufactures the proprioceptive evidence for an abstract claim or rule — the metaphor stops being a verbal assertion and becomes muscle memory the listener has just executed. A vacuum/suction model is ratified by ordering 'suck your cheeks in right now'; an arithmetic +2/-1 rule is locked into proprioception by paced self-stroking (down-on-inhale) that reverses the usual template; a directed self-touch tour is run under induction copy on the same line of speech so arousal and deepening are inseparable and self-touch itself becomes compliance-proof. Because the body has already done the thing, the subsequent 'your mind works the same way' / 'this is the rule' claim rides on enacted proof rather than argument, and the careful attention the action demands is itself a compliance signal.
nodes.disc: Unlike somatic-mirroring, which READS a sensation already present, this DIRECTS an action to generate the sensation as evidence. Unlike breath pacing, which entrains, here the paced motion is a vehicle to map an abstract rule onto proprioception. And unlike a behavioral-commitment move, the enacted action manufactures evidence for a cognitive claim — it is not a commitment/consistency lever.

nodes.name: induction-less-work-as-onramp
nodes.mech: A whole-artifact architecture in which there is no separate induction phase — no progressive relaxation, breath-count, eye-fixation, or body-scan opener. The induction boundary is deleted by design, realized two ways. (a) WORK-AS-ONRAMP: the file opens already inside the frame and the work content itself (a sustained single image, arousal/masturbation, or a payload-fused first descent) does the induction's job, so trance is built by the work rather than as scaffolding for it — state carried by rhythm, prosody, and repetition of the work material, presupposing an already-conditioned listener who drops on a learned cue. (b) AMBIENT OCCUPATION-OF-ROLE: the file opens in essayistic/conversational register and stays there, so trance is implied by sustained presence in the frame rather than marked by a felt entry threshold; the center of gravity shifts from state-change-by-induction to occupation-of-role (not 'going under' but 'putting on'), and residual emergence infrastructure (a terminal wake-count) may remain even though the induction it would reverse is absent, letting the piece run as background. In both, the induction-deepener-work-emerge sequence is collapsed or inverted and the reusable lever is deletion of the induction boundary; because no threshold is crossed there is no clear point at which the listener could have refused.
nodes.disc: Separates from guided-visualization (which uses an image as CONTENT inside a normal staged arc) and from progressive-relaxation (a discrete induction section): here there is NO discrete induction section at all — the work substrate carries entry. Separates from a broken/incomplete arc (the tell is deliberateness — an already-conditioned audience and a learned drop-cue, not a missing block). Not the diegetic/procedural collapse of scene-and-deepener (that fuses SCENE with DEEPENING mid-file; this deletes the OPENER). Separates from song-architecture-delivery-vehicle (that substitutes a cyclical musical form with no arc; this still runs a collapsed linear file).

nodes.name: measurement-confound-mitigation
nodes.mech: An operator-side measurement-design rule that recovers a valid picture of the subject's behavior from an assessment process that would otherwise distort it. Two confounds are managed by the same lever (vary and/or repeat observation): MASKING — a behavior live in one context is absent from a single sample — is defeated by deliberately spreading observation across times, settings, and caretakers so a false-negative target map is caught rather than missed; and REACTIVITY — being watched shifts the behavior — is defeated by minimizing obtrusiveness and repeating observation across days until the novelty-driven reactive transient decays, then reading the stabilized baseline. Both convert a measurement artifact into a managed, validity-protecting arrangement; the move acts on the operator's data, not on the subject's state.
nodes.disc: Not an intervention that changes the subject's behavior and not the recording protocol itself; the tell is that the move manages a measurement confound (masking or reactivity) to protect the validity of assessment data. Separates from preparatory-target-definition (which fixes WHAT to record before observing) by acting on HOW representative/undistorted the observation window is.

nodes.name: no-exit-reachability-closure
nodes.mech: A whole-artifact design property in which the listener's reachable-state / reachable-response set is arranged so that no reachable state hosts criticality or offers an exit back to baseline. The closure is realized by several interchangeable operations, all producing the same no-off-ramp topology: FUSING opposed states so every relief channel feeds the system it would relieve (relaxation<->arousal, choice<->compulsion, frustration<->deepening); DELETING competing referents (build a sensory referent, destroy it, fill the void with operator tokens until only the voice remains); RE-ROUTING every resistance behavior into a deepener (intrusive thoughts, startle-back, doubt, trying-to-stay-awake all pre-loaded with a reframe that routes them back to the target state); SEALING each escape route with a distinct mechanism so counter-moves feed the next seal (many entrances, no exit); running an unbroken monotonic ramp with no fractionation valley so no seam exists at which to reassert judgment; or PRE-VALENCING every listener action inside the operator frame (stroke=good, stop=good, embarrassment=service, hold-back=failure) before any move can be claimed as resistance. The lever is reachability- closure of the state/response space across the whole arc, not any single seal, fusion, or line.
nodes.disc: The property is the RELATIONSHIP across the whole artifact — removing any one passage leaves an exit or a valley, so no single line carries it. Distinct from a progressive deepener (which descends but leaves off-ramps), a compulsion loop (which repeats but is escapable), and ordinary escalation (a directional intensity increase, orthogonal to closure). Fusion vs deletion vs re-routing vs sealing vs pre-valencing are surface realizations of one closure topology, not distinct mechanisms. Distinct from switching-state-machine-topology, which REQUIRES a route back to baseline (gated switching) rather than sealing all exits.

nodes.name: perpetual-obligation-ledger
nodes.mech: Under the reciprocity norm, the operator repays a debt PLUS a small explicitly-labeled surplus ('These five are yours... These are mine'), so each settlement instantiates a fresh debt and the obligation ledger structurally never reaches zero. The exchange chain self-perpetuates, converting a one-off favor into a standing relationship tie the operator can lean on — the manipulated quantity is a relational debt balance held permanently open across repeated occasions.
nodes.disc: Separates from any single reward/craving conditioning (v6.9 conditions a present drive); here the moved quantity is an inter-agent obligation ledger, not a state dimension on the subject. Separates from staged-negotiation-favor-theater: that manufactures a one-time felt debt via fake effort; this keeps a running balance perpetually non-zero by structural over-repayment.

nodes.name: pleasure-as-currency-payoff-reframe
nodes.mech: A whole-script value/goal-topology reframe that re-assigns which quantity is the payoff of the encounter. The surface transaction (operator gives pleasure, listener gives obedience) is inverted so every pleasure increment is reframed as evidence of operator control, and CONTROL — not pleasure — is positioned as the actual reward ('better than any orgasm to know you are this deeply controlled'). A freeze-at-edge is load-bearing: it withholds the apparent product (pleasure) at peak desire and substitutes the actual product (a helplessness-identity). The lever is relocating the goal of the scene, built cumulatively across the whole file, so post-session compounding only reads as desirable once losing-self is established as the reward.
nodes.disc: Separates from ordinary reward statements (this is a whole-script INVERSION of which quantity is the payoff, built cumulatively) and from no-exit-reachability-closure / response-foreclosure (that closes the reachable-response set; this re-values the GOAL). Not valence-rerouting of an affect direction — it re-assigns the payoff quantity, not the sign on an affect lever.

nodes.name: preparatory-target-definition
nodes.mech: An operator-side, pre-observation design move: before any direct observation, the assessor interviews the people in the setting and joins their conversation to operationally define the target behavior and to fix in advance which antecedents and consequences will be watched for. This is the indirect-to-direct hand-off — it pre-commits the recording schema to a single agreed definition and a short watch-list, reducing on-the-fly judgment and observer drift, so a vague complaint becomes an agreed, recordable definition plus a focused schema.
nodes.disc: Not the observation/recording itself and not confound management; the tell is the hand-off that fixes the definition and watch-list BEFORE observing. Separates from measurement-confound-mitigation, which acts on how representative/undistorted the observation window is rather than on what will be recorded.

nodes.name: somatic-mirroring
nodes.mech: Takes a sensation that is already present in the listener's body — heaviness, warmth, numbness, drift, arousal, an involuntary twitch — and reinterprets it, in the moment, as evidence of the session's installed theme or of trance itself. The move never conjures a new feeling; it seizes a real, locally-verifiable percept (often one the listener has just confirmed via an interoceptive check) and re-narrates its meaning, so the felt sensation becomes self-generated proof the transformation is real. Because the raw material is genuine, the reframe is far harder to resist than an operator's bare claim. Variants extend the base lever along articulable rules: pre-attributing operator-driven change to the listener's own spontaneous physiology, exploiting a known perceptual property so the body produces the evidence for free, binding the relabel into a self-fueling ramp, manufacturing state through presuppositional leading questions rather than observing it, or renaming one confirmed referent into an escalating need-state.
nodes.disc: Nearest neighbors: kinesthetic hallucination INDUCES a sensation that is not present; somatic-mirroring reuses one that is. Pacing-and-leading reflects what is actually true to build rapport; somatic-mirroring reassigns the MEANING of the true sensation. Distinct from pleasure-authorship-relocation (that transfers the felt CAUSE of a sensation to the operator, an agency claim, not a meaning reframe) and from enacted-embodied-proof (that COMMANDS a physical action to manufacture the percept rather than reading one already there).

nodes.name: song-architecture-delivery-vehicle
nodes.mech: A whole-artifact delivery-vehicle property in which the conditioning payload is carried by a musical/song architecture rather than a linear induction-to-trance-to-wake arc: layered tiers (minimal repeating mantra hooks, a rhyme-locked sung chorus, and a spoken 'spacy recital' narrative) each operate at a different cognitive depth, and the piece is built for exposure-over-repetition (designed to be replayed) with no wake or emergence. A familiar pop sample in the carrier register lowers analytic guard by delivering the content as passively-consumed entertainment. The reusable lever is the artifact FORM (music-first, cyclical, replay-looped) as the conditioning substrate.
nodes.disc: Separates from the induction-less onramp candidate (that deletes the induction stage but still runs a linear file; this substitutes a cyclical MUSICAL form with no arc at all) and from carrier-medium-binding of a single trigger to a tone (this is whole-artifact song composition, not one binding). The tell is the tiered mantra/chorus/recital structure plus stated replay-loop intent, not any single passage.

nodes.name: staged-negotiation-favor-theater
nodes.mech: The operator, already knowing the outcome, stages a visible costly struggle with an off-stage authority (a 'battle' with the sales manager that never actually happens) and returns bearing fatigue signals — disheveled, weary, loosened tie, elapsed time — presenting the predetermined deal as a hard-won concession. The manufactured effort makes the target revalue an unchanged offer as a costly favor, manufacturing felt indebtedness and aligning the target emotionally with the operator ('he's on my side') against the fabricated adversary, which suppresses resistance.
nodes.disc: Separates from perpetual-obligation-ledger: that keeps a running debt balance open via over-repayment; this manufactures a single felt debt from theatrical effort with no real ledger. Distinct from a genuine negotiation — the outcome is predetermined and the cost-signal is theater; it collapses if the target glimpses the empty office.

nodes.name: switching-state-machine-topology
nodes.mech: A whole-script install shape that builds a two-state machine (e.g. normal / bimbo) with explicit gated transitions and an accumulation rule biasing drift toward the target state over repeated cycles — rather than pushing toward a single permanent end-state. It requires the listener to spend most time in the vanilla state and enter the target state only on cue; a protective amnesia rule shields the vanilla state from contamination so the script is re-runnable rather than one-shot. The on-trigger is the ongoing operational interface; the script itself is a one-time installer for repeated cross-session use. The lever is the state-space topology (switching with a drift bias), not a directional intensity push.
nodes.disc: Separates from a destination-installer ('you are now permanently X') because the design deliberately keeps the listener mostly in the baseline state and gates entry to the target state — the tell is the two-state gated topology with an accumulation/drift rule and protective amnesia enabling re-runs. Distinct from no-exit-reachability-closure, which seals ALL exits; here exit back to baseline is REQUIRED by design.

nodes.name: valued-channel-induction
nodes.mech: The operator selects the induction channel matching the subject's strongest/most-valued representational system (read from predicates) and issues an opening task that PRESUPPOSES that channel. Because the task is one the subject executes fluently and without effort, executing it IS the entry into trance — processing transfers off the verbal/analytic track with near-zero friction. A failed induction is reframed as wrong-channel choice, not subject resistance.
nodes.disc: The channel is SELECTED from the subject's read valued system and the task PRESUPPOSES it rather than requesting it — the tell that this is not generic vivid-imagery rapport. Pacing-and-leading reflects the subject's CURRENT experience then leads; this instead matches the subject's channel CAPACITY and makes task execution itself the entry. Unlike guided-visualization, no scene is built; the channel choice is the mechanism. Unlike overlap-bridging, it stays INSIDE the strong channel; bridging deliberately crosses to a weak one.

nodes.name: crisis-induction-live-readout
nodes.mech: The operator deliberately names the group's most taboo material (even insulting a member) to detonate the habitual interaction sequence, then withholds all content engagement and observes, re-igniting with trigger mentions when it slows. The real, un-self-conscious sequence exposes who-triggers-whom that a polite session hides; fatigue and lowered later resistance are side effects, not the point.
nodes.disc: Operator stays a non-engaging igniter/observer harvesting a structural read-out - not arguing content, not running a covert-induction pretext, and not handling resistance: the provocation is diagnostic and resistance-lowering is only a byproduct. Sibling stage to influence-topology-node-selection, whose node choice the live read-out feeds.

nodes.name: target-selection
nodes.mech: Design-time selection and operationalization of WHICH behavior/target the intervention will aim at, decided before anything is done to the subject; the payoff is the operator's target list, not any subject state. The variants are the selection criteria a writer chooses among: (a) FORWARD LEVERAGE — privilege behavioral cusps whose change unlocks disproportionate downstream contingency space, so one trained behavior cascades into untrained learning; (b) STANDING-CONTINGENCY MAINTAINABILITY — keep only targets the post-instruction environment will already catch and reinforce (and reject age-/community-atypical targets that suppress natural reinforcement), shifting the maintenance burden off the operator; (c) PRODUCING-BEHAVIOR VALIDITY — refuse to hang the contingency on an outcome or mere correlate; decompose the stated result into the definable behaviors that produce it and place the contingency there (named failure: contingency-on-the-product programs fail); (d) GOAL-PROXIMAL DIMENSION — operationalize the vague goal as one specific measurable dimension (rate, duration, latency, magnitude, topography) moved in a named direction, chosen by which dimension most directly advances the actual goal (calories, not bites); (e) TRAIT-TO-BEHAVIOR DECOMPOSITION — meet every intrinsic-trait label ('lazy','fearful') with 'what does X DO?' to dissolve the internal-cause attribution into a countable, environment-linked, targetable behavior; (f) STRENGTHS-FIRST BALANCE — force a fixed-count strengths inventory ahead of an equal-count deficit list at intake so the target pool tilts toward building, not only suppressing.
nodes.disc: Reach for target-selection when the writer's question is 'what should the intervention aim at?' — a design-time filter/operationalization on the operator's target list, nothing enacted on the subject. Pick the criterion by the sub-question: downstream leverage (a), will-it-last (b), causal validity (c), which measurable dimension (d), how to make a vague trait targetable (e), or is the pool strengths-balanced (f). Distinct from intervention-gating (which decides whether/which-arm to proceed on an already-chosen target) and from preparatory-diagnostic-read (which reads the subject to build the map this move selects over).

nodes.name: functional-analysis-methodology
nodes.mech: EXPERIMENTAL FUNCTIONAL ANALYSIS — the operator upgrades a correlational hunch into demonstrated causal control by arranging conditions and actively turning a suspected controlling variable on and off while holding others constant, watching whether the target behavior tracks the manipulation (control over occurrence AND nonoccurrence). Core design = a control condition expected to yield the lowest rate (typically play: preferred items free, no demands, continuous attention) against test conditions selected only for the hypothesized function(s); differential responding anchored by the play baseline establishes causal function, with the explicit cost that untested functions cannot be ruled out. Requires operator control of antecedents/consequences and the ability to evoke the behavior.
nodes.disc: Reach for experimental FA when you need PROOF of what maintains a behavior and you control the antecedents/consequences and can evoke it — the tell is active on/off manipulation of a variable with a control condition, demonstrating control over occurrence AND nonoccurrence. Pick the realization by constraint: standard multielement when single variables can be isolated; brief/trial-based when disruption must be minimal; IISCA when isolated conditions yield nothing (compound/interactive maintenance); EO-verification when the question is whether a contrived motivating operation (not a cue) drives responding; per-topography coding when several problem behaviors co-occur; single-variable off/on when the object is a belief/false-cause. Distinct from descriptive-functional-assessment (observes only -> correlational, hedged, no manipulation), from contingency-space-analysis (computes a dependency from already-collected counts, no arrangement), and from procedure-fidelity/transferability tests (document enactment vs a causal claim).

nodes.name: design-time-reconnaissance
nodes.mech: Before instruction/design, exhaustively map the space the plan must survive so gaps are caught on paper rather than in the field; nothing is delivered to the subject. Realizations: (a) GENERALIZATION-DOMAIN RECON — enumerate every setting and stimulus condition where the behavior should AND explicitly should NOT occur (treated as the unseen test, with discriminated alternative responses planned for inappropriate opportunities); list every desired response form and triage train-directly vs delegate-to-generalization; and survey the discriminative stimuli, schedules, and reinforcer types already operating in the target settings, so training is matched to what the environment will actually deliver; (b) EXHAUSTIVE-OBJECTOR CENSUS — before design work, demand a complete externalized (written) census of every objecting part and its function, sweeping every representational system rather than stopping at first responders, pre-warning that many typically object, so no suppressed objector is omitted from later design and cannot resurface as post-install sabotage. The shared lever is exhaustive design-time enumeration for completeness; the failure mode it prevents is a missed item (setting or objector) resurfacing after commitment.
nodes.disc: Reach for design-time-reconnaissance when the writer needs an exhaustive pre-design map so nothing is missed -- a completeness sweep on the PLAN before any teaching/install, subject untouched. Tells: enumerate should/should-not settings + response-form triage + standing-contingency survey (a); complete written cross-channel census of objectors (b). Distinct from target-selection (which FILTERS/picks targets rather than enumerating the space), from preparatory-diagnostic-read (which reads/measures the subject rather than enumerating on paper), and from intervention-gating (which branches proceed/how). Its contingency survey supplies the environment map that target-selection's maintainability criterion tests against.

nodes.name: generative-cusp-installation
nodes.mech: Install a fixed frame with a swappable slot ("I want __") plus a self-driven question-asking repertoire (the mand-for-information cusp, "What's that?") so new content drops into the slot and each question harvests new material with no per-item training. The small installed cusp is a behavioral lever whose returns compound, yielding open-ended, self-driven, combinatorial repertoire expansion rather than item-by-item gains.
nodes.disc: The tell is compounding self-amplification from a single installed frame-plus-cusp, where returns outpace the instruction delivered. Not ordinary item-by-item teaching or a single new label, and unlike forward-leverage-target-selection (which privileges cusps on the operator's target list) this move acts on the subject's repertoire - it installs one.

nodes.name: influence-topology-node-selection
nodes.mech: Map who-responds-to-whom, then route a minimal change through the single node whose change propagates system-wide - deliberately avoiding the symptomatic member (easy to flip, but the system flips them back) and preferring the most tenacious member others actually respond to. The system then does most of the work and the change persists.
nodes.disc: Selection of the intervention NODE by influence-graph propagation and tenacity - not any particular change technique and not work with the presenting member; tell is deliberate non-symptomatic tenacious-node targeting. The graph is read and routed through, not restructured. Sibling stage to crisis-induction-live-readout, whose read-out supplies the map this move selects from.

nodes.name: natural-contingency-handoff
nodes.mech: Retire the operator by handing maintenance to a natural contingency already operating in the target setting, via one of two levers. Contact lever: drive just enough emissions of the trained behavior in the generalization setting for it to contact the already-present reinforcer, then withdraw operator support once contact occurs. Fluency lever: do not stop at bare correctness — push measured performance (accuracy, rate, latency, duration, magnitude, topography) until the response is fluent enough to satisfy the natural setting's unforgiving timing/quality demands, because a correct-but-too-slow response never contacts reinforcement and extinguishes. Either way the response survives because the environment now selects and maintains it, collapsing operator effort from "sustain indefinitely" to "get the behavior over the natural contingency's threshold."
nodes.disc: The operator supplies no content and retires once natural reinforcement takes over — unlike moves that deliver operator content at the trance/waking threshold, schedule practice for state re-access, or sustain compliance for depth. Presupposes a target already screened by a standing-contingency maintainability filter; the deficit fixed is a CONTACT-frequency deficit (drive exposures) or a FLUENCY deficit (train measured dimensions to threshold), not broadened cues.

nodes.name: social-reinforcement-recruitment
nodes.mech: Route the maintaining reinforcement through another AGENT whose delivering behavior is itself the engineered variable — convert the subject's social environment into the reinforcement engine. Operator-side forms: inform capable-but-dormant people in the setting of the value of their attention and explicitly ask them to watch for and reinforce any reasonable effort (awakening an asleep community so gains persist after the trainer leaves); or, where ABC narrative data reveal caregivers/staff reinforcing the wrong endpoint (e.g. the end of an escalation chain over appropriate bids), directly reverse that agent's contingency (reinforce appropriate responses, extinguish the escalation endpoint, shape delay tolerance). Selection-side form: choose a proxy target behavior specifically because its payoff changes how significant others treat the subject, recruiting a named third-party causal path. Subject-side form: the subject self-evaluates against a criterion and, on meeting it, actively recruits praise/feedback from an authority, engineering the conditions under which that person reinforces them (raising the authority's own praise rate as a collateral change). Includes the dosing layer: calibrate recruiting rate and topography to the setting's tolerance so the recruited contingency stays net-positive and the reinforcing agent is not flipped into a punisher.
nodes.disc: The operative move lands on the setting's people, or on target choice routed through them - never on the subject's state. Unlike a trigger install that arms someone to fire a cue, nothing is installed in anyone; third parties are asked to notice and reinforce. Unlike a subject-comfort check, the dosing layer preserves a third party's goodwill rather than checking the subject's comfort. Unlike the producing-behavior validity rule of target selection, the proxy here is deliberately chosen for its third-party path, not rejected as a mere correlate.

nodes.name: compounding-dependency-loop
nodes.mech: A meta-suggestion claims repeated listening cumulatively RAISES a waking baseline state (e.g. natural arousal) across sessions rather than resetting per session, and the installed state's only relief route is more of the same hypnosis — so the cure feeds the disease. Re-listening is motivated (each now "does more"), any felt increase is pre-explained as the suggestion working, and the teardown route interlocks with the escalation so the dependency closes into a loop: more listening raises baseline further, which motivates more listening.
nodes.disc: Separate from progressive-conditioning (which accumulates trance DEPTH or response strength as a passive belief) by the cure-worsens-condition DEPENDENCY INVERSION — the installed waking-baseline state's designated relief route is the very mechanism that escalates it, forming a closed dependency loop. The structural cure-feeds-the-disease inversion is not a scale/target twist, so it stands apart rather than folding in as a variant.

nodes.name: object-as-causal-agent-of-cognition
nodes.mech: An external object (a worn garment, a hallucinated device, or a recast environmental detail such as a color) is declared the CAUSAL AGENT of the listener's mind-state rather than a carrier of installed meaning: putting on the uniform causes the persona/blankness to 'expand to fill' it or 'supplies the mind' or continuously drains cognition at skin contact; a hallucinated collar 'radiates every word' and 'amplifies' suggestions so rising obedience is felt as the equipment working; a color is re-cast into the listener's drainage system ('thoughts stream out into red') so later encounters replay the emptying. Authorship of behaviour is displaced from the listener onto the object, which becomes the grammatical subject of compliance ('the uniform/collar is doing it'), neutralizing resistance (refusing means fighting an object) and giving a portable, externally-checkable on/off switch that locates the source of compliance outside the self. The object is then externalized as a post-session cue so encountering it replays the actual in-session mechanism, not merely a reminder of it.
nodes.disc: The object is declared causal of the mind-state (it supplies/drains cognition, amplifies/radiates the words, IS the drainage/operative apparatus) and compliance is attributed to it - not merely an object carrying re-evocable significance the listener still owns (portable-object-state-export), and not a discrete cue-response state-shift. The tell is the object assigned an ACTIVE CAUSAL role in producing the state (always-on ambient drain; encounter replays the mechanism), with compliance attributed to the object rather than the listener.

nodes.name: identity-displaced-into-external-object
nodes.mech: The listener's body, will, or whole state-configuration is relocated INTO an external object that then serves as the addressable handle for future control — a sympathetic proxy (poppet bound with strands and sited in the operator's home), a container object that stores and re-instates an entire bundled mental configuration on "on/off", an amulet dissolved into the flesh so it becomes non-removable installed physiology, or a worn single-word ownership anchor read aloud by the listener that fuses object-meaning with a behavioral lock. Unlike a re-encounterable worn re-trigger, the identity or state itself is understood to LIVE in the object; addressing the object addresses the listener across sessions, and the consent/ratification moment is captured before or at the point the relocation becomes irreversible.
nodes.disc: The listener's identity/will/state-set is relocated into the object as its residence (proxy, container, internalized-into-body), so the object is the address of the person — not merely a worn item that re-fires a state the listener still hosts (portable-object-state-export). Not a discrete cue-trigger. The tell is the object standing in FOR the listener (poppet = body/will; collar = the whole state-bundle; locket "Mine" = the ownership relation itself), often operator-held or operator-sited.

nodes.name: identity-origin-erasure
nodes.mech: Relocates the ORIGIN of the installed identity into an erased or unfalsifiable past so there is no "before" the listener could locate or return to. Rather than relabeling new content as native (the intrinsic reframe), it rewrites autobiographical memory/timeline: the trait is asserted to have always been true ("you have always been the submissive", "you were always made to be a doll, you didn't have a life before me"), often filling the void with a fabricated flattering past ("always been this way, can't remember being any other way"), so the "I changed into this" seam that would let the listener date and undo the change is removed. It typically depends on a prior amnesia/emptying foundation so the timeline cannot be checked from inside the trance, and is sometimes synchronized with a physical act (stripping) that mirrors the identity removal.
nodes.disc: The load-bearing move is deletion of the baseline: it forecloses return-to-baseline by removing the baseline itself, where intrinsic-self-reframe relabels new content as native but leaves the prior self/timeline intact. Screen-memory work replaces a SPECIFIC targeted memory; this erases the whole pre-scene self/origin globally. And where persistence framing projects the installed identity forward in time, this rewrites the past backward.

nodes.name: intrinsic-self-reframe
nodes.mech: Reframes installed content (an identity, trait, feeling, state, or even a control surface) as always-intrinsic and pre-existing rather than externally imposed, so the listener's stance shifts from evaluating a proposition to recognizing a fact about themselves. The lever is authorship relocation onto the listener's own self via a self-discovery frame ('you already know this', 'it was always there deep down', 'this is simply who you are', 'a side you have always had', 'it doesn't come from me, it was there all along'). Once accepted, resistance reads as self-denial rather than refusal of an external claim, and later content lands as confirmation of an existing identity rather than imposition. Realizations range over placement (opening whole-identity premise, mid-session ontological restatement), over the object (an identity, a coined category, a just-built affect whose authorship is disavowed, an arousal control surface claimed to have 'always been there'), over vehicle (copular assertion, latent-self-surfacing where the listener supplies the content, first-person creed inscription declared to BE the walls of the listener's own mind), and over the GROUNDING of the always-was claim - which can be grounded in the self/identity or grounded in a physiological/developmental substrate (endocrine/reproductive vocabulary, 'born with a female spirit', an infant caregiver-trust circuit 'reconnected' to the operator, with an unflagged category mismatch doing the smuggling) so pushing back feels like arguing with one's own body.
nodes.disc: The tell is the single-self self-discovery reframe that dissolves the installed/native boundary without splitting the self, erasing a timeline, or citing a physiological source. Named-alter-partition-install builds a SECOND self alongside; identity-origin-erasure deletes the prior baseline/timeline so there is no before to return to, rather than merely relabeling the new content native; clear-and-replace self-model surgery excises the prior self and installs a replacement; and persistence framing asserts the change forward in time, where this asserts always-was retroactively.

nodes.name: named-alter-partition-install
nodes.mech: Constructs a SECOND self-locus inside the listener — often a separately-named, persistent alter-identity (a named doll-self, a slave-self) or a manufactured sub-self (a 'primal self' below thought, a pre-labeled 'part that always listened') built feature-by-feature (traits, body, drive, sometimes a fabricated autobiography) — and transfers the conditioned behavior onto it, either by relocating the listener's 'I' INTO the alter or by installing the alter BESIDE the listener as a discrete third-person carrier of the payload, so the listener can enact compliance while disowning agency ('the doll responding', 'Daddy brought the alter out'). The distancing is the mechanism: a manufactured person absorbs conduct the listener would not own directly, entered at low ego-defense and routed back to 'you'. The partition makes compliance ego-syntonic for the installed part while ego-dystonic resistance is relocated onto a losing faction; a verdict is pre-assigned that the compliant part is the authentic self. Future triggers address the alter rather than the listener, and the second self is engineered as always-on/permanent so it feels inherent, sometimes with a retroactive backdating or anti-deprogramming immunity clause.
nodes.disc: The tell is naming-or-manufacturing a persistent second agent and relocating agency/behavior onto it. Intrinsic-self-reframe reframes the ONE self as intrinsic with no split; this builds a distinct second locus. Consciousness-splitting work partitions awareness into observer/responder within one self for in-session ideomotor proof; this installs a durable IDENTITY-typed second self carrying the conditioned behavior, addressed by name/trigger. And proxy-agent-resistance-offload's proxy is externally-authored, definitionally obedient, and FIGHTS the listener; here the alter is a self the listener inhabits and defers to.

nodes.name: portable-object-state-export
nodes.mech: Object-anchoring: bind the in-session state (trance, arousal, ownership, submission, cognitive blankness) to a specific everyday object the listener wears/carries by repeated equivalence, then hand it over as a self-administered out-of-session re-trigger. Because the object persists where the operator's voice does not, encountering/wearing/noticing it re-instantiates the bound state with the operator absent, extending the session's reach indefinitely. Realizations differ only in firing intensity and in what the object holds: (a) at the gentle pole, a worn item carries persistent ambient meaning (a 'constant reminder', a 'soft pull back'); (b) at the active pole, the object is a live portable re-induction surface fired by ordinary encounter; (c) in the EXCLUSIVITY variant, the object is elevated to the SOLE control channel every later move routes through ('all I need to control you', 'deeper than chains') — the knob is whether this is the only lever; (d) in the STORAGE-LOCUS variant, the object is made the place an abstract outcome is stored and retrieved on demand (a named 'Magic Spot' holding a permanent result even after the physical trace fades) rather than a cue that fires — the knob is what the object holds, a stored outcome vs a re-fired state. All share one lever: persistent conditioned meaning installed onto a physical object the listener owns.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the persistence carrier is an EXTERNAL, encounterable object the listener OWNS/WEARS and its payload is a state/meaning/outcome re-evoked or retrieved on encounter (includes the exclusivity 'sole lever' and storage-locus 'where the outcome lives' realizations). Choose a sibling technique instead when: the object is declared the CAUSAL AGENT that supplies/drains/amplifies cognition and compliance is attributed to it (object-as-causal-agent-of-cognition); the listener's identity/will/state is RELOCATED INTO the object so it becomes the address of the person, often operator-held (identity-displaced-into-external-object); the anchor is sited ON/IN the listener's own body and cannot be set down (somatic-self-anchor); or the move is a discrete cue-response trigger install firing a state-shift. The tell separating it from a session-bound prop is explicit export into daily life plus self-administered re-firing/retrieval with no operator present.

nodes.name: progressive-conditioning
nodes.mech: Installs a belief that conditioning compounds with each return, replay, firing, or even sleep — so trance depth and response strength are asserted to accumulate monotonically across sessions, with no ceiling and no decay. The listener's own progress-narrative is made self-fulfilling: any later gap or plateau is pre-read as on-schedule confirmation rather than failure, and the cost of deepening is transferred off the operator onto a structural belief the listener now holds. Realizations range over the accrual vehicle (per-session, per-firing, per-replay, per-orgasm, per-act-of-obedience, during-sleep, via a listener-maintained memory artifact) and over the target (depth, compliance, amnesia-schedule, exercise drive), and over framing — from a plain accumulation claim to an unfalsifiable GEOMETRIC multiplier ("twice as powerful", "a hundred times deeper" per replay/firing, no measurable baseline) that pre-attributes any felt drift to "the recording working" and pre-authorizes dose escalation and session stacking. The lever is one: a self-reinforcing expectancy of increasing effect over repeated engagement.
nodes.disc: Separate from a within-session deepener by the forward-binding to FUTURE sessions/replays (single play explicitly insufficient). Separate from manufactured-conditioning-history, which sources present state from a counterfactual prior history — events that never happened. Separate from environmental reinforcement-schedule shaping (the ABA literature), which titrates a measured criterion, not a belief. The geometric per-replay multiplier ("twice as powerful", no baseline) is a framing variant of the accumulation lever, not a separate move; the cross-replay time horizon is what separates it from in-session intensity multiplier-stacking.

nodes.name: proxy-agent-resistance-offload
nodes.mech: Install an AUTONOMOUS agent that holds real decision-authority the listener defers to, and route the contest through it — displacing surrender-agency off the listener onto a party 'programmed never to lose'. The agent's representational LOCATION (inner part vs in-scene figure) is a parameter. VARIANTS: (a) externally-authored obedient inner character [proxy-agent-resistance-offload] — a named, persistent, seeded-by-a-prior-file part that is definitionally obedient and exempt from justification; the listener's resistance is reframed from 'me vs the operator' (winnable) into 'me vs an internal part that never loses' (defeat structurally guaranteed), and irrational beliefs the listener's reason would reject are assigned to the proxy ('doesn't need it to make sense') and radiated in via a shared-mind premise as ambient feeling; (b) aftercare-clause subconscious [guardian-delegation-inner-agent] — a safety/reassurance clause that names the 'subconscious' as a competent autonomous decision-holder owning the off-switch and timing ('removing the lipstick ends the effects AND your subconscious already knows when to put it on'); the reassurance IS the installation, defusing 'what if I can't turn this off' anxiety while relocating the off-switch into an installed inner authority rather than returning it to the listener; (c) interposed in-scene proxy [interposed-proxy-agent] — a separate figure in the scene is granted real agency and made the actual command-issuer while the operator recedes to narrator (draws the listener in, guides their hands, supplies affection the stranger-operator could not credibly give); authorship diffuses to the admired proxy so compliance feels like inclusion/identification, and the proxy is staged as a permanent occupant carried out of session ('she can live for you'), the wake omitted. Pick by inner-combatant vs aftercare-subconscious vs in-scene-actor — but all install a delegated authority the listener cannot simply reclaim.
nodes.disc: Installs an autonomous agent (inner part OR in-scene figure) that HOLDS authority against the listener and carries the contest/belief, rather than the listener inhabiting it — the tell is delegated decision-authority the listener defers to and cannot simply reclaim. Separates from a genuine agency-reminder/aftercare disclaimer (which hands control BACK), from named-source-authority (which points at a figure outside the listener the operator relays or borrows), and from ordinary guided-imagery characters that are used and released (these agents are non-dismissed and carry real authority). External-scene proxy vs inner named character vs ambient subconscious is the agent's location, a parameter.

nodes.name: replay-until-ready-failure-absorber
nodes.mech: A pre-induction frame positions the file as one installment of a multi-file arc to be replayed "again and again until you feel like you've reached the appropriate level", with success defined as listener-self-judged readiness. This removes the pass/fail pressure that would short-circuit conditioning: any partial result becomes on-track training data and the only failure state becomes not-repeating. Front-loaded before any state work, it neutralizes performance anxiety and licenses repetition — a structural commitment device that rewrites what counts as success across sessions.
nodes.disc: Separate from progressive-conditioning (a depth-accumulation claim) by being a pre-induction EVALUATION FRAME that rewrites the success metric (no pass/fail, only not-repeating fails) rather than asserting cumulative depth. Separate from a post-orgasm scrapbook/consolidation bridge by its placement before any state work and its preemptive, not consolidating, function. Separate from plain expectancy-seeding (which seeds an expectation of an effect) by rewriting the success/failure metric to license replay.

nodes.name: self-perpetuating-object-ritual-loop
nodes.mech: A bundle that chains a ubiquitous environmental cue into a commerce/acquisition obligation and a recurring private ritual, closing the loop back onto re-listening — so post-session daily life is threaded with cue -> obtain-the-object -> perform-the-ritual -> re-install-the-state -> return-to-the-recording. It is not a single anchor but an engineered self-sustaining loop: the environmental cue (seeing red) drives a purchase, the purchased object drives a timed private ritual with sub-triggers, and the ritual re-reinforces trance and operator authority while driving re-consumption of the recording. The object is one node in a loop whose payload is perpetuation itself.
nodes.disc: A multi-node self-sustaining loop (environmental cue + commerce + recurring ritual + re-listen closure), not a single worn re-trigger (portable-object-state-export) and not a single firing of stacked triggers. The tell is the closed loop that recruits commerce and re-consumption, designed to perpetuate rather than fire once; it installs a real post-hypnotic bundle, but the load-bearing payload is the arc/loop shape.

nodes.name: design-space-pedagogy
nodes.mech: A reader-directed pedagogical architecture that presents a family of techniques not as isolated tricks but as a parameterized design space with dials and a default heuristic. Realizations: a 2x2 matrix walked cell-by-cell with a coverage-vs-cost tradeoff; mirror-pairing every value-raising move with its value-abolishing dual plus a normative default; imperatives-then-decision-frame layering that gates when-not-to-use; and twinned exemplars withholding the category names so the reader induces the grid. The reader internalizes a parameterized mental model plus a selection heuristic rather than a rote list.
nodes.disc: Teaches a DISCRIMINATION/SELECTION space (dials, tradeoffs, when-not-to-use), NOT acceptance of a refused claim — separating it from validation-by-demonstration-arc (which earns a contested claim via stacked corroboration). Operates on the READER, not an in-session listener x(t); a non-executable corpus-shape observation citable to no single passage (a container, not a script move). Held separate from the general reader-assent-engineering container on this dial-space tell.

nodes.name: public-avowal-third-party-propagation
nodes.mech: Externalize the installed state so parties OUTSIDE the operator-listener dyad do the reinforcing/propagating work, making a private experience a self-reinforcing relational system that extends operator reach past the audio. VARIANTS by how the outside world is recruited: (a) public avowal / third-party-directed act [public-avowal] — post a named avowal, publicly self-label, tell someone the operator's slogan, share the file, so an AUDIENCE reinforces via self-consistency pressure (having declared it publicly, the listener is pushed to keep believing) and doubles as recruitment/distribution; frequently laundered as defiance/self-proof or prosocial sharing; (b) viral propagation / recruit-new-subjects [viral-propagation-directive] — redirect the whole payload OUTWARD, the listener guides others toward becoming the operator's slave or craves the trigger from others and 'uses it on others', a proselytizing transmission vector (raising exit cost — leaving now requires publicly admitting one was wrong); (c) deputize-toward-a-partner [listener-as-influence-vector] — the subject is made an active recruiter/contingency-manager toward a specific third party (transform your husband into a 'X lover'; or reciprocal ABA where two parties each manage the other's consequences) so the third party becomes co-invested; (d) legible body-signal [body-as-broadcast-signal] — prescribe visible bodily modifications with a READING attached ('leave no question') so the body broadcasts ownership status, every social interaction becomes reinforcement (signal read) or felt violation (not read), and the listener becomes their own observer. All share the lever: the social world outside the dyad maintains the install; pick the register by active-act vs propagation vs partner-deputization vs passive-signal.
nodes.disc: The reinforcing/propagating engine is EXTERNAL to the operator-listener dyad — witnesses, a third party, corpus evangelism, or observers of a body-signal do the work (self-consistency pressure, recruitment, distribution). Reach for it to make the social world maintain the install. NOT a private self-anchor (behavioral-bridge) and NOT a private deliverable to the operator (extraction); the tell is externality-to-an-audience. Distinct from internal-permeation moves, which spread WITHIN the subject (inverse direction).

nodes.name: reader-assent-engineering
nodes.mech: A container for whole-chapter / whole-section / front-matter rhetorical architecture whose target is the READER of a persuasion or instructional text (not any in-text listener), engineering the reader's acceptance of a method, frame, doctrine, or reclassification before it is defended and independent of any subject-facing move. Recurring levers pooled here: front-loading a credibility or distrust regime (dense per-claim citation as truth-proxy; validate-before-you-teach; function-over-form as a precondition); case-then-formalize (a vivid demo licenses a linguistic model retro-fitted onto it); reclassification drills and menu-as-one-logic framings that retrain the reader's default lens; a single mirror-inference making distinct findings feel cumulative; disclosed-placebo self-demonstrating argument relocating the active ingredient from operator to subject; concede-reframe-empower-authorize closing arcs building reader persistence; doctrine-as-paradigm borrowed credibility (yoking a new principle to an already-accepted one plus stacked authority); do-not-reify theory-frames whose force is accumulation-under-one-frame; named-desire testimonial openers setting a yes-disposition; transcript-then-formalize plus ordinary-case replication; serial public failure-correction drills; concede-elicit-constrain-operationalize-defer funnels; recap-as-scaffold / closure-and-test end-matter teaching boundaries through distractors; and authority-by-lineage plus you-already-know-the-basics presupposition. In every case the object acted on is the reader's belief in the system, no listener state is moved, and the strategy is DISTRIBUTED — removing any one passage does not dissolve it.
nodes.disc: Target is the reader's belief in the method, NOT any listener's state — every member is reader-directed rhetoric with no listener-facing move; a distributed corpus-shape observation that survives removing any single citation/case/definition. Reach for THIS as the general reader-assent-engineering tool: engineer the reader's acceptance of a method/frame/doctrine BEFORE it is defended, by any pooled sub-shape — credibility/citation scaffolding, case-then-formalize, reclassification drills, mirror-inference, borrowed-credibility/doctrine-reification, testimonial recruitment, failure-correction drills, concede-funnels, recap-test end-matter, and concede-BEFORE-EVALUATE ordering: universal-lever framing ('everything is an anchor'), front-loaded efficacy/citation ordering so the method reads as explanation-of-a-known-success, and anchor-failure-then-numbered-differential-then-fix diagnose-repair sequences unifying otherwise-unrelated sections. Nearby reader-facing techniques have their own tells: validation-by-demonstration-arc earns acceptance of a claim the reader would refuse cold via stacked corroboration; design-space-pedagogy teaches a discrimination/dial space, not acceptance of a refused claim; concede-then-rescue-forebear concedes, firewalls, and rehabilitates a lineage ancestor; the paratext techniques act on the reader-as-BUYER through the product surface before playback; and arc-shape-engineering is a delivered piece's energy contour, not a printed argument's shape.

nodes.name: unattributable-cause-severing
nodes.mech: A design property in which every operator move is engineered so the subject experiences an outcome but cannot locate its cause — command hidden in a question, depth test in conversation, amnesia probe in discussion, catalepsy in comfortable positioning, awakening in a state-adjustment, hallucination in pantomime, content left for the subject to author, reference deleted for the subject to fill. By severing each outcome from any identifiable operator cause, there is nothing for the subject to attribute control to and therefore nothing to resist; the recurring inexplicably-to-him / at-a-loss-to-understand reactions are the diagnostic signature of the architecture working.
nodes.disc: Acts on the SUBJECT by relocating or erasing the authorship-of-cause he can perceive, rather than sliding a state dimension. Separates from reader-assent-engineering (which persuades the READER — the paired sibling S1 in the same chapter) and from ordinary covertness of a single technique: the tell is that it is the through-line unifying ALL the chapter's moves, an authored resistance-bypass DESIGN rather than one hidden command — a non-executable whole-chapter observation (container).

nodes.name: validation-by-demonstration-arc
nodes.mech: A reader-directed persuasive architecture that manufactures conviction for a claim that would be rejected if stated cold, by staging corroborated demonstrations (or previously-granted premises) first and back-loading the formal claim/apparatus. Staged demos, null-vs-positive result pairings, external witnesses, and stacked premise chains substitute the author's criterion for the reader's own, so the boundary or conclusion feels earned rather than asserted. The reader is run through the very conviction-without-audit process the text is teaching.
nodes.disc: Earns ACCEPTANCE of a contested claim/boundary the reader would refuse cold, via stacked corroboration — NOT a discrimination/dial grid (separating it from design-space-pedagogy). Operates on the READER of a book, no in-session subject state; a non-executable corpus-shape observation citable to no single passage (a container). Held separate from the general reader-assent-engineering container on this earn-a-refused-claim tell.

nodes.name: acceptance-laddered-identity-migration
nodes.mech: A whole-arc escalation architecture that migrates the subject's identity/status through enumerated tiers (guest -> slave -> object; responsive -> commanded -> "controllable is who I am"), where each next-tier claim is warranted by the subject's uptake of the prior tier: the accumulated weight of having-already-accepted earlier stages is recruited as the license or evidence for the next escalation, so the subject experiences each new, larger claim as merely consistent with who they have already agreed to be. The ladder — not any single identity assertion — is the mechanism; the terminal tier is an identity claim the lower tiers exist to purchase. Physical tokens (collar acquisition) and persistence artifacts (mental scrapbook) appear as stage-pivot instruments, not as the mechanism.
nodes.disc: Tiered, whole-arc warrant-recruitment with an identity/status payload. A yes-set / compliance ladder is sentence-level tag-question assent chains building in-session agreement momentum — its unit is the utterance and its effect is reduced critical resistance; here the unit is a named identity STAGE and the effect is a persistent identity/status migration (same consistency genus, different mechanism grain and effect class). A single-act behavioral-commitment device is different too: here the commitment token (the collar) is only one rung's instrument inside the ladder. Consent-manufacture edits the permission ledger (what was authorized, when); the ladder edits the self-concept warrant — prior acceptance is spent as evidence of who the subject IS, not relabeled as authorization (a rung that relabels acceptance as AUTHORIZATION is consent-manufacture, not this). Self-model surgery names the payload face (self demoted to object); this names the purchasing machinery that gets there stage by stage. And cross-session tethering makes a claim on future consumption; the 100-day pacing here is fictional and delivered inside one artifact.

nodes.name: wake-exempting-preserved-trigger
nodes.mech: An explicit, complete-sounding wake ("counted 1-10, wide awake, refreshed, exactly as you were before this file began") that quietly exempts the installed trigger — presenting it as part of the restored self ("that trigger word just sits at the back of your mind, waiting") rather than as a residue. Full recall is preserved (unusual for trigger-install, where amnesia is typical), and that preservation is load-bearing both ways: it reads as a consent/safety move AND functions as the binding surface, because the listener remembers accepting the trigger and therefore feels bound to it. The stance is present-it-explicitly, deliver-it-partially: the reversibility is openly disclosed while only partially delivered, and the disclosure itself is the binding lever.
nodes.disc: Not a clean full reversal and not a standard amnesic trigger-install. The tell is a wake that explicitly restores the pre-file self while carving out and preserving an already-installed trigger, using remembered acceptance as the binding surface. A declarative trigger install is the install itself and does not thematize the wake; this is the reversibility-framing move at the wake that exempts the already-installed trigger. And acceptance-laddered-identity-migration is a multi-stage identity-escalation ladder; here remembered-acceptance-as-binding is a byproduct of a single whole-script wake-framing property, not a staged warrant chain.

nodes.name: boundary-dissolution-no-not-operator-region
nodes.mech: One sustained operation dissolves every boundary the listener could use to bound the operator's reach — sleep and hypnosis and arousal are equated, dreaming and trancing and waking are equated, the listener's subconscious is equated with the operator, and the listener's wants are equated with the operator's wants. The same boundary-erasing operation is applied across multiple INDEPENDENT axes, and because it recurs at every layer, removing any one equivalence does not restore a boundary. The cumulative payload is that no mental territory remains that the listener can point to as definitively not-operator.
nodes.disc: Separates from any single equivalence/confusion move (which erases one boundary) by applying the SAME operation across multiple independent axes — the repetition-across-axes is the payload; separates from arc-shape-engineering by being a specific reusable mechanism (comparator/boundary removal) rather than a contentless arc contour. Separates from closed-epistemic-self-validation-loop by erasing the inside/outside boundary rather than validating claims through self-induced states.

nodes.name: closed-epistemic-self-validation-loop
nodes.mech: The whole text is wired into a closed epistemic loop in which the script's claims are validated by the states the script itself induced: images-are-hypnotic justifies imagining, imagining proves helplessness, helplessness justifies accepting control, and accepting control justifies accepting further claims — each layer's output feeding the next layer's premise. This gives grip with no external anchors (no partner, triggers, or props); the listener's own induced experiences become the corroborating evidence, making the script self-contained and self-validating.
nodes.disc: Separates from the individual moves it wires together (each a discrete suggestion) by being the whole-text observation that those moves form a closed circuit; separates from boundary-dissolution by validating claims through self-induced states (an evidentiary loop) rather than erasing the inside/outside boundary; separates from closed-graph-foreclosure in that the closure is evidentiary (self-induced states corroborate escalating claims), not a routing of every behavioral lever to deepening.

nodes.name: removed-self-as-install-material
nodes.mech: A single continuous causal chain in which each stage's byproduct is the next stage's raw material: the conscious mind is externalized, then physically extracted and stored, and that stored substance becomes the literal ingredient of the devotion the listener then ingests. Because the removal produces the install medium, the two phases are materially linked rather than merely sequential, and the installed devotion is framed as self-sourced — foreclosing the "this was done to me" reframe, since the listener cannot reject the install as foreign when it was made of them. A prior substrate reframe pre-licenses treating consciousness as poolable substance. Nothing is discarded; the self that resisted is recycled into the mechanism of its own replacement.
nodes.disc: The tell is the MATERIAL LINK — the extracted self is literally the ingredient of the install, spanning premise through container to ingestion. Distinct from an ordinary remove-then-install sequence (phases merely adjacent) and from dissociation/amnesia moves alone (the removed material is discarded, not recycled into the install). Distinct from other whole-arc foreclosure entries by lever: authorship relocation via material recycling, not routing-every-lever-inward or nested-dependency sealing.

nodes.name: anti-stuck-filter
nodes.mech: Append an escape-hatch caveat to a specific immobility or stuck suggestion ('...knowing that if for any reason you needed to open your eyes, you always could'), preserving a reality-testing / agency floor under depth and heaviness suggestions that were not explicitly consented to as literal inability. The move is additive — a caveat line attached to the stuck suggestion, not an omission or a general affirmation.
nodes.disc: Appends a caveat to SPECIFIC immobility/stuck suggestions — distinct from a general power-to-choose affirmation and from a consensual suggestion of literal inability; distinct from semantic-exit-cue-hygiene, which withholds phrasings rather than adding a caveat.

nodes.name: assessment-teaching-firewall
nodes.mech: During baseline assessment, when the learner cannot do a step, the examiner silently completes that step, repositions the learner for the next, and continues — deliberately NOT teaching — so measurement and instruction never contaminate each other and the baseline stays an uncontaminated measure of the true entering repertoire; later gains are then attributable to instruction, not to the assessment.
