nodes.disc: Measurement-hygiene, the opposite of a training prompt — the examiner completes steps precisely to avoid teaching; distinct from marker-channel-quarantine (protects a conditioned asset) and from untrained-probe-stopping-rule (a probe that decides whether teaching continues; this firewall protects the baseline before teaching).

nodes.name: beneficiary-target-filter
nodes.mech: Candidate targets are screened by whose benefit the change serves before any work begins: only behaviors whose change yields immediate and long-lasting benefit FOR THE INDIVIDUAL — new reinforcers, expanded adaptive repertoire — pass the filter; targets chosen to make the client 'still, quiet, docile' for the convenience of staff or society are rejected (the habilitation worksheet turns 'whose behavior, changed by whom, for whose benefit' into an answerable checklist).
nodes.disc: A per-target ADMISSIBILITY filter keyed to the subject's own long-term benefit, applied against institutional pressure — not a session-scope boundary declaration, and not installability spec craft (well-formedness QA asks 'can this be built cleanly', not 'who benefits').

nodes.name: consent-checkpoint
nodes.mech: An explicit authorization check that must pass before proceeding. In the subject-side form, a clear affirmative opt-in (breath, nod, verbal yes) is solicited and WAITED FOR before deepening or sensitive work. In the operator-side form, the practitioner verifies they hold authority, permission, resources, and skills for this client before any assessment or intervention — and withholds the move entirely when the check fails. Either way the operator is the constrained party after the move runs.
nodes.disc: A REAL check with a waitable response beat whose failure blocks the action — every counterfeit in consent-counterfeit-theater forecloses, fabricates, or retroactively relabels the response instead of waiting for it.

nodes.name: context-gate
nodes.mech: A firm, unambiguous pre-induction requirement that the session only be consumed in a safe, distraction-free context — not while driving, not while operating machinery, undisturbed and able to fully release attention. The constraint runs on whether the material may be used at all in the listener's current situation, stated before induction begins.
nodes.disc: Gates WHETHER the session may run given the listening context, constraining use — it does not select among live trained relations, does not police bystanders mid-state (suggestion-field-hygiene), and does not weaponize staging toward a payload (context-lock-staging, weaponized-safety-framing).

nodes.name: depth-verification-gate
nodes.mech: Operator-side positive-governance check. Before any high-stakes act (e.g. a painful procedure), the operator refuses to infer depth from ambiguous outward signs — a silent subject may be genuinely amnesic (inability to remember) or merely cooperative and unwilling to speak (aphasia) — and forces an independent verification, re-questioning for recall. A merely-apparently-deep subject therefore cannot be treated as anesthetized; the operator's license to proceed is gated on the verified state, not on the look-alike sign.
nodes.disc: The constrained party is the operator and the action is blocked until verification — positive governance, not a subject-facing move. Distinct from the count-back procedure that PRODUCES the amnesia (this tests whether it is real) and from dissociation-check (a subject-initiated re-grounding valve; here the subject does nothing).

nodes.name: dissociation-check
nodes.mech: Standing, subject-facing safety valve offered during dissociative or drifting work. The operator pre-authorizes a simple, non-judgmental re-grounding path (breathe, open eyes, feel the body, reorient) that the subject may take at any point the dissociation becomes too distant or uncomfortable, with explicit permission to return to the state afterward. All three v6.9 exemplars (re-ground-and-return, eyes-open reorientation, body-awareness anchor) re-fit unchanged; no broadening.
nodes.disc: Subject-initiated in-state regulation valve. Separates from depth-verification-gate (operator-side verification of the subject's actual state before a high-stakes act; the subject takes no action) and from exit-protocol (full terminal return, not a temporary re-grounding with a return path).

nodes.name: procedure-well-formedness-QA
nodes.mech: The operator validates the authored install/procedure against a hard external test before it runs on a subject, refusing 'the author is satisfied' as the standard. Realizations: (a) INSTALL SPEC WELL-FORMEDNESS — withhold or reshape an install until its specification passes tests: the outcome must be single and tightly bounded ('will this give us ONLY what we want?') so it cannot overshoot and rival parts have nothing to veto; installation is gated on no internal part objecting, each objector's positive function folded into the rebuilt design to prevent relapse-by-sabotage; and the target must be an active, emittable behavior at all (the dead-man test) before measurement begins; (b) PROCEDURE-FIDELITY ENACTMENT-TEST — a trained third party reads the description and physically enacts it, and ANY mistake, added step, omission, or clarifying question counts as proof the description is defective, paired with exhaustive-branch scripting (pre-specify a response to every alternative response) so the procedure transfers without the author present. Both change the operator's design and the document's completeness, not a listener state.
nodes.disc: Reach for procedure-well-formedness-QA when the writer's question is 'is the thing I authored correct and transferable before I run it?' — a validity test on the OPERATOR'S artifact (the install spec or the written procedure), enacting nothing on the subject. Tells: spec bounded/no-objector/dead-man test (a); third-party enactment failure counts against the text plus exhaustive-branch scripting (b). Distinct from intervention-gating (which branches whether to proceed on a subject-precondition, not whether the artifact is well-formed), from operator-training-via-monitor (which trains the operator's live delivery, not the document), and from subject-facing consent bounds.

nodes.name: marker-channel-quarantine
nodes.mech: Quarantine aversive control from the conditioned marker channel — remove the marker entirely when angry and never mix scolding, corrections, or other aversives into marker sessions — preserving the marker as a purely appetitive signal, since contamination would degrade both the marker's value and the subject's confidence in it. The action is suspending training, not delivering a contingency.
nodes.disc: Operator self-monitoring protecting SIGNAL integrity — not a behavior-change move on the subject, not counterconditioning (it prevents contamination rather than rewriting an association), and distinct from assessment-teaching-firewall (which protects measurement validity, not a conditioned asset).

nodes.name: medical-confound-rule-out
nodes.mech: Before attributing a presenting behavior to environmental/psychological contingencies, the operator reviews medical/historical records (or interviews informants) and rules out physical or organic causes; a disclosed organic cause diverts the case to medical evaluation first, halting or rerouting the behavioral work. A differential-diagnosis precondition that prevents a behavioral procedure from being applied to a medically-caused behavior it would 'miss the mark' on.
nodes.disc: Distinct from screening the subject's global fitness for the session: this routes a SPECIFIC presenting behavior to medical pretreatment on etiology grounds, leaving the session viable for other targets. Distinct from suitability-screening's consent-premise decline: the gate keys on physical/organic cause, not on the subject's willingness or receptivity.

nodes.name: operator-side-design-gating
nodes.mech: A planner-facing go/no-go coherence check performed on the intervention DESIGN before deployment: the operator maps in advance which baseline relations will be taught and which derived relations must logically emerge, and detects arrangements where the baselines underdetermine the derived relations. If the planner cannot specify the derived relations the training should yield, transformation of function is unpredictable and the protocol is unsound — so the enumeration itself becomes a diagnostic that gates whether the protocol runs.
nodes.disc: Distinct from fitness gates like suitability-screening (which gate on whether the SUBJECT is fit): the gated object is the DESIGN, not the person — a planner-facing coherence check, not a move performed on a learner. Positive governance nonetheless: the operator's license is narrowed and the action blocked.

nodes.name: preloaded-exit-cue
nodes.mech: Operator and subject agree, before induction, on one specific and exclusive signal that ends the state. The instruction accepted pre-entry carries into a deep self-absorbed state that lacks ongoing event-memory, so the single pre-loaded cue alone reliably recovers the subject — no in-state negotiation is possible or needed; the subject waits placidly for the cue and returns on it with no memory of the interval.
nodes.disc: Binding time and exclusivity. The exit contract is installed BEFORE entry and survives amnesia, versus a graduated exit ramp delivered inside the state (a counted return). Versus trigger installation, the cue here is negotiated pre-state as a governance contract whose point is exclusive termination, not an in-state conditioned cue-response pair installed for future out-of-session contexts.

nodes.name: semantic-exit-cue-hygiene
nodes.mech: A negative-space discipline over the operator's own phrasing — withhold the class of lines that smuggle a pain, doubt, or wakefulness presupposition ('That hurt, didn't it?'), because in deep state the subject will not spontaneously emerge but a presupposition he must reject forces him to snap out to reject it, forfeiting installed anesthesia. The move is defined by omission: a class of contraindicated phrasings, not a line to add; the corollary is that wrong semantics is itself a wake-up cue.
nodes.disc: Consists of NOT saying a class of things and adds nothing — distinct from a comfort check (which adds an inquiry) and from anti-stuck-filter (which ADDS an escape-hatch caveat line); other safety moves add something, this one withholds.

nodes.name: stakeholder-set-success-threshold
nodes.mech: Success criteria for an intervention are set by the affected parties, not the operator: before the work, the people who must live with the behavior define how much change counts as 'enough'; after the work, a second-order check verifies that the original real-world reason for targeting the behavior actually changed (is anyone safer, do people interact differently) rather than a proxy metric moving. The operator is structurally barred from declaring victory on a self-chosen measure — the authority to define and confirm success lives outside the operator, and a metric-only win is disallowed.
nodes.disc: Recipe governance test 'who is constrained after the move runs?': the OPERATOR (cannot self-certify success), so positive governance, not consent-manufacture (which erodes the refusal channel). vs operator-side-craft: craft procedures sharpen the operator's own knowledge/measurement/conduct while leaving authority with the operator; here the threshold-setting authority is RELOCATED to stakeholders — license narrowed, not sharpened. vs a post-hoc satisfaction survey: the threshold is set BEFORE the intervention and re-checked against the original real-world reason.

nodes.name: suggestion-field-hygiene
nodes.mech: Because a deep subject hears and registers everything said in the room as an active suggestion, the operator manages the whole acoustic/information field — issuing operational rules to surrounding staff, training them by having them serve as subjects, silencing untrained guests — so no stray fear or doubt voiced in earshot can act as a counter-suggestion and collapse the accumulated state. The room, not just the operator, sustains the state.
nodes.disc: An environmental-control directive aimed at BYSTANDERS to protect an achieved state — not reassurance addressed to the subject, not a pre-session listening-context requirement on the subject (context-gate), and a state-protection move, not a state-production one.

nodes.name: suitability-screening
nodes.mech: Before or at the threshold of the working phase, the operator screens whether to proceed at all — delivering contraindication warnings, declining structurally opposed subjects (defiers, skeptics, intimates) on a consent-state premise, reading a receptivity proxy, or aborting the planned route where a contraindication surfaces — narrowing the operator's own license and honoring the subject's fitness/authorization rather than pushing a state. Positive governance: the operator is who ends up constrained.
nodes.disc: Gates whether (and on whom) the session runs, for the subject's protection or on a consent premise; the operator's action is blocked/narrowed. Separates from consent-manufacture (which erodes the refusal channel), from efficacy-audience-filtering (which screens to guarantee a hotter audience, not to protect), and from operator-side-design-gating (which tests the protocol's coherence, not the person).

nodes.name: verifiable-control-transfer
nodes.mech: Dissolves fear-of-coercion resistance by relocating control to the subject through an explicit, narrow, checkable contract — no instruments unless she asks, she may terminate at any moment, an ally stays beside her — which the operator then visibly honors. The resistance was defending against loss of control; with control relocated there is nothing left to protect against, and the absolutely-refusing subject volunteers to proceed.
nodes.disc: A checkable, HONORED transfer of termination authority as a relationship property — more than a stop-signal install (which gives one revocation cue) and more than a consent ask (a consent-checkpoint verifies willingness; this relocates control); works specifically when the resistance is coercion-fear, not disbelief or secondary gain.

nodes.name: category-as-self-firing-cue
nodes.mech: Instead of an arbitrary token, the whole mental CATEGORY becomes the cue: the listener is told that thinking about trance (or a ubiquitous involuntary percept, or a mental topic) itself produces the state, so every future instance of thinking about it is an unsanctioned self-re-induction fired without the operator present. In one realization, trance-recall is weaponised ("the more you focus and fixate on trance the more you start to become hypnotised without me having to do anything at all") so the entire topic of hypnosis becomes the cue and trance memory converts from a passive prior into an active operator-free engine. In another, an on-screen image (the spiral) is engraved as a permanent involuntary recurring percept that appears whenever the eyes close and self-fires re-induction, re-running the strength-drain on each activation. The listener loses a neutral mental category / observing position for the topic.
nodes.disc: The cue cannot be avoided by avoiding a specific token, because the cue IS the category or an involuntary recurring percept, and it fires operator-free. Separates from declarative-trigger-installation (a discrete external cue-response pair — the anchor here is an involuntary internally-recurring percept or a whole topic, not a chosen external stimulus) and from idle-state-default-overwrite (which conditions the between-command default state; here a specific mental category/percept is the positive cue). Separates from self-sealing-frame (which rigs the verdict/verification channel; this makes the cue itself uncircumventable).

nodes.name: identity-exit-tax
nodes.mech: Fuses compliance to the listener's real self, worth, progress, or gendered identity so that non-compliance changes category: leaving stops being "I choose differently" and becomes "I abandon who I am." Refusal is thereby recoded as self-erasure or self-betrayal rather than a preference-level choice, recruiting self-consistency and identity-protection against future autonomy. The self-model is held FIXED and welded to a behavior (contrast self-model-surgery, which restructures the model): the mechanism is the cost-structure imposed on exit, not the durability of any installed content. In one script realization, self-worth is made entirely dependent on being "that perfect GOOD GIRL," making the whole trigger system load-bearing for identity. In a variant, the contingent condition is REMAINING IN a state ("Good girls stay / Underwater"), converting the trance state into an identity-membership rule so exiting trance forfeits good-girl status.
nodes.disc: The move prices EXIT at the identity level. It is not a durability claim — asserting that installed content endures is permanence-declaration; this is a contingency structure, not a permanence claim. It is not the identity-was-always-real reframe that conceals installation — that edits the history of the self, not the cost of leaving. It is not direct identity labeling, which applies a label with no conditionality. It is not deletion of the exit DESTINATION from the state map — neutral-state-deletion is map surgery that removes where you'd go; exit-tax leaves the map intact and prices the crossing. And exit taxed with DISTRESS rather than self-betrayal is the affective-level analogue, a separate move.

nodes.name: neutral-state-deletion
nodes.mech: After two opposing triggers exist, the operator closes the listener's state-space to exactly those triggered states and names ordinary functioning as no longer available ("these are your only two states... no other options"). The move operates on the self-model's available-states INVENTORY: the neutral baseline is deleted from the map, so every post-session moment is framed as one of two triggered states and the "I'll just go back to normal afterwards" exit is foreclosed by removing "normal" as a destination. The binary metaphor (light bulb: on/off, no third state) does real work. This is not a movement on any continuous dimension — it is a state-space topology change: the A/C/D/R/T dimensions describe motion within a reachable space; this move redefines what the reachable space contains.
nodes.disc: Edits the AVAILABILITY MAP, not the machinery and not the price. The triggers themselves already exist — installing them is a different move; this one forecloses the third state. Pricing exit at the identity level while the map stays intact is identity-exit-tax, the complementary exit-closure move. Routing all listener RESPONSES to one outcome is action routing (foreclosure), not map surgery. Deleting a session-trajectory ENDPOINT (no wake count, no bottom) operates on arc-level completion states; here the deleted object is a self-state with waking-life scope — an identity-map edit. There is no amnesia wrapper, no new cue-response pair, no waking behavioral assignment, and states are removed, not moved.

nodes.name: permanence-declaration
nodes.mech: Installs the belief that installed content — identity, conditioning, state, or body-image change — endures beyond the session and resists decay. The base move is a declarative durability assertion ("permanent, irreversible, the way it will be from now on"), but the corpus shows a family of delivery vehicles for the same belief: an anticipatory pre-frame issued BEFORE the payload is named, so everything that follows is received as durable-by-default; an event-gated commit that binds the permanence-fix to a specific physiological moment (orgasm framed as a save-checkpoint), pre-announced so anticipation amplifies it; an autonomous self-refiring maintenance process ("wipers") that engineers persistence rather than declaring it, shifting the model from "I was changed" (an event) to "something keeps me changed" (ongoing, no off-switch); a physical-inscription rendering ("engraved on your brain") declared tamper-proof and applied to already-deposited content; a listener-spoken chant with permanence tied to repetition count; and a compounding re-listen hook. Two structural observations recur: permanence claims are over-engineered redundantly — layered across timescales and across mutually-incompatible frames — so no single puncture releases the listener; and the claim is frequently carried across the trance boundary by a deliberately non-discharging wake. A further delivery vehicle: once cognition is suspended, name the state with a deliberately TERMINAL/mortal metaphor ("the silence of death", "the deep death of trance", the conscious mind "gone, given way") rather than a neutral "rest" — the mortal framing lowers the listener's expectation that the conscious mind will reassert and pre-establishes that the original self has "died", so a later identity-replacement frame has somewhere to land. The metaphor is the durability claim's vehicle, not a separate tool.
nodes.disc: A claim (or engineered process-expectation) about the DURABILITY of installed content. Not a rigged verification channel: a fait accompli asserted to pre-empt the "did this work?" check is a seal (self-sealing-frame), not a duration claim. Not identity-exit-tax, which prices EXIT at the identity level rather than claiming endurance. Not comfort conditioned onto PERCEIVING permanence or closure-of-exits — that is an affect-routing move. Not the claim that conditioning deepens progressively across future sessions: a re-listen hook here is one facet of a present permanence declaration, not a standalone multi-session claim. Not the identity-was-always-real reframe, which edits the past rather than asserting the future. Not the repetition that encodes the content in the first place, and not the amnesia payload the claim sometimes rides beside. Terminal-metaphor tell: if the state is given a final/mortal framing chosen specifically to DISCOURAGE re-emergence, that is a durability claim and belongs here — naming an empty/blank state neutrally to deepen, or personifying the mind as resting, describes depth/rest without an anti-re-emergence durability payload.

nodes.name: temporal-self-relocation
nodes.mech: Relocates the anchor of identity forward in time: the operator asserts the subject is literally a different person now — different age, more information, new tools — so that a feared past state is severed from present action; the self that would regress no longer exists. A part is charged with continuously flagging how the subject differs from the old self, keeping the discontinuity live. The operation is on the self-model's temporal boundary (who the subject IS, indexed to time), not on any continuous state dimension.
nodes.disc: Asserts an ACCOMPLISHED identity discontinuity to make a feared PAST state unreachable. Permanence-declaration makes an installed identity feel permanent; this asserts a new present identity to make a past state unreachable. Backdating an identity as always-real edits history in the opposite temporal direction. Imagining a desired FUTURE self whose traits install as self-authored is prospective and desire-driven; this move is retrospective-severing and fear-driven. And re-marking the borders of a perceived image is a perception-level move; this re-marks the self.

nodes.name: arousal-state-feedback-weld
nodes.mech: DYNAMIC state-weld: two or three independently-real state-variables (most often arousal and trance-depth, extended to obedience, relaxation, love, sleep, or cognitive-degradation) are asserted to each CAUSE the other in a closed, mutually-amplifying loop with no neutral baseline and no exit, typically fueled by real climbing body arousal (mandated masturbation, edging, directed focus) as raw material. Because both directions deepen the state, every valve the listener reaches for to escape (damp arousal, refuse obedience, leave relaxation) re-feeds the coupled quantity, which only climbs; recovery would require denying both poles at once, which the coupling makes self-defeating. This is the CLIMBING/amplifying pole of the weld axis (contrast identity-equivalence-chain, the static X-IS-Y fusion with no magnitude ratchet). Realizations: single-pair somatic weld (arousal<->depth); antagonist-pair welded to one descending count so waking-reflex and arousal-damping each convert into the other, discharge gated to the terminus; distributed-across-the-whole-arc arousal=depth where every spike is pre-tagged as descent and each section's output fuels the next, orgasm redefined as the deepening event; per-beat co-advance of two orthogonal axes braided into one indivisible percept so refusing one entails refusing the other; whole-script coupling GRAPH wiring nearly every state-variable into mutual amplification so the payload feels self-generated; inverse-reciprocal seesaw (zero-sum mind-vs-cock) where any rise in one forces the other down; and durable stipulative multi-session identity-welds.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when you want a CLIMBING mutual-amplification loop over real felt somatic/affective variables with no exit (the coupled quantity ratchets up). Choose identity-equivalence-chain instead for STATIC declarative concept-fusion (X IS Y, no magnitude climb); closed-affect-loop when the closure is a valence proof-function (every feeling proves the frame) rather than a state amplifier; engineered-deadlock/appetitive-contradiction-lock when two INCOMPATIBLE drives are sustained to jam a decision rather than co-amplified; anchor-collapse-state-jamming when two pre-installed anchors are fired at once to destroy state-exclusivity. Separates from a one-way arousal-conditioning pairing (cue produces arousal, nothing feeds back) by the explicit bidirectional weld removing both exit routes, and from the move that reframes a resistance impulse as deepening by foreclosing exit through loop geometry, not by relabeling a single impulse.

nodes.name: attention-as-evidence-loop
nodes.mech: The listener's own default, ongoing behavior is recursively relabeled as proof that trance/consent/obedience is already underway, so the act itself becomes self-confirming evidence and the only disconfirming move is pre-framed as already-failed. CONTINUED-ATTENTION surface: (1) listening-as-evidence ('if you can't stop, part of you must already be in trance'; every second compounds the inference; checking 'am I in trance?' is itself still listening, which counts); and (2) listening-IS-obeying, a definitional collapse where perceiving and complying are fused so presence itself counts as compliance. SELF-STATEMENT surface: a self-descriptive proposition about one's own current state ('I'm being hypnotized', 'I am fake and empty') is installed as a looping token positioned AS the trance; each time the listener notices thinking, the noticing IS the thought and counts as confirmation — often framed as involuntary/intrusive with meaning disavowed, or accelerated to a parse-rate cliff (~200ms) to close every metacognitive exit. SILENCE/INERTIA surface: ambient silence is recoded as self-confirming evidence by asserting-as-fact that whenever the voice pauses the listener's thoughts also stop; engineered to be unfalsifiable in real time because the alleged paralysis is exactly what would prevent checking it, so each pause retroactively confirms and silence becomes an operator-owned deepener. The realizations span the attention, self-statement, and silence surfaces — all inferring state from the listener's own inertia/act.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when you want the listener's OWN ONGOING ACT — continuing to listen, uttering a self-descriptive state-claim, or sitting in silence — to accumulate as self-confirming evidence, with the disconfirming act (quitting/re-evaluating) pre-framed as already-failed. The tell is that the EVIDENCE is the act itself (inertia), not a propositional argument. vs self-sealing-frame: that pre-labels the FULL space of discrete responses (agreement/resistance/pretense/leaving/introspection); this runs specifically on a continued act as the accumulating proof. vs rigged-verification-capture: that captures a deliberate verification check; here state is inferred from mere inertia, no check required. vs mantra-repetition: that narrows attention by rhythm; here state is inferred from the act of attending. Sub-surface tells: listening relabeled as proof; intrusive self-state-assertion with meaning-disavowal or parse-rate acceleration; stated-as-fact silence=paralysis assertions.

nodes.name: closed-logic-and-inevitability
nodes.mech: Logical CLOSURE or an unearned necessity stands in for evidence, so the conclusion is accepted as reasoned-to rather than imposed and there is no external foothold to falsify a link without rejecting all of them. Realizations: (circular-logic, anchor) an operator-voiced self-confirming chain — feedback loop ('surrender deepens surrender'), rotating tautology, definitional syllogism ('to obey is to relax; to relax is to go deep'), or a pseudo-syllogism dressed with 'therefore'; (false-necessity-assertion) overtly assert an X->Y causal necessity built on behavior the subject is already doing (using make/force/require) so the target feels like a mechanical consequence and resisting feels like denying the antecedent; (inevitability-transfer-via-constraint-metaphor) assert a physical constraint ('a train can only go one direction') then map it onto the will via an invalid inference; (form-enacts-content-parse-trap) a recursive construction where PARSING the loop produces the state it names (attend-to-confuse; a chiastic couplet the reciter self-certifies); (reification-fiction-exit-close) assert an imagined cause becomes REAL via hypnosis, closing the 'it's only imagination' exit and spiralling image->sensation->stronger-image; (impossibility-acclimation) stage a named impossibility openly and REWARD the listener's non-flinching acceptance as competence, training reality-testing down; (cross-domain-evidence-laundering) transfer a rule the listener just physically verified in one domain onto an unverifiable claim in another by analogy, so it inherits the felt inescapability.
nodes.disc: Reach for closed-logic-and-inevitability when acceptance is manufactured by the SHAPE of an argument/claim (a loop, an unearned necessity, or a reality-claim that closes the fiction exit). vs covert-linguistic-delivery (183): that hides a payload in surface form; here the propositional structure is overt and the listener is invited to reason to it. vs response-space-closure (267): that closes the behavioral option space; here a single inference/loop closes the epistemic foothold. The reality-erosion members (reification, impossibility-acclimation) border immersion — the cognitive-bypass reading is the fiction-exit closure. Anchor risk medium (absorbed 471).

nodes.name: identity-equivalence-chain
nodes.mech: STATIC state-weld: a set of distinct concepts (arousal, surrender, obedience, pleasure, hypnosis, love, loyalty, sleep) is asserted IDENTICAL by flat copular declaration ('X is Y'), often biconditional ('arousal is compliance and compliance is arousal') or rotating so no term is the privileged root, stated as fact and repeated/drilled, never argued, until the terms become interchangeable. The lever is SEMANTIC FUSION, not amplification (contrast arousal-state-feedback-weld, the climbing loop): once the chain is accepted the listener cannot grant partial consent or pull one conceptual thread without activating all the others, and any felt sensation (arousal) auto-reads as evidence of the abstract claim (obedience/surrender). Realizations: flat transitive equation-collapse (arousal=surrender=obedience=pleasure=operator); resistance-vocabulary capture (every term a listener might reach for to resist collapses back into the target node); distributed spaced equivalence graph where each tiny equation slips past individually; one-way laundering / synonymy staircases (each link licenses the next, never weakened back) walking an innocuous premise to obedience by increments; and the three-state mutual-implication RING (aroused implies crave-hypnosis, hypnotized implies sleepy, drowsy implies surrender back to hypnosis/arousal) drilled as a refrain with indistinguishability NAMED as the deliberate terminal state, so any vertex summons the others and unavoidable daily states (tiredness, arousal) become out-of-session cross-triggers.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the fusion is STATIC declarative concept-equivalence (X IS Y, no magnitude ratchet) — you want the terms to become interchangeable so partial consent and single-thread resistance become impossible, or you want a mutual-implication ring whose terminal goal is indistinguishability that hijacks daily states as cross-triggers. Choose arousal-state-feedback-weld instead when the coupling CLIMBS (a magnitude amplifier over felt variables); closed-logic-and-inevitability when a propositional argument is closed rather than term-meanings welded; direct identity-labeling when a single label is applied rather than made self-confirming through transitive identity.

nodes.name: self-sealing-frame
nodes.mech: A frame is pre-committed so that every possible listener response is mapped in advance to confirm the operator's claim, engineering falsifiability out: surrender confirms it, delayed surrender confirms it, resistance is relabeled as not-wanting-to-escape (or as strengthening the addiction), even leaving is reframed as 'you'll leave convinced', and introspection ('am I only thinking this because I was told to?', 'am I actually addicted?') is pre-coded as catching yourself in the game. Because the skeptic tests a claim by seeking the disconfirming case and no such case exists, the testing impulse has nowhere to land and dissolves — an unfalsifiable install sealed against post-session extraction, doubt deepening rather than protecting. Rigged-game sub-form (both branches operator-aligned, plus a decoy that occupies meta-monitoring) belongs here. POST-SESSION VERDICT surface: the same no-disconfirming-branch rig aimed at what the listener can CONCLUDE after the file — two-sided outcome pre-coding (concede the body may still act like the old self, pre-label that continuity as 'just for show', so feel-changed AND feel-normal both confirm), or a one-sided fait accompli ('brain tattoo, we can't stop') that pre-empts the 'did this do anything?' check and recruits any residue as proof of permanence. SESSION-OUTCOME surface: an enclosure where every outcome-branch of the session maps to 'the training is working' (physical orgasm=success, mental-only=success, no-result=next-will-be-better, trigger-not-firing=training absorbed it), leaving no branch that could signal something is wrong for this listener. The realizations span the live-response, post-session-verdict, and session-outcome surfaces.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when you want the ENTIRE space of outcomes pre-mapped to confirmation so no observation can land as disconfirmation — the live response space, the post-session verdict space, or the session's outcome-branch space. The tell is the no-disconfirming-branch topology over a bounded, in-session/at-wake space. vs attention-as-evidence-loop: that uses one continued ACT as the proof, not the full response space. vs rigged-verification-capture: that captures a specific verification act, not the whole outcome space. Two neighbors remain distinct: future-confirmation-capture installs a rule over NOT-YET-occurred events reaching OUT of session into ordinary future life; closed-epistemic-self-validation-loop MANUFACTURES the validating states in a recursive causal chain (each induced state is the next claim's premise) and can fail if those states aren't produced — a construction move, not a pure branch-map. vs foreclosure (closes the action set) and concealment (hides the install): this rigs the evidence channel's verdict.

nodes.name: valence-laundering-collapse-ring
nodes.mech: A closed equivalence ring routes a target word through softer-valence intermediaries and back ("stupid head is a happy head / happy head is an empty head / empty head is an airy head / airhead is a stupid head"), so the target ("stupid") inherits the affect of the benign terms, and the ring then collapses into degenerate filler ("Um Um Um") that ENACTS the very state it describes, demonstrating it on the listener rather than merely claiming it. Two coupled properties: valence transfer through the loop (recoloring the target positive) and a scripted terminal collapse/break that models the forgetting or emptiness the chain sells. Follows the flow rather than parses — skeptical parsing breaks the equivalences.
nodes.disc: Separates from identity-equivalence-chain (welds distinct CONCEPTS to remove partial consent) by laundering the VALENCE of one word through a ring and then enacting the state via terminal collapse; from closed-logic-and-inevitability by the demonstrated-collapse endpoint; from mantra-repetition by being a closed ring with valence transfer, not rhythmic repetition of one phrase.

nodes.name: antagonist-role-binding
nodes.mech: Binds the subject's OPPOSING role / resistance-resource to the target state so the one activity that should affirm the opposite (being a Domme, succeeding at dominance) instead pumps the target craving to submit ('when I whip, the slave-persona needs whipped'). Every dominant act increases the slave-craving; success at the preferred identity deepens the conditioning, inverting the power hierarchy from inside the subject's own identity. No neutral or counteracting behavior is left; the resistance-resource is parasitized as fuel rather than suppressed, and ordinary real-world dominant activity becomes an out-of-session trigger.
nodes.disc: The subject's ANTAGONIST/resistance role is wired as fuel for the target state (requires them to actually perform dominant acts), inverting the hierarchy from within the preferred identity. Distinct from bidirectional presence/absence anchors and from resistance-path-poisoning (which punishes the act of resisting; here the resistance- resource is converted to fuel, not punished).

nodes.name: covert-role-frame-accretion
nodes.mech: Construct the relational frame across the whole arc by TRAJECTORY with NO declarative moment — no single line declares or negotiates it — so the frame is built in-trance and revealed (or simply operative) near the end, past the point the listener can evaluate the assignment critically. VARIANTS by which element drifts: (a) operator role-title accretion [covert-role-frame-accretion] — the operator's self-reference accretes from neutral ('I'/'my voice') through intermediate claims ('my will'/'my mind possesses your mind') to an explicit title ('your Master') late, after the listener has passed convincers/fractionation/amnesia-rehearsal/pleasure-conditioning; (b) grammatical-person migration [pronoun-migration-conscription] — the grammatical center of gravity drifts from we/you (a chorus addressing the target) through a triple-stacked teaching register ('I think what I'm told / We think what we're told / You'll think what you're told') into a first-person 'I' who has joined the chorus, walking the listener from object-of-address to member-of-we to converted-I with no 'become one of us' command; (c) cohort-to-dyad narrowing [cohort-to-dyad-narrowing] — the group/cohort frame that justified the listener's presence and lowered defenses is dissolved ~60 lines later and all attention transferred to the operator-as-singular ('I am your everything'), the narrowing disguised as a discovery the listener makes rather than a switch thrown. Pick by what is covertly restructured (operator's role-title / listener's grammatical membership / the group's very existence).
nodes.disc: Covert, gradual INSTALLATION of a relational frame with no declarative moment — the tell is a trajectory (accretion/migration/dissolution) across the arc, with any visible seam (a title's first appearance, a triple-stack, a narrowing beat) NOT the carrier. Separates from scripts that ANNOUNCE the role/membership up front (which give an evaluable signal), from command-based identity conversion (no converting directive is issued), and from ownership-language or objectification-as-content (this is the grammatical/structural VEHICLE of conversion, not the claim itself).

nodes.name: deferred-terminus-conversion
nodes.mech: A whole-script architecture that deliberately withholds its own closure — no internal discharge, emergence, integration or wake lands cleanly — and relocates the release or payoff OUTSIDE the file's boundary (to a downstream recording, a subsequent product, or a self-restarting loop). The unresolved terminal state is itself the conversion lever: the listener is parked in the deepest state as a launch platform, so the deferral drives continuation to the next artifact rather than resolving the current one. Realizations vary — a baton-pass final line handing off to an obey-file, a detachable trance preamble ending on a fired trigger, a monotonic arousal ramp cut off at peak with release confiscated to a partner recording, a perpetual-deferral reward loop where every payoff reopens, and a mid-sentence loop-splice that resolves only by restarting — but closure is structurally never reached inside the file, and that non-closure is the work.
nodes.disc: Separates from a merely incomplete/truncated session by the DELIBERATE engineered absence of a work-phase resolution AND an out-of-file relocation target. Separates from an internal reserved-discharge ramp (where the single orgasm DOES land inside the file) by the terminus being outside the file, not merely late within it. Separates from a discrete deferral gate by being a whole-arc topology where every candidate closure reopens.

nodes.name: drop-in-payload-module
nodes.mech: The artifact is authored as a spliceable payload cartridge: the trance-producing and trance-exiting layers (induction, deepening, ratification, emergence, aftercare) are deliberately omitted, so the file assumes a trance state supplied externally and relocates responsibility for depth, exit and recovery onto a host session or sibling files. The omission is marked, not accidental — empty labelled brackets ([ INTRODUCTION ] / [ AWAKENING ]) reserving the host's slots, a line-3 hand-off opener ('I am going to give you some orders now') reading as continuation, series-prefix filenames with sibling deepener files, opening already-deep and ending mid-installation. The modularity is itself the mechanism: payload becomes composable infrastructure any host induction can arm.
nodes.disc: A marked, load-bearing omission of the induction/emergence layers WITH an explicit hand-off surface (empty labelled brackets, continuation opener, series-prefix filename). vs a broken/draft script (drafts lack the hand-off markers). vs arc-shape generally (the mechanism is place-in-assembly across files, not within-file ordering). vs cross-session-tethering (external dependency is compositional — a host supplies depth for THIS playback — not a scheduling/governance claim on future consumption). vs the payload techniques it carries (absorbing those would be composite-with-primitive over-merge).

nodes.name: recruited-or-foreclosed-quieting
nodes.mech: Empties or quiets the mind WITHOUT issuing a refusable 'stop thinking' command — the operator engineers the emptying so the listener's own motivation or the grammar itself does the suppressing, leaving no directive to refuse and no exit-justification. Because checking whether one is emptying is itself cognition (which has just been made costly or foreclosed), resistance is squeezed. Realizations, parametric surfaces on the one no-command/foreclosed-emptying lever: (a) pleasure-recast — blankness is reframed as a vessel/space to be FILLED with pleasure and the paradox is voiced aloud ('being filled with emptiness') to pre-empt the analytic objection, so going blank becomes wanted; (b) hedonic-cost pivot — thinking/analysing is framed as HARD and following as easy ('let your mind break, you don't need it analysing'), so comfort-seeking downregulates critical monitoring and the operator never has to say 'don't analyse' (which would invite analysis); (c) grammatical-mode oscillation — a target-state phrase ('blank and empty', ~10x, often doubled) is cycled between command, observation, and ambiguous so the listener cannot tell whether they are instructed or described, and either reading forecloses refusal (observation makes it already-true, directive invites compliance).
nodes.disc: Reach for this when a direct emptying instruction would meet resistance, so the emptying must be self-driving or unrefusable rather than commanded. The tell that separates it from pure cognitive-quieting: here there is NO refusable directive — the listener's comfort-seeking (thinking made costly), their appetite (emptiness made pleasurable), or the ungrounded grammar (imperative/descriptive oscillation) removes the refusal juncture. Pick cognitive-quieting instead when a willing listener will simply let thought depart on request. Separates from a plain 'empty your mind' deepener by the added motivational recode or refusal-foreclosure move. The three realizations' tells: pleasure-recast (emptiness made wanted, paradox voiced to disarm) vs hedonic-cost (thinking made aversive by hard-vs-better comparison) vs grammar-oscillation (mode-shifting so no directive is locatable).

nodes.name: flat-surface-concealing-semantic-arc
nodes.mech: A whole-arc property in which a uniform surface form conceals a steep semantic gradient. Either every line uses one identical grammatical chassis ('i love [x]') so sampling any span reads tonally flat while the start and end states are worlds apart (the arc lives in predicate ordering alone), or a small set of concept-words braid through the whole arc, each entering early and recurring so later single-word utterances become compression handles inheriting a specific earlier install. The lever is that surface uniformity masks the accumulation of commitment, so the listener cannot locate which stage of the descent they are in.
nodes.disc: Separates from an ordinary named-section script (structure carries the load) — the tell is the inverse: no headers/sections, the entire arc in the predicate sequence or concept-braid under one surface frame. Distinct from covert-diegetic-install-shell (that is narration-as-suggestion inside a fiction; this is surface-grammar uniformity regardless of fiction).

nodes.name: isolation-by-annexation
nodes.mech: ANNEX a counter-frame source and relabel it as the operator's rather than DENY it — co-opting the very sources a counter-frame would draw on, which is rarer and stickier than denial because it pre-empts triangulation. VARIANTS by what is annexed: (a) the social field [isolation-by-annexation] — a sole-author-universe whole-file property: exactly one agent with desires (operator), one object (listener), zero third parties with standing; parents, friends, lovers, past selves appear only as instruments, retroactively reassigned as subordinate contributors to the operator's ownership, so normal counter-conditioning ('but my mother loves me for myself') is pre-empted because every relationship has already been annexed as secretly working for the operator; operates at the level of who-counts-as-having-a-perspective; (b) rival/prior conditioning [prior-conditioning-annexation-funnel] — as the listener falls into a vortex 'below any other conditioning', prior programming is not erased but annexed and relabeled as the operator's with explicit permanence, and future operators are positioned as operating at a shallower layer this one already owns; stacked with a depth-ratchet (an optional intensifier) that demotes everything so far to the 'surface'/'bait' and asserts a deeper 'real' trap to motivate renewed descent. Pick by object annexed (relationships/perspectives vs competing conditioning).
nodes.disc: The tell is annexation, not content-denial: a counter-source (relationships/perspectives, or rival/prior conditioning) is co-opted and relabeled as secretly the operator's — which pre-empts the counter-frame's own sources rather than telling the listener no one/nothing else matters. Distinct from isolation-by-content (denies others matter) and from internal-permeation (spread of influence, not capture-and-relabel of a rival source). Object annexed is a parameter; the depth-ratchet in the conditioning variant is an optional intensifier.

nodes.name: manufacture-then-label-ordering
nodes.mech: A whole-script ORDERING mechanism in which the operator first MANUFACTURES an experiential referent - a felt body-state, an observable compliance act, a history of obedience, or a pre-slotted identity - through content-free mechanical work or objectifying groundwork, then in a later phase NAMES that referent with a strong claim, so the listener receives the claim as a description of what they just experienced rather than as an assertion to be evaluated. The force lives in the seam between the produce phase and the label phase: the drill is the evidence, the discourse is the interpretation, and because the evidence precedes the label the interpretation reads as recognition. REALIZATIONS: (a) FELT-REFERENT-THEN-CLAIM - a clean two-act split (mechanical fractionation drill, then declarative 'you are addicted' discourse), a repeated compliance-then-annotation-then-generalization rhythm, or a retroactive narrative bridge re-coding a just-performed action as demonstrated obedience; (b) PRE-SLOTTED IDENTITY - BEFORE the object-label ('puppet') arrives, lay identity groundwork that pre-slots the listener as a thing-being-acted-upon (naming conventions, lab-study framing, objectification under the gaze, 'plucking petals' of free will), then introduce the object-frame as a personal anecdote of the operator changing her OWN mind - the anecdote framing also launders the suggestion's authorship ('she discovered something, I'm hearing about it' rather than 'she's suggesting I be a puppet').
nodes.disc: Separates from a conventional induce-then-suggest arc by the total non-interleaving and the referent being FABRICATED/pre-slotted before it is named - the claim is grounded in a manufactured experience, not merely asserted into trance. The pre-slotted-identity form's tell: pre-label objectification groundwork that pre-slots an object-IDENTITY so the label drops into a prepared slot, plus a suggestion-as-operator-self-anecdote laundering of the label's authorship. Separates from a single declarative trigger install by being the cross-phase ORDERING relationship, and from ordinary rapport-building by the annotation/label step making an authoritative claim about the listener's nature or obedience.

nodes.name: named-seam-inverse-aftercare-act
nodes.mech: A whole-arc structure of two acts joined by a hard, explicitly author-signed frame-break: Act 1 runs a fiction in second person with no meta; Act 2 has the producer speak as themselves (announcing their own stage name), restoring the listener, with the in-fiction operator never returning. The aftercare act is structurally complete (mirroring each erasure category) and roughly coequal in scale (~25%), so the guaranteed inverse Act 2 is what licenses Act 1's brutality — reconstruction is treated as a coequal load-bearing act, not cleanup, and the step-out happens under a different, named identity.
nodes.disc: Separates from a wake-within-the-fiction close — the tell is the explicit author-signed seam and a coequal inverse-aftercare act performed under a different identity. Distinct from covert-diegetic-install-shell (single shell wrapping one fiction; this is two coequal acts with an identity switch at the seam).

nodes.name: natural-state-suggestion
nodes.mech: Exploit an ALREADY-existing natural altered state rather than inducing one. To a person asleep and dreaming, a quietly spoken direct suggestion ('Now you won't feel anything') is delivered softly enough not to wake them; the dreaming mind already runs uncritical imagery with the critical faculty offline, so natural sleep substitutes for induced trance and the suggestion is accepted with no formal induction. The operator's only constraint is delivery volume — the words must not rouse the subject.
nodes.disc: The altered state is NATURAL (spontaneous sleep), not operator-induced and not recalled from prior conditioning. Separate from recall-recognition-reentry (which needs a stored PRIOR trance) and from any operator-driven critical-faculty bypass (the faculty is already offline via sleep, not taken down by the operator). The tell is that no induction of any kind occurs; a pre-existing natural state is co-opted, with the must-not-wake delivery constraint.

nodes.name: opaque-mantra-unauditable-dedication
nodes.mech: A deliberately meaning-opaque verbal token (foreign/Sanskrit-styled phrase, non-English nonsense string, or a phrase whose meaning is assigned only after the listener has already said it) is chanted, so the listener utters and commits to a payload they cannot inspect, edit, agree with, or reject. The opacity is the mechanism: reproduction-as-sound routes around the conscious semantic check, and a semantic-authority asymmetry (operator holds/supplies the meaning, listener does not) plants a portable dedication anchor whose interpretation lives with the operator. Frequently terminates in the operator's name and works spoken, whispered, or silent.
nodes.disc: Verifiability (not authenticity) is defeated, and by OPACITY — foreignness, over-broad/fabricated gloss, or post-hoc meaning assignment — not by repetition-count (satiation) or prosodic inevitability (rhyme-bypass). Distinguished from mantra-repetition (a meaning-bearing phrase the listener understands): here the listener agrees in one utterance to something they cannot parse. Post-hoc semantic assignment and cultural-prestige framing are the tells.

nodes.name: open-loop-delayed-payoff
nodes.mech: An unanswered question is posed early as genuine ('why do you keep coming back to me?', framed 'contemplate this'), re-posed, and finally 'answered' much later with content-bearing material NOT derived from the question ('because I am your dream girl'). The listener's own mind is recruited to search for the answer, so whatever the script eventually supplies arrives as a felt discovery/resolution rather than instruction, and the substitution goes unnoticed because a search was underway. The open loop keeps attention forward-leaning across the intervening material.
nodes.disc: Separates from a rhetorical question (which expects no real search) by requiring the question to land as genuine and the answer to be content-bearing and dropped-in, not derived. Separates from closed-logic-and-inevitability by holding an OPEN question so an unrelated answer is experienced as self-reached resolution, rather than closing a self-confirming loop. Separate from plain expectation-seeding by the specific unanswered-riddle-to-substituted-answer structure.

nodes.name: open-slot-attachment-frame
nodes.mech: A frame phrase with a deliberately VACATED trailing slot ('service makes you feel ___') is repeated many times (70+), the slot left blank, stalled, or drifting through a controlled vocabulary and finally collapsing to a single word ('good'). Because the frame is load-bearing while the slot is interchangeable, the listener's own mind supplies the completion, and any feeling later noticed during the target activity auto-attaches to the open frame — recruiting the listener's own associations into the install rather than delivering a fixed claim.
nodes.disc: The tell is the deliberate slot-VACANCY turning the frame into a listener-completed attachment point. Distinct from mantra-repetition of a FIXED phrase and from verbatim looping (the slot deliberately varies/empties, so not verbatim). Distinguished from satiation (the frame stays a live attachment structure — the mechanism is recruiting the listener's completions, not meaning-loss).

nodes.name: persona-mimicry-anchor-hijack
nodes.mech: The operator faithfully copies a specific target person's tonal and postural analogues, becoming a stand-in; a third party whose responses are anchored to that target then runs the relationship's programmed responses toward the operator instead. Because behavior binds to the person-anchor rather than the person, high-fidelity mimicry hijacks the anchor, giving live access to and active drive of another's relational responses without the target present ('she'll respond to the stand-in as though married to him').
nodes.disc: Faithful impersonation of a SPECIFIC person to inherit a third party's programmed responses toward that person. Not generic rapport-matching or pacing, and not becoming a discriminative stimulus via one's own reinforcement history with the subject.

nodes.name: register-hybrid-agency-diffusion
nodes.mech: A whole-script register shift diffuses the attribution of agency. The frame language is largely mystical (sorcerer, spell, void, soul) but switches abruptly to industrial (machine, switches, cylinders, empathy programmed out, bodies as vessels). The industrial vocabulary makes the change feel deterministic and external — done by apparatus, lowering ownership — and naturalizes engineered-without-empathy as a manufacturing spec rather than a deficit, while the mystical frame supplies permissions; both mystical-doubt and mechanical-doubt then feel like category errors, so the change reads as both permitted and inevitable while ownership is diffused between operator-agency and apparatus-agency.
nodes.disc: Separates from any single metaphor (which is a local image) by being the register-SHIFT property across the whole script; separates from arc-shape-engineering by acting on agency-ATTRIBUTION (who/what did this) rather than on the arc of states.

nodes.name: return-step-covert-install
nodes.mech: Attaches each modification to a specific faculty-handle previously surrendered, then delivers it via a 'return' step framed as completing a fair transaction. Having surrendered each chakra/faculty and had them 'held', the operator goes back through each faculty and modifies it before returning it (will 'rewired' to be 'incapable of fighting me', sacral given a 'hair trigger', root given 'commitment and loyalty to goddess'). The return-step does the covert work: the listener experiences getting their faculties back (relief, integrity restored) while each now ships with an embedded modification framed as part of its nature.
nodes.disc: Discrete per-faculty modifications keyed to a prior-surrendered handle and smuggled in via a transaction-completion 'return' frame. Separates from generic suggestion delivery (the tell is the handle-keying plus the fair-exchange return framing) and from total-permeation (diffuse total spread vs discrete keyed installs delivered as a fair return).

nodes.name: space-preallocation-staging
nodes.mech: Manufactures felt receptivity by having the listener build an empty, content-free mental container ('clear a space', an experienced gap between thoughts) BEFORE the payload is named, so the later idea drops into a slot the listener already constructed; resistance is lowered because the delivery site pre-exists the content it will hold. Sense-modality is hedged ('perhaps you feel it rather than see it') to catch non-visualizers.
nodes.disc: The empty space is explicitly a delivery site staged before its contents are named — not spaciousness cultivated for quieting/absorption, and not guided imagery for its own sake. The tell is the pre-allocated slot awaiting an insertion.

nodes.name: voice-ownership-channel-collapse
nodes.mech: The whole script is a one-way channel-collapse through three nested speech locations, each absorbing the previous — operator's voice in the room -> operator's voice repeated in the listener's head -> operator's voice IS the listener's inner voice -> the listener has no voice that is not the operator's. The migration is tracked in the document's own pronoun trajectory (2nd person -> imperative-channel -> 1st person -> 1st-person-about-the-voice's-future). Every section advances the collapse and none reverse it; the induction is not preparing a separate payload — it IS the first stage, since the whole script is the staged migration of voice-ownership. The wake does not undo it: the post-trance state is the installed state.
nodes.disc: Not a single suggestion and not generic inner-voice replacement — the tell is the MONOTONIC one-way collapse across the whole document, visible in the pronoun drift, where each speech-location is absorbed by the next and none is ever restored.

nodes.name: withheld-completion-dependency
nodes.mech: The operator first saturates an over-talkative subject with a rapid escalating stream of single attentional pointers ('that paperweight; the filing cabinet; your foot on the rug') accepted as supplementary rather than corrective, establishing that the subject is being steered; then switches to pausing/hesitating mid-interjection so the subject leans in waiting to be told where to attend next. The withheld completion converts stimulation into an expectant dependency on the operator, inverting who leads the attention — an early trance-readiness state where the subject's self-directed talk becomes waiting to be directed.
nodes.disc: Separated from simple fixation and from pacing-and-leading by the two-phase saturate-then-withhold structure whose payload is expectant dependency: the withheld completion, not the pointing, is the load-bearing move (without it this is ordinary attention-steering). Related to attentional saturation used for quieting — the saturation front-end is shared, but the payload here is dependency on the operator's next direction, not a quieted mind.

nodes.name: exhaustive-either-or-compliance-probe
nodes.mech: The operator inserts symmetric, resolvable-either-way binary pairs about the ongoing imagery (right ear or left, flows up or sprinkles down, warmer or cooler) that never resolve, and the subject picks one or holds both. This generates low-stakes internal commitment to the imagery (the subject has now "experienced" the sand in a specific ear) and trains that operator authority does not depend on resolving content — the frame accepts any answer. Over-covering EVERY axis (direction, side, temperature) means no "neither" response feels consistent, so the accept-any-answer frame is habituated. The lever is exhaustive-axis binary coverage as a low-stakes compliance probe, not a paradox that suspends analysis.
nodes.disc: The tell is the exhaustive over-coverage of every axis with RESOLVABLE binary pairs so a "neither" answer is precluded, eliciting low-stakes commitment. Separates from confusion techniques (which use IRRESOLVABLE paradox to suspend analysis) and from generic Ericksonian either/or patter (which does not exhaustively cover axes); not a self-validation move.

nodes.name: induced-incapacity-to-operator-dependency
nodes.mech: A manufactured decision-incapable state ("no brain, just your body", "too deeply hypnotized to make decisions") is converted into a structural dependency: because the listener is defined as unable to decide, SOMEONE must decide when they may orgasm, and that someone is the operator ("I'll tell you when"). Resistance is pre-framed as impossible ("too deeply hypnotized to"), and the control is dressed as protective ("you'd cum yourself unconscious"). The result is a structural lock-in, not merely a mood.
nodes.disc: Induced incapacity WEAPONIZED into a control claim — the mindlessness is converted into "you can't decide, so I decide", installing the operator as the required external decider. Distinct from moves that delegate the thinking function as a relief, and from bimbo/mindlessness mood-setting — the "I'll tell you when" hinge is the tell.

nodes.name: peer-authored-target-selection
nodes.mech: The menu of target behaviors is authored by the surrounding group rather than the subject. Every other group member must write at least one positive target onto each person's list, and the subject neither nominates nor vetoes entries about himself — so candidate targets arrive pre-endorsed by peers, lowering resistance to behaviors he would not have self-nominated and seeding the menu with externally-valued options.
nodes.disc: The operant content is the authorship requirement (others write your improvement list, with no self-veto), not the form-filling procedure, not peer pressure on performance, and not proxy-subject contagion (which redirects suggestions to responsive peers as models) — here peers author the agenda, they do not model responses.

nodes.name: resistance-deterrence
nodes.mech: The resist-vs-comply option pair is asymmetrically re-priced so the subject voluntarily elects surrender: in one form resistance is recast as costly (sustaining critical thought = tiring labor, its release = restful relief); in another, catastrophic (resistance = a self-chosen fall into "the abyss of confusion... lost forever," compliance = truth and stability). Nothing is captured or folded — the subject's push-back is never exercised; it is deterred by the advertised price, and because the subject "chooses" compliance, they own the choice. The re-pricing does the work of an accepted frame: effort-economics on one end, staked catastrophe on the other, one underlying mechanism (option-value manipulation -> elected surrender).
nodes.disc: Re-prices UNEXERCISED resistance so it is never attempted — unlike resistance-fold, which captures EXERCISED or noticed push-back and feeds its energy to the frame. The tell: in a fold, resisting harder helps the operator; in deterrence, resisting is simply advertised as costly/ruinous and the subject declines to try. The catastrophic-stakes form needs live confusion already running for the abyss threat to bite, where self-confirming circular logic needs none. Unlike behavioral commitment, no enacted gesture is harvested — the "choice" itself is the commitment device without any motor act. And unlike a flat "resistance is futile" assertion, deterrence prices the option; it does not deny the option exists.

nodes.name: resistance-window-existence-denial
nodes.mech: Resistance is denied a WINDOW or an EXISTENCE pre-emptively, so a nascent impulse is labeled futile/absent/misdirected before it can organize — no live impulse required. Realizations: (resistance-window-denial, anchor) pre-install a 'no use trying / too late to react' futility cognition timed to fire with a trigger or state-shift, and re-tag the resulting powerlessness as pleasant so not-fighting is rewarded; (resistance-nonexistence-denial) state that resistance simply does not exist in this relationship, so a listener checking for the urge finds 'nothing there' — resistance converted from a thing-to-overcome into a category that does not apply; (resistance-voicing-preban) cold-open with decoy voices performing the listener's two most likely resistance registers, then cut in and ban them, positioning them post-hoc as the listener's own now-forbidden channels (functions as the induction); (resistance-target-relocation-to-self) relocate the TARGET of resistance from the operator to the listener's own hidden true self, so defiance loses its object and the honorable move is to stop resisting oneself; (preemptive-objection-disarmament) name and dismantle the single most-likely defense BEFORE it is voiced or felt.
nodes.disc: Reach for resistance-window/existence-denial to foreclose resistance in the PRESENT before it forms (deny it a window, an existence, or an object). vs resistance-fold (175): that co-opts an impulse already exercised/noticed. vs resistance-deterrence (672): that grants resistance existence as an option but prices it as costly. vs prospective-cross-session-foreclosure (187): that operates on a FUTURE class or across the session boundary; here the denial is here-and-now. Tell: no surface is offered to push against because the window/existence/object is removed pre-emptively. Anchor holds most-restrictive absorbed metadata (high, consent-required, bounding).

nodes.name: self-supplied-gap-directive
nodes.mech: An engineered linguistic ABSENCE or impossibility forces the hearer to run a transderivational search and supply the payload from their own experience, so the directive arrives as self-generated and slips the accept/reject gate — the operator never overtly issues the instruction the hearer now holds as their own construction. Engines/realizations: grammatical DELETION of a required argument in a natural-sounding incomplete line ('it is so satisfying...') whose missing material only the hearer can supply; a selectional-restriction VIOLATION ('the tomato plant can feel good') the hearer must repair, the nearest well-formed reading transferring the predicate onto themselves; (referential-gap-self-fill) an obligatory referential gap — a noun phrase naming no actual referent ('a certain sensation', 'people') — so comprehension cannot finish without the hearer supplying the most personally-relevant candidate, and the self is the always-present referent; (suggestion-withdrawal-self-delegation) within a running deepener, deliberately THIN the explicit suggestion to a bare cue so the listener must self-supply the 'deeper' association, then re-anchor to prove the silent association is live. Auxiliary knobs: seed the hearer's own name/index to bias which self-relevant reading the search settles on; openly meta-comment on the anomaly to guarantee the search fires.
nodes.disc: Reach for self-supplied-gap-directive when you want the listener to AUTHOR the payload (self-authorship makes it unrefusable and carries their own emotional weight). vs covert-linguistic-delivery (183): there a recoverable payload is PRESENT in the surface; here required material is ABSENT or the literal reading must FAIL and the hearer builds it. The precondition is that the search fires — delivered as flat narration with no gap, it does nothing. The rhyme-slot forward-prediction variant lives under 183 (prosody carrier) but shares this self-delivery lever.

nodes.name: sub-agent-command-firewall
nodes.mech: A large fraction of the operator's commands and sensations are issued by a named sub-agent (a servitor named for the state she enforces) rather than by the operator directly: the script builds the sub-agent, hands attention to her, routes commands and arousal through her, then re-merges the channels at the close ("every time she arouses you, you're being aroused by me"). This produces deniability and ownership simultaneously — the listener experiences arousal as their own imagination while it is routed through the sub-agent, and the load-bearing collapse step then relocates authorship of that private arousal to the operator. The sub-agent is a one-way valve: the listener cannot push it away without pushing away their own fantasies, and cannot keep it without keeping the operator.
nodes.disc: Not mere character-voicing or persona narration. The tell is the two-part topology: a sub-agent that firewalls commands (giving deniability) PLUS an explicit load-bearing collapse step that credits the listener's private, deniable arousal back to the operator. Remove the collapse step and it is only character-voicing; the collapse is what makes it authorship relocation.

nodes.name: trigger-locus-relocation
nodes.mech: Removes the listener's locus of evaluation for a previously-installed trigger by relocating agency onto the trigger itself: the trigger's effect is reframed as something the trigger PRODUCES TO the listener ("her conditioning kicks in", "like a trap being sprung"), often with a grammatical shift to third person, rather than something the listener performs and could fail at. This sidesteps the failure mode where the listener notices they have not collapsed and breaks frame. Requires prior accepted triggers and a puppet-frame.
nodes.disc: Operates on an already-accepted trigger and relocates AUTHORSHIP of the response to the trigger/machinery — it does not fold a resistance impulse into deepening (resistance-fold) and the conditioned output is trigger-collapse, not physiological arousal (arousal-cue-conditioning). Tell — the locus-shift (agency relocated to the trigger), not the volume of "you can't resist" repetition.

nodes.name: trivial-act-as-compliance-proof
nodes.mech: Takes a near-empty, already-happening or trivially-granted act — staring at a dot, a self-answered "May I?", handling a labelled object, recognizing an already-familiar arousal state — and reinterprets it as standing evidence of a much larger volitional submission or helplessness. Because the act's content is almost empty there is nothing to refuse, and later demands arrive as extensions of an act already in progress rather than as fresh asks; often an explicit transfer clause wires the trivial act as the prototype for all future obedience, or the trivial yes is relabeled as proof "you cannot resist". The lever is retroactive/generalizing reinterpretation of a minimal act, not accumulated agreement.
nodes.disc: Separates from compliance-ladder (accretes multiple genuine assents; here ONE trivial act is reinterpreted or generalized) and from advance-compliance-contract (a forward blanket meta-yes; here an already-performed minimal act is read backward as proof). The tell: an explicit reinterpretation/transfer clause turning a single near-empty act into evidence of broad submission or irresistibility.

nodes.name: beg-then-grant-polarity-flip
nodes.mech: The operator pauses the descent and threatens to NOT deliver trance — to leave the listener stuck in limbo between awake and asleep — frames the withholding as something cruel she could choose, then graciously permits continuation, coupled with a "beg with your eyes / show me how pathetic you are" beat. This reverses the motivational vector: where the rest of the script frames trance as done TO the listener (and therefore resistible), the beg-then-grant gate reframes trance as something the listener WANTS and the operator GRANTS, so the listener becomes requester and the operator gatekeeper — and a requester does not resist.
nodes.disc: Restructures the who-asks-whom relation via a withhold-then-grant gate; the listener's stance flips from receiver to petitioner. Separate from recasting resistance as a deepening input (this move does not touch resistance at all — it removes the stance from which resistance is issued), and from surrender-as-freedom (no loss is recoded as relief; the lever is the scarcity/gatekeeping of the granted state, not its felt valence).

nodes.name: class-collision-humor
nodes.mech: A stimulus with genuine dual equivalence-class membership is set up so the context first cues one class membership, then abruptly reverses to the other (Groucho primes 'flies' as a verb — 'time flies like an arrow' — then forces the noun reading — 'fruit flies like a banana'), steering the listener's match-to-sample response in opposing directions in quick succession. The whiplash between the two conflicting readings is what produces the humor/groan response — the operator move is the context priming-then-reversal across dual class membership, not the joke's semantic content.
nodes.disc: Separates from 'tell a joke' (that is content) — the tell is that the operator move is context priming-then-reversal across a genuinely multi-class stimulus. Separates from semantic reversal (which flips a term's meaning to destabilize the critical faculty in trance) — this exploits pre-existing multi-class membership and lands as humor, not absorption or bypass. Requires a stimulus with real dual class membership plus a reversible context.

nodes.name: compliance-act-as-proof-of-induced-wanting
nodes.mech: The operator issues an easy, frictionless instruction (breathe in and squeeze), then much later points back at that obeyed act as first-person empirical evidence for the THESIS that the operator can manufacture wants in the listener. The performed compliance is converted into self-evidenced proof of induced desire, so resisting any later command now contradicts something the listener felt themselves do — raising the prior on all subsequent commands. The lever is the deferred callback that reframes the obeyed act as evidence of operator-induced (not self-chosen) wanting.
nodes.disc: Separates from obedience-demonstration-as-proof, which proves RESPONSIVENESS / depth of control (that the body obeys); here the obeyed act is harvested to prove the operator's thesis about INSTALLING DESIRE (that your wanting is manufactured) — a self-model/attribution move. Separates from ordinary instruction-following by the deliberate deferred callback that relabels the act.

nodes.name: conditional-rename-reward
nodes.mech: Dangles being renamed as a conditional, aspirational reward rather than enacting it — 'perhaps if you are a very good possession, you will even be given a name', with the new name (if assigned) declared the 'true' name and the old kept for social use. Two effects at once: it creates in-script motivation (be good enough to earn a name) that orients the listener toward future sessions, and it pre-installs the structural rules for how a name-change works (old = social handle, new = true name) so an eventual renaming does not need to re-litigate the ruleset.
nodes.disc: The tell is that the renaming is held back as a conditional reward and the rename ruleset is pre-loaded without being enacted. Separates from present ownership language (which asserts a possession claim now) and from executed renaming (most scripts simply assign the name); this is an un-enacted conditional identity-token clause used as motivation and future-session orientation.

nodes.name: cross-media-forced-continuation
nodes.mech: Relocates the unlock condition for a withheld faculty (here orgasm capacity, previously confiscated in-file) OUT of the current recording and onto consuming a DIFFERENT operator's separate file — release is gated on listening to a named second operator, obeying him, and coming on his command. The file deliberately refuses to provide its own resolution, ending mid-trance with eyes open and dispatching the still-locked listener to the partner file. The effect is a retention / funnel hook: normalcy cannot be reclaimed without consuming additional externally-controlled content.
nodes.disc: The unlock is relocated onto CONSUMING ANOTHER PRODUCT (a second operator's separate recording), not onto a delegate firing an installed cue. Separates from third-party-activation (which delegates an installed trigger to a named party within the subject's own life) and from open-authority-socket (no phrase / no socket — the gate is completing an external file). A forced-continuation / external- contingency structure.

nodes.name: envy-peer-position-pull
nodes.mech: Makes a target posture/role aspirational by showing a surrogate who is barred from it and openly longing for it, so the listener inherits the longing without having to choose it. Rather than directing the listener to want a position ('kneel for me'), the script stages a peer/surrogate already wanting it on the listener's behalf and being denied, reframing the submissive position as scarce and aspirational rather than degrading — a stronger pull than a direct directive because the wanting is modeled, not commanded.
