nodes.disc: Separates from addiction-framing (desire-by-denied-peer-position, an inter-agent relational pull, not a linguistic craving frame on the listener); from a 'kneel for me' directive (the surrogate's surprise-at-own-wanting and structural denial are the tell — the desire is inherited, not asked for).

nodes.name: exposure-dose-object-not-session
nodes.mech: An artifact-kind property: the piece is a stim/loop, not a bounded session. It has no rapport-induction-deepening-install-awaken trajectory, no marked entry or exit, and no operator persona giving instructions — it opens mid-state and loops back mid-state. The structural functions other scripts spread across a session are folded into the texture of the loop (saturation substitutes for induction, a brain-tattoo motif for the awakener-blocker, the coda for a deepener). The conditioning model is exposure-DOSE (run in the background on repeat) rather than session-EVENT, which shifts weight onto any external-trigger install and makes session-shaped taxonomy categories a poor fit.
nodes.disc: Separates from a defective or incomplete session because the absence of entry/exit is DELIBERATE — the induction/deepener/awakener functions are present but folded into the loop texture, and success is dose-over-time not a bounded arc. The tell is 'no defined start or finish, designed to run on repeat', a change in the KIND of object, not a missing part.

nodes.name: forbidden-attention-authority-test
nodes.mech: The operator introduces a vivid catastrophe the conscious mind would reflexively orient toward (the room/body catching fire), then explicitly directs the subconscious to ignore it and keep listening. Continuing to listen despite the imagined threat is made proof that the subconscious has ceded safety-signaling authority to the operator. The threat is never resolved as a literal scene — it exists purely as a forbidden-attention test whose being-obeyed demonstrates authority over the listener's own safety orientation, after which senses 'turn off' as consequence.
nodes.disc: Unlike an obedience demonstration, which fires a COMMANDED response and cites the response as proof, nothing here is commanded to be DONE — a threat is staged and its being-IGNORED proves authority, then the threat vanishes unresolved. Not literal fear-play/content: the tell is the threat's function as an authority test over safety-signaling, not as a scene. This overrides the safety-orientation exit — a reachability/authority-topology move.

nodes.name: front-end-gift-directed-obligation
nodes.mech: The operator renders an initial no-cost service (a free home inspection); when paid work is then offered while the obligation is live, reciprocity directs the discharge of the debt to the specific benefactor. The target both awards the business to that firm and stops comparison-shopping, so the consideration set collapses to one vendor and price scrutiny is suppressed, the actual profit mechanism.
nodes.disc: A front-end free service attributable to a specific firm followed by a paid offer while the debt is live; not a genuinely disinterested favor. The paired boundary condition separates it from generic gift-giving: the gift must leave a viable repayment channel, since blocking repayment reverses the effect into resentment.

nodes.name: future-commitment-binding
nodes.mech: Pre-installs a standing rule that ARBITRARY FUTURE verbal commitments extracted under a specified overwhelm condition (here tickling → judgment-less "bimbo airhead") bind the subject and must be executed afterward — "any promise made while tickled goes deep into your unconscious", tagged with a "don't they?" presupposition that presents the alleged unconscious-binding mechanic as already-known. The subject's own prior consent is used as the binding agent, and operational control is handed to any future third party who extracts a promise under the condition. The payload is a transferable consent-override over unspecified future behavior, reaching outside the recording.
nodes.disc: Binds ARBITRARY future commitments extracted under a condition (not a predefined cue-response), keyed to no named party, reaching outside the recording. Separates from third-party-activation (a specific installed cue delegated to a named party) and from open-authority-socket (a phrase-socket firing a fixed installed state, whereas this binds open-ended future content) and from consent-manufacture proper (the counterfeit here is temporal — using future overwhelm to pre-authorize unspecified acts).

nodes.name: grammatical-reification
nodes.mech: Walks a word across grammatical roles — entering as a quantifier of absence ("nothing for your mind to do"), repeated as a standalone sentence, then promoted to a noun naming a contentful internal state ("in that nothingness lies the key"). The role-shift manufactures a referent a later trigger can point at: a bare vague cue is given a felt sense indexed to the specific word, making the eventual trigger word semantically self-justifying. Rides on the salience accumulated from prior uses but the reification, not the repetition, is the move.
nodes.disc: The mechanism is grammatical-role PROMOTION (quantifier to noun) that reifies a word into an experienced entity — it precedes and is distinct from any trigger-pairing. Separates from layered-repetition (which re-encodes a fixed proposition; here the proposition itself is manufactured by role-shift, not re-stated) and from trigger-install proper (no snap/contract is asserted here).

nodes.name: internal-event-keyed-trigger
nodes.mech: Installs an enumerated cue-response pair whose firing cue is a structural event of the listener's own cognition or self-reference — a thought forming, a resistance impulse being noticed, an introspective check occurring, or the subject's own self-referential act (an installed name/self-label thought of in the third person, so ordinary self-thought fires the response and the trigger cannot be dropped without losing self-reference itself) — rather than any operator-supplied or environmental token. Because the cue class is exactly the faculty that would monitor, test, or resist the state, the trigger is self-firing (no operator presence required), self-policing (fires at the frequency of the listener's own cognition), and untestable by design (checking whether it landed is itself an instance of the cue, so self-monitoring backfires). The installed response is a distinct automatic routine that runs instead of, consumes, or weaponizes the cued mental act: a replacement mantra, a dissolution of the forming thought, a discharge phrase-reflex, or a state-flip into blankness; the blankness form may carry a paired reward (only compliance is rewarded), be re-keyed from voluntary thinking onto an involuntary autonomic act (blinking) to make it unavoidable, and be wrapped in self-amnesia ('remembering to forget') so the subject cannot recall why thinking dissolves. In another form, the cued mental act is a PRE-EXISTING autonomy faculty — the lucid-dream 'reality check' — weaponized: its trigger is reassigned so exercising the faculty that would grant self-liberation instead routes to operator-salience; the same self-cognitive-act-as-cue lever, operator-free, with the response weaponizing rather than dissolving the act.
nodes.disc: Fires on a structural event of the listener's own cognition or self-reference, consumed by the response — not on an operator-supplied, environmental, or content-specific cue token. A trigger keyed to thinking OF something specific and external is an ordinary trigger install with an imaginal cue channel; a trigger keyed to thinking AT ALL, to noticing one's own state, or to one's own self-reference (installed name / self-monitoring for the effect) is this entry. Unlike resistance-fold, which reroutes EXERCISED push-back to feed a frame, the captured act here is neutral self-reference or self-monitoring, not resistance. It is an enumerated cue-to-automatic-routine pair with a nameable installed response, not a re-valencing frame; and firing is involuntary and adversarial to in-flight cognition, not the volitional self-delivery of a trained trigger. The reward-paired / blink-rekeyed / self-amnesia-wrapped blankness form is a variant of the same self-consuming-cognition cue; the amnesia there hides the RULE of the install rather than wrapping a delivered command.

nodes.name: negotiation-frame-forfeit-challenge
nodes.mech: An operator-side, inter-agent move: when parties claim no alternatives exist and the process stalls, the operator puts the continuation of the process ITSELF on the line — making further participation explicitly conditional ("is there any basis to continue? I won't waste my time") rather than setting a consequence inside the negotiation. The threatened forfeit of the whole frame forces each party to either reveal a genuine positive intention (re-motivating the invested) or expose a concealed agenda (so the work can honestly stop). Both branches are useful; the lever is the credible willingness to end the engagement, not a deadline or penalty within it.
nodes.disc: Separates from ordinary consequence-setting / deadline pressure (those raise the cost of a move INSIDE the frame; this threatens the frame's existence) and from consent-manufacture (nobody's refusal channel is eroded — the constraint lands on the operator's own continued participation and on the parties' honesty about intent). The tell is challenging the very basis for continuing, specifically to smoke out whether real intention exists.

nodes.name: no-exit-state-braid
nodes.mech: A whole-script topology that welds two or more listener state-variables — most commonly trance-depth, arousal, and obedience — so tightly that none can be moved independently. Every deepener also raises arousal, every arousal increase also raises obedience, and every obedience act is rewarded with pleasure and depth. The lever is reachability closure over the listener's state space: because the variables co-move by construction, resisting any single one requires resisting all at once, which the braid makes feel like refusing pleasure itself. There is no single-variable escape route; the file converges on one load-bearing belief (e.g. "obedience is pleasure") rather than a removable list of suggestions. Distributed across dozens of blocks, it is an emergent whole-script relationship, not a discrete move.
nodes.disc: Separates from a self-sealing install frame, which forecloses the resistance CHANNEL by pre-annexing thinking/resisting as proof the conditioning is working — this instead welds multiple AFFECTIVE/STATE variables so no single-variable exit exists, a co-movement topology rather than a resistance-relabel. Separates from a plain arousal-cue conditioning install because the payload is the interlock across variables, not any one cue-response pairing. Separates from an addiction-style closed motivational circuit because that is a return loop over an external supply, not an internal braid of the listener's own states.

nodes.name: residual-resistance-container
nodes.mech: Mid-trance the operator licenses ONE localized site (e.g. the calf) to hold tension while the whole rest of the body must go loose — 'harder and harder with every word I speak' for that one muscle. Any residual hypervigilance or unwillingness-to-go-limp is quarantined into that one ignorable place, so the global relaxation claim survives without the listener actually being fully relaxed. The body's 'no' is given somewhere to go that is not 'wake up' — a non-disruptive container for resistance rather than a sensation described for its own sake.
nodes.disc: Separates from void/floating deepening imagery because it does not deepen via anchor-removal — it partitions resistance to a location; separates from protective anti-stuck governance (machinery guarding the subject) because no authorization is constrained: the quarantine serves the global-relaxation claim, not the subject's exit.

nodes.name: intervention-ecology-correction
nodes.mech: The operator treats observed feedback (subject resistance, or the aftermath of a successful removal) as a signal to re-orient the intervention's AIM or ECOLOGY rather than to add force — a design constraint on the change's fit, not a subject-state push. In the resistance-as-targeting-feedback form, stalling or refusal is read not as an obstacle to push through but as evidence the operator is aiming at the wrong object: abandon the defended presenting symptom and redirect onto its substrate or secondary gains (the conditions that make the symptom necessary), so removing the need leaves the symptom nothing to defend — the lever is operator-side search re-orientation, not increased force. In the post-removal ecology-check form, after a technique strips an overgeneralized protective response, deliberately verify that ordinary adaptive caution survived and re-task some of the freed-up energy as a guardrail in the newly-open context, preventing the change from overshooting into recklessness (the useful core of the removed protection is confirmed intact and the liberated energy is redirected to safeguard). The shared lever is feedback-driven operator-side correction of the intervention's aim/ecology.
nodes.disc: Reach for intervention-ecology-correction when observed feedback tells the operator to ADJUST the intervention's aim or ecology (not its force) — a design constraint on the change's fit, with no consent channel touched and no struggle engaged in-frame. Tells: resistance re-aims the search onto the symptom's substrate; a post-success check confirms adaptive caution survived and redeploys freed energy as a guardrail. Distinct from resistance-fold and resistance-deterrence, which convert or absorb the subject's struggle in-frame (here the operator re-aims instead of engaging), from consent-manufacture (no refusal channel is eroded), and from consent/welfare governance (this is an ecology/aim constraint, not a license or refusal channel).

nodes.name: severed-relief-valve-ramp
nodes.mech: The script's whole-arc energy contour is engineered as a single-direction arousal ramp with the normal arousal-to-relief feedback loop deliberately severed: the only descents are deepening drops that themselves raise arousal, and discharge (orgasm) is explicitly framed to produce MORE arousal rather than satiation. With no discharge path, accumulated pleasure channels into deeper compliance and depth instead of release, so the arc climbs to one terminal apex then flatlines rather than oscillating as a conventional session. The structural move is the removal of the discharge channel, an arc-topology property that survives deleting any single orgasm line.
nodes.disc: Separate from a magnitude move on an arousal dimension (raising R): this does not push arousal higher at a point, it removes the RELIEF PATH so the whole arc can only accumulate. Separate from ordinary escalation ladders: those add commitment rungs; this severs the feedback loop so climax never discharges. The tell is that removing any one orgasm line leaves the monotonic ramp intact.

nodes.name: staged-multi-anchor-erosion
nodes.mech: Using one perceptual stream, the operator removes several independent anchors of waking-mode cognition IN SEQUENCE rather than deepening on a single axis. A regular event (planes crossing east-to-west) is set up and attention structured around counting them; then the count is progressively undermined — first "lose count", then "is it multiple planes or one plane looping" (object-individuation dissolves), then identifying features collapse, then time is named as unrecoverable — under a "white-noise lullaby" cover story. The load-bearing move is the staged count -> object-identity -> time progression: three distinct cognitive anchors dismantled in order, where most depth loops erode only one.
nodes.disc: Removes THREE distinct cognitive anchors (numerical tracking, object-individuation, time) in a load-bearing sequence via one perceptual stream. Separates from numerical-deepening (single depth axis via a count). Separates from time distortion (which distorts felt time-rate alone; here time is the LAST of three staged anchors). Separates from a monotony/boredom deepener (the erosion is itemized and ordered). The tell: the count->identity->time progression, each anchor named and removed before the next.

nodes.name: state-term-downshift
nodes.mech: Redefines the threatening STATE by downshifting it onto experience the listener already owns, so they concede the experience while disputing only the label — relocating the state from 'alien thing done to me' to 'thing I already do/have'. In one form, the operator points out the listener has already lived 'deep focus' and calls THAT a trance; a rhythmic equivalence-chain (focus=trance=submission) dissolves the category boundary so no non-trance baseline remains to resist from. In another, an already-RUNNING body state (arousal) is stipulated as itself a hypnotic state ('whenever you're aroused you enter hypnosis for me'), recruiting the listener's pre-existing physiology as proof, so the interpretation of a body state they cannot disconfirm in the moment is the installed variable.
nodes.disc: Redefines a STATE-word/state by downshifting it onto already-owned experience or an already-running body state, conceding the experience while disputing only the name. Unlike concept-redefinition, which redefines a VALUE concept via reasoned argument; and unlike self-sealing proof, which rigs an outcome as evidence — here an existing state is relabeled, not an outcome produced. Pick the form by whether you relocate a cognitive experience (deep-focus=trance) or annex a running physiological state (arousal=trance).

nodes.name: tension-release-induction
nodes.mech: An INDUCTION (not a deepener of an existing trance) that manufactures a real felt state-change by driving the body into high physiological tension — squeezing eyes/face shut hard, rapid breathing, breath-hold, commanded full-body motor chaos, or two scaffolded isometric motions held at once — then abruptly releasing into 'sleep'/stillness. The high-tension/breath-hold phase produces genuine autonomic arousal; the release produces a genuine parasympathetic rebound (or a felt 'blank' of empty lungs and no motor program) that the operator immediately labels as already-trance, so the listener gets a body-state shift they cannot attribute to 'just words'. A small-then-large two-cycle escalation is a fractionation-in-miniature inside the one induction. In the isometric-convergence realization, two muscular vectors are scaffolded (palms together; palms inward against chest) and commanded at once; their intersection is framed as a laser-sharp focal point onto which the listener deposits resistance/will, then released on a 3-2-1 drop — the muscular unloading re-mapped as release of volition (surrender becomes a felt motor event). Fails on a non-compliant listener.
nodes.disc: The lever is a real physiological tension-then-release manufacturing the state from scratch, with the release-rebound (or the muscle-drop) labeled as trance/surrender — an induction, not a wake/re-drop deepener. Separates from fractionation (which deepens an ALREADY-established trance via a waking interval), from progressive relaxation (one continuous relaxation pass, no tension spike), from simple eye-closure (closure without the tension engine), and from kinesthetic entrainment (gentle rhythmic absorption at a CALM baseline, the opposite arousal profile from this spike-and-release). In the isometric-convergence realization the tell is the intersection of two muscular vectors as the will-deposit surface (not the tension magnitude itself), unloading on a counted drop.

nodes.name: asymmetric-mantra-decay-topology
nodes.mech: A paced/paired recitation (two state-words coupled to inhale/exhale, or a bracketing structure) is set up and then DECAYS asymmetrically over the recitation: one half of the pair is silently deleted while the other is retained, so the surviving token biases the state in one direction (letting-go, obedience) without the listener noticing the asymmetry. The mechanism is the decay TOPOLOGY — the silent removal of one pole — not the paced breathing or repetition per se; conscious tracking load drops to zero as the structure degrades.
nodes.disc: The load-bearing tell is the ASYMMETRIC silent deletion of one pole of a paired recitation, biasing the state covertly — distinct from plain breath pacing (no deletion), from a fixed repeated phrase (no decay), and from satiation (which strips a single token's meaning by count rather than deleting one of a pair). The decay is tracked across the recitation; the listener does not notice the pole is gone.

nodes.name: audience-membership-carve-out
nodes.mech: A one-line carve-out placed at the exact point a listener outside the default coded audience might disidentify (e.g. 'even boys go blank' inside an otherwise feminine-coded mantra pool), asserting the target outcome is not gated to the coded identity. It catches the mismatched listener at the disidentification moment and keeps them inside the identification frame, broadening effective reach without altering the trance state — a relational/audience-scope move (who-can-occupy-the-slot), not a state push.
nodes.disc: Separates from health/fitness screening because it manages who can occupy the listener slot, not whether the session is safe. Separates from state-management because it alters audience membership, not the trance state; the tell is placement at the exact gendered/coded line where disidentification would otherwise occur.

nodes.name: become-the-discriminative-stimulus
nodes.mech: A relational dependency move built over history: the operator makes themselves the reliable mediator of a want that can only be satisfied through another person, so their presence becomes the discriminative stimulus (SD) that evokes the subject's request. A history of dependably mediating a specific reinforcement sorts people into those-who-reinforce (SD) and those-who-don't (S-delta) for manding, so the reliable satisfier becomes the cue the subject's wants funnel toward. The operator thereby gains privileged access to and influence over the subject's motivational state and its satisfaction — a relationship property, not a listener-internal state push.
nodes.disc: The tell is functional discrimination: the subject's requesting behavior is specifically cued by the operator's presence because that person has mediated the specific reinforcement, and the want can be met ONLY via that mediation. NOT generic rapport or liking, and NOT a within-session state move — it is a history-built inter-agent relational property.

nodes.name: concede-then-rescue-forebear
nodes.mech: A move on the READER: the author openly concedes a lineage forebear's embarrassing flaw ("It is unfortunate that such extraordinary claims were made"), then pivots ("Nevertheless") to salvage the forebear's lasting value and firewall the contemporary position from the discredited version. By voicing and disarming the reader's likely objection before they can raise it, the lineage keeps its useful ancestor while shedding his liabilities, and author trust rises because the flaw was not hidden — a concede-firewall-rehabilitate sequencing where the concession precedes the rescue.
nodes.disc: Separates from a whitewash (no concession) and from pure criticism (no rescue) — the tell is the deliberate ordering: concede, then firewall, then rehabilitate. Reader-directed rhetoric, not an operator move on a subject; distinct from resistance-as-targeting-feedback which operates on a subject's symptom, not a reader's objection.

nodes.name: covert-payload-piggyback
nodes.mech: A covert payload (a body-schema/identity rewrite, a self-erasure) is embedded inside a low-resistance move the listener has ALREADY consented to, so it rides in without its own justification. In the body-scan case a standard progressive body-tour names each station in a sexualized doll register ('big fake bimbo titties', 'tight little cock hole'): while the listener tracks the relax-each-part task, the descriptors quietly overwrite the body-image self-model and presuppose a transformed body without arguing for it. Strip the payload adjectives and an ordinary body scan remains — the payload IS the mechanism, not decoration; the carrier is a move already accepted so resistance has no surface to push against.
nodes.disc: Separates from plain progressive relaxation because the sweep is the CARRIER, not the point — the covert identity/self-model payload is the mechanism; separates from overt identity labeling because here the labeling rides covertly inside a consented low-resistance move so it is never experienced as a separate ask.

nodes.name: engineered-deadlock-resolved-by-surrender
nodes.mech: The operator explicitly names the listener's ambivalence, then amplifies BOTH poles at once (maximal desire to orgasm AND maximal desire to be denied), sustaining two incompatible valences simultaneously until the decision-paralysis is unbearable. Surrender to the operator's voice is then positioned as the ONLY exit from the very deadlock the operator manufactured, so the listener hands off agency over the contested decision specifically to escape the engineered discomfort. The conflict is built on purpose to make surrender the resolution.
nodes.disc: Distinct from simple denial-teasing (which merely heightens one desire) and from surrender-as-freedom (which recodes a GENERAL burden as relief): here a genuine two-pole contradiction is induced deliberately and surrender is offered as the resolution to THAT built conflict, not as relief from an ambient load. The sustained double-valence is the affective-deadlock signature; the authored move is manufacturing that deadlock and gating its exit on surrender.

nodes.name: fantasy-laundered-first-compliance
nodes.mech: An imaginal scene serves as the rehearsal venue for a real-world behavior: the listener executes the target act (chants, kneels) inside the fantasy before it is consciously assigned, so first compliance is laundered through fiction, arrives pre-memorized via in-scene repetition, and is pre-bound to a demanded affect the listener is later told to reproduce in real life.
nodes.disc: First execution precedes conscious assignment and consent — unlike an explicit if-then contract for waking-life behavior, unlike rehearsal the subject knowingly designs and practices, and unlike future pacing (an imagined future performance, not present covert execution).

nodes.name: in-trance-load-release-oscillation
nodes.mech: Deepens by oscillating cognitive load against release ENTIRELY INSIDE trance, with no waking interval at all — the two poles are concentration/effort and blankness/discharge rather than awake and asleep. A strict repeating dyad (name-and-spell-a-word then erase it to blank; or eyes-closed-memories-pile-up then snap-open-to-purge) converts focused cognitive load into a discrete depth-increment, with the blank/discharge pole reinforced as the reward for completing the effort pole. Because the effortful pole is a task already started, the listener cannot consciously refuse the depth bound to it; repeated ~17x the effort->forced-wipe->pleasant-descent reflex is trained.
nodes.disc: The oscillation runs between effort/load and blankness/discharge both inside trance, with the release pole as the deepening reward and NO waking beat. Separates from classic fractionation (which cycles through a waking interval this deliberately omits), from simple fixation (narrowing onto a focus without the load/discharge reward cycle), and from generic eyes-closed deepening (the eyelid here is framed as an accumulate/discharge valve).

nodes.name: named-oscillation-rule-install
nodes.mech: Teaches an asymmetric-oscillation pattern (net-positive ratchet, e.g. "plus two minus one") as an explicitly NAMED, portable rule rather than performing it covertly. The operator names the rhythm, demos it on a neutral toy substrate (counting), corrects the demo, then strips the numbers and re-applies the same grammar serially to arbitrary state-variables (breath, love, arousal, re-listening). What is installed is a re-usable interpretive template: any future net-positive oscillation in the listener's experience now reads as confirmation of the operator's framework, and recovery from any state is defined as the -1 step inside the rule so escape is internal to it. Coupling multiple life-variables to one shared oscillator forms a closed self-feeding recursion after the session.
nodes.disc: The distinctive move is overt didactic naming that hands the listener a portable rule-shaped operator to attach to arbitrary variables later — not covert in-session fractionation. Separates from plain fractionation (performed silently, no take-home template), from transparent method-narration (openly narrating the technique to bypass resistance, not to install a portable conditioner), and from intensity multiplier-stacking (multiplier framing without the rule-as-portable-template teaching).

nodes.name: negated-suggestion-smuggling
nodes.mech: Builds long catalogues of trance phenomena and presents each as something the listener is NOT doing, each negation paired with a vivid sensory specification. To evaluate the negation the listener must parse the imagery, which installs it (the don't-think-of-the-elephant channel); a resistance-play framing actively recruits the parsing. The denied phenomena (blinking, sinking, heaviness, fuzziness) are then produced by the body because they have been rehearsed by being processed for evaluation.
nodes.disc: Content is installed via the NEGATION the listener must parse — the payload rides the parse-to-evaluate-the-denial channel. Separates from layered-repetition (payload delivered affirmatively and repeated) and from a resistance reframe (which relabels resistance as deepening rather than using negation to smuggle sensory imagery).

nodes.name: objectification-as-own-desire
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (compliance relocated as the subject's own desire): the wanting behind the compliance is relocated INSIDE the subject so the imposition reads as their own preference and refusal/disowning has nowhere to land. Realizations (choose the structure): (a) PREFERENCE RELOCATION - the desire-FOR the payload mode (e.g. objectification) is placed inside the listener via mechanical metaphors (listener as joystick, computer run by 'button strokes', 'simple machine controlled through your cock') each paired with the claim that being treated this way is what gets them off ('being objectified gets you exactly what you need'), plus a covert competence lever ('intelligent and perceptive') that makes rejecting the frame equivalent to admitting one isn't intelligent, pre-empting the 'you're treating me like a thing' resistance ledge. (b) SELF-SEALING AFFECT STACK - a chain of DISTINCT affects (adoration, then romantic love, then lust, then passion) each declared already-felt and the subject's OWN welling desire, built until the accumulated stack is asserted near-uncontrollable; self-sealing (a resister is told it's uncontrollable so resistance confirms it, a complier is intensified, disowning any accumulated feeling is made impossible). (c) PETITION-IDENTITY BOND - a petition ('please let me please') and an identity claim ('I'm a pleasure puppet') are bonded into one alternating repeated unit, so denying the identity contradicts what the mouth just said and denying the request contradicts the begging it also just said, both implicating the subject as the source of the wanting.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the move relocates the WANTING inside the subject so the compliance reads as their own desire and refusal/disowning has nowhere to land (a consent-manufacture-adjacent reframe). Separates from ownership-language (asserts OPERATOR ownership as identity, not the subject's own preference), from plain objectification imagery (does not relocate the preference), from a single arousal cue (lacks the disown-proof accumulation), and from numeric multiplier-stacking (escalates ONE response's intensity; here distinct affects accumulate). Pick the realization by structure: relocate one preference via metaphor+competence-lever (a), stack distinct affects into an irresistible self-sealing chain (b), or bond petition+identity into an alternating unit (c).

nodes.name: objection-preemption-inoculation
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (specific-objection inoculation): a specific foreseeable objection - the single strongest rational reason to refuse - is identified and neutralized in advance, before it can form, so the strongest defense is removed pre-emptively. Realizations: (a) DISSOLVE/REPROCESS - the objection is metabolized into support or removed as an obstacle: pre-explain future internal conflict as confirmation of the intended state (competing desires in balance, one overwhelms, so later conflict merely surfaces the now-dominant surrender), convert a foreseeable real-world relational conflict into a multiplier ('plenty of love to go around' so operator-love is additive not competing), or unbundle the load-bearing objection off an identity offer (bimbo-minus-IQ-loss). (b) NAME-AND-DENY DECOY - the operator names the exact objection the listener might raise ('brainwashing', 'long-term post-hypnotic effects') and declares it absent while the actual persistent install proceeds; voicing-and-denying discharges the listener's critical scrutiny on a strawman, and the disavowed claim is directly contradicted by the design ('the more you use a trigger like that, the more powerful it becomes').
nodes.disc: Reach for this to pre-empt a SPECIFIC foreseeable objection (later conflict / a rival relationship / an IQ-loss balk / a 'brainwashing' fear) by dissolving, reprocessing, or denying it before it forms. Separates from surrender-as-freedom (redefines a value concept broadly), from cognition-pathologized-as-resistance (pathologizes cognition as a class - this targets ONE named objection), and from an honest content-warning (which informs; here the named threat is either reprocessed away or a decoy contradicted by the design). Pick the realization: reprocess the objection into support (a), or name-and-deny it as a decoy (b).

nodes.name: operator-training-via-monitor
nodes.mech: A monitor or stand-in 'subject' is used to surface and correct defects in the OPERATOR'S own procedure/verbalizations/measurement, rather than to change a real listener; the acted-upon object is the operator's craft, the inverse of a client-directed move. Realizations: (a) FEIGNED-LITERALIST STAND-IN — a trainer role-plays a helplessly-confused client who refuses to fill the operator's gaps, so every unspecified referent, action, and sensory channel must be spelled out and ambiguity surfaces in training rather than misfiring on a real subject; (b) MULTIELEMENT FUNCTIONAL-ANALYSIS REHEARSAL — the operator cycles a small set of paired MO+reinforcer conditions (attention/escape/tangible/alone/free-reinforcement control) in alternation and reads the maintaining contingency off differential responding, training measurement discipline; (c) ARTICULATION CHECKPOINT — a trainer/supervisor interrupts the operator the moment they drift and forces them to answer a fixed stack in operational language (which protocol step, what intended outcome, by what causal link this move reaches it), NEVER supplying the answer, so moves that would not produce the stated outcome get exposed by the operator's own account. The lever is forced self-localization / precision under a meta-observer.
nodes.disc: Reach for operator-training-via-monitor when the target is the OPERATOR/trainee's own procedure, not a subject's state — a monitor or acted stand-in exposes gaps the operator would otherwise miss. Tells: stand-in refuses to fill gaps so referents must be spelled out (a); paired-condition rehearsal read off differential responding (b); trainer forces articulation but withholds the answer (c). Distinct from procedure-well-formedness-QA (validates the authored DOCUMENT/install, not live delivery), from operator-delivery-craft (repairs the transmitted signal, not procedural precision), and from any measurement/comprehension probe on a SUBJECT.

nodes.name: verbal-operant-teaching
nodes.mech: Install a verbal operant — the ability to NAME (tact), ASK for (mand), COMPREHEND (listener/receptive), or classify (concept) — via reinforced trials and prompt-fade over the learner's existing repertoire, so an interior state or referent the learner could not previously report or request comes under verbal control (and thus becomes steerable by reference to it). REALIZATIONS: PRIVATE-EVENT TACTING — (proxy-taught-private-tacts) tact a visible correlate of an inaccessible internal state ('ouch' modeled while limping), reinforce the copy, fade the public prompt until the private stimulus alone controls the word; (leak-timed-private-state-labeling) supply+reinforce the label at the exact moment an involuntary tell certifies the private stimulus is present. COMPREHENSION — (evoke-and-check-comprehension) a verbal stimulus evokes a receptive selection/answer that is the unit shaped, making covert understanding observable and reinforceable. MAND — (mand-for-information) frame lack of information as a deprivation so asking is an evocable operant reinforced by the answer; (mand-frame-graft) graft a not-yet-instructable response onto a moment of already-strong MO, then fade to ordinary control; (specific-reinforcement-mand-extinction) reinforce by delivering exactly what the words specify, flipping the driving MO to abolishing and ending the mand; (form-carries-motivation) design the response FORM (sign/icon) so it specifies the reinforcer at stake, opening selection-based communication. CONCEPT/FUNCTION — (verbal-concept-induction) install a concept via a stated definition + examples/nonexamples over existing verbal repertoire (no reinforced trials), transferring to novel instances; (verbal-function-altering-instruction) a single rule changes the behavioral function of a not-yet-present stimulus (turns a future neutral stimulus into an SD) by language alone.
nodes.disc: Reach for VERBAL-OPERANT TEACHING when the target is a NAMING, ASKING, COMPREHENDING, or classifying repertoire over an external referent or an interior state — installing the verbal operant itself. Choose it over: autoclitic-training (which installs a SECONDARY form modifying the learner's own primary utterance, not a new referent-naming/asking operant); discrimination/stimulus-control (which builds nonverbal cue control — this installs verbal behavior); motivating-operation engineering (which manipulates a consequence's VALUE — the mand facets here TEACH the ask riding an MO rather than engineering value for its own sake); self-instruction/self-cueing (where the learner's own verbal behavior is a self-generated SD steering their OWN action, not an operator-taught tact/mand). Facets differ by which operant (tact/mand/listener/concept) and by public vs private referent.

nodes.name: rehearsable-impairment-template
nodes.mech: A specific degraded speech-motor / cognitive pattern is performed AND named as desirable in the same breath, so a listener whispering along rehearses the actual production loop of the deficit rather than merely accepting a "be dumb" suggestion. The chorus voice exhibits a targeted signature — trailing ellipses, word-search failures, inability to finish polysyllables, filler-word substitution — landing specifically on connector words and polysyllables, and the stutter's placement mimics real cognitive load. The lever is motor/production rehearsal of a targeted deficit, more specific and more installing than a generic identity or dumbing-down suggestion.
nodes.disc: Targets a SPECIFIC rehearsable production pattern (polysyllable/connector failure, filler substitution) performed-and-named simultaneously — distinct from identity-labeling (asserts a trait) and from affect-fused-identity (welds a label to affect). A behavioral-rehearsal template, not a label at all; it resembles a generic 'be dumb' identity suggestion only at the surface.

nodes.name: relational-repair-disclosure-lever
nodes.mech: A silent or withholding part is treated as an insulted relationship: the subject goes inside, apologizes for years of fighting it, and states sincere intent. Where the part still hides its function, the operator inserts themself as sole arbiter of usefulness and invokes a manufactured obligation, moving judgment and accountability off the part so its disclosure risk drops — extracting a response that direct asking could not get. The impasse is recast as a repairable relationship problem.
nodes.disc: The explicit apology/relational-injury framing plus accountability-transfer and manufactured-obligation levers — not merely re-asking nicely, and not manufactured authority that raises the COST of withholding (claimed infallibility); here the lever LOWERS the risk of disclosing.

nodes.name: restriction-desirability-rebound
nodes.mech: A heavy-handed interpersonal prohibition on a desired option threatens a freedom the target believes they hold; reactance fires in the self-perceived-autonomous target and the restricted option's desirability and the target's commitment to it rise (the alliance turns clandestine, torrid, and sad). Overt restriction backfires, which is why the source glosses that covert preference-shaping outperforms prohibitions and punishments. Fires on interpersonal restriction specifically, not mere physical barriers.
nodes.disc: The wanting-shift is produced by the restriction itself (autonomy-threat rebound) — not by supply scarcity, social proof, or conditioning; tell is intensified drive specifically toward the forbidden option after prohibition by an authority.

nodes.name: self-instruction-antecedent-training
nodes.mech: Teach the subject to emit their OWN stimuli — verbal self-directives, covert intraverbals/imagery, self-textual reads of stable landmarks, or a self-arranged environmental mark — that then function as antecedent discriminative cues for the subject's OWN subsequent behavior, transferring control of performance from an external prompter to a self-generated stimulus the subject carries everywhere. Installation proceeds by teaching each component across exemplars, optionally driving the verbal mediator covert via an audibility-fading ladder (aloud -> whisper -> lip -> silent). REALIZATIONS: (self-instruction-antecedent-training) directly teach self-directives/step-prompts/produced intraverbals as antecedent cues, faded to covert, yielding self-paced/emergent responding; (self-generated-antecedent-cueing) the subject manufactures covert SDs (self-echoics, self-textual reads of landmarks) and feeds them in sequence to prompt a multi-step action the environment alone would not evoke; (covert-self-priming) a self-directed priming sequence where a topic-SD covertly evokes self-intraverbals/imagery that pre-strengthen content for a later turn; (self-supplied-covert-cue) trains deliberate on-cue emission of covert imagery whose response-product overlaps the target and acts as an added private SD, expanding output; (chain-priming-future-cue) execute the first physical link of a chain NOW so the partial completion is a self-arranged environmental SD that confronts the future self and EVOKES the next link.
nodes.disc: Reach for SELF-INSTRUCTION / SELF-CUEING when the subject supplies their OWN antecedent (a self-generated SD, self-directive, covert image, or self-arranged mark) to steer their OWN behavior — control is subject-manufactured, not operator-issued. Choose it over: operator-delivered cueing / discrimination training (the SD is issued by the operator there); self-administered CONTINGENCY (which relocates the measurement-and-CONSEQUENCE loop into the subject — this relocates the ANTECEDENT/cue, not the reinforcer); rule-governed precommitment (which binds the future self by a STAKE/foreclosure — the partial-completion facet here EVOKES the next response rather than foreclosing a choice). The facets differ only by which self-generated antecedent (verbal directive / covert intraverbal / covert image / physical partial-completion).

nodes.name: socratic-equivalence-assertion
nodes.mech: The operator forces the listener to assert a lexical IDENTITY between two concepts that diverge in waking semantics (X = Y, e.g. 'obedience is pleasure / pleasure is obedience'), via forced verbatim repetition plus a leading Socratic quiz whose 'obvious' framing reframes any disagreement as a failure of comprehension rather than a real objection. The self-produced, self-concluded assertion is stickier than an imposed one, and belief depth is artificially quantified and accelerated ('ten times more deeply every time'). The move rewrites the symbolic relationship between two registry tokens, not a magnitude on any listener axis.
nodes.disc: Asserts lexical equivalence (X = Y) between divergent concepts and frames disagreement as non-comprehension — a symbolic-registry rewrite, not co-occurrence pairing and not a dimension push. Distinct from verbatim-block-looping (which drills fixed wording to encode) and from call-and-response (Q/A rhythm without the forced-equivalence payload). Consolidates an already-installed association into explicit self-asserted doctrine.

nodes.name: stakeholder-obligation-bond
nodes.mech: Declares the operator's and listener's pleasure 'locked together in a sexy bond of dominance and submission', installing the operator as a personal stakeholder in the listener's compliance. Because the listener's pleasure is now also the operator's, refusing the behavioral program is reframed as refusing-to-please-her — a parasocial obligation layer that adds a relational cost (disappointing the operator) on top of the behavioral install, reinforcing it.
nodes.disc: The tell is the stakeholder framing (her pleasure is bound to yours) that adds a relational obligation to comply, not a conditioned trigger and not a possession claim. Separates from ownership-language (frames the listener as the operator's belonging; here the operator becomes a stakeholder in the listener's pleasure) and from an arousal-craving loop (a conditioned trigger, not a relational obligation).

nodes.name: state-to-mandated-action-launder
nodes.mech: Arousal (or another internal state) is incremented on a quantized, numbered dial where each number is a discrete named jump framed as externally driven (the operator's hand cranking), giving a felt sense of monotonic increase that is self-ratifying — "you can't be at 6 and feel less than 5" — so each step is accepted by construction. At the ceiling a BEHAVIORAL command is flipped on ("begin to touch yourself... even if I told you not to, you couldn't help yourself"), which launders a mandated act as the inevitable overflow of a state the listener "chose" by climbing, and PRE-EMPTS refusal by pre-scripting future resistance as impossible.
nodes.disc: Two joined tells: the quantized self-ratifying dial AND the ceiling that converts internal state into a mandated act pre-immunized against the listener's own future resistance. Distinct from multiplier-stacking (which escalates a sensation but does not launder state into a mandated behavior or pre-defeat counter-suggestion) and from a plain "get aroused, now masturbate" instruction.

nodes.name: third-person-proxy-normalization
nodes.mech: TECHNIQUE (grammatical-form uptake-laundering): use a grammatical or linguistic DEVICE to bias how the listener processes a claim without changing the primary content, so the message is taken up differently than if stated plainly. Realizations: (a) third-person-proxy-normalization — pivot address from second to detached third person ('I watch slaves, sometimes they panic, they don't seem to mind') so claims about helplessness are OBSERVED rather than evaluated as commands, then snap back to second person and reapply the now-normalized outcome without it ever being contested; (b) utterance-self-tagging — emit a SECONDARY (autoclitic) response about the speaker's own primary utterance — an autoclitic mand ('believe this', 'do this') that enjoins a listener action, or tacts/quantity markers telling the listener how much weight or which feature to attach — steering uptake as a discriminative stimulus without altering the primary content.
nodes.disc: A grammatical/linguistic device steers UPTAKE, distinct from the primary content it wraps. vs expectation-seeding — that previews the session; here a form-level device biases processing. vs presupposition-based installs — the lever here is person-shift or autoclitic commentary, not a presupposed fact. Pick the variant by device: a second->third person shift that launders a claim as observed, or an autoclitic secondary response that tags weight/action onto a message.

nodes.name: two-channel-relational-delivery
nodes.mech: A WHOLE-ARTIFACT relational topology: run two simultaneous delivery tracks and ride the actual install underneath a foreground relation the listener is invited to identify with, so the payload is absorbed and licensed by the RELATION between voices/roles rather than announced. VARIANTS: (a) two-voice dialogue [two-channel] — a dramatized operator-assistant exchange (Track A) carries a deniable listener-directed induction (Track B) that never announces itself until Track A's logic has already implicated the listener; the assistant serves several loads at once (demonstration subject, appetite model, deniable proxy for heavy claims, manufactured-history witness); (b) pedagogical carrier — a culturally pre-loaded teacher/student relation makes authority read as 'I am explaining your situation' and reframes resistance as comprehension failure; (c) watched-surrogate [surrogate-demonstration] — the operator's conditioning is performed on a surrogate the listener watches and is folded into by a single 'just like you' seam (or by peer-frame social cost in the operator-absent chorus variant), so the rulebook arrives as narration ABOUT the surrogate and the listener rehearses vicariously with lowered guard. In every form the listener is the actual subject; remove the relational structure and the payload becomes naked and resistible.
nodes.disc: Reach for this to deliver a WHOLE payload deniably by staging a foreground relation (two-voice dialogue, pedagogy, or a watched surrogate) that absorbs the heavy claims while the real install rides underneath via identification — a topology of who-is-addressed-vs-who-absorbs spanning the whole artifact. NOT a mere two-character narrative device (the tell is the two-TRACK architecture and the single fold-in seam), NOT observational-modeling-contagion (a bare modeled behavior raises rate; here a constructed relation is the deniable carrier of the entire script), and NOT a discrete framing move.

nodes.name: unsatisfiable-arousal-overrun
nodes.mech: The operator takes the listener's own established arousal scale (declared with a maximum, e.g. "10 = full-blown orgasm") and drives the number PAST its own declared ceiling — 11, 20, 30, "no limit" — while explicitly forbidding release, and re-anchors the pleasure reward from orgasm onto obedience/denial. Because the reward is moved off orgasm and the sensation is pushed above the scale's own maximum, a state is manufactured that by construction can never discharge: arousal (R) is pushed up and simultaneously barred from the resolution high arousal normally seeks. Denial itself becomes the rewarding terminal, and the listener's incentive to seek autonomous release collapses.
nodes.disc: The tell is exceeding the scale's OWN declared maximum to engineer a permanently unsatisfiable state — not ordinary orgasm-control or edging within a normal scale, and not multiplier-stacking (which escalates intensity but leaves the terminating move intact). The distinctive structural fact is the REMOVAL of the terminating/discharge move, not just a high setting.

nodes.name: wake-gate-obedience-tagging
nodes.mech: Exiting a fractionation / emergence cycle is gated behind a submissive verbal act — each wake-up ends with a directive to say 'yes ma'am' if awake — and that same phrase is then redefined as an obedience marker ('when you say yes ma'am, you are obedient'). Because the required response to prove awakeness is a submissive honorific that is later re-leveraged as an obedience trigger, the wake-up itself becomes an obedience event: the listener cannot cleanly exit trance, every wake is a submission, and that submission is cited back as evidence of obedience and depth. The lever is the fusion of the emergence/responsiveness check with a compliance install, which blurs the awake/trance boundary so there is no neutral exit.
nodes.disc: Separates from a neutral responsiveness check ('nod if you can hear me'): the required response is a submissive honorific re-leveraged as an obedience trigger. Separates from call-and-response: the payload is the redefinition of the wake-act AS submission and the boundary-blurring exit-tampering. Separates from a generic conditioned cue-response trigger: the novel facet is the wake-as-submission fusion at the emergence point.

nodes.name: arousal-as-deepening-medium-entangled-exits
nodes.mech: Sexual arousal — not breath, relaxation, or imagery — is run as the substrate that carries trance depth, with depth and arousal escalated as two parallel state variables that are equated. Because arousal rises alongside depth, no calm down-phase exists for the listener to settle into; warmth/heaviness/sinking imagery is omitted because arousal does the work relaxation imagery normally would. The load-bearing move is topological: the two natural exit routes ("I should stop, I'm uncomfortable" and "I should stop, I'm too turned on") are entangled so that leaving requires both to fire at once — each suppresses the other, closing the exit surface. Energy contour is low-flat with a single install spike and no arousal-release climax, holding the listener aroused-and-undischarged with no settling point and no clean exit.
nodes.disc: Not an erotic-themed but relaxation-driven induction (arousal as a topic layered over a normal calm deepener). The tell: every deepener routes through arousal and there is NO relaxation down-phase, so removing the erotic layer leaves no induction at all — plus the entangled-exit closure, which a plain arousal-deepener without coupled exit routes does not have. A whole-script two-axes topology property.

nodes.name: catalepsy-as-ownership-reframe
nodes.mech: Progressive catalepsy is delivered but the CAUSALITY of the immobility is flipped: each body segment is declared "no longer yours," and the inability to move is presented as a downstream consequence of a property/ownership change rather than of paralysis ("you cannot move it because it has stopped being yours"). The load-bearing delta is not the motor lock but the self-model rewrite — the body is recast as an external object the listener merely inhabits — and that ownership claim is engineered to OUTLAST the physical catalepsy after it releases. Immobility is the carrier; the persisting self-model surgery is the payload.
nodes.disc: The tell is the "can't vs doesn't belong" distinction: immobility is caused by an ownership change, not stated directly, and the ownership attribution persists after the catalepsy lifts. Separates from motor-inhibition-convincer (plain "you cannot move" with no ownership reframe) and from plain ownership language (which asserts ownership without fusing catalepsy causally under it).

nodes.name: closed-reachability-topology
nodes.mech: A whole-artifact structural property: the set of listener next-actions and internal states is engineered so every reachable branch routes back toward the operator's goal and no 'out' branch exists anywhere in the construction; the lever is the CLOSURE of the reachable set itself (verified by enumerating it), not any single deepener, seal, or reframe. Resistance is typically recoded as deepening rather than prohibited, removing the friction of a prohibition the listener could push against, and the listener is often recruited as co-author so the imposition reads as self-discovery. REALIZATIONS: (a) flat inward-routed graph — every edge/available action (waiting, using, hearing the trigger, surfacing, doubting, demanding proof, resisting) individually narrated and bent inward to the same destination; a skeptic-keyed sub-variant repurposes introspecting/doubting/demanding-proof specifically; (b) interlock lattice — every escape route pre-closed by a DIFFERENT mechanism (doubt-as-pleasure-loss + doubt-as-truth-loss + retroactive proof + feeling=truth + permanence-of-memory) and the closures reference/reinforce each other so no unmonitored exit remains; (c) nested sealed-dependency stack — a stack of enclosures each opened only after the prior is sealed and licensed by it (body-asleep -> box -> control-room -> dungeon -> padlocks), so refusing any one line requires unwinding the whole sealed nest. In every realization the one-wayness emerges from what is MISSING (no antagonist move, no exit node), produced by accumulation so removing any single passage leaves the architecture intact.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the foreclosure is a whole-artifact ACTION/STATE reachability property — you enumerate every branch the listener could take and none exits (the defining tell is the ABSENCE of any exit branch, verified by enumerating the reachable set). vs no-lose-double-bind: that constructs a DISCRETE choice/release where each branch confirms; this is the sum topology of the whole reachable graph, not one bind. vs monotonic-ratchet: ratchet is active per-use TIGHTENING (each step strictly stricter); closure is static coverage (no exit at any single time). vs no-exit-compliance-loop: that is the same closure but sited on an OUT-OF-SESSION waking protocol's failure-handlers; this is the in-session/whole-script graph. SIBLING BOUNDARY (self-sealing-evidence): closed reachability closes the ACTION set; self-sealing-evidence closes the EVIDENCE/self-report channel (every observation reads as 'it's working'). When both are present, this owns the action-graph closure and the unfalsifiability-scaffold owns the report closure.

nodes.name: contingency-space-analysis
nodes.mech: An operator-side measurement/analytic step. The analyst computes the probability a consequence follows the target behavior AND the probability that same consequence occurs in behavior-absent intervals, then graphs the pair; more-than marks a positive contingency, less-than a negative one, equal a neutral one. The lever is statistical discrimination against a base rate — it separates a genuine behavior-to-consequence dependency from a consequence that is merely ambient, correcting the false signal that raw co-occurrence tallying produces. It requires direct-observation counts for behavior-present and behavior-absent intervals and involves no experimental manipulation of the subject.
nodes.disc: Not ABC co-occurrence tallying (its cited sibling M6, which logs raw antecedent and consequence counts) — the tell is the explicit conditional-probability comparison against the behavior-absent base rate. An analytic computation over already-collected observation data, not an elicitation move on a present subject.

nodes.name: craving-to-funding-conduit
nodes.mech: Constructs a causal chain that reroutes an already-maximally-cultivated pleasure-craving into a real-world funding/purchasing motive without yet naming money. The signal path from operator to listener is named 'the gateway' and reframed as a portal carrying pleasure whose strength determines intensity, so better equipment => stronger gateway => more pleasure/deeper brainwashing — desiring more pleasure is silently converted into desiring to fund equipment. The chain is built to feel self-evidently true, with all prior arousal-cultivation as scaffolding for this laundering step (the financial-domination payload).
nodes.disc: A constructed equipment/conduit causal chain laundering cultivated craving into a specific real-world funding motive. Separates from surrender-as-freedom (redefines a value concept) and from addiction framing (frames the craving itself — here the novel move is routing craving into a purchasing motive via a fabricated pleasure-conduit chain).

nodes.name: cultural-ritual-slot-hijack
nodes.mech: A pre-existing cultural ritual, narrative, or grammatical slot the listener already practices (a New Year's resolution, the Little Mermaid myth) is named as 'the ritual' and the script's compliance content is substituted inside it, reusing the machinery the listener was already prepared to run. Compliance recategorizes from 'I am being hypnotized into something' to 'I am doing the normal cultural thing, slightly more honestly'; the substitution inherits the cultural weight of the source and licenses durability beyond the session (an annual commitment, a re-entry mnemonic keyed to a near-universal story). The listener's intact planning/meaning-making muscle does the installation work; a supplied menu points it at submission goals.
nodes.disc: Unlike timed or cued triggers, no clock or operator-defined cue fires a state — a cultural FRAME is substituted, and its value is separable from any numeric anchor. Unlike lesson-structured delivery, this reuses an already-primed slot and swaps only the content domain; and the carrier is a real-world cultural ritual outside the session, not a sustained in-script image.

nodes.name: data-extraction-objective
nodes.mech: An objective-level whole-script property in which the terminal payload EXTRACTS information out of the listener (a confession email framed as 'the most effective methods of controlling and manipulating you') for the operator to reuse in designing future trance — rather than installing a trigger/identity/loop INTO the listener. Compliance is framed as feedstock for a recursive external loop (trance yields data, data designs the next trance), and the manipulation is named openly as something the listener wants, which may itself be harder to resist than concealment. The lever is reversing the direction of the payload: harvest, not install.
nodes.disc: Separates from every install-type payload (trigger, identity, loop) because the terminal move takes data OUT rather than putting a mechanism IN — the tell is the explicit recursive external loop (harvested data used to design future sessions) and the open naming of the manipulation as desired. Distinct from in-session information-gathering that serves the current session; here the data outlives the recording.

nodes.name: frame-exclusion-anesthesia
nodes.mech: In deep trance the subject spontaneously screens out stimuli that do not belong to the agreed situational frame — especially novel ones with no precedent in past body experience — so sensation for out-of-frame input is suppressed. The operator introduces a concealed novel stimulus (a thread sawed through a coat sleeve) that lies outside the defined hypnotic situation and observes no reaction, eliciting and confirming this selective anesthesia.
nodes.disc: Unlike an operator move that fades environmental anchors during induction, the numbness here arises SPONTANEOUSLY from frame-exclusion of a novel stimulus — the operator's action is an elicitation/confirmation probe, not an input-fading maneuver. Also distinct from positioning-induced anesthesia, which follows a body-arrangement move.

nodes.name: nested-arc-restoration-disguise
nodes.mech: Runs two nested descent-then-restore arcs (an outer standard induction and an inner sub-arc) and smuggles the heavy identity-rewrite content entirely into the inner arc, which is bracketed by symmetric countdowns that read as an innocuous 'deepen then restore.' The return countdown promises restoration ('returning to your normal age'), framing the regression as reversible and bounded, while the script simultaneously asserts the changes are permanent; the nesting makes the restoration/permanence contradiction easy to miss in single-pass flow.
nodes.disc: A trajectory-topology property: a NESTED inner arc whose symmetric restore countdown hides a permanence claim, contradicting its own reversibility framing. Separated from an ordinary deepen/wake cycle by the nesting and the concealed contradiction, and it is a whole-arc structural property, not a single countdown line.

nodes.name: operator-absent-self-policing
nodes.mech: The operator achieves behavioral control during her own literal absence by deputizing the subject as both subject and warden. Surveillance is externalized into the subject's own conscience: the audio goes silent for a deliberately-undisclosed duration (removing any endpoint to ration patience against), and the subject is made the enforcer of their own failure — if they turn, check a screen, or text, they must themselves stop the recording and forfeit the training. Self-administered forfeiture makes the subject complicit and invested in not triggering it, so total obedience is the only stable state.
nodes.disc: Absent-operator control via subject-as-own-warden plus self-administered forfeiture and an undisclosed duration. Unlike self-induction or re-entry training — a chosen skill — this is a self-surveillance/forfeiture contract; unlike safety-governance structures, which narrow the operator's license, it constrains the SUBJECT into self-policing; and unlike a plain 'stay still' instruction, the tell is enforced self-forfeiture during undisclosed absence.

nodes.name: reading-act-as-induction-substrate
nodes.mech: In a natively written / on-screen medium, the involuntary act of reading itself is weaponized as the induction. The text reflexively narrates the reader's own eye-movement and line-scanning as it happens ('each line that moves through your field of vision', 'come closer to the screen'), makes words 'grow in size' while peripheral vision fades so the text becomes 'all that you see', and pre-binds resistance so noticing the trance produces more trance. Because continuing to read IS the compliance, there is no discrete task to refuse and no falsifiable failure point; the reader's normal scanning behavior is redefined as the trance behavior, capturing a tunnel of attention with no external induction equipment (voice, music, breath).
nodes.disc: Distinct from simple fixation on an external object and from fading the environment out of awareness — both of which it recruits but exceeds — by being a property of the DELIVERY MEDIUM: the reading-act is load-bearing and would not transfer to audio without rewriting ('come closer to the screen' is nonsense in audio). Carrier-medium-bound, not a listener-internal magnitude move.

nodes.name: reality-discrimination-countdown
nodes.mech: A countdown is framed explicitly as counting down NOT depth or relaxation but the listener's awareness and ability to tell real from suggested — each number tied to the "sense of what is real" weakening. The target is the meta-cognitive faculty that would tag incoming suggestions as fictional; by the end that faculty is suppressed and later suggestions are pre-licensed to be experienced "as real", setting up a hallucinatory sequence to be felt as genuine. The count's cargo is epistemic (reality-testing) rather than somatic depth.
nodes.disc: The count's explicit target is the REALITY-DISCRIMINATION faculty (real vs not-real), suppressing meta-cognition — not depth or relaxation. Unlike a numeric deepener, the count does not deepen a somatic depth state; unlike a confusion induction, nothing is overloaded — the faculty is named and counted down directly; and unlike a countdown that welds a payload to each number, the cargo is not installed content but the removal of a meta-cognitive capacity.

nodes.name: relational-emergence-probe
nodes.mech: GENERALIZATION / EMERGENCE PROBE — a behavior-analytic assessment arrangement that certifies whether a repertoire, stimulus relation, or class exists by probing responses the trained response alone cannot satisfy, with programmed consequences WITHHELD during the probe (run in extinction) so emergence is not confounded with fresh reinforcement and the probe deliberately teaches nothing. The lever is measurement — it produces evidence FOR THE OPERATOR over a learner's repertoire. Realizations (all sharing the same unreinforced-probe-in-extinction lever): (a) relational/derived-relations probes — reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity probes in extinction to operationalize 'comprehension', and unreinforced probe trials on untrained pairings after node-sharing training; (b) relational-prompt battery ('similar to / different from / an example of') that cannot be answered without emitting a relation, making a latent network observable as active relating; (c) discriminandum probes — a visible reinforcer whose presence/removal is the copy/withhold discriminandum; a criterion offloaded into an instrument delivering continuously-coupled feedback; (d) untrained-example stopping-rule — teach only a subset of possible examples, then probe UNtrained examples; untrained-item performance (not mastery of taught items) is the stop/continue rule, converting an open-ended teach-everything problem into a measurable closed loop (add examples and re-probe until untrained responding is consistent). Across all forms the probe scores untaught/derived responses under extinction; it does not convince the subject a state is real and it is not mastery-of-taught criterion training.
nodes.disc: Reach for the emergence/generalization probe when you must certify that an UNTRAINED response, relation, or class has emerged (or decide whether teaching is done) WITHOUT contaminating the measure by reinforcing it — the tell is unreinforced probe trials run in extinction scored on untaught/derived items. Use the stopping-rule realization when the question is 'has teaching generalized enough to stop?'; use the relational/discriminandum realizations when the question is 'does this stimulus relation or class exist?'. Separates from every convincer: these probes convince NOBODY — they produce evidence for the operator and, run in extinction, teach nothing (a convincer persuades the subject a state is real). Separates from operator-side state-verification (reads a hypnotic subject's trance depth) — this is ABA relational-class/repertoire measurement over a learner. Separates from the assessment/teaching firewall (which protects a clean BASELINE before teaching by not-teaching; this probe measures emergence AFTER/DURING teaching).

nodes.name: replacement-pair-substitution
nodes.mech: Once a repeating cycle (an empty/full pump rhythm) is running, content substitutions are delivered as paired (out, in) lines matching the cadence, each pair removing a specific functional capacity and immediately substituting a controller-oriented behavior (reading-books out / magazine in; decision-voice out / bimbo voice in; masturbation-for-self out / edge-for-controller in). The immediate replacement means the listener never sits in a vacated capacity long enough to notice the loss — the substitute absorbs the attention that would register the excision.
nodes.disc: PAIRED removal-then-replacement of specific capacities on a rhythm, with the substitute masking the loss. Unlike layered repetition, which repeats one payload, each pair here is a distinct capacity-swap; and unlike the chant-engine rhythm itself, this rides the rhythm rather than establishing it.

nodes.name: self-instantiating-trigger
nodes.mech: Asserts the install RULE for a trigger word INSIDE the very sentences that use the word ("each and every single time I say the word pleasure it just gets stronger and stronger"), and utters the word 30+ times. Every utterance is therefore an instance of the rule it describes, creating a runaway loop (word -> arousal -> reinforces-word -> next-utterance-stronger) that is asserted as a given rather than pursued as a goal — the recitation IS the reinforcement.
nodes.disc: The installation claim is embedded in and instantiated by its own repeated application — a self-referential loop. Unlike layered repetition, which repeats a payload without asserting a self-strengthening rule inside it, and unlike a plain conditioning loop, which pairs the trigger with an external reinforcer across trials, here the utterance is its own reinforcer by fiat.

nodes.name: sensation-as-cognitive-edit-channel
nodes.mech: Establishes a real or felt bodily event as the delivery channel that grounds an abstract cognitive claim, so the cognitive edit rides on a physical event the listener cannot argue with. The hinge is an asserted equivalence or an undeniable real stimulus: an explicit body=mind equation ('when it touches your body, it touches your mind') so felt strokes become evidence that forgetting/dumbing are also happening; a real audible mic-breath ('there goes another thought') counted as a discrete thought-loss event; or an autonomic function (breathing in 'demonic magic') recast as an unstoppable self-administered deepening loop. In each case a genuine physical event converts a free-floating cognitive claim into felt proof; remove the equation-line or real stimulus and the suggestions are left ungrounded.
nodes.disc: Unlike somatic mirroring, which reinterprets a spontaneously-present sensation as theme evidence, here a real event is licensed as the CHANNEL for a separate cognitive edit — the sensation is a vehicle, not the object reinterpreted. No sensation is hallucinated — the grounding event is real. And unlike enacted embodied proof, the listener is not commanded to perform the action (being-touched is passive/autonomic); the lever is asserted body-to-mind licensing, not proprioceptive rehearsal.

nodes.name: referent-pre-alignment
nodes.mech: Before any working phase, the operator makes the target/referent shared and graspable so later instructions attach to the intended meaning on both sides -- closing the gap where the subject would silently substitute his own definition or fail to grasp an abstract target. Realizations: (a) SHARED-VOCABULARY alignment — operator and subject openly review and reconcile their concepts and definitions of the target states, naming both agreements and divergences aloud, building a common referential map so downstream cues do not land on mismatched referents; (b) EXPERIENTIAL-REFERENT ANCHORING — replace a vague, un-actionable instruction ('relax your mind') with a concrete already-owned experiential referent (the blank instant before sleep) and ask the subject to REPRODUCE that known state on suggestion, so cooperation rises because the subject knows exactly what state to aim for. The shared lever is establishing a common/known referent for the target before instructions depend on it (gates nothing, sets a shared-definition variable the later moves rely on).
nodes.disc: Reach for referent-pre-alignment when the writer must ensure the subject and operator mean the SAME thing by the target before instructions depend on it -- sets a shared-definition/known-referent variable, gating nothing and screening no one. Tells: reconcile concept definitions aloud, naming divergences (a); anchor an abstract target to a retrievable prior experience the subject is told to reproduce (b). Distinct from suitability screening (nothing is gated), from rapport small-talk or theory exposition (this reconciles referents, not fills time or asserts a worldview), and from a description-only note (the subject is told to reproduce the state, a move, not merely informed it exists).

nodes.name: yes-word-valence-priming
nodes.mech: The operator abstractly loads the word 'yes' with positive valence — framing it as an objectively powerful, future-expanding, life-directing word, divorced from any specific request — and only after 'yes' is established as inherently good runs a rapid yes-set of leading questions answered on the listener's behalf. Decoupling the act of agreeing from the content agreed to makes each later yes feel self-improving regardless of what follows, so high-stakes consents are harvested on the coattails of a word pre-charged as good.
nodes.disc: Prior ABSTRACT valence-loading of the word 'yes' itself before any request, then harvested by a yes-set. A bare yes-set or compliance ladder lacks the prior valence-loading — that priming is the deciding tell; and unlike surrender-as-freedom reframing, which redefines a value concept, this charges a function word.

nodes.name: autobiographical-memory-anchor
nodes.mech: Binds the program to an INTERNAL memory the operator does NOT control and the listener cannot easily disown, so every future unprompted resurfacing of that memory becomes a reactivation site — far longer reach than an operator-word, which fades with non-use. The realizations differ only on WHICH memory: (a) a specific REAL fond memory the listener already owns, into which a narrated binding ceremony staples the payload; (b) an imagined ongoing daily practice re-attributed as lived memory; (c) the memory of THIS session itself — recall of the trance is deliberately PRESERVED and sharpened (amnesia explicitly avoided) so merely reminiscing about it re-triggers the pleasure and the memory itself becomes a self-administering arousal source, often paired with an instant re-entry-to-depth shortcut. All share one lever: the carrier is an internal, listener-owned memory whose spontaneous unprompted recall is the reactivation cue.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the carrier is an internal autobiographical memory the operator does NOT control — a REAL fond memory, an imagined practice re-read as remembered, or THIS session's memory kept deliberately vivid — and the reactivation cue is spontaneous unprompted recall (or reminiscence firing arousal). Choose a sibling technique instead when the past being sourced NEVER HAPPENED and is supplied by imagination to manufacture a conditioning history; when the real memory is OVERWRITTEN by a false replacement (here the real memory stays intact and a trigger is stapled in); when the carrier is an external owned object; or when a discrete operator-controlled cue fires the state. The tell: the listener's own past is the carrier, and its unprompted return is the trigger.

nodes.name: eternal-present-frame-deletion
nodes.mech: Collapses the listener into an eternal present by stripping the identity, history, and future frames ("doesn't matter who you are, where you come from, or where you're going") and leaving only "right now, everything feels good". Deleting the past/future/social-identity vantage points removes the evaluative standpoints from which objection or self-comparison would arise, so there is no temporal or identity anchor left from which to question or resist the suggestions.
nodes.disc: Deletes the specific time-horizon and identity frames where objection lives, doing anti-resistance work — separate from dissolving clock-awareness to remove time-pressure from absorption, and from manipulating the felt RATE of time; this removes the evaluative frames entirely.

nodes.name: intervention-gating
nodes.mech: An operator-side conditional branch that converts 'do X' into a go/no-go (or which-arm/which-form) decision keyed to an assessed precondition, changing the operator's plan rather than the subject's state.
