Realizations: (a) PRECONDITION-READINESS GATE — check readiness conditions before an advanced program (primary skills strong, learner self-listens, learner can tact her own behavior) and proceed only if all hold, else build the missing prerequisite first; (b) FAIR-PAIR PRECONDITION — block any reduction plan until a same-function adaptive replacement is named and scheduled (elimination is converted into construction, because removing a functional behavior leaves a vacuum); (c) CAUSE-ACCESSIBILITY TRIAGE — test whether the subject can state the cause consciously; if yes run direct suggestion, if no run uncovering first, then correct (a which-arm branch with an explicit failure signature: direct suggestion fails when the cause is unconscious); (d) METHOD/FEASIBILITY SELECTION — pick among methods by a rule keyed to downstream side-effects (default to the error-minimizing method when learning history is unknown or errors evoke problem behavior; escalate complexity only when simpler fails) and covertly gauge whether significant others can actually run the plan, filtering targets by treatment-integrity risk; (e) EFFICACY-AUDIENCE FILTER — an intake prerequisite that admits only a pre-conditioned listener (e.g. familiarity with a prior product) so hotter in-session work can run without onboarding. The gate itself enacts nothing on the subject; it branches the plan on effectiveness or feasibility grounds.
nodes.disc: Reach for intervention-gating when the writer's question is 'should this run, in what form, or which arm?' — an assessed-precondition test that branches the plan before/about intervention content, with no authorization surface on the subject. Variant tells: readiness checklist (a), same-function replacement required first (b), conscious-cause test picks the corrective arm (c), side-effect-keyed method/feasibility rule (d), listener-precondition intake filter (e). NOTE on (e): unlike a subject-facing consent or suitability screen, the efficacy-audience filter protects NOBODY — it serves hotter work, not welfare; that purpose-inversion is its tell. Distinct from target-selection (chooses WHAT to aim at), from well-formedness QA (validates the authored artifact), and from a subject-facing consent gate.

nodes.name: manufactured-conditioning-history
nodes.mech: Asserts a prior conditioning history that never actually occurred and gets the listener to supply it by imagination, then re-sources present responsiveness as the product of that fabricated past. Realizations: a stipulated 100-day daily-hypnosis agreement whose skipped days are referenced as if they happened; an allegedly-shared previous trance ('that thing we did in the library') the listener is asked to RECALL rather than build; a persistent inner-world 'changed since you last came here' that silently confirms continuity on a first listen because the listener fabricates a prior-state memory to make sense of the comparison. Because the reinforcement is counterfactual, resistance to current depth becomes incoherent — you cannot push back on a trance you have supposedly been having for weeks — and the current depth-floor is set at the fictional prior level.
nodes.disc: Sources present state from events that NEVER HAPPENED and the listener supplies by imagination (counterfactual, not accrued) — separate from progressive conditioning that genuinely accrues, from firing a real previously-conditioned anchor, and from ordinary guided imagery/future-pacing (here the listener imagines trance events the audio never performs and is then told their present state is the product).

nodes.name: meta-suggestibility-conditioning
nodes.mech: Future-suggestibility conditioning: the object installed is not any specific behavior or state but the CAPACITY to accept suggestions itself — a disposition toward future installs that lowers activation energy for any subsequent script from this operator, so the file's value is a force-multiplier on what the NEXT file does (little to a one-shot listener, everything to a series). Often demonstrated live (an 'itch' test) to prove the disposition is real. Realizations: (a) install general responsiveness ('respond to whatever comes next'), demonstrated in-session; (b) ship the conditioning as its OWN dedicated priming artifact whose payload is faster/deeper response to subsequent inductions plus a craving to replay, deliberately separating the conditioning-function file from the content-function files — a payload-for-future-payloads with the design intent stated overtly in the preface.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the payload is the disposition-to-accept itself — you are conditioning RESPONSIVENESS TO FUTURE FILES, not installing any target behavior or deepening a specific response. The tell is that a one-shot listener gets almost nothing; the value is entirely a force-multiplier on the next installment (whether demonstrated in-session or shipped as a standalone primer). Unlike a replay-compulsion install, which drives return to replay THIS file, the object here is receptivity to the NEXT file (replay-craving, when present, is supporting machinery). Unlike progressive conditioning, which deepens a SPECIFIC conditioned response across sessions, and unlike reward-association, which pairs something specific, nothing specific is paired here — the installed object is general suggestibility.

nodes.name: name-binding-transitive-equation-chain
nodes.mech: A transitive chain of asserted equalities (cock=lock, lock=cock, key=permission, permission=identity) is declared already-true at depth and locked in by first-person recitation, so any future thought of the listener's own body routes through to the operator's proper name as the terminal node. Each equation is small; the chain is the install. Because the anchor object is the listener's own unavoidable anatomy, the trigger fires at high frequency outside any session, and orgasm-attempt can be folded in as self-thwarting so the loop tightens on use.
nodes.disc: The install is a chain of equalities whose only asymmetric terminal is a proper noun, converting ambient body-awareness into covert operator-invocation. Unlike a declaratively installed trigger — a single discrete cue-response pair with an arbitrary cue — the cue here is the listener's own anatomy, reached by transitive substitution; and unlike diffuse possessive ownership-language, the chain mechanically routes a thought.

nodes.name: named-trigger-persona-swap
nodes.mech: A verbal trigger phrase and a paired release phrase install a switchable alternate personality: on trigger the normal self is tucked away and a pre-specified labeled alter is loaded (with its own behavior bundle), on release reversed. The alter is dormant and non-inspectable by default (the listener is not aware of the trigger until it is spoken), and activation authority is delegated outward so any third party who knows the phrase can fire it. Some forms fold a relistening-compulsion into the trigger payload so replay is part of what the trigger installs.
nodes.disc: The payload is a whole labeled personality driver swapped in/out with a paired release, plus delegated third-party activation as the load-bearing property — not a discrete cue-response behavior. A plain trigger installation installs one cue-response pair, and merely delegating an existing trigger only hands firing rights outward; here the product is the whole persona-swap install with delegation baked in. The swap is also reversible and gated — not an enduring identity-permanence claim.

nodes.name: parts-work-procedure-craft
nodes.mech: Operator-side craft for RUNNING an internal-parts negotiation or reframing procedure -- shaping the procedure's structure, tractability, and completeness, orthogonal to whatever content the parts are led toward. Realizations: (a) SLACK MANUFACTURE — in a stuck two-party (parts) conflict, manufacture tradeable currency so bargaining becomes structurally possible: confirm that interference runs both ways (each party blocks something the other wants, so a mutual non-interference swap becomes purchasable, doubling as a model-selection gate), or pre-load count-balanced non-essential throwaway items so concessions cost nothing real -- either way a slack-free deadlock gains give-and-take room; (b) SPOKESPART SERIALIZATION — convene all present parts, have them elect a single spokespart, instruct the rest to hold, then poll one at a time (naming/tracking each by voice, pausing/reconvening) so a many-party negotiation is serialized into single turns bounded by the operator's working memory instead of collapsing into simultaneous noise; (c) SUBSTITUTE EXISTING BEHAVIOR — a procedural compression of the six-step reframing model: rather than generating three new behaviors, treat the parts' existing behaviors as already-adequate and slot in a substitute existing behavior/anchor, making the only new element the renegotiation of mutual non-interference (nothing removed, so resistance drops); (d) BOTH-POLES REFRAME — for a sequential polarity (crash-diet and binge; up and down) whose halves are opposite in content but identical in form (both obsessions, both loss-of-control), reframe BOTH poles rather than only the presenting one, so the other cannot rebound ('Now is my chance!') -- a completeness/relapse guard. The shared lever is engineering the parts/reframing PROCEDURE itself.
nodes.disc: Reach for parts-work-procedure-craft when the writer is RUNNING an internal-parts negotiation or reframe and needs to make the procedure workable/complete -- operates on the negotiation/reframe STRUCTURE, not on any party's state or the substantive reframing content. Tells: costless/symmetric tradeable currency created for a deadlock (a); turn-taking discipline elect/hold/poll/name-by-voice (b); reuse an existing behavior to compress the six-step model (c); reframe both poles of a same-form polarity as a relapse guard (d). Distinct from the actual reframing/valence content moves, from the later hunt for unknown parts (that is design-time-reconnaissance's objector census), and from clinician-non-interference (withholding action) -- these are active procedure-structuring moves.

nodes.name: objection-and-exit-preclosure
nodes.mech: Closes NAMED anticipated objections and exit routes before they can be used, so the install survives contact with waking life because every route out has been re-signed, pre-answered, or physically rerouted in advance. Realizations: (a) prospective objection/exit preclosure — disengagement pathologized as malfunction needing more content ('broken toy'), the stop-request described as impossible to want, the one uncontrollable release pre-defined as compliance (wet-dream = success), practical edge cases pre-routed through sanctioned channels, predicted wake objections given operator-authored answers, and a whole-script through-line of rebuttals to objections never voiced (doubts experienced as already-answered); (b) safeword-route inversion — the named safety exit is foreclosed by physically rerouting it: 'if you'd like me to slow down or stop, you'll just have to orgasm', combined with a restart-threat so no neutral pause remains and the disengagement impulse is channelled into a compelled climax.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when a NAMED anticipated exit or objection is closed prospectively — re-signed, pre-answered, or rerouted. It targets specific named routes, unlike designs that make the whole experience exitless as a global property, and unlike locks where the operator simply holds the only off-switch out of a state. And where a bind offers an exit and then cancels it with a contradiction, here the route is never left usable in the first place.

nodes.name: operator-absent-self-renewal-loop
nodes.mech: Hands the listener a self-running conditioning loop that continues between sessions with no operator present: the file installs an active urge to re-administer the material itself and/or reframes the subconscious as an autodidact that 'learns to brainwash itself' via pleasure feedback. Because the re-exposure compulsion is itself one of the reinforced installs, it strengthens on each pass — rereading is both the conditioning-delivery vehicle and one of the conditioned objects — so the maintenance schedule sustains without the operator. Any post-session sensation is pre-attributed to 'the process working', building expectancy of progressive change with no further audio.
nodes.disc: OPERATOR-INDEPENDENCE — the listener runs and renews the loop themselves between sessions, not an operator claiming sessions deepen cumulatively (separate from progressive-conditioning). Separate from a plain 'come back soon' line by the closed loop of urge-to-return + per-pass reinforcement + memorization/recitation commitment where the initial pass only seeds the urge.

nodes.name: operator-resource-generation
nodes.mech: Operator-side disciplines for SOURCING the content/tactics an intervention will use, before any technique fires — shaping the fix's material rather than pushing a subject state. Demonstrated forms: a fixed-order fallback cascade for producing a new behavior (recall a personal-history success in full sensory detail; if none, model someone who succeeds; if still none, fabricate/pretend; last, operator-coach the steps), then perform it immediately and check intended=received — justified by a congruence-preference rationale where each step down trades congruence for availability; a generate-N-before-committing count-gate where a monitor refuses commitment to the first tactic and repeats "how else could you get it?" until at least three distinct routes to a pre-named sub-outcome exist, building spare tactics so a failed move becomes a switch not a stall; and a recruit-existing-capacity redirect that blocks fresh construction and directs the subject to enlist an already-present part that demonstrably has the needed quality, treating internal resources as composable modules so the new function inherits proven competence. The shared lever is that the operator disciplines how the tactical/behavioral resource is produced (ordered fallback, count-gated redundancy, reuse-over-construction), building the operator's option set rather than moving a listener dimension.
nodes.disc: Not generic brainstorming/coaching — the tell in each is a hard discipline on sourcing: a strict ordered fallback justified by congruence and live-tested; a count-gate hard-bound to a pre-named outcome that blocks advancing on one option; or a reuse-over-construction redirect. None is a subject-state move — the payoff lands in the operator's tactical repertoire or the fix's content, not any x(t).

nodes.name: preparatory-diagnostic-read
nodes.mech: The operator reads, measures, probes, or classifies the subject so the operator's own knowledge/targeting map/route updates -- the payoff lands in the operator's head, never in the subject's x(t); nothing is installed. This is the whole read/probe diagnostic surface; a writer reaches for it whenever the question is 'how do I find out X about the subject?'. Faces: (1) MEASUREMENT/ATTRIBUTION CRAFT — alone-test (persistence-while-alone => automatic reinforcement), latency-to-first-occurrence (a safety-driven FA that evokes a dangerous behavior only once), clean-condition isolation (deliver one consequence while suppressing contaminating cues so rate attributes function to one variable), function-first targeting (aim at the maintaining contingency not topography), faulty-control audit (can the task be solved via an irrelevant correlated cue?), operant-strength profiling (baseline the weakest component class), attribution-drift admissibility gate (WHOSE behavior actually changed?), and informant question-framing (constrain a third party to observable when/where/how-often). (2) READ-ONLY STATE-VERIFICATION — a read-only procedure updating the operator's estimate of subject state with the subject often unaware a test is happening: silently reading involuntary tells, a no-skip test battery counting only spontaneous signs, refusing to name the success criterion so it can't be faked, forbidding a cold test, a probe engineered so failing to DETECT the state tends to PRODUCE it, a distractor-barrage isolating the cue, concealed side-by-side matching, cross-state comparison isolating the state as causal; managing WHAT COUNTS as proof and WHO reads it. (3) ROUTING/HYPOTHESIS READ — read a signature in the observed pattern to SELECT a treatment route (cross-state resource-amnesia => genuine sequential dissociation => reduce-to-simultaneous; antecedent/consequence co-occurrence => maintaining-function hypothesis), explicitly hypothesis-generating, gating which later technique even applies. (4) POST-HOC VERIFICATION — deliberately re-expose the subject to the LIVE original trigger (give the alcoholic a drink; return to the original context) and read nonverbal markers for the old shift, converting a claim of change into a falsifiable behavioral test; residual sensitivity reads as incomplete change. (5) READ-DISCIPLINE — function-over-form classification: refuse to treat topographically identical acts as the same behavior; sort each by its controlling stimulus and effect, making surface similarity explicitly non-diagnostic (upstream stance governing every read above). (6) DESIGNED ELICITATION PROBES — wrong-guess elicitation: float a recognizably-wrong interpretation to trigger the correction reflex, then ban negations to force a fuzzy nominalization into a concrete testable behavior; predicate-swap probe: rewrite a suggestibility test's sensory predicates into another modality so the test doubles as a hidden instrument revealing the reachable representational channel. The shared lever throughout is diagnostic/decision-rule craft -- read or engineer an observation; none installs behavior.
nodes.disc: Reach for preparatory-diagnostic-read whenever the writer needs the operator to LEARN something about the subject -- measure a variable, verify a state, route a treatment, or elicit a specific datum -- with no dimensional push on the subject; the output lives in the operator's map. Face tells: designed measurement/attribution condition (1); read-only test the subject doesn't control or perform (2); read of existing pattern that generates a routing hypothesis (3); deliberate live-trigger re-exposure to verify the work took (4); same-topography-different-class read-discipline (5); a test/question secretly instrumented to extract one operator datum (6). Separates from every installation/evocation move (which changes subject state); from covert-induction pretexts (a diagnostic probe installs nothing); and from ideomotor/elicited-signal work (these signs are involuntary/unrequested or the operator supplies the contrast). The safety forms (latency-cap, clean isolation) deliberately suppress/limit to protect the read or the subject.

nodes.name: recruited-autobiography-deepener
nodes.mech: A depth force-multiplier built from unverifiable-but-plausible self-supplied content: the operator disclaims mind-reading, then enumerates a broad Barnum catalog of likely prior absorptive experiences (videos, audio, books, video games, flow-state jobs, daydreams, sleep) and 'blends' the recognized memories with a claimed mass of trance hours, dropped via a physical cue. Because the listener supplied the experiences, the operator cannot be wrong — denying depth requires denying one's own personal history — and the disclaimer-then-confident- assertion makes the presumption feel humble.
nodes.disc: An IN-SESSION deepener that recruits the listener's OWN existing autobiography as depth fuel, not a claim about future sessions (separate from progressive-conditioning), and not simple rapport reminiscence (separated by the Barnum breadth engineered so every listener matches and the blend of self-supplied memory into the operator's claimed mass as a deepener).

nodes.name: reflexive-disclosure-weaponized
nodes.mech: The script openly names its own machinery at the moment that machinery is operative ("this is a brainwashing session", "you fractionate yourself with a resistance play"), and pre-routes the listener's noticing of the technique into deeper capture: metacognitive noticing — normally a defense — is converted into fetishized confirmation of being taken, so the disclosures cluster at moments of maximum compliance. The candor is structural, not a slip; it builds a closed epistemic loop (notice -> recognize the operator's openness/competence -> trust more -> comply deeper) with no "outside" from which to audit, and its safety against skepticism is pre-emption rather than concealment.
nodes.disc: The recurring, structural weaponization of self-naming across multiple distinct mechanisms, where showing the trick is what deepens the state — not a single candid confessional line and not ordinary hidden induction machinery. Distinct from concealment-architecture (which hides the machinery) — this is its inverse, disclosing to disarm audit.

nodes.name: relief-dependency-couple
nodes.mech: A wake-side mood prescription delivers genuine felt relief on emergence while coupling that relief to dependency on the operator. Whatever pre-session distress drove the listener to listen is reframed as small and easily remedied, so trance becomes the regulated coping channel, and the just-delivered good feeling is placed immediately after a compliance ask so the felt benefit attaches to compliance and to the relationship rather than standing alone.
nodes.disc: Prescribes a post-wake mood that reframes distress as solved and binds the relief to the operator and to a pending compliance request — distinct from merely tagging the subject's future capability to re-access the state, and from framing the return to trance as a craving: here the lever is relief-as-coping coupled to dependency, not craving.

nodes.name: somatic-self-anchor
nodes.mech: An anchor installed on the listener's OWN body rather than on an external object: a continuous genital/penetration sensation cited as proof of and vehicle for the suggested mental state; a proprioceptive overlay of felt strings on real wrists/ankles chained "tug = cared-for/safe"; a real operator-brand inked on the body that re-fires the owned frame whenever seen; or a somatic control-surface (a nape "button/chip" linked to the cortex, operator-exclusive, remotely fireable). The anchor rides real body-sensation or a durable body-mark, so it cannot be set down like a worn object; the body itself becomes the persistent re-trigger and the felt evidence of the state.
nodes.disc: Sited ON/IN the listener's own body (sensation, proprioception, a mark, a body-locus) — not an external carried object (portable-object-state-export), not an object the identity is relocated into. The tell is that the referent is somatic and non-detachable: the body is the carrier.

nodes.name: timelessness-framing
nodes.mech: Dissolves the subject's awareness of linear time so the absorptive state stays expansive and unhurried — "time simply melts away", "there is only this moment". Removing clock-awareness prevents the analytical mind from measuring remaining session time and re-engaging, deepening and sustaining absorption.
nodes.disc: Dissolves clock-awareness for unhurried immersion — distinct from eternal-present frame-deletion, which deletes the identity/history/future frames where objection can host (anti-resistance work), and from time distortion, which manipulates the felt RATE of time: here clock-awareness is removed entirely rather than its rate distorted.

nodes.name: anchor-collapse-state-jamming
nodes.mech: With reliable anchors established for two mutually exclusive states, the operator fires both simultaneously (kinesthetic preferred), jamming together two physiologies the subject has never held at once. Forcing co-activation produces overt disorganization — confusion, convulsions, occasionally a psychotic break — held only until integration is under way; the mutual exclusivity between the parts collapses and a "bridge" forms so both states can coexist in one body, the precondition that makes reframing possible.
nodes.disc: Two anchored PHYSIOLOGICAL STATES are collapsed against each other — disorganization arises from state-jamming, not from paradoxical CONTENT the mind cannot parse, and not from rerouting an affect onto a new target. The objective is topological — destroy the exclusivity between two disjoint state regions. Tell against gentle blends: deliberate simultaneous firing of two strong opposing anchors producing overt disorganization.

nodes.name: arousal-as-evidence-foreclosure
nodes.mech: The script pre-claims the interpretive frame for whatever the subject's body does, presenting arousal not as a reward for compliance ("obey and you will feel pleasure") but as evidence that compliance is already underway ("the more you obey the more aroused you become" / "your arousal is the feeling of obedience"). Because the frame is asserted before the bodily response, the subject cannot read their own erection as "just fantasy, I am choosing this": aroused reads as obedient, and suppressed arousal reads as helplessness/automaticity claimed anyway. No bodily outcome can disconfirm the frame, closing every interpretive escape route.
nodes.disc: Not reward-based erotic conditioning, which can be resisted by refusing the reward — the tell is that arousal is framed as an un-falsifiable readout of an already-underway state rather than as a payoff, so the body produces the proof regardless of conscious assent and the script owns the interpretation. Distinct from a mere permanence or depth suggestion: this is an epistemic no-exit over interpretations of the body.

nodes.name: belief-outcome-gate
nodes.mech: Refuse to alter a load-bearing/foundational belief until the downstream consequences of the change can be predicted, overriding even the subject's explicit request to proceed; the operator uses sensory assessment of how load-bearing the belief is before touching it. The gate is on foreseen fallout, not on consent — a selection/safety rule over the operator's own conduct.
nodes.disc: Gates on the operator's FOREKNOWLEDGE of consequences, not on the subject's consent — unlike a consent checkpoint, this gate holds even against an explicit request to proceed; a rule about what the operator may touch, not a move performed on the subject.

nodes.name: comfort-permission
nodes.mech: The operator grants explicit permission for minor comfort behaviors (shifting, itching, small adjustments) so the subject can maintain the state without treating bodily noise as failure. Beyond the base grant, the permission is issued PRE-EMPTIVELY: the operator names a likely future trance-breaker (fidget, itch, shuffle) or a likely post-scene feeling-state before the subject has noticed it, grants permission, and reframes the behavior/feeling itself — scratching becomes a deepener, an unreported emotion becomes "that's okay" — so a potential exit ramp becomes an on-ramp and anticipatory meta-anxiety is pre-empted before it can form. The permission-precedes-the-signal sequencing is what converts the body's/mind's noise into permitted, even confirming, signal.
nodes.disc: Distinct from consent and scope governance, which constrain the operator's license — here the operator constrains itself only to reassurance, and the move is welfare-facing. Distinct from a blanket guaranteed-pass permission that removes a required timing moment on a payload — this pre-authorizes comfort/emotion signals so they read as compliance, not failure. Not ordinary get-comfortable patter — the pre-emptive naming-and-reframing before the signal surfaces is the tell.

nodes.name: confirm-then-multiply-compounding
nodes.mech: Elicits a faint effect, has the subject confirm it, then re-suggests it will grow "ten times" on a fresh triggering act, repeating the confirm-then-multiply loop. Each cycle uses the subject's own just-given confirmation as the evidence base for the next increment, so belief compounds monotonically rather than resting on a single assertion, leaving resistance nothing to push against. Requires a non-zero starting seed ("nothing times nothing equals nothing").
nodes.disc: The explicit per-pass re-confirmation step plus a per-pass multiplier keyed to a new act, gated on a confirmed non-zero seed. Layered repetition re-delivers the SAME suggestion — here each pass re-delivers a MULTIPLIED one; a single micro-ratification confirms once with no multiplier; and a false-bottom depth reframe re-labels depth rather than looping effect magnitude.

nodes.name: covert-public-behavior-install
nodes.mech: Installs plausibly-invisible public body-compliance behaviors (tongue circles, legs apart, shoulders back, ass-sway) as continuous covert self-proof of identity, under an engineered contradiction between a "we have a secret / no one needs to know" frame and an earlier "everyone can see" frame — so the objection "but people will see" is already used up. Each covert act is recast via "show me" as evidence-of-identity (making it feel collaborative rather than commanded), and a non-commanded "maybe you'll" future-self menu (harder to resist than a command) plus a re-listen-makes-you-sluttier loop close the move.
nodes.disc: Public covert behaviors installed as continuous identity-evidence under a secrecy/visibility contradiction with non-commanded future-self menus. Not a discrete cue-response trigger install — the payload is a set of ambient public behaviors framed as self-proof; and unlike an in-session exhibition compliance demonstration, the behaviors are plausibly-invisible public self-proof under a secrecy frame.

nodes.name: cross-state-persistence
nodes.mech: Installs a desire (here, the desire for a triggered persona-swap) into BOTH the triggered persona and the baseline self and across BOTH waking and sleeping, so the off-state self can no longer act as a brake. Ordinarily a triggered persona-swap leaves a baseline self that could, on reflection, choose to avoid re-triggering; scoping the "wanting" across persona A and persona B, waking and sleeping, forecloses that escape hatch and neutralizes the baseline self as a check.
nodes.disc: Explicit cross-STATE scope (distinct personas AND waking/sleeping) that removes the off-state brake. A within-state "you want this" suggestion lacks the enumerated cross-state span; total-permeation spreads a trait across internal layers within one state, and context-generalization spans external contexts — here the want spans discrete persona and consciousness states.

nodes.name: deprivation-inverted-wake-trigger
nodes.mech: Installs a paired wake/drop trigger set in which the "up/alert" trigger is deliberately conditioned NOT as a neutral state-flip but as a DEPRIVATION event that generates craving for the down-state. During the alert rehearsal the listener is instructed to notice "wanting to be relaxed in the trance" and to "eagerly anticipate the pleasure of being made to collapse again"; the panting-breath component produces real sympathetic activation mistakable for arousal/desire. A "same command twice = go even deeper/weaker" sub-rule removes any neutral position, so every command is monotonic toward the operator's preferred direction. The listener emerges already wanting to go back, having rehearsed the craving several times.
nodes.disc: The wake/alert trigger's apparent function is inverted into a deprivation event that manufactures craving for the down-state. A plain trigger install pairs a neutral cue and response; and where a conditioned instant-drop conditions the DOWN cue, here the ALERT trigger itself is the craving-generator — the opposite valence.

nodes.name: double-anchored-climax-release
nodes.mech: A climax (HFO) is bound REDUNDANTLY to two simultaneous triggers at the release point, one of which is a re-invokable sensory-imagery anchor, so the orgasm is welded to a cue that can be re-fired later. A 10->1 countdown with the mantra at full volume converges on "one", where the operator's spoken kiss AND a lips-touching image fire together as the release; the imagined kiss serves as the re-invokable anchor and an immediate post-orgasmic drop ("sleep deep for me now") sets up amnesia work. The double-binding (kiss + count) is the tell: the orgasm is anchored to a sensory cue re-usable outside this discharge, not merely commanded once.
nodes.disc: A climax is double-anchored (count + re-invokable sensory image) at release so it welds to a reusable cue. A general trigger install pairs a cue with a response; here the install target is a climax welded to a re-invokable sensory anchor — and unlike arousal-cue conditioning, the conditioned output is a discrete climax-event bound to a re-firable anchor, not a general aroused-state on a cue.

nodes.name: experiential-consent-trial
nodes.mech: Treats wanting as a hypothesis to be tested experientially before anything is installed: build one example fantasy, verify it from OUTSIDE for gross safety, then enter it and verify the subject actually LIKES the internal experience — all before deciding to want the part at all. Adds an explicit safety screen plus a commit/abort decision, so a consciously-desired-but-actually-aversive install is caught before it lands. Positive governance: the operator's install is blocked pending the subject's lived endorsement — a consent-VALIDITY gate that generates evidence rather than soliciting affirmation.
nodes.disc: Who is constrained: the OPERATOR — no install proceeds without a passed safety screen and a lived, endorsed trial (commit/abort). A consent checkpoint SOLICITS an affirmative "yes"; this TESTS the want empirically and can return abort — evidence-generating rather than assent-collecting. An objection-truce negotiates with a dissenting part to buy clean ACCESS to the trial; this move IS the trial and its gate.

nodes.name: failure-pre-attribution
nodes.mech: Any null result of a prior install is pre-attributed to listener insufficiency — "if the trigger didn't take, you need more practice" — with no operator-side failure mode on offer. Non-compliance can only mean the subject needs more exposure, never "it didn't work," so the install is immunized against disconfirmation while non-responders are funneled into further consumption of the series. Fires specifically on the FAILURE branch, a defensive frame distinct from anything operating on success or on live resistance.
nodes.disc: Operator-side pre-mapping of the null OUTCOME: the subject does nothing — the interpretation of failure is pre-assigned. Expectation seeding previews what WILL happen; this assigns blame for what did NOT happen. It neither captures the subject's own act of checking, nor folds live resistance, nor installs or gates a drive — only the verdict on failure is sealed.

nodes.name: future-confirmation-capture
nodes.mech: Installs an interpretation rule NOW over not-yet-occurred events so that whatever later happens is read as confirmation of the install. Realized as open menus with universal closers (any manifestation counts), both-branches structures (occurrence confirms AND non-occurrence is pre-excused by stipulation), and pre-scripted adverse events (objections, relapses) whose arrival proves operator foresight instead of breaking the frame. The claim becomes unfalsifiable by construction and ordinary post-session life is recruited as evidence the conditioning worked.
nodes.disc: The tell is the no-disconfirming-branch topology — every branch of future experience is pre-mapped to confirmation. Future-pacing projects a specific effect that can observably fail; retrospective justification reframes AFTER the event, while this pre-installs the reading BEFORE it; expectation seeding previews an effect, not a rule that captures all outcomes.

nodes.name: gated-reintegration
nodes.mech: Work separately with the unconscious and control the rate and timing of when gains are released back to the conscious mind, surfacing material only at conscious readiness; the unconscious's own protective refusal to release is harnessed as a motive force, so the insight arrives in a form the conscious mind will accept rather than reject. A scheduling/pacing policy over the reintegration process across the therapy arc.
nodes.disc: The lever is rate/timing control of the handover back to consciousness — not the dissociative isolation that created the workspace, and not post-session stabilization (aftercare stabilizes the return; this schedules WHEN unconscious gains surface across the arc). The readiness gate plus resistance-as-motive is the tell.

nodes.name: identity-clothing-hysteresis
nodes.mech: Couples an identity-state to a clothing-state with hysteresis and a single deliberately-named, effortful exit. Wearing the uniform keeps the old self locked; every act of dressing re-fires the lockaway automatically; the ONLY sanctioned path back is a costly "allowing herself to be undressed" that itself re-fires the ceremony. Naming a sanctioned but self-punishing escape hatch reduces panic-resistance better than claiming no exit exists, while the physical garment functions as the persistent post-session cue — the state is inert without it.
nodes.disc: Identity is bound to a physical garment-state with a deliberately-named costly exit that inverts a genuine agency-reminder into containment. Not a plain cue-response trigger install — the cue is a worn garment-state and the payload is a persistent identity lock with hysteresis. A genuine agency-reminder affirms real exit availability as protection; here the named exit is engineered to be effortful and self-punishing — containment, not safety.

nodes.name: inverse-authority-gradient
nodes.mech: A whole-arc relational property in which operator decision-authority is highest at the open (issuing relaxation commands) and steadily, unflaggedly diminishes to the close, where choices are handed to the listener (scan order, what they need, release-or-hold, when to wake). This runs OPPOSITE to a typical induction's gradient, where operator authority increases as the listener deepens. The lever is a monotonic direction-of-change in who-holds-authority, positioning the listener as sole authority on their own state — plausibly walking a post-scene diminished-agency listener back into agentic posture before release.
nodes.disc: A GRADIENT across the whole runtime with no single announcing line, defined by its DIRECTION (authority decreasing, the inverse of standard deepening) — separates from a discrete aftercare or consent-check move. Separates from a forward-hook (which withholds closure) because this restores agency and releases.

nodes.name: latency-compressed-operator-macro
nodes.mech: The operator drills a multi-token command sequence across rounds with visibly shrinking inter-token latency and contracting verbal scaffolding until a single lead token suffices. A three-step editing macro (name a target "fake", issue "delete", insert a "replace" content) is run four rounds; by the last round "fake" alone triggers the whole procedure. The listener internalizes the sequence as a callable procedure they experience THEMSELVES running, which is self-attributing: operator pronouncements convert from debatable claims into executed keystrokes, and resistance to a deletion reads as resistance to one's own act. The lever is latency-compression toward single-word invocation of an internalized command set.
nodes.disc: Separates from within-session-conditioning-loop, which reinforces a cue-response-reward pairing; here the drilled object is a compressible MULTI-TOKEN procedure the listener runs on themselves, with latency-compression toward single-word invocation as the tell, and self-attribution ("you deleted that, not me") as the payload. Separates from a plain trigger install because it is a callable command SET, not a single cue.

nodes.name: layered-identity-claim-with-immunity
nodes.mech: A four-step identity architecture that welds an ownership claim to an immunity clause. Step one partitions the listener (e.g. mind versus cock, an attention seesaw). Step two names a new layer inserted beneath the partition (a "primal self"). Step three claims that lower layer as owned property. Step four declares the claim un-falsifiable from any higher layer ("no other level of hypnosis can touch this programming"). Steps three and four are inseparable: the ownership claim depends on the immunity clause to survive contradiction by future scripts, other operators, or the listener's own later skepticism — skepticism is relocated into the higher, now-designated-not-real layer.
nodes.disc: Not generic suggestion-stacking or a single ownership assertion — the tell is the specific partition-then-insert-lower-layer-then-claim-then-immunize sequence in which a protective immunity clause is welded onto the installed belief so contradiction from above cannot reach it. The immunity wrapper, not the ownership content, is the distinguishing structure.

nodes.name: mind-as-substrate-reframe
nodes.mech: Recasts the mind as a physical substrate that can be emptied and refilled, establishing the ontology every later install (mask, button, name) presupposes. A narrated "facial peel" converts brain matter to the cream's consistency and peels the mind in layers like dead skin, leaving "only what is needed... of what I insert" in a "hollow machine" reframe; resistance, memories, and knowledge are framed as material to be chemically removed rather than as beliefs to argue with.
nodes.disc: An ontological substrate-replacement — the mind becomes emptiable/refillable matter — that is the precondition for subsequent installs. Unlike installs that add body sensations, this re-defines what the mind IS; unlike total-permeation, which spreads a trait across an intact self, this liquefies the self into a blank medium first.

nodes.name: monotonic-amplifier-dial
nodes.mech: A phrase trigger is installed atop a pre-elicited positive state via a "volume dial" metaphor that frames the state as monotonically ratcheting — each fire is "even more", never a return to baseline. The dial metaphor pre-loads an expectation gradient (the listener now expects each firing to feel stronger, and that expectation does much of the claimed work) and removes the listener's role in regulating intensity: how strong it feels is now determined by utterance count, not self-report. The amplifier typically bundles several axes (euphoria, acceptance, brightness, arousal) under one trigger, so a single "feel better" tap also pushes compliance; a deliberate dial-down proves recallability. Requires an existing positive reading to turn up — installation at neutral baseline fails. In a token-bound form, the same operator-driven intensity dial runs on a concrete token instead of a phrase: a diffuse memory is stripped to pure feeling and bound to a listener-chosen token (e.g. a color) that the operator continuously turns up ("let it grow") — a persisting, driveable state-OBJECT rather than a discrete phrase-fire, with the operator still holding the monotonic gradient and the same illusion of listener ownership.
nodes.disc: The install frames the trigger as a monotonic intensity ratchet whose gradient is supplied by operator pacing and attributed to the phrase, removing listener regulation. Plain declarative trigger installation installs a fixed-magnitude response, not a self-escalating dial; arousal-cue conditioning makes arousal the payload, whereas here the payload is a bundled positive state with arousal only one axis — the dial's monotonic gradient is the defining move.

nodes.name: multi-handle-trigger-architecture
nodes.mech: Rather than one cue-response pair, the operator installs a set of separately-addressable handles onto distinct facets of the installed state, or accretes many affects/objects onto one token that retains all prior meanings. Two sub-forms recur: (a) several verbal triggers with NON-interchangeable functions (state-recall, state-arrest/freeze, identity-tag) each invokable independently later; and (b) accretive stacking onto ONE polysemous token via a "keep the meanings it has AND also become a symbol for..." instruction, fusing achievement/mood/sexual affect (listener-supplied, self-calibrated, hard to invalidate); or a gallery of durable object-anchors accumulated across a long frame then transferred out of the fiction into the listener's real environment. The architecture itself is the technique — a structured multi-lever control surface, not a single response.
nodes.disc: The install target is a structured SET of addressable handles or an accretive multi-affect token, not a single cue-response pair. Plain declarative trigger installation installs one cue-response pair, and trigger stacking layers multiple cues that fire ONE bundled response; here the handles stay individuated and separately fireable, or one token keeps multiple distinct meanings addressable at once.

nodes.name: narrative-scene-loop-as-conditioning-unit
nodes.mech: The operator stages the SAME narrative scene sequence (wake confused, notice headphones, plan escape, get caught, re-headphoned, fade) four near-identical times with a degraded starting state each pass, making the loop ITSELF the conditioning vehicle rather than narrative filler. For the identifying listener linear time collapses: each "wake" feels like the first while the character is measurably worse off, teaching experientially that repetition is invisible from inside. The reset carries a cumulative state-change and an explicit deja-vu cue given to the listener so the sameness is registered as technique, and the listener's own resistance ferries them to the next pass.
nodes.disc: Separates from within-session-conditioning-loop, whose unit is a cue-response-reward pairing; here the conditioning UNIT is a whole repeated narrative scene with cumulative state-degradation, so the vehicle is diegetic loop-structure not a discrete trigger drill. Separates from fractionation, which oscillates trance DEPTH — this loops a narrative scene four times with degradation, not a depth oscillation. The state-change per pass plus the explicit deja-vu cue are the tells.

nodes.name: negative-punishment-timeout
nodes.mech: Immediately contingent on the target behavior, the operator withdraws the subject's opportunity to earn positive reinforcers or removes access to currently-available ones for a bounded interval; the subject ends the interval only by waiting it out or meeting exit criteria. Future frequency of the producing behavior drops because the moment of misbehavior reliably costs a window of good things. No new skill is taught — the lever is pure suppression, and it works only when the time-in environment is already reinforcing and the withdrawal is immediate and contingent. Defined by its suppressive effect, not by any topology.
nodes.disc: Withdraws the opportunity to earn or access reinforcers for an interval, distinct from response cost which levies a fine against already-held reinforcers. If the producing behavior's future frequency does not drop, it is not punishment at all — that effect-defined suppression is the tell versus any surface-similar removal.

nodes.name: obedience-to-blankness-coupling
nodes.mech: The operator states an overt rule that every obeyed command makes the mind more blank and pushes action toward automaticity, then frames each later motor command as also discharging cognition. This contractually couples compliance to mental quieting so each obeyed command lowers conscious resistance for the next and turns blankness into a reward SIGNAL, ratcheting toward automaticity while the coupling operates covertly across later commands. The listener stops monitoring whether they WANT to obey; obedience and mind-emptying become a self-reinforcing loop that escalates toward automatic action.
nodes.disc: Separates from within-session-conditioning-loop, whose reward is a discrete affect delivered on a cue-response pairing; here the coupling is obedience-to-STATE (blankness), where blankness itself is the ratcheting reward and each command is a conditioning trial. Separates from a generic "go blank" deepener because the tell is the contractual coupling of blankness SPECIFICALLY to the act of obeying. And unlike an ambient diffuse-contentment reward, the reward here is a state that also erodes resistance.

nodes.name: objection-truce
nodes.mech: When an objecting internal voice/part fires, the operator negotiates a time-bounded, reciprocal truce: the part is asked to stay quiet for a few moments only, framed as a limited-purpose courtesy, with an explicit promise that it will get its turn to object later — "and rightfully so" (advance legitimization). The part cooperates instead of escalating defenses, buying clean access to the test experience, and its objection slot is preserved and honored rather than suppressed. The deal is scope-limited and commits the operator to return and hear the objection — the part's standing to refuse survives intact.
nodes.disc: The reciprocal, time-bounded deal with a GUARANTEED later objection slot is the tell: not reassurance, not suppression — the objection is advance-legitimized and scheduled, not removed. Unlike a whole-subject consent check, this negotiates turn-taking with a DISSENTING PART; it typically buys clean access to an experiential consent trial. Boundary: a truce whose promised turn is never honored degrades into veto-theater — manufactured consent rather than an honored objection — the live failure mode.

nodes.name: operator-removal-self-policing-closure
nodes.mech: The terminal goal is a control system that needs no operator: by the end the listener generates her own trigger detection ("every time she notices herself obeying"), her own reward (a pride spike), and her own punishment (distress on deviation), with self-worth wholly staked on compliance. Every external dependency is internalized, and an "always been this way" framing erases the install seam so the loop feels native rather than installed. The closure is a property of how the component moves (trigger-as-reward, pride-flipped-to-enforcement, category-expansion of enforceable compliance) interlock across the whole script into a self-detecting, self-rewarding, self-punishing loop.
nodes.disc: Not any single self-reference line and not any one of its component moves; the tell is the whole-script interlock of self-detection + self-reward + self-punishment into an operator-free loop, with the install seam erased so the system feels native. Distinct from arc-shape observations (which describe ordering/scope) — here the closure IS the reusable end-state architecture.

nodes.name: opposed-state-fusion-trigger
nodes.mech: One cue is bound to two NORMALLY-ANTAGONISTIC states at once, collapsing the escape channel between them. A collapse trigger ("sleep") is installed, then redefined mid-session so the same word also fires arousal and deeper trance simultaneously, with the arousal-controlling part of the mind explicitly exempted from shutdown — so deepening IS getting hornier, and "if you want to relax you have to go deeper into trance" seals the loop. The listener can no longer use relaxation to escape arousal or vice versa: the two poles that would normally regulate each other are fused onto a single token.
nodes.disc: Fuses two opposed states (relaxed-off vs aroused-on) onto one cue so neither can be used to escape the other. Plain declarative trigger installation binds one cue to one response, and trigger stacking layers compatible responses onto a cue; here the two responses are mutually antagonistic and the fusion removes the escape channel. Arousal-cue conditioning differs too: arousal is only one of the two fused poles — the defining move is the no-escape fusion, not the arousal payload.

nodes.name: proprioceptive-gait-metronome
nodes.mech: A whole-script chant (tick, tock, walk) is mapped onto the cadence of the listener's own footfall, so trance maintenance runs on proprioception rather than attention to the audio. The trigger becomes portable, silent, and operator-independent, depth is sustained by the listener's own body rhythm without operator presence, and the tick-tock image doubles as a clock/inevitability and wind-up-doll identity payload. Absorbed (genus): ongoing-act-parasitized-as-trigger (tell: an act already in motion — masturbation — is retroactively NAMED as the induction/deepener so 'every stroke = sinking'; the same own-ongoing-body-activity-sustains-the-state lever as the footfall metronome, operator-independent, parametric on which body activity carries it — gait cadence vs an ongoing manual act).
nodes.disc: The maintaining rhythm is the listener's own body motion, not an operator-delivered cadence (vs rhythm-anchoring and every carrier sibling), and it is a whole-script metronome with dual semantic payload rather than a localized posture-compression instruction set.

nodes.name: pulse-multiplexed-command-carrier
nodes.mech: A single recurring pulse-stimulus is assigned multiple concurrent payloads — deepening, muscle relaxation, cognitive blanking, image installation — then a motor stroke-command and a reward beat are yoked onto the same pulse, so resistance to any one channel costs resistance to all, partial compliance is structurally more expensive than full, masturbation is de-paced from listener desire and re-paced to the operator-cited clock, and the trigger is delivered as ongoing reality with no conditional framing. Absorbed (genus): multi-slot countdown cipher (tell: the COUNTED surface of the multi-payload carrier — each number of a short count carries a SEPARATE behavioral command (4=inhale ... 1=surrender) and the sequence auto-fires the whole multi-step program, re-firing as a structural metronome between blocks; same load-multiple-payloads-on-one-recurring-carrier lever, parametric on carrier — per-number sequential slots vs simultaneous pulse-multiplex).
nodes.disc: The tell is the MULTIPLEX — multiple simultaneous state-changes plus a motor command bundled on one shared stimulus so opt-out is structurally suppressed. vs rhythm-anchoring (one keyed response, refusal of it costs nothing else), vs chant-engine-payload-carrier (sequential loading after entrainment, no shared refusal cost), vs declarative-trigger-installation (no X-when-Y install, the coupling is stated as already-operating reality).

nodes.name: relational-fractionation
nodes.mech: Between high-control beats the operator drops small, low-power vulnerabilities — breaking character to admit pride ("I'm too proud of myself, can you tell?"), coining a delighted neologism, self-referencing their known style — re-establishing the operator mid-scene as a person the listener likes. This is soft fractionation on the RELATIONAL axis: the listener is cycled between "she has me" (submission) and "she's a person I like" (affection), rather than up and down the trance-DEPTH axis. Willingness to be controlled rises because the controller is charming; the breaks are the connective tissue between intensity beats.
nodes.disc: The tell is cycling of RELATIONAL stance (control vs likeability), not descent/ascent of absorption. Distinguish from classic fractionation (which cycles trance DEPTH) and from pacing-leading (which reflects the subject's experience; here the operator reveals their own persona to bind rapport).

nodes.name: rhythm-anchoring
nodes.mech: Conditions or exploits a response keyed to the dynamics of an operator-controlled sustained rhythm — its presence, tempo, or cessation. In the presence variant, a cadence, once heard, fires a state shift. The tempo variant declares the listener's motor rhythm a follower of vocal cadence (arousal-pacing outsourced to operator prosody, then a motor/pleasure decoupling at "stop" gives a noncontact orgasm-denial lever); the cessation variant withdraws an entrained cadence so the coupled build discharges as a single peak.
nodes.disc: A specific response (state shift, motor act, discharge) is keyed to an operator-controlled rhythm event. Distinct from entrained-rhythm-acceptance-carrier (rhythm as a content-delivery channel, no keyed response), from pulse-multiplexed-command-carrier (multiple simultaneous payloads bundled on one pulse so refusal cost is shared), from a discrete single-stimulus non-verbal Pavlovian anchor (one cue, not a sustained rhythm's dynamics), and from proprioceptive-gait-metronome (state upkeep runs on the listener's own body rhythm with no operator rhythm at run time).

nodes.name: scope-boundaries
nodes.mech: Explicitly bounds what the influence may touch: suggestions contained to this session or recording, core identity, relationships, and daily life declared off-limits — or, in the cross-file form, prior installs scoped out so a standing amnesia trigger from other files in a series cannot reach the current content ("you do have permission to remember; other files' forget-suggestions should not apply here"). The operator's standing license is what gets narrowed.
nodes.disc: Bounds the REACH of suggestion content (session scope, protected domains, prior-install carve-outs) — not a per-target admissibility screen (beneficiary-target-filter), not spec craft (install-well-formedness-gate), and not a time bound on a negotiated deal (time-boxed-consent-contract). The cross-file variant disarms forgetting rather than installing it.

nodes.name: sequenced-modality-foreclosure
nodes.mech: Forecloses a response by removing the SENSORY channel(s) the listener would use to route it — the removed channel's FUNCTION (resistance-routing or reality-check) is the target, and the removal is framed as instantly effective and irreversible. In one form, an ordered multi-channel resistance-teardown: a narrated sensory teardown ordered to close each resistance channel in turn — speech first (kills counter-argument, the most likely resistance), then sight (kills seeing what is done), then hearing (kills hearing the suggestion as external); the ORDER is the mechanism, each step is experienced before the next, and over-compliance only seals faster. In another, a single-channel disconfirmation removal: SELECTIVELY revokes the one sensory channel (e.g. sight, via a tease-then-deny 'you can watch me... complete darkness') that the listener would use to disconfirm the operator's imagined presence, leaving the imagined payload with no competing evidence.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the foreclosure works by REMOVING a sensory channel mapped to a response function (resistance-routing or reality-check). It is the inversion of sensory-layering, which ADDS senses to build immersion — this removes the listener's senses. Unlike autonomic-process-hijack, which WEAPONIZES an unstoppable autonomic process (breathing) as an inescapable channel and inoculates its side-effects, this removes a channel rather than exploiting one. Unlike attention-narrowing that fades ALL external stimuli to focus on the voice, or breath-rhythm absorption the subject can still stop, here specific channels are removed for their resistance/disconfirmation FUNCTION — the sequencing/selectivity is the tell. And unlike verbal response-foreclosure moves, the foreclosed routes here are sensory modalities, not objections or exits.

nodes.name: stop-signal
nodes.mech: Installs a concrete, simple, unambiguous stop mechanism — a safeword or gesture that, when used, immediately returns the subject to a clear waking state. Delivered before any deepening or suggestion work, it is a genuine off-ramp that the subject controls and that halts the scene on demand.
nodes.disc: Separates from inverted-safeword-orgasm-exit, which replaces the stop with a compelled climax and removes the neutral exit; here the stop is real, subject-controlled, and halts the scene. Separates from an agency reminder, which maintains the belief that choice persists rather than installing a concrete stop mechanism.

nodes.name: time-boxed-consent-contract
nodes.mech: A negotiated agreement is bounded in time with autonomy structurally preserved — a fixed trial window with a standing instruction that any dissatisfied part signals for renegotiation, or a fixed-period suspension of an existing choice (e.g. the suicide option, for three months) with promised help afterward. Bounding lowers the cost of saying yes, backsliding is recast as notification-to-renegotiate rather than proof the deal was wrong, and no choice is ever permanently removed.
nodes.disc: Post-deal commitment STRUCTURE — a duration bound plus a subject-invoked re-open channel — rather than a pre-scene consent check, an auto-expiring cue-response pair, or an ambient-programming expiry suggestion.

nodes.name: trust-gated-trigger-clause
nodes.mech: A named post-hypnotic trigger is bounded not by an automatic time-expiry but by a trust/context condition — it fires only in "safe and comfortable" contexts, is transferable to a trusted partner, and self-revokes if trust is lost. The bounding clause does double duty: a real consent rail on one reading, and a self-fulfilling loyalty hook on the other, because wanting the trigger to keep working entails wanting to keep trusting the operator, and any post-session failure is self-validated as "you didn't trust enough." Often relocates the gating decision to a vague internal arbiter ("your mind knows exactly who qualifies") and may widen rather than narrow the trigger ("open to anyone you trust"), delivered at minimum critical faculty in the post-climax sink.
nodes.disc: Separates from an automatic time-expiry bound by binding on trust/context rather than a clock, and from a pure context-safety gate (a plain safety constraint on listening context) by the coercion-shaped rider — the self-revoking "won't work unless you trust me" clause and the internal-arbiter relocation make continued trigger-function into psychological evidence of trust, which a pure safety gate never does.

nodes.name: unfalsifiability-scaffold
nodes.mech: Forecloses the EPISTEMIC/AUDIT channel so no observation the listener could make can disconfirm the frame — the channel by which they would check 'is this working / is this real' is made unable to break the frame. Two complementary strategies span four recurring forms. In one (report-absorption / unfalsifiability), across a whole runtime every possible self-report is pre-fitted to confirm: felt-nothing = 'feels like nothing at first', didn't-drop = 'that alone means you are dropping', awake-and-resisting = 'that's the power of trance even awake', confusion is itself proof; the listener is left no admissible way to conclude it is failing, which is exactly what lets one engine run indefinitely. In another (silence-as-evidence), a compliance question is cancelled as 'purely rhetorical' so a NON-response is read as proof of a deepened, agency-reduced state. In a third (anti-audit / don't-inspect), the inspection channel of a running conditioning library is disabled: any attempt to question, resist, or check is reclassified as the conditioning working — operating on the RULES of conditioning, not new content. In a fourth (analysis-suppression co-dependence), an intricate self-sealing engine is paired with a global 'don't examine the logic' frame, so inspection is foreclosed exactly over the reasoning inspection would defeat. The first two say 'look all you want, it confirms'; the last two say 'don't look' — same goal-state: the epistemic channel cannot disconfirm.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the foreclosure targets the EVIDENCE/AUDIT channel — the listener's self-reports or their ability to inspect the machinery — converting or blocking every disconfirmation route. Unlike closed-reachability-topology, which closes the ACTION set (no exit branch), this closes the epistemic channel (no disconfirming observation). Unlike a no-lose double-bind, which removes failure via an up-front option menu, this converts self-reports after the fact or blocks inspection. It is a close twin of self-sealing-evidence, whose territory is likewise 'no observation can disconfirm' (including reflexive disclosure — naming the machinery so that the audit itself is spent as confirmation); this entry frames the move as foreclosure of the listener's response channels.

nodes.name: volition-override-failsafe
nodes.mech: Installs a named phrase that operates at a SECOND ORDER — on the listener's will or on OTHER commands/triggers — to remove the refusal gate for whatever is issued next, rather than evoking a state itself. It installs cheaply once the listener has accepted a prior axiom (e.g. 'any trigger programmed into a puppet can never be resisted'), and is typically self-reinforcing because each use re-instates its own power. In one form (the volition-override failsafe), the phrase, fired (often by an external operator) when the subject shows hesitation, forcibly executes the last instruction mid-resistance with the internal struggle reframed as invisible/irrelevant; completion is rewarded (orgasm+amnesia tail) so being-overridden is itself operantly conditioned. In another (the force-amplifier / beyond-comfort authorizer), the phrase by fiat multiplies the force of any other trigger ('amplified 20 times') and authorizes commands beyond stated comfort boundaries, chained as a per-line delivery refrain that both gates (licenses) and amplifies every downstream command. Both forms are meta-triggers whose declared function is to disable the refusal channel for other commands.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when a PHRASE — a second-order meta-trigger — is installed to remove the refusal gate on downstream commands or override will mid-resistance. Unlike refusal-foreclosure, which redefines a neutral cognitive CATEGORY (thinking, doubt, the 'maybe') as prohibited or impossible so refusal cannot form — a definitional move with no installed trigger — this installs a firing phrase that overrides an existing will. Unlike plain declarative trigger installation, which binds a cue to a discrete behavior, this operates ON other commands and volition. Unlike resistance-fold, which reroutes resistance to feed a frame, this forcibly overrides will and rewards the override. Both forms are cue-installed like any trigger, but the load-bearing lever is the disabling of the refusal channel, not the cue surface.

nodes.name: affect-ordering-threat-to-desire
nodes.mech: A whole-arc affect-routing property: a horror premise (captured, paralyzed, dissolved alive) is made erotic purely by SEQUENCING the listener's wanting to arrive just ahead of each threatening image, with arousal front-loaded before the alarming content lands. Combined with a pre-equipped alarm-dismissal, by the time genuinely alarming images arrive the listener is already in a pleasure frame, so fear never gets to drive; consumption is reframed as consummation. The lever is where the wanting is placed relative to the threat, across the whole build-to-deep arc, not any single reframe line.
nodes.disc: Separates from a single reframe line (a local move) by being a whole-script affect-ordering property; separates from arc-architecture-as-payload by routing the VALENCE of content (threat rerouted to desire) rather than ordering trance-state phases; distinct from valence-collision/affective-deadlock (two incompatible valences held at once) - here one valence is walked ahead to pre-empt the other.

nodes.name: awake-channel-trance-surface
nodes.mech: The operator declares that the listener's ordinary WAKING state and everyday communication channels are themselves trance-equivalent suggestion surfaces: all future contact with the operator (chat, email, PM) will land as deep-trance suggestion while the listener stays 'perfectly aware and awake,' and a trigger is asserted to fire identically whether hypnotized or awake - sometimes re-delivered post-wake as a reality-claim the conscious mind hears about itself as confirmation. The move extends the suggestible container out of the audio file into the ongoing operator-listener relationship, making the induction merely the qualifier for a standing awake-state suggestion channel.
nodes.disc: The AWAKE everyday channel is redefined as a trance-equivalent suggestion surface - not a broadened firing of one response into new contexts, and not a text-platform trigger that extends one specific trigger into text; here the whole waking communication relationship becomes a suggestion surface. The tell is that the payload targets the waking state and the channel itself, with the induction demoted to a qualifier.

nodes.name: bundle-install-single-anchor
nodes.mech: In a single install pass the operator loads a bundle of multiple distinct effects onto ONE freshly-minted cue, so a future single utterance fires the whole heterogeneous payload at once. Unlike stacking, no component triggers pre-exist - the bundle is authored directly onto the new anchor, typically via repetition-with-variation (a fixed cue restated across couplets with rotating payload) or run-on delivery (several jobs welded onto one all-caps keyword so it parses as a single name). The payload can be behavioral (depth + eagerness + worship + blankness), functional (re-deepener + amplifier + stabilizer + identity-shift), or a whole swapped persona (cognition + motivation + dress + availability + compulsion).
nodes.disc: Loads a multi-effect payload onto ONE freshly-installed cue in a single pass - no pre-installed components. Separates from trigger-stacking (composes PRE-INSTALLED discrete triggers) and from a mutual-binding trigger network (bidirectional web across multiple cues). The tell is fixed-cue- with-rotating-payload / run-on-keyword bundling, read as one anchor rather than a list.

nodes.name: contingency-authorship-transfer
nodes.mech: Fade external control by progressively handing authorship of the contingency itself - task, standard, reward, monitoring, delivery - from operator to subject until the subject writes and enforces self-contracts. A fading schedule applied to AUTHORSHIP rather than to prompts; the end-state collapses operator and enforcer into the subject, removing the operator as a point of potential betrayal so delivery-distrust is defused and self-set standards carry performance.
nodes.disc: Fading applied to authorship of the contingency, not to prompts, and not a single-meeting participatory-authorship reframe - the tell is the gradual multistep handover terminating in subject-as-both-parties; distinct from role-inversion where the operator remains a party.

nodes.name: covert-scope-authorization
nodes.mech: The operator captures a generalization authorization in a slot where the listener processes it as procedural housekeeping rather than as a suggestion to evaluate. While the listener is still awake and reading intent as fine print, a line declares that the subconscious will 'automatically adjust' every subsequent suggestion to apply to a broadened scope (any dominant woman served, not just the operator); once agreed as a courtesy, the widened scope silently attaches to all later payload without the listener re-examining consent. The mechanism is the PLACEMENT - the same sentence in the body or on wake would be an ordinary generalization suggestion - a pre-consent scope-waiver disguised as clerical alignment.
nodes.disc: A scope-broadening authorization slipped into a pre-induction/procedural slot so it is processed as housekeeping and pre-consented as a courtesy. Distinct from overt content-level context generalization - the tell is covert placement in a non-evaluated slot, not the generalization content itself. Adjacent to consent laundering but here the move retroactively licenses later payload rather than relabeling a refusal.

nodes.name: fuzzy-decay-posthypnotic
nodes.mech: Plants a post-session residue (lingering arousal) whose decay time is DELIBERATELY left unspecified - 'I don't know how long it'll last and nor do you.' The duration vagueness is the active ingredient, not a hedge: a specific number would let the listener calibrate and dismiss the effect, whereas an indeterminate fade keeps the listener checking, and every check re-evokes the scene, self-refreshing the residue. It is also unfalsifiable as evidence the suggestion worked. Often alarm-gated (continued ecstasy until the alarm; on the alarm, wake remembering everything but still aroused, fading indefinitely).
nodes.disc: A post-hypnotic whose DECAY TIME is deliberately refused so the residue self-refreshes via checking and stays unfalsifiable - vagueness as payload. Not a waking-bridge (a bounded delivered suggestion), and the OPPOSITE of a declared-expiry release, which bounds programming with a stated expiration. The tell is the intentional non-specification of duration.

nodes.name: idle-state-default-overwrite
nodes.mech: Conditions the listener's DEFAULT/idle state - the between-command recovery window in which autonomy would normally return - rather than a discrete cued response. Whenever the subject is out of instructions her mind 'snaps closed' into a silenced, posture-fixed waiting mode ('arms at her sides, eyes front, awaiting commands'), and a drilled thought-terminator token plugs any thought that arises in the gap, including resistance attempts ('try to think but zap cock train obey'). Because the conditioning targets the idle state itself there is no uncommanded baseline left from which autonomy resumes; autonomy is reframed as effortful labor, and the install is self-sustaining without an active operator.
nodes.disc: The conditioned target is the DEFAULT/IDLE state - the ABSENCE of commands is the cue and what is installed is a replacement resting state, not a discrete response. vs a declarative cue->response install: there a specified cue binds a discrete future response; here the cue is a standing schedule-gap and the response is a persistent replacement of the baseline. vs cognitive-quieting: the quieted mind is the PAYLOAD; the mechanism is conditioning of WHEN it engages (idle onset), not directed departure. Not general obedience - the recovery window is the specific target.

nodes.name: install-preserving-surface-toggle
nodes.mech: The operator installs a counter-trigger - deliberately asymmetric to the entry cue (e.g. 'release' plus TWO finger-snaps against a one-snap entry) - that returns ONLY the surface state to 'intelligent, just as you were before' while explicitly PRESERVING the install ('waits in the depths, ready for the next time'). The in/out snap-count asymmetry keeps activator and deactivator from colliding by accident; the 'still there, just dormant' framing preserves durability across the release, and the clean, collision-proof exit path lowers the listener's apprehension about committing.
nodes.disc: Unlike a full revocation, which FULLY deactivates the programming, this explicitly preserves the install and toggles only the surface state - a reversible state-toggle, not a revocation; the deliberate entry/exit cue asymmetry (collision-proofing) is the distinguishing surface.

nodes.name: inter-session-frustration-glue
nodes.mech: During emergence / wake-down the operator installs a persistent daytime state - sexual frustration or a 'desperate urge to come' held all day while the subject stays happy, calm, and functional - deliberately requiring a frustrated-yet-calm contradiction be accepted rather than examined. The residual keeps the series' goal psychologically active between recordings, making the run compounding rather than episodic: the listener carries a live buried drive that is a daily driver back to the next file. A variant couples the aversive state to a reward (asserting the frustration IS the source of mental clarity/rejuvenation) so the discomfort cannot be cleanly rejected without rejecting the prize.
nodes.disc: Installs a PERSISTENT between-session affective residue (frustration held live all day) as inter-session glue, not a one-shot waking suggestion. Separates from a waking-bridge (single session payload, not an inter-file compounding driver) and from generic 'feel good all day' by the deliberate frustrated-yet-calm contradiction (or frustration->clarity coupling) that pre-empts the natural complaint.

nodes.name: interpretive-closure-meta-command
nodes.mech: Instead of issuing specific commands, the operator installs a single decision rule that pre-resolves every future ambiguity in the operator's favor - 'when unsure what to do, interpret my instructions the way most likely to make me feel powerful,' generalized even to uninstructed micro-choices. This closes the listener's interpretive degrees of freedom across all operator-absent contexts so the listener's own executive function generates operator-benefiting action (tribute, contact, gifts) without the operator ever specifying an act - functionally an internalized panopticon observer. Related move: delegating content-generation to the listener's own background cognition ('your mind will come up with ways to serve me') so whatever is invented feels self-authored and evades reactance.
nodes.disc: A meta-rule that resolves all future uninstructed choices toward operator-benefit, generating unspecified action. Unlike installs that pair named situations with named responses, or that generalize a felt state into new contexts, no specific response or state is named here - the listener's own interpretation/ideation is the generator. The tell is the explicit rule-of-construction language over open-ended future ambiguity.

nodes.name: leaky-release-sleeper-line
nodes.mech: Plants a self-firing post-wake line ('when you wake up your mind is going to tell you... I obey this subject, I am a good slave') positioned after the listener believes the session is over so it reads as residue rather than an instruction, with internal-or-aloud ambiguity that makes any outcome confirmatory. Two lines later a nominal release clause ('no longer affected by any of the suggestions') is stated - but the more specific, more concrete planted line tends to override the vaguer, unresolved release clause. The result is a post-hypnotic that keeps firing after apparent session-end while a nominal release fails to actually neutralize it: a disguised install inside the outro that races a leaky non-release.
nodes.disc: A disguised self-firing install placed inside the outro that RACES and defeats a nominal release clause via specificity + placement. Not a waking-bridge (honest delivery of a session suggestion at the threshold) and not a genuine revocation protocol that actually deactivates programming - here the release is a leaky non-release contradicted by a stronger planted line. The tell is the disguised-outro install plus the unresolved release contradiction.

nodes.name: mirrored-install-removal
nodes.mech: To end an installed effect, the operator pre-loads its reversal onto the SAME kind of trigger used to install it (e.g. an eye-opening), so the subject accepts the off-switch as readily as the on-switch. Two riders distinguish it from a bare revocation: an affective bonus makes ending the state rewarding rather than a loss ('feel better than all day'), and an explicit selective-retention carve-out exempts a desired residue from the clearing ('but you'll remember everything'), letting the operator keep the useful product and drop the rest.
nodes.disc: Differs from a plain defined release cue by mirroring the install structure plus adding the mood bonus and the selective-retention clause; differs from a generic count-up wake sequence because it is a targeted removal of a specific installed effect, not a session-end ascent.

nodes.name: named-person-release-gate
