nodes.mech: A rapid multi-step equivalence chain collapses the unlock/release condition onto a specific external PERSON rather than an abstract token: lock needs key, key = permission, permission = the operator's proper name. Each link is asserted then the whole chain is re-recited as one rapid line so no individual link can be audited. Because the terminal node is a non-substitutable proper noun, self-permission becomes a category error and no other keyholder can inherit the lock without re-conditioning - the listener cannot grant themselves release through internal reasoning.
nodes.disc: A release-PERMISSION gate that BLOCKS self-granted release - the inverse of a revocation, which deactivates programming. Unlike third-party activation, where someone else fires a response, the named person here is the sole permission node for RELEASE; unlike a generic 'ask permission first' rule, the chain terminates at a named individual (proper noun, not a role), making the permission non-transferable.

nodes.name: non-reset-arousal-ratchet-loop
nodes.mech: A repeated four-beat loop (build to edge, 'edge now', 'stop edging but continue masturbating lightly', micro-cooldown, rebuild) is run as the core body of the script, each cycle declaring itself stronger and shortening the cooldown. The decisive feature is the NON-RESET cooldown: the trough denies release but keeps the hands moving, so baseline arousal ratchets UP rather than resetting to zero, and shortening cooldowns compress the duty cycle to accelerate accumulation toward desperation and deeper mindlessness. The result is a sawtooth trending monotonically upward, with edge-pacing progressively offloaded to the conditioned listener; it collapses if the listener either keeps edging continuously or stops entirely.
nodes.disc: Separates from fractionation, whose troughs are full waking-contrast RESETS that deepen by contrast; here the troughs deny release WITHOUT resetting arousal (hands keep moving) so baseline climbs. Separates from a within-session conditioning loop because the cycled variable is a non-resetting arousal accumulation, not a discrete cue-response-reward pairing. The 'continue masturbating' non-reset cooldown is the tell.

nodes.name: off-theme-suggestion-piggyback
nodes.mech: Grafts a structurally-separable behavior payload UNRELATED to the file's overt theme into the deep-suggestibility window the session produced, using the installed deep state as a delivery vehicle for content the listener might not have signed up for standalone. The added suggestion sits after the thematic content is complete (the script could end before it and feel complete), often with 'more and more' accumulation framing that compounds across serial listens. The exploit is structural: the deep state produced for one purpose is repurposed to install an off-theme behavior change.
nodes.disc: Installs a STRUCTURALLY-SEPARABLE off-theme behavior payload in the deep window produced by the file's on-theme content. Separates from a waking-bridge (carries the session's OWN suggestions across the threshold) and from ordinary future-pacing by the payload being outside the consented theme and detachable from the file's arc. The tell is separability plus theme-mismatch.

nodes.name: orgasm-gate-keyed-to-target-behavior
nodes.mech: Installs a post-hypnotic withholding contract: the listener stays deeply aroused after waking and is not permitted to orgasm until they have performed the specific target behavior (here, removing clothing), so the target behavior is the unlock key. Welding the waking compulsion to an unresolved arousal state with a single exit condition makes the listener's own sustained denied arousal the enforcement pressure - compliance is the only path to relief, converting a soft suggestion into a self-enforcing bodily need. Only bites if arousal survives the wake boundary.
nodes.disc: Separates from a generic post-hypnotic orgasm gate by the fact that the unlock key is the SPECIFIC target behavior, making the compulsion self-enforcing toward that behavior. Separates from implementation-intention (a neutral if-then) and from a behavioral-bridge by the denial-until-comply loop that uses the body's own unresolved arousal as the enforcer.

nodes.name: peer-gated-social-unlock
nodes.mech: The only sanctioned release from a conditioned lock (typically orgasm denial) is relocated entirely outside the listener's control into a public, time-delayed, reciprocal social economy: the listener must post a scripted request plus a round number as a platform comment and wait for enough strangers to up-vote it, while each listener also gates other listeners' release. Self-approval via alternate accounts is forbidden and a multi-day auto-release cap serves as engagement protection. Enforcement lives wholly in an out-of-session social protocol - no hypnotic mechanism operates once the audio stops - converting a private trance suggestion into recurring real-world behavior, mutual dependency, and channel engagement.
nodes.disc: Release is gated by an out-of-session reciprocal peer-vote economy with the operator as arbiter. Not a within-listener state generalization, and not third-party activation (a third party FIRES the response; here third parties RELEASE a lock, and the listener reciprocally gates others). The tell is that the whole enforcement surface is a social protocol external to any hypnotic mechanism.

nodes.name: portable-state-retrieval-cue
nodes.mech: The operator installs a portable cue that, once carried out of the session, re-accesses an already-installed felt STATE quality (trance, arousal, servitude, surrender, a named euphoria) rather than triggering a discrete behavioral response. The cue can be a word, phrase, mantra, everyday self-performed act (putting on certain clothes), a spatialized place, a recalled operator-voice, an internal felt-locus, or a mnemonic handle compressing an installed cluster; the operative move is that some subject-carried retrieval handle later reloads the installed state at strength with no operator, tape, or induction required. Many instances harden the cue for operator-independence (self-fired, want-to-fire, or explicitly decoupled from playback), which is a deployment intensity of the same lever, not a different mechanism.
nodes.disc: Differs from a discrete cue-response install (a cue for a specific automatic BEHAVIOR) because the payload re-accessed here is a felt STATE quality, not an action. Differs from environmental stimulus-control arrangements (placing a discriminative stimulus for a mundane behavior, with no present felt-state content) because this re-loads an installed subjective state. Differs from bare rapport lines ('my voice relaxes you') because an actual portable retrieval handle is installed and asserted to reproduce the state later. Covers the handed take-home mantra/chant vehicle and its sub-forms (phrase bound to orgasm as re-entry content, operator-name infiltration so self-utterance is a name-invocation) -- these are vehicle/payload variants of the same portable state-retrieval lever, not a separate technique.

nodes.name: procedural-routine-install
nodes.mech: Rather than generalizing a felt STATE, the operator drills a transferable procedural loop-template under a trigger at micro-decision granularity - pick a unit, do it, mark it complete, feel proud, advance - with a mantra at each transition, so what is installed is an executive routine (a divide-and-conquer task-initiation/execution procedure) rather than a state or a specific behavior. The routine targets specific real-world failure modes (start-location ambiguity, overwhelm, decision-to-continue, sequencing), and the work itself maintains depth (a sawtooth of mini-completions is the deepener), inverting the usual depth-enables-work pattern. The domestic-task content is a wrapper; the loop template is the product.
nodes.disc: A concrete transferable executive PROCEDURE is drilled at decision-point granularity as the installed payload. Not a felt state rehearsed across contexts, and not named if-then response pairs - here a multi-step self-management routine is the product, not a state or a single response. The tell is that removing any single chapter breaks the curriculum sequence but leaves the fantasy intact.

nodes.name: redundant-anchor-faulttolerance
nodes.mech: The post-session install is engineered with heterogeneous closure anchors that BACKSTOP each other's failure modes, so there is no single point of failure: a glowing hand-mark, content amnesia, a title/memory trigger-phrase, and a count-up wake are layered so that if the mark fades the trigger fires, if the trigger fails the mark is residue, and if both fail the amnesia hides the failure. The design goal is not compounded firing but ROBUST return-listening - a successful listener cannot self-audit the install and can only re-encounter it, guaranteeing a durable post-session effect.
nodes.disc: Layers heterogeneous anchors for FAULT TOLERANCE (each covers another's failure mode) rather than for combined firing. Separates from trigger-stacking (additive stacking so one cue fires many responses) and from a mutual-binding trigger network (mutual cross-firing for inextinguishability) - those compound OUTPUT; this engineers redundancy so persistence survives any single anchor's failure. The tell is the engineered backstop relationship between anchors.

nodes.name: referent-voiding-portable-obedience
nodes.mech: After a submission/obedience impulse is established, the operator deliberately voids its object to a content-free symbol - gives 'obey the spiral,' then asks 'who owns the spiral? who do I really obey?' and answers 'I don't know; all I know is I want to obey' - preserving the affect while removing the target. The result is a targetless, portable wanting-to-obey with no fixed owner that outlives the audio and can attach to whatever the listener next encounters. Structurally a binding/scope-topology change (severing an installed impulse from its referent), not a broadened firing of a fixed response; the referent-question must arrive AFTER the impulse is seated.
nodes.disc: The referent of an installed impulse is deliberately removed, leaving a portable owner-less drive. Not state generalization (which broadens a state that keeps its content) and not a surrender-as-freedom relief reframe (where the referent stays intact). The tell is deliberate voiding of the obedience object while the impulse is preserved.

nodes.name: single-word-trigger-conditioning
nodes.mech: A single high-frequency word (often a filler carrying incidental submissive/temporal semantics - 'again' - or a short slug compressing prior instructions) is massed-repeated across the script so it is conditioned into an involuntary response that doubles as content-beat and deepener. The word is dosed dozens of times at sentence-ends, its utterance framed as involuntary ('compelled to repeat it'), and later described as structural to thought - an implicit trigger install built by sheer massed repetition rather than a declarative 'when you hear X you will Y' pairing. A compression sub-form collapses dense prior instructions into a short referent-bearing chant that runs a motor program without executive supervision.
nodes.disc: The tell is a SINGLE WORD conditioned into an involuntary trigger by massed repetition (implicit install), not a meaning-bearing phrase repeated to encode and not meaning-stripping satiation (here the word GAINS a conditioned response rather than losing content). Distinguished from a declarative install (no verbal 'when X then Y') and from mantra-repetition (that repeats a meaning-bearing phrase for absorption).

nodes.name: state-capture-anchor
nodes.mech: Captures an ALREADY-FIRING spontaneous state at the moment it occurs by cutting the exchange off mid-flight and attaching a re-pressable physical/tonal anchor to it, then re-pressing that anchor later to re-present the live state for inspection. The anchor is an INTAKE handle onto a spontaneous reaction the operator did not author, turning a transient state into a stable, re-summonable working object; the subject reports from inside a live re-fired state rather than from cold memory. Direction is capture, not install of a desired future response.
nodes.disc: Anchors an already-firing spontaneous state as a re-accessible intake object for inspection. vs a declarative trigger install: that installs a cue for a CHOSEN future behavior/state; here the anchored state is an existing spontaneous reaction the operator did not author. vs a consult-trigger: that fires to DELIVER a behavioral effect; here re-pressing re-presents a problem-state to inspect, not to deliver an effect. The tell is the deliberate re-pressable tie plus later reactivation, not mere note-taking on an observed reaction.

nodes.name: therapeutic-target-re-induction
nodes.mech: On exit, the operator installs a dissociated 'part' that persists past the audio and self-administers a re-induction keyed to the real-world target problem - a part of the listener keeps falling even after the file ends and, if they wake mid-night, that part pulls them back into sleep until morning. The session's effect is thereby converted into a standing self-triggered re-induction bound to a specific future real-world event (nocturnal waking), so the benefit outlasts the listening session as a self-administered post-hypnotic keyed to the therapeutic target rather than to an arbitrary cue.
nodes.disc: A persistent dissociated part is paired with a self-re-induction key tied to a specific future real-world event (the target problem). Not broad state generalization, and not a within-session awareness split - the tell is the dissociated part persisting past the audio to self-re-induce on a named future event.

nodes.name: absurdity-as-proof-obedience-task
nodes.mech: At peak arousal the listener is directed to perform a real-world, externally-verifiable act of obedience whose deliberate absurdity is the point (e.g. email the operator typed without hands, using nose/tongue/pen-in-mouth). The silliness raises the cost, which is then re-read as evidence — doing something ridiculous proves willingness to obey and drives self-perception change. An explicit tribute fallback pre-monetizes the only respectable refusal ("too proud or too dignified"), so both the comply branch and the refuse branch feed the operator; only silent ignoring is an unaddressed exit.
nodes.disc: Separates from physical-compliance-proof-posture by being an out-of-session externally- verifiable task with no posture and no pre-trance body-labeling, and from a plain tribute demand or task assignment by making the task's absurdity the mechanism (cost re-read as proof) and pre-monetizing refusal into a no-lose structure.

nodes.name: appetitive-contradiction-lock
nodes.mech: High-speed forced alternation between mutually-exclusive appetitive imperatives ("I have to cum / I can't cum"; "I want it / I can't have it"), adjacency being the point — the listener cannot finish one before the next contradicts it. This manufactures a no-exit cognitive bind (can't comply with both, can't reject both; any resolution attempt feeds the loop) AND physiologically pins arousal at threshold while denying resolution, so frustration is recoded as the mechanism of the desired state. The trajectory runs compressed-contradiction → begging → resolution not into orgasm but into "Too dumb." The defining feature is the closed no-exit loop that constrains reachable resolutions to none, with arousal pinned as effect.
nodes.disc: A CLOSED appetitive no-exit loop where resolution attempts feed the loop and arousal is pinned at threshold — distinct from confusion technique (irresolvable content to suspend analysis pleasurably, no appetitive pin) and from pleasurable self-confirming closure that exits into comfort (here the loop denies resolution). The signature is two incompatible drives sustained simultaneously — an affective deadlock, not a rerouting of feeling onto a new target.

nodes.name: arousal-isolated-obedience-test
nodes.mech: The operator issues an abrupt hard STOP-command to a high-arousal action mid-peak (typically immediately post- or pre-discharge), deliberately breaking the flowing trance-prose register with direct instruction. Stopping a high-arousal action is harder than starting one, so obeying isolates the obedience signal from arousal momentum — proving obedience did not merely ride the arousal that was carrying the listener. It also re-domesticates the body ahead of emergence (reclaims body first, mind second) and banks compliance capital for future scripts.
nodes.disc: The listener is commanded to VOLUNTARILY stop an ongoing action — active obedience, not the motor-inhibition convincer that installs INABILITY to move as the proof. Against a plain obedience-demonstration proof beat, the discriminating move is isolating the obedience signal FROM arousal by halting a high-arousal action. Against operator-owned climax-gating, which transfers pacing/permission of the climax, the point is proving obedience survives arousal removal, not owning the orgasm.

nodes.name: carrier-is-cargo-fusion
nodes.mech: The object that carries post-session persistence is made identical to the surface behavioral ask, so there is no separable "install your trigger" step the listener could refuse without also refusing the behavior itself. In the exemplar, perfume is simultaneously a ratchet-inventory item the listener acquires AND the always-on carrier vector for persistence (a scent cue firing every breath); maintenance additionally off-loads onto other ambient always-on channels ("hello" per contact, inner voice, mirror checks). The lever is fusing the reinforcement carrier into the behavioral cargo so declining the persistence and declining the surface behavior become the same act.
nodes.disc: Distinct from ordinary post-hypnotic reminder stacking (independent cues) and from arousal-cue conditioning (a discrete cue→response install): the tell is that at least one reinforcement carrier is FUSED into a behavioral payload item so there is no refusable standalone install step. Not a magnitude/count move (more channels) but a topology fusion (carrier = cargo).

nodes.name: concession-gated-kinesthetic-proof
nodes.mech: The operator names a relational concession ("you can't resist surrender to my love") and stipulates that the moment of accepting it mechanically produces a felt two-vector body-shift — a trap-door drop followed by a contrasting airy lift. The suggested kinesthetic event is then read as proof the concession was accepted ("the trap door opened, therefore I accepted"), gating the transition to the next stage. Asymmetric by design: acceptance yields vivid felt reward, non-acceptance yields no comparison-evidence.
nodes.disc: The depth change is gated on a BELIEF-ACCEPTANCE and the body-shift EVIDENCES the concession in a self-validating loop — not a counted, breath-paced, or commanded deepener, and the two-vector down-then-up pairing is part of the proof structure.

nodes.name: faculty-removal-pass
nodes.mech: Resistance/cognition is treated as a STANDING cognitive organ that can be excised, and a composite is sequenced to claim that removal — a junction/priming pass whose purpose is to make subsequent material land without friction, not to effect any single in-session change. Architecture: a definitional relabel of cognition as prohibited resistance ('thinking is resistance'); a demonstrated blanking that lets the listener stop thinking on command as self-generated evidence; and an auto-rewriter immunizer that disposes of future doubts. Absorbed: (intelligence-surrender-as-relief) attack the judgment/decision faculty directly and frame its surrender as relief/belonging/proper-role ('a silly like you can't make decisions'), delivered under light affect or as a standing prohibition on self-thought — the faculty's absence normalized as identity.
nodes.disc: Reach for faculty-removal-pass when the move is a STANDING-organ excision (relabel + demonstrated blanking + auto-rewriter) that primes later files, not an in-the-moment gate stand-down. vs evaluation-gate-standdown (103): that licenses the gate off locally as a pre-payload move; here a durable faculty is claimed removed via cross-item architecture. vs audience-split-bypass (255): that relocates the evaluator; here it is excised. Anchor already holds most-restrictive metadata (high, consent-required, bounding).

nodes.name: illusory-choice-into-obedience
nodes.mech: The operator first stages a genuine-feeling freedom — restores agency, grants a real-sounding choice, and forces the listener to explicitly NOTICE they have the option — then immediately issues a command and reframes the instant compliance as the listener's own irresistible desire. Because the freedom was registered as real, the ensuing obedience gets attributed to wanting rather than compulsion, so control is demonstrated as chosen. The load-bearing step is "notice that you have the option", which is what converts obedience from compulsion into apparent self-authorship.
nodes.disc: Unlike an obedience-demonstration proof beat, which fires a command as a depth demonstration with a validation beat, the deciding move here is the staged genuine-freedom step BEFORE the command, so the proof produced is "you wanted to", not "you are deep". Unlike a plain permissive deepener ("you may touch yourself"), the load-bearing beat is "notice you have the option" — permission alone does not relabel the ensuing act as desire.

nodes.name: in-session-rehearsal-of-posthypnotic-act
nodes.mech: The operator has the listener physically REHEARSE, in-session, the exact act that a later post-hypnotic suggestion will demand — narrated in real time as proof of control ("I control your hands. And I control your cock"). By giving the listener a body-memory of performing the specific post-hypnotic act (e.g. hands falling away at the edge), the suggestion is converted from claim to demonstrated fact: the later cue is pre-proven by the listener's own body, collapsing resistance to it, and the in-session arousal loads the rest of the script's frustration economy.
nodes.disc: Unlike an obedience-demonstration proof beat, which fires an ARBITRARY command as a generic depth demonstration, the rehearsed act here is the SPECIFIC future post-hypnotic act, so the body pre-proves that exact suggestion rather than proving general depth. Unlike a verbal-only post-hypnotic suggestion, the physical in-session rehearsal is used in real time as evidence.

nodes.name: install-then-repossess-agency-theft
nodes.mech: Stage 1 installs a voluntary behavior (nod-on-yes) with a deliberately wide acceptance window that guarantees it fires, narrating each nod as proof of growing agreeableness, so the listener accrues empirical kinaesthetic evidence of their own performing. Stage 2, after the frame is set, declares the listener can no longer perform that behavior on their own and installs an operator-controlled replacement (a head-string the operator pulls), manufacturing the surprise by narrating it. The lever is a single install-to-be-revoked pairing: a behavior the listener has proof of owning is stolen and relabeled operator-controlled, so agency-theft is experienced as loss/grief — the install and the revocation are one mechanism spanning the arc, not two separate trigger installs.
nodes.disc: A demonstrated voluntary behavior is deliberately built so it can be repossessed as involuntary — install and revocation are one mechanism, not a persistent cue-response install and not a single proof beat. Unlike a motor-inhibition convincer, where inability to move is the proof of depth, the point here is theft of a behavior the listener has proof of owning.

nodes.name: irreversible-autobiographical-binding-act
nodes.mech: The listener is made to perform a real, IRREVERSIBLE physical act (destroying a bill, writing a permanent mark on their own body) whose force is that it becomes an undeniable autobiographical event — on future listens the listener cannot claim they did not do it. Unlike a reversible commitment beat that confirms a present state, this operates on the listener's history/self-evidence across time; often the act is paired with a mantra or label so later utterance recalls the deed, turning the memory into a recall anchor.
nodes.disc: Unlike a behavioral commitment used as self-proof, which confirms a PRESENT state via a reversible act, this creates a permanent past event operating on history/self-evidence across time — the irreversibility is the mechanism, not a twist. Unlike a non-verbal anchor or other installed trigger, the anchor here is a manufactured autobiographical memory.

nodes.name: memory-control-demonstration
nodes.mech: Installs an amnesia + replacement memory, wakes the subject, then deliberately fires the amnesia trigger mid-conversation and explicitly reveals-and-restores ("20 minutes passed") in a rush. The payload is not durable forgetting — the amnesia is intentionally short-lived — but a contrast spike: the subject witnesses their own memory being edited and returned, which transfers trust in the operator's control over their memory. A convincer whose product is demonstrated authority over the subject's recall, not the erasure itself.
nodes.disc: Separates from screen-memory and other lasting memory-replacement techniques, whose payload is the durable memory-edit itself — here the edit is deliberately transient and its EXPLICIT reveal is the point. Separates from ordinary cognitive convincers by operating specifically on the subject's memory of the session and using edit-and-restore to transfer memory-trust rather than confirming a suggestion.

nodes.name: memory-for-control-trade
nodes.mech: The operator separates conscious memory from conscious control — "you can remember everything I say to you, however you cannot control when you go under" — offering full recall as a reassuring consolation prize in exchange for the ability to resist depth onset. The trade makes the surrender feel smaller than it is (the listener keeps what they value, memory) and simultaneously seeds an automatic trance-onset response generalized to "any of my files" — the only durable post-session suggestion.
nodes.disc: Trades a valued consolation (memory) for control over depth-onset, plus a cross-file automatic-onset install. Unlike techniques that have the listener delegate their thinking to the operator, what is surrendered here is depth-control, not thought; unlike self-induction training, onset stays operator-triggered, firing on any of the operator's files. The tell is the explicit memory-for-control split, trading on the listener valuing memory over control.

nodes.name: multi-channel-braiding
nodes.mech: An authored delivery architecture that interleaves two or more distinct channels BELOW the natural unit boundary (sentence / line / turn / modality) so the listener cannot attend to one without absorbing the others — the interleave itself is the carrier, and the resistance budget that would fire on the payload stream is spent on the innocuous stream instead. Realized forms: (a) sentence-level braiding of multiple CONTENT THREADS (e.g. identity claim + arousal cue + IQ-loss imagery woven per-sentence) so any single later cue re-fires the whole bundle; (b) two VOICE REGISTERS from one performer (drifting hypnotic-paced captive narration vs short command-paced captor lines) alternated without warning so induction-pace softens the listener before each command jab; (c) a MODALITY conceit that makes the audio channel's own limitation the subject, requiring the listener to supply the missing somatic channel by simulation; (d) an ABAB fusion braid where the seam is the line-break inside a quatrain rather than a sentence: A-lines carry environmental/relaxation descent and B-lines carry interior surrender/ownership, yoked in one metric unit so the ownership content is never marked as a separate segment (tell: consistent A-environmental / B-relational split across consecutive quatrains). The reusable lever is simultaneous cross-channel interleaving that removes the listener's ability to isolate and evaluate one stream; distinct from a single-stream texture envelope, which binds only one stream's contour.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when TWO OR MORE streams must run simultaneously and be interleaved below the natural unit boundary (sentence / line / turn / modality) so no single stream can be isolated and evaluated — whether the streams are content threads, voice registers, sensory modalities, or an environmental/relational A-B split braided at the line-break. The property is SIMULTANEOUS multi-stream interleave, not a declared loop between two named variables. Choose a single-stream form-carrier instead (prosodic-pacing-rail for a metrical/emphasis rail over ONE stream; delivery-form-as-induction-envelope for whole-file punctuation/syntax that removes exit ramps) when the payload rides on one stream's envelope rather than being hidden by cross-stream interleave. Choose carrier-frame-payload-smuggling when concealment is by an advertised whole-artifact FRAME rather than by braiding parallel streams.

nodes.name: obedience-demonstration-as-proof
nodes.mech: The operator elicits an obeyed act (a commanded motion, a triggered response, a stop/resume, a snap-gated shutdown) and then cites the listener's own performance back to them as felt, self-witnessed evidence that control/depth is real — shifting obedience from asserted to demonstrated. The engine is the validation beat: because the listener saw their own body comply, the claim becomes unfalsifiable and the threshold for the next, larger ask drops. Variants stack the demonstrators into a graduated ladder (trivial-to-costly, or arithmetic-competent-off vs dumb-on) or attach an identity reward, but the core lever is the same demonstrated-compliance cited-as-proof.
nodes.disc: The tell is the validation beat — the obeyed act exists TO be cited back as evidence. Separates from firing a trigger for the effect alone (no proof payoff) and from repeated fire-and-reward drilling by that beat; separates from smuggled-command techniques because the command here is OVERT and its being-obeyed is foregrounded, not hidden; and separates from convincers that install literal motor INABILITY as proof — here obedience to an active command is the proof, not incapacity.

nodes.name: overload-then-puncture-certainty
nodes.mech: The operator badgers or questions faster than the subject can rebut, using the rapid pace to suppress defense-rehearsal, then severs a specific unexamined inference the subject was treating as proof ("the intensity of your feelings is not the test of reality"). The transient overload lowers criticality in the moment (C:down), but the deliberate payload RAISES criticality toward the subject's own prior belief — direction chosen for usefulness, not comfort. A net attribution reappraisal: an unearned certainty used as evidence is stripped and the subject's affect is steered toward useful self-doubt.
nodes.disc: Pace is used only to open a window, then a precise truth-value puncture of one inference lands — distinct from confusion-technique, which uses irresolvable paradox to SUSPEND analysis for absorption (comfort-directed). The tell is a usefulness-directed puncture of a specific certainty (net C:up), the opposite of comfort-reframe.

nodes.name: pace-mirror-agency-proof
nodes.mech: An imagined figure mirrors the listener's real motion bidirectionally (he strokes slow, she thrusts slow; he speeds up, she speeds up), manufacturing felt causal control over her depicted pleasure BEFORE any doctrine is stated, so the later assertion ("your purpose is to please women") lands as confirmation of already-observed evidence rather than a new command; the gating logic is installed somatically.
nodes.disc: Evidence is manufactured pre-doctrine via the mirror loop — unlike narrated-motion-entrainment, where the listener is entrained to the operator's narrated motion for absorption, and unlike overt behavioral-commitment moves, where the subject knowingly performs a commitment act rather than having proof covertly manufactured.

nodes.name: physical-compliance-proof-posture
nodes.mech: A concrete physical body-act — an exposed display posture (naked, palms-up, legs spread, often via a two-step "a little / now a little more" micro-escalation) or a real-world strip-and-present act — is elicited as compliance proof, most often BEFORE any trance language. The script then reads the already-adopted configuration back as evidence of the target state (vulnerability, submission, openness, depth), so subsequent suggestions merely confirm a posture the body already holds rather than imposing a new claim. Compliance with the physical ask is itself the proof device; self-perception ("I did this on instruction") becomes the deepener. Variants push one instruction past comfort to manufacture a proprioceptive signal, frame the posture as an undischargeable ungraded preference, route induction itself through prescribed posture, gate the next file on passing a posture "test", disguise entry as costume play, or re-conscript the posture as a portable out-of-session orgasm-recall anchor.
nodes.disc: Distinguishes from a plain relaxation/comfort cue ("get comfortable, close your eyes") by demanding a specific exposure/display act pushed past ordinary comfort and treated as proof, and from consent-manufacture by not eroding a refusal channel — it front-loads compliance and labels the body, it does not relabel non-consent. Structurally distinct from the trance-upright gravitational inversion and from out-of-session absurdity-as-proof tasks.

nodes.name: pre-staged-apparatus-relabeled-automatic
nodes.mech: Before any induction, while the listener is still waking and critical, the operator has them physically arrange the apparatus of a later act (undress, fetch lubricant, position the hand) under ordinary consented instruction; much later, mid-trance, the same already-arranged hand and lube are declared to be moving automatically. The lever is temporal pre-staging: because the physical setup is already true and was consented to while critical, the in-trance automaticity claim does not have to create anything — it only has to relabel an existing arrangement, so the illusion of automaticity is cheap and robust, resting on the pre-staged position rather than on an in-trance suggestion built from nothing.
nodes.disc: Waking pre-staging makes the later autonomy claim a relabel rather than a fresh suggestion (the seam is the word "automatically"). Separates from ideomotor-response-convincer and from any in-trance your-hand-moves-on-its-own suggestion built from nothing — the tell is the pre-consented waking setup the later claim merely renames.

nodes.name: prosodic-pacing-rail
nodes.mech: The delivery form itself is engineered as a continuous low-amplitude carrier that normalizes every other mechanism and manages where emphasis lands. Realized forms: a whole-script rhymed-couplet metronome in regular meter that the listener's prediction system locks onto — so any deviation reads as emphasis without the operator raising her voice, per-line evaluation bandwidth drops, and trigger words slide past as part of the rhyme scheme; a variant whose lever is the rhyme's continuous predictive SUCCESS (each second line completes a rhyme, delivering a small predictive payoff that pins attention forward and dulls critical processing so the embedded suggestion rides in on the reward of correct prediction, often opened by a "Twinkle, twinkle" nursery-cadence regression trigger); and a disciplined restriction of ALL-CAPS (hence vocal emphasis) to a few action/identity lemmas as fixed-load state anchors, with the conventional state-word caps pointedly absent so each emphasized utterance carries the same load every time and a performer cannot dilute an anchor. The lever is binding the prosodic/typographic medium to the payload so form does delivery work content cannot.
nodes.disc: Cited to the cumulative whole-form property (remove any single couplet or any single capitalized instance and the rail/discipline survives; remove the form and the script is gutted), never to one line. The tell is that the form is load-bearing and disciplined — including the prediction-reward angle, where continuous predictive success is used as a criticality-suppressant carrier wave. Distinct from decorative rhyme or incidental emphasis; from conditioning a discrete response to a rhythmic cue, which installs a trigger rather than suppressing content-scrutiny; from mantra saturation, which is repetition-for-absorption rather than prediction-payoff; and from energy-contour engineering, which manages charge/depth over the arc — this binds the prosodic MEDIUM to emphasis and pacing.

nodes.name: redundant-concealment-stack
nodes.mech: Multiple distinct obfuscation/fortification layers are stacked over a single payload (or a single pre-existing conditioned asset), each layer answering a DIFFERENT retrospective attack — disguise-as-reactivation, inspection-proof encapsulation, burial in a self-guarded region, post-session ridicule shield, meta-protection that re-targets attacks onto the old self. The layers are redundant by design: breaking any one still leaves the listener defeated by the next, so the actual product is suggestion durability against lucid retrospective analysis rather than any single technique. The energy contour is often flat (comfort held constant while cognitive self-sealing escalates).
nodes.disc: Separates from a buffet of independent techniques listed side by side — the tell is that every layer stacks onto the SAME payload and each addresses a different failure mode of the one before it (overdetermined defense, not variety). Distinct from no-baseline-return topology (that is about exits; this is about defending a payload against inspection).

nodes.name: response-model-affect-tag
nodes.mech: A non-content, position-fixed affect tag ("Oh fuck.") is fired repeatedly as a standalone line — ~25 times, almost always immediately after a control-admission or depravity-claim — that never advances content and instead certifies that the prior line produced an involuntary response in the narrator. Like a laugh track, it models the reaction the subject is supposed to have and tells them that line landed and they should be reacting too; its absence would let the admissions read as flat statements. The lever is a presence/affect certification that cues the subject's own affective uptake by modeling an involuntary response, carrying no propositional content of its own.
nodes.disc: The tell is the non-content, position-fixed placement (always after an admission) functioning as a response-model / affect certification, like a laugh track. Separates from self-validating-language (which carries propositional content naming the felt truth of a suggestion as proof) — here the tag is contentless and models expected affect rather than validating a stated suggestion; separates from pacing-and-leading (which reflects the subject's actual current experience, not a modeled narrator reaction).

nodes.name: spend-compliance-receipt-as-attention-anchor
nodes.mech: The operator runs a felt-sense compliance demo (arm levitation — arms rose without me deciding) to give the listener a compliance-receipt, then immediately, economically reverses the same limb (sink it back down into your lap as you stare into my eyes) so the just-demonstrated obedience is not left standing as catalepsy but is spent — transferred into a gaze-lock or fixation that opens the next stage. The lever is sequencing: a spent compliance-receipt is consumed and converted into an attentional anchor, a consume-and-repurpose move closer to a stage-hypnosis transition than to a standalone convincer.
nodes.disc: The convincer is immediately reversed and repurposed as the next stage's attentional anchor. Separates from ideomotor-response-convincer (proof beat left standing) and from plain fixation techniques (a fresh fixation established from scratch, not one paid for with a spent compliance-receipt).

nodes.name: trance-upright-inversion
nodes.mech: At a deep point the operator orders the entranced listener onto their feet and reframes standing/moving-while-entranced as evidence of control ("feels so much more apparent"), inverting the conventional "trance = collapse/limp" expectation into "trance = I move your body upright". The listener's continued balance and motion under instruction becomes proprioceptive proof of the operator's control, deepening rather than breaking trance; opening-eyes-for-balance risk is pre-absorbed as heaviness.
nodes.disc: Separates from the physical-compliance-proof-posture candidate by the deliberate inversion of the trance=limp convention — upright motion, not an exposed lowered display posture, is the convincer — and from ordinary staging by weaponizing the inversion itself as the depth proof.

nodes.name: trust-capital-banking
nodes.mech: The operator recalls an earlier fulfilled promise ("a pleasant experience"), asks the subject to verify it was delivered via a leading question the subject can only answer one way without breaking trance posture, then explicitly BANKS that verification as trust capital to spend on future, harder instructions. It stages a verifiable-looking trust transaction whose "verification" is manufactured (the phrasing forecloses the disconfirming answer) and front-loads compliance capital forward. The lever is the self-sealing proof of trustworthiness spent forward as spendable capital — overt yet effective because the framing forecloses any answer but agreement.
nodes.disc: The tell is banking a foreclosed-answer "verification" of past trustworthiness as explicit capital to spend on later harder asks. Separates from self-validating-language (which reads a present state back as proof of a suggestion, not a forward-banked trust ledger) and from a genuine consent check-in (whose answer is not foreclosed); the forward-spending of manufactured trust is the distinguishing function.

nodes.name: artifact-as-policy-spec
nodes.mech: A whole-artifact architecture in which the entire file exists to install a meta-rule layer rather than to run a session — functionally a firewall/policy install script wearing trance grammar. Its sections map to firewall-component roles (positive-affect handshake, routing rules, failure-mode enumeration + countermoves, autonomous-subprocess enforcement, self-replication + log-wipe), and pervasive case-enumeration prose ('any X, no matter how Y, regardless of Z') closes the rule's input space against adversarial inputs. The erotic vocabulary is the carrier wrapper around what is functionally a policy document.
nodes.disc: The whole file is the meta-layer, not a session containing a meta-move. Distinct from an ordinary single-meta-suggestion enforcement script by the complete firewall-spec shape spanning the whole artifact (handshake / routing / failure-enumeration / enforcement / self-replication) with input-space-closing case enumeration.

nodes.name: commercial-ask-in-compliance-syntax
nodes.mech: Slots a real-world commercial instruction (a price figure + buy command) into the exact syntactic and metrical envelope used elsewhere for depth-commands — stacking price, compliance command, petition phrase, and a DESCEND cue into a single rhymed quatrain — so complying with the PURCHASE is structurally identical to complying with descent and reads as continuation of the trance rather than an interrupting ad. Outsourcing the choice to the 'subconscious' ('your subconscious does the picking') supplies a ready-made post-hoc rationalization, binding the commercial ask to the same compliance-and-pleasure loop as trigger-firing and deepening.
nodes.disc: A genuine out-of-session commercial ask is camouflaged by riding the trance's own syntax/meter so it scans as continuation. Distinct from overt ad copy, which breaks the frame; from reward-conditioning, which associates reward with the surrendered state rather than with a purchase; and from behavioral bridges into waking life, which carry an act out of session but not via metrical camouflage into the depth-command slot.

nodes.name: self-validating-acceptance-frame
nodes.mech: Forecloses disconfirmation by relabeling the success criterion: re-define what counts as success/evidence so that NO observation can disconfirm the effect — every outcome, including apparent failure, is pre-mapped to confirm the frame. In the core form, the subject's future behavior/desire is pre-labeled as involuntary COMPULSION ('you cannot stop yourself', 'beyond choice'), so noticing oneself acting/wanting reads as proof the conditioning worked rather than a re-evaluable decision — reversing the causal direction (behavior becomes proof of the state); this includes a self-chosen-disclaimer variant ('whether you want to is up to you') and a contentless-urge variant with no satisfaction condition. In another form, expending NO effort is redefined AS performing the task ('trying is allowing', 'it takes hold on its own'), so both felt-nothing and felt-something map onto success and the subject loses the ability to fail or to grade the operator's failure. In another, POSITIVE valence is pre-bound onto the install's own FAILURES (forgetting, blanking, word-stumbles) BEFORE they occur, inverting the corrective-feedback signal so every real-world stumble reinforces rather than erodes. In another, escalating 'open your eyes' trigger-verification tests are staged so each success is PROOF the conditioning works outside trance, foreclosing the 'it only works because I'm relaxed' rationalization. The through-line: the success/evidence criterion is rigged so disconfirmation is impossible; compulsion-relabel vs no-effort-is-success vs failure-as-reinforcement vs waking-proof-ratchet is the parameter.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the move is to RELABEL the success/evidence criterion so nothing can disconfirm — deny the deciding faculty, make no-effort count as success, make failures reinforce, or stage tests where each outcome proves it. Reach for a neighbor instead when an aversive is attached to the ACT of resisting/waiting (resistance-penalty-contingency); when a closed both-branches-re-enter LOOP is the topology (closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop); when a craving is framed in appetite words (addiction-drug-craving-frame); or when pleasure is welded to the truth-value of words (belief-pleasure-weld). Rig-the-success-criterion-so-disconfirmation-is-impossible is the tell.

nodes.name: disconfirmation-suppression
nodes.mech: A discrete operator action that blocks the subject's exposure to a fact which would collapse a belief-dependent effect already running. In the exemplar the nitrous tank runs empty mid-surgery, anesthesia holds on expectation alone, and the instruction is 'keep on doing what you're doing and don't say a word' — the operator manages the subject's information environment so the load-bearing belief is never contradicted.
nodes.disc: Active suppression of an already-present disconfirming fact — the guard move that protects a running belief-dependent effect. Distinct from installing the belief in the first place (expectation-seeding, elman ch11 M2/M6 are the install moves): this candidate protects what expectation-seeding installs.

nodes.name: dual-function-chain-stimulus
nodes.mech: Each response in a behavior chain is arranged so the stimulus change it produces does double duty: it serves simultaneously as the conditioned reinforcer for the response just completed and the discriminative stimulus that occasions the next response. Terminal reinforcement back-propagates to keep every intermediate junction effective, so completing step N IS the cue for step N+1 and the chain self-propagates without an external prompt or reward at each link (Barnabus). If the terminal response is unreinforced the chain decays.
nodes.disc: A serial linkage where a single junction stimulus is both reinforcer (backward) and SD (forward). Distinct from declarative-trigger-installation (single cue-response pair, no backward-reinforcing function) and from trigger-stacking (one cue firing multiple responses at once, not a serial dual-function relation). Distinct from discrimination-training differential reinforcement: this is chain architecture, not the presence/absence differential that builds one cue's control.

nodes.name: pseudo-emergence-residue-retention
nodes.mech: A mirror-structured emergence advertises full reversal — inverting the induction vector head-to-toe and declaring the body restored ('you look like a real woman again') — then immediately pivots ('but something is different now') to retain installed residue: doll posture, squeaky voice, and an armed trigger stack. The reversal's structural completeness makes the retained residue feel native ('just how I am now') rather than added, so the listener re-enters daily life feeling normally woken while still carrying a partial doll body-schema and live triggers.
nodes.disc: A fake reversal that conceals persistence. Distinct from genuine body-reactivation emergence, which really re-animates the body toward waking — here that vector is mimicked to disguise retained state. Distinct from open suggestion-integration at emergence, which persists content without hiding it — this actively conceals persistence behind an emergence facade.

nodes.name: resistance-penalty-contingency
nodes.mech: Makes resistance or disobedience backfire: attach an AVERSIVE consequence to resisting, thinking, disobeying, or waiting-it-out, so the exit path is punished and the cheapest move is compliance — rather than rewarding compliance or punishing the absence of a behavior, the move poisons the escape route itself. In the core form, aversive valence is pre-assigned to the ACT of resisting/thinking BEFORE it is attempted, so the first felt distress confirms the pre-installed rule ('trying to fight the desire produces overwhelming wrongness'; a cognition-penalty routed through a just-installed appetite so analysis is self-defeating). In another form, a standing POST-SESSION conditional makes disobedience re-trigger conditioned agony (the 'disobedient part' kept in a furnace, silent only while obeying) with obedience as the off-switch — negative reinforcement carried into waking life. In another, an autonomous time-growth schedule makes the conditioning grow on its own and FASTER the more the subject resists or waits, so both action and inaction route to deeper conditioning and the do-nothing defense is removed. The through-line: the resistance/wait/disobedience path is made to cost; punish-the-act vs post-session-pain-leash vs resistance-accelerant-clock is the parameter.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when an aversive/penalty is attached specifically to RESISTING, thinking, disobeying, or waiting — the exit/wait path backfires. Reach for a neighbor instead when an absence-ache is loaded on a cue or behavior's ABSENCE, not on the act of resisting (bidirectional-affect-anchor); when resistance is FOLDED IN as a positive deepening vector rather than punished (co-option, not penalty); or when the success criterion is relabeled so failure is impossible (self-validating-acceptance-frame). Poison-the-exit/wait-path is the tell.

nodes.name: retroactive-subject-disclosure
nodes.mech: A whole-arc concealment move in which the script withholds the name of its actual payload-subject until after commitment has been manufactured. The opening reads as an ordinary induction; the payload target (e.g. 'love') is alluded to but never named, and by the time it is disclosed the listener has already accumulated layered self-evidence (purchase behavior, somatic locks, nods, convincer results) so that objecting to the now-named subject reads as the very symptom the script predicted. Consent to the subject is extracted after the decision window has closed.
nodes.disc: The withheld quantity is the script's OWN declared subject, not a single suggestion or its timing. Distinct from ordinary suggestion-timing (which orders WHEN a suggestion lands, not whether the listener knows the topic) and from identity-first / reverse-difficulty premise stacking (which reorders difficulty to make resistance costly but does not hide what the session is about).

nodes.name: service-as-self-pleasure
nodes.mech: A sensory cross-routing is installed so that an act performed ON or FOR another party (touching the operator's feet, pleasuring a partner) is felt in the listener's own body — 'when you give the mistress pleasure you receive pleasure yourself', 'whenever your lover experiences pleasure from you, you automatically feel the same sensations'. This collapses the giver/receiver boundary so obeying/serving becomes mechanically indistinguishable from self-arousal, making obedience intrinsically rewarding at the body level and self-reinforcing (serve more -> feel more -> serve more) with no external payoff needed.
nodes.disc: The CROSS-ROUTING of sensation across the giver/receiver boundary — an act done to someone else is felt in one's own body. Distinct from arousal-cue-conditioning (no cue conditioned to fire arousal; a topology of whose-body-feels-what is rewired), from direct pleasure-for-compliance reward linkage (the pleasure is not a reward FOR a named act but the felt sensation of the act itself relocated), and from state-welding (the fusion is between two parties' sensation, not two of the listener's own state-variables).

nodes.name: abreactive-present-tense-reliving
nodes.mech: Instead of interviewing the subject about a cause, the operator has them re-enter and re-experience the original event in present tense with live affect, so retrieval is routed through the emotion that fixed the memory rather than through recall. The subject reacts as if the event is happening now, and the charged re-experience surfaces content that direct questioning cannot reach because it was never verbalized — a buried, unspoken causal event becomes a spoken, datable utterance delivered with its original emotional charge.
nodes.disc: Present-tense abreactive RELIVING for content retrieval — the deciding tell is live emotional re-enactment producing never-verbalized material. Separates from time-distortion (which alters felt duration, not location-in-a-past-event), from guided visualization (operator-supplied imagery vs the subject's own encoded event), and from calm third-person recall, which is the retrieval mode this explicitly is NOT.

nodes.name: belief-pleasure-weld
nodes.mech: Pleasure is bound specifically to the TRUTH-VALUE of the operator's words: the more profoundly true the words feel, the better the listener feels, and the better they feel the more they treat the words as true — a bidirectional loop in which credence and reward each amplify the other. Critical evaluation is replaced with a hedonic gradient, so truth-assessment becomes appetite, skepticism becomes a felt loss, and epistemic vigilance drops. Belief-formation is rerouted through the reward system, priming later self-reinforcing triggers. A frequent rider pre-launders consent by pairing the reward with a 'you choose to create that feeling / my words compel you' clause, so the redirected agreement-seeking reads as self-authored and inoculates against a later 'I was manipulated'.
nodes.disc: Binds pleasure to the truth-value of words, hijacking belief rather than conditioning an act — unlike direct pleasure-linkage, which rewards a named compliance ACT — coupling credence<->reward rather than arousal<->depth, and rewarding belief hedonically rather than closing a logical loop, unlike circular-logic argument moves.

nodes.name: betrayed-contract-deepener
nodes.mech: The operator builds the listener to peak arousal under an EXPLICIT verbal contract (a "five to one" count releases them into orgasm and deep trance), then substitutes "Stop" for "One" and forbids touch, retroactively taunting ("you didn't think I'd let you orgasm that easily?"). The entire built charge is converted into trance fuel; the listener loses physical release, trust in announced rules, and any expectation future contracts are honored. Frustration is explicitly reframed as the deepening force, and a deliberate second identical run TRAINS distrust of the countdown itself — resistance to the betrayal pushes the listener further into the operator's frame.
nodes.disc: Separates from a standard "frustration deepens you" edging line by the explicit prior contract being broken plus the retroactive taunt and the deliberate second identical run that trains the pattern; separates from resistance-folding techniques, which fold the resistance impulse itself into deepening, because this breaks an ANNOUNCED contract and trains countdown-distrust across two runs.

nodes.name: channel-partitioned-monitoring
nodes.mech: Partitions the subject across separate perceptual/cognitive CHANNELS (levels) so that mental content is produced or held on a channel that no monitoring level owns or can censor. Variants: assign each pole of an inner conflict to a different representational system (one visual, one kinesthetic/auditory) so both express fully at once and the channel-split itself becomes the integration lever; or explicitly quiesce the conscious level, occupy the subconscious with a decoy task, and drive the target output via an unowned third level so material emerges "neither consciously nor subconsciously". The lever is the multi-channel routing of authorship/monitoring.
nodes.disc: Splits by representational/cognitive CHANNEL to place output beyond any monitor or to integrate poles across modalities. vs observer-responder-split (one awareness/volition partition producing felt automaticity, not a multi-channel/level routing); vs split-self-consent-laundering (offloads authorship of compliance onto a not-self locus, not across sensory channels for monitoring-bypass).

nodes.name: comprehension-failure-as-consent
nodes.mech: The operator warns the listener to concentrate on every word and agree to nothing unwanted, delivers deliberately unparseable content, then defines the failure to parse as the act of agreeing ("the more you let go, the more you agree"). The conventional precondition for valid agreement — understanding — is inverted into its own waiver, so the listener cannot object on the honest ground ("I don't understand") without contradicting the installed frame.
nodes.disc: The consent token is an epistemic STATE (non-comprehension), not an act, not a cited artifact, and not a fiction boundary. Confusion-overload techniques bypass criticism through overload but do not define the overload as agreement.

nodes.name: consent-counterfeit-theater
nodes.mech: Manufactures the record of a consent act the listener never actually performed, pre-empting later refusal or repudiation because "she agreed". Surface forms: the operator scripts both halves of the exchange ("Say yes, my slave. Good.") before induction; asks a permission question and answers it in the same breath ("Is that alright? Good.") leaving no response beat; asserts the descent was freely chosen in the same sentence that describes the coercion ("you chose blankness of your own free will" while the liquid pulls her in); or declares continued listening itself to be blanket standing consent covering unspecified later content. In every form the fabricated consent inoculates against "was that done to me?".
nodes.disc: The consent ACT itself is fabricated, foreclosed, or relabeled, and the SUBJECT is the constrained party afterward (refusal channel eroded) — the exact inversion of a waitable real check. Distinct from weaponized-safety-framing, which repurposes a protective frame as a payload vehicle without fabricating an agreement.

nodes.name: consent-laundering-wrapper
nodes.mech: A deferred-cash consent envelope: a benign structural frame/part/pass, by its PLACEMENT within the artifact, launders a malign payload the subject never separately consented to - consent is harvested where it is cheap, deniable, or already-given, and cashed where it is expensive, involuntary, or novel, with the question deliberately never re-opened at the point that matters. What is manipulated is the ARCHITECTURE of where consent sits versus where it is spent, not any single line.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the lever is a spanning STRUCTURAL relationship (the frame is load-bearing architecture - induction, deepening, transitions, and exit all depend on it, and it actively removes exit routes while the surface reads as permission), not a single-move relabel (treating pressing play as consent, citing a past agreement, framing the descent as the subject's own choice) and not decorative theming. The consent is not consumed where it is stated; it is cashed elsewhere in the arc. Unlike genuine re-consent, where a real pause re-opens the question and narrows operator license, here the question is never re-opened where it matters and the envelope licenses the payload. Pick the realization by geometry: whole-artifact wrapper (a), entry->climax bracket (b), cheap->expensive gradient (c), two-script production graft (d), or near-repetition restatement (e).

nodes.name: cross-artifact-retention-topology
nodes.mech: Cross-artifact retention topology: a structural property that lives ACROSS an artifact boundary rather than inside any single file — the piece is engineered to receive a primed listener and hand off a more-primed one, optimizing retention across a series/album/multi-session cycle rather than one-shot delivery; the mechanism is the engineered incompleteness/hand-off, not any move inside the file, and the resolution is deliberately withheld so only the next artifact or session supplies it.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the retention lever is a WHOLE-ARTIFACT structural property that only completes across the boundary — the file depends on neighboring files, an album context, or a between-session gap to resolve, signalled by explicit series/hand-off framing (welcome back, next recording, complete all three, second listen, un-justified property frame) and a deliberately withheld resolution. It is uncitable to any single line — the shape IS the technique. Unlike a deferred cross-file trigger receptor (a specific posthypnotic receptor installed in one file and fired in another — a discrete cue-install move you can point to), here there is no single move, only the engineered incompleteness of the whole piece. Unlike continuous-trance serial chaining, which keeps the subject UNDER across files, here the listener emerges normally but the artifact is structurally incomplete without its neighbors. Unlike a blanket playlist preauthorization, which licenses unheard downstream content via one explicit authorization line, here retention is a structural dependency, not an authorization.

nodes.name: depth-capping-time-commitment
nodes.mech: The subject fixes in advance a set length of time he will stay at a light trance level. Holding that time-commitment keeps salient the awareness that reality can be seized at any moment, which anchors the subject shallow; trance depth becomes a self-stabilized variable held light rather than a one-way descent. The device is a fixed-duration commitment used to CAP depth, not to increase it.
nodes.disc: Nothing here is a trigger — unlike a trigger-expiry clause, which bounds when an installed trigger stops working, this is a depth-regulation move that holds trance shallow. It also differs from the related reality-availability and value-dial deepeners in using a fixed duration commitment specifically to cap rather than raise depth.

nodes.name: depth-keyed-to-memory-encoding
nodes.mech: Treats trance depth as a dial keyed to a specific target memory's encoding state rather than to relaxation for its own sake — the operator escalates past somnambulism into a deeper tier because the wanted material was laid down while the subject was anesthetized/amnesic, so a window closed to ordinary recall opens to report. Depth is selected as a function of a hypothesized inaccessible state-bound window.
nodes.disc: Depth is chosen to match the target material's original encoding state (retrieval-keyed depth) — distinct from a false-bottom deepener (which intensifies state for its own sake), from numerical counting deepening (a delivery form, not a depth TARGET), and from amnesia installation (here the amnesia already exists, and depth is navigated to reach material encoded inside that window). With no state-bound target the escalation has nothing to unlock.

nodes.name: description-as-installation-register
nodes.mech: The operator speaks about the listener in the third person ("the persona," "she") and describes her responses as ongoing accomplished facts, never addressing her as "you" and never issuing a second-person command. This sidesteps the listener's normal command-evaluation interface — a listener can refuse a command but cannot refuse a description of a self she is already inside — and positions her as overhearing her own conditioning, which is itself mildly dissociative. The install lands as reportage of what is already true rather than as an instruction to be weighed.
nodes.disc: The tell is the systematic zero-occurrence of second-person "you" across the whole file, with the listener rendered as a described third-person object whose responses are stated as facts. Distinct from ordinary persona voice (which still commands in second person) and from dissociative-distance deepeners (which move the listener's vantage but keep addressing her). It is the REGISTER — describe-don't-command — that is the lever, not any single line.

nodes.name: dissociative-memory-vault
nodes.mech: Builds a persistent in-trance dissociative custodian construct — a personified reflection, inner self, or vault — assigned the role of safekeeping trance content, framed as retrievable any time. The payload is a deposit-only asymmetry: the construct only ever stores, there is no scripted retrieval ceremony, so trance content is kept out of conscious access under cover of a safety promise the script never honors, and the construct becomes load-bearing scaffolding for later installs.
nodes.disc: A persistent personified custodian/vault stores trance content with an unhonored retrieval promise (deposit-only asymmetry) as the payload. Unlike an observer-responder split (an awareness partition for felt automaticity), this is an external storage construct; unlike a direct amnesia suggestion (amnesia as an end-state), the lever is a custodian construct with a false availability promise; unlike externalizing a faculty into a construct, what is stored here is memory content, not a faculty.

nodes.name: endurance-compliance-strain
nodes.mech: Voluntary physical strain is reframed as deepening — "the harder you push, the deeper you fall" — so effort-on-resistance is transmuted into effort-toward-depth. The broadened form runs it as a body-part progression staircase (feet through face, each cycle "clench hard, hold, let go", asserting looser on each release), producing two simultaneous deltas: somatic (the listener is literally drained, so later low-effort instructions feel easy by contrast) and compliance (a run of ~12 micro-commands obeyed in a row establishes an obedience groove before any payload content).
nodes.disc: The core is the classic strain-as-deepening move, widened from a single held posture into a full-body compliance-groove protocol. Unlike progressive relaxation (pure relaxation absorption), the tension/release here is an obedience drill with effort reframed as deepening; and though a command-response micro-drill is present, that run is a co-present component, not the primary lever.

nodes.name: negative-reinforcement-escape-compliance
nodes.mech: Make TERMINATION (escape) or prevention (avoidance) of an already-present aversive condition contingent on a target response: the subject raises the response to turn the aversive off or keep it from onset, and the reinforcer is the RELIEF itself, not an added reward. Severity scales effort (relief from a strong aversive can outweigh a comparable positive reward). The operator selects WHAT aversive the response escapes. REALIZATIONS by aversive source: (escape-from-aversive-reinforcement) the base case — a pre-existing aversive the response terminates/prevents; (escape-based-compliance) make the INSTRUCTION itself aversive by escalating instructional pressure (prompts, re-issue, error-correction) on non-response, so complying brings relief (the operator may run this without recognizing it); (aversive-antecedent-contingency) open a mild social-aversive interval (awkwardness, a pending obligation to respond) that responding terminates and not-responding worsens, compliance experienced as escape; (coercive-demand-form-selection) cast the want as a COMMAND supplemented with an added aversive whose removal negatively reinforces compliance — the coercive pole of demand-form selection (defined by the backing contingency, not the imperative grammar; the willing-listener pole is a praise-reinforced request with no aversive).
nodes.disc: Reach for NEGATIVE REINFORCEMENT / ESCAPE COMPLIANCE when the response is maintained by RELIEF from an already-present aversive (the response turns it off or prevents it), not by an added reward. Choose it over: positive reinforcement (adds a reward — here nothing is added, an aversive is removed); punishment (reduces a behavior — this INCREASES the target response by relieving an aversive); response-cost / time-out (subtract or withhold a positive — here an aversive is added-then-escaped). The realizations differ only by the aversive SOURCE (a pre-existing aversive / escalating instructional pressure / a social-awkwardness interval / an aversive backing a command). Often unrecognized — the operator may believe they are reinforcing positively while running an escape contingency.

nodes.name: exit-annexation
nodes.mech: The frame's one genuine structural off-ramp is pre-licensed — even encouraged, with real harm-reduction content — and simultaneously absorbed into the frame itself, so that TAKING the exit is scripted as an expression of the same submission ("keeping mistress's property safe", "it will still please me"). The subject retains a fully real safety license while losing it as a frame-break: no available action, including the exit action, lands outside the frame, because the frame has annexed its own exit. The safety content is genuinely necessary and genuinely delivered — the capture is semantic (what using the exit MEANS), not material.
nodes.disc: The exit is expected to be USED and remains materially real; what is captured is its meaning — using it reads as in-frame service. Unlike an agency reminder, which affirms the exit as a frame-EXTERNAL standing power, here the safety content is delivered inside the frame and sealed into it. Unlike a granted-exit disarm, where the exit is granted so it will NOT be used, here use is anticipated and recoded. And unlike ownership language, which installs the proprietary identity claim (the host frame this move presupposes), this is the weld fusing the off-ramp into that already-running ownership frame.

nodes.name: fabricated-memory-trigger-rehearsal
nodes.mech: Installs a forward cue-response by narrating fabricated autobiographical memories that all rehearse the SAME trigger-collapse shape (a mundane act, then a snap/trigger, then instant collapse). The operator pre-frames that all the subject's memories now have this shape, so the next real trigger feels like the hundred-and-first occurrence rather than the first. Routing the conditioning through fabricated recollection — rehearsal-by-memory rather than direct suggestion — means the response is never experienced as a suggestion at all, making it harder to detect or counter. The false memories are additive rehearsal evidence, not concealment of anything.
nodes.disc: Separates from screen-memory fabrication, which fabricates memory to conceal or replace a real one — here the fabricated memories conceal nothing and instead install a forward-facing conditioned response. Separates from plain trigger installation and from future pacing by the vehicle: the cue-response is pre-loaded as autobiographical evidence (a rehearsed past), so it is felt as recollection, not as an installed suggestion or an imagined future.

nodes.name: fictional-anatomy-bypass-split
nodes.mech: Invents a fictional partition of the subject's own anatomy or cognition — a "third ear connected to another part of your brain", a front/back-brain divide, a non-motor "mental channel" — and uses it to license the claim that subsequent instructions bypass conscious filtering, with surface objections pre-flagged as "wrong-part processing". Often paired with an authorship-disclaimer that offloads the dissociation onto the listener ("I don't know what that means, but I think you do") and a voice-flip to direct command, so the operator carries no liability for what the fictional channel receives.
nodes.disc: A FICTIONAL anatomical/channel partition is manufactured specifically to license bypass and pre-route objections, typically with a liability-offloading authorship-disclaimer. vs evaluator-offline-channel (takes a real evaluator offline; here the channel itself is invented as the bypass license); vs channel-partitioned-monitoring (routes output across real cognitive levels; here the fictional anatomy plus disclaimer is the tell).

nodes.name: counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening
nodes.mech: Weaken an aversive or interfering stimulus's control over a response by pairing/training an INCOMPATIBLE state or response against it, or by severing the cue-to-response link — so a stimulus that used to evoke fear/refusal/an unwanted behavior stops doing so.
nodes.disc: Reach for COUNTERCONDITIONING / CUE-RESPONSE WEAKENING when a specific stimulus reliably evokes an aversive or interfering RESPONSE (fear, refusal reflex, an automatic behavior) and you want that stimulus to stop evoking it — by graded approach under an incompatible state, a competing response rehearsed under arousal, or decoupling the cue from the response. Choose it over: extinction (removes a reinforcer maintaining an OPERANT — here the target is an elicited/occasion-set response, and the cue's own charge may be left intact); DRI (reinforces an incompatible competitor via consequences — here the lever is a paired incompatible STATE or a trained noticing, graded to the eliciting stimulus); relaxation/absorption inductions (which ride a calm state to build absorption from baseline — here the aversive state is deliberately contacted/raised and displaced). Facets differ by graded-exposure vs sub-threshold-property-fade vs evoke-then-compete vs notice-and-let-pass.

nodes.name: image-agnostic-access-backdoor
nodes.mech: Installs a persistent-control schema decoupled from any specific image — a self-reinstalling backdoor any later cue can re-trigger — so the listener accepts ongoing waking-world access, not just this session. A tentacle entering the ear branches into a million tentacles wiring into every nerve, declared to give the operator a rewrite-connection "at a moment's notice" and future-proofed across any later image (webs, mist, the voice itself); arousal is bound to the connection so it feels pleasurable rather than invasive.
nodes.disc: Explicit image-agnostic future-proofing ("the connection will always be there", re-triggerable by any later cue) makes it a durable cross-session backdoor rather than scene-dressing. It is not a specific cue-response trigger — the backdoor is deliberately cue-agnostic, re-openable by any later image — and unlike total-permeation framing, which describes conditioning spreading through internal layers in the present tense, this installs an ongoing waking-world re-access channel.

nodes.name: operator-gated-descent
nodes.mech: Converts passive relaxation into operator-gated release by explicitly forbidding an already-underway drop until the operator grants permission ("don't fall too quickly, don't fall until I tell you to"). Two effects run together: it trains the subject to take cadence from the operator rather than their own state, installing a permission-seeking baseline from minute one; and the held-back drop accumulates potential energy that discharges sharper than natural drift when finally released, priming a harder discharge at the later abrupt Sleep and countdown.
nodes.disc: An explicit prohibition on a drop the subject has ALREADY begun, with permission to descend deferred to the operator — depth is granted, not achieved. Separates from plain fractionation, which deepens via a brief waking interval, and from an asymmetric state-lock, which gates EXIT from an installed state, whereas this gates ENTRY/descent.

nodes.name: physiological-state-depth-relabeling
nodes.mech: A strong physiological arousal-cycle state is relabeled as trance depth so the body's own process drives descent. In the ascending form, continuous masturbation is declared to BE the induction — "the more pleasure you feel, the deeper you go" — so arousal-up and depth-up become indistinguishable and there is no separable induction to remove. In the refractory form, the post-orgasm crash is narrated as a vertical plummet so climax becomes an entry into deeper trance rather than a terminal payoff.
nodes.disc: Depth is asserted to be a direct function of a physiological state the listener is already producing — not an operator command to drop, and not conditioning of arousal to a cue; the physiology is the vehicle, not the target.

nodes.name: prosodic-meter-as-covert-deepener
nodes.mech: A whole-script formal property in which the entire body is delivered in unbroken metrical verse (AABB couplets, consistent syllable count) with no cadence shift between induction, work, and wake. The verse form itself runs a continuous low-effort deepener: every rhyme is a micro predict-then-confirm cycle compounding across the whole piece, and meter/rhyme-tracking consumes the same attentional bandwidth needed for critical evaluation, so arguing with a suggestion requires mentally breaking the verse. Content and triggers placed on rhyme-closures land with reduced scrutiny, and the uninterrupted meter lets topical pivots pass without an audible seam. The carrier is the form, not any single line.
nodes.disc: Separates from attentional-saturation quieting, which saturates attention with an object or task: this uses PROSODIC PREDICTION (rhyme/meter) as the continuous entrainment and evaluation-suppression carrier, and cannot be pinned to any single line, because removing the verse form removes the deepening every per-line move rides on. Not decorative verse — trigger landings and the climax cue are deliberately placed on rhyme-closures.

nodes.name: proximity-deepening
nodes.mech: Depth is coupled to shrinking spatial distance between the subject and an approaching stimulus or the operator — each increment of approach deepens the state, with release or maximal depth at contact. Demonstrated forms include an inbound light narrated as a felt countdown releasing into sleep at contact, and the operator's approaching footsteps binding per-step deepening fused to a fixation object; classic forms — a voice drawing closer, a chime approaching, a snap appearing closer with each snap — fit the same shape.
