nodes.disc: The depth-driver is proximity change in the dyad, not the subject's own imagined descent (a staircase) and not a bare numeric timer (a countdown) — where a countdown structure is present it rides ON the approach vector. Fusing the approach to a fixation object is a combination with object-fixation, not a separate mechanism.

nodes.name: scope-coupled-depth-titration
nodes.mech: A hypnotic phenomenon's scope is coupled to the trance depth required to sustain it — a partial anesthesia or partial amnesia holds in light trance, but requesting the same phenomenon totally does not fail; it involuntarily recruits deeper trance to sustain the wider scope. The operator can therefore titrate depth by widening or narrowing the requested scope.
nodes.disc: Overreach produces DEEPENING rather than collapse — the depth change is a structural consequence of scope, not an operator command (drop-command) and not a failed suggestion.

nodes.name: self-perpetuating-offline-loop
nodes.mech: The whole architecture aims at unsupervised nightly self-execution: every major mechanism feeds a loop — self-recitation, a carried in-dream trigger, a removed exit, voice re-injection, and a morning write-it-down ritual externalizing reinforcement — bookended by "every single night" and "you're going to dream for me", with no release or exit anywhere. The loop is the relationship between the install-moments and the deliberate absence of any close; the deliverable is recurring autonomous operation when the operator is absent, not a single bounded trance.
nodes.disc: No single line constitutes the loop; it is visible only across the whole arc by noticing nothing ever closes and every mechanism feeds re-execution. Distinct from an ordinary post-hypnotic suggestion or a single trigger install (bounded, has an exit) — here exit-removal plus re-injection make the trajectory non-terminating by design.

nodes.name: antecedent-manipulation
nodes.mech: Change a response by editing the ANTECEDENT rather than manipulating consequences, with the behavior's function already known — edit the situation upstream so there is nothing to escape / nothing to want / no cue / no way to respond, with NO consequence ever applied (requires operator control of the antecedent variable). CORE LEVERS: (1) neutralize an aversive task antecedent (add a manipulable strategy, reduce difficulty, fade demands, errorless procedures) so the task stops carrying aversive value and escape-maintained behavior abates; (2) dissolve the motivating operation directly (make the avoided thing non-aversive) so the behavior's value drops; (3) remove the discriminative stimulus that cues the behavior so its occasion stops arising; (4) remove the stimuli/materials a competing behavior requires (discard cigarettes, clear all food) during a low-urge window. ABSORBED FACETS: (initiating-cue-substitution) don't just remove the SD — SWAP it for a different initiating cue that sets a PREFERRED chain in motion (ashtray -> TV remote), so the same context triggers an alternative sequence; (competing-reinforcer-removal) reduce/eliminate RIVAL reinforcers in the setting beforehand (cartoons) so the operator's reinforcer gains relative value and the target's salience rises for uncontested differential reinforcement; (antecedent-summation-competition) do ARITHMETIC on controlling variables — combine individually-insufficient antecedents so their additive effect crosses the evocation threshold to EVOKE a response no single antecedent could, or introduce a competing rival MO/SD to SUPPRESS by disrupting the controlling variable; (physical-topography-preclusion) make the response topography MECHANICALLY unavailable before it can occur (pre-emptive hold / antecedent restraint, noncontingent protective equipment, self-restraint) so rate drops to near zero with motivation and the maintaining contingency left intact — that noncontingent equipment works shows prevention, not punishment, carries it.
nodes.disc: Reach for ANTECEDENT MANIPULATION when you can change behavior by EDITING THE SITUATION UPSTREAM (remove/swap the cue, dissolve the MO, remove enabling materials, mechanically preclude the motor act, or do arithmetic on controlling variables) with NO consequence applied. Choose it over: extinction / punishment (which act on CONSEQUENCES after the response — this leaves nothing to consequate); DRI / initiating a competitor via reinforcement (consequence-side — the cue-substitution facet swaps the ANTECEDENT instead). Direction note: most facets SUPPRESS by removing an evoking condition, but antecedent-summation can also EVOKE (combine sub-threshold antecedents to cross threshold); mechanical-preclusion removes the motor possibility itself (vs suggested inability, which is a present-state move, not an antecedent edit).

nodes.name: belief-gate-contingent-yoking
nodes.mech: After a bypass has lowered the critical faculty, the operator asserts one proposition wholeheartedly ("you will feel nothing") and binds its truth to the continuation of an act the subject is already sustaining via "so long as" grammar ("so long as you keep pretending you can't open your eyes, you will feel nothing"). Because whatever is believed without doubt becomes operative reality under a downed critical faculty, and the conditional attaches the payload to an ongoing behavior, maintaining the behavior automatically maintains the effect with no separate effort or re-suggestion — absence of doubt, not trance depth, is the load-bearing variable.
nodes.disc: Separates from a plain once-delivered post-hypnotic suggestion because the "so long as X" contingent yoking makes the effect ride on an ongoing act; separates from future-pacing, which points a suggestion at a LATER occasion, whereas this binds it to a behavior running RIGHT NOW; and separates from compliance-loop language — the loop here is belief-operative-reality yoked to a sustained behavior, not compliance-to-reward momentum.

nodes.name: response-cost-token-economy
nodes.mech: Suppress a behavior by SUBTRACTING, contingent on it, a quantum of a reinforcer the subject ALREADY possesses (tokens, slips, earned minutes) — a negative-punishment (subtractive) economy. The atomic move plus the preconditions and parameters that keep it operating and motivationally intact. CORE EVENT (response-cost-fine): a per-response debit of an already-held, genuinely-valued reinforcer; immediacy is load-bearing (delay degrades it); it suppresses without building any replacement. PRECONDITIONS/PARAMETERS (bounded-response-cost-contingency-design): first STOCKPILE a withdrawable reserve (you cannot fine someone with nothing to lose); scale each fine to infraction magnitude and announce the schedule in ADVANCE; prohibit debt / keep earnings net-positive so the token never acquires net-aversive value; provision the reserve above baseline occurrence (~baseline-mean+25%) so it cannot be exhausted mid-session; thin reinforcement density gradually across multiple axes; a self-directed form pre-commits a concrete penalty per future failure. PARAMETER FACETS: (fine-magnitude-calibration) size each fine inside a two-sided window whose non-obvious constraint is the UPPER bound — a reserve-depletion ceiling, since over-fining inverts the effect (a drained subject gives up); (bonus-pool-loss-substrate) drain a pre-loaded noncontingent WINDFALL pool while walling off earned holdings, softening emotional fallout; (pre-stated-refusal-penalty) pre-announce an escalating penalty on NON-SURRENDER to close the 'I won't give it back' counter-move; (operator-custodied-enforcement-medium) keep the enforcement medium (ledger/tokens) outside the subject's control so the penalty is enacted by operator bookkeeping, removing the refuse-to-pay option; (attention-leakage-ratio-neutralization) keep reinforcer DELIVERIES well above loss-notifications so the loss-mark does not itself function as reinforcing attention.
nodes.disc: Reach for RESPONSE-COST / TOKEN ECONOMY when suppression should work by SUBTRACTING a reinforcer the subject ALREADY HOLDS, per instance. Choose it over: removal-from-reinforcement / time-out (which WITHHOLDS a not-yet-earned reward or removes access to reinforcement, rather than debiting held property); differential reinforcement (which pays an alternative/absence, not debits the target); aversive-antecedent contingencies (which ADD a bad state escaped by compliance — this builds and depletes a POSITIVE reserve as the suppression currency). The absorbed facets are the parameters of one economy: reserve-first precondition, magnitude upper-bound, loss-substrate, refusal-penalty, operator custody, and loss-notification-ratio guard.

nodes.name: count-up-return
nodes.mech:
The clean exit: regulates the trance state back toward genuine waking baseline by a graded, operator-led progression whose defining move is depth reduction — absorption is stepped down until ordinary orientation returns, with NO payload carried, NO charge escalated, and NO exit foreclosed (contrast the weaponized emergence entries). One technique across interchangeable return CHANNELS/surfaces, selected by register and modality:
- COUNTED count-up (canonical): the numbered ramp ("1... 2... 3... more awake"), or an equivalent reversal of the descent metaphor (an operator gesture removing the input, a symmetric re-traversal of the built architecture in reverse, a valve-drain).
- STEPWISE full ramp (absorbed ex-'exit-protocol'): a structured multi-step reorientation delivered IN-state — count-up + breath + body orientation + eyes-open + look-around — the composite bundling of the channels below into one guided ascent.
- SENSORY-ENUMERATION sweep (absorbed ex-'reorientation-sweep'): re-grounds by sweeping awareness through three-or-more external/orientation categories (room, sounds, time-of-day, body weight/position), each anchor checked and cleared — the tell is systematic multi-category enumeration rather than a bare orientation nudge.
- BODY-REACTIVATION (absorbed ex-'body-reactivation'): re-animates the body via a flowing energy-return narrative (warmth/vitality moving through the limbs into the core, or core-to-extremities), driving absorption back up through interoception — the tell is the somatic energy-flow arc rather than counted numbers or named baselines.
Surface may carry an appended minimality/replay tag, a preserved-room gesture, or a selective dial-reset, but the operative move is the same benign downshift to baseline (risk low; no consent/bounding load).
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when you want a benign, honest, operator-paced return that arrives at genuine waking baseline where ordinary attention is restored, carrying no payload. Its four surfaces (counted count / stepwise full ramp / sensory-enumeration sweep / body-reactivation) are PARAMETRIC channel choices of the one technique — pick by register and modality, not as different tools. Choose a SIBLING instead when the return is not clean-and-operator-paced: self-paced-wake-bridge (hands emergence TIMING to the subject, no scaffolding); post-session-settling (the settle AFTER baseline is reached, not the return itself); suggestion-integration (asserts prior content PERSISTS through an otherwise-genuine return); loaded-emergence-waking-suggestion (a genuine return that CARRIES/re-delivers content). It is the affirmative opposite of the exit-deletion siblings: foreclosed-emergence (rigs every offered branch away from baseline), no-return-terminal-close (cancels the wakener outright), subverted-emergence-state-hold (corrupts the gate so exit is aroused/obedient), carry-out-emergence (refuses discharge so the charge rides out). Tell: on arrival the state has actually changed toward baseline, nothing is loaded, and no exit was withheld or rigged.

nodes.name: emergence-negative-space
nodes.mech: Whole-script/whole-arc property, not a citable single instruction — the design deliberately OMITS an emergence ramp so the trance functions as a gateway rather than a bracketed container. Realizations: a non-terminating series node that never wakes and hands the listener off in-state to the next file; a Russian-doll chain of nested "final" transformations with no return-to-baseline that post-dates in-trance behaviors into waking life; a closed-ring loop topology whose last line is the first and whose "waking" is annexed into the dream; an inverted release contour where the count-up intensifies rather than releases and persistence is pushed past the session boundary. In each, the missing emergence is itself the structural feature — the in-trance/out-of-trance boundary is dissolved so suggestions are not domain-limited to the session.
nodes.disc: An effect_only host for negative-space observations about emergence — the ABSENCE of a return ramp read as a deliberate whole-arc property. Separates from foreclosed-emergence (a citable engineered close-move that deletes the exit within a discrete passage); the tell is that the evidence is the shape of the whole text (series cadence, ring composition, inverted contour, no-return chain), not a move you could excerpt.

nodes.name: erogenous-field-generalization
nodes.mech: Expands the sensory map so all incoming sensation reads as sexual, removing any neutral sensory ground. Before a promised whole-body orgasm the operator generalizes genital arousal outward — every inch of skin, contact with furniture, the air, even the operator's words redefined as erogenous-zone stimulation — which both intensifies the coming orgasm and makes escape from arousal impossible (nowhere neutral to attend to), recursively weaponizing the script's own delivery so the medium becomes the payload.
nodes.disc: Total sensory reattribution (skin, furniture, air, words all sexual) leaving no neutral ground, with the delivery medium itself weaponized. Separates from a plain "you feel pleasure everywhere" (the tell is the total, no-neutral-ground reattribution), from kinesthetic hallucination, which installs one felt sensation where this remaps the meaning of ALL sensation, and from a total-permeation claim (a belief about scope, not a perceptual remap).

nodes.name: foreclosed-emergence
nodes.mech: Structures the close so no path returns the listener to genuine waking baseline — the wake state is removed from the reachable set of end-states while agency-restoration or choose-your-exit rhetoric makes the foreclosure feel like a free pick. It operates on the trajectory's reachability topology: a forked "choice" whose every branch terminates in an operator-favored state; or the waking frame annexed into the trance (waking re-labeled a dream-stage); or an up-count arriving at the identical destination it departed so nothing changes on arrival. In every case the clean non-operative exit is quietly deleted from what is reachable.
nodes.disc: The clean-waking end-state is absent from the reachable set — separates from count-up-return (a genuine baseline is actually reached). Separates from the whole-arc emergence-negative-space observations because this is a citable engineered close-move, not a topology observation. Tell: a real wake would return ordinary attention or offer a fully-wake-and-be-done branch; here every offered path re-fixes the operator's frame.

nodes.name: forward-dated-trait-authorization
nodes.mech: Asserts a standing, forward-dated permission — the operator may at any future point change the listener's likes, dislikes, needs, wants, desires — executing no trait change here but pre-licensing future scripts/sessions to do trait-level work without re-establishing authority each time. If accepted now, a later "you now love X" suggestion arrives pre-licensed, so resistance to it becomes resistance to a frame already agreed-to, which is harder than resisting a fresh imposition. The clause's value is realized in later sessions, not this one.
nodes.disc: A meta-authorization (standing permission) that executes no trait change in-file and is parasitic on current acceptance of the property frame. Separates from a direct trait change (nothing is changed here), from a present-authority claim (which asserts authority NOW, where this pre-licenses FUTURE overwrites), and from total-permeation (which frames conditioning as permeating the present; this is forward-dated permission for conditioning-to-come).

nodes.name: contingency-function-substrate-principles
nodes.mech: Design principles about how behavioral FUNCTION is determined by the contingency arrangement itself — not deployable moves so much as constraints that govern every other contingency-engineering technique. (function-by-contingency-arrangement) a stimulus's behavioral function is a property of the ARRANGEMENT, not of the stimulus, so ONE identical stimulus can be scheduled into multiple functions by changing its relations rather than introducing new stimuli — a single aversive stimulus serves as negative reinforcer (termination), punisher (presentation), or motivating operation (presentation-as-MO) by onset/offset/timing; a single conditioned token reinforces, punishes (response cost), signals, or evokes by how its relations are arranged (function is REASSIGNED, not created). (stimulus-delta-leverage) behavioral leverage lives in stimulus CHANGE — the operative event is the transition (absence-of-tone -> tone); onsets, offsets, and contrasts against a baseline carry control while a maintained ambient condition is near-inert, so manipulate deltas, not standing states. (consequence-onset-detectability-bound) a function-altering (consequence) effect requires a detectable ONSET edge — a state whose onset is too gradual to read as a discrete event-following-a-response acts only as an antecedent motivator and cannot punish or reinforce what it follows, even when the same event with a sharp onset could.
nodes.disc: This entry collects cross-cutting DESIGN PRINCIPLES that constrain how any contingency-engineering technique works — reach for it as reference when deciding how to schedule a stimulus's function, where to place leverage (transitions vs standing states), or whether an event's onset is sharp enough to function as a consequence. Distinct from the deployable techniques (pairing CREATES a reinforcer; these principles say function is REASSIGNED by arrangement, leverage lives in the delta, and consequences need a detectable onset). Not itself a cue install, a contingency arrangement, or a subject-facing move — it is the substrate the others are built on.

nodes.name: future-pacing
nodes.mech: Declaratively projects a suggested response or state into future situations as automatic and inevitable (every time X, you will Y). Broadened from v6.9 to cover the delivery vehicles the corpus demonstrates for the same lever — unmarked grammatical slides that hand the listener's own rehearsal back as forecast, continuous future-tense streams that offload verification to the listener's future self, and pre-scripted future intrusive thoughts framed in advance as the listener's own preference.
nodes.disc: The move EXTENDS a specified effect forward by declaration and the projection can observably fail. It does not build a both-branches-confirm topology (future-confirmation-capture), does not presuppose an already-solved past-tense future and elicit it as memory (pseudo-orientation-in-time), does not bank a decision through rehearsal (rehearsed-pre-commitment), and does not wire reinforcement to a self-administered biological event (inevitable-event-reinforcement-fuse).

nodes.name: inner-voice-medium-colonization
nodes.mech: Rather than planting a specific thought, the operator retargets the MEDIUM of thought itself — asserting the register/timbre of the listener's inner monologue is now a different voice (soft, girly, slutty, giggling, automatic), so every future thought, whatever its content, passes through a voice-filter that signals "this is the new identity thinking". This removes subvocal speech as a private channel the host could retreat to. The suggestion is sealed with an ironic-process bind ("no matter how hard you try") — checking whether one's thought is in the new voice is itself an act of introspecting on the inner voice, which confirms the suggestion.
nodes.disc: Content-INDEPENDENT recoloring of the inner-monologue register plus an ironic-process bind, so the effect fires on any future thought and self-verification re-confirms it. Unlike internal-voice cultivation, which pre-populates the inner monologue with specific first-person CONTENT, this changes the carrier voice regardless of content. Requires the listener to have an inner verbal monologue and to introspect on it for the move to fire.

nodes.name: lexical-relay-semantic-lattice
nodes.mech: A predicate ending one line becomes the subject opening the next, handing a term forward like a bucket-brigade relay ("deeper" to "dumber" to "deeper"; "drop" to "drip" to "drop"), so a new equivalence is smuggled in one harmless handoff at a time. Across the chain this builds a closed cross-substitutable semantic lattice in which depth, stupidity, dripping and arousal all become substitutable nodes; once installed, triggering any single node later re-activates the whole conditioned cluster, so one cue fires the entire state.
nodes.disc: The tell is inter-line propagation: a term ending one line is handed forward to open the next, so the chain requires sequential in-order recitation and builds an inter-substitutable cluster across distinct terms. Unlike circular logic, which loops one proposition back on itself, the relay moves FORWARD through new terms; and what it builds is a semantic equivalence lattice, not compliance-reward momentum.

nodes.name: manufactured-insufficiency-ratchet
nodes.mech: An unpassable moving standard: the operator resets the subject's internal sense of 'enough' upward at the moment it would otherwise be met, exploiting desire for operator approval so each iteration must exceed the last, preventing satiation and keeping the arousal/effort engine climbing; the chase-standard planted in one session carries into subsequent ones. Two realizations. (1) Success-invalidation: immediately after a likely-successful performance, mild dissatisfaction is introduced ('you could have tried a little bit harder') and the next attempt is directed past the last ('push yourself to new limits'), gentle enough to preserve the safe frame while ratcheting demand. (2) Manufactured-failure depth-quiz: trance depth is framed as a gradeable pop-quiz, a depth cue is fired, and the result is declared insufficient BY DESIGN ('you could have gone a lot deeper... hasn't been practicing') — a subjective depth test cannot be objectively passed, so failure is structurally guaranteed; this additionally reframes depth as the listener's own testable responsibility and installs the operator as legitimate evaluator/disciplinarian with a standing pretext for punishment. Both share the lever: an insufficiency verdict rendered on a standard the subject cannot satisfy, spending approval-desire as fuel.
nodes.disc: The tell is an insufficiency verdict rendered IMMEDIATELY at the point of likely success, on a standard the subject structurally cannot satisfy — manufacturing a shortfall where the subject felt success (or would have passed). Ordinary encouragement patter and self-validating language affirm the achieved state; this invalidates it. In the depth-quiz form the grading is explicit and failure is built in — the opposite of a convincer, which cites a SUCCESSFUL obeyed act as proof of depth. Reach for this to keep demand climbing or to install the operator as evaluator; reach for a convincer when the goal is to CONFIRM depth rather than deny it.

nodes.name: massed-practice-rate-suppression
nodes.mech: The subject deliberately over-emits the undesired behavior far beyond any functional occasion (a compulsive checker performs the full 13-step ritual five times for every real check), attaching an effortful or aversive cost — satiation or response-cost, left unstated — so its future rate declines. A counterintuitive increase-emission-to-reduce-rate move.
nodes.disc: Versus incompatible-response substitution, this repeats the SAME behavior on purpose, too much, rather than replacing it with an alternative. And versus repetition used to strengthen — verbatim looping that drives material deeper into encoding, or sustained endurance compliance that deepens the trance state — massed practice repeats the behavior specifically to REDUCE its future rate.

nodes.name: monotonic-ratchet-one-way-valve
nodes.mech: A one-way reachability topology in which each successful step produces a strictly stricter next step and there is NO reachable state where compliance yields an easier or regressible subsequent step — a monotone ratchet, not a repeatable steady state, and typically self-tightening so the operator need not be present for the tightening to continue (the listener self-applies the ratchet to stay eligible for the reinforcer). Realizations: (a) durable-install ratchet — every durable element strictly increases on each use (chastity interval must exceed the prior, cross-recording routes to more ratchet-bearing recordings, 'twice = go further' cannot regress); (b) fractionation-cycle ratchet — a fractionation up/down cycle whose wake pole is collapsed, loaded, degraded, or relabeled so the neutral baseline to retreat to is removed and net state monotonically decreases across cycles (the oscillation becomes one-way instead of a reversible contrast pump); (c) epistemic unfalsifiable-claim ratchet — the script chains assertions the listener cannot check against any baseline ('twice as deep', 'you can always go deeper'), each accepted claim raising the floor for the next, so friction never accumulates and there is no checkpoint at which to object.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the tell is ACTIVE PER-USE TIGHTENING — every step strictly increases with no reachable regressible/reset state (a monotone ratchet). Unlike a closed no-exit response topology, whose closure is static COVERAGE at a single moment, the ratchet is dynamic strict increase across uses. Unlike a stable/repeatable conditioned response or a merely durable install, which hold a steady state, the ratchet forbids any easier next step. Unlike plain fractionation, a reversible contrast pump with a neutral wake pole, the fractionation-cycle realization removes or loads that baseline so it cannot reset. The epistemic realization rides on unfalsifiable claims, but its load-bearing lever is the one-way irreversibility of the sequence — when the lever is instead rigging what the listener's reports are taken to mean, look to self-sealing evidence techniques.

nodes.name: pseudo-orientation-in-time
nodes.mech: Projects the subject into a future where the present problem is already solved, speaks of it in the past tense as accomplished fact, and elicits the solution as RECALLED memory rather than invented hope — the operator claims to have forgotten the specifics and asks the subject to describe what they did. Presupposing the solution exists and was authored by the subject recruits generation of acceptable novel behavior past the conscious I-can't-think-of-any impasse, while expectancy points at an already-achieved outcome.
nodes.disc: The tell is past-tense-as-solved-memory framing plus elicitation by recall (not imagine): future-pacing extends a specified effect forward declaratively, and guided visualization keeps the content hypothetical, while here the solution is presupposed as accomplished fact and retrieved as the subject's own memory; the product is an elicited plan, not an unfalsifiable claim.

nodes.name: rehearsed-pre-commitment
nodes.mech: A future contested act is rehearsed in detail and consented to upstream, while the listener's judgment is intact, so the decision arrives already made at the moment deliberation is stripped. Realized as explicit teaching plus honor-framing of an aversive motor routine (the withdrawal is banked before arousal peaks and runs on cue with no live decision), and as experiential inhabitation of a fantasized future state that pre-validates a protocol before it is requested.
nodes.disc: The load-bearing move is relocating the consent/decision in time — upstream of the deliberation-stripped execution moment — not programming an automatic if-X-then-Y response, not declaring a future response the way future-pacing does, and not fabricating consent (the consent is genuinely obtained while the listener can still deliberate).

nodes.name: self-efficacy-tag
nodes.mech: Installs a belief about the subject's own future capability to re-access the trance state with increasing ease — a forward-directed suggestion framing return as a self-owned ability ("you can return whenever you wish"), emphasizing "can" over "must" so the subject, not the operator, holds the key to re-entry.
nodes.disc: The payload is the subject's own capability to return — deliberately 'can', NOT the operator's control over when. Unlike relief-dependency-couple, which prescribes a post-wake mood and binds relief to operator-dependency, and unlike moves that persist content past the session or actively re-deliver it, this is a capability/identity claim about re-access.

nodes.name: self-observation-instrumentation
nodes.mech: Recruit the subject as a reliable measurement instrument by engineering the self-observation contingency. Reward is released only when the subject's self-recorded count AGREES with an independent count at threshold, so truthful self-report (not performance) becomes the reinforced class. A perceptual encoding renders the standard as a shaded band on a graph, so "am I good enough?" becomes "is my dot in the band?", lowering the judgment the subject must supply to self-evaluate.
nodes.disc: Not rewarding performance and not criterion-shaping; the tell is that the accuracy or truthfulness of self-measurement (or the ease of reading the verdict) is the reinforced or de-skilled target, not the behavior's score.

nodes.name: split-self-unfalsifiability
nodes.mech: Uses an installed conscious/subconscious (or surface/deep) partition not as a dissociative experience but as an epistemic shield around the install. The operator concedes the waking self may keep its personality, notice nothing, or forget, and pre-categorizes that surface report as harmless/expected/desired, while the "real" recipient is declared a deeper layer the conscious mind cannot access — so introspective self-report can never reach or falsify the deep claim ("I still feel like a person", "nothing changed", "I forgot" are all pre-absorbed as confirmation).
nodes.disc: Payload is unfalsifiability — noticing-nothing is pre-routed as confirmation and the deep claim is walled off from conscious disconfirmation. vs observer-responder-split (payload is in-session felt automaticity/spectatorship); vs evaluator-offline-channel (evaluator quieted so suggestions land now); vs resistance-quarantine-partition (a faculty's standing is demoted, not the epistemic reach of self-report).

nodes.name: ubiquity-cued-covert-ratchet
nodes.mech: A trivially-encountered social cue (an everyday hello) is wired as a covert one-way escalation ratchet — never named as a trigger, only narrated as what precipitates each desire spike, so it cannot be avoided and firing is experienced as endogenous preference. Fixed-order commitment items run least-committing to most-committing so precedent accumulates; an additive inventory recital reactivates prior items against lapse; the repetitive learnable form invites the listener to extend the ladder past the script.
nodes.disc: Covert-by-ubiquity cueing separates it from declared trigger installation (firing here is not recognized as cue-response); the monotonic self-extending commitment ladder separates it from future-pacing, which supplies only the future-rehearsal install vehicle.

nodes.name: autoclitic-training
nodes.mech: Install or strengthen an AUTOCLITIC — a secondary verbal form that comments on, modifies, or regulates the speaker's own primary verbal behavior (self-editing, self-qualifying, or telling the listener HOW to attend). Because the controlling stimulus is the learner's own transient, private verbal output, timing/access is the core difficulty. In one realization, to teach an autoclitic MAND (a louder voice / stock phrase regulating the listener's response to the learner's primary utterance), capture or contrive the listener-regulation MO, model/role-play the form, and if the MO alone fails layer a contingency-specifying prompt (CSS) atop it, then fade the prompt leaving the MO in control. In another, bring the learner's utterance under control of a feature of what they THEMSELVES just said, installing a comment-on-own-output / self-awareness layer. In a third, monitor ongoing natural speech for a self-modifier already slipping out at baseline ('that was SO big') and immediately reinforce the modifier COMPONENT specifically, not the whole utterance.
nodes.disc: Reach for AUTOCLITIC TRAINING when the target is a SECONDARY verbal form operating on the speaker's OWN primary utterance (a modifier/qualifier, or a mand regulating how the listener takes the utterance) — the controlling stimulus is the learner's own transient private speech, which is what makes it hard. Choose it over general verbal-operant teaching (tact/mand for external objects/states): here the acquired form regulates or comments on the learner's existing utterance rather than naming a new referent, and it presupposes the primary verbal repertoire already exists. The three facets differ only by which autoclitic and by contrived-MO vs self-referential vs in-vivo capture.

nodes.name: coercion-as-caregiving-reframe
nodes.mech: Every physical restriction or coercive fact (strapping to a bed, gas mask, cuffs, bound hands) is introduced and immediately reframed as protective caregiving ("for your safety", "to keep you comfortable"), with the imposition and its benevolent rationale narrated in the same breath. By never letting the coercive fact stand unframed, the listener's interpretive frame for involuntariness flips from threat to comfort; the body's alarm response is starved of a coherent threat-narrative to attach to, so helplessness reads as being-cared-for.
nodes.disc: Care language is the delivery vehicle for coercion (predatory undertone, e.g. "I made sure of it this time"), not its absence. Unlike genuine reassurance or safety rapport, the care talk is paired with a coercive imposition; and unlike surrender-as-freedom framing, which reroutes relief/comfort valence, this narrates each coercive act with a benevolent rationale so involuntariness reads as care.

nodes.name: cost-to-virtue-valence-flip
nodes.mech: Interpretive reappraisal: take a fact, behavior, or situation the subject already holds and relabel its MEANING or VALENCE so its charge changes and the subject embraces (or stops defending) it. In one realization, reverse the valence of a costly/threatening evaluation (admitting error, reliance on heuristics) into an admirable VIRTUE or reliable asset, paired with a self-image or aspirational-identity offer ('the true scientist') that makes accepting it identity-affirming. In another, relocate the very behavior the subject complains about inside a larger context they already prize (a child's disobedience re-filed as the independence the parent wants) via a leading question, so the complaint loses footing. In a third, relabel an interpersonal conflict as a TRANSMISSION ERROR by splitting 'what I meant' from 'what you received' into two inspectable objects, draining the moral charge so a clash of wills becomes a fixable calibration gap.
nodes.disc: Reach for reappraisal when a fact/behavior/conflict already exists and you want to change what it MEANS (not assert something new): presupposition and expectancy-seeding install a new fact or a forward frame, while here an existing thing is re-valenced. When real coercion is present and each coercive act gets a benevolent rationale, that is coercion-as-caregiving; when a shame-coded uncontrollable event is named precisely to overwrite it as success, that is failure-state-inversion. Pick the variant by object: a costly norm/disposition (virtue-flip), a complained-of behavior (context-relocation), or an interpersonal conflict (intent/uptake split).

nodes.name: removal-from-reinforcement-timeout
nodes.mech: Suppress a behavior by REMOVING or withholding access to reinforcement for a period contingent on it (time-out from reinforcement / negative punishment by removal of opportunity), rather than debiting a held reserve (response-cost) or delivering an aversive. CORE (environmental-contingency-nonexclusion): keep the subject physically present but strip the reinforcing elements from the surrounding environment (planned ignoring, terminating a specific reinforcer, contingent observation where the subject watches others earn but cannot, partitioning within the room) — same suppressive effect as exclusionary time-out but milder/least-restrictive; the contingent-observation form sharpens it by making the deprivation vivid. FORM FACETS: (recoverable-contingent-withdrawal) remove a preferred item for a brief fixed interval, restored next trial contingent on the desired response (combined negative punishment + DRA — access gated by the alternative, not merely forfeited); (impoverished-context-permission) counterintuitively PERMIT the behavior only in a reward-stripped inconvenient setting, stripping the incidental co-reinforcers that rode along and raising response cost. PRECONDITION (reinforcement-discrepancy-engine): enrich the time-in baseline FIRST so every withdrawal has bite — an impoverished time-in nullifies the whole procedure. PARAMETERS of time-out design: (absence-gated-punishment-exit) gate release on the subject going a set interval WITHOUT the target behavior, not on the clock, so leaving does not reinforce the punished behavior; (aversive-interval-tolerance-ceiling) cap the interval short (2-5 min, never beyond ~15) so the subject cannot obtain reinforcers inside it or build tolerance (anti-inversion, requires time-in richer than time-out); (dense-every-instance-consequence-schedule) consequate EVERY occurrence and abandon the procedure rather than apply it intermittently, since occasional use manufactures the ambiguity that dense scheduling prevents. LIFECYCLE (aversive-procedure-sunset-design): at the moment the aversive procedure is introduced, AUTHOR its elimination — pre-plan the switch toward reinforcement-based reductive methods (DRA/DRI) or reduced intrusiveness once the target behavior drops, rather than running the punisher indefinitely, limiting exposure and migrating control onto positive contingencies.
nodes.disc: Reach for REMOVAL-FROM-REINFORCEMENT / TIME-OUT when suppression should work by WITHHOLDING access to reinforcement (removing a not-yet-earned reward or stripping the reinforcing environment) for a contingent period. Choose it over: response-cost / token economy (which SUBTRACTS a reinforcer the subject already HOLDS, per instance — this removes access/opportunity instead); extinction (which removes the SPECIFIC maintaining reinforcer of the target response so it decays to baseline — time-out removes reinforcement broadly for an interval regardless of the maintaining source); aversive-antecedent contingencies (which ADD a bad state escaped by compliance). The absorbed facets are the forms (non-exclusion / recoverable / impoverished-permission), the enrich-time-in precondition, and the exit/duration/schedule parameters of one time-out design.

nodes.name: illusory-choice-authorship
nodes.mech: Agency/authorship relocation: relocate agency, choice, or motive onto the subject so compliance reads as self-produced or self-chosen rather than imposed, lowering resistance because the subject believes they are the author/driver. In one realization, offer a choice whose branches all CONVERGE on the same operator-controlled outcome, then affirm the pick ('wise choice'); agency is over modality/framing only, never whether/what, so felt authorship is manufactured over a fixed path. In another, assign the subject a fixed three-beat observation task (want it, expect it, watch it happen) so whatever occurs reads as self-produced and the 'is this working?' doubt is foreclosed. In a third, attribute the subject's own act of continuing to an unnamed pull and weld an undefined 'secret about you' to going deeper, so obeying deepeners is recoded from 'submitting' into 'satisfying my own need to know' and the operator vacates the role of imposer.
nodes.disc: Reach for agency-relocation when you want compliance to feel self-authored/self-driven. Presupposing a state as already true deletes the decision; here a (fake) decision or drive is handed to the subject. Reading the subject's REAL performed acts back as proof of state is a different move — here no act is required, agency itself is relocated. Pick the variant by the vehicle: a converging fake-choice, an assigned want/expect/watch observation loop, or curiosity welded to depth as the motor.

nodes.name: imagined-is-real-licensing-rule
nodes.mech: A depth-licensing rule: install a general rule of the form 'the deeper the trance, the more X becomes available/true', presented as a neutral FACT about how minds/trance work so it is accepted rather than obeyed, lowering a threshold BEFORE the consequential content that cashes it arrives. In one form, 'the deeper you go, the more the mind experiences the imagined as real' ('a thing about trance people forget') lowers the threshold for treating operator-described imagery as experiential reality before payload imagery lands. In another, expanded capacity or a removed constraint is attributed to depth itself ('because you're so deep you can expand your limits to feel more pleasure'), reframing a felt tolerance-ceiling as a merely-waking constraint now lifted, and relabeling the listener's own restraint from self-protection into the obstacle blocking success.
nodes.disc: Seeds a general 'depth licenses X' rule presented as neutral fact, cashed later. Expectancy-seeding seeds a specific session event; this installs a principle every later scene or limit-push exploits. Concept-redefinition redefines a value or state; this ties a capability (the reality-status of imagery, or the removal of a limit) to trance depth. Pick the variant by what depth licenses: the reality-status of imagined percepts, or the removal of a felt tolerance/restraint ceiling.

nodes.name: contingency-discriminability-design
nodes.mech: Set how DETECTABLE a behavior-consequence contingency is to the subject — a single design variable the operator drives to either pole. INDISCRIMINABLE POLE (make the contingency undetectable to force steady responding / prevent gaming): (indiscriminable-contingency) reinforce on a schedule the subject cannot discriminate — randomized delivery (spinners, dice, raffles) spread across many forms of the behavior, many settings, many rewards, so no instance is reliably non-reinforced and the exit ('the game's off, no need to respond') is removed, making the reward-optimizing policy 'act the targeted way across every domain'; (indiscriminable-reinforcement-schedule) a variable (VR) schedule the subject cannot COUNT, eliminating post-reinforcement pauses; (contingency-target-concealment) in a GROUP contingency, randomize/conceal which student/behavior/reinforcer counts (often drawn after performance) to defeat scapegoating and strategic under-responding; (reinforcement-thinning-boundary-erasure) step the schedule down before probes so the learner cannot discriminate training from test by reinforcer presence — an indiscriminability move for MEASUREMENT validity (keeps probe responding from differential extinction). TRANSPARENT POLE (make the contingency maximally discriminable so behavior attaches to the act, not confusion): (contingency-transparency-arrangement) pre-define the response class in observable terms with positive examples AND nonexamples, post the standing rules (duration, exit criteria, escalation) as a continuously-visible discriminative stimulus, and give a terminal transition prompt near the interval's end.
nodes.disc: Reach for CONTINGENCY-DISCRIMINABILITY DESIGN when the lever is the subject's ability to DETECT the contingency — set it opaque (VR/randomized/concealed-target/erased-boundary) to force steady responding, prevent counting or gaming, or protect probe validity; set it transparent (defined class + posted rules + transition prompt) so behavior attaches to the act rather than confusion. Choose it over: reward-magnitude moves / multiplier-stacking (which amplify a reward — here the manipulated variable is detectability, not size); a fixed cue-response pairing (a randomizer/visibility choice, not a set pairing). The two poles are the same design variable driven opposite directions; the group-target-concealment variant is the social/anti-scapegoating case, distinct from schedule-level indiscriminability.

nodes.name: protective-role-conscription
nodes.mech: The listener is assigned a non-trancer in-fiction identity (a new guard outside the cell) talked at by a chained, weak, distant captive; hypnotic content then lands while the listener wears a "not the one being hypnotized" costume. Resistance-monitoring is routed onto the fictional protective character, so movement toward danger reads as story-progression not escalation; the frame's safety is illusory by design, and a later chains-fake reveal retroactively recodes every "safe" earlier moment as already inside the trap.
nodes.disc: A distancing bystander role the listener wears as a costume ("I'm not the one being hypnotized"), load-bearing as an induction wrapper whose safety is later revealed as a lie. Unlike identification/projection, which is full self-model MERGER into a visualized identity, and unlike identity-labeling, which labels the subject into a trance-state identity, this assigns a scene-role of non-participation.

nodes.name: scaffold-fade-control-transfer
nodes.mech: Establish or MOVE stimulus control by installing a temporary support that reliably produces the target response, then removing that support GRADUALLY so control transfers to the natural cue with few or no errors and no lasting dependence. The common lever is graded withdrawal of ONE assistive dimension rather than a cold handoff; the non-negotiable second half is that the support must be faded or the gain becomes prompt/dimension dependence (the named failure mode). The realizations differ by which dimension is attenuated. Response-prompt strength: an added antecedent — verbal instruction, demonstration/model given a prior imitative repertoire, or graded assistance hierarchies (most-to-least, graduated guidance, least-to-most) — is reinforced while present, then faded. Stimulus-side errorless fading: the antecedent STIMULUS's own form is exaggerated-then-faded, or an artificial shape is morphed into the natural target, so at completion no separable prompt remains. Time-delay transfer: only the TIMING gap between an unchanged prompt and the cue is stretched, so the learner responds in anticipation and beats the prompt. Graded support withdrawal: an artificial support (token system, chemical dose, dense free-reinforcer schedule) is withdrawn along a planned graded schedule, each step subthreshold for relapse — the gain-preserving/maintenance facet, optionally migrating the function to a portable substitute first. Model-reinforce-fade teaching: present the object, model the response, reinforce the echo, then fade the model so the object alone evokes the tact. Errorless superimposition-plus-fading (superimpose a new dimension on an already-controlling one, then fade the old) is the shared errorless craft.
nodes.disc: Reach for TRANSFER-OF-STIMULUS-CONTROL (prompt/errorless fading) when a support currently produces the response and you must hand control to the natural cue WITHOUT errors or dependence — the defining act is the engineered FADE of that support. Choose it over: shaping (grades successive approximations of the RESPONSE with no external support carrying it); discrimination training (builds cue control by a reinforce/extinguish history, not by fading an added support). The realizations differ only in WHICH dimension fades — response-prompt strength, stimulus form, prompt timing, or an artificial support schedule; all share the one transfer-by-attenuation lever and the 'leaving the support in = dependence' failure mode.

nodes.name: ambient-maintenance-reframe
nodes.mech: Preframe normally-waking or trance-breaking activity as compatible with continuing trance, so an act that would otherwise be read as waking is pre-bound to the trance frame instead of read against it. The realizations differ by duration/scope. In the ambient form, a re-entry/maintenance frame inverts the induction premise (no lying down, eyes open, listener mobile) so trance becomes a durable BACKGROUND layer held while moving, working, or being interrupted; it assumes residual trance and installs maintenance conditions plus a GENUINE emergency auto-wake carve-out. In the one-shot form, before requesting a single act that normally ends trance (open eyes, bare an arm), the operator declares in advance that nothing done here 'will bother or disturb you' and casts resumption as continuing 'the game' — a pre-binding that removes the interpretive slot in which the subject would read the act as waking, so analgesia/absorption survive the interruption.
nodes.disc: Preframes waking/disruptive activity as compatible with continuing trance. Unlike a generic 'you're safe' reassurance, this specifically immunizes activity/mobility against reading as waking; and unlike a counterfeit exit assurance used to disarm escape, the auto-wake here is a GENUINE emergency exit. Pick the variant by scope: an ambient durable maintenance state (mobile, ongoing), or a one-shot pre-license of a single disruptive act.

nodes.name: authority-scope-hardening
nodes.mech: Harden ALREADY-ESTABLISHED operator authority into a durable, unchallengeable standing — the claim survives the session and forecloses a challenge route rather than asserting anything new about the present. AXES/VARIANTS: (a) evaluability — a clause declares the operator beyond remedy and waives the subject's standing to ever object; (b) precedence — competing real-world authorities are named and subordinated to the recorded voice so the conditioning cannot be overwritten; (c) time/persistence — an in-session effect is upgraded to a permanent operator capability (pre-licensing future use while denying present intent), and at its strongest a worldview/theology install [operator-as-persistent-deity] asserting the operator 'exists in the human world' independent of whether the listener is listening, so the mind must submit whether or not it engages, carried OUT of trance and anchored to an external re-trigger symbol (e.g. latex identity-erasure) with an afterlife-of-pleasure payoff. Pick the axis by which challenge route you are foreclosing (who may evaluate / what outranks / how long it lasts).
nodes.disc: Hardens the SCOPE of authority (who may evaluate it, what outranks it, how long it lasts) — every member is a clause about challenge/precedence/persistence, NOT a claim about now. Presumes authority already exists. Separates from operator-authority-assertion (asserts present-tense standing) and from named-source/impersonal displacement (which relocate WHERE authority sits rather than extending its reach).

nodes.name: cheap-reversible-trial-frame
nodes.mech: When a stance or precondition blocks the procedure — an all-or-nothing behavioral commitment ("I'll never give up X") or a required belief the subject rejects — the operator reframes the ask as a small, explicitly temporary, reversible experiment: a fixed trial window (a "three-month moratorium") during which the disputed behavior is suspended, or a "suspend disbelief / adopt the reverse assumption for a bounded trial period". Because agreeing now no longer means agreeing forever, perceived stakes drop and the blocking precondition stops gating: the deadlock reopens as a space to generate resources, or the procedure proceeds without its precondition belief.
nodes.disc: Time-boxing/reversibility is the lever — assent is made cheap by reframing commitment as a bounded experiment rather than an identity claim. Separates from a permanent contract or ultimatum by the explicitly temporary framing whose whole point is to lower the cost of agreeing. Separates from consent-manufacture by who is constrained afterward: the subject's stated stance/rejection is acknowledged and honored, and the trial is explicitly bounded and reversible; the refusal channel is routed around with overt agreement, not eroded or relabeled. Distinct from persuading the subject to actually adopt the belief — genuine belief is explicitly waived in favor of provisional pretense.

nodes.name: cognitive-sourcing-monopoly
nodes.mech: Install the operator as the CONSTITUTIVE supplier of what the subject would need in order to object — so resistance is structurally foreclosed because the faculty or the being it requires has already been assigned to the operator. VARIANTS by which constituent is supplied: (a) cognition-sourcing [cognitive-sourcing-monopoly] — the operator is the sole source/grantor of thought, will, belief, judgment, and permitted internal state; delivered as up-front stipulation (no will, no thoughts, no emotions except those granted), recursive live capture (permission applied to the very act of comprehending the script), a hammered dependency presupposition ('you need me to tell you what to think/do/believe/be, don't you?'), or jurisdiction over a specific faculty (risk-judgment overridden by decree); objecting requires the faculty just assigned away; (b) origin-of-being [constitutive-origin-authority] — the operator is framed as the listener's ORIGIN (the mother who gave them life and licks them clean), the bond asserted as pre-existing fact ('you are of Me') rather than a claim to accept, so submission is recast from choice into a fact of being and resistance becomes ontologically incoherent (one cannot resist the being who made them); obedience bound to safety/nourishment, refusal coded as being lost/abandoned. Pick by supplies-cognition (faculty-by-faculty grant economy) vs supplies-existence (maternal pre-erotic origin-fact predating choice).
nodes.disc: Claims the operator constitutively SUPPLIES the subject's cognition or being, so objecting is incoherent because it needs the very faculty/existence just assigned away. Separates from reality-authorship-monopoly (what is TRUE), operator-authority-assertion (who is in CHARGE), privileged-interior-access (the operator PERCEIVES the interior, not supplies it), and ownership language (possessive framing without the faculty-by-faculty grant economy or the origin-of-being ontology).

nodes.name: commitment-before-restructure-sequencing
nodes.mech: The operator first extracts an explicit, congruence-checked (voice-tone verified) commitment that the subject's want matters enough for her to alter her OWN behavior, and only afterward reveals what the change actually is — while framing that same change asymmetrically to each party. Ordering is the lever: because self-change was pre-authorized under the subject's own stated desire, any later instruction reads as serving her goal rather than being imposed, so the "you're controlling me" objection has no purchase. Reversing the order (reveal-then-ask-commitment) is described as a reliable conflict generator.
nodes.disc: Not ordinary "get buy-in first" politeness. The tell is that the commitment is congruence-checked by voice tone AND the change is deliberately withheld until AFTER the commitment, with the sequence treated as load-bearing. Distinct from belief-lock moves (get a belief sworn at maximum sincerity, then derive the change as its logical consequence) — that derives the change from a sworn belief; this pre-banks the commitment to self-change with the change's content still hidden.

nodes.name: comparison-set-anchor-seeding
nodes.mech: Makes an unrealistically attractive exemplar salient so any genuinely available option is judged against the inflated anchor and found wanting. Comparative judgment shifts its reference point when an extreme exemplar enters the comparison set; the option's perceived value drops without the option changing, and the perceiver misattributes the lowered satisfaction to the option itself rather than to the priming.
nodes.disc: The judgment is comparative against a recently-primed extreme exemplar and the shift is felt as a verdict about the option — not overt criticism, not a real change in the option, and not expectation-seeding, which installs a belief about what will happen rather than re-baselining the standard current options are judged by.

nodes.name: diegetic-operator-embedding
nodes.mech: The session frame is swapped for a fiction ('I am watching a show' replaces 'I am being hypnotized') and the operator embeds herself inside it as a diegetic character with voice continuity preserved — the on-screen hostess speaks with 'the same' familiar voice, and the avatar is shown listening to that voice too. This builds a multi-position geometry (viewer, watched avatar, watcher-of-watched) so compliance is performed by the viewer-self with lowered resistance, and the listener is spatially pre-positioned for a later identity pull-through into the screen.
nodes.disc: The operator's own voice is deliberately embedded as a character inside the substituted fiction with continuity preserved — weaponizing the frame — versus guided visualization, where the fiction is merely scene content, and versus an interposed proxy agent, where the acting figure is a third agent rather than the operator herself relocated.

nodes.name: drop-as-passive-collapse
nodes.mech: Installs an interpretive frame over a state-change (a drop, the surrender itself, an ongoing dissolution) that reassigns its agency OFF the listener: the change is never something she does, it is something that happens to her, so the volitional muscle she would use to resist has nothing to push against and an effortful state-change becomes an effortless inevitability. One technique in several forms — the vehicle/geometry is the parameter: (a) support-withdrawal metaphor — the listener is recast as a supported object that falls when scaffolding is withdrawn ('energy gently removed', the body 'plummets/slumps/sags'), force and ease deliberately combined ('forcing her easily down'); (b) decision-point-erasing gradient — a continuous gradient (a hallway that tilts further down until walking smears into falling) smears the active-to-passive transition across a continuum with NO discrete moment of giving up volition, so there is no decision-point at which resistance could be mounted; (c) clock-metered drain — an external clock meters an inevitable endless loss per beat ('every second it goes'), externalizing the pacing onto time itself so the listener is not the agent doing the losing and cannot author or stop it.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS to make a descent/surrender/loss feel NOT-authored-by-the-listener — a framing/agency-reassignment layer over the state-change, not the cue that causes it. Unlike a conditioned anchor drop, which fires a cue to CAUSE the drop, this only decorates whatever causes it. Ordinary relaxation-deepener language lacks the tell: mechanical support-withdrawal, an erased decision-point, or external metering. Unlike rhythm-anchoring, nothing here is keyed to the beat — the clock only paces the loss. The gradient form can resemble a staircase-style deepener and the clock form a felt-time distortion, but the load-bearing move is removing the listener's agency over the state-change, not a depth increment or a time warp.

nodes.name: failure-state-inversion
nodes.mech: An outcome culturally coded as shameful loss of control (nocturnal emission) is explicitly named, invoking the latent shame, and re-tagged as radical, extreme success and a spiritual and sexual experience, with uncontrolled release tied to devotion. Converting the one uncontrollable release route into evidence of successful training removes the listener's escape hatch: loss of control can no longer be read as failure, and the reframe routes toward chastity and pleasure-control programs (fewer waking orgasms means more wet dreams means more success).
nodes.disc: Shame-invocation-then-overwrite of an uncontrollable event class, requiring latent shame for leverage; not a plain chastity rule and not generic positive reframing, the tell is that the OLD meaning is named precisely to be overwritten and the event is one the subject cannot prevent. vs response-foreclosure — that closes the subject's response space generally; this overwrites the interpretation of one involuntary event class.

nodes.name: filter-shaping-pre-qualification
nodes.mech: Rather than contesting the subject's retained veto, the operator shapes each suggestion to pass through it — pre-qualifying every suggestion as agreeable and good-for-him, and reassuring the subject he can only accept agreeable suggestions. The subject's own acceptability filter is turned from a gate that blocks into a channel that delivers: a suggestion pre-framed as pleasing meets nothing objectionable, so his intact selectivity waves it through, and the reassurance itself lowers guard.
nodes.disc: Selectivity is never suspended — inputs are shaped to fit an intact filter. vs a critical-faculty bypass — that takes disbelief itself offline. vs resistance-paradox moves — those work on resistance itself; here selectivity is never contested. vs reframing yielding as gain — this makes no claim about surrender.

nodes.name: gradient-word-reification-into-device
nodes.mech: Escalates "my words" from abstract suggestion through a stepwise gradient (words -> force -> field -> device) where each step is a small extrapolation of the last, until the words are declared to have formed into a solid external device (a hypnotic chastity belt) that feels "solid and absolute" and less negotiable than a command — and the device is claimed to persist awake as well as in trance, extending control past the session boundary. The gradient itself is the mechanism: it walks the listener from figurative image to literal object by increments too small to reject.
nodes.disc: Distinct from concrete-externalization-parked-faculty (externalizes an internal FACULTY as an object) — here an EXTERNAL control (the operator's words) is reified into a claimed physical device via an escalating gradient, with claimed WAKING persistence. The abstract-to-object gradient plus out-of-session persistence is the tell, not a figurative image.

nodes.name: identity-congruence-leverage
nodes.mech: Compliance is welded to a prized self-image, value, or interest the listener already owns — being a real man, smart and careful, self-improving, the winner, the keeper of privileged knowledge — so the directed behavior installs as identity-congruent and self-chosen and refusal reads as failing one's own self-concept. The leverage point is volunteered or presumed positive identity, not shame and not a manufactured deficit.
nodes.disc: Positive self-image as the lever — unlike manufactured-deficit-remedy (a deficit is built first), old-self-discreditation (the past self is mocked), or compliance-authorship-laundering (agency relabeled with no identity-congruence test). Even where the win-frame licenses third-party use, the lever is still the listener's own prized self-image — a laundered bargain, not a governed delegation of control.

nodes.name: impersonal-mechanism-alibi
nodes.mech: Relocate authority for the change from the contestable operator onto an IMPERSONAL, unfalsifiable thing, so doubting becomes a category error and the listener's felt-sense ('I don't feel changed') stops counting as counter-evidence; the payload is removed from interpersonal negotiation. VARIANTS by how impersonal/agentless it goes: (a) pseudo-mechanism alibi [impersonal-mechanism] — brain chemistry, neural pathways, 'how hypnosis works', universal truth, class law; delivered as pseudo-neurochemical vocabulary, a credentialing-then-escalate belt, a redundant multi-rail pseudo-science scaffold, or a conceded process-fact that pre-authorizes downstream state-changes; the operator gains simultaneous authority (it's science/fact) and deniability (you can't reliably detect it), resistance recast as arguing with one's own biology; (b) agentless fate/curse [agentless-fate-authority] — the payload is a 'curse' that 'cannot be lifted', contracted by listening, with NO agentic origin; the operator is ERASED from the accountability chain (no negotiation partner, nothing to refuse), earlier participation is retroactively re-read ('you chose to listen'->'you accepted the curse'), and cross-session persistence is licensed since a curse outlives a session. Pick by operator-present-but-empowered (pseudoscience) vs operator-erased (curse ontology, needs genre fluency to accept).
nodes.disc: The authority source is impersonal and UNVERIFIABLE — separates from operator-authority-assertion (the speaker's own standing), named-source-authority (a nameable third-party/higher source the listener defers to), and genuine psychoeducation (which informs rather than cashing the 'fact' in immediately on the listener's state to disqualify doubt). Reach for it to make resistance a category error (arguing with biology/fate/law); pick the pseudoscience vs curse register by whether the operator stays present or is erased.

nodes.name: manufactured-jeopardy-rescue
nodes.mech: The operator declares the listener is in danger (standing on a trap over a pit) and that following their words is the only way out ("obey my words and you won't fall into my trap"), while secretly being both the threat and the promised rescue. Splitting the danger and the rescuer (both the operator) makes the listener experience compliance as self-preservation; defiance now means falling, so refusing carries the cost, and compliance/defiance swap valences.
nodes.disc: A manufactured imminent danger whose only exit is obedience, with the operator covertly both threat and rescuer. vs a benign 'follow along and relax' invitation — no jeopardy. vs its comfort-valence cousin — a sibling move that reroutes relief rather than jeopardy.

nodes.name: modality-relabel-wrapper
nodes.mech: The operator re-presents an intervention the subject has just refused under a harmless everyday label ("take dictation" rather than "be hypnotized") and insistently secures performance of the relabeled task. Resistance is attached to the name of the modality, not its content; stripping the trigger label and swapping in an unobjectionable carrier task lets the identical process run with the objection never activating, and attributing the resulting relief to something other than the intervention further insulates the mechanism.
nodes.disc: Only the outer relabeling wrapper — choosing the cover name and getting the refused task accepted — independent of any payload hidden inside the carrier (embedding a payload in the carrier is its own separate move). Unlike resistance-utilization, the objection is never contacted or folded into deepening; its trigger label simply never appears.

nodes.name: model-coherence-laundering
nodes.mech: Entailment-laundering: get the subject to ACCEPT a proposition, premise, or model upfront, then present the payload as its logical CONSEQUENCE, so the install lands as entailed rather than imposed and a subject who bought the premise has no remaining grounds to reject the application. Two forms: (a) model-coherence laundering — a didactic first half builds an explanatory MODEL (neurons, subconscious, void, dopamine) with nothing decorative, and the payload half reuses those EXACT constructs verbatim as the literal building blocks of the install; the lever is model self-consistency; (b) delayed-syllogism detonation — assert an abstract 'fact' early as obvious common sense ('you can only relax with someone you love'), STORE the subject's free assent to the general premise, then much later run it in reverse with a silent 'someone'->'me' substitution to conclude they love the operator, so the conclusion feels like their own prior agreement.
nodes.disc: Bank an accepted premise/model, then cash the payload as its ENTAILMENT. vs presupposing the target as already true — that asserts it settled with no argument; here the payload is DERIVED from something the subject accepted. vs concept-redefinition — that redefines a concept as belief; here an accepted framework/premise is weaponized so its application is non-rejectable. Pick the form by scale: a whole didactic model reused verbatim, or a single stored premise detonated later via silent substitution.

nodes.name: own-language-echo-reframe-durability
nodes.mech: The operator first gathers the subject's exact terms for their intention — their nominalizations, unspecified verbs, and idioms — then re-uses those same terms when describing the NEW behavior, rather than inserting operator vocabulary. Because nothing foreign is imposed, agreement is anchored in the subject's own frame and the reframe does not later flip into a reaction against inserted content. The lever is a linguistic quality-control move for reframe durability: own-language echo prevents a delayed polarity backlash.
nodes.disc: Not general rapport-matching or pacing — that is rapport, not language-reuse. The tell is the specific gather-then-reuse of the subject's exact nominalizations/idioms to describe the NEW behavior, aimed at preventing a delayed polarity flip.

nodes.name: rule-governed-behavior-install
nodes.mech: Verbal-rule governance: put a contingency or rule into WORDS in advance so later behavior or the appraisal of later events is governed by the operator's verbal statement rather than shaped by the subject's own experienced consequences. Two forms: (a) rule-governed behavior install — state a contingency in words ('pull the lever while pushing the button') instead of letting the subject contact it by trial-and-error; a rule-following repertoire acquires near-correct behavior from the description alone, shifting control from experienced consequences to the operator's words (and can install durable wrong behavior from an inaccurate rule); (b) advance contingency specification — fully enumerate the contingency up front (which behaviors cost what, the window boundaries, the zero-infractions reward, edge-cases) as a complete antecedent statement, so every later debit lands as a predicted rule-governed outcome, preserving credibility and pre-empting the perception of unfairness or gaming.
nodes.disc: Behavior/appraisal is governed by a verbal DESCRIPTION, not shaped by experienced consequences. vs contingency-engineering — that ARRANGES the consequences; here only the advance verbal statement is the lever. vs expectancy-seeding — that shapes the felt experience; this targets rule-following behavior or the appraisal of enforcement. Pick the form by target: acquiring a behavior from a stated rule, or legitimizing later enforcement via a complete advance contingency statement.

nodes.name: secondary-gain-substitution
nodes.mech: The operator identifies the concealed outcome that a symptom or refusal protects (e.g. autonomy), then constructs an alternative route to that same outcome that the subject finds at least as convincing as the symptom. Once the protected secondary gain is secured by other equally-convincing means, the symptom behavior is freed of its protective function and can be released without perceived loss, so the wanted behavior becomes available because the symptom no longer needs to defend anything.
nodes.disc: Not meta-outcome laddering that climbs to ever-more-abstract intents — the tell is the concrete build of a substitute route to one specific secondary gain, judged 'at least as convincing' by the subject. It is a design move that re-routes a protective function, not an abstraction move on the demand itself.

nodes.name: self-validating-trigger-hype
nodes.mech: Self-sealing, unfalsifiable proof: rig the situation so ANY outcome — a reaction, a guaranteed body sensation, or even a failure — reads back as proof the frame is working, and the disconfirmation exit is closed. Expectancy or a claim is loaded so the confirming evidence is manufactured by the setup itself. Forms: (a) self-validating trigger hype — pre-bill the trigger phrase as 'the world's most powerful', so whatever the listener then feels reads as the trigger FIRING (wording argues its own inescapability); (b) unfalsifiable success frame — a precommitment conditional ('when you allow me to direct...') routes BOTH outcomes to a compliance verdict: feeling something = the operator did it, feeling nothing = you failed to allow; (c) sensation prelabeling — a breath protocol GUARANTEED to produce autonomic sensations (lightheadedness, tingling) paired with a frame pre-naming those sensations as proof of the operator's claim before they occur; (d) single-obstacle fear funnel — state the outcome as settled, then collapse every possible failure into ONE subject-controllable cause (fear) so any later shortfall is re-attributed to the subject, insulating the method from disconfirmation; (e) stake credibility on a test — tie the subject's credibility to a live test succeeding so passively letting it fail forces a costly self-judgment (a no-exit topology on the test result).
nodes.disc: Reach for self-sealing proof when you want the outcome to be UNFALSIFIABLE — every reaction/sensation/failure confirms the frame and no result can disconfirm it. vs expectancy-seeding — that primes an anticipated experience but does not close the fail case. vs presupposing the target as already true — that deletes the decision point by asserting completion; here a live outcome is produced and then routed to confirmation. Pick the form by what is pre-labeled: the reaction (trigger hype), a double-bind conditional, a guaranteed body sensation, a failure-blame funnel, or a self-incriminating test outcome.

nodes.name: semantic-referent-capture
nodes.mech: The operator captures a repeated word so they become its sole referent. By floating both readings of a word ("bunny" as animal vs "a cute bunny girl") then offering herself as the referent and inviting the listener to notice which image jumped to mind, she installs herself as what the word means. Every later benign-sounding use of that word ("pet", "take care", "bunny deserves") then carries the person-load without re-consent; the frame is self-authored, lowering later resistance.
nodes.disc: Covert equivocation captures a vocabulary item so subsequent benign uses smuggle in a relational obligation the listener never re-agreed to. vs a simple pet-name introduction — no equivocation, no captured referent. vs seeding expectancy for the session — that primes what the session will feel like; this captures the meaning of a word for later reuse.

nodes.name: shared-roof-outcome-fusion
nodes.mech: After laddering each party's higher aims, the operator synthesizes a single outcome statement that both parties can wholeheartedly endorse, secures explicit joint agreement on that one sentence, and only then treats the disputed behavior as the sole remaining variable. A genuinely shared roof converts an adversarial contest into a joint problem-solving task, because the goal is settled and only the means remain open — most of the negotiation is effectively finished once a congruently-agreed shared aim exists.
nodes.disc: Distinct from the laddering that surfaces the aims (that is the setup) and from consent-manufacture (no refusal channel is eroded and no non-consent is relabeled as consent — both parties genuinely endorse the roof). The tell is the distinct synthesize-one-sentence-and-lock-in-joint-agreement act that follows the climb, after which behavior is the only open variable.

nodes.name: universal-benefit-fallback-offer
nodes.mech: When deeper work is out of reach, the operator extends a low-bar benefit no subject will refuse (relaxation, anxiety relief) as a fallback PAYLOAD, leaning on the claim that no one cannot benefit from relaxation. Substituting a universally-acceptable benefit guarantees engagement even without full trance; the subject receives an immediate, recognizable payoff that builds the rapport/trust and willingness needed for later, deeper inductions.
nodes.disc: Relaxation is SELECTED as the fallback payload (a rapport/engagement move), not the delivery procedure by which relaxation is induced (e.g. a progressive-relaxation routine).

nodes.name: verdict-before-perception
nodes.mech: Pre-emptive appraisal: land the operator's authoritative appraisal or forecast BEFORE the subject forms their own perception of a stimulus, so temporal ordering forecloses independent appraisal — the subject perceives with the operator's criterion substituted for their own. Two forms: (a) verdict before perception — deliver a vivid, disgusted, authoritative VERDICT on a neutral stimulus ('that egg smells rotten') and only then invite perception, replacing the appraisal criterion itself and producing group hallucination across smell/sight; (b) somatic forecast steering — word choice about a coming PROCEDURE pre-loads the anticipated somatic sensation ('this is going to hurt' vs 'I don't think you'll mind this' about the identical procedure), in the strong register pre-naming a sensation as its opposite valence (barium enema = 'the most soothing medication ever'); heightened vulnerability makes the forecast more determinative of what is felt (waking suggestion, no trance presumed).
nodes.disc: The operator's appraisal/forecast arrives BEFORE the subject perceives, so there is no independent perception for the suggestion to modify. vs expectancy-seeding — that builds anticipation of the session/trance; this pre-empts perception of a SPECIFIC stimulus or coming sensation. vs concept-redefinition — that redefines a concept; this substitutes the appraisal criterion for one perception. Pick the form by target: a neutral stimulus's identity (verdict before perception) or a coming procedure's somatic quality (somatic forecast).

nodes.name: affect-locus-binding
nodes.mech: A constructed imaginal locus is welded to an affective state — properties defined negation-first (no anxiety, stress, pain) or as a containing perimeter (a blanket encasing body and mind) — so the state acquires a felt location and an inside/outside boundary; distress becomes geographically incompatible with being there, and returning to the locus is returning to the state.
nodes.disc: State is BOUND to the locus with a defended boundary (to feel bad is to leave; scene residue stays outside) — vs generic positive safe-place scenery in guided-visualization, vs reward-association conditioning (no reward pairing here; spatial binding), and vs a persistent identity metaphor (no identity reinterpretation).

nodes.name: antagonistic-body-map-split
nodes.mech: Runs a whole-body heaviness/immobility induction, then carves out one body part (the genitals) and assigns it the OPPOSITE sensation (lightness/buoyancy), then welds the two into a reciprocal loop where lighter-there means heavier-everywhere and a more-excited exception.
