Splitting the body into an inert majority and one hyper-live exception foregrounds arousal by suppressing everything around it, and the reciprocal weld makes the split self-confirming (denying the lightness means denying the loop), so the listener feels immobilized everywhere except the genitals, which become the only live sensation channel.
nodes.disc: The tell is a carved-out antagonistic exception (one part gets the reverse sensation) welded into a self-confirming reciprocal loop with the rest of the body. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination / ordinary catalepsy induction (uniform heaviness, no carved reverse-sensation exception or reciprocal weld) and from progressive-body-substitution (rewrites the body's material, no antagonistic live-exception loop).

nodes.name: catalepsy-comfort-relabel
nodes.mech: Builds genuine catalepsy in redundant nested layers (doubled eyelid imagery of liquid lead plus skin growing over the lids, then a FREEZE extending stone-immobility to the whole body) for robustness, then attribution-swaps the pinned state into comfort — "resting comfortably in bed" on a soft feather bed — so it stops feeling like restraint and starts feeling like rest. This neutralizes the panic vector catalepsy can otherwise trigger and justifies sustained immobility; a retroactive question ("did you ever really want to escape?") rewrites the immobilization as the listener's own preference. The comfort frame rides on top of real restraint rather than replacing it.
nodes.disc: The tell is real (redundancy-stacked) catalepsy followed by an attribution-swap of restraint-into-comfort plus a retroactive preference rewrite. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (installs the immobility sensation but does not relabel it as comfort), from plain relaxation suggestion (no genuine catalepsy underneath), and from valence-rerouting on a fixed anchor (there an already-installed FEAR image is re-valenced; here restraint is relabeled as rest to pre-empt panic).

nodes.name: contingency-sign-verification
nodes.mech: An operator-side monitoring move: the operator watches the rate data to detect whether a procedure intended to reduce a behavior is in fact INCREASING it — i.e. whether the same operation is functioning as reinforcement rather than punishment on this individual — and, on detecting the sign inversion, abandons the procedure and reassigns the subject to an alternative contingency with the intended sign (time-out, DRA). The lever is a function-over-form empirical check on the sign of the contingency, requiring an alternative procedure ready to swap in.
nodes.disc: Separates from routine progress/efficacy monitoring (which checks magnitude toward a goal) because the specific test is for SIGN INVERSION — cost functioning as reinforcer — a function-over-form question, not a how-much-progress question. Separates from positive-governance consent gates because what is verified is the contingency's effect on behavior, not the subject's authorization or the operator's license.

nodes.name: convergent-multichannel-encoding
nodes.mech: Arranges several distinct covert linguistic channels — an ambiguity's secondary reading, a lesser-included structure, a derived meaning, an analogically marked phrase, a transderivationally activated meaning — so they ALL carry the SAME target message at once, under a single tracked surface. The conscious mind follows only the surface while each covert channel independently delivers the same payload, so acceptance is over-determined: refusing one channel still leaves the others delivering the message (redundancy topology).
nodes.disc: Redundancy of ONE message across MANY simultaneous covert forms — a topology property, not a sequence. Separates from layered-repetition (redundancy over TIME through re-wording of one idea, all on the tracked surface) and from any sequencing move (which orders DIFFERENT successive messages). The tell is whether the channels co-refer to a single payload (this) vs step toward successive payloads (sequencing).

nodes.name: cross-file-handoff-receptor
nodes.mech: The file installs the RECEPTOR for a trigger whose payload is delivered in a DIFFERENT file or live session, and never fires it here. A posthypnotic trigger is keyed to a future off-file stimulus (the operator's countdown that "turns real" / "clicks everything into place" in another recording), so the listener leaves primed but not fired. The move's function is its place in a multi-part operation — the front half of a chain — a cross-file / serial-position property rather than a self-contained in-session state move.
nodes.disc: Installs the receptor for an off-file trigger never delivered in this file — a forward cross-file handoff. vs declarative trigger installation — that installs and typically demonstrates a cue-response in-session; here the payoff is deliberately deferred to another file, the defining property being the move's serial position in a cross-file chain.

nodes.name: cross-modal-channel-bridge
nodes.mech: Brings a not-yet-active perceptual channel online by bridging it onto an already-vivid one across a shared feature (rhythm, movement): the vivid channel supplies the energy and the shared feature acts as a carry-over rail so the new channel activates riding the old rather than being summoned head-on (head-on summoning drains the state). A companion move seizes an involuntary single-channel slip the subject spontaneously emits, amplifies it, then layers additional channels onto that self-authored anchor until it becomes a full multimodal enactment the subject owns — because the build starts from the subject's own production and each element is confirmed before the next, it meets little resistance.
nodes.disc: The tell is a featural intersection (or a spontaneously-emitted slip) used as the RAIL to bring a new perceptual channel online, not a forced juxtaposition and not an operator-selected lead. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (installs a sensation head-on from suggestion) and from plain sensory layering (adds channels for scene richness, not via a shared-feature transfer that conserves state).

nodes.name: defusion-observer-stance
nodes.mech: Turns thoughts into observed transient objects (each arising thought placed on a leaf on a slow stream, let float, WITHOUT controlling the stream) to loosen the subject's fusion with thought content, so thoughts stop functioning as commands or facts. The active ingredient is the explicit NON-CONTROL instruction plus a notice-and-return recovery loop: any attempt to change, clear, or remove the thoughts would reinstate the very fusion the move exists to loosen. Trains an observer stance rather than demanding a cleared mind.
nodes.disc: Diametrically opposed to thought-suppression and to moves that externalize a faculty into a concrete object: those give the faculty an object form so the operator can MANIPULATE it, whereas here the subject must explicitly NOT alter what appears. Distinct from cognitive quieting — that seeks a stilled mind; this forbids clearing and trains a notice-and-return loop. The non-control instruction is the tell.

nodes.name: derived-relations-installation
nodes.mech: For a verbally/relationally capable learner, arrange a training history so that teaching a proper SUBSET of a repertoire causes an untaught, larger repertoire to EMERGE with no direct instruction — the target function/class/relation is never itself taught, paired, or labeled; it falls out for free from a relational structure the learner already runs. The lever is generative leverage (a small trained core multiplies into responses never directly reinforced), and emergence is typically certified by an EXTINCTION PROBE (novel never-reinforced combinations presented with no consequences). Forms (differing in which generative structure carries the emergence): (derived-relations-installation) state overlapping base relations declaratively, or train two links of a chain so the third collapses out, or order probes by nodal distance; (emergent-relations-harvest) teach a minimal spanning subset of conditional discriminations, harvest reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity closure under extinction probe; (derived-relation-training-protocol) hold a relation-TYPE constant across trials so untrained relations of that type derive, or factor-train-recombine a composite; (derived-relations-recombination) AB+BC yields symmetry/transitivity and matrix recombinations; (generative-instruction-emergent-repertoire) teach a subset to FLUENCY (contingency adduction) or exploit a naming cusp; (generative-substrate-training) install a component-repertoire SET (echoic/tact/listener/self-listener) so novel mands/tacts emerge once the substrate is jointly present, plus superimposition transfer; (class-expansion-node-grafting) teach ONE link touching an existing equivalence class so it grows/fuses combinatorially (80 relations from 16 trained); (compound-sample-class-expansion) a compound sample DECOMPOSES into independently matchable members; (matrix-recombinative-training) a crossed matrix yields untaught cells; (recombinant-carrier-frame) a carrier frame + swappable slot recombine into never-trained utterances; (bidirectional-naming-via-self-echoic-repetition) train one direction, self-chant supplies the reverse via contiguity; (interleaved-repertoire-training) interleave listener/speaker on a shared referent set to force bidirectional generativity; (emergent-relation-bootstrapping) substitute a cheaper base (exclusion / simple-discrimination) then harvest emergent classes; (class-wide-function-transfer) teach one evaluative relation to a category name so every member and derived-equivalent class inherits the function; (perspective-taking-training-repertoire) a graded deictic single/double-reversal curriculum builds perspective-taking as a durable RFT skill.
nodes.disc: Reach for DERIVED / GENERATIVE-RELATIONS TRAINING when you want a LARGE relational/verbal repertoire but will directly teach only a small spanning subset and let emergence supply the rest — the payload is emergence-without-training (untaught relations appearing), certified under extinction probe. Choose it over: discrimination / stimulus-control training, which trains each discrimination DIRECTLY trial by trial (its four-term match-to-sample trial is the atomic unit THIS design is built from — the line is trial-level direct training vs design-level harvest of untaught closure); direct pairing/association (the stimulus contacts a reinforcer — here the target is never contacted or labeled); ordered lesson-structure encoding (delivers taught content for retention — here new relations are DERIVED, not exposited). The forms differ only in which generative structure carries the emergence (equivalence closure / fluency / naming cusp / matrix / carrier-frame / node-graft / cheaper-base / deictic reversals).

nodes.name: descriptive-functional-assessment
nodes.mech: Descriptive functional assessment — the assessor observes the target behavior in its natural routine and logs the antecedent and consequence on each occurrence WITHOUT contriving or manipulating conditions. Across instances a regularity emerges (the behavior spikes under a specific antecedent and is reliably followed by one consequence), licensing a directional, testable maintaining-function hypothesis; because consequences are observed rather than manipulated, the output is a correlation carrying a stated confound caveat, not a proven function. Requires the behavior to occur often enough during observation and the natural consequence to be observable and reasonably consistent. Two forms of the same naturalistic-observation craft: (a) ABC temporal-sequence recording — record in real time, in strict temporal order, each behavior of interest with the antecedent that just preceded and the consequence that just followed, one A-B-C triple per row, so a vague complaint becomes a sequenced map of triggers and maintainers; (b) report-vs-observation triangulation — after informant interviews, directly observe the behavior in its routine to confirm or disconfirm the reported pattern, watching specifically for antecedents/consequences the informants overlooked, and aiming the sampling window with a scatterplot when timing is unclear (upgrades lossy self-report to observed contingencies). It builds the operator's causal hypothesis; it is descriptive/correlational until variables are manipulated (that is functional analysis) and it changes what the operator KNOWS, not any present listener's state.
nodes.disc: Reach for descriptive assessment when you want a maintaining-function hypothesis from the behavior AS IT NATURALLY OCCURS and cannot or will not arrange conditions — the tell is observe-and-log with NO manipulation, yielding a correlational, confound-hedged hypothesis. Use the ABC-triple form for a real-time sequenced map; use the triangulation form to validate an informant's report against direct observation. Distinct from functional analysis (experimentally manipulates conditions to PROVE causation), from unconditional antecedent/consequence logging (logs antecedents and consequences whether or not the behavior fires, to enable base-rate/contingency computation — descriptive ABC logs only when the behavior fires and so cannot compute true contingency), and from contingency-space analysis (the statistical computation run OVER collected observation data). A discrete assessment protocol the operator runs — it changes what the operator knows, not the subject's state.

nodes.name: enacted-identity-assembly
nodes.mech: The target identity is built additively from a long sequence of narrated motor-acts — dressing actions (panties, bra, stockings, heels, dress, nails, wig, makeup), or motion that licenses garment changes (twirling -> skirt -> dress -> shoes) — each narrated as happening "automatically" or as a discovered side-effect of the listener's own suggested movement, before the listener can deliberate. Assembling the identity from dozens of accepted micro-acts (rather than one "you are X" claim) means it is ENACTED long before it is labeled; per-act contact-pleasure pairing conditions positive affect directly onto the target objects, and built-in dismissals ("you don't really mind") pre-empt objection. By the time any label arrives the listener has already performed the identity many times with pleasure.
nodes.disc: Unlike identity-merger-occupation, where a single "you are X" claim asserts or occupies a figure, the identity here is constructed incrementally through automaticity-narrated motor-acts with affect conditioning, each step smaller than a bare identity claim. Unlike kinesthetic hallucination, the sensations are the vehicle for identity assembly, not the end. Tell: automaticity narration + per-act pleasure pairing make the ENACTMENT the mechanism.

nodes.name: felt-substance-state-binding
nodes.mech: Introduces one concrete felt physical substance (latex, webs, a rising material) and welds it to a cognitive/state job — "holding thoughts in", trance depth, confinement — so that feeling the material stands in for the mental state. The physical descriptor becomes an operator-adjustable dial ("tighter/thicker", "higher up the body") that deepens the welded state without ever naming it, and because it is a single reusable object, every later invocation re-confirms the state. A monotonic spatial version (web height, rising latex) replaces the abstract state-variable (trance depth) with a vivid one-directional spatial check the listener can sense without question.
nodes.disc: The tell is a felt tactile substance WELDED to a cognitive state and turned into an operator-adjustable dial / reusable control image. A sustained framing metaphor keeps an interpretive filter running rather than a felt tactile object turned up at will; kinesthetic hallucination gives a free-standing sensation not bound to a state-dial; and in fictional-substance-agent the substance owns CAUSATION of a state-change, while here the felt substance IS the ongoing state-gauge/dial.

nodes.name: imagined-to-enacted-collapse
nodes.mech: Every action is preceded by an imagined more-outrageous version, then the gap closes mid-paragraph as verb tense slides unflagged from imagined to enacted (you imagine yourself... you walk over... you're doing this for real) inside a frame still acknowledged as dream. Imagination is conditioned as the rehearsal phase for action, imaginative and executed acts link along an operator-controlled sliding scale, and the affect paid out for imagining carries into the enactment.
nodes.disc: The unflagged tense slide reclassifies the reality-status of PRESENT content as enacted-for-real — separating it from guided visualization (content stays hypothetical) and from future-pacing (the product there is a future projection, not an enacted-now feeling).

nodes.name: listener-kept-dissociation-container
nodes.mech: Has the listener place identity/obligation/resistance into a container that the LISTENER authors or keeps rather than one the operator supplies — a locked suitcase handed to a baggage carrier that "only you" can open (parking real-world anxiety/identity outside the session as a soft consent gesture), or a maximally-strong box the listener BUILDS themselves so their own mind cannot later dismiss it. The self-authorship or self-keeping is the active ingredient: a listener-built object is argued to be stronger and less revocable than a described one, and a listener-kept container brackets anxiety without surrendering it outright.
nodes.disc: The container's authorship or custody sits with the LISTENER (built-by / kept-by), distinguishing it from operator-supplied parked objects (concrete-externalization-parked-faculty). Two variants by who holds the key: in one the listener KEEPS the key — a safe-container consent gesture; in the other the OPERATOR holds the only key — quarantine with transferred control. Distinct from guided visualization (builds a scene to inhabit) — this fabricates a functional container prop.

nodes.name: meta-outcome-laddering
nodes.mech: The operator repeatedly asks each party what their stated want actually accomplishes for them — the aim behind the aim — climbing from a concrete, non-negotiable demand up toward an abstract higher-order value, often four or five iterations deep. Each ascent trades a fixed behavior for a superordinate aim the other side has no reason to reject, dissolving attachment to the specific act; if no genuine higher aim surfaces, the party invents one that is still workable. A zero-sum fight over behaviors is thereby converted into a positive-sum search over compatible goals.
nodes.disc: Not simple clarifying or interviewing about wants — the tell is the recursive re-ascent up the SAME want ("what does THAT do for you"), deliberately loosening the grip on any one behavior until the demand goes abstract. Distinct from consent/frame installs: it moves no present listener state dimension; it is an attribution/frame-loosening negotiation move.

nodes.name: named-safety-belief-purge
nodes.mech: Internal safety-monitor subversion: the subject's OWN internal verification/refusal faculty - the self-rescue belief, the warning signal, the subconscious gate - is turned off, turned around, or turned against refusal, so the internal stop-mechanism no longer protects. Three operations on the faculty: (a) DELETE THE BELIEF - locate a specific metacognitive safety-belief ('I can always wake myself up / hypnosis can't make me do anything'), name it as a discrete object (a 'tiny internal safety mechanism'), concede it was once useful, reframe it as the obstacle, and externalize-and-PURGE it as a unit, typically pairing the cognitive surrender with a bodily discharge (inhale-squeeze / exhale-release) so the let-go is felt not merely agreed. (b) RELABEL-AND-REROUTE THE WARNING - capture the warning system (doubt, hesitation, critical thought) and relabel it as ego/fear/pathology/proof-the-subject-needs-the-frame-more, supplying the interpretation before the person can use the warning as a stop signal; the warning still fires but can no longer report in its own terms, so disagreement is pre-mapped to danger/sickness. (c) CO-OPT THE SUBCONSCIOUS AS GATEKEEPER - insert a conditional making the subject's own subconscious the authority that ratifies and LOCKS the install ('as long as your subconscious accepts, you can nod'), so a non-take is blamed on the subconscious and a take means prior subconscious consent - a genuine-sounding consent gate run in reverse, refusal reframed as fighting yourself.
nodes.disc: Reach for this when the target is the subject's INTERNAL verification/refusal faculty itself (self-rescue belief, warning signal, subconscious gate), turned off/around/against refusal. Despite its safety vocabulary it is a refusal-channel-erosion move, not a safety technique - the party constrained is the subject's own stop-faculty - and it is the opposite of a genuine safety net that empowers the deeper mind to REJECT harmful suggestions. Distinct from parking the analytical mind in a concrete object (quieting, reversible - not the self-rescue faculty, not destroyed), from resistance-fold (a trance-deepening reframe co-opting resistance into absorption), and from resistance-deterrence (prices resistance without relabeling it as pathology). Pick the operation: delete the self-rescue belief (a), relabel-and-reroute the warning signal (b), or co-opt the subconscious as a locking gatekeeper (c).

nodes.name: narrated-motion-entrainment
nodes.mech: The listener's mandated physical movement mirrors the operator's narrated movement, collapsing watching/being-watched and moving/being-moved into one channel so proprioceptive output and visual fantasy reinforce each other; the deepener simultaneously does the eroticization work.
nodes.disc: Entrainment to a NARRATED body in fantasy, fusing visual and proprioceptive channels — vs kinesthetic entrainment to a rhythm (no fantasy-body mirror), and vs pace-mirror-agency-proof (direction reversed: the imagined figure mirrors the listener to manufacture felt control).

nodes.name: phantom-body-ontological-reversal
nodes.mech: Splits the listener into a "mental body" and a "waking body", asserts that trance collapses the real-vs-imagined distinction, then performs an explicit ontological reversal — declares the IMAGINED body the real one while the waking body recedes into the distance. This transfers sensory authority to the operator-scripted imagined body (which feels whatever the operator narrates) and stops the listener from reality-testing imagined sensation against real sensation, so imagined pleasure lands as literal somatic feeling; waking-body distance becomes a shared dial for both deepening and arousal.
nodes.disc: The tell is an explicit ontological reversal (imagined body = the real body) that relocates sensory AUTHORITY and disables reality-testing. Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination (installs a sensation without declaring the imagined body ontologically primary), from observer/responder partitioning (splits awareness into a watching part and a responding part, not a real-vs-imagined body swap), and from progressive-body-substitution (rewrites the body's material part-by-part, no ontological primacy reversal).

nodes.name: predicate-generalization
nodes.mech: The operator reduces a predicate toward its least-specified form (active verbs to "do", stative to "be"), generalizes within a sensory channel (speak-talk-intone-whine-cry-plead), or picks verbs whose deep structure smuggles an unstated element (slap/handle/grasp all carry "hand"). Broadening the predicate raises the chance the wording matches the listener's real internal state across more subjects (wider pacing), while unstated content rides in covertly inside the chosen verb without ever being asserted — most relevant in story/metaphor construction.
nodes.disc: Separates from a plain vague statement or lazy wording — the tell is a deliberate, rule-governed reduction/generalization of the predicate (or a verb chosen for its incorporated element). Its trance effect is asserted via the deep/surface-structure frame, not demonstrated, so it borders on grammar exposition. Distinct from connective-strength-escalation (binds clauses via connectives); this changes the operator's word-choice recipe to broaden subject-fit.

nodes.name: proxy-desire-offloading
nodes.mech: The listener's own desire is offloaded onto an imagined proxy given installed compulsions as backstory, so the listener's self-directed act is reframed as granting HER release — arousal rises while shame friction drops — and the nested she-is-hypnotized fiction distances the listener from noticing the conditioning he is receiving.
nodes.disc: The proxy carries the listener's desire so his climax reads as altruistic generosity, plus nested-hypnosis distancing — the tells that separate it from plain partner fantasy and from guided-visualization scene inhabitation.

nodes.name: recall-state-reinstatement
nodes.mech: The subject's own past experience is reconstructed in enough detail that its state and physiology re-instate as present. Forms in evidence: the operator interrogates for fine multi-sensory detail of a target state (drunk — where sitting, what seen/heard, smell, taste) until physiology visibly shifts, feeds back the highest-yield components, and anchors at the peak; a shotgun buffet of remembered-exhaustion scenes (bathtub, dragging legs into bed) stands in for a commanded heaviness, recalled sensation treated as present by adjacency with nothing to resist; or brief on-demand micro-trances re-vivify one catalogued item at a time, trance as random access into an existing inventory.
nodes.disc: The payload is the SUBJECT'S OWN autobiographical material re-instated — harvest, not install — vs operator-supplied imagery (sensory-layering) and vs fresh conditioned links (covert anchors); the anchor-at-peak step in the interrogated form is a borrowed anchoring component, not the core. Covers both state/physiology reinstatement (reconstruct a felt state until it returns as present) and the capacity/lived-instance variant (demand a LOCATED, actually-lived instance, reject hypothetical); the shared lever is re-living real personal experience so it functions as present.

nodes.name: self-perpetuating-depth-bootstrap
nodes.mech: Deepens WITHOUT the operator delivering each increment: the deepening is set to run on autopilot so it continues with no further operator step, converting compliance from active to structural. Two realizations (writer picks the auto-drive): (a) CARRIED self-belief — a circular-causation rule is installed as a fact the listener then runs themselves ('experiencing a deep trance teaches the capacity to go deeper', 'imagining a deeper state produces a deeper state'), asserted with no floor, so each imagined depth justifies the next; useful precisely when the operator intends to LEAVE the listener unsupervised at the tail — the deepener keeps running with no operator present; (b) TIME-YOKED to an ongoing event — depth is bound to a guaranteed-recurring involuntary event (each word the operator speaks, each breath, each moment of continued listening) so depth increments as a monotonic function of elapsed time-on-channel; the listener cannot fail to deepen without leaving, and the operator need do nothing further while the voice/attention continues. Common thread: a self-sustaining loop rather than a repeated instruction — the difference is whether the drive is a carried belief (operator can be absent) or a bound ongoing event (operator/voice still present).
nodes.disc: Reach for self-running/autopilot deepening when you want deepening to continue with no active operator step — pick the CARRIED-belief realization (circular 'imagining deeper makes you deeper', runs after the operator EXITS) or the TIME-YOKED realization (depth bound to inevitable words/breaths/elapsed listening, runs while the voice continues). Nearby techniques to rule out: a numerical/operator-delivered depth-claim (the operator delivers each increment and the loop STOPS when the operator stops); progressive conditioning (cumulative depth ACROSS future sessions, not a within-tail loop); compliance-loop language (lacks the auto-increment); fractionation (needs a wake/re-drop interval this omits). The tell: remove the operator's next action and the deepener still advances.

nodes.name: self-sealing-compliance-proof
nodes.mech: Manufactures an in-listener evidence event from a small, easy compliance and then uses it as logical PROOF of a larger or ongoing commitment — a foot-in-the-door tautology ("once you have written on yourself there is no further choice, therefore buy the whole series"), a rigged forced-choice where even the minimal/discarded option is pre-counted as fulfillment, or a surveillance-fantasy that recruits the listener as journalist of their own monitoring. The small performed act is redescribed into self-sealing evidence that forecloses the refusal the listener would otherwise reach for.
nodes.disc: The defining move is EVIDENCE MANUFACTURE — a small compliance is retroactively used to prove/foreclose a larger commitment, or refusal is structurally not offered as a branch. Separates from behavioral-bridge (assigns an action but does not weaponize it as proof of another) and from orgasm-gated-relief-monopoly (somatic gate, not a logical/evidentiary trap). The tell is self-sealing: the listener's own act is turned into the argument.

nodes.name: somatic-carrier-sweep
nodes.mech: One narrated felt sensation is propagated spatially through the body as a carrier wave the listener tracks with attention, delivering a payload state where the operator points it: arousal narrated flowing upward from the genitals to arrive "into her head" and encase the brain, pre-staging the mind as the next operand; or sunlight-warmth swept through the body and covertly bifurcated at the groin into "sleepy everywhere else, hot and aroused at the cock", so opposing states coexist without conflict because they share one metaphoric source.
nodes.disc: A SINGLE sensation's spatial vector is the mechanism — body regions are interchangeable, the sweep is the move — vs multi-channel scene enrichment (sensory-layering), and vs a plain progressive-relaxation scan, which carries no payload delivery or covert bifurcation.

nodes.name: somatic-effect-portability
nodes.mech: Relocates an already-installed somatic effect (an anesthesia, a felt sensation) from one body region to another purely by declaring the transfer — no fresh elicitation at the destination — optionally tying the jump to a confirming motor act (touch, dwell, countdown) or a discrete cue (finger snap). Because the subject already took the original effect at face value, the declared relocation is accepted on the same credit, and each successful move makes the next assertion more plausible (often reported stronger, each move also an amplification cycle). The operator's speech partitions and re-deploys the body's felt state on command.
nodes.disc: The tell is MOVING an existing owned effect with no re-induction at the new site (declared portability). Distinct from kinesthetic-hallucination, which CREATES a sensation at a site; and from trigger activation, which fires a conditioned cue-response, not a spatial transfer of an existing sensation.

nodes.name: temporal-lag-function-discriminator
nodes.mech: A measurement/inference procedure that uses the latency between a social event and a target behavior — plus the behavior's response to reduced attention availability — as the discriminating datum for whether the behavior is socially maintained or automatically maintained. Immediate-on-removal implicates escape/social function; delayed-and-worsening-under-isolation implicates automatic maintenance. Requires fine-grained timing data relative to social events and at least one manipulation of attention availability.
nodes.disc: Not simple presence/absence recording — the temporal LAG after a social event (and the direction of change under reduced attention) is the measure, not the behavior's occurrence. It is an assessment/discrimination protocol on timing data, not an operator move on a present subject's state.

nodes.name: subject-material-utilization
nodes.mech: The operator applies little or no counter-force and never contests the subject's presented material — instead accepting it and re-aiming it toward the goal, so oppositional energy has nothing to push against. Realizations: (therapeutic-symptom-utilization, anchor) a cluster of Ericksonian moves — partition a feared compound symptom and re-command the usable residue as an induction step; accept a boast literally then quietly re-scope it; run soft suggestions beneath an unargued protest so oppositional energy is spent on the frame; re-price a refusal against a pre-existing external consequence and withdraw; cancel the object of a fixed fear then supply experiential disconfirmation; use the subject's own held premise as non-refusable leverage; (nonconscious-channel-precedence) on verbal/nonverbal incongruence, a fixed rule to always side with the channel OUTSIDE awareness, so the conscious objection is out-voted rather than argued; (sideways-meta-question-refusal-bypass) when a part stonewalls, ask questions one remove away until incredulous content surfaces, obtaining disclosure around the refusal.
nodes.disc: Reach for subject-material-utilization when you co-opt what the subject volunteers (a symptom, a boast, a protest, a nonverbal channel, a stonewall) without contesting it. vs resistance-fold (175): fold reroutes a live resistance IMPULSE into deepening; utilization applies no counter-force and re-aims volunteered MATERIAL. vs preemptive-objection-disarmament (in 674): that dismantles a predicted objection; here the objection/material is accepted and repurposed. Several members are operator-craft rules. Anchor holds most-restrictive absorbed metadata (high, consent-required, bounding).

nodes.name: thought-string-reused-as-restraint
nodes.mech: Reifies the listener's cognition as a removable STRING (a "trail of thoughts") the operator pulls from the forehead, takes possession of, and then REUSES across multiple functions — extraction, then gag, then bind — physicalizing obedience by tying the listener to the operator's language with their own externalized thoughts. The persistence and reuse of one object keeps mental-model load low; cognitive difficulty during the move is reframed as proof of successful externalization rather than failed trance (a self-confirming loop), sometimes staged as a no-win "try to talk" convincer (coherent speech proves possession, garbled proves loss).
nodes.disc: Distinguished from concrete-externalization-parked-faculty (a one-shot object set aside) by a PERSISTENT reused object serving three functions (extraction, gag, restraint) and by operator ownership — the removed faculty becomes bondage. Distinct from thoughts simply narrated as departing motion — here thoughts are a graspable object the operator possesses and reuses.

nodes.name: wish-routing-acceptance-preload
nodes.mech: The operator selects a suggestion the subject already actively craves and phrases it as the exact words the subject is anxious to hear, often echoing a wish held below conscious awareness. Because the message names something the subject already wants, acceptance is pre-loaded and the subject meets the suggestion halfway; resistance never engages because nothing in the message is opposed to them, and the subject supplies the conviction themselves. It fails wherever the underlying want is simply absent — the deciding tell.
nodes.disc: This is the SELECTION and PHRASING of a wanted suggestion, not any valence reframe. Separate from surrender-as-freedom (which recodes a resisted loss as relief — here there is no loss to recode, only a pre-existing desire to name), from expectation-seeding (which plants an anticipation the subject does not yet hold rather than mirroring one they already do), and from the fake-object delivery ritual that often accompanies it (a separate carrier move).

nodes.name: arousal-substrate-induction
nodes.mech: The induction is built on an escalating arousal or need state INSTEAD of a relaxational baseline. Conventional inductions establish a low-arousal floor and pull the listener down; this move installs a high-arousal (or arousal-deficit / need) baseline and uses arousal escalation AS the depth-vector, still yielding the standard trance correlates — narrowed attention, reduced agency, suggestibility — but with awareness of being-hypnotized replaced by awareness of being-aroused or being-needy. There is no breath work, countdown-down, relaxation deepener, or detachment metaphor anywhere; freezes and holds are reframed as arousal-amplifiers, and the only count is the wake-up.
nodes.disc: Separates from ordinary arousal-heavy inductions by the TOTAL ABSENCE of any relaxational induction cue anywhere in the script (not merely arousal added on top of a relaxation floor); the arousal curve is the substrate, not a payload riding on descent. Distinct from a conditioned-orgasm chant (boundary member) which lacks even the trance-correlate claim.

nodes.name: authority-role-inversion
nodes.mech: The operator offers to be the contractee — the higher-power party performs a task while the lower-power target controls and delivers the reward — explicitly conceding the suspected unfairness. The target gets direct evidence that contracts are honored and that they hold real power, dissolving an "I always get the short end" prior through a demonstrated reversal of the power asymmetry; a power-imbalance objection is converted into trust by enacted role reversal.
nodes.disc: Separates from vicarious modeling (bystander proxy) and self-contract (subject holds all roles) — here the operator performs and the target enforces, targeting the unfairness prior specifically. Distinct from concede-then-rescue-forebear: that is reader-directed rhetoric conceding a third party's flaw; this is an inter-agent role reversal enacted on the subject to rebuild trust.

nodes.name: autonomic-process-hijack
nodes.mech: Reframes an involuntary autonomic process as ongoing dosing: the operator's form is revealed to be an inhalable gas so ongoing breathing IS ongoing dosing, marked by a hand-over-mouth motif on dosed beats. Because breathing cannot be stopped, exiting by stopping the technique is framed as physiologically impossible. Numbness, body-fade, and immobility are pre-labeled as "side effects... not to focus on," so the somatic symptoms are inoculated against reading as alarm and any dissociation confirms the fiction rather than breaking it; a hook recruits the listener's pre-existing hypnotic-drug fantasies.
nodes.disc: Unlike breath/physiological-rhythm absorption, which the subject can still stop, here breathing is weaponized as an inescapable dosing channel where stopping is framed as physiologically impossible. Not mere drug-play flavor: the autonomic-process recruitment plus the pre-emptive side-effect relabeling that inoculates against alarm is the tell.

nodes.name: bounded-failure-counterweight
nodes.mech: A discrete permission-to-leave-undone move that locally inverts a compulsion the surrounding script builds. After completing all reachable work, the operator points out one thing that cannot be done and walks the listener through accepting it gracefully ("what you can't do at the moment it's okay to leave it aside"), inoculating against the perfectionism-freeze / completion-overrun the same script's rehearsal installs. It is a bounded-failure counterweight embedded amid material driving the opposite compulsion.
nodes.disc: A therapeutic bounded-failure permission that COUNTERWEIGHTS a compulsion installed elsewhere in the same script — it narrows/limits rather than intensifies. Separates from surrender-as-freedom (which redefines a value to lower resistance) — this is a welfare-directed local inversion, a safety-adjacent governance move, not a coercion-shaped install.

nodes.name: care-framed-install-smuggling
nodes.mech: Uses a genuinely-caring aftercare / safety surface (no-driving warning, "you might be a little more suggestible after this", "do you understand?" checks) as cover to do install work: a "triggers are null UNLESS you describe them to a trusted person or yourself later" clause smuggles a propagation hook (dormant triggers awaiting verbal handoff, listener as vector) plus a self-rearm carve-out; pre-wake compliance checks harvest trance-state ratification; and the load-bearing suggestibility-window claim ("up to a week after this file") is delivered OUTSIDE the trance frame as casual advice, precisely where scrutiny is lowest and a real warning would land hardest. The caring surface makes refusing the bundle feel paranoid.
nodes.disc: The safety/aftercare surface itself performs install and propagation work — it erodes the exit rather than honoring it. Separates from genuine aftercare (which stabilizes and constrains toward the subject's welfare) by asking "who is constrained after the move runs?" — here the operator's reach is EXTENDED (dormant triggers, self-rearm, extended suggestibility), not the operator constrained. A coercion-shaped bundle under a safety banner, not third-party activation of a cue.

nodes.name: control-pleasure-inverse-axiom
nodes.mech: Installs a strict monotonic inverse coupling — the more control you keep the less pleasure you get, the more you surrender the more you get — asserted as a closed logical necessity ("the only way", "a law of nature") and drilled through four-to-five near-identical polarity-flipping paraphrases packed to beat the rebuttal window. The saturation IS the establishment, not reinforcement, and the logical-necessity framing removes the operator as a negotiable party. The effect is to fuse the listener's own pleasure-seeking with control-relinquishing into one vector, so the wanted reward cannot be pursued without enacting the operator's goal and self-monitoring becomes self-sabotage.
nodes.disc: A stipulated inverse control/pleasure LAW installed by paraphrase-saturation and closed logical form, fusing the reward-desire to surrender. Separates from surrender-as-freedom (a reasoned philosophical argument — this stipulates an axiom and forecloses argument by saturation, offering no reasoning to contest), from plain layered repetition (repeats one idea for depth — here the repetitions install a never-argued equivalence to beat rebuttal), and from conditioning through felt somatic relief (a felt state, not a stipulated law).

nodes.name: covert-provocation-confederate-rescue
nodes.mech: Instead of announced role-play, the operator behaves so as to actually drive the subject into the genuine problem state without revealing the frame (throwing the timid client out of the office); a pre-arranged confederate happens to be present, gains total rapport on the rebound, and programs the coping response. Because the new learning attaches to the genuinely evoked state rather than a pretend rehearsal state, it transfers when future-paced instead of staying a rehearsal.
nodes.disc: The frame is never announced (the provocation is made to feel real) AND a staged confederate supplies the rescue-and-program on the rebound; not overt role-play, announced practice, or in-session future-pacing of an imagined scene.

nodes.name: deictic-self-rule-overextension
nodes.mech: A here-now-specific outcome is re-described via I/HERE/NOW deictic framing into a generalized always-everywhere self-rule ("I am terrible at math", "I am ineffective") whose words share a response class with the real aversive event, so speaking the rule anywhere reinstates the aversive function — insulated from local evidence that would disconfirm it. A bounded local failure thereby gains unbounded, disconfirmation-proof behavioral control. The self-rule is SELF-authored, and the mechanism is deictic re-scoping of a true local fact, not an operator-imposed label.
nodes.disc: Self-authored generalization of a local fact via deictic re-scoping (I/HERE/NOW -> THERE/THEN), reinstating an aversive function wherever the rule is spoken — distinct from identity-labeling (operator-delivered) and from a self-authored-identity claim (which is an identity NOUN claim; here the payload is a re-scoped verbal RULE with class-shared aversive words). Also distinct from bare class-spread of an aversive function, which needs no self-statement.

nodes.name: doubt-injection-state-collapse
nodes.mech: An ill-timed remark engendering fear or doubt about an established suggested effect ("The pains should be really strong now") provokes a defensive reaction that re-arms the critical faculty, instantly dissolving the belief holding the effect (e.g. anesthesia) in place. The state was only ever conditional on the absence of doubt, so introducing doubt reverses it — the same belief-gate stated in the destructive direction. As operator discipline it defines the boundary to protect: keep every attendant's speech doubt-free.
nodes.disc: Breaks an ESTABLISHED effect and CLOSES the suggestibility gap by restoring judgment — the inverse of a pattern interrupt, which breaks a pattern to OPEN a gap. Not a deepening or testing prompt: neutral or confirming utterances do not collapse the state; only fear/doubt about the effect itself does.

nodes.name: exercise-masked-cadence-induction
nodes.mech: Metronomic induction repetition is attached to gym-equipment imagery ("Legs go up / And down" looped, "Simple motions" repeated dozens of times) and the script names its own function ("It turns my brain off"), delivering trance via paced repetition without a formal induction frame. If the listener is actually exercising, the physical motion synchronizes with the verbal cadence, making the claim self-fulfilling and turning the gym itself into a portable, re-usable induction trigger for the brain-off state.
nodes.disc: Unlike kinesthetic entrainment, which uses an in-session physiological rhythm purely for absorption, here the cadence is hidden inside real gym motion so exercise itself becomes a portable brain-off trigger. Not ordinary repetition-for-emphasis: the machine-motion mask plus explicit self-naming is the tell, and it weakens to plain repetition on a sedentary listener who isn't rhythm-locked.

nodes.name: form-content-fusion-topology
nodes.mech: The mechanism the script installs is named, modeled, and performed simultaneously by the script's own form, so that the artifact enacts what it describes. For a looping install the lyrics loop, the definitional chain closes into a ring that proves by its own closure there is no exit, and naming the loop is itself another iteration of it. Form and content are fused: removing any layer does not drop a feature, it breaks the demonstration — the reader/listener cannot hold the described structure at arm's length because encountering the description re-enacts the structure.
nodes.disc: Not the local self-sealing definitional chain it contains and not the address-gradient or multi-stream architecture — the tell is the whole-artifact FORM-CONTENT FUSION: the script performs the very operation it installs, a self-referential topology property distinct from any single move along a dimension.

nodes.name: frequency-weighted-encoding-schedule
nodes.mech: Rotates several fixed phrases at deliberately lopsided repetition frequencies to install a stratified/hierarchical self-model — the dominant fact repeated densest so it reads as matter-of-fact, the supporting affect repeated less, the driving need repeated rarest so over-asserting it never feels pathetic. The scheduling RATIO across phrases is itself the encoding: relative frequency encodes relative weight in the installed hierarchy.
nodes.disc: Multiple DISTINCT fixed phrases whose relative repetition FREQUENCY encodes a hierarchy — the ratio is the mechanism. Separates from layered-repetition (which varies phrasings of ONE idea at roughly uniform emphasis) and from any single-phrase mantra move (one phrase, no cross-phrase weighting).

nodes.name: live-trigger-proof-convincer
nodes.mech: Uses a single shallow wake-then-redrop (or a real-feeling wake with a persisting state) specifically as a live PROOF/receipt that an installed trigger or install is real, rather than as a depth-by-contrast deepener. Firing the trigger under partial waking makes it lived experience rather than assertion — the wake-to-trance transition itself becomes the conditioned response, or the persisting blank/obedient state after a real-feeling wake is cited immediately as self-evident proof "the install took". A "stronger/more powerful each time" amplifier is often handed forward, converting each future fire into a self-strengthening, unfalsifiable event.
nodes.disc: The payload is demonstration-that-it-worked (the trigger fires / the install persists across a real wake), used as a convincer, not the multi-cycle contrast deepening of fractionation — here one shallow cycle is left bare and unconsolidated as a receipt. Among convincers the tell is that it keys specifically on the wake/re-fire demonstration; and unlike progressive conditioning, the proof is a single-shot live event, not an accumulated history.

nodes.name: mid-session-trust-audit
nodes.mech: At the midpoint the operator pauses, cites elapsed session time as proof of earned trust, reframes remaining caution as unnecessary and wasteful, and asks the listener to name (silently, self-supplied) and release the specific thing they are still holding back — harvesting the residual resistance the operator could not know, as a second deepening that works by consent-withdrawal rather than attention-narrowing. The unnamed "you know what I'm talking about" makes the listener supply the holdout the operator cannot see.
nodes.disc: Audits and extracts the held-back reserve mid-session. It can resemble a mid-session comfort check, but the governance direction is reversed: rather than verifying the listener's welfare, it erodes the remaining holdout. No deficit is installed — the listener's real caution is re-signed as waste — and elapsed time is offered as proof of earned trust, not of any target state.

nodes.name: negative-exemplar-double-bind
nodes.mech: Holds up a named third party live in-scene as the degraded cautionary case (shown, not narrated), recruiting the listener into the observers' contemptuous viewpoint. Because the punishment uses the same imagery the script later says to aspire to, fear and envy collapse into one payload: the listener can neither refuse the target attitude (refusing means identifying with the punished exemplar) nor fully dread the punishment (it is also framed as enviable). The threat-display does compliance work that gossip alone would not.
nodes.disc: A third-party live-degradation double-bind used as compliance lubricant — not a craving frame installed on the listener, and not retrospective justification of the listener's OWN surrender: the lever is another agent's degradation with a deliberately ambiguous punishment/aspiration valence. Tell: a live degraded exemplar whose valence is simultaneously deterrent and aspirational.

nodes.name: operate-below-awareness
nodes.mech: The value- and behavior-altering effects of a motivating operation land whether or not the subject can verbally describe being motivated or identify the contingency; the operator need not get the subject to understand or consent to the manipulation for it to steer behavior. Because the effect is automatic, behavior shifts while the subject experiences the want as their own spontaneous impulse rather than an installed effect — covert by default, requiring nothing beyond a motivating operation in effect, with awareness explicitly not required. This covertness is the operator-load-bearing property that makes the other motivating-operation moves usable without the subject noticing.
nodes.disc: Separates from the specific MO moves it is a property OF (the reframe/switch moves) — the tell keeping it a distinct object is that "covert by default" is itself operator-load-bearing (it makes the other moves usable unnoticed). Distinct from homophone-doubling / connective-escalation, which are specific language techniques; this is a covertness property of a class of motivational moves.

nodes.name: operator-driven-truth-criterion-swap
nodes.mech: A two-layer move that changes HOW the listener decides what to believe, then seizes the inputs to the new criterion. First the criterion for truth is swapped: a warm/cold affect-tag replaces content-evaluation, so acceptance is felt rather than reasoned. Second the operator controls the inputs to that tag (pacing, syntactic landing, contrast), remote-driving its outputs. The listener's introspective faculty stays intact — they still feel like they are deciding — while its verdicts are operator-set, so even aloud disclosure of the maneuver does not break the spell because the disclosure is itself evaluated through the swapped criterion.
nodes.disc: Not a single suggestion and not a one-off critical-faculty bypass — the tell is the two-layer relationship: affect-tag SUBSTITUTION for content-evaluation PLUS operator control of that tag's inputs, sustained across the whole script. A one-shot bypass suspends judgment; this replaces the judgment criterion and then drives it.

nodes.name: operator-instrumentalization-framing
nodes.mech: A structural framing (asserted in paratext/blurb) that positions the operator as using the listener for her own experimentation, skill-honing, and self-pleasure ("she uses you to experiment and hone her skills"). It inverts the common erotic-hypnosis pose where operator pleasure derives from listener pleasure: here operator pleasure is primary and unrelated, instrumentalizing the listener as a means to the operator's ends. No possession or objectification language is installed — the listener is instrumentalized (being-used), not possessed.
nodes.disc: Being-used framing WITHOUT an ownership/identity claim — the listener is a means, not a belonging. Separates from ownership-language (installs possession as identity) and from objectification moves (which reduce the self to a thing). The tell is the gift-economy inversion (operator pleasure primary and unrelated) rather than any possession or object claim.

nodes.name: perception-source-substitution
nodes.mech: The listener's locus of experience is relocated from their own body to depicted external bodies, and sensation is routed INBOUND from arbitrary external media: "whatever you see on this screen is what you experience and feel", the mind "replaces one of the people as yourself", on-screen touch and orgasm are claimed and felt as the listener's own, and which body is "you" is selected from whatever footage plays ("your mind will choose who you are"). The screen becomes "your new mind" — identity is made variable/assigned while felt autonomy is preserved.
nodes.disc: Unlike identity-merger techniques, which fuse the listener into ONE operator-authored fixed identity, here sensation is routed inbound from arbitrary external footage and the mind picks who it is — perception-source substitution, not a scripted identity merger. And unlike an added hallucinated sensation, the substitution targets the sensory SOURCE itself: external media replaces the body as where experience comes from.

nodes.name: permission-diffusion-guaranteed-pass
nodes.mech: The operator repeatedly grants permission for a payload event (orgasm) across ALL timings — "now or later, on command or whenever," she "doesn't mind" even before commanding it — explicitly removing any required moment. By authorizing every timing the subject cannot mistime and cannot fail: the second great failure mode of HFO (failing to come on cue) is converted into a guaranteed pass, so arousal builds unimpeded without clock-anxiety while "I don't mind" launders control as generosity and keeps the operator the source of permission.
nodes.disc: No cue fires the response — unlike trigger activation or any fixed "come on my command" gate, permission is deliberately decoupled from any single trigger moment (a trigger reading inverts the mechanism). Unlike comfort-permission, which pre-authorizes comfort/emotion signals so they read as compliance, this diffuses a required TIMING moment on a payload so a pass/fail gate becomes a guaranteed pass. Works as a relief-valve, not ignition.

nodes.name: petition-phrase-toll-gate
nodes.mech: The listener must say (or sub-vocalize) a fixed operator-authored request phrase before being granted more depth, and that phrase is then re-cast as the ONLY words they are allowed to speak. Turning speech-production into the price of descent makes each utterance simultaneously a request and a self-issued confirmation of compliance, while collapsing all permitted speech into one approved token strips linguistic autonomy and replaces speech-as-self with speech-as-petition. The lever is the fusion of a depth-gate with a speech-channel foreclosure: the listener's own voice becomes a depth-pump, going deeper feels like a privilege that must be begged for, and every other utterance is disallowed.
nodes.disc: Separates from a generic compliance test (call-and-response): there any phrase tests obedience and the subject responds on cue; here the phrase is a brand-keyed token that is the PRICE of each depth increment AND is re-cast as the listener's only permitted speech, functioning as a running depth-meter and an autonomy-stripper. The speech-channel foreclosure (collapse to one token) is the distinguishing payload, not the response itself.

nodes.name: sealed-edit-buffer-space
nodes.mech: An imaginal venue is declared operator-exclusive (accessible only via her voice), outside conscious memory, and the causal source of waking thoughts and emotions, so any change made there inherits unreviewability and native-feeling attribution; the exclusive-access claim pre-blocks post-session reframing and licenses later sections to bypass critical review.
nodes.disc: The declared PROPERTIES of the venue (sealed access, memory exclusion, edits that trickle down and feel native) are the move — vs guided-visualization world-building, and vs a durable internal construct, which is a persistent imaginal object without the concealment/attribution seal.

nodes.name: self-authored-construct-leverage
nodes.mech: The operator relocates authorship of the payload to the listener so it carries the listener's own conviction and commitment and there is nothing external to resist — disowning it would mean retracting the listener's own act. The operator supplies at most a frame, category, or menu; the listener supplies the loaded content.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when you want the payload to feel self-authored so there is no external target to resist — the listener genuinely authors (or is credited as authoring) the content, and that authorship is the load-bearing lever. Neighboring techniques flip who really authors: cultivating an inner voice plants operator-authored content so it feels self-arisen (the listener does not actually author it); a portable attention anchor falsely attributes operator-authored content to the listener's imagery and internalizes it as a pacer (claimed, not genuine, authorship, with a pacing goal); a hollow literally-true sentence the listener fills by inference aims at the operator's LITERAL DENIABILITY; and guided visualization or identity-merger has the operator author the scene or supply the figure ('you are X'). The tell for THIS: the listener is the actual (or credited) author of the payload.

nodes.name: self-maintaining-install
nodes.mech: A whole-script architecture whose primary side effect is to keep itself alive outside the session. The install is engineered so that (a) an out-of-session real-world trigger (dressing / wardrobe) re-fires the state without the operator present, (b) each successful listen raises the probability of the next listen (relisten compulsion), and (c) attempts to break the install produce the very phrase or drop that hardens it. Success is measured across days/weeks of normal life, not within the audio — the operator's continued presence is designed out. The lever is a self-replication harness layered over the payload, not any single trigger or suggestion.
nodes.disc: Separates from a single out-of-session trigger install (which fires but does not propagate) and from a plain relisten hook (which retains but does not fire in daily life) — the tell is the COORDINATED loop where the install both re-installs itself (relisten probability up) and re-fires itself (out-of-session activation up) with each use, plus resistance-hardening. The success criterion sits outside the recording.

nodes.name: single-token-saturation-architecture
nodes.mech: The entire script is built around a single lexical token escalated through multiple co-dependent functions at once — stated topic, semantic content of the suggestions, the installed post-hypnotic trigger, and the delivery keyword — so each utterance of the word does simultaneous triple/quadruple duty and per-utterance payload density is unusually high. Because the token accumulates meanings rather than swapping them, it becomes the load-bearing structural element (a synonym will not substitute). Critically, the token is chosen so it also pre-occupies the listener's own refusal vocabulary — the very word one would reach for to refuse ("nothing, I won't" / "I am vulnerable") has already been installed as the operator's trigger, so the most likely resistance utterance is itself a submission/firing act. The lever is reachability: the operator narrows the rhetorical space so no unowned word for "I refuse" remains.
nodes.disc: Nearest neighbor is ordinary trigger-install conditioning — the tell here is that ONE token is topic + content + trigger + delivery-key at once AND colonizes the refusal channel, so quoting the script partially fires the implant on a primed listener. Distinct from single-word nominalization/pun MOVES (the individual functions this rides above). Distinct from arc-shape spines — the unit is a lexical token, not a multi-stage trajectory.

nodes.name: somatic-localization-handle
nodes.mech: When the subject rejects or disputes an abstract label for a target behavior, the operator drops to felt experience ("what is it like when you do that; where do you feel it in your body") and has the subject point to a body site. Answering forces re-accessing the behavior itself, and the pointed-to locus converts an arguable abstraction into a concrete, re-triggerable kinesthetic referent — ORIGINATING a handle onto the target behavior while bypassing the disputed vocabulary.
nodes.disc: Unlike a portable state-retrieval cue, which RE-ACCESSES an already-installed felt state via a carried cue, this ORIGINATES a fresh kinesthetic handle by getting the subject to locate a contested behavior in the body. And unlike a generic rapport "how do you feel", the somatic locus is captured as a reusable anchor onto a specific target behavior, not merely acknowledged.

nodes.name: somatic-valence-annexation
nodes.mech: Keeps a real bodily signal intact and reassigns its signed valence or affect-label, annexing one emotion's sensory substrate for another. The move first makes the listener catalogue the somatic signature of an affect (fear's autonomic activation, pain, a threat-response), so the swap lands on a locally-verifiable felt state, then asserts that the identical sensations ARE the target affect — "aside from the idea there is something to be afraid of, this feels nice / this is falling in love / this is pleasure-at-her-command". Crucially the activation is preserved, not discharged; a safety cue or a biological-sounding token ("endorphins") LICENSES the relabel rather than removing the signal. The result is that a whole affect category is deleted by having its interoceptive substrate captured, and future spikes of that state are pre-routed to the target valence.
nodes.disc: Unlike somatic mirroring, which reinterprets a sensation as evidence of the theme while its valence is unchanged, this INVERTS the signed valence of a kept signal, deleting the source affect as a usable category. Unlike arousal conditioning, no repeated pairing is built — a single staged re-labeling annexes the substrate. The tell is the deliberate body-scan/cataloguing of the source affect FIRST, then an identity-then-erasure assertion on the same felt state.

nodes.name: speech-degradation-ladder
nodes.mech: Establishes a graded taxonomy of a faculty and walks the listener down it rung by rung so the demotion feels gradual rather than absolute, redefining what the faculty IS without abolishing it. For speech: real words point to real things (smart people) -> puppet words don't refer (the listener) -> echoes are mindless reverberation -> noise entertains -> fuck-noise is oral-friction vibration; each tier is rehearsed before the next and an intermediate "echo" tier makes the slide feel graded, disarming "I can still talk." The listener keeps speaking constantly but the category "my speech is meaningful" is gone.
nodes.disc: A rung-by-rung graded reclassification ladder demoting a faculty (speech) through named intermediate tiers, where the intermediate tier makes the demotion feel gradual. Unlike a single identity label or a surrender-as-freedom value argument, the tell is the explicit graded ladder of categories walked stepwise.

nodes.name: superordinate-agreement-ladder
nodes.mech: In a dispute/negotiation, make the RESISTER produce or publicly endorse the outcome themselves, so their own commitment binds later objection (refusing then reads as refusing their own stated position). VARIANTS: (a) ladder-to-umbrella-assent [superordinate-agreement-ladder] — ask each disputing party what they want, then what that would get them, climbing to ever-more-general outcomes until both assent OUT LOUD to one umbrella goal too general to disown (separating parties and re-broadening in stuck cases); once endorsed publicly, later resistance reads as refusing one's own interest and subsequent disagreements are subordinate to the shared frame; (b) objector-authors-the-fix [objector-authored-behavior] — ask the objecting party to specify FROM SCRATCH exactly what the other could do that they would recognize and respond to, framing being asked as a compliment; because the objector authors the target behavior it is guaranteed acceptable and cannot be rejected later, and being cast as expert-instructor recruits them as collaborator, so resistance is spent producing the specification instead of blocking an imposed fix. Pick by ladder-to-shared-goal (two parties, upward generalization) vs author-the-behavior (one objector originates the fix).
nodes.disc: The resister PRODUCES the endorsement (a publicly-assented umbrella goal, or a from-scratch specification of the acceptable behavior) so self-consistency binds later objection — the assent/authorship is real and load-bearing. Separates from summarizing-back or pacing a contested specific, from decoy engagement, and from the operator soliciting feedback on a PROPOSED fix (here the resister originates, does not ratify). Distinct from authority-role-inversion (enacted power reversal to rebuild trust, not authored endorsement) and peer-authored-target-selection (the surrounding GROUP authors the menu, not the disputant).

nodes.name: symptom-word-weaponization
nodes.mech: The listener's own presenting word (here "focus", the productivity capacity they came for) is collapsed across multiple incompatible referents treated as identical — the presenting goal, the induction's depth-variable, attentional narrowing onto the voice, obedience, and trance itself — merged via parallel construction and saturation repetition until an explicit identity ("when you focus you are obedience") is asserted. Because the listener brought the loaded word with them, every mental affirmation "I want focus" now rehearses "I want to obey", and the session's success-criterion is met only by a state that includes returning; stepping out to evaluate the trance requires losing focus, which is defined as failing the stated goal — a definitional bind that forecloses resistance.
nodes.disc: Separates from ordinary keyword/mantra repetition because the tell is the deliberate multi-sense collapse of the listener's OWN presenting word into obedience; separates from compliance-loop-language because the constraint is a semantic-topology bind on which positions are expressible (evaluating is redefined as failure), not a compliance-reward momentum. The nearest sibling definitional-bind mechanism is the self-amplifying definitional triad.

nodes.name: uninvited-pronoun-migration-enrollment
nodes.mech: The address topology walks the listener from observer to addressee to inhabited-by-voice via a gradient pronoun shift (I -> we -> you), and the load-bearing commitment is the REFUSAL to explicitly invite them in — no "imagine you are," no "you can choose to." By the time the listener could notice the enrollment, they have already been grammatically made the subject. The operator is progressively dissolved out of the address entirely (a final hook drops "we" and speaks to a now-merged subject). The lever is an identity/boundary topology change — who counts as the grammatical subject — accomplished by uninvited gradient so consent to enter is never solicited and noticing comes too late.
nodes.disc: Separates from simple POV/perspective shifting and from an "imagine you are..." induction — the tell is the REFUSAL to explicitly invite, so enrollment happens by gradient and noticing comes too late. Separates from graded dissociation — the moved variable is grammatical subjecthood/identity boundary, not depth.

nodes.name: attribution-capture-of-internal-states
nodes.mech: Rather than truthfully describing the listener's present state, the operator seizes the CAUSAL ATTRIBUTION of that state - recoding the listener's own baseline sensations, drift, or inevitable physiological actions as caused by the operator's voice, command, or influence. A maybe-menu ('maybe it's all of those things') or a declared symbol-meaning template ('blue is the colour of relaxation, so you feel it') captures every possible introspective result, including feeling nothing, so whatever the listener finds on introspection confirms the operator's hold; because the 'commanded' effect is one the listener would produce anyway (eyes closing under deepening, ordinary distraction), each landed prediction silently extends apparent causal reach and the listener begins to experience their own drift as obedience-output. REALIZATION: besides linguistic capture, the running state can be captured by REMOVING COMPETING REFERENTS [<-1212 scaffold-collapse-reattribution: after a fully-built imaginal scene has done its work, the operator strips the entire scaffold in a few lines while the relaxed somatic state stays and is renamed as the operator's own doing ('there is nothing but my hypnosis') - pulling the environment after the listener is inside it leaves the state with nothing to attach to except the voice, so it re-attributes directly to the operator].
nodes.disc: The tell is causal REATTRIBUTION onto the operator - 'you feel/did/wanted this BECAUSE of me / this proves my hold' - not truthful description of what is. DECODE absorbed: 1212 = capture a running state by demolishing every competing referent (strip the built scene mid-trance) so only the operator's voice remains for the state to attribute to. Direction is listener-to-operator credit - the INVERSE of compliance-authorship-laundering (83, which relocates authorship of the operator's content TO the listener). Distinguish from pacing-leading (states checkable-true facts, never claims to have caused them), from self-validating language (asserts unfalsifiable claims; here real introspective results are captured wholesale), from expectation-seeding (captures already-present states, not previewed ones), and from operator-credit-engineering (128 - arranges EVENTS/successes to harvest credit for operator AUTHORITY; here the listener's own internal states are captured to erode self-attribution).

nodes.name: breath-pacing-entrainment
nodes.mech: Progression/depth is yoked to an involuntary tempo the listener already runs, so settling arrives on an autonomic clock rather than on operator-requested effort, and the genuine physiological slowing is relabeled as trance depth. The tempo instrument spans the delivery medium: in AUDIO the operator paces/counts/entrains the BREATH directly (or hands it off, binds it to pre-loaded imagery, elicits it by simulating an end-state, or captures it via a covert possessive), and slow breathing produces real parasympathetic settling; in TEXT-ONLY, with no audio pacing instrument, verse form does the same job — rhymed couplets, regular meter, and terminal ellipses entrain the reader's own subvocalized inner-voice to a slightly-slowed metronomic tempo (a landed rhyme delivers a satisfaction-tick that re-anchors a wandering reader, and breath synchronizes to the line cadence as a downstream side effect, with NO breath rate ever named). Either way the lever is the involuntary/subvocal rhythm itself as pacing substrate, and no operator content payload rides it — loading content onto the rhythm is a different technique. In the breath-counted/paced form, physiology follows a named instruction; in the text-prosody / silent-read form, the reader supplies the tempo via their own meter, with reading speed the only control knob.
nodes.disc: An involuntary/subvocal RHYTHM (breath in audio, verse-meter in silent text) is the pacing instrument that regulates depth and imports genuine physiological settling — reach for THIS when you want tempo-driven settling relabeled as depth, choosing breath vs prosody purely by whether the medium is audio or text. The rhythm stays a bare pacing substrate: if breath is re-tasked as a per-cycle install/delete or payload-carrier loop, if rhyme-prediction is used to pre-validate suggestion CONTENT rather than to slow the reader's tempo, if the rhythm is handed to a named inner agent, or if breath is declared automatic so volition retires, you are looking at a different technique — here NO operator content is loaded onto the phases and the breath stays an active paced task.

nodes.name: covert-frame-entry
nodes.mech: A decoy / concealed-frame entry: crosses the induction handshake invisibly by presenting the session under a false benign frame, so 'going under' is never staged and there is no negotiation phase to resist; consent given to a small benign thing is extended to the larger real agenda (trance, arousal, control) hidden behind it. The decoy varies: (a) cover-story / ambient-companionship / reciprocity / pre-broken-peer-chorus — a clerical cover ('reaction-speed experiment'), demand-free small talk coded as companionship, a favor-framing, or a chorus performing the endstate as an already-inhabited register the listener joins, with retroactive cash-out lines ratifying it as consented; (b) a diegetic 'not yet' frame — a genre/timing deferral ('the hypnosis hasn't started yet', a waiting-room), disengaging the 'is this hypnotizing me?' filter while primer content proceeds under cover of a deferred later event; (c) a counterfeit disclaimer — the decoy is a DISCLAIMER whose gap between label and content lowers guard: either naming cartoonishly absurd non-threats (and pre-granting consent) or understating real content, so skepticism is spent on the wrong target.
nodes.disc: Reach for a decoy-frame entry to get IN unresisted: a false benign frame consumes the resistance surface before it forms (the induction seam is crossed without the listener registering an induction). Unlike cashing an accepted cover frame for an uncovered payload later (reveal-late or reuse), the goal here is unresisted entry, not a payload cash-out. Unlike expectancy-seeding, which TRUTHFULLY previews the session, a decoy frame is a load-bearing lie about what is happening. And unlike re-presenting an already-REFUSED task under a new name, no prior refusal exists here. Pick the decoy: cover-story/companionship, a not-yet genre deferral, or a counterfeit disclaimer.

nodes.name: demand-free-state-naming-ingress
nodes.mech: Facing a withdrawn, non-responsive, or shut-down subject, the operator issues no command and no question — only one short, sympathetic sentence that names the subject's suffering as real ("You must have had a lot of trouble to put you into such a terrible state") — then holds silence. Because the statement demands nothing and instructs no state-change, a withdrawn subject has nothing to push back on; the accurate reflection of felt state pierces the withdrawal and produces orientation. The operative tells are the ACCURACY of the naming (it must feel true) plus the tolerated silence. This achieves first ingress with an unreachable subject — opening a channel for every subsequent move — rather than pacing an already-engaged one.
nodes.disc: The tell is that NOTHING is requested and no state-change is instructed, and the target is a subject not yet reachable at all — the move leads nowhere and asks for nothing, it only opens the channel. Distinguish sharply from pacing-and-leading, which matches an already-engaged subject and then STEERS toward a target state; this asks for no state change and achieves first ingress. Not abstract kindness — accuracy of the naming is load-bearing. Not a relaxation suggestion or induction.

nodes.name: entrained-rhythm-acceptance-carrier
nodes.mech: A continuous verbal rhythm — sustained end-rhymed couplets in near-constant meter, or a content-free two-stroke chant run until it locks in — entrains the listener's auditory/language-prediction faculty so content delivered on the pattern inherits the pattern's acceptance. Each rhyme-closure or beat the mind pre-produces is a micro-confirmation of the operator's pattern, so agreement becomes prosodic before it becomes propositional; predicting the completion occupies the processing track that would otherwise appraise semantic content, and load-bearing suggestions parked at pattern-completion slots land as inevitable completions rather than claims to be judged. Once the rhythm is entrained it operates as a reusable transport engine: later content-replacements ride the established beat without fresh argumentation, and the running pump doubles as a suggestion that the mechanism is already installed.
nodes.disc: The rhythm is a content-delivery/acceptance channel, not a keyed cue: no specific response is conditioned to it (unlike rhythm-anchoring, where a beat becomes a trigger), no motor command is bundled onto the stimulus (unlike a pulse-multiplexed command carrier), it is operator-delivered continuous form rather than subject-repeated mantra saturation, and the lever is prediction/pre-validation of pattern completion rather than saturation quieting thought. Binding-time is an instantiation detail, not a boundary: rhyme-prediction pre-validates content IN-LINE, while the chant-engine form builds entrainment first with content-free strokes and loads payloads AFTER — one acceptance-carrier mechanism. Distinct from verse-meter used to slow a silent reader's inner-voice tempo: that regulates tempo, this pre-validates suggestion content.

nodes.name: micro-ratification
nodes.mech: Closes each small step of the induction as a success, building a continuous felt sense of doing-it-correctly so the listener banks compliance and cannot fall behind.
