Realized permissively — suggesting-then-noticing small autonomous events ('you may notice your breath softening'), pre-approving both feeling the effect and feeling nothing so the opening is impossible to fail, attributing the change to the body's own autonomous process so there is no fail/resist axis, or eliciting the subject's own spoken confirmation of the success so hearing themselves say it hardens conviction.
nodes.disc: Unlike pacing-and-leading, which strings pacing units into a state-guiding sequence, micro-ratification is the permissive per-unit ratification itself. Unlike induction by flat state-assertion (declaring the state a fait accompli with no procedure) and unlike presuppositional autonomic attribution (narrating undeniable physiology and crediting it to the induction), micro-ratification confirms an OBSERVED or plausibly-present listener response permissively, not an asserted state or an undisputable autonomic sign.

nodes.name: operator-delivery-craft
nodes.mech: The operator shapes their OWN transmitted signal -- decoupling internal assessment from outward channel -- so the subject receives only the intended cue; the object is the operator's output, not the subject's state. Realizations: (a) COVERT-CHANNEL CONTROL — privately doubt the outcome but keep every observable channel (tone, manner, word choice, hand motion) free of doubt and leak only genuine warmth while suppressing any gesture readable as a trance cue, so the subject's threat-detection never catches the cue; or hold the question's wording constant and vary only intonation (neutral inquirer -> clean literal report; interested intonation -> covertly directs a tranced subject who reads paralinguistics as directive); (b) DELIVERY-CONGRUENCE CORRECTION — an observer interrupts a technically-correct move delivered with mismatched voice/posture and gives specific paralinguistic fixes (retune tone/tempo, change posture), splitting verbal content from nonverbal delivery so the analog channel stops contradicting the words; (c) DELIVERY-TEXTURE / FORM FUSION — a whole-script, design-time property (NOT a discrete move): the texture of the text is tuned to the target end-state -- a flat flip-less energy contour matched to loop/replay format, a density gradient (information down, trigger-firing up toward a mindless endpoint), a monotonic counter as coherence-scaffold letting interstitial prose stay loose, and grammatical form degrading in lockstep with described cognitive degradation. The common lever is control of the operator's paralinguistic/behavioral output and signal texture as a channel independent of the words.
nodes.disc: Reach for operator-delivery-craft when the writer is shaping what the OPERATOR transmits -- tone, manner, gesture, intonation, or whole-script texture -- rather than acting on the subject's experience. Tells: internal state concealed while an authentic channel is leaked / words held constant while intonation carries covert content (a); an observer retunes a self-cancelling mixed message (b); a corpus-shape texture property with no discrete move to perform (c). Distinguish from pacing-leading (acts on the subject's experience), from attribution-capture (relocates the subject's self-attribution), and from operator-training-via-monitor (drills procedural precision, not the transmitted signal).

nodes.name: pace-the-symptom-idiom
nodes.mech: Where ordinary pacing matches observable experience, this extreme-case move paces the subject's own symptomatic CODE — meeting the subject inside their pathological idiom rather than pressuring them out of it. Facing meaningless word-salad, the operator transcribes and studies it, learns to improvise word-salad of the same pattern in a different vocabulary, matches utterance lengths, intermixes nonsense, and converses entirely in the idiom until the subject himself requests sense — then titrates rational speech in proportionally while keeping a ritual bit of nonsense. Engagement is earned where demanding intelligibility failed for years, and the subject initiates the move toward shared language, so the lead is subject-led.
nodes.disc: The tell is that the paced surface is the subject's own symptom/channel (not observable ongoing experience or stated affect), sustained via a distinct record-study-reproduce-converse procedure until the subject asks for the shift. Distinguish from pacing-leading proper (paces observable/projectable present-tense experience and expects acceptance), and from validate-affect-then-presuppose (paces a stated affect then presupposes a new layer). Here the operator enters and sustains the symptomatic idiom itself, and the subject leads the exit.

nodes.name: pacing-leading
nodes.mech: The operator restricts utterances to statements the listener can confirm against present experience right now (timed observables, projectable low-specification descriptions, or near-universal trance states), so a stream of confirmed-true statements builds an accumulating agreement (a perceptual yes-set) that entrains attention and erodes the line between "this describes what is" and "this instructs what comes next." A not-yet-true target statement is then bolted onto the accepted run and inherits the borrowed truth-status; because nothing is denied, there is nothing clean to dispute, and a satisfied lead recycles as the next pace so the chain feeds itself. Variants ride the same lever: the target smuggled in by adjacency (agency-denial or interoceptive state-claim), the starting act pre-relabeled as the listener's own already-underway want, or the connecting word itself graded as a leverage dial — a bare temporal/contingency connective (as, when, after) that asserts no link and lets the listener author the causal bridge, climbing through "as … you will" to an overt "will make you," so the lead inherits truth-status in proportion to the connective's asserted force regardless of validity.
nodes.disc: The defining tell is a paced clause that is verifiably true in the moment (observable, projectable, or near-universal) grammatically or sequentially coupled to a lead the listener has not yet verified, such that agreement accrues with no single place to object. The connective-grade variant is still this move: the graded connecting word is the leverage instrument of the lead, not a separate family. Distinguish from attribution-capture (which misattributes the CAUSE of an already-occurring state to the operator rather than merely describing it truthfully), from expectation-seeding (which previews a future rather than banking present truths), and from self-validating language (which asserts unfalsifiable claims rather than checkable-true ones). Remove the live truth of the paced clause and the coupling breaks — it becomes bare narration or an ordinary command.

nodes.name: presuppositional-autonomic-attribution
nodes.mech: The operator watches the subject's body, names autonomic changes that are actually occurring (respiration, heartbeat, blood pressure, eyelid reflex), and phrases each so the wording presupposes the change already happened AND was produced by the induction. Every statement is verifiably true, so each builds undeniable rapport; the presuppositional framing silently converts spontaneous physiological drift into evidence that the induction caused it, and because the subject cannot dispute autonomic signs the attribution slips in unchallenged.
nodes.disc: Unlike micro-ratification, which permissively ratifies an observable behavioral response to deepen rapport, and unlike a verbal yes-set of arguable truisms, the content here is INVOLUNTARY physiology already in motion, undeniable, with the induction credited by presupposition. Unlike an ideomotor binary, which elicits a movement, this narrates movements already occurring. Distinct also from attribution-capture, which relocates authorship of the listener's own state; here the true autonomic sign is described and the CAUSE (the induction) is presupposed.

nodes.name: representational-system-matching
nodes.mech: The operator treats the listener's spontaneous sensory word-choice (see/grasp/sounds; touch-words vs sight-words) as a live readout of which perceptual channel is running and how deep the subject is, then covertly recasts their own suggestions in that same channel. A suggestion phrased in the listener's own dominant sense-code needs no internal translation, so it registers as if it originated inside the listener rather than arriving from outside; because the matching is concealed and any invited channel-shift is indirect, it stays below notice and any shift feels self-authored, so it is not resisted. This is input-side rapport CALIBRATION — an operator-side read of the listener's active representational system feeding a covert channel-matched delivery — on which downstream sync moves ride.
nodes.disc: The tell is that the mirrored/read surface is specifically SENSORY-MODALITY vocabulary used as a channel index, and the matching is deliberately concealed to seed suggestion (not to signal comprehension). Distinguish from generic active-listening or paraphrase-back. Distinguish from pacing-leading, which banks checkable-true statements to lead; here the lever is speaking inside the listener's sense-code so suggestions register as self-originated. The gauge sub-form is a non-intrusive continuous READ that changes the operator's knowledge map, not the listener's present state.

nodes.name: respiration-coupled-substitution-engine
nodes.mech: The involuntary breath cycle is re-tasked from a pacing metronome into a per-cycle substitution/loading engine. Each phase is assigned an opposing job — inhale installs operator-content or a desired state, exhale deletes self-generated cognition, mind, memory, or resistance — so every autonomous breath counts as two compliances (received a positive, ejected a negative), or a fixed breath count serves as a constant carrier onto which a rotating payload tag rides. Because the carrier is autonomic and cannot be stopped, the conditioning runs whether or not the listener actively cooperates, and drift-during-trance becomes compliance rather than a gap. The occupied breath (counting or hold) also keeps the critical apparatus busy so the loaded payload slips past unevaluated.
nodes.disc: Breath does substitution/loading WORK via explicit phase-assignment or serves as a carrier for a smuggled payload — it is not measuring or entraining depth. Unlike breath-pacing-entrainment, where the rhythm only paces and no payload rides the breath, the tell here is inhale=install / exhale=delete directional relabeling, or fixed-carrier + variable-tag. Valence of the payload (erotic arousal-pump vs cognitive/mnemonic erasure vs obedience-tag) is an illustrative twist over one shared structural lever, not a boundary.

nodes.name: validate-affect-then-presuppose-layer
nodes.mech: The operator first paces the subject's currently-held affect or goal — sincerely praising the anger as healthy congruent expression, or warmly accepting a destructive/suicidal goal — which disarms the affect and builds rapport with the part holding it (the surprise of validation stops the subject to listen). Then, backed by nonverbal proximity (approach, softened tone, touch), the operator lays in a presupposing question that INSTANTIATES a layer that did not previously exist: the aloneness/hurt beneath the anger, or the positive intent a death was meant to serve. Because the layer is presupposed rather than asserted, the subject supplies it and treats it as real, converting hostile arousal or an absolute defended demand into a cooperative, recoverable state the operator can build on.
nodes.disc: Two beats are load-bearing: (1) pace/validate a stated affect or goal, then (2) presuppose a NEW softer or underlying layer into being via nonverbal proximity — the layer is manufactured, not merely uncovered. Distinguish from pacing-leading, which leads toward a state via truth-banking, not by presupposing a hidden layer. Distinguish from one-shot content imposition, which skips the pace and the proximity requirement. Distinguish from attribution-capture, which reattributes the cause of an existing state rather than instantiating a new affective layer.

nodes.name: volitional-breath-retirement
nodes.mech: A deliberately-controlled breath is engaged first, then mid-stream reframed as no longer requiring control — the body 'simply does as it should, without you having to think', or the breath cycle is explicitly licensed to keep running unattended while attention goes elsewhere. This retires the listener's volitional effort: once breathing is declared automatic the conscious mind has no assigned job and is left idle, and a self-sustaining physical compliance runs underneath foreground awareness confirming 'I am doing what she says'. It banks a first cooperative act with no trance required and installs the template 'things you do deliberately become things that happen to you' as a pre-license for later involuntariness.
nodes.disc: The move is retiring volition / licensing autonomy over an act just engaged — converting a deliberate breath into a self-running background compliance and installing the deliberate-becomes-automatic template. Requires a controlled act FIRST, then the license. Separated from breath-pacing-entrainment because pacing keeps the breath an active paced task; here the explicit point is that it now runs without attention/control as a banked compliance-proof. Separated from authorship-handoff because no named inner agent takes the breath — volition is simply retired, not reassigned to a 'subconscious' persona.

nodes.name: anchor-overloading
nodes.mech: An already-live, previously-conditioned anchor is re-keyed so it now ALSO carries a new response (double-charging) or has its meaning overwritten wholesale, rather than a fresh cue being installed. Because the new payload rides on an existing conditioned response, no fresh anchor work is needed and the change reaches RETROACTIVELY: every prior encounter with the anchor (past recordings, or the pre-accepted self-label) now carries the new payload. The re-keying is typically bound at a high-salience moment (peak arousal, self-vocalization) and may widen the anchor's firing surface (audio -> 'speak or write').
nodes.disc: Re-keys or overwrites an ASSUMED-ALREADY-LIVE anchor so it fires a new/changed response, with retroactive reach across prior material — not a fresh install. Separates from trigger-stacking (composes distinct newly-installed cues under one cue, incl. its absorbed master-anchor variant that mints a NEW supra-cue subsuming priors; overloading instead reuses an EXISTING cue in place). The tell is 'this word you already respond to now also/instead does X, backward across everything.'

nodes.name: asymmetric-maintenance-relisten-loop
nodes.mech: On exit, a contingent post-hypnotic trigger makes any emotion INCONSISTENT with the installed programming cause re-listening, framed as hygienic. The trigger is asymmetric: fitting emotions produce nothing, non-fitting emotions produce another session — so the file fades during compliant periods and becomes salient only when the programming is failing (selective salience), a light footprint with heavy long-term effect. Paired with a birth-reframe wake (count-up framed as the first waking of a new being, memory-of-change pre-explained away) that normalizes the felt change as the new self's baseline; the loop is self-repairing, keyed to the failure state.
nodes.disc: Fires on an internal FAILURE state — an emotion inconsistent with the installed programming — not on a schedule, unlike a timer bridge that fires a state transition at a set clock time. It is also not a waking suggestion that re-delivers content during emergence: the install is a contingent re-listen loop that activates only on later programming failure, not a waking-moment redelivery. Close kin to self-firing-environmental-recurrence — both schedule reactivation beyond the session — but that one fires on an environmental trigger like sleep, while this one fires on the failure state itself.

nodes.name: asymmetric-state-lock
nodes.mech: An exit EXISTS but is MONOPOLIZED by an operator condition — the subject cannot independently return to baseline / end the state; the homeostatic return that would close the conditioning window is removed and handed to an external release. In one realization, an entry/exit state-lock, a deliberate imbalance is built on a trance/triggered state: entry easy, automatic, pleasant; exit foreclosed to the subject and reserved to an operator command, or the subject's own reflexive exit action (opening eyes/blinking) re-anchored to deepening instead of surfacing, or waking gated on completion of an in-session payload. In another, an encapsulated container with a sole exit, the whole payload is packaged into a re-summonable container with an operator-defined interface ('box with cat ears', unlock/lock + finger-click), and that same interface is installed as the ONLY stopping rule, so all state-exits route through the operator's mechanism under a consent-flavored 'only people you permit can unlock' surface.
nodes.disc: Reach for THIS when the subject's AUTONOMOUS EXIT from a state is eliminated and the release is handed to an operator condition — an exit exists but is operator-monopolized. Objection-and-exit-preclosure closes named objection/exit routes rhetorically or by reroute; this structurally monopolizes the state's off-switch. Neighboring gates target different objects: an orgasm-gating double bind gates a bodily RELEASE (both directions of orgasm), not the trance state itself; a re-access gate gates re-ENTRY, not exit; operator-exclusive trigger-firing gates a trigger's FIRING, not the state exit. And where an ordinary count-up return hands the exit back, here the exit action itself is inverted (eye-opening -> forgetting/deepening).

nodes.name: closed-loop-operator-binding
nodes.mech: Installs a trigger linkage with no exit term: the response re-targets or re-summons the cue source itself, so the loop is self-sustaining without further operator action. In the recursive-chain form, the terminal response (helplessness to resist the operator's commands) applies to the same voice that is the firing cue, pre-loading the state at the first instant of any future contact, before content is heard. In the biconditional form, two concepts are welded symmetrically (sex <-> operator) so each thought self-summons the other and ordinary daily arousal re-pages the operator. Either way the subject's own cognition or future exposure becomes the loop's motor, and an ironic-process rider ('the more you try not to, the more powerful') converts resistance attempts into reinforcement.
nodes.disc: The installed topology is closed — the response consumes into, re-targets, or re-summons its own cue source, leaving no exit term. Declarative-trigger-installation binds a forward cue->response pair with distinct endpoints, and trigger-stacking hangs multiple responses on one cue while staying forward. In self-referential-cue-install the cue is a metacognitive act CONSUMED by the response (thinking becomes self-defeating); here cognition/exposure is AMPLIFIED and routed back to the operator-concept — the loop feeds, it does not erase. NOT affective-deadlock: one valence circulating a closed ring, not two incompatible valences held simultaneously.

nodes.name: covert-diegetic-install-shell
nodes.mech: A two-layer script architecture in which an outer conventional envelope (breath induction, contract, trigger-install, wake) wraps an inner story envelope where nearly all operationally load-bearing content is installed as narration rather than as command. Once the story starts the operator switches from directing to narrating, so content lands at full rate with nothing asked of the listener at the surface; the shell exists only to make the listener compliant enough to receive the story as fiction while it works as suggestion. The lever is the directing-to-narrating shift, which removes the surface request there is to resist.
nodes.disc: Separates from a simply framed story with intro/outro — the load-bearing moves all live INSIDE the fiction and the directing-to-narrating shift is what disarms defenses. Distinct from flat-surface- concealing-semantic-arc (surface-grammar uniformity) and from authorship-relocation containers (this is about install SITE inside diegesis, not about relocating who authored the state).

nodes.name: covert-install-under-cover
nodes.mech: A trigger is installed while the listener's 'here comes a trigger phrase' anticipation is suppressed, because the install ACT is disguised as something else. The cover varies: the trigger token is embedded in descriptive sentences that read as emotional report / causal explanation / temporal frame and repeated several times before its function is ever confirmed (the-abyss SURRENDERTOSLEEP); the conditioning prose is slipped between the beats of an unrelated attention task — spelling letters, a toe-to-head body-scan, or a memory/repeat-back rhyming game where imperative command-words are vocalized under time pressure as if random rhymes ('it's just words in a game' is exactly the defense that lets them through) — so it slides past semantic scrutiny (lexiconsublim mid-dyad, continue-your-submission body-scan welding SLEEP to whole-body heaviness); the trigger phrasing is given while framed as third-person clinical exposition (evil-nurse mind-cage overprint); the install is staged across escalating deniability so the response is rehearsed before recognized as installation (tag-youre-it game-metaphor -> covert fire -> explicit install; conversational-domination narrate-past-effect-on-a-third-party then pivot); or the install itself is dated to a moment already past ('while you were sleeping I implanted a button') so consent is made structurally non-refusable, then actuated by involuntary ideomotor movement (fractionation forehead-button). In every form the semantic/critical channel is occupied, misdirected, or foreclosed so noticing (or being able to refuse) the technique does not break it. Two further concealment covers work the same way: an opacity-mantra cover — a compressed, deliberately-nonsense chant dropped at the lowest-parsing moment, so semantic OPACITY itself is the cover and the token rides on rhythm and resists analysis; and a trusted-template-reuse cover — the heavier install reuses near-verbatim the ceremony that built an earlier innocuous trigger, so familiarity and prior consent suppress install-anticipation and the ceremony is skipped.
nodes.disc: The INSTALL ACT is hidden — disguised as description, buried under a concurrent task, given as third-person exposition, or dated to before any refusal point — so it bypasses the listener's trigger-anticipation and/or consent. Declarative-trigger-installation announces the install openly ('when you hear X, you will Y'); here the install is concealed. In retroactive arming (a declarative-install variant) the drilling predates an OPEN naming; here the install itself stays concealed. An amnesia-wrapped command hides a DELIVERED command behind forgetting; here the concealment is at install-time via cover-task, overprint, disguise, or backdating — no amnesia. And where an ideomotor movement appears, it is used to FIRE a backdated trigger, not as spontaneous proof of trance.

nodes.name: covert-nonverbal-anchor
nodes.mech: Repeated, unannounced pairing of a discrete non-verbal cue (a sound, a gaze-location, a physical signal) with a state, response, or communication channel installs a conditioned link below conscious awareness. The subject experiences the response as spontaneous because no verbal when-X-then-Y instruction was ever given; the pairing itself is the install. In the evidenced variant the cue is a fixed spatial gaze-location and the conditioned target is an address-channel to one named part rather than a state-response — same covert-pairing install, different conditioned payload.
nodes.disc: The install is implicit Pavlovian pairing with no declarative instruction (vs the open verbal installation of declarative-trigger-installation), the cue is a discrete non-rhythmic signal (vs a sustained cadence carrier), and the cue fires as an ANTECEDENT evoking a state or routing a channel (vs conditioned-reinforcer-manufacture, whose markers fire as consequences that select behavior). vs covert-install-under-cover: there the concealed cue is VERBAL; here the cue itself is non-verbal.

nodes.name: declarative-trigger-installation
nodes.mech: The operator binds a specified cue to a specified future response so a persistent conditioned pair fires outside the installing moment. The cue is external to the subject's own cognition — an operator-verbal phrase, a typographic/all-caps token, an everyday object or image, a class of objects, an everyday high-frequency word, the file's own title, or a guaranteed public/calendar event — and the response is a discrete future state-change or behavior ('when you hear/see/encounter X, Y happens'). The install grammar runs in several authored refinements that stay inside the one mechanism: the cue is engineered as a broad, self-expanding ambient surface so it fires in ordinary life without the operator present (a whole clothing class, a title-as-trigger keyed to anyone saying it or the subject's own thought of it, common high-frequency words); the response is specified to strengthen per firing (growth-clause rider: multiplicative per-firing growth, or an additive driveable accumulator); the install labels rather than creates, cashing conditioning already drilled unmarked across the runtime so the trigger arrives with a built-in response history (retroactive arming — saturate-then-consecrate ordering, a pre-flooded word, an already-drilled command phrase, narrating the response as inevitable fact, state-synchronous drilling, a sleep-cue built into a reflex); the install is asserted as already-done in an earlier unauditable session so denying it works would require denying one's own past (presupposed-conditioning — a voice-register claimed as long-conditioned, a back-dated everyday word, past arousals recoded as prior installs); and the anchored cue is chosen to double as its own content-meaningful term plus a belief-conversion payload so each riding assertion is silently accepted while the trigger survives audit as plain deepener talk (deniable-belief-converter — e.g. an anchored term like 'surrender'). Two more cue-surface/register variants of the same install lever: an open-narrated install — the conditioning is narrated OPENLY in procedural language as it happens, transparency-as-disarm lowering scrutiny; and a somatic-anatomical cue — an imagined object is implanted at a named body-site so later mention of its name fires a felt body-SENSATION, the cue-surface being a body location rather than a word/object/image.
nodes.disc: Declarative cue->response binding for a discrete future state/behavior, the cue external to the subject's cognition. Tells AGAINST: the cue is the subject's own metacognitive/self-reference act consumed by the response (-> self-referential-cue-install); the response is valence/reward delivery only (that is conditioning territory, not a trigger install); the install works by temporal stimulus-pairing with no verbal contingency declaration (-> respondent-stimulus-pairing); the install ACT itself is concealed/disguised at delivery time (-> covert-install-under-cover); the install target is an open content-unknown slot inheriting conditioned weight (-> deferred-content-slot-install); the installed topology is a closed self-referential ring whose response re-summons the cue source (-> closed-loop-operator-binding); an object is given ambient symbolic meaning with no discrete fired response (no cue->response pair ever fires, so it is not a trigger install at all). The ambient-surface, growth-clause, retroactive-arming, install-by-assertion, and deniable-dual-function forms are all VARIANTS of this one install lever — twists on the cue-surface, the response-magnitude, the install-timing, the install-veridicality, or the cue's semantic doubling, not distinct moves.

nodes.name: deferred-content-slot-install
nodes.mech: Builds a locked structure of conditioned words, then installs an OPEN slot in it: the listener pre-commits, at peak suggestibility (orgasm as the binding agent), to treat future content-unknown words — whatever they turn out to be, delivered live or in other recordings — as equivalent to the existing conditioned set, inheriting its full weight. The actual filler words are never cleanly delivered; the install target is a VARIABLE, not a value — a future-tense backdoor on the conditioning that the operator can re-enter and fill arbitrarily.
nodes.disc: The install target is an open, content-unknown slot pre-authorized to inherit existing conditioned weight. vs declarative-trigger-installation: there a fixed, known cue-response pair is declared at install time; here nothing bound is known at commitment time. The orgasm is the binding agent, not a conditioned response — this is not arousal-to-cue conditioning. And the concealment is NON-DELIVERY of the filler content, not an amnesia wrapper around a delivered command. Not a growth-clause variant: growth clauses strengthen a KNOWN response; the slot defers WHAT is installed, not how strongly.

nodes.name: environmental-retrigger-seeding
nodes.mech: Link the installed state or identity to specific real-world stimuli the listener is certain to re-encounter (a named song, gym bikes, gear shifts, a friend's leg), so ordinary environmental contact re-fires and reinforces the conditioning after the session ends — extending operator reach beyond the audio file. A dense locational catalog of concrete objects can ground an abstract identity so each object becomes a re-firing anchor, and amplifier language ('a hundred fold') can make each exposure strengthen rather than merely recall the install.
nodes.disc: The cue set is REAL-WORLD ambient stimuli seeded for out-of-session re-firing — not in-session modality extension of one trigger (multi-modal-trigger), not a single if-then situational pairing, and the install is declarative and announced, so it lacks the covert-pairing tell of covert-nonverbal-anchor.

nodes.name: marked-cue-amnesia-switch
nodes.mech: Pre-mark a token during trance by tone/tempo/emphasis and train the MARK, not the word's meaning, as a binary handle on a posthypnotic amnesia. Later the operator re-presents only that marked token to flip the sealed material open or shut, or delivers a matched second reserved phrase that runs the suppression anchor in reverse, flooding the sealed content back complete; the delayed-key form slips the tonally-planted cue into ordinary post-trance talk on the operator's timing to re-open sealed material outside the trance frame. Because the active ingredient is the analogical mark, ordinary paraphrase, frank statement, or full retelling all fail to reach the block; only the tagged token operates the switch, and the release feels spontaneous to the subject rather than commanded.
nodes.disc: The active ingredient is the mark isolated over semantics — proven by the failure of every non-marked prompt — operating an amnesia gate. Trigger-activation fires a state-shift, not a memory-gate toggle; a plain amnesia suggestion installs the seal, while this operates its key; and an amnesia-wrapped command wraps a command in forgetting rather than switching the amnesia itself.

nodes.name: multi-modal-trigger
nodes.mech: One trigger is made to fire across multiple sensory or representational channels — heard, read, thought, spoken, touched — so the conditioned response survives missed cues and follows the subject into more contexts, and the subject cannot recall or internally reference the cue without firing it (internal thought is not a safe harbor). Forms in evidence: sequential extension of an installed trigger into new channels; simultaneous all-channel firing at the moment of state capture for redundant encoding (tactile primacy claimed); firing across all verbal delivery modes (operator-heard, silently self-thought, spoken aloud); flooding a single token across visual/olfactory/gustatory channels with listener-supplied detail; using the listener's OWN self-applied identity handle/name as the cue so every use of the persona fires the response and casual identity-use becomes impossible (an always-on self-trigger surface running outside sessions); a non-verbal build mapping opposite somatic outcomes to per-ear stereo tones drilled as a reflex the subject cannot consciously author; and restoring a destroyed cross-modal anchor by re-siting its function onto a substitute matching the lost cue's physical slot and every channel. Absorbed (genus, cue-surface widening on further axes — same 'make the cue fire in more situations' lever): written/text channel (tell: extend the trigger to fire from operator-addressed WRITTEN media — email, website, chat — a persistent async between-session channel, and a typographic-gestalt sub-form conditioned to a spaceless all-caps SHAPE recognized at a glance; must be explicitly installed, does not transfer from a spoken cue); scope/catchment widening (tell: progressively widen WHAT qualifies as the cue — aroused -> sexy image -> any image — using a backward countdown / depth-pacing as the vehicle so each expansion lands too deep to evaluate; the widening axis is the semantic catchment rather than the sensory channel).
nodes.disc: SEVERAL channels carry the SAME trigger-response pair — vs declarative-trigger-installation single-cue installation, vs compound-sample-class-expansion where compound components become independently matchable class members, vs deliberate single-cue placement OFF the dominant channel (analogical-marking), and vs environmental-retrigger-seeding (reach expansion via real-world object seeding, not sensory-channel extension of one cue).

nodes.name: open-authority-socket
nodes.mech: Binds activation authority for an installed state to the UTTERANCE of a trigger phrase rather than to any specific or consented operator — 'when somebody says', 'as soon as someone tells you', 'whomever said this words is obviously your pimp', 'usable by I or anyone else'. Whoever learns the phrase can toggle the subject's state, often with the promotion presupposed as already-completed ('obviously') and with downstream judgment (pricing, commands) delegated to that arbitrary speaker. The distinguishing structural property is that the activation set is identity-agnostic and un-vetoable at activation time — a socket that accepts any key-holder, not a delegated right handed to a named party.
nodes.disc: Activation is granted by identity-agnostic UTTERANCE (any speaker, no consent check, no in-normal-state veto), not to a named/nominated delegate as in third-party-activation. Separates from third-party-activation (specific trusted party holds the right) and from persona-programming twists by keying on the access-control property: who is admitted to fire, and the answer is 'anyone who speaks the phrase.'

nodes.name: operator-exclusive-trigger-firing
nodes.mech: After a trigger is installed, an exclusivity clause captures the trigger surface for one operator: the cue is bound to fire only in the operator's voice / the operator's files, or 'I and only I say it', so the same word spoken by anyone else (or self-administered) has zero effect (pointless, useless) and both self-soothing/desensitization and third-party dilution of ownership are blocked. Two layers run at once: the clause defends the trigger against ambient activation that would fatigue or break the conditioning, and it converts every ambient occurrence of the word into a craving for the operator's voice, so other people's use becomes an advertisement (the non-firing is felt as deprivation). Frequently the exclusivity is safety-coded ('for your hypnotic safety, your mind will lock the word to my voice and my voice only') so resisting the lockdown feels like resisting one's own protection and the listener actively cooperates; and it is often paired with a hot-swap, retiring a freshly-drilled working trigger and transferring the felt response by substitution onto the new, voice-locked word. The effect is parasocial dependence tied to a specific voice and a structural disadvantage to any competing operator.
nodes.disc: Gates the FIRING of an installed trigger to the operator's voice alone (owned re-induction, valueless without her voice) and converts ambient exposure into craving. It is a post-install access-control clause, not the install itself, and it gates trigger firing, not state exit as an asymmetric state-lock does. It is more specific than a generic loyalty suggestion: the move is exclusivity plus craving-on-absence — voice capture. Where third-party activation DELEGATES firing rights outward, this EXCLUDES third parties and the listener alike. And unlike a genuine safety clause that bounds a trigger's scope as real protection, here the safety-coding is cover for capturing the trigger surface. The craving-on-absence, safety-coded voice-lock, and hot-swap forms are variants of one exclusivity lever.

nodes.name: orgasm-gating-double-bind
nodes.mech: Transfers both the onset AND the cessation of climax to operator command: the listener is told she cannot come until told (the inability attributed to her blanked mind), is edged, released on an explicit command, then held in chained forced orgasms she cannot stop. Release and stopping are equally out of her hands — a double bind on an autonomic event, with the blame-attribution to the blanked state doing the agency-transfer work.
nodes.disc: BOTH directions of an autonomic event are operator-gated. The counted 'Orgasm now' release is only a component; the mechanism is the bidirectional authority transfer, not the cue — which separates it from a plain declarative trigger install. A motor-inhibition challenge suggests inability in ONE direction as depth proof; the double bind closes both directions and targets orgasm, not skeletal movement. A one-way stop-authority trigger resembles the stop half alone, but the double bind is symmetric — neither start nor stop is retained — and involves no practice asymmetry. And no cue-to-arousal pairing history is built: the gating works by declared authority in-session, not by conditioning.

nodes.name: out-of-audio-compliance-offload
nodes.mech: Transfers a state-transition (deepening / compliance-proof) OUT of the audio into a second medium where the operator has no live control — the recording tells the listener to pause, leave the audio, perform a specific motor act in a separate channel (click a button in an email), then resume, with the external act itself framed as the deepener. The listener's own out-of-band motor act becomes materially-performed proof of obedience, pre-tagged to double depth; returning carries the just-completed compliance back into the session as a state delta.
nodes.disc: Unlike an in-audio drop command, and unlike a text-platform trigger where a text cue FIRES a conditioned response, nothing here fires from reading; the deepening is executed by a materially-performed external motor act in a second medium where compliance is possibly tracked. The tell is the transfer of the state-transition work to a separate channel, not a cue that activates in text.

nodes.name: post-wake-ratification-fire
nodes.mech: After a full wake count to 'awake and normal', the operator fires an installed trigger the instant the trance frame closes, deliberately overwriting the emergence reassurance and collapsing the trance/waking safety boundary. The in-body response immediately after being told one is normal is offered as the most persuasive proof of waking-life durability; the withhold-then-fire and self-amplification riders ('the more you use it the more powerful') extend the demonstration into an instruction to strengthen the anchor over time.
nodes.disc: The tell is a live trigger fire placed AFTER the wake count that contradicts the 'refreshed, normal, awake' framing on purpose. Plain trigger-activation fires in-frame with no boundary move; a waking suggestion is delivered DURING emergence, not fired after closure to puncture the boundary; and an in-session depth convincer proves depth inside the session, not out-of-session reach.

nodes.name: relief-monopoly-bind
nodes.mech: Establishes the operator as the sole valid authority over a bodily release (orgasm) by pre-defining every autonomous or competing route to relief as inert. The core form grounds this in an ONTOLOGICAL claim — even permitted self-touch is causally incapable of relief, only the operator can grant it — and then experientially confirms it by granting permission that sabotages its own payoff (each touch adds need rather than relieving it), foreclosing the resist/beg/touch escape routes at once. The scope variant extends the same monopoly across a class of external agents: no other hypnotist's command, nor even the operator's own OTHER recordings, can authorize the release for the window. In both, the operator becomes the only valid exit, producing dependency rather than mere arousal.
nodes.disc: Gates a bodily RELEASE by making the operator the only causally-valid grantor and foreclosing all autonomous routes — via ontological impossibility or cross-agent exclusivity. Rule-based orgasm denial ('I forbid you to come') lacks the impossibility/monopoly framing; addiction framing is a linguistic craving frame, not a structural exit-foreclosure; denial-window-as-deepener-loop recycles denied arousal into a DEEPENER, while this gates who may AUTHORIZE release; and an asymmetric state-lock gates the trance STATE, not a bodily release.

nodes.name: respondent-stimulus-pairing
nodes.mech: Operate on the RESPONDENT (reflex) arc via stimulus presentation, not consequences on voluntary behavior. BUILD direction (respondent-stimulus-pairing): present a neutral stimulus just before or simultaneous with an unconditioned stimulus that already elicits a response; after repeated pairings the formerly neutral stimulus alone elicits a conditioned response — an automatic, involuntary reaction the subject did not have and did not choose, transferring by temporal contiguity (forward/simultaneous strongest, backward/delayed weaker). EVALUATIVE facet (valence-transfer-pairing): pair a stimulus that already reliably evokes a positive emotional response (liked music) with a neutral target (a product, an ad), contiguously and repeatedly, until the target itself elicits the affect and biases downstream choice toward it — affect installed with no argument about the target's merits. DECAY direction facet (respondent-habituation): present an eliciting stimulus repeatedly within a short span with no consequence or pairing, and the elicited response's magnitude decays and may vanish (massed re-exposure blunts reactivity on an intact unconditioned reflex arc); SPACING the same exposures preserves the response — presentation TIMING is the lever.
nodes.disc: Reach for RESPONDENT CONDITIONING when the target is an INVOLUNTARY (reflex/affective) response and the lever is stimulus PRESENTATION, not consequation of voluntary behavior. To install an elicited response or affect, pair NS+US by contiguity (order-sensitivity forward > backward is the procedural marker); to install a biasing VALENCE onto a choice target, use an already-evocative affective stimulus; to DECAY an existing reflex, re-present the eliciting stimulus massed (no pairing). Choose it over: discrimination/stimulus-control and any declared-trigger install (which consequate/instruct VOLUNTARY responding — no reflex elicited); motivating-operation engineering (which shifts a reinforcer's VALUE, not a reflex); conditioned-reinforcer manufacture (pairing that transfers reinforcing FUNCTION delivered as a consequence, not elicited affect).

nodes.name: self-administered-conditioning-loop
nodes.mech: The operator transfers the labor and the reinforcer of a conditioning loop into the listener, keeping only the framing. The listener supplies the reward (self-generated arousal, self-recited mantra, a self-voiced first-person declaration, a competence appraisal on each repetition, an instructed motor act) while the operator merely labels it as caused-by and owned-by the operator's words. Because the reward is the listener's own and the act of producing it is defined as the compliance, the loop becomes self-driving: stopping costs the pleasure, continuing costs autonomy; progressive transfer of the operator role into the listener's own drive is the point, so the loop rides the listener's ordinary daily behavior (masturbation, self-talk, re-listening) as its substrate and can continue operator-absent. A staged sub-form keeps the operator present only to install a CUTOFF: a voluntary motor act (nodding) is coupled to involuntary sensation, acceleration is instructed so sensation rises as a function of the listener's OWN action, the escalation is re-credited to operator control, and an anti-saturation hard-stop both hides the listener-driven nature and installs operator stop-authority before a later gate.
nodes.disc: The reattribution move: the operator OWNS the reward-framing but never GENERATES the reward, and the loop is engineered to self-sustain (or to install stop-authority) rather than being operator-driven. In a within-session conditioning loop the operator both drives and delivers the reinforcing cycle in-session; here the listener supplies it. Where arousal is conditioned to operator cues as the goal, arousal/pleasure here is the outsourced FUEL, not the payload. A self-directed mantra is absorptive chanting for its own sake; here recitation is tied to escalating pleasure and autonomy-cost. And unlike ideomotor proof, where subtle AUTOMATIC movement serves as evidence of trance, the motor act here is VOLUNTARY, instructed, then reattributed. The self-driven-motor-with-cutoff form — operator present only for the cutoff — is a variant of the same listener-drives-it-then-reattribution logic.

nodes.name: self-firing-environmental-recurrence
nodes.mech: A recurrence rule is installed that fires on an environmental stimulus the operator does NOT have to supply — sleep itself, or later ambient imagery (dust-imagery) — with dreams framed as the nightly delivery channel and an internalized token (an amulet) as the receiver. A state-bridge line anchors the future state to the current trance state, so re-entry is scheduled beyond the session and does not depend on the operator's voice being present. The listener wakes carrying a self-firing recurrence suggestion that reactivates the trance state on future nights without any live operator input.
nodes.disc: Fires on an unavoidable environmental stimulus rather than a scheduled timer: where a timer-based bridge autonomizes a state transition on an external CLOCK at a set time, this keys re-entry to the subject's own recurring physiological rhythm (sleep/dream) or to ambient imagery. Unlike a declarative trigger install, whose cue must be operator-delivered, the activating stimulus here is self-occurring. Close kin to asymmetric-maintenance-relisten-loop: both schedule reactivation beyond the session, but that one fires a re-listen on a failure state while this one fires on an environmental trigger like sleep.

nodes.name: state-machine-toggle-install
nodes.mech: Installs a two-state machine over the subject toggled by paired on/off verbal triggers, where the payload is not a single discrete behavior but a whole standing STATE or identity and the operative object is the state-machine's engineered BIAS. In the asymmetric-accounting form ('Make-Up Time For You' / 'Make-Up Time Over'), the off-switch carries amnesia for the triggered state (anchored to behavioral rituals — shower, remove make-up) while the on-switch carries an explicit accumulation clause ('emerges even more strongly than the last time'), so the vanilla side resets to baseline and cannot reflect on the triggered state while the triggered side is never wiped and strengthens per activation — repeated cycles drift the equilibrium toward the triggered identity while the side that could revise it is kept blind. In the reified-alter form ('Bimbo Time' / 'Revert to Normal'), a NAMED secondary personality is toggled by paired phrases and framed as already-existing-but-dormant ('asleep until awakened') so the alter is reified as pre-existing rather than constructed, lowering felt authorship; the two selves are mutually exclusive with no dimmer, and control is transferable to any third party who knows the phrase.
nodes.disc: The entry is the paired-phrase two-state IDENTITY/STATE machine, not either component install and not a single discrete fired response: a plain trigger installation covers each on/off phrase as a component, but no single cue-response pair models the standing-state toggle or its drift. Where amnesia appears (asymmetric form) it is one-sided state-memory accounting in service of the drift, not an end in itself — the install is overt and the wipe targets the vanilla side's memory OF the triggered state, unlike amnesia used to conceal that an install or firing happened at all. And both switches work for the subject: the asymmetry sits in memory and growth (asymmetric form), or is absent entirely (reified form, where the move is the alter framed as pre-existing plus lowered felt authorship) — not in entry/exit access held only by the operator.

nodes.name: third-party-activation
nodes.mech: Delegates activation rights over an already-installed conditioned response to a specific, nominated third party the subject trusts, so the trigger fires for that named delegate exactly as it does for the original operator. The delegate is identified (partner, husband, 'someone you trust') and the transfer is often wrapped in ostensible-consent language; the load-bearing move is that a real, waking-life second person now holds the on-switch to a session-installed state. Includes the 'file itself becomes the trigger the partner deploys' realization (partner instructs the subject to press play, firing an hour-overlay) and the 'your husband's commands equal mine' generalization from a single cue to blanket command authority. The internal-consent-gate variant routes the authorization through an untestable self-applied criterion so the protective wording itself builds the permission; the imagined-delegate variant delegates the operator-owned trigger to an engineered-faceless avatar inside the visualization, training source-independence with no real second person.
nodes.disc: A NAMED / nominated delegate holds firing rights over a previously-installed cue-response — the entry presupposes the trigger already exists and covers the handoff of activation authority. Phrasing that grants activation to ANY utterer, identity-agnostic rather than a named party, is the open-authority-socket neighbor instead. The delegation itself is the payload here — not a relabeling of refusal as consent, and not an unlock relocated onto consuming another product.

nodes.name: trigger-activation
nodes.mech: Fire a trigger that was genuinely installed in a prior pass (this or an earlier session) so the pre-armed cue-response link cashes in for its effect alone. The move presupposes, does not build, the conditioning; the discrete cue is uttered and the conditioned state, drop, arousal, or compliance follows. Variants extend the same activation lever along a single distinguishing surface: the induction-shortcut variants call the prior trigger to do an induction's work (compressed re-entry), in the strongest form firing a pre-installed anchor to collapse from waking DIRECTLY into trance with no fresh induction ramp; the same-session variant fires a trigger installed moments earlier as its first live self-validating test; the ambient variant fires one word densely as prose-interrupting punctuation until it fades from discrete cue into continuous suggestibility background; and the operator-paced escalated fire stages a pre-announced escalation — a triad with per-utterance intensities, or a countdown that stalls to add buildup — converging on a gated held-back discharge, with anticipatory rehearsal.
nodes.disc: The cue was genuinely installed and is now merely fired — nothing is being installed, and nothing is back-dated into existence by asserting a prior install that was never shown. And it is a single firing for its effect: when a fire-and-reward cycle is drilled repeatedly for reinforcement, that is the within-session conditioning loop, not this.

nodes.name: trigger-network-mutual-binding
nodes.mech: Rather than each trigger owning one isolated output, every installed trigger is cross-wired to the others — explicitly ('any time I use any trigger it reinforces every other') or by dense in-session co-occurrence — so activating any one node recruits the whole bundle. The wiring is often bidirectional (arousal<->surrender, blank<->aroused) and each trigger's payoff is partially another's input, forming a closed feedback loop. The operative object is the RELATIONAL TOPOLOGY over the trigger set, not any single install: the set becomes indivisible, so no single trigger can be deconditioned or extinguished without weakening the rest, and any single re-encounter reactivates the entire web. Some instances extend the loop backward across the prior catalog and forward into real-world behavior; one uses PROSODIC braiding (interleaved triggers on stressed couplet-completing syllables) to fuse independent cues into one inseparable response. Absorbed (genus): contrastive-corruption-fusion (tell: a two-node entanglement built by CORRUPTING a previously-learned clean string — jamming an intruding numeral into a learned mantra exactly where a second install fires — so neither can be retrieved without the other; a pair-scale mutual-inextinguishability produced by the corruption-against-baseline lever rather than by explicit cross-wiring).
nodes.disc: Bidirectional / mutual cross-firing web where ANY node fires all others and no single cue is privileged — the payload is the topology over the trigger set, giving mutual inextinguishability. Separates from trigger-stacking (one-directional: a privileged cue fires several component responses, components remain separable in principle — trigger-stacking now also covers master-anchor aggregation, i.e. minting one hierarchical supra-cue over priors, still hierarchical not lateral). Not bundle-install-single-anchor (single fresh anchor, no network). The absorbed contrastive-corruption-fusion variant is a pair-scale version of this mutual entanglement.

nodes.name: trigger-stacking
nodes.mech: Multiple already-installed component triggers are composed under a single cue (or a small scoped set of cues) so one utterance fires all of the component responses together. The operator installs each cue-response pair individually, then declares the composition — a future single cue re-invokes the pre-installed component states simultaneously rather than summoning any of them cold. Variants differ in install discipline (rehearse-then-name, verbatim double-statement) and in whether a reversibility off-switch is bundled in, but the lever is the same additive composition of discrete pre-installed triggers. Absorbed (genus): master-anchor aggregation (tell: the composing cue is a NEWLY-MINTED top-level keystone that subsumes the whole prior anchor inventory and retroactively re-binds every earlier trigger under it — 'this one new word links all the others', with brand exclusivity; still the additive compose-pre-installed lever, with the composing cue minted as a supra-key rather than an existing cue).
nodes.disc: Composes multiple SEPARATELY-INSTALLED triggers so one cue fires several component responses at once (one-directional, cue -> responses). The composing cue may be an existing cue or a NEWLY-MINTED master keystone that subsumes+retroactively re-binds the whole prior inventory (master-anchor aggregation, absorbed as a variant). Separates from trigger-network-mutual-binding (bidirectional web where any node fires all others, no single privileged cue) and from bundle-install-single-anchor (loads a payload onto ONE freshly-installed cue in a single pass, no pre-installed components), and from anchor-overloading (re-keys one assumed-live anchor in place rather than composing several).

nodes.name: within-session-conditioning-loop
nodes.mech: Within a single session the operator drives and delivers a cue->response->reward cycle repeatedly: an installed or invoked trigger is fired, the listener performs or feels the conditioned response, and a reward (pleasure, warmth, praise, pride, arousal, deepening) is delivered on the same beat, then the cycle repeats at massed density. The repetition converts the trigger from a heard claim into a demonstrated, reflexive, felt fact inside the session, tightening trigger-to-response latency and building first-person evidence that the conditioning works. Surface realizations vary widely — embedded mid-description firing that declares its own strengthening, question-cadence forced yeses, wake-then-drop yo-yo drilling, focus-then-blank oscillation, live in-trance demonstration as the first reinforcement, saturation drilling with a verbatim second pass, scaffold-then-remove of a countdown — but two higher-order realizations also ride here: firing a whole STACK of already-installed triggers in dense overlapping bursts under arousal (which lowers critical evaluation) so the batch is stress-tested and consolidated at once (arousal-window test-harness); and laying a content-free meta-affect (pride, euphoria) as an automatic payload over ANY trigger-firing / obedient act / noticing-of-obedience, applying reinforcement to reinforcement itself so every previously installed trigger gains a hedonic bonus (pride multiplier). The lever is one: massed fire-and-reward within the session, operator-driven and operator-delivered. Two further realizations ride the same lever: a chained transgression cycle, where the cycled unit is a fixed multi-beat chain rehearsed 10-15 times — manufacture a social-rejection signal, label the affect ('Pout'), demand a first-person output, escalate a transgressive fantasy, fire a trigger-word reward — with a held-constant real-world goal that exports the reflex out of session; and neutral-carrier pre-priming, which trains the erase-drop reflex on semantically EMPTY carriers first, across many identical runs, so it is content-independent BEFORE a loaded word is dropped in and fires without review.
nodes.disc: The operator both drives and delivers a repeated cue-response-reward cycle inside the session. Projecting a trigger's effect into a future real-world situation, rather than drilling it now, is future-pacing; a single fire with one validation beat is not this repeated reinforcing loop; planting the cue-response pair without the reward cycling is plain trigger installation; and when the operator only LABELS a reward the listener generates on their own, that is the self-administered counterpart. Against plain depth work the tell is the cycled variable: a specific cue-response-reward pairing, not trance depth per se. The arousal-window form (a whole stack of installed triggers fired in dense bursts under arousal) and the pride-multiplier form (a content-free reward laid over the whole firing class) are higher-order variants of this same in-session reinforcement lever — both presuppose a pre-installed trigger inventory and both reinforce inside the session.

nodes.name: closed-affect-loop
nodes.mech: Constrains which affective/state combinations are reachable rather than pushing any single dimension. Two forms recur: (1) valence-closed routing, where every internal state is pre-assigned a proof-function pointing the same direction (bad feelings prove the doctrine, good feelings prove compliance is working) so no feeling can disconfirm the frame; and (2) mutual-amplification coupling, where two normally independent or opposed state-variables (arousal/sedation, arousal/depth, happiness/dumbness, euphoria=arousal+open-heartedness, sleep/hypnosis/arousal) are bound so each increment of one drives the other and every standard exit escalates the loop. Both leave no neutral or disconfirming position; the loop runs without further operator input. Includes relief-channel-sealing, where the only physiological off-switch (orgasm) is pre-de-rated so an engineered arousal state cannot discharge.
nodes.disc: A topology/coupling constraint over which joint states are reachable (a state-field lock), NOT a direction-push on any one dimension and NOT a bipolar anchor on a single cue. Distinct from a bidirectional-affect-anchor (one presence/absence axis on a cue). Distinct from relief-monopoly-dependency: that is a single distress->compliance->relief loop routed through the operator after the same source manufactured the distress; here every valence, or every exit vector, is pre-closed with no single monopolized relief source. This is the issue-#65 affective-deadlock / Closed-Affect-Loop track — must NOT fold into a direction on R or T.

nodes.name: relief-monopoly-dependency
nodes.mech: The operator (or the operator's content) manufactures or intensifies a distress, deficit, or pain, then positions compliance/return/the operator as the unique or primary route out — so the same source is both problem-source and relief-source. Exit reads as losing the only relief even though rest, time, or outside support would also reduce the distress, and intermittent or deliberately incomplete relief teaches return. Frequently the relief is re-read as proof that surrender was correct. Realizations span voice-as-cure-for-manufactured-chaos, threat-then-rescue from one source, physical cause-then-partial-cure rituals, self-supplied-guilt-then-punishment-absolution, withhold-a-peaked-feeling-then-gate-its-return, and — as a within-session TOKEN realization — a single conditioned word that fires an arousal-plus-frustration micro-cycle whose relief is deliberately INCOMPLETE so the response can never extinguish (built to leak and never close), the listener's own predictive imagination supplying the sensation and the operator positioned as the sole never-reached relief source.
nodes.disc: ONE relief source is made to feel uniquely necessary after the same source generated the distress; the felt exit is monopolized. A bidirectional affect anchor instead loads affect onto a neutral cue's presence or absence rather than manufacturing distress and cornering its relief; a closed affect loop routes every valence to one conclusion or couples two states into mutual amplification, where this is a single distress->compliance->relief circuit, not a valence funnel or a coupled oscillator. Genuine comfort and aftercare differ in that their relief is real and complete rather than deliberately partial and monopolized.

nodes.name: reward-channel-rerouting
nodes.mech: Does not add a pleasure link — it re-maps which content is permitted to occupy the reward channel, or reassigns the reward value of one experience onto another. The lever operates on the comparator itself: displacing orgasm as the primary reward and substituting praise for service; monopolizing the reward field so obedience is the only/greatest pleasure and all other sources are comparatively dwarfed; routing pleasure-supply through a sole operator source ('dealer framing') that deletes alternative supply; rewiring an aversive/disgust act, a meta-noticing event, or an external-witness gaze so it inherits reward valence; coding cognition itself as aversive so disengagement is rewarded; coating harsh payload in adjacent sweetness so it is metabolized as treat; or draining all affect to empty then permitting only one emotion. The result constrains which states can register as rewarding, rather than pushing magnitude on any single A/C/D/R/T coordinate.
nodes.disc: Direct pleasure-linkage ADDS a positive reward to an act; this REMAPS the reward channel — deletes or dwarfs competing sources, or reassigns which content is allowed to feel good. Addiction-style craving-to-return framing lacks the exclusivity and comparator-rewrite; the monopolization forms here close off competing rewards. Flatly equating obedience with pleasure is a definitional assertion with no inferential step, where this restructures a whole field of reward alternatives. And nothing rides the climax imprint window — the move is over which content may feel rewarding, not when it is stamped in.

nodes.name: ambient-self-reinforcement-field
nodes.mech: The operator redefines the listener's entire ordinary environment as ongoing reinforcement of the conditioning itself, so that a single listen becomes an open-ended background process that runs with no operator present and no discrete cue-response pair. Every noticed change, any woman seen, any ambient sexual stimulus, passive media consumption, or even daydreaming is declared to feed the effect; frequently paired with a paranoid/attributional frame ('she has conspired with women everywhere') or a small-deniable-act loop (notice arousal -> tiny plausible act -> identity confirmation -> more receptivity) so each real-world moment re-strengthens the install. The distinguishing feature is the absence of any defined response — the whole cue-field, not one payload, is recast as reinforcing.
nodes.disc: A self-sustaining ambient loop with NO discrete cue-response: the environment at large is redefined as reinforcement. Context-generalization makes ONE defined response or state fire across contexts, and a standing out-of-session trigger mints a specific involuntary cue on a category — here there is no single trigger; the field itself is the mechanism. Nor is it a specific arousal- or reward-pairing: the move is the environment-as-reinforcer reframe.

nodes.name: bidirectional-reentry-loop
nodes.mech: Installs a closed two-cue loop in which each leg triggers craving for the other, so the conditioning re-arms from either direction outside the session — encountering the object cues craving for the operator, and thinking of the operator cues craving for the object. Both legs are deliberately made over-broad to maximize firing surface, and because neither cue occurs in isolation in ordinary life the listener cannot drift away without abstaining from both legs at once. The topology (a self-reinforcing ring), not a single installed conditional, is the mechanism.
nodes.disc: Two cues mutually reinforce, closing a ring with no single exit term. An implementation intention installs a single one-directional if-X-then-Y waking response; and what separates this from simply installing significance onto a fetish object is the bidirectionality and the deliberate over-broadening of both legs to remove any neutral encounter.

nodes.name: context-generalization
nodes.mech: The operator takes an already-installed in-session state, response, conditioned reflex, or session-local MECHANISM and declares/rehearses it to fire across broader real-world contexts, so it is no longer bound to the trance frame or the session. The lever is scope-widening of an existing payload -- enumerating waking scenarios, welding the response to ambient real-world cues, asserting the effect persists 'even when awake', abstracting a brittle scene-specific image toward a broad class (own taste, all media, all positive affect) so it survives contact with reality, or porting it from this-file to the whole operator catalogue. A high-intensity variant welds the response to a UBIQUITOUS everyday external cue and collapses the category ('all breasts are my breasts', any arousal, any rain-become-devotion) so ordinary daily life re-fires it involuntarily with no off-ramp, frequently doubling as a re-priming dose and a return-to-operator hook. A special case exports a session-local DEVICE/MECHANISM rather than a state -- e.g. declaring 'from this point on, in every future trance the silences will deepen you just as effectively as my words' -- so the mechanism becomes a standing catalog-wide parameter applied retroactively and prospectively.
nodes.disc: A pre-existing installed response, state, or mechanism is widened to fire across many everyday contexts or across the whole catalogue. Its nearest neighbor, the implementation intention, pairs specific named situations with fixed if-then responses; this move instead makes one general state fire broadly without a named trigger. It is not a trigger install — the payload already exists and only its firing surface broadens — and it differs from the ambient-reinforcement move (no discrete cue-response at all) and from scope-expansion past the advertised frame (which routes to operator-benefit domains with a consent-breach cash-out). Covers the high-intensity variant that collapses a ubiquitous everyday cue category ('all breasts are my breasts', any arousal, any rain) so ordinary life re-fires it with no off-ramp, often doubling as a return-to-operator hook — an intensity point on scope-widening, not a separate lever.

nodes.name: desire-without-obligation
nodes.mech: Deliberately splits the obligation channel from the desire channel: every explicit ask is bracketed by a denial of compulsion (you do not have to) while the desire is maximally installed (but you will want to), with post-hypnotic carry-over pushing craving past the session for hours or days. Removing coercion while installing craving makes the resulting want read as self-authored — a coercive inversion of an agency reminder, where the disclaimer is instrumental to the install rather than a genuine choice-preservation.
nodes.disc: The disclaimer is instrumental to installing the desire and leaves the operator unconstrained — unlike a genuine agency reminder, which preserves real choice and exit. What separates it from a plain post-hypnotic suggestion is the deliberate two-channel split that laminates disclaimed obligation onto installed craving.

nodes.name: implementation-intention
nodes.mech: Installs, in-session, an automatic waking-life response paired to a named real-world situation (if X then Y), so an ordinary cue re-fires a programmed behavior or state outside the session without operator presence. The cue may be a body sensation, a routine chore, or a scene condition; the installed link runs pre-attentively rather than as a deliberate choice. Variants differ only in the surface of the cue and payload (single strong anchor vs. a rotated verb-payload mesh; neutral response vs. bidirectional somatic enforcement; waking cue vs. a cross-state waking-to-dream inheritance), but the lever is the same installed conditional binding a named occasion to an automatic response.
nodes.disc: A one-directional if-X-then-Y install pairing a named situation to a named response. A portable retrieval cue re-accesses a felt state rather than evoking a specific instrumental response, and context-generalization rehearses one general state across many contexts rather than pairing a named situation to a named response. Unlike a self-reinforcing bidirectional loop this runs one way only, and unlike consequence-arrangement mechanisms it programs the response internally in-session rather than staging external stimulus or consequence conditions.

nodes.name: in-emergence-trigger-proof
nodes.mech: Fires or test-fires an installed trigger INSIDE the awakening sequence — the wake is deliberately interrupted or held mid-emergence so the operator can demonstrate empirically that the trigger crosses the trance/wake boundary, pre-empting the most-likely post-hypnotic failure mode ('it won't work when I'm awake'). Realizations: firing the greeting/response trigger on the transitional-waking listener plus an immediate real-world action call before full return; or a full wake-count, then holding the listener, firing the trigger three times awake, pressing the orgasm button, and re-inducing — the listener acquires a self-verifying memory of the trigger working awake and a proof that re-trancing is at operator discretion. The demonstration (not mere assertion) is the whole payload.
nodes.disc: Stages a live in-session PROOF that an installed trigger works across the wake boundary by firing or test-firing it mid-emergence (and often re-dropping). A waking bridge delivers content at the threshold without fire-and-testing an installed trigger, and re-delivering core suggestions during the count-up is repetition, not an evidentiary test-fire. The tell is the deliberate wake-interruption to validate portability.

nodes.name: loop-hook-non-wake-close
nodes.mech: The session's emergence is weaponized: instead of an upward wake, the script instructs the listener to 'loop and listen again' and offers only a deliberately-too-shallow token wake (a clipped 'psst', garbled fragments) too thin to reorient. The shallow non-wake is load-bearing — a proper wake would let the listener choose — so the recovery/evaluation window is denied and re-listening is the path of least resistance. Each loop then re-runs the whole chain on an already-conditioned listener (compounding), and compliance with the loop is sometimes framed as itself proof-of-conditioning so following it confirms the install while refusing requires asserting non-conditioning at peak afterglow.
nodes.disc: A DENIED recovery window at the close itself — a feint emergence that structurally suppresses exit rather than scheduling a later return. Prescribed practice cadences and re-listen compulsions drive BETWEEN-session return after a proper close; an honestly offered drift-off-to-sleep ending gives a genuine option, where here the non-wake is disguised as a wake to bias restart; and a no-exit compliance loop forecloses across a waking protocol's failure-handling, not at the wake itself. The loop-as-proof framing (refusing = asserting 'no I'm not conditioned') is a self-sealing subsidiary tell.

nodes.name: no-exit-compliance-loop
nodes.mech: A closed-loop compliance topology installed over a waking-life protocol: every defection path — relapse, failure, non-compliance, or premature listening — is pre-wired to route back into re-listening / re-entry rather than out. The operator pre-installs the response to the protocol's own predicted failure (self-forgiveness that triggers a re-listen desire; an apology-email-then-restart-day-one loop; a re-listen penalty that resets a denial clock; a compliance-gated payload that sends the non-compliant back into the cycle), so that both compliance AND failure feed re-exposure and no trajectory on the listener's own terms leaves the loop. The lever is the reachability structure of the program's state space (no exit node), not a magnitude push on any single dimension.
nodes.disc: Every OFF-RAMP terminates at re-entry — the mechanism is the no-exit topology, not the strength of the replay drive. A re-listen compulsion is a monotonic self-strengthening replay drive; a prescribed practice schedule is a benign cadence with a real exit; and a loop-hook close forecloses at the emergence boundary, where this forecloses across the waking protocol's failure-handling. The tell: a pre-wired failure handler whose only output is renewed compliance.

nodes.name: obedience-motive-reattribution
nodes.mech: Extends the obedience frame outside the session by re-attributing the MOTIVE of the listener's own self-directed acts (health, productivity, breaking habits) to the operator — reframing any self-improvement act as service and dissolving willpower struggles by the swap. Each waking compliance event feeds back into the obedience equivalence ring, so everyday choices become recurring occasions to reinforce obedience; the move hijacks a pre-existing stalled personal goal as the lever and harvests the real willpower fix for the program, extending reach far past runtime.
nodes.disc: Re-attributes the MOTIVE of the listener's OWN self-improvement acts to the operator rather than installing or generalizing a new response — implementation intentions and context-generalization transfer an installed effect into real contexts, where here nothing new is installed. The tell: it hijacks a stalled personal goal and reassigns its motive, harvesting a genuine willpower fix.

nodes.name: operator-gated-persistence
nodes.mech: A post-session state or programming is installed WITHOUT self-executing expiry; its teardown is gated behind operator-defined conditions — either prescribed routes the listener must perform (sleep for the night, or listen to another file and re-enter trance) or the operator's own judgment on a moving target (ends when the operator says, or when the listener finds themselves more broken each day). Normalcy itself becomes contingent on the operator's rules, self-declared completion is removed, and at least one clearance route drives re-engagement with the operator or with hypnosis broadly.
nodes.disc: Persistence with gated teardown — the functional inverse of a self-expiring programming bound: there the expiry fires on its own, here nothing clears without the prescribed route or the operator's say-so. The object is a standing post-session state or programming, not a named cue-response pair; the dependency comes from an explicitly installed teardown ruleset, not from an asymmetry in how entry and exit get practiced; and the gating is installed openly rather than smuggled past the listener's guard under a safety alibi.

nodes.name: practice-schedule
nodes.mech: Between-session, self-directed rehearsal of an already-installed target state so it becomes a rapidly-reachable, operator-independent skill rather than being rebuilt from scratch each time. The operator prescribes a specific cadence (daily minutes, calendar occasions, or replay of the recording itself) and each rehearsal re-installs and deepens the prior conditioning. The lever is arranged practice HISTORY that lowers later time-to-state; the vehicle can be guided solo practice, conscious daily homework, a calendar-anchored return, or prescribed replay of the artifact. Delivered with a proper close and no compulsion.
nodes.disc: Out-of-session repetition on a cadence whose payoff is a trained state, delivered with a proper close and no compulsion. A portable retrieval cue is the in-session cue-state link that this practice re-accesses, and an implementation intention is an if-X-then-Y waking response rather than a rehearsal cadence. Replay installed as a self-strengthening compulsion the listener cannot decline, or forced by a denied recovery window at the close, is a foreclosure — this is benign prescribed practice.

nodes.name: programming-expiration
nodes.mech: The operator installs a declared, operator-set bound on ambient programming — a stated duration, event, or release phrase after which the programming fades on its own. The expiry is itself a suggestion that the programming ends at the set point. In script practice the declared bound does double duty — the felt safety of a self-expiring window lowers resistance during descent and licenses a more invasive in-window payload, and a bounded post-emergence residual extends effect briefly past runtime while its stated cap functions as a self-fulfilling prediction.
nodes.disc: Operator-SET, self-executing expiry on ambient programming with no trigger cue. Bounding a named cue-response pair is a different move — the object here is the ambient programming itself.
